  setDetailReturnScrollId: (val: string) => void;
  budgetTabSearchTerm: string;
  setBudgetTabSearchTerm: (val: string) => void;
  costTabSearchTerm: string;
  setCostTabSearchTerm: (val: string) => void;
  tabHistory: TabId[];
  setTabHistory: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<TabId[]>>;
  locationVisibility: Record<string, boolean>;
  activeNotifications: ActiveNotification[];
  readNotifs: string[] | Set<string>;
  notificationFilterId: string | null;
  setNotificationFilterId: (val: string | null) => void;
  unreadCount: number;
  handleRequestPermission: () => Promise<void>;
  notifActions: any;
  notificationRules: NotificationRule[];
  handleTabChange: (tab: TabId) => void;
  handleNavigateToLayout: (projectCode: string, store: string, location?: string, taskId?: string) => void;
  handleNavigateToTaskDetail: (projectCode: string, store: string, taskId?: string) => void;
  setQuickNavTarget: (target: any) => void;
  setEditingProject: (p: Project | null) => void;
  setEditingTask: (t: Task | null) => void;
  setEditingUser: (u: AppUser | null) => void;
  setIsReadOnlyModal: (val: boolean) => void;
  setModalInitialTab: (val: "details" | "chat") => void;
  setIsProjectModalOpen: (val: boolean) => void;
  setIsTaskModalOpen: (val: boolean) => void;
  setIsUserModalOpen: (val: boolean) => void;
  setPrefillProjectCode: (val: string) => void;
  setPrefillProjectYear: (val: number | null) => void;
  setPrefillProjectStore: (val: string | null) => void;
  isAppReadyRef: React.MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  executeDeepLinkRef: React.MutableRefObject<((type: string, id: string | number, extra?: any) => void) | null>;
  onRenderCallback: (id: string, phase: any, actualDuration: number, baseDuration: number, startTime: number, commitTime: number) => void;
}

export const AppTabRouter: React.FC<AppTabRouterProps> = React.memo(({
  activeTab,
  currentUser,
  userRole,
  permissionMatrix,
  layoutTabFilters,
  setLayoutTabFilters,
  ganttTabFocusTaskId,
  setGanttTabFocusTaskId,
  detailTabFilterCode,
  setDetailTabFilterCode,
  globalStoreFilter,
  globalYearFilter,
  setGlobalStoreFilter,
  setGlobalYearFilter,
  detailTabFocusTaskId,
  setDetailTabFocusTaskId,
  detailReturnScrollId,
  setDetailReturnScrollId,
  budgetTabSearchTerm,
  setBudgetTabSearchTerm,
  costTabSearchTerm,
  setCostTabSearchTerm,
  tabHistory,
  setTabHistory,
  locationVisibility,
  activeNotifications,
  readNotifs,
  notificationFilterId,
  setNotificationFilterId,
  unreadCount,
  handleRequestPermission,
  notifActions,
  notificationRules,
  handleTabChange,
  handleNavigateToLayout,
  handleNavigateToTaskDetail,
  setQuickNavTarget,
  setEditingProject,
  setEditingTask,
  setEditingUser,
  setIsReadOnlyModal,
  setModalInitialTab,
  setIsProjectModalOpen,
  setIsTaskModalOpen,
  setIsUserModalOpen,
  setPrefillProjectCode,
  setPrefillProjectYear,
  setPrefillProjectStore,
  isAppReadyRef,
  executeDeepLinkRef,
  onRenderCallback,
}) => {
  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();
  const appUsers = useAppStore(state => state.appUsers);
  const setActiveTab = useAppStore(state => state.setActiveTab);

  return (
    <div className="flex-grow flex flex-col min-h-0 relative z-[10]">
      <TabErrorBoundary tabKey={activeTab}>
        <Suspense fallback={
          <div className="flex-1 w-full h-full p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 animate-pulse bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0e0e11]">
            <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full space-y-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="h-8 w-48 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#18181a] rounded-lg"></div>
                <div className="h-8 w-24 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#18181a] rounded-lg"></div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                {[1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => <div key={i} className="h-24 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#18181a] rounded-xl"></div>)}
              </div>
              <div className="h-[400px] w-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#18181a] rounded-xl"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        }>
          <motion.div
            key={activeTab}
            initial={{ opacity: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.06 }}
            className="flex flex-col flex-grow min-h-0"
          >
              {activeTab === "layout" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.layout) && (
                  <LayoutTab
                    initialStore={layoutTabFilters?.store}
                    initialLocation={layoutTabFilters?.location}
                    initialProjectCode={layoutTabFilters?.projectCode}
                    onClearFocus={() => setLayoutTabFilters(null)}
                    onBackToGantt={() => {
                      if (layoutTabFilters?.sourceTaskId) {
                        setGanttTabFocusTaskId(layoutTabFilters.sourceTaskId);
                      } else {
                        setGanttTabFocusTaskId("");
                      }
                      handleTabChange("gantt");
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "summary" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" ||
                  permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.summary ||
                  permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.report) && (
                  <SummaryTab />
                )}

              {activeTab === "general" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.general) && (
                  <GeneralTab
                    onProjectClick={(p) => {
                      setQuickNavTarget({ project: p });
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "detail" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.detail) && (
                  <Profiler id="DetailTab" onRender={onRenderCallback}>
                    <DetailTab
                      initialFilterCode={detailTabFilterCode}
                      initialStoreFilter={globalStoreFilter}
                      initialFocusTaskId={detailTabFocusTaskId}
                      returnScrollId={detailReturnScrollId}
                      onClearFocus={() => {
                        setDetailReturnScrollId(detailTabFocusTaskId);
                        setDetailTabFocusTaskId("");
                      }}
                      onBackToGantt={() => {
                        setDetailReturnScrollId(detailTabFocusTaskId);
                        setDetailTabFocusTaskId("");
                        setDetailTabFilterCode("");
                        handleTabChange("gantt");
                      }}
                      onAddProject={() => {
                        setEditingProject(null);
                        setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                        setModalInitialTab("details");
                        setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      onAddTask={(p) => {
                        if (!isAppReadyRef.current) return;
                        const safeP = p || (projects && projects.length > 0 ? projects[0] : null);
                        setPrefillProjectCode(safeP?.code || "");
                        setPrefillProjectYear(safeP?.year || null);
                        setPrefillProjectStore(safeP?.store || null);
                        setEditingTask(null);
                        setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                        setModalInitialTab("details");
                        setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      onEditProject={(p, isReadOnly, initialTab) => {
                        setEditingProject(p);
                        setIsReadOnlyModal(isReadOnly || false);
                        setModalInitialTab((initialTab as "details" | "chat") || "details");
                        setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      onEditTask={(t, isReadOnly, initialTab) => {
                        setEditingTask(t);
                        setIsReadOnlyModal(isReadOnly || false);
                        setModalInitialTab((initialTab as "details" | "chat") || "details");
                        setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                      }}
                      onNavigateToDelegation={(groupId, sourceTaskId) => {
                        if (sourceTaskId) setDetailReturnScrollId(sourceTaskId);
                        handleTabChange("taskDelegation");
                        setTimeout(() => {
                          window.dispatchEvent(
                            new CustomEvent("taka_open_delegation_group", {
                              detail: { groupId },
                            }),
                          );
                        }, 400);
                      }}
                    />
                  </Profiler>
                )}

              {activeTab === "calendar" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" ||
                  permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.calendar ||
                  permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.report) && (
                  <CalendarTab
                    onEditTask={(t, isReadOnly) => {
                      setEditingTask(t);
                      setIsReadOnlyModal(isReadOnly || false);
                      setModalInitialTab("details");
                      setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                    }}
                    onEditProject={(p, isReadOnly) => {
                      setEditingProject(p);
                      setIsReadOnlyModal(isReadOnly || false);
                      setModalInitialTab("details");
                      setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "gantt" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.report) && (
                  <Profiler id="GanttTab" onRender={onRenderCallback}>
                    <div className="flex flex-col flex-grow min-h-0">
                      <GanttTab
                        initialFocusTaskId={ganttTabFocusTaskId}
                        onClearFocus={() => setGanttTabFocusTaskId("")}
                        onNavigateToLayout={handleNavigateToLayout}
                        onNavigateToTaskDetail={handleNavigateToTaskDetail}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </Profiler>
                )}

              {activeTab === "budget" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.budget) && (
                  <BudgetTab
                    initialSearchTerm={budgetTabSearchTerm}
                    onGoToCost={(code) => {
                      setCostTabSearchTerm(code ? String(code).replace(/["']/g, '').trim() : "");
                      handleTabChange("cost");
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "taskDelegation" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.taskDelegation) && (
                  <TaskDelegationTab
                    onBackFromFocus={() => {
                      if (tabHistory.length > 0) {
                        const prev = tabHistory[tabHistory.length - 1];
                        setTabHistory((h) => h.slice(0, -1));
                        setActiveTab(prev);
                      } else {
                        setActiveTab("detail");
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "taskDelegationCalendar" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.taskDelegation) && (
                  <DelegationCalendarTab
                    groups={visibleDelegationGroups}
                    onTabChange={handleTabChange}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "cost" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.costDetail) && (
                  <CostTab
                    initialSearchTerm={costTabSearchTerm}
                    onGoToBudget={(code) => {
                      setBudgetTabSearchTerm(code);
                      handleTabChange("budget");
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "accControl" && (
                <AccControlTab
                  users={appUsers}
                  locationVisibility={locationVisibility}
                  onEditUser={(u) => {
                    setEditingUser(u);
                    setIsUserModalOpen(true);
                  }}
                  onAddUser={() => {
                    setEditingUser(null);
                    setIsUserModalOpen(true);
                  }}
                />
              )}

              {activeTab === "notification" &&
                (currentUser.role === "admin" || currentUser.notification !== false) && (
                  <NotificationTab
                    activeNotifications={activeNotifications}
                    readNotifs={readNotifs}
                    filterId={notificationFilterId}
                    initialStatusFilter={unreadCount > 0 ? "unread" : "all"}
                    onClearFilter={() => setNotificationFilterId(null)}
                    onRequestPermission={handleRequestPermission}
                    onTogglePushEnabled={notifActions.onTogglePushEnabled}
                    onToggleRead={notifActions.onToggleRead}
                    onMarkAllRead={() => notifActions.onMarkAllRead(activeNotifications)}
                    onActionAgree={notifActions.onActionAgree}
                    onActionReject={notifActions.onActionReject}
                    onQuickCompleteTask={notifActions.onQuickCompleteTask}
                    onSnoozeNotif={notifActions.onSnoozeNotif}
                    onClearStaleNotifs={() => notifActions.onClearStaleNotifs(activeNotifications)}
                    onNotificationClick={(notif) => {
                      notifActions.onNotificationClick(notif);

                      if (notif.targetId && notif.targetType) {
                        if (notif.targetType === "notification") {
                          setNotificationFilterId(notif.targetId);
                          handleTabChange("notification");
                          return;
                        }

                        const canSeeLayout = currentUser.role === "admin" || !!permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.layout;
                        const combinedProjects = (projects && projects.length > 0) ? projects : (useAppStore.getState().allProjectsForNotifs || []);
                        const combinedTasks = (tasks && tasks.length > 0) ? tasks : (useAppStore.getState().allTasksForNotifs || []);
                        const layoutMatch = canSeeLayout ? findProjectLayoutUnit(notif, combinedProjects, combinedTasks) : null;

                        if (canSeeLayout && layoutMatch) {
                          const targetYear = layoutMatch.year || (layoutMatch.project?.year ? String(layoutMatch.project.year) : (notif.projectYear ? String(notif.projectYear) : ''));
                          if (targetYear && targetYear !== globalYearFilter && targetYear !== 'all') {
                            setGlobalYearFilter(targetYear);
                          }
                          const targetStore = layoutMatch.store || notif.projectStore || 'HCM';
                          if (targetStore && targetStore !== 'all') {
                            setGlobalStoreFilter(targetStore);
                          }
                          const targetLocation = layoutMatch.location || 'L1';
                          if (targetLocation && targetLocation !== 'ALL') {
                            useAppStore.getState().setGlobalLocationFilter([targetLocation]);
                          }

                          const targetUnitCode = layoutMatch.unitCode || layoutMatch.project?.code || notif.projectCode || (notif.title && notif.title.includes(' - ') ? notif.title.split(' - ')[0].trim() : '');

                          setLayoutTabFilters({
                            store: targetStore,
                            location: targetLocation,
                            projectCode: targetUnitCode,
                            sourceTaskId: layoutMatch.task?.id,
                          });

                          handleTabChange("layout");

                          if (layoutMatch.isComment) {
                            if (layoutMatch.isTaskComment && layoutMatch.task) {
                              setEditingTask(layoutMatch.task);
                              setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                              setModalInitialTab("chat");
                              setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                            } else if (layoutMatch.project) {
                              setEditingProject(layoutMatch.project);
                              setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                              setModalInitialTab("chat");
                              setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
                            }
                          }
                          return;
                        }

                        if (notif.targetType === "task_delegation") {
                          handleTabChange("detail");
                          const targetProject =
                            layoutMatch?.project ||
                            combinedProjects.find(
                              (p) =>
                                (notif.projectCode && p.code?.toLowerCase() === notif.projectCode.toLowerCase()) ||
                                String(p.id) === String(notif.targetId) ||
                                String(p.no) === String(notif.targetId)
                            );

                          if (targetProject) {
                            setEditingProject(targetProject);
                            setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                            setModalInitialTab("chat");
                            setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
                          } else if (layoutMatch?.task) {
                            setEditingTask(layoutMatch.task);
                            setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
                            setModalInitialTab("chat");
                            setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                            return;
                          }
                        }

                        executeDeepLinkRef.current?.(
                          notif.targetType,
                          notif.targetId,
                          {
                            store: notif.projectStore,
                            year: String(notif.projectYear),
                            code: notif.projectCode,
                          }
                        );
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                )}

              {activeTab === "setting" && (
                <SettingTab rules={notificationRules} />
              )}

              {activeTab === "manual" && (
                <ManualTab />
              )}

              {activeTab === "audit" && (currentUser.role === "admin" || (permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See as any)?.audit) && (
                <AuditLogTab />
              )}

              {activeTab === "csv_export" && (currentUser.role === "admin" || !!permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.importCsv || !!permissionMatrix[userRole]?.Write?.importCsv) && (
                <CsvExportTab />
              )}

              {activeTab === "picture_mapping" && (currentUser.role === "admin" || !!permissionMatrix[userRole]?.See?.pictureMapping || !!permissionMatrix[userRole]?.Write?.pictureMapping) && (
                <PictureMappingTab />
              )}
            </motion.div>
        </Suspense>
      </TabErrorBoundary>
    </div>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/AppTour.tsx ==================== */
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { Portal } from './Portal';
import { X, ChevronRight, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';

interface AppTourProps {
  onClose: () => void;
}

const steps = [
  {
    title: "Welcome to the App!",
    content: "Since this is your first time here as a guest, let's take a quick tour to help you get started.",
  },
  {
    title: "Navigation",
    content: "Use the tabs at the top to switch between Dashboard, Gantt chart, Tasks, and more. This is how you access all the main features.",
  },
  {
    title: "Notifications",
    content: "The bell icon in the top right shows your notifications. You'll see alerts here when someone mentions you or assigns a task.",
  },
  {
    title: "Settings & Options",
    content: "Click the icons on the top right to customize your experience, switch to Dark Mode, change the language, or manage your keyboard shortcuts.",
  },
];

export function AppTour({ onClose}: AppTourProps) {

  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups: delegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  const theme = useAppStore(state => state.theme);
  const appUsers = useAppStore(state => state.appUsers);
  const subAppUsers = useAppStore(state => state.subAppUsers);
  const parties = useAppStore(state => state.parties);

  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  const nextStep = () => {
    if (currentStep < steps.length - 1) {
      setCurrentStep(prev => prev + 1);
    } else {
      onClose();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Portal>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>
        <div 
          className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl shadow-xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden relative"
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          
          <button onClick={onClose} className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          
          <div className="p-6">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-xl text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] mb-2">{steps[currentStep].title}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] mb-8 min-h-[60px]">
              {steps[currentStep].content}
            </p>
            
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                {steps.map((_, idx) => (
                  <div 
                    key={idx} 
                    className={cn(
                      "w-2 h-2 rounded-full transition-colors",
                      idx === currentStep ? "bg-blue-600" : "bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336]"
                    )}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
              
              <button
                onClick={nextStep}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm transition-colors"
              >
                {currentStep === steps.length - 1 ? (
                  <>Get Started <Check className="w-4 h-4" /></>
                ) : (
                  <>Next <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /></>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          
        </div>
      </div>
    </Portal>
  );
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/AuditDiffViewerModal.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { Portal } from './Portal';
import { AuditLog } from '../types';
import { formatDisplayDateTime } from '../lib/utils';
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from './DebouncedSearchInput';
import { 
  X, GripHorizontal, ArrowRight, Copy, Check, ShieldCheck, 
  Layers, Clock, User, FileText, Search, Code2, Columns2, 
  PlusCircle, MinusCircle, RefreshCw
} from 'lucide-react';

interface AuditDiffViewerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  log: AuditLog | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function AuditDiffViewerModal({ isOpen, log, onClose }: AuditDiffViewerModalProps) {
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'visual' | 'side-by-side' | 'raw'>('visual');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen || !log) return null;

  const handleCopyJson = () => {
    try {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(log, null, 2));
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch {}
  };

  const isFinancialKey = (key: string) => {
    const k = key.toLowerCase();
    return k.includes('budget') || k.includes('cost') || k.includes('fee') || k.includes('amount') || k.includes('price') || k.includes('total');
  };

  const formatValue = (key: string, val: any): React.ReactNode => {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) {
      return <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic font-mono text-xs">null</span>;
    }
    if (typeof val === 'boolean') {
      return (
        <span className={`inline-flex px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold ${val ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300'}`}>
          {val ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE'}
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (typeof val === 'number') {
      if (isFinancialKey(key) || Math.abs(val) >= 10000) {
        return (
          <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
            {new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(val)} <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-normal">₫</span>
          </span>
        );
      }
      return <span className="font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-semibold">{val}</span>;
    }
    if (typeof val === 'string') {
      // Check for ISO Date
      if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(val)) {
        return <span className="font-mono text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-medium">{val}</span>;
      }
      // Status badges
      const lower = val.toLowerCase();
      if (lower === 'completed' || lower === 'finished' || lower === 'done' || lower === 'active') {
        return <span className="inline-flex px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 font-semibold text-xs">{val}</span>;
      }
      if (lower === 'in progress' || lower === 'doing' || lower === 'ongoing') {
        return <span className="inline-flex px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 font-semibold text-xs">{val}</span>;
      }
      if (lower === 'pending' || lower === 'waiting' || lower === 'delayed') {
        return <span className="inline-flex px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/40 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 font-semibold text-xs">{val}</span>;
      }
      return <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 break-words">{val}</span>;
    }
    if (typeof val === 'object') {
      return (
        <pre className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#121214] p-1.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 overflow-x-auto max-h-32">
          {JSON.stringify(val, null, 2)}
        </pre>
      );
    }
    return String(val);
  };

  // Compile all changed keys
  const prevObj = log.previousData || {};
  const currentObj = log.data || {};
  const allKeysSet = new Set<string>();

  if (typeof prevObj === 'object' && prevObj !== null) {
    Object.keys(prevObj).forEach(k => allKeysSet.add(k));
  }
  if (typeof currentObj === 'object' && currentObj !== null) {
    Object.keys(currentObj).forEach(k => allKeysSet.add(k));
  }

  const allKeys = Array.from(allKeysSet).filter(k => 
    !searchTerm || k.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  const getActionBadgeClass = (action: string) => {
    switch (action) {
      case 'CREATE': return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800';
      case 'UPDATE': return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800';
      case 'DELETE': return 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/60 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800';
      default: return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700';
    }
  };

  const getEntityBadgeClass = (entity?: string) => {
    switch (entity) {
      case 'project': return 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300 border-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-800';
      case 'task': return 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-950/60 dark:text-sky-300 border-sky-300 dark:border-sky-800';
      case 'cost': return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800';
      case 'user': return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/60 dark:text-purple-300 border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800';
      case 'delegation': return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 dark:bg-orange-950/60 dark:text-orange-300 border-orange-300 dark:border-orange-800';
      default: return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700';
    }
  };

  return (
    <Portal>
      <div 
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-[9999] p-2 md:p-6"
        onClick={(e) => {
          if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
        }}
      >
        <Draggable 
          disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} 
          handle=".modal-handle" 
          bounds="parent" 
          nodeRef={nodeRef} 
          cancel="button, input, select, textarea, pre"
        >
          <div 
            ref={nodeRef} 
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 pointer-events-auto"
          >
            {/* Modal Draggable Header */}
            <div className="modal-handle cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#2e2e32] flex items-center justify-between select-none">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                  <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white">
                    Audit Event Diff Viewer
                  </h2>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={handleCopyJson}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3a3a3e] bg-white dark:bg-[#252528] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#2e2e32] transition-colors active:scale-95"
                  title="Copy full JSON event"
                >
                  {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy JSON'}</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#2e2e32] transition-colors active:scale-95"
                  title="Close (Esc)"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Event Metadata Bar */}
            <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-slate-100/70 dark:bg-[#141416] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#2e2e32] flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold border text-[11px] ${getActionBadgeClass(log.action)}`}>
                  {log.action}
                </span>
                <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold border uppercase text-[10px] ${getEntityBadgeClass(log.entityType)}`}>
                  {log.entityType || 'Document'}
                </span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 ml-1">
                  <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                  <span className="font-semibold">{log.userEmail}</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-mono">({log.userId})</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                  <span>{formatDisplayDateTime(new Date(log.timestamp).toISOString())}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-[220px] truncate" title={log.docPath}>
                  <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">{log.docId}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Controls & View Mode Tabs */}
            <div className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#28282b] flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#222226] p-1 rounded-xl w-full sm:w-auto">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('visual')}
                  className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                    viewMode === 'visual'
                      ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#2e2e34] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Visual Changes</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('side-by-side')}
                  className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                    viewMode === 'side-by-side'
                      ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#2e2e34] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Columns2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Side-by-Side</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('raw')}
                  className={`flex-1 sm:flex-initial flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                    viewMode === 'raw'
                      ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#2e2e34] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Code2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Raw Event</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {viewMode !== 'raw' && (
                <div className="relative w-full sm:w-64">
                  <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5 z-10 pointer-events-none" />
                  <DebouncedSearchInput
                    placeholder="Filter field changes..."
                    value={searchTerm}
                    onChange={(val) => setSearchTerm(val)}
                    debounceMs={200}
                    className="w-full pl-8 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#222226] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Main Diff Content Container */}
            <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto max-h-[60vh] space-y-4">
              {/* TAB 1: VISUAL FIELD CHANGES */}
              {viewMode === 'visual' && (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {allKeys.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="text-center py-10 text-slate-400 text-sm">
                      No matching field differences found.
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    allKeys.map((key) => {
                      const prevVal = prevObj[key];
                      const nextVal = currentObj[key];
                      const hasPrev = key in prevObj;
                      const hasNext = key in currentObj;

                      const isChanged = hasPrev && hasNext && JSON.stringify(prevVal) !== JSON.stringify(nextVal);
                      const isAdded = !hasPrev && hasNext;
                      const isRemoved = hasPrev && !hasNext;

                      return (
                        <div 
                          key={key} 
                          className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e22] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#2e2e32] rounded-xl p-3.5 transition-all hover:border-indigo-200 dark:hover:border-indigo-900"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282c] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383c]">
                                {key}
                              </span>
                              {isAdded && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                                  <PlusCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> ADDED
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {isRemoved && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                                  <MinusCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> REMOVED
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {isChanged && (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                                  <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" /> MODIFIED
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {/* Comparison Grid */}
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-1 text-xs">
                            {/* Before */}
                            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg border ${
                              isChanged || isRemoved 
                                ? 'bg-rose-50/70 dark:bg-rose-950/20 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/40 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200' 
                                : 'bg-white dark:bg-[#252528] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336]'
                            }`}>
                              <div className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span>Before</span>
                                {isChanged && <span className="text-rose-500 font-mono">- OLD</span>}
                              </div>
                              <div className="break-words">
                                {hasPrev ? formatValue(key, prevVal) : <span className="text-slate-400 italic">Not set</span>}
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* After */}
                            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg border ${
                              isChanged || isAdded 
                                ? 'bg-emerald-50/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200' 
                                : 'bg-white dark:bg-[#252528] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336]'
                            }`}>
                              <div className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span>After</span>
                                {(isChanged || isAdded) && <span className="text-emerald-500 font-mono">+ NEW</span>}
                              </div>
                              <div className="break-words">
                                {hasNext ? formatValue(key, nextVal) : <span className="text-slate-400 italic">Removed</span>}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* TAB 2: SIDE-BY-SIDE JSON */}
              {viewMode === 'side-by-side' && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 rounded-xl p-4 font-mono text-xs overflow-x-auto border border-slate-800">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 mb-2 border-b border-slate-800 text-rose-400 font-bold">
                      <span>PREVIOUS STATE (BEFORE)</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Snapshot</span>
                    </div>
                    <pre>{JSON.stringify(prevObj, null, 2)}</pre>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 rounded-xl p-4 font-mono text-xs overflow-x-auto border border-slate-800">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 mb-2 border-b border-slate-800 text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                      <span>CURRENT STATE (AFTER)</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Committed Payload</span>
                    </div>
                    <pre>{JSON.stringify(currentObj, null, 2)}</pre>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* TAB 3: RAW EVENT INSPECTOR */}
              {viewMode === 'raw' && (
                <div className="bg-slate-950 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl p-4 font-mono text-xs overflow-x-auto border border-slate-800 shadow-inner max-h-[50vh]">
                  <pre>{JSON.stringify(log, null, 2)}</pre>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Modal Footer */}
            <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1a1a1d] border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#28282b] flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Takashimaya Immutable Audit Trail • Enterprise Security
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-900 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
              >
                Close Viewer
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Draggable>
      </div>
    </Portal>
  );
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/AuditLogParts/AuditLogFilterToolbar.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from '../DebouncedSearchInput';

interface AuditLogFilterToolbarProps {
  entityFilter: string;
  setEntityFilter: (val: string) => void;
  actionFilter: string;
  setActionFilter: (val: string) => void;
  userEmailFilter: string;
  setUserEmailFilter: (val: string) => void;
  onSearch: () => void;
  indexWarningUrl: string | null;
}

export const AuditLogFilterToolbar: React.FC<AuditLogFilterToolbarProps> = ({
  entityFilter,
  setEntityFilter,
  actionFilter,
  setActionFilter,
  userEmailFilter,
  setUserEmailFilter,
  onSearch,
  indexWarningUrl,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-white tracking-tight">Audit Logs</h1>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800">
              <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" /> Diff Visualizer Active
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Enterprise activity history & immutable audit trail. Click any row to inspect visual Before & After changes.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 w-full md:w-auto">
          <select
            value={entityFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setEntityFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-800 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Modules</option>
            <option value="project">Projects</option>
            <option value="task">Tasks</option>
            <option value="cost">Costs & Finance</option>
            <option value="delegation">Delegations</option>
            <option value="user">Users & RBAC</option>
          </select>

          <select
            value={actionFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setActionFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-800 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Actions</option>
            <option value="CREATE">CREATE</option>
            <option value="UPDATE">UPDATE</option>
            <option value="DELETE">DELETE</option>
          </select>

          <div className="flex relative items-center">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5 z-10 pointer-events-none" />
            <DebouncedSearchInput
              placeholder="User email..."
              value={userEmailFilter}
              onChange={(val) => setUserEmailFilter(val)}
              debounceMs={250}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && onSearch()}
              className="w-full sm:w-64 pl-9 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] rounded-l-lg text-sm text-slate-800 dark:text-white outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
            />
            <button
              onClick={onSearch}
              className="bg-slate-800 dark:bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-r-lg text-sm font-semibold active:scale-95 transition-transform"
            >
              Search
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {indexWarningUrl && (
        <div className="bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/50 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-bold">⚡ In-Memory Filtering Active:</span>
            <span>Firestore composite index is being synced. Logs are automatically filtered in memory without interruption.</span>
          </div>
          <a
            href={indexWarningUrl}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"

interface AuditLogRowItemProps {
  log: AuditLog;
  onSelect: (log: AuditLog) => void;

const renderDataPreview = (data: any) => {
  if (!data) return <span className="text-slate-400 italic">No data</span>;
  const str = JSON.stringify(data);
  if (str.length > 80)
    return <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">{str.substring(0, 80)}...</span>;
  return <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">{str}</span>;
};

export const AuditLogRowItem: React.FC<AuditLogRowItemProps> = React.memo(({ log, onSelect }) => {

    <tr

            log.entityType
          )}`}
        >
          {log.entityType || 'system'}
        </span>
      </td>

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/AuditLogParts/auditLogTypes.ts ==================== */
import { AuditLog } from '../../types';

export interface AuditLogTabProps {}

export type AuditActionFilter = 'ALL' | 'CREATE' | 'UPDATE' | 'DELETE';
export type AuditEntityFilter = 'ALL' | 'project' | 'task' | 'cost' | 'delegation' | 'user';

export const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

export const getActionColor = (action: string) => {
  switch (action) {
    case 'CREATE':
      return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-300';
    case 'UPDATE':
      return 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300';
    case 'DELETE':
      return 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-500/20 dark:text-rose-300';
    default:
      return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-500/20 dark:text-slate-300';
  }
};

export const getEntityBadgeColor = (entity?: string) => {
  switch (entity) {
    case 'project':
      return 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 dark:bg-indigo-500/20 dark:text-indigo-300';
    case 'task':
      return 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-800 dark:bg-sky-500/20 dark:text-sky-300';
    case 'cost':
      return 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-300';
    case 'user':
      return 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-500/20 dark:text-purple-300';
    case 'delegation':
      return 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 dark:bg-orange-500/20 dark:text-orange-300';
    default:
      return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-700/50 dark:text-slate-300';
  }
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/AuditLogParts/useAuditLogData.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  collection,
  query,
  orderBy,
  limit,
  startAfter,
  getDocs,
  where,
  QueryConstraint,
} from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { AuditLog } from '../../types';
import { PAGE_SIZE } from './auditLogTypes';

export function useAuditLogData() {
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<AuditLog[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedLog, setSelectedLog] = useState<AuditLog | null>(null);

  // Pagination state
  const [lastVisible, setLastVisible] = useState<any>(null);
  const [firstVisible, setFirstVisible] = useState<any>(null);
  const [pageHistory, setPageHistory] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);

  // Filters
  const [actionFilter, setActionFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [entityFilter, setEntityFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [userEmailFilter, setUserEmailFilter] = useState<string>('');
  const [indexWarningUrl, setIndexWarningUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fetchLogs = async (direction: 'next' | 'prev' | 'initial' = 'initial') => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      const qConstraints: QueryConstraint[] = [orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')];

      if (actionFilter !== 'ALL') {
        qConstraints.push(where('action', '==', actionFilter));
      }
      if (entityFilter !== 'ALL') {
        qConstraints.push(where('entityType', '==', entityFilter));
      }
      if (userEmailFilter.trim()) {
        qConstraints.push(where('userEmail', '==', userEmailFilter.trim()));
      }

      qConstraints.push(limit(PAGE_SIZE));

      if (direction === 'next' && lastVisible) {
        qConstraints.push(startAfter(lastVisible));
      } else if (direction === 'prev') {
        const prevDoc = pageHistory[currentPage - 2];
        if (prevDoc) {
          qConstraints.push(startAfter(prevDoc));
        }
      }

      let snapshot;
      try {
        const q = query(collection(db, 'audit_logs'), ...qConstraints);
        snapshot = await getDocs(q);
      } catch (queryErr: any) {
        const msg = queryErr?.message || '';
        if (
          msg.includes('requires an index') ||
          msg.includes('indexes?create_composite') ||
          queryErr?.code === 'failed-precondition'
        ) {
          console.warn('Firestore composite index not found, falling back to in-memory filtering:', msg);

          const matchUrl = msg.match(/https:\/\/console\.firebase\.google\.com[^\s]+/);
          if (matchUrl && matchUrl[0]) {
            setIndexWarningUrl(matchUrl[0]);
          }

          const fallbackQ = query(
            collection(db, 'audit_logs'),
            orderBy('timestamp', 'desc'),
            limit(200)
          );
          const fallbackSnap = await getDocs(fallbackQ);

          const filteredLogs: AuditLog[] = [];
          fallbackSnap.forEach((doc) => {
            const data = doc.data();
            let keep = true;
            if (actionFilter !== 'ALL' && data.action !== actionFilter) keep = false;
            if (entityFilter !== 'ALL' && data.entityType !== entityFilter) keep = false;
            if (userEmailFilter.trim()) {
              const term = userEmailFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
              const email = (data.userEmail || '').toLowerCase();
              const uid = (data.userId || '').toLowerCase();
              if (!email.includes(term) && !uid.includes(term)) keep = false;
            }
            if (keep) {
              filteredLogs.push({ id: doc.id, ...data } as AuditLog);
            }
          });

          setLogs(filteredLogs.slice(0, PAGE_SIZE));
          setHasMore(filteredLogs.length > PAGE_SIZE);
          setFirstVisible(filteredLogs.length > 0 ? filteredLogs[0] : null);
          setLastVisible(
            filteredLogs.length > 0
              ? filteredLogs[Math.min(PAGE_SIZE - 1, filteredLogs.length - 1)]
              : null
          );
          setCurrentPage(1);
          setPageHistory([]);
          setLoading(false);
          setError(null);
          return;
        }
        throw queryErr;
      }

      const newLogs: AuditLog[] = [];
      snapshot.forEach((doc) => {
        newLogs.push({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as AuditLog);
      });

      setLogs(newLogs);

      if (snapshot.docs.length > 0) {
        if (direction === 'next' || direction === 'initial') {
          if (direction === 'next') {
            setPageHistory((prev) => [...prev, lastVisible]);
            setCurrentPage((p) => p + 1);
          } else {
            setPageHistory([]);
            setCurrentPage(1);
          }
        } else if (direction === 'prev') {
          setPageHistory((prev) => prev.slice(0, prev.length - 1));
          setCurrentPage((p) => p - 1);
        }

        setFirstVisible(snapshot.docs[0]);
        setLastVisible(snapshot.docs[snapshot.docs.length - 1]);
        setHasMore(snapshot.docs.length === PAGE_SIZE);
      } else {
        if (direction === 'initial') {
          setHasMore(false);
          setFirstVisible(null);
          setLastVisible(null);
        } else if (direction === 'next') {
          setHasMore(false);
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch audit logs:', err);
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to fetch logs');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchLogs('initial');
  }, [actionFilter, entityFilter]);

  const handleSearch = () => {
    fetchLogs('initial');
  };

  return {
    logs,
    loading,
    error,
    selectedLog,
    setSelectedLog,
    currentPage,
    hasMore,
    actionFilter,
    setActionFilter,
    entityFilter,
    setEntityFilter,
    userEmailFilter,
    setUserEmailFilter,
    indexWarningUrl,
    fetchLogs,
    handleSearch,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/AuditLogTab.tsx ==================== */
import React, { Suspense } from 'react';
import { lazyWithRetry } from '../lib/lazyWithRetry';
import { useAuditLogData } from './AuditLogParts/useAuditLogData';
import { AuditLogFilterToolbar } from './AuditLogParts/AuditLogFilterToolbar';
import { AuditLogTableView } from './AuditLogParts/AuditLogTableView';

const AuditDiffViewerModal = lazyWithRetry(
  () => import('./AuditDiffViewerModal'),
  'AuditDiffViewerModal'
);

export function AuditLogTab() {
  const {
    logs,
    loading,
    error,
    selectedLog,
    setSelectedLog,
    currentPage,
    hasMore,
    actionFilter,
    setActionFilter,
    entityFilter,
    setEntityFilter,
    userEmailFilter,
    setUserEmailFilter,
    indexWarningUrl,
    fetchLogs,
    handleSearch,
  } = useAuditLogData();

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 w-full h-full p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 overflow-y-auto bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0e0e11]">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full space-y-6">
        <AuditLogFilterToolbar
          entityFilter={entityFilter}
          setEntityFilter={setEntityFilter}
          actionFilter={actionFilter}
          setActionFilter={setActionFilter}
          userEmailFilter={userEmailFilter}
          setUserEmailFilter={setUserEmailFilter}
          onSearch={handleSearch}
          indexWarningUrl={indexWarningUrl}
        />

        {error && (
          <div className="bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800/50 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200 flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>{error}</span>
            <button
              onClick={() => fetchLogs('initial')}
              className="font-bold underline hover:no-underline"
            >
              Retry
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <AuditLogTableView
          logs={logs}
          loading={loading}
          currentPage={currentPage}
          hasMore={hasMore}
          onPageChange={(dir) => fetchLogs(dir)}
          onSelectLog={setSelectedLog}
        />
      </div>

      {selectedLog && (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <AuditDiffViewerModal
            isOpen={!!selectedLog}
            log={selectedLog}
            onClose={() => setSelectedLog(null)}
          />
        </Suspense>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default AuditLogTab;


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/BudgetEditableCell.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { formatCurrencyValue, cn } from '../../lib/utils';

export interface BudgetEditableCellProps {
  value: any;
  type?: string;
  onSave: (val: any) => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
  isCurrency?: boolean;
  currency?: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate?: number;
  usdRate?: number;
  wrapText?: boolean;
}

export function BudgetEditableCell({
  value,
  type = 'text',
  onSave,
  canWrite,
  isCurrency = false,
  currency = 'VND',
  jpyRate = 160,
  usdRate = 25000,
  wrapText = false
}: BudgetEditableCellProps) {
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [val, setVal] = useState(value !== undefined && value !== null ? value : '');
  const isTypingRef = React.useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTypingRef.current) {
      setVal(value !== undefined && value !== null ? value : '');
    }
  }, [value]);

  const handleBlur = () => {
    isTypingRef.current = false;
    setIsEditing(false);
    const newVal = type === 'number' ? Number(String(val).replace(',', '.')) : val;
    if (newVal !== value) {
      onSave(newVal);
    }
  };

  const displayValue = isCurrency
    ? (value === null || value === undefined ? '-' : formatCurrencyValue(value, currency, jpyRate, usdRate))
    : (value || '-');

  const isMoneyLocked = isCurrency && currency !== 'VND';
  const effectiveCanWrite = canWrite && !isMoneyLocked;

  if (!effectiveCanWrite) {
    return (
      <span
        title={isMoneyLocked ? `Editing locked in ${currency}. Switch to VND to edit.` : undefined}
        className={isMoneyLocked ? "cursor-not-allowed select-text opacity-95 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]" : ""}
      >
        {displayValue}
      </span>
    );
  }

  if (isEditing) {
    return (
      <input
        autoFocus
        type={type === 'number' ? 'text' : type}
        inputMode={type === 'number' ? 'decimal' : 'text'}
        value={val}
        onFocus={(e) => {
          isTypingRef.current = true;
          e.target.select();
        }}
        onChange={(e) => setVal(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={handleBlur}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
        }}
        className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-400 rounded px-1 py-0.5 outline-none text-inherit font-inherit text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)}
      className={cn(
        "cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] px-1 py-0.5 rounded border border-transparent hover:border-slate-200 min-h-[24px]",
        wrapText ? "whitespace-normal break-words" : "truncate"
      )}
      title={typeof displayValue === 'string' ? displayValue : undefined}
    >
      {displayValue}
    </div>
  );
}
