            value={effectiveStore} 
            onChange={(e) => setGlobalStoreFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block p-2 outline-none shadow-sm min-w-[85px] sm:min-w-[95px] flex-1 sm:flex-none"
          >
            {stores.length > 1 && <option value="all">{t('All Stores')}</option>}
            {stores.map(s => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
          </select>

          <MultiCheckboxSelect 
            value={globalLocationFilter}
            onChange={setGlobalLocationFilter}
            options={locationOptions}
            placeholder={t('All Locations')}
            className="min-w-[95px] sm:min-w-[100px] flex-1 sm:flex-none"
          />

          <select
            value={moneyFilter}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const val = e.target.value;
              setMoneyFilter(val);
              if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
                lastSelectedMoneyFilterRef.current = val;
                safeSetItemSession("taka_budget_money_filter", val);
              }
            }}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block p-2 outline-none shadow-sm min-w-[95px] sm:min-w-[100px] flex-1 sm:flex-none"
          >
            <option value="all">{t('All Projects')}</option>
            <option value="has_money">{t('Has Budget or Actual')}</option>
            <option value="has_budget">{t('Has Budget Only')}</option>
            <option value="has_act_forc">{t('Has Actual/Forc Only')}</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="relative w-full">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3 pointer-events-none text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] z-10">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <DebouncedSearchInput 
            value={searchTerm} 
            onChange={(val) => setSearchTerm(val)}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block w-full pl-9 pr-3 p-2 outline-none shadow-sm" 
            placeholder={t('Search anything...')}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 justify-end">
        <button 
          onClick={handleExportBudget} 
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
          title="Export Filtered CSV"
        >
          <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">{t('Export CSV')}</span>
        </button>
        
        {canWrite && (
          <>
            <input 
              type="file" 
              ref={fileInputRef} 
              onChange={handleImportBudget} 
              accept=".csv" 
              className="hidden" 
            />
            <button 
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()} 
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
              title="Import Budget CSV (Updates matching projects)"
            >
              <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">{t('Import CSV')}</span>
            </button>
          </>
        )}

        <ColumnAdder 
          availableColumns={AVAILABLE_COLUMNS} 
          visibleColumns={visibleColumns} 
          onAddColumn={handleToggleColumn} 
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/BudgetLinkChildColumn.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { ProjectFinancials } from './budgetTypes';
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from '../DebouncedSearchInput';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { Link as LinkIcon, Unlink } from 'lucide-react';

interface BudgetLinkChildColumnProps {
  selectedParentProject: Project | null;
  childSearchTerm: string;
  setChildSearchTerm: (val: string) => void;
  filteredChildProjects: Project[];
  handleLinkParent: (childProject: Project, parentCode: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  getProjectFinancials: (p: Project) => ProjectFinancials;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
}

export const BudgetLinkChildColumn: React.FC<BudgetLinkChildColumnProps> = React.memo(({
  selectedParentProject,
  childSearchTerm,
  setChildSearchTerm,
  filteredChildProjects,
  handleLinkParent,
  getProjectFinancials,
  formatCurrency,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-[500px] lg:h-full min-h-0 bg-white dark:bg-[#1c1c1f] rounded-xl border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-900/30 shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
      {/* Panel Header */}
      <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-blue-950/20 border-b border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-900/30 flex flex-col gap-2 shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-extrabold shadow-xs">2</span>
            <span>{t('Link / Unlink Sub-Projects')}</span>
          </label>
          {selectedParentProject && (
            <span className="text-[11px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold">
              → {t('Main')}: {selectedParentProject.code}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {/* Search Input */}
        <div className="relative">
          <DebouncedSearchInput 
            placeholder={t('Search sub-projects to link or unlink...')}
            value={childSearchTerm}
            onChange={(val) => setChildSearchTerm(val)}
            className="w-full pl-3 pr-8 py-1.5 border rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383a] text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none shadow-xs font-medium"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Child Candidates Scrollable List */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto p-2.5 space-y-2">
        {!selectedParentProject ? (
          <div className="py-20 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('Please choose a Main Project on the left panel first')}</p>
            <p className="text-xs mt-1">{t('Then manage its sub-projects here.')}</p>
          </div>
        ) : filteredChildProjects.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="py-16 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">{t('No projects available to link')}</p>
            <p className="text-xs mt-1">{t('Try adjusting your search query.')}</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredChildProjects.map((childP) => {
            const isLinkedToCurrent = childP.parentId && String(childP.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === String(selectedParentProject.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
            const isLinkedToOther = childP.parentId && !isLinkedToCurrent;
            const cStore = (childP.store || '').toLowerCase();
            const cStats = getProjectFinancials(childP);

            return (
              <div
                key={childP.id || childP.code}
                className={cn(
                  "p-2.5 rounded-xl border transition-all flex flex-col gap-2",
                  isLinkedToCurrent
                    ? "bg-blue-50/80 dark:bg-blue-950/30 border-blue-400 dark:border-blue-800 shadow-xs"
                    : "bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#2e2e32] hover:border-blue-300 dark:hover:border-blue-800"
                )}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                      <span className={cn(
                        "px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-extrabold rounded uppercase tracking-wider border",
                        cStore === 'hcm'
                          ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/80 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200/80'
                          : cStore === 'hn'
                          ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200/80'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200'
                      )}>
                        {childP.store || '-'}
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">
                        {childP.code}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-medium">
                        • {childP.year || '-'}
                      </span>
                      {childP.location && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-700">
                          {childP.location}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="font-semibold text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 line-clamp-1">
                      {childP.name}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Link / Unlink Action Button */}
                  <div className="shrink-0">
                    {isLinkedToCurrent ? (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleLinkParent(childP, null)}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-red-600 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:hover:bg-red-900/50 rounded-lg border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/60 shadow-2xs transition-colors active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
                        title="Unlink from this main project"
                      >
                        <Unlink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>{t('Unlink')}</span>
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleLinkParent(childP, selectedParentProject.code)}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 rounded-lg border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/60 shadow-2xs transition-colors active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
                        title={isLinkedToOther ? `Change link from ${childP.parentId} to ${selectedParentProject.code}` : "Link as sub-project"}
                      >
                        <LinkIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>{isLinkedToOther ? `${t('Relink')} (${childP.parentId})` : t('Link')}</span>
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Mini Financial Stats of Sub-Project */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1 text-center bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-[#141416] p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 text-[10px]">
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase">{t('Budget')}</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 truncate">{formatCurrency(cStats.budget)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col border-x border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 px-0.5">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase">{t('ACT')}</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 truncate">{formatCurrency(cStats.actual)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pr-0.5">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase">{t('Fee')}</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-600 truncate">{formatCurrency(cStats.supportingFee)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase">{t('Rem.')}</span>
                    <span className={cn("font-mono font-bold truncate", cStats.remaining < 0 ? "text-red-500" : "text-emerald-600")}>
                      {formatCurrency(cStats.remaining)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});
BudgetLinkChildColumn.displayName = 'BudgetLinkChildColumn';


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/BudgetLinkModal.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, useDragControls } from 'motion/react';
import { Layers, X, Filter, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { ProjectFinancials } from './budgetTypes';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { getZIndexClass } from '../../lib/zIndexManager';
import { BudgetLinkParentColumn } from './BudgetLinkParentColumn';
import { BudgetLinkChildColumn } from './BudgetLinkChildColumn';

interface BudgetLinkModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  selectedParentProject: Project | null;
  setSelectedParentProject: (p: Project | null) => void;
  parentSearchTerm: string;
  setParentSearchTerm: (term: string) => void;
  childSearchTerm: string;
  setChildSearchTerm: (term: string) => void;
  candidateParentProjects: Project[];
  candidateChildProjects: Project[];
  linkedChildrenCount: number;
  getProjectFinancials: (p: Project) => ProjectFinancials;
  handleLinkParent: (childProject: Project, parentCode: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
  projects?: Project[];
  initialYear?: string;
  initialStore?: string;
  initialLocation?: string;
}

export function BudgetLinkModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  selectedParentProject,
  setSelectedParentProject,
  parentSearchTerm,
  setParentSearchTerm,
  childSearchTerm,
  setChildSearchTerm,
  candidateParentProjects,
  candidateChildProjects,
  linkedChildrenCount,
  getProjectFinancials,
  handleLinkParent,
  formatCurrency,
  projects,
  initialYear,
  initialStore,
  initialLocation
}: BudgetLinkModalProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const dragControls = useDragControls();

  const [modalYearFilter, setModalYearFilter] = useState<string>(initialYear || 'all');
  const [modalStoreFilter, setModalStoreFilter] = useState<string>(initialStore || 'all');
  const [modalLocationFilter, setModalLocationFilter] = useState<string>(initialLocation || 'all');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      if (selectedParentProject) {
        if (selectedParentProject.year) setModalYearFilter(String(selectedParentProject.year));
        if (selectedParentProject.store) setModalStoreFilter(String(selectedParentProject.store).toUpperCase());
      } else {
        setModalYearFilter(initialYear || 'all');
        setModalStoreFilter(initialStore || 'all');
        setModalLocationFilter(initialLocation || 'all');
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen, selectedParentProject, initialYear, initialStore, initialLocation]);

  const allProjects = projects && projects.length > 0 ? projects : candidateParentProjects;

  const availableYears = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    allProjects.forEach(p => {
      if (p.year) set.add(String(p.year).trim());
      else if (p.start) set.add(String(p.start).substring(0, 4));
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
  }, [allProjects]);

  const availableLocations = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    allProjects.forEach(p => {
      if (p.location && p.location.trim()) {
        set.add(p.location.trim());
      }
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [allProjects]);

  const filteredParentProjects = useMemo(() => {
    const term = parentSearchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    return allProjects.filter(p => {
      if (modalYearFilter !== 'all') {
        const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '');
        if (pYear && pYear !== modalYearFilter) return false;
      }
      if (modalStoreFilter !== 'all') {
        const pStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (pStore && pStore !== modalStoreFilter.toUpperCase()) return false;
      }
      if (modalLocationFilter !== 'all') {
        if (p.location !== modalLocationFilter) return false;
      }
      if (!term) return true;
      const searchPool = [
        p.code,
        p.name,
        p.year,
        p.store,
        p.location,
        p.type,
        p.note
      ].map(v => String(v || '').toLowerCase());
      return searchPool.some(val => val.includes(term));
    }).slice(0, 100);
  }, [allProjects, parentSearchTerm, modalYearFilter, modalStoreFilter, modalLocationFilter]);

  const filteredChildProjects = useMemo(() => {
    const parentCode = selectedParentProject ? String(selectedParentProject.code || '').trim().toUpperCase() : '';
    const parentId = selectedParentProject?.id || (selectedParentProject ? `${selectedParentProject.code}-${selectedParentProject.year}-${selectedParentProject.store}-${selectedParentProject.no}` : '');
    const term = childSearchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();

    const filtered = allProjects.filter(p => {
      const pId = p.id || `${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.store}-${p.no}`;
      const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();

      if (selectedParentProject && (pId === parentId || pCode === parentCode)) return false;
      if (selectedParentProject?.parentId && String(selectedParentProject.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === pCode) return false;

      const targetYear = selectedParentProject?.year 
        ? String(selectedParentProject.year).trim() 
        : (modalYearFilter !== 'all' ? modalYearFilter : '');
      if (targetYear) {
        const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '');
        if (pYear && pYear !== targetYear) return false;
      }

      const targetStore = selectedParentProject?.store 
        ? String(selectedParentProject.store).trim().toUpperCase() 
        : (modalStoreFilter !== 'all' ? modalStoreFilter.toUpperCase() : '');
      if (targetStore) {
        const pStore = String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (pStore && pStore !== targetStore) return false;
      }

      if (modalLocationFilter !== 'all') {
        if (p.location !== modalLocationFilter) return false;
      }

      if (!term) return true;
      const searchPool = [
        p.code,
        p.name,
        p.year,
        p.store,
        p.location,
        p.type,
        p.note
      ].map(v => String(v || '').toLowerCase());
      return searchPool.some(val => val.includes(term));
    });

    if (parentCode) {
      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const aIsChild = a.parentId && String(a.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === parentCode ? 1 : 0;
        const bIsChild = b.parentId && String(b.parentId).trim().toUpperCase() === parentCode ? 1 : 0;
        return bIsChild - aIsChild;
      });
    }

    return filtered.slice(0, 100);
  }, [allProjects, selectedParentProject, childSearchTerm, modalYearFilter, modalStoreFilter, modalLocationFilter]);

  if (!isOpen && !selectedParentProject) return null;

  const parentStats = selectedParentProject ? getProjectFinancials(selectedParentProject) : null;

  return (
    <div className={`fixed inset-0 ${getZIndexClass('MODAL_MODULAR')} flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs p-2 sm:p-4 overflow-hidden pointer-events-auto`}>
      <motion.div
        drag
        dragControls={dragControls}
        dragListener={false}
        dragMomentum={false}
        className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-[96vw] max-w-6xl xl:max-w-7xl h-[90vh] max-h-[860px] flex flex-col border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
      >
        {/* Modal Drag Header */}
        <div 
          onPointerDown={(e) => dragControls.start(e)}
          className="p-3.5 sm:p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-[#18181a] cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing select-none shrink-0"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">
              <Layers className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-base md:text-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">
              {t('Project Modular (Link Budget)')}
            </h3>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button 
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200/50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Scope Filter Toolbar: Year, Store, Location */}
        <div className="px-3.5 sm:px-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#18181a] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2.5 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 mr-1">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]" />
              <span>{t('Filter Scope')}:</span>
            </div>

            {/* Year Selector */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{t('Year')}:</span>
              <select
                value={modalYearFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setModalYearFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="text-xs bg-white dark:bg-[#222225] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg px-2 py-1 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
              >
                <option value="all">{t('All Years')}</option>
                {availableYears.map(y => (
                  <option key={y} value={y}>{y}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Store Selector */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{t('Store')}:</span>
              <select
                value={modalStoreFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setModalStoreFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="text-xs bg-white dark:bg-[#222225] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg px-2 py-1 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
              >
                <option value="all">{t('All Stores')}</option>
                <option value="HCM">HCM</option>
                <option value="HN">HN</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Location Selector */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{t('Location')}:</span>
              <select
                value={modalLocationFilter}
                onChange={(e) => setModalLocationFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="text-xs bg-white dark:bg-[#222225] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg px-2 py-1 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 outline-none cursor-pointer shadow-2xs max-w-[140px] truncate"
              >
                <option value="all">{t('All Locations')}</option>
                {availableLocations.map(loc => (
                  <option key={loc} value={loc}>{loc}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Reset Filter */}
          {(modalYearFilter !== 'all' || modalStoreFilter !== 'all' || modalLocationFilter !== 'all') && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setModalYearFilter('all');
                setModalStoreFilter('all');
                setModalLocationFilter('all');
              }}
              className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8] flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>{t('Reset Filter')}</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Main Content: 2 Columns Side-by-Side */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:gap-4 p-3 sm:p-4 overflow-y-auto lg:overflow-hidden">
          {/* Column 1: Parent Projects */}
          <BudgetLinkParentColumn
            filteredParentProjects={filteredParentProjects}
            selectedParentProject={selectedParentProject}
            setSelectedParentProject={setSelectedParentProject}
            parentSearchTerm={parentSearchTerm}
            setParentSearchTerm={setParentSearchTerm}
            parentStats={parentStats}
            linkedChildrenCount={linkedChildrenCount}
            formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
          />

          {/* Column 2: Child Projects */}
          <BudgetLinkChildColumn
            selectedParentProject={selectedParentProject}
            childSearchTerm={childSearchTerm}
            setChildSearchTerm={setChildSearchTerm}
            filteredChildProjects={filteredChildProjects}
            handleLinkParent={handleLinkParent}
            getProjectFinancials={getProjectFinancials}
            formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
          />
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/BudgetMobileCard.tsx ==================== */
import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Layers, Unlink } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { BudgetTreeNode } from './budgetTypes';
import { QuickNavButton } from '../QuickNavButton';
import { QRCodeButton } from '../QRCodeButton';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';

interface BudgetMobileCardProps {
  node: BudgetTreeNode;
  depth: number;
  isExpanded: boolean;
  canWrite: boolean;
  onGoToCost: (code: string) => void;
  onProjectClick: (p: Project) => void;
  toggleExpand: (id: string) => void;
  handleOpenLinkModal: (p?: Project) => void;
  handleLinkParent: (childProject: Project, parentCode: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
}

export const BudgetMobileCard = memo(function BudgetMobileCard({
  node,
  depth,
  isExpanded,
  canWrite,
  onGoToCost,
  onProjectClick,
  toggleExpand,
  handleOpenLinkModal,
  handleLinkParent,
  formatCurrency
}: BudgetMobileCardProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const isParent = node.isParentNode && node.filteredChildren && node.filteredChildren.length > 0;
  const vColor = (node.remaining || 0) < 0 ? 'text-red-500 dark:text-red-400' : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400';
  const vBg = (node.remaining || 0) < 0 ? 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-[#3b1a1a] border-red-200 dark:border-[#5c2424]' : 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-[#1a3821] border-emerald-200 dark:border-[#265330]';
  
  const isSelfRow = !node.isParentNode && node.isSelf;
  const isSubRow = !node.isParentNode && !node.isSelf;
  const isHighlightedChild = !node.isParentNode && Boolean(node.isSearchMatch);

  let cardStyle = "";
  if (node.isParentNode) {
    cardStyle = isParent
      ? "border-2 border-blue-500/80 dark:border-blue-500/60 shadow-md bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-50/60 to-indigo-50/40 dark:from-[#1b2030] dark:to-[#1e1e24] border-l-[5px] border-l-blue-600"
      : cn("border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-[#38383b] shadow-xs bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]", (node.remaining || 0) >= 0 ? "border-l-[5px] border-l-emerald-500" : "border-l-[5px] border-l-rose-500");
  } else if (isHighlightedChild) {
    cardStyle = isSelfRow
      ? "ml-4 border-2 border-blue-500 ring-2 ring-blue-500/50 bg-blue-100/60 dark:bg-blue-950/70 shadow-md border-l-[5px] border-l-blue-600"
      : "ml-4 border-2 border-amber-500 ring-2 ring-amber-500/50 bg-amber-100/60 dark:bg-amber-950/70 shadow-md border-l-[5px] border-l-amber-600";
  } else if (isSelfRow) {
    cardStyle = "ml-4 border-l-[5px] border-l-blue-500 border-t border-r border-b border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-900/50 bg-blue-50/30 dark:bg-[#151926]/70 shadow-xs";
  } else {
    cardStyle = "ml-4 border-l-[5px] border-l-amber-500 border-t border-r border-b border-amber-300/80 dark:border-amber-800/60 bg-amber-50/35 dark:bg-[#231b12]/70 shadow-xs";
  }

  const cleanNodeName = node.name ? node.name.replace(new RegExp(`^${node.store}\\s*-\\s*${node.code}\\s*-\\s*`, 'i'), '') : '-';

  return (
    <div 
      className={cn(
        "mobile-card-optimized rounded-xl p-3.5 flex flex-col gap-2.5 transition-all",
        cardStyle
      )}
    >
      {/* Top row: Badges & Remaining Badge */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap flex-1 min-w-0">
          {node.isParentNode && isParent && (
            <button 
              onClick={() => toggleExpand(node.id || node.code)} 
              className={cn(
                "px-2 py-0.5 text-white rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-extrabold shadow-2xs shrink-0",
                (node.filteredChildren?.length ?? 0) >= 2
                  ? "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500"
                  : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700"
              )}
            >
              {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              <span>MAIN ({node.filteredChildren.length})</span>
            </button>
          )}
          {isSelfRow && (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-blue-600 text-white uppercase shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs">
              <span>↳</span> BẢN THÂN (SELF)
            </span>
          )}
          {isSubRow && (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-600 text-white uppercase shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs">
              <span>↳</span> SUB
            </span>
          )}
          {isHighlightedChild && (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-blue-600 text-white uppercase shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
              MATCH
            </span>
          )}
          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shrink-0">
            {node.year || '-'}
          </span>
          <span className={cn(
            "px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded border uppercase shrink-0", 
            node.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hcm' 
              ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/80 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800' 
              : node.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hn' 
              ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800' 
              : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
          )}>
            {node.store || '-'}
          </span>
          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold font-mono rounded bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800 shrink-0">
            {node.code}
          </span>
          {(node.location || node.project?.location) && (
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium truncate">
              • {node.location || node.project?.location}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="shrink-0">
          <span className={cn("px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg border", vBg, vColor)}>
            {formatCurrency(node.remaining)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Project Name */}
      <div 
        onClick={() => node.project && onProjectClick(node.project)}
        className={cn(
          "font-bold text-sm leading-snug cursor-pointer hover:underline hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8]",
          node.isParentNode ? "text-slate-900 dark:text-[#ffffff]" : (isSubRow ? "text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200 font-semibold" : "text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]")
        )}
      >
        {cleanNodeName}
      </div>

      {/* Key Metrics Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#161618] rounded-lg p-2 border border-slate-100 dark:border-[#2e2e32] text-center">
        <div className="flex flex-col">
          <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase">{t('Budget')}</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] truncate">
            {formatCurrency(node.totalBudget ?? node.budget)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col border-x border-slate-200 dark:border-[#2e2e32] px-1">
          <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5">
            {t('Actual')}
            {node.hasForc && <span className="text-[8px] text-orange-600 font-extrabold">(F)</span>}
          </span>
          <span 
            onClick={() => onGoToCost(node.code)}
            className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 truncate cursor-pointer hover:underline"
          >
            {formatCurrency(node.totalActual)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col">
          <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase">{t('Support Fee')}</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 truncate">
            {formatCurrency(node.totalSupportingFee ?? node.ownSupportingFee)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Note & Actions row */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#2e2e32]/60 text-xs">
        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 italic truncate flex-1 min-w-0">
          {node.note || <span className="opacity-40">{t('No notes')}</span>}
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
          <QuickNavButton project={node.project} title={`Quick Navigator (${node.code})`} />
          <QRCodeButton title={node.name || node.code} url={`${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}?tab=budget&q=${encodeURIComponent(node.code || '')}`} />
          {canWrite && (
            <>
              {node.isParentNode ? (
                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleOpenLinkModal(node.project)}
                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 rounded bg-slate-100 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors active:scale-95"
                  title="Project Modular (Set as Main)"
                >
                  <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              ) : (
                !node.isSelf && (
                  <>
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => handleOpenLinkModal(node.project)}
                      className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 rounded bg-slate-100 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors active:scale-95"
                      title="Project Modular (Set as Main)"
                    >
                      <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => handleLinkParent(node.project, null)}
                      className="p-1 text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 rounded bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-red-950/50 transition-colors active:scale-95"
                      title="Unlink (Make Standalone Parent)"
                    >
                      <Unlink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </>
                )
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/BudgetMobileView.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { BudgetTreeNode } from './budgetTypes';
import { BudgetMobileCard } from './BudgetMobileCard';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';

interface BudgetMobileViewProps {
  filteredRoots: BudgetTreeNode[];
  visibleCount: number;
  setVisibleCount: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
  canWrite: boolean;
  searchTerm: string;
  collapsedInSearch: Set<string>;
  expandedParents: Set<string>;
  toggleExpand: (id: string) => void;
  toggleAllParents: () => void;
  onGoToCost: (code: string) => void;
  onProjectClick: (p: Project) => void;
  handleOpenLinkModal: (p?: Project) => void;
  handleLinkParent: (childProject: Project, parentCode: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
}

export function BudgetMobileView({
  filteredRoots,
  visibleCount,
  setVisibleCount,
  canWrite,
  searchTerm,
  collapsedInSearch,
  expandedParents,
  toggleExpand,
  toggleAllParents,
  onGoToCost,
  onProjectClick,
  handleOpenLinkModal,
  handleLinkParent,
  formatCurrency
}: BudgetMobileViewProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const renderMobileCards = (nodes: BudgetTreeNode[], depth = 0): React.ReactNode[] => {
    let cards: React.ReactNode[] = [];
    nodes.forEach((node) => {
      const isParent = node.isParentNode && node.filteredChildren && node.filteredChildren.length > 0;
      const isExpanded = searchTerm.trim() 
        ? !collapsedInSearch.has(node.id || node.code) 
        : expandedParents.has(node.id || node.code);

      cards.push(
        <BudgetMobileCard
          key={`mobile-${node.id || `${node.code}-${node.year}-${node.store}-${node.no}`}`}
          node={node}
          depth={depth}
          isExpanded={isExpanded}
          canWrite={canWrite}
          onGoToCost={onGoToCost}
          onProjectClick={onProjectClick}
          toggleExpand={toggleExpand}
          handleOpenLinkModal={handleOpenLinkModal}
          handleLinkParent={handleLinkParent}
          formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
        />
      );

      if (isParent && isExpanded && node.filteredChildren) {
        cards = cards.concat(renderMobileCards(node.filteredChildren, depth + 1));
      }
    });
    return cards;
  };

  const paginatedRoots = filteredRoots.slice(0, visibleCount);

  return (
    <div className="xl:hidden flex-grow overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-3 p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#121214] relative min-h-0">
      {/* Expand / Collapse All Parents for Mobile */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center px-1">
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
          {t('Showing')} {Math.min(visibleCount, filteredRoots.length)} {t('of')} {filteredRoots.length} {t('projects')}
        </span>
        <button 
          onClick={toggleAllParents} 
          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-semibold hover:underline touch-manipulation active:scale-95"
        >
          {expandedParents.size === 0 ? (
            <><ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {t('Expand Parents')}</>
          ) : (
            <><ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {t('Collapse Parents')}</>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Cards List */}
      {renderMobileCards(paginatedRoots)}

      {/* Load More on Mobile */}
      {visibleCount < filteredRoots.length && (
        <div className="py-2 text-center">
          <button
            onClick={() => setVisibleCount(prev => prev + 30)}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors text-xs w-full max-w-xs touch-manipulation active:scale-95"
          >
            {t('Load More Projects')} ({filteredRoots.length - visibleCount} {t('remaining')})
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/BudgetTableRow.tsx ==================== */
import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Layers, Unlink } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { BudgetTreeNode } from './budgetTypes';
import { BudgetEditableCell } from './BudgetEditableCell';
import { QuickNavButton } from '../QuickNavButton';
import { QRCodeButton } from '../QRCodeButton';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';

interface BudgetTableRowProps {
  node: BudgetTreeNode;
  idx: number;
  depth: number;
  isExpanded: boolean;
  visibleColumns: string[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  currency: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate: number;
  usdRate: number;
  onGoToCost: (code: string) => void;
  onProjectClick: (p: Project) => void;
  toggleExpand: (id: string) => void;
  handleUpdateProject: (p: Project, field: keyof Project, value: any) => Promise<void>;
  handleOpenLinkModal: (p?: Project) => void;
  handleLinkParent: (childProject: Project, parentCode: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
}

export const BudgetTableRow = memo(function BudgetTableRow({
  node,
  idx,
  depth,
  isExpanded,
  visibleColumns,
  canWrite,
  currency,
  jpyRate,
  usdRate,
  onGoToCost,
  onProjectClick,
  toggleExpand,
  handleUpdateProject,
  handleOpenLinkModal,
  handleLinkParent,
  formatCurrency
}: BudgetTableRowProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const isParent = node.isParentNode && node.filteredChildren && node.filteredChildren.length > 0;
  const vColor = (node.remaining || 0) < 0 ? 'text-red-500 dark:text-red-400' : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400';
  
  const isSelfRow = !node.isParentNode && node.isSelf;
  const isSubRow = !node.isParentNode && !node.isSelf;
  const isHighlightedChild = !node.isParentNode && Boolean(node.isSearchMatch);

  let rowBgClass = "";
  if (node.isParentNode) {
    rowBgClass = isParent 
      ? "bg-blue-50/35 dark:bg-[#1a2030]/60 hover:bg-blue-50/60 font-semibold" 
      : (idx % 2 === 0 ? "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] hover:bg-blue-50/30" : "bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#1b1b1d] hover:bg-blue-50/30");
  } else if (isHighlightedChild) {
    rowBgClass = isSelfRow 
      ? "bg-blue-100/80 dark:bg-blue-950/70 font-semibold ring-2 ring-blue-500 dark:ring-blue-400 ring-inset shadow-xs relative z-10" 
      : "bg-amber-100/80 dark:bg-amber-950/70 font-semibold ring-2 ring-amber-500 dark:ring-amber-400 ring-inset shadow-xs relative z-10";
  } else if (isSelfRow) {
    rowBgClass = "bg-blue-50/20 dark:bg-[#151926]/50 hover:bg-blue-50/40 border-l-2 border-l-blue-400/80";
  } else {
    rowBgClass = "bg-amber-50/25 dark:bg-[#221a12]/50 hover:bg-amber-50/40 border-l-2 border-l-amber-500/80";
  }

  return (
    <tr 
      className={cn(
        "table-row-optimized border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] transition-all text-xs",
        rowBgClass
      )}
    >
      {visibleColumns.includes('no') && (
        <td className="px-2 py-2.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 min-w-0">
            {isParent && (
              <button 
                onClick={() => toggleExpand(node.id || node.code)} 
                className={cn(
                  "p-1 text-white rounded transition-colors flex items-center gap-0.5 text-xs font-bold shrink-0 shadow-2xs",
                  (node.filteredChildren?.length ?? 0) >= 2
                    ? "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500"
                    : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700"
                )}
                title={isExpanded ? "Collapse" : `Expand (${node.filteredChildren?.length})`}
              >
                {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                <span className="text-[10px]">({node.filteredChildren?.length})</span>
              </button>
            )}
            {isSelfRow && (
              <span className="text-[8.5px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-800 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] uppercase shrink-0 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 flex items-center gap-0.5 leading-none" title="Dòng tự thân (Self)">
                ↳ SELF
              </span>
            )}
            {isSubRow && (
              <span className="text-[8.5px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/80 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300 uppercase shrink-0 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 flex items-center gap-0.5 leading-none" title="Dòng con (Sub)">
                ↳ SUB
              </span>
            )}
            {isHighlightedChild && (
              <span className="text-[8.5px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 text-white uppercase shrink-0 shadow-2xs leading-none">
                MATCH
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('year') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center font-medium text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
          {node.isParentNode ? (
            <BudgetEditableCell 
              value={node.year} 
              type="number" 
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateProject(node.project, 'year', val)} 
              canWrite={canWrite} 
            />
          ) : (
            <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]">{node.year || '-'}</span>
          )}
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('store') && (
        <td className={cn("px-4 py-3 font-bold", node.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hcm' ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]' : node.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hn' ? 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400' : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]')}>
          {node.isParentNode ? (
            <BudgetEditableCell 
              value={node.store} 
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateProject(node.project, 'store', val)} 
              canWrite={canWrite} 
            />
          ) : (
            <span>{node.store || '-'}</span>
          )}
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('location') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
          <BudgetEditableCell 
            value={node.location} 
            onSave={(val) => handleUpdateProject(node.project, 'location', val)} 
            canWrite={canWrite} 
          />
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('code') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2.5 whitespace-nowrap">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-mono font-extrabold uppercase whitespace-nowrap min-w-0">
            {node.isParentNode ? (
              <BudgetEditableCell 
                value={node.code} 
                onSave={(val) => handleUpdateProject(node.project, 'code', String(val || '').toUpperCase())} 
                canWrite={canWrite} 
              />
            ) : (
              <span 
                onClick={() => node.project && onProjectClick(node.project)}
                className={cn(
                  "font-semibold whitespace-nowrap text-xs tracking-tight cursor-pointer hover:underline hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8]", 
                  isSubRow ? "text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200" : "text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]"
                )}
                title="Click to view details in Tasks"
              >
                {node.code}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('projectName') && (
        <td 
          onClick={() => node.project && onProjectClick(node.project)}
          className={cn(
            "px-4 py-3 whitespace-normal break-words leading-snug min-w-[200px]", 
            node.project && "cursor-pointer hover:underline hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8]",
            node.isParentNode ? "font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]" : (isSubRow ? "font-medium text-amber-950/90 dark:text-amber-200/90" : "font-normal text-slate-600 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]")
          )}
          title={node.project ? "Click to view details in Tasks" : undefined}
        >
          {node.name || '-'}
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('totalBudget') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">
          {node.isParentNode ? (
            <span className="font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">{formatCurrency(node.totalBudget)}</span>
          ) : (
            <BudgetEditableCell 
              value={node.budget} 
              type="number" 
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateProject(node.project, 'budget', val)} 
              canWrite={canWrite}
              isCurrency={true}
              currency={currency}
              jpyRate={jpyRate}
              usdRate={usdRate}
            />
          )}
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('actual') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
            <span 
              onClick={() => onGoToCost(node.code)}
              className={cn(
                "cursor-pointer hover:underline text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium",
                node.isParentNode && "font-bold"
              )}
              title="Click to view in Cost Tab"
            >
              {formatCurrency(node.totalActual)}
            </span>
            {node.hasForc && (
              <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-1 py-0.2 rounded bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-950/80 text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-400 border border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-800 uppercase" title="Includes Forecasted Costs">
                FORC
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('supportingFee') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400">
          {node.isParentNode ? (
            <span className="font-bold">{formatCurrency(node.totalSupportingFee)}</span>
          ) : (
            <BudgetEditableCell 
              value={node.ownSupportingFee} 
              type="number" 
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateProject(node.project, 'supportingFee', val)} 
              canWrite={canWrite}
              isCurrency={true}
              currency={currency}
              jpyRate={jpyRate}
              usdRate={usdRate}
            />
          )}
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('variance') && (
        <td className={cn("px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold", vColor)}>
          {formatCurrency(node.remaining)}
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('type') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
          {node.isParentNode ? (
            <BudgetEditableCell 
              value={node.type} 
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateProject(node.project, 'type', val)} 
              canWrite={canWrite} 
            />
          ) : (
            <span>{node.type || '-'}</span>
          )}
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('note') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] max-w-xs">
          {node.isParentNode ? (
            <BudgetEditableCell 
              value={node.note} 
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateProject(node.project, 'note', val)} 
              canWrite={canWrite} 
              wrapText={true}
            />
          ) : (
            <span className="whitespace-normal break-words">{node.note || '-'}</span>
          )}
        </td>
      )}

      {visibleColumns.includes('actions') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-center">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
            <QuickNavButton project={node.project} title={`Quick Navigator (${node.code})`} />
            <QRCodeButton title={node.name || node.code} url={`${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}?tab=budget&q=${encodeURIComponent(node.code || '')}`} />
            {canWrite && (
              <>
                {node.isParentNode ? (
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => handleOpenLinkModal(node.project)}
                    className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 rounded bg-slate-100 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors active:scale-95"
                    title="Project Modular (Set as Main)"
                  >
                    <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  !node.isSelf && (
                    <>
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => handleOpenLinkModal(node.project)}
                        className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 rounded bg-slate-100 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors active:scale-95"
                        title="Project Modular (Set as Main)"
                      >
                        <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => handleLinkParent(node.project, null)}
                        className="p-1 text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 rounded bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-red-950/50 transition-colors"
                        title="Unlink (Make Standalone Parent)"
                      >
                        <Unlink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </>
                  )
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
    </tr>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/BudgetTableView.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { BudgetTreeNode, BudgetSortConfig } from './budgetTypes';
import { BudgetTableRow } from './BudgetTableRow';
import { ResizableHeader } from '../ResizableHeader';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

interface BudgetTableViewProps {
  filteredRoots: BudgetTreeNode[];
  visibleCount: number;
  visibleColumns: string[];
  colWidths: Record<string, number>;
  sortConfig: BudgetSortConfig | null;
  canWrite: boolean;
  currency: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate: number;
  usdRate: number;
  searchTerm: string;
  collapsedInSearch: Set<string>;
  expandedParents: Set<string>;
  totalGlobalBudget: number;
  totalGlobalActual: number;
  totalGlobalSupportingFee: number;
  totalGlobalRemaining: number;
  totalVarianceColor: string;
  onGoToCost: (code: string) => void;
  onProjectClick: (p: Project) => void;
  toggleExpand: (id: string) => void;
  handleSort: (key: string) => void;
  handleResize: (col: string, width: number) => void;
  handleBudgetScroll: (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
  handleUpdateProject: (p: Project, field: keyof Project, value: any) => Promise<void>;
  handleOpenLinkModal: (p?: Project) => void;
  handleLinkParent: (childProject: Project, parentCode: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
}

export function BudgetTableView({
  filteredRoots,
  visibleCount,
  visibleColumns,
  colWidths,
  sortConfig,
  canWrite,
  currency,
  jpyRate,
  usdRate,
  searchTerm,
  collapsedInSearch,
  expandedParents,
  totalGlobalBudget,
  totalGlobalActual,
  totalGlobalSupportingFee,
  totalGlobalRemaining,
  totalVarianceColor,
  onGoToCost,
  onProjectClick,
  toggleExpand,
  handleSort,
  handleResize,
  handleBudgetScroll,
  handleUpdateProject,
  handleOpenLinkModal,
  handleLinkParent,
  formatCurrency
}: BudgetTableViewProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const renderRows = (nodes: BudgetTreeNode[], depth = 0): React.ReactNode[] => {
    let rows: React.ReactNode[] = [];
    nodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      const isParent = node.isParentNode && node.filteredChildren && node.filteredChildren.length > 0;
      const isExpanded = searchTerm.trim() 
        ? !collapsedInSearch.has(node.id || node.code) 
        : expandedParents.has(node.id || node.code);

      rows.push(
        <BudgetTableRow
          key={node.id || `${node.code}-${node.year}-${node.store}-${node.no}`}
          node={node}
          idx={idx}
          depth={depth}
          isExpanded={isExpanded}
          visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
          canWrite={canWrite}
          currency={currency}
          jpyRate={jpyRate}
          usdRate={usdRate}
          onGoToCost={onGoToCost}
          onProjectClick={onProjectClick}
          toggleExpand={toggleExpand}
          handleUpdateProject={handleUpdateProject}
          handleOpenLinkModal={handleOpenLinkModal}
          handleLinkParent={handleLinkParent}
          formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
        />
      );

      if (isParent && isExpanded && node.filteredChildren) {
        rows = rows.concat(renderRows(node.filteredChildren, depth + 1));
      }
    });
    return rows;
  };

  const paginatedRoots = filteredRoots.slice(0, visibleCount);

  return (
    <div 
      onScroll={handleBudgetScroll}
      className="hidden xl:block flex-grow overflow-auto border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] relative min-h-0"
    >
      <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse table-fixed">
        <thead className="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282b] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] font-bold shadow-xs text-xs border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383a]">
          <tr>
            {visibleColumns.includes('no') && (
              <th className="px-2 py-3 text-center" style={{ width: colWidths.no || 80 }}>{t('No.')}</th>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('year') && (
              <ResizableHeader width={colWidths.year} onResize={(w) => handleResize('year', w)} className="text-center">{t('Year')}</ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('store') && (
              <ResizableHeader width={colWidths.store} onResize={(w) => handleResize('store', w)}>{t('Store')}</ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('location') && (
              <ResizableHeader width={colWidths.location} onResize={(w) => handleResize('location', w)}>{t('Location')}</ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('code') && (
              <ResizableHeader width={colWidths.code} onResize={(w) => handleResize('code', w)}>{t('Code')}</ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('projectName') && (
              <ResizableHeader width={colWidths.projectName} onResize={(w) => handleResize('projectName', w)}>{t('Project Name')}</ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('totalBudget') && (
              <ResizableHeader 
                width={colWidths.totalBudget} 
                onResize={(w) => handleResize('totalBudget', w)} 
                onClick={() => handleSort('totalBudget')} 
                className="cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-right"
              >
                {t('Budget')} {sortConfig?.key === 'totalBudget' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
              </ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('actual') && (
              <ResizableHeader 
                width={colWidths.actual} 
                onResize={(w) => handleResize('actual', w)} 
                onClick={() => handleSort('actual')} 
                className="cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-right"
              >
                {t('Actual/Forc')} {sortConfig?.key === 'actual' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
              </ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('supportingFee') && (
              <ResizableHeader width={colWidths.supportingFee} onResize={(w) => handleResize('supportingFee', w)} className="text-right">{t('Supporting Fee')}</ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('variance') && (
              <ResizableHeader 
                width={colWidths.variance} 
                onResize={(w) => handleResize('variance', w)} 
                onClick={() => handleSort('variance')} 
                className="cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-right"
              >
                {t('Remaining')} {sortConfig?.key === 'variance' && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓')}
              </ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('type') && (
              <ResizableHeader width={colWidths.type} onResize={(w) => handleResize('type', w)}>{t('Type')}</ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('note') && (
              <ResizableHeader width={colWidths.note} onResize={(w) => handleResize('note', w)}>{t('Note')}</ResizableHeader>
            )}
            {visibleColumns.includes('actions') && (
              <th className="px-3 py-3 text-center" style={{ width: colWidths.actions || 90 }}>{t('Actions')}</th>
            )}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-[#2d2d30]">
          {/* Sticky Sum Bar */}
          <tr className="sticky top-[37px] z-20 bg-blue-50/90 dark:bg-[#1a2030]/90 backdrop-blur-xs font-bold text-xs border-b-2 border-blue-200 dark:border-[#38383a] shadow-xs">
            {visibleColumns.includes('no') && <td className="px-2 py-2 text-center text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">{t('Total')}</td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('year') && <td></td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('store') && <td></td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('location') && <td></td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('code') && <td></td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('projectName') && <td className="px-4 py-2 text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">{filteredRoots.length} {t('projects')}</td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('totalBudget') && <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right font-mono text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">{formatCurrency(totalGlobalBudget)}</td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('actual') && <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{formatCurrency(totalGlobalActual)}</td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('supportingFee') && <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right font-mono text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400">{formatCurrency(totalGlobalSupportingFee)}</td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('variance') && <td className={cn("px-4 py-2 text-right font-mono", totalVarianceColor)}>{formatCurrency(totalGlobalRemaining)}</td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('type') && <td></td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('note') && <td></td>}
            {visibleColumns.includes('actions') && <td></td>}
          </tr>

          {filteredRoots.length === 0 ? (
            <tr>
              <td colSpan={visibleColumns.length} className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]">
                {t('No projects found matching the criteria.')}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ) : (
            renderRows(paginatedRoots)
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/BudgetParts/budgetTreeScope.test.ts ==================== */
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { buildBudgetTreeData } from './useBudgetTreeData';

describe('Budget Tree Scope & Cross-Year Guard', () => {
  it('does not attach children of year 2026 to a parent of year 2027 with identical code', () => {
    const mockProjects: any[] = [
      {
        id: 'p_2026_parent',
        code: 'L3-CORRIDOR',
        name: 'Corridor replacement',
        year: 2026,
        store: 'HCM',
        location: 'L3',
        budget: 3000000,
        actual: 2379610,
        no: 1,
      },
      {
        id: 'p_2027_parent',
        code: 'L3-CORRIDOR',
        name: 'Corridor replacement, Reserve',
        year: 2027,
        store: 'HCM',
        location: 'L3',
        budget: 200000,
        actual: 820500,
        no: 2,
      },
      {
        id: 'p_2026_child',
        code: 'L3-CORRIDOR-SUB1',
        name: 'Floor tiles',
        year: 2026,
        store: 'HCM',
        location: 'L3',
        parentId: 'L3-CORRIDOR',
        budget: 500000,
        actual: 400000,
        no: 3,
      },
    ];

    const tree = buildBudgetTreeData(mockProjects, []);
    expect(tree).toHaveLength(2);

    const node2026 = tree.find((n) => n.year === 2026);
    const node2027 = tree.find((n) => n.year === 2027);

    expect(node2026).toBeDefined();
    expect(node2027).toBeDefined();

    // 2026 parent should have 2 children: selfChild + p_2026_child
    expect(node2026?.children).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(node2026?.children?.some((c) => c.code === 'L3-CORRIDOR-SUB1')).toBe(true);

    // 2027 parent must NOT contain the 2026 child! It should only have its selfChild
    expect(node2027?.children).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(node2027?.children?.[0].isSelf).toBe(true);
    expect(node2027?.children?.some((c) => c.code === 'L3-CORRIDOR-SUB1')).toBe(false);
  });
});
