          {Array.from(new Set(locations)).map((l) => (
            <option key={l} value={l}>
              {l}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {/* Toggle Task Con */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShowSubTasksInMonth((prev) => !prev)}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all shadow-xs shrink-0 select-none ${
            showSubTasksInMonth
              ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-semibold'
              : 'bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a]'
          }`}
          title="Bật/tắt hiển thị task con trong calendar"
        >
          <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
            {t('Task con')}
          </span>
          <div
            className={`w-8 h-4.5 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors relative flex items-center ${
              showSubTasksInMonth ? 'bg-blue-600' : 'bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-600'
            }`}
          >
            <div
              className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-transform duration-200 ${
                showSubTasksInMonth ? 'translate-x-3.5' : 'translate-x-0'
              }`}
            />
          </div>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={onExportICS}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] transition-colors outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 shrink-0"
          title="Export to Calendar (.ics)"
        >
          <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Export ICS</span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => useAppStore.getState().setIsCalendarSyncModalOpen(true)}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:hover:bg-red-900/50 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800/60 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-red-700 dark:text-red-300 transition-all outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500 shrink-0 shadow-xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
          title="Đồng bộ Apple Calendar (iOS)"
        >
          <Smartphone className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Apple Calendar (iOS)</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CalendarTabParts/CalendarMonthDayList.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { format, startOfDay } from 'date-fns';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { CalendarEvent } from './calendarTypes';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';

interface CalendarMonthDayListProps {
  selectedMonthDate: Date;
  events: CalendarEvent[];
  onEditTask: (t: Task, isReadOnly?: boolean) => void;
  onEditProject: (p: Project, isReadOnly?: boolean) => void;
}

export const CalendarMonthDayList: React.FC<CalendarMonthDayListProps> = ({
  selectedMonthDate,
  events,
  onEditTask,
  onEditProject,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const dayEvents = events.filter(
    (e) =>
      startOfDay(e.start) <= startOfDay(selectedMonthDate) &&
      startOfDay(e.end) >= startOfDay(selectedMonthDate)
  );

  return (
    <div className="mt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] pt-4">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] mb-3">
        {format(selectedMonthDate, 'EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy')}
      </h3>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {dayEvents.length > 0 ? (
          dayEvents.map((event, idx) => (
            <div
              key={`${event.id}-${idx}`}
              onClick={() => {
                if (event.type === 'task' && event.resource) {
                  onEditTask(event.resource, true);
                } else if (event.type === 'project' && event.resource) {
                  onEditProject(event.resource, true);
                }
              }}
              className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-white text-sm font-medium shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2"
              style={{
                backgroundColor:
                  event.color ||
                  (event.colorIndex === 0 ? '#10b981' : '#fb923c'),
              }}
            >
              <span className="truncate">{event.title}</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/20 text-white shrink-0 uppercase tracking-wider">
                {event.type === 'project' ? t('Project') : t('Task')}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))
        ) : (
          <div className="text-slate-400 text-sm italic px-2 py-1">
            {t('No events scheduled for this day.')}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CalendarTabParts/CalendarSyncGuideTab.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CalendarTabParts/CustomVerticalView.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { format, addDays, subDays, startOfDay, endOfDay } from 'date-fns';
import { CalendarEvent } from './calendarTypes';

interface CustomVerticalViewProps {
  date: Date;
  events: CalendarEvent[];
  onSelectEvent?: (event: CalendarEvent) => void;
  daysCount: number;
}

export const CustomVerticalView: React.FC<CustomVerticalViewProps> = ({
  date,
  events,
  onSelectEvent,
  daysCount,
}) => {
  const range = useMemo(() => {
    let start: Date;
    let end: Date;
    if (daysCount === 7) {
      start = startOfDay(date);
      end = addDays(date, 6);
    } else {
      start = startOfDay(date);
      end = addDays(date, 30);
    }

    const daysArray: Date[] = [];
    let current = start;
    while (current <= end) {
      daysArray.push(current);
      current = addDays(current, 1);
    }
    return daysArray;
  }, [date, daysCount]);

  const eventsByDay = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, CalendarEvent[]>();
    range.forEach((day) => {
      map.set(day.toDateString(), []);
    });

    events.forEach((event: CalendarEvent) => {
      range.forEach((day) => {
        const dayStart = startOfDay(day);
        const dayEnd = endOfDay(day);
        if (event.start <= dayEnd && event.end >= dayStart) {
          map.get(day.toDateString())?.push(event);
        }
      });
    });
    return map;
  }, [events, range]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 overflow-y-auto h-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 rounded-b-xl">
      {range.map((day) => {
        const dayEvents = eventsByDay.get(day.toDateString()) || [];
        if (daysCount !== 7 && dayEvents.length === 0) return null; // hide empty days in agenda

        return (
          <div
            key={day.toDateString()}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
          >
            <div className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a]/80 px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-sm flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{format(day, 'EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy')}</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] px-2 py-1 rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-sm">
                {dayEvents.length} {dayEvents.length === 1 ? 'task' : ''}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 flex flex-col gap-2">
              {dayEvents.length > 0 ? (
                dayEvents.map((event, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={`${event.id}-${idx}`}
                    onClick={() => onSelectEvent && onSelectEvent(event)}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-white text-sm font-medium shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor:
                        event.color ||
                        (event.colorIndex === 0 ? '#10b981' : '#fb923c'),
                    }}
                  >
                    {event.title}
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="text-slate-400 text-sm italic px-2 py-1">
                  No scheduled for this day.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export const CustomWeekView: any = (props: any) => (
  <CustomVerticalView {...props} daysCount={7} />
);
CustomWeekView.range = (date: Date) => [startOfDay(date), addDays(date, 6)];
CustomWeekView.navigate = (date: Date, action: string) => {
  switch (action) {
    case 'PREV':
      return subDays(date, 7);
    case 'NEXT':
      return addDays(date, 7);
    default:
      return date;
  }
};
CustomWeekView.title = (date: Date) => {
  const start = startOfDay(date);
  const end = addDays(date, 6);
  return `${format(start, 'MMM d')} - ${format(end, 'MMM d')}`;
};

export const CustomAgendaView: any = (props: any) => (
  <CustomVerticalView {...props} daysCount={30} />
);
CustomAgendaView.range = (date: Date) => [startOfDay(date), addDays(date, 30)];
CustomAgendaView.navigate = (date: Date, action: string) => {
  switch (action) {
    case 'PREV':
      return subDays(date, 30);
    case 'NEXT':
      return addDays(date, 30);
    default:
      return date;
  }
};
CustomAgendaView.title = (date: Date) => {
  const start = startOfDay(date);
  const end = addDays(date, 30);
  return `${format(start, 'MMM d')} - ${format(end, 'MMM d')}`;
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CalendarTabParts/calendarExportUtils.ts ==================== */
import { format, addDays } from 'date-fns';
import { CalendarEvent } from './calendarTypes';

export function exportEventsToICS(events: CalendarEvent[]) {
  if (events.length === 0) {
    alert('No events to export.');
    return;
  }

  const formatDate = (date: Date) => {
    return date.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').split('.')[0] + 'Z';
  };

  const icsContent = [
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
    'VERSION:2.0',
    'PRODID:-//Takashimaya Project Management//Calendar//EN',
    'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
    'METHOD:PUBLISH',
  ];

  events.forEach((event) => {
    icsContent.push('BEGIN:VEVENT');
    icsContent.push(`UID:${event.id}@taka.app`);
    icsContent.push(`DTSTAMP:${formatDate(new Date())}`);
    if (event.allDay) {
      const startStr = format(event.start, 'yyyyMMdd');
      const endStr = format(addDays(event.start, 1), 'yyyyMMdd');
      icsContent.push(`DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:${startStr}`);
      icsContent.push(`DTEND;VALUE=DATE:${endStr}`);
    } else {
      icsContent.push(`DTSTART:${formatDate(event.start)}`);
      icsContent.push(`DTEND:${formatDate(event.end)}`);
    }
    icsContent.push(`SUMMARY:${event.title.replace(/[,;]/g, '\\$&')}`);
    if (event.resource && event.resource.detail) {
      icsContent.push(
        `DESCRIPTION:${(event.resource.detail || '')
          .replace(/\n/g, '\\n')
          .replace(/[,;]/g, '\\$&')}`
      );
    }
    icsContent.push('END:VEVENT');
  });

  icsContent.push('END:VCALENDAR');

  const blob = new Blob([icsContent.join('\r\n')], {
    type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8',
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `Takashimaya_Calendar_${format(new Date(), 'yyyyMMdd')}.ics`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CalendarTabParts/calendarTypes.ts ==================== */
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';

export interface CalendarTabProps {
  onEditTask: (t: Task, isReadOnly?: boolean) => void;
  onEditProject: (p: Project, isReadOnly?: boolean) => void;
}

export interface CalendarEvent {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  start: Date;
  end: Date;
  allDay: boolean;
  resource: any;
  type: 'project' | 'task';
  subType?: 'start' | 'finish';
  colorIndex?: number;
  color?: string;
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CalendarTabParts/useCalendarEvents.ts ==================== */
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { CalendarEvent } from './calendarTypes';

interface UseCalendarEventsParams {
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  filterStore: string;
  filterLocation: string;
  currentView: string;
  showSubTasksInMonth: boolean;
}

export function useCalendarEvents({
  projects,
  tasks,
  filterStore,
  filterLocation,
  currentView,
  showSubTasksInMonth,
}: UseCalendarEventsParams) {
  const events = useMemo(() => {
    const calendarEvents: CalendarEvent[] = [];

    if (currentView === 'month') {
      const filteredProjects = projects.filter((p) => {
        if (filterStore && p.store !== filterStore) return false;
        if (filterLocation && p.location !== filterLocation) return false;
        return true;
      });

      filteredProjects.forEach((p) => {
        const start = parseDateTime(p.computedTakStart || p.start);
        const end = parseDateTime(
          p.computedTakCompl || p.handover || p.computedOpening || p.opening
        );

        if (start) {
          const dayStart = new Date(start);
          dayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          const dayEnd = new Date(start);
          dayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
          calendarEvents.push({
            id: `p_start_${p.id || p.no}`,
            title: `Start: ${p.code} - ${p.name}`,
            start: dayStart,
            end: dayEnd,
            allDay: true,
            resource: p,
            type: 'project',
            subType: 'start',
            colorIndex: 0,
            color: '#10b981',
          });
        }

        if (end) {
          const dayStart = new Date(end);
          dayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          const dayEnd = new Date(end);
          dayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
          calendarEvents.push({
            id: `p_end_${p.id || p.no}`,
            title: `Finish: ${p.code} - ${p.name}`,
            start: dayStart,
            end: dayEnd,
            allDay: true,
            resource: p,
            type: 'project',
            subType: 'finish',
            colorIndex: 1,
            color: '#fb923c',
          });
        }
      });

      if (showSubTasksInMonth) {
        const projectMap = new Map<string, Project>();
        projects.forEach((p) => {
          const key = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}`;
          projectMap.set(key, p);
          if (p.code) {
            projectMap.set(p.code, p);
          }
        });

        const filteredTasks = tasks.filter((t) => {
          const key = `${t.projectCode || ''}-${t.projectYear || ''}-${t.projectStore || ''}`;
          const project =
            projectMap.get(key) ||
            (t.projectCode ? projectMap.get(t.projectCode) : undefined);
          if (!project) return false;

          if (filterStore && project.store !== filterStore) return false;
          if (filterLocation && project.location !== filterLocation) return false;

          return true;
        });

        filteredTasks.forEach((t) => {
          const start = parseDateTime(t.start);
          const end = parseDateTime(t.finish);

          if (start) {
            const dayStart = new Date(start);
            dayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
            const dayEnd = new Date(start);
            dayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
            calendarEvents.push({
              id: `t_start_${t.id}`,
              title: `Start: ${t.projectCode ? t.projectCode + ' - ' : ''}${t.name}`,
              start: dayStart,
              end: dayEnd,
              allDay: true,
              resource: t,
              type: 'task',
              subType: 'start',
              color: '#2563eb',
            });
          }

          if (end) {
            const dayStart = new Date(end);
            dayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
            const dayEnd = new Date(end);
            dayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
            calendarEvents.push({
              id: `t_end_${t.id}`,
              title: `Finish: ${t.projectCode ? t.projectCode + ' - ' : ''}${t.name}`,
              start: dayStart,
              end: dayEnd,
              allDay: true,
              resource: t,
              type: 'task',
              subType: 'finish',
              color: '#a21caf',
            });
          }
        });
      }
    } else {
      const projectMap = new Map<string, Project>();
      projects.forEach((p) => {
        const key = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}`;
        projectMap.set(key, p);
        if (p.code) {
          projectMap.set(p.code, p);
        }
      });

      const filteredTasks = tasks.filter((t) => {
        const key = `${t.projectCode || ''}-${t.projectYear || ''}-${t.projectStore || ''}`;
        const project =
          projectMap.get(key) ||
          (t.projectCode ? projectMap.get(t.projectCode) : undefined);
        if (!project) return false;

        if (filterStore && project.store !== filterStore) return false;
        if (filterLocation && project.location !== filterLocation) return false;

        return true;
      });

      filteredTasks.forEach((t) => {
        const start = parseDateTime(t.start);
        const end = parseDateTime(t.finish);

        if (start && end) {
          let current = new Date(start);
          current.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          const endDay = new Date(end);
          endDay.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

          while (current <= endDay) {
            const dayStart = new Date(current);
            const dayEnd = new Date(current);
            dayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

            calendarEvents.push({
              id: `t_${t.id}_${current.getTime()}`,
              title: `${t.projectCode} - ${t.name}`,
              start: dayStart,
              end: dayEnd,
              allDay: true,
              resource: t,
              type: 'task',
            });

            current.setDate(current.getDate() + 1);
          }
        } else if (start) {
          const dayEnd = new Date(start);
          dayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
          calendarEvents.push({
            id: `t_${t.id}`,
            title: `${t.projectCode} - ${t.name}`,
            start: start,
            end: dayEnd,
            allDay: true,
            resource: t,
            type: 'task',
          });
        } else if (end) {
          const dayEnd = new Date(end);
          dayEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
          calendarEvents.push({
            id: `t_${t.id}`,
            title: `${t.projectCode} - ${t.name}`,
            start: end,
            end: dayEnd,
            allDay: true,
            resource: t,
            type: 'task',
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // Sort events to ensure consistent ordering
    calendarEvents.sort((a, b) => a.start.getTime() - b.start.getTime());

    if (currentView !== 'month') {
      const eventsByDate: Record<string, number> = {};
      calendarEvents.forEach((event) => {
        const dateStr = event.start.toDateString();
        if (eventsByDate[dateStr] === undefined) {
          eventsByDate[dateStr] = 0;
        }
        event.colorIndex = eventsByDate[dateStr] % 2;
        eventsByDate[dateStr]++;
      });
    }

    return calendarEvents;
  }, [projects, tasks, filterStore, filterLocation, currentView, showSubTasksInMonth]);

  return { events };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/ColumnAdder.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Plus, SlidersHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLanguage } from '../lib/LanguageContext';
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';

export function ColumnAdder({
  availableColumns,
  visibleColumns,
  onAddColumn,
  isHeader = false
}: {
  availableColumns: { id: string; label: string }[];
  visibleColumns: string[];
  onAddColumn: (id: string) => void;
  isHeader?: boolean;
}) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const hiddenCols = availableColumns.filter(c => !visibleColumns.includes(c.id));

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block text-left" ref={ref}>
      {isHeader ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
          className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center mx-auto active:scale-95"
          title={t("Add / Restore Column")}
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/80 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#252528] transition-all text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
        >
          <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400" />
          <span>{t('Add Column')}</span>
        </button>
      )}

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute top-full right-0 mt-1.5 w-56 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-xl z-50 p-2 flex flex-col gap-1.5 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 px-2 py-1 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>{t('Toggle Columns')}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono">{visibleColumns.length}/{availableColumns.length}</span>
          </div>

          <div className="max-h-56 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-0.5 py-1">
            {availableColumns.map((col) => {
              const isVisible = visibleColumns.includes(col.id);
              return (
                <button
                  key={col.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onAddColumn(col.id)}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors text-left cursor-pointer",
                    isVisible
                      ? "bg-blue-50/80 dark:bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300"
                      : "hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400"
                  )}
                >
                  <span>{col.label}</span>
                  <span className={cn(
                    "text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded",
                    isVisible
                      ? "bg-blue-600 text-white"
                      : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-400"
                  )}>
                    {isVisible ? t('Shown') : t('Hidden')}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}



/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CommandPaletteModal.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import { Search, Command, X, Sparkles, Building2, Tag, List, LayoutDashboard } from 'lucide-react';
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from './DebouncedSearchInput';
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';
import {
  CommandPaletteModalProps,
  CommandCategory,
} from './CommandPaletteParts/commandPaletteTypes';
import { useCommandPaletteItems } from './CommandPaletteParts/useCommandPaletteItems';
import { CommandPaletteItemRow } from './CommandPaletteParts/CommandPaletteItemRow';
import { CommandPaletteFooter } from './CommandPaletteParts/CommandPaletteFooter';

export function CommandPaletteModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onTabChange,
  onToggleTheme,
  onToggleFocusMode,
  onPrintPreviewToggle,
}: CommandPaletteModalProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<CommandCategory>('all');
  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState(0);

  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Auto focus input on open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setSearchQuery('');
      setSelectedCategory('all');
      setSelectedIndex(0);
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        inputRef.current?.focus();
        inputRef.current?.select();
      }, 50);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const categories: Array<{ id: CommandCategory; label: string; icon: React.ElementType }> = [
    { id: 'all', label: 'All', icon: Sparkles },
    { id: 'actions', label: 'Actions', icon: Sparkles },
    { id: 'navigation', label: 'Navigation', icon: LayoutDashboard },
    { id: 'floors', label: 'Floors', icon: Building2 },
    { id: 'projects', label: 'Projects', icon: Tag },
    { id: 'tasks', label: 'Tasks', icon: List },
  ];

  const { filteredItems } = useCommandPaletteItems({
    searchQuery,
    selectedCategory,
    onClose,
    onTabChange,
    onToggleTheme,
    onToggleFocusMode,
    onPrintPreviewToggle,
  });

  // Adjust active index within range
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedIndex(0);
  }, [searchQuery, selectedCategory]);

  // Scroll active item into view
  useEffect(() => {
    if (listRef.current) {
      const activeEl = listRef.current.querySelector(`[data-index="${selectedIndex}"]`);
      if (activeEl) {
        activeEl.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }
  }, [selectedIndex]);

  // Keyboard navigation
  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSelectedIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % Math.max(1, filteredItems.length));
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSelectedIndex(
          (prev) => (prev - 1 + filteredItems.length) % Math.max(1, filteredItems.length)
        );
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (filteredItems[selectedIndex]) {
          filteredItems[selectedIndex].onSelect();
        }
      } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      } else if (e.key === 'Tab') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const catKeys = categories.map((c) => c.id);
        const currentCatIdx = catKeys.indexOf(selectedCategory);
        const nextCatIdx = e.shiftKey
          ? (currentCatIdx - 1 + catKeys.length) % catKeys.length
          : (currentCatIdx + 1) % catKeys.length;
        setSelectedCategory(catKeys[nextCatIdx]);
      }
    },
    [filteredItems, selectedIndex, selectedCategory, categories, onClose]
  );

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-start justify-center pt-16 sm:pt-24 p-3 bg-slate-900/50 dark:bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <motion.div
        ref={containerRef}
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96, y: -10 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96, y: -10 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: 'easeOut' }}
        className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383a] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[82vh]"
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      >
        {/* Top Draggable Handle & Search Bar Header */}
        <div className="border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] p-3 sm:p-4 bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#252528]/70">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2 px-1 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
              <Command className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Command Palette</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="hidden sm:inline-flex text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-[#38383a] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">
                Esc to close
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="p-1 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-[#f3f3f3] hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#38383a] transition-colors"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="relative flex items-center">
            <Search className="absolute left-3.5 w-5 h-5 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] pointer-events-none z-10" />
            <DebouncedSearchInput
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(val) => setSearchQuery(val)}
              debounceMs={180}
              placeholder="Search projects, tasks, floors, actions, or jump to tab..."
              className="w-full pl-11 pr-24 py-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-[#838383] text-sm sm:text-base font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 shadow-xs transition-all"
            />
            <div className="absolute right-3 flex items-center gap-1 pointer-events-none z-10">
              <kbd className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded shadow-2xs">
                ⌘K
              </kbd>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Filter Categories Chips */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-2.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-0.5">
            {categories.map((cat) => {
              const Icon = cat.icon;
              const isActive = selectedCategory === cat.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={cat.id}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat.id)}
                  className={cn(
                    'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shrink-0 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation',
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-200/70 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-[#38383a]'
                  )}
                >
                  <Icon className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>{cat.label}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* List of Filtered Items */}
        <div
          ref={listRef}
          className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-1 divide-y divide-slate-100/50 dark:divide-[#28282a]/50"
        >
          {filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]">
              <Search className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">No results found for "{searchQuery}"</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
                Try typing project codes, task names, or actions like "Gantt" or "Theme"
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            filteredItems.map((item, idx) => (
              <CommandPaletteItemRow
                key={item.id}
                item={item}
                idx={idx}
                isSelected={idx === selectedIndex}
                onMouseEnter={setSelectedIndex}
              />
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        <CommandPaletteFooter totalResults={filteredItems.length} />
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default CommandPaletteModal;

                  )}
                >
                  {item.badge}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            {item.subtitle && (
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] truncate mt-0.5">

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CommandPaletteParts/commandPaletteTypes.ts ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { TabId } from '../../types';

export interface CommandPaletteModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onTabChange: (tab: TabId) => void;
  onToggleTheme?: () => void;
  onToggleFocusMode?: () => void;
  onPrintPreviewToggle?: () => void;
}

export type CommandCategory = 'all' | 'actions' | 'navigation' | 'floors' | 'projects' | 'tasks';

export interface PaletteItem {
  id: string;
  category: 'actions' | 'navigation' | 'floors' | 'projects' | 'tasks';
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  code?: string;
  badge?: string;
  badgeColor?: string;
  icon: React.ElementType;
  iconColor?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
  onSelect: () => void;
  score?: number;
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CommandPaletteParts/useCommandPaletteItems.ts ==================== */
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  FolderPlus,
  PlusCircle,
  Sun,
  Moon,
  Maximize2,
  Minimize2,
  CalendarCheck,
  Printer,
  DollarSign,
  ImageDown,
  LayoutDashboard,
  Calendar,
  BarChartHorizontal,
  List,
  PieChart,
  Shield,
  FileText,
  Settings,
  HelpCircle,
  Building2,
  Tag,
  AlertCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { TabId, AppRole } from '../../types';
import { PaletteItem, CommandCategory, CommandPaletteModalProps } from './commandPaletteTypes';

interface UseCommandPaletteItemsProps {
  searchQuery: string;
  selectedCategory: CommandCategory;
  onClose: () => void;
  onTabChange: (tab: TabId) => void;
  onToggleTheme?: () => void;
  onToggleFocusMode?: () => void;
  onPrintPreviewToggle?: () => void;
}

export function useCommandPaletteItems({
  searchQuery,
  selectedCategory,
  onClose,
  onTabChange,
  onToggleTheme,
  onToggleFocusMode,
  onPrintPreviewToggle,
}: UseCommandPaletteItemsProps) {
  const currentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.currentUser);
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore((state) => state.permissionMatrix);
  const theme = useAppStore((state) => state.theme);
  const isFocusMode = useAppStore((state) => state.isFocusMode);
  const currency = useAppStore((state) => state.currency);
  const setCurrency = useAppStore((state) => state.setCurrency);
  const locations = useAppStore((state) => state.locations);
  const setIsProjectModalOpen = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsProjectModalOpen);
  const setEditingProject = useAppStore((state) => state.setEditingProject);
  const setIsTaskModalOpen = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsTaskModalOpen);
  const setEditingTask = useAppStore((state) => state.setEditingTask);
  const setIsReadOnlyModal = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsReadOnlyModal);
  const setModalInitialTab = useAppStore((state) => state.setModalInitialTab);
  const setPrefillProjectCode = useAppStore((state) => state.setPrefillProjectCode);
  const setPrefillProjectYear = useAppStore((state) => state.setPrefillProjectYear);
  const triggerGanttToday = useAppStore((state) => state.triggerGanttToday);
  const setLayoutTabFilters = useAppStore((state) => state.setLayoutTabFilters);
  const setGanttTabFocusTaskId = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttTabFocusTaskId);
  const setDetailTabFocusTaskId = useAppStore((state) => state.setDetailTabFocusTaskId);
  const setQuickNavTarget = useAppStore((state) => state.setQuickNavTarget);

  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks } = useEnrichedData();

  const userRole = (currentUser?.role || 'guest') as AppRole;
  const isAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  const perms = permissionMatrix[userRole] || {};

  // 1. Build Quick Actions
  const actionItems: PaletteItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    const items: PaletteItem[] = [];

    // New Project
    if (isAdmin || !!(perms as any)?.Write?.general) {
      items.push({
        id: 'action-new-project',
        category: 'actions',
        title: 'Create New Project',
        subtitle: 'Open blank project modal',
        icon: FolderPlus,
        iconColor: 'text-blue-500 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/50',
        shortcut: 'P',
        onSelect: () => {
          setEditingProject(null);
          setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
          setModalInitialTab('details');
          setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
          onClose();
        },
      });
    }

    // New Task
    if (isAdmin || !!(perms as any)?.Write?.detail) {
      items.push({
        id: 'action-new-task',
        category: 'actions',
        title: 'Create New Task',
        subtitle: 'Add new task to current or selected project',
        icon: PlusCircle,
        iconColor: 'text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50',
        shortcut: 'T',
        onSelect: () => {
          setEditingTask(null);
          setIsReadOnlyModal(false);
          setModalInitialTab('details');
          const safeP = projects && projects.length > 0 ? projects[0] : null;
          setPrefillProjectCode(safeP?.code || '');
          setPrefillProjectYear(safeP?.year || null);
          setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
          onClose();
        },
      });
    }

    // Toggle Theme
    items.push({
      id: 'action-toggle-theme',
      category: 'actions',
      title: theme === 'dark' ? 'Switch to Light Mode' : 'Switch to Dark Mode',
      subtitle: `Currently in ${theme === 'dark' ? 'Dark' : 'Light'} theme`,
      icon: theme === 'dark' ? Sun : Moon,
      iconColor: 'text-amber-500 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/50',
      onSelect: () => {
        onToggleTheme?.();
        onClose();
      },
    });

    // Toggle Focus Mode
    items.push({
      id: 'action-toggle-focus',
      category: 'actions',
      title: isFocusMode ? 'Exit Focus Mode' : 'Enter Focus Mode',
      subtitle: 'Maximize workspace and hide toolbars',
      icon: isFocusMode ? Minimize2 : Maximize2,
      iconColor: 'text-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/50',
      shortcut: 'Shift+F',
      onSelect: () => {
        onToggleFocusMode?.();
        onClose();
      },
    });

    // Go to Today in Gantt
    items.push({
      id: 'action-gantt-today',
      category: 'actions',
      title: 'Go to Today (Gantt Timeline)',
      subtitle: 'Scroll timeline directly to Today vertical marker',
      icon: CalendarCheck,
      iconColor: 'text-rose-500 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50',
      onSelect: () => {
        onTabChange('gantt');
        triggerGanttToday();
        onClose();
      },
    });

    // Print Preview
    items.push({
      id: 'action-print-preview',
      category: 'actions',
      title: 'Toggle Print Preview',
      subtitle: 'High-fidelity PDF and paper export preview',
      icon: Printer,
      iconColor: 'text-purple-500 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/50',
      onSelect: () => {
        onPrintPreviewToggle?.();
        onClose();
      },
    });

    // Switch Currency
    items.push({
      id: 'action-currency',
      category: 'actions',
      title: `Cycle Currency (Current: ${currency === 'VND' ? "'000 VND" : currency === 'JPY' ? '万円' : 'USD'})`,
      subtitle: 'Switch between VND, JPY, and USD display rates',
      icon: DollarSign,
      iconColor: 'text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50',
      onSelect: () => {
        let next: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD' = 'VND';
        if (currency === 'VND') next = 'JPY';
        else if (currency === 'JPY') next = 'USD';
        setCurrency(next);
        onClose();
      },
    });

    // Export PNG
    items.push({
      id: 'action-export-png',
      category: 'actions',
      title: 'Export Active View as PNG',
      subtitle: 'Capture high resolution image snapshot',
      icon: ImageDown,
      iconColor: 'text-cyan-500 bg-cyan-50 dark:bg-cyan-950/50',
      onSelect: () => {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('export-png'));
        onClose();
      },
    });

    return items;
  }, [
    isAdmin,
    perms,
    theme,
    isFocusMode,
    currency,
    projects,
    onClose,
    onTabChange,
    onToggleTheme,
    onToggleFocusMode,
    onPrintPreviewToggle,
    setEditingProject,
    setIsReadOnlyModal,
    setModalInitialTab,
    setIsProjectModalOpen,
    setEditingTask,
    setPrefillProjectCode,
    setPrefillProjectYear,
    setIsTaskModalOpen,
    triggerGanttToday,
    setCurrency,
  ]);

  // 2. Build Navigation Items (Tabs)
  const navItems: PaletteItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    const tabs: Array<{
      id: TabId;
      label: string;
      desc: string;
      icon: React.ElementType;
      shortcut?: string;
    }> = [
      { id: 'general', label: 'General Tab', desc: 'Project overview and master summary table', icon: LayoutDashboard, shortcut: '1' },
      { id: 'calendar', label: 'Calendar Tab', desc: 'Monthly project & task delivery schedule', icon: Calendar, shortcut: '2' },
      { id: 'gantt', label: 'Gantt Chart Tab', desc: 'Interactive timeline with dependencies & today pin', icon: BarChartHorizontal, shortcut: '3' },
      { id: 'detail', label: 'Task Detail Tab', desc: 'Granular task list with inline status & progress', icon: List, shortcut: '4' },
      { id: 'budget', label: 'Budget Tab', desc: 'Capital expenditure and cash flow management', icon: PieChart, shortcut: '5' },
      { id: 'cost', label: 'Cost Detail Tab', desc: 'Detailed payment vouchers & vendor expenses', icon: DollarSign, shortcut: '6' },
      { id: 'layout', label: 'Floor Layout Tab', desc: 'Interactive 2D architectural map & store locator', icon: Building2, shortcut: '7' },
      { id: 'summary', label: 'Summary Matrix Tab', desc: 'Cross-functional executive KPIs and metrics', icon: FileText, shortcut: '8' },
      { id: 'taskDelegation', label: 'Task Delegation Tab', desc: 'Multi-party vendor and contractor assignment', icon: List, shortcut: '9' },
      { id: 'taskDelegationCalendar', label: 'Delegation Calendar Tab', desc: 'Timeline view of contractor work schedules', icon: Calendar },
      { id: 'accControl', label: 'Access Control Tab', desc: 'User permissions, roles, and store access matrix', icon: Shield },
      { id: 'audit', label: 'Audit Log Tab', desc: 'Append-only chronological change history', icon: Shield },
      { id: 'csv_export', label: 'CSV Export / Import Tab', desc: 'Bulk data migration and backup engine', icon: FileText },
      { id: 'picture_mapping', label: 'Picture Mapping Tab', desc: 'Floor plan image and anchor configuration', icon: ImageDown },
      { id: 'notification', label: 'Notifications Tab', desc: 'Critical milestones, handover & opening alerts', icon: AlertCircle },
      { id: 'setting', label: 'Settings Tab', desc: 'Notification rules, threshold days, and display preferences', icon: Settings },
      { id: 'manual', label: 'User Manual Tab', desc: 'Standard operating procedures and user manual', icon: HelpCircle },
    ];

    return tabs.map((tab) => ({
      id: `nav-${tab.id}`,
      category: 'navigation',
      title: tab.label,
      subtitle: tab.desc,
      icon: tab.icon,
      iconColor: 'text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a]',
      shortcut: tab.shortcut,
      onSelect: () => {
        onTabChange(tab.id);
        onClose();
      },
    }));
  }, [onTabChange, onClose]);

  // 3. Build Floor Layout Items
  const floorItems: PaletteItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    const list = locations && locations.length > 0 ? locations : ['L1', 'L2', 'L3', 'B1', 'B2', '3F', '4F'];
    return list.map((floor) => ({
      id: `floor-${floor}`,
      category: 'floors',
      title: `Floor ${floor} Layout`,
      subtitle: `Jump directly to Floor ${floor} architectural floor plan`,
      badge: floor,
      badgeColor: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/60 dark:text-purple-300',
      icon: Building2,
      iconColor: 'text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/50',
      onSelect: () => {
        setLayoutTabFilters({ location: floor });
        onTabChange('layout');
        onClose();
      },
    }));
  }, [locations, setLayoutTabFilters, onTabChange, onClose]);

  // 4. Build Projects Items
  const projectItems: PaletteItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!projects || projects.length === 0) return [];
    return projects.map((p) => {
      const isHCM = (p.store || '').toUpperCase() === 'HCM';
      const desc = p.detail || (p as any).description || p.note || '';
      return {
        id: `proj-${p.id || p.code}`,
        category: 'projects',
        title: p.name || 'Untitled Project',
        subtitle: `${p.year || ''} • ${p.store || 'HCM'} • Floor ${p.location || 'N/A'}${
          desc ? ` • ${desc.length > 80 ? desc.slice(0, 80) + '...' : desc}` : ''
        }`,
        code: `${p.code || ''} ${p.linkCodes || ''} ${desc}`,
        badge: p.store || 'HCM',
        badgeColor: isHCM
          ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/60 dark:text-blue-300'
          : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/60 dark:text-red-300',
        icon: Tag,
        iconColor: isHCM
          ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/50'
          : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/50',
        onSelect: () => {
          setQuickNavTarget({ project: p });
          onClose();
        },
      };
    });
  }, [projects, setQuickNavTarget, onClose]);

  // 5. Build Tasks Items
  const taskItems: PaletteItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!tasks || tasks.length === 0) return [];
    return tasks.map((t) => {
      const runningStatus = t.runningStatus || 'In Progress';
      const percent = (t as any).percent ?? (t as any).progress ?? 0;
      return {
        id: `task-${t.id}`,
        category: 'tasks',
        title: t.name || 'Untitled Task',
        subtitle: `Project ${t.projectCode || ''} • Party: ${t.party || 'Internal'} • Status: ${runningStatus}`,
        code: t.taskCodePhu || t.projectCode,
        badge: `${percent}%`,
        badgeColor:
          percent >= 100
            ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/60 dark:text-emerald-300'
            : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-[#333336] dark:text-[#c3c3c3]',
        icon: List,
        iconColor: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50',
        onSelect: () => {
          setGanttTabFocusTaskId(t.id);
          setDetailTabFocusTaskId(t.id);
          onTabChange('gantt');
          onClose();
        },
      };
    });
  }, [tasks, setGanttTabFocusTaskId, setDetailTabFocusTaskId, onTabChange, onClose]);

  // Combine & Filter based on searchQuery and selectedCategory
  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();

    const pool = [
      ...(selectedCategory === 'all' || selectedCategory === 'actions' ? actionItems : []),
      ...(selectedCategory === 'all' || selectedCategory === 'navigation' ? navItems : []),
      ...(selectedCategory === 'all' || selectedCategory === 'floors' ? floorItems : []),
      ...(selectedCategory === 'all' || selectedCategory === 'projects' ? projectItems : []),
      ...(selectedCategory === 'all' || selectedCategory === 'tasks' ? taskItems : []),
    ];

    if (!q) {
      if (selectedCategory === 'all') {
        return [
          ...actionItems.slice(0, 4),
          ...navItems.slice(0, 4),
          ...floorItems.slice(0, 3),
          ...projectItems.slice(0, 5),
          ...taskItems.slice(0, 4),
        ];
      }
      return pool.slice(0, 25);
    }

    return pool
      .filter((item) => {
        const titleMatch = item.title.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const subMatch = (item.subtitle || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const codeMatch = (item.code || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const badgeMatch = (item.badge || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        return titleMatch || subMatch || codeMatch || badgeMatch;
      })
      .slice(0, 30);
  }, [searchQuery, selectedCategory, actionItems, navItems, floorItems, projectItems, taskItems]);

  return {
    filteredItems,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/ConfirmModal.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { Portal } from './Portal';
import { AlertTriangle, Info, X, GripHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';
import { getZIndexClass } from '../lib/zIndexManager';

interface ConfirmModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  title?: string;
  message: string;
  confirmText?: string;
  confirmStyle?: "danger" | "primary";
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export function ConfirmModal({ isOpen, title = "Confirm", message, confirmText = "Delete", confirmStyle = "danger", onConfirm, onCancel}: ConfirmModalProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onCancel();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onCancel]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <Portal>
      <div className={`fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/50 flex items-end md:items-center justify-center ${getZIndexClass('CONFIRM_ALERT')} p-0 md:p-4`}>
        <Draggable disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} handle=".modal-handle" bounds="parent" nodeRef={nodeRef} cancel="button">
          <div ref={nodeRef} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-t-2xl md:rounded-2xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden border border-transparent dark:border-[#333336] animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-full md:slide-in-from-bottom-0 md:zoom-in-95 duration-200 pointer-events-auto relative">
            <div className="modal-handle cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing px-6 pt-4 pb-2 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#28282a]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-400">
                <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span className="font-medium text-[11px]">{t("Drag to move") || "Drag to move"}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onCancel}
                className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-[#e3e3e3] rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors"
                title={t("Cancel") || "Cancel"}
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-6 pb-[calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom)+1.5rem)] md:pb-6">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4">
                <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full ${confirmStyle === 'danger' ? 'bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30' : 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30'} flex items-center justify-center shrink-0`}>
                  {confirmStyle === 'danger' ? (
                     <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" />
                  ) : (
                     <Info className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                  )}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">{title}</h3>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] text-sm mt-1">{message}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-3 justify-end mt-8">
                <button type="button" title={t("Cancel")}
                  onClick={onCancel}
                  className="flex-1 md:flex-none px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors"
                >{t("Cancel")}</button>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => {
                    onConfirm();
                    onCancel();
                  }}
                  className={`flex-1 md:flex-none px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-colors ${
                    confirmStyle === 'danger' ? 'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700' : 'bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {confirmText}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Draggable>
      </div>
    </Portal>
  );
}

              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'secondPaid', val)}

            />
            {c.secondPaidAt && (
              <span
                className={cn(

                  isSecondPaidMatch
                    ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold'
                    : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]'
                )}
              >

              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('thirdPaid') && (
        <td
          className={cn(
            'px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/30 transition-all',
            isThirdPaidMatch &&
              'bg-emerald-100/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/80 rounded-sm'
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex flex-col items-end">
            <CostEditableCell
              value={c.thirdPaid || 0}
              type="number"
              isCurrency
              currency={currency}
              jpyRate={jpyRate}
              usdRate={usdRate}
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'thirdPaid', val)}
              canWrite={canWrite}
            />
            {c.thirdPaidAt && (
              <span
                className={cn(
                  'text-[10px] font-normal mt-1',
                  isThirdPaidMatch
                    ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold'
                    : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]'
                )}
              >
                update {formatDisplayDateMain(c.thirdPaidAt)}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('balance') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/30">
          {formatCurrency(
            (c.actual || 0) -
              (c.firstPaid || 0) -
              (c.secondPaid || 0) -
              (c.thirdPaid || 0)
          )}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('supportingFee') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/30">
          <CostEditableCell
            value={c.supportingFee}
            type="number"
            isCurrency
            currency={currency}
            jpyRate={jpyRate}
            usdRate={usdRate}
            onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'supportingFee', val)}
            canWrite={canWrite}
          />
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('description') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] whitespace-normal break-words min-w-[200px]">
          <CostEditableCell
            value={c.description}
            onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'description', val)}
            canWrite={canWrite}
            wrap
          />
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('vendor') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-medium whitespace-normal break-words min-w-[140px]">
          <CostEditableCell
            value={c.vendor}
            onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'vendor', val)}
            canWrite={canWrite}
            wrap
          />
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('action') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <QRCodeButton
                title={c.description || c.vendor || 'Cost Entry'}
                url={`${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}?tab=cost&q=${encodeURIComponent(
                  c.description || c.vendor || ''
                )}`}
              />
              {canWrite && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleDeleteCost(c)}
                  className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 transition-colors p-1.5 rounded hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/30 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 mx-auto" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            {c.updatedAt && (
              <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] font-mono text-center leading-tight">
                Update
                <br />
                {formatDisplayDateMain(c.updatedAt)}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
    </tr>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CostParts/CostEditableCell.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { cn, formatCurrencyValue } from '../../lib/utils';

interface CostEditableCellProps {
  value: any;
  type?: string;
  onSave: (val: any) => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
  isCurrency?: boolean;
  wrap?: boolean;
  currency?: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate?: number;
  usdRate?: number;
}

export const CostEditableCell = React.memo(function CostEditableCell({
  value,
  type = 'text',
  onSave,
  canWrite,
  isCurrency = false,
  wrap = false,
  currency = 'VND',
  jpyRate = 160,
  usdRate = 25000,
}: CostEditableCellProps) {
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [val, setVal] = useState(value || '');

  useEffect(() => {
    setVal(value || '');
  }, [value]);

  const handleBlur = () => {
    setIsEditing(false);
    const newVal = type === 'number' ? Number(val) : val;
    if (newVal !== value) {
      onSave(newVal);
    }
  };

  const displayValue = isCurrency
    ? value === null || value === undefined
      ? '-'
      : formatCurrencyValue(value, currency, jpyRate, usdRate)
    : value || '-';

  const isMoneyLocked = isCurrency && currency !== 'VND';
  const effectiveCanWrite = canWrite && !isMoneyLocked;

  if (!effectiveCanWrite) {
    return (
      <span
        title={
          isMoneyLocked
            ? `Editing locked in ${currency}. Switch to VND to edit.`
            : undefined
        }
        className={cn(
          wrap ? 'break-words whitespace-pre-wrap' : '',
          isMoneyLocked
            ? 'cursor-not-allowed select-text opacity-95 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]'
            : ''
        )}
      >
        {displayValue}
      </span>
    );
  }

  if (isEditing) {
    if (wrap && type === 'text') {
      return (
        <textarea
          autoFocus
          value={val}
          onChange={(e) => setVal(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={handleBlur}
          className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-400 rounded px-1 py-0.5 outline-none text-inherit font-inherit text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] min-h-[60px] resize-y"
        />
      );
    }
    return (
      <input
        autoFocus
        type={type}
        value={val}
        onChange={(e) => setVal(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={handleBlur}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
        }}
        className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-400 rounded px-1 py-0.5 outline-none text-inherit font-inherit text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)}
      className={cn(
        'cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] px-1 py-0.5 rounded border border-transparent hover:border-slate-200 min-h-[24px]',
        wrap ? 'break-words whitespace-pre-wrap' : 'truncate'
      )}
    >
      {displayValue}
    </div>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CostParts/CostFilterToolbar.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { MultiCheckboxSelect } from '../MultiCheckboxSelect';

interface CostFilterToolbarProps {
  globalYearFilter: string;
  setGlobalYearFilter: (val: string) => void;
  years: string[];
  effectiveStore: string;
  setGlobalStoreFilter: (val: string) => void;
  stores: string[];
  globalLocationFilter: string[];

  canWrite: boolean;
  isAdmin: boolean;

export const CostFilterToolbar = React.memo(function CostFilterToolbar({
  globalYearFilter,

  setGlobalStoreFilter,
  stores,
  globalLocationFilter,
  setGlobalLocationFilter,
  locationOptions,
  hasActForcFilter,
  setHasActForcFilter,
  searchTerm,
  setSearchTerm,
  visibleColumns,
  handleToggleColumn,
  canWrite,
  isAdmin,
  handleExportCosts,
  handleImportCosts,
}: CostFilterToolbarProps) {
  return (
    <div className="px-3 sm:px-4 md:px-5 py-3 md:py-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 flex flex-col xl:flex-row gap-3 justify-between items-stretch xl:items-center shrink-0 print:hidden">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 w-full xl:w-auto flex-grow min-w-0">
        <select
          value={globalYearFilter}
          onChange={(e) => setGlobalYearFilter(e.target.value)}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block p-2 outline-none shadow-sm min-w-[85px] sm:min-w-[95px] flex-1 sm:flex-none cursor-pointer"
        >
          <option value="all">All Years</option>
          {years.map((y) => (
            <option key={y} value={y}>
              Year {y}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>

        <select
          value={effectiveStore}
          onChange={(e) => setGlobalStoreFilter(e.target.value)}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block p-2 outline-none shadow-sm min-w-[85px] sm:min-w-[95px] flex-1 sm:flex-none cursor-pointer"
        >
          {stores.length > 1 && <option value="all">All Stores</option>}
          {stores.map((s) => (
            <option key={s} value={s}>
              {s}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>

        <MultiCheckboxSelect
          value={globalLocationFilter}
          onChange={setGlobalLocationFilter}
          options={locationOptions}
          placeholder="All Locations"
          className="min-w-[95px] sm:min-w-[100px] flex-1 sm:flex-none"
        />

        <select
          value={hasActForcFilter}
          onChange={(e) => setHasActForcFilter(e.target.value)}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block p-2 outline-none shadow-sm min-w-[95px] sm:min-w-[100px] flex-1 sm:flex-none cursor-pointer"
        >
          <option value="all">All Act/Forc</option>
          <option value="has_value">Has Act/Forc</option>
        </select>

        <div className="relative flex-grow min-w-[140px] sm:min-w-[180px] max-w-full">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3 pointer-events-none text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] z-10">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <DebouncedSearchInput
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(val) => setSearchTerm(val)}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block w-full pl-9 pr-3 p-2 outline-none shadow-sm"
            placeholder="Search in cost details..."
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end shrink-0 self-end xl:self-center">
        <ColumnAdder
          availableColumns={AVAILABLE_COLUMNS}
          visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
          onAddColumn={handleToggleColumn}
        />

        {canWrite && (
          <div className="flex gap-1 items-center">
            {isAdmin && (
              <FullReplaceImport
                collectionName="taka_costs"
                onImportSuccess={(count) =>
                  useAppStore.getState().setToast({
                    title: 'Notice',
                    message: `Full replace successful! Imported ${count} cost entries.`,
                  })
                }
                onParseRow={(row, headers) => {
                  const c: any = {};
                  const parseCSVNumber = (val: any) => {
                    if (typeof val === 'string') {
                      const cleaned = val.replace(/,/g, '').trim();
                      if (cleaned === '-' || cleaned === '') return 0;
                      const num = Number(cleaned);
                      return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num;
                    }
                    return Number(val) || 0;
                  };

                  headers.forEach((h, i) => {
                    const keyMap: Record<string, string> = {
                      projectcode: 'projectCode',
                      projectyear: 'projectYear',
                      year: 'projectYear',
                      projectstore: 'projectStore',
                      store: 'projectStore',
                      firstpaid: 'firstPaid',
                      firstpaidat: 'firstPaidAt',
                      secondpaid: 'secondPaid',
                      secondpaidat: 'secondPaidAt',
                      thirdpaid: 'thirdPaid',
                      thirdpaidat: 'thirdPaidAt',
                      supportingfee: 'supportingFee',
                    };
                    const field = keyMap[h] || h;
                    let val: any = row[i];
                    if (
                      [
                        'actual',
                        'firstPaid',
                        'secondPaid',
                        'thirdPaid',
                        'supportingFee',
                      ].includes(field)
                    ) {
                      val = parseCSVNumber(val);
                    }
                    if (['projectYear'].includes(field)) {
                      val = isNaN(Number(val)) ? val : Number(val);
                    }
                    c[field] = val;
                  });
                  if (!c.projectCode || !c.description) return null;
                  return c;
                }}
                id="cost-full-import-btn"
                hiddenBtn={true}
              />
            )}
            <button
              id="cost-export-btn"
              onClick={handleExportCosts}
              className="hidden"
            />
            <input
              id="cost-import-input"
              type="file"
              accept=".csv"
              onChange={handleImportCosts}
              className="hidden"
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CostParts/CostMobileCard.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project, Cost } from '../../types';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { QuickNavButton } from '../QuickNavButton';
import { CostMobileItemRow } from './CostMobileItemRow';
import { PaidDateMatches } from './costTypes';

interface CostMobileCardProps {
  project: Project;
  groupCosts: Cost[];
  groupKey: string;
  isExpanded: boolean;
  toggleGroup: (key: string) => void;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
  canWrite: boolean;
  handleAddCost: (p: Project) => void;
  handleDeleteCost: (c: Cost) => void;
  handleUpdateCost: (c: Cost, field: keyof Cost, value: any) => void;
  currency: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate: number;
  usdRate: number;
  paidDateStart: string;
  paidDateEnd: string;
  paidStageFilter: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd';
  getCostPaidMatches: (
    c: Cost,
    start: string,
    end: string,
    stage: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd'
  ) => PaidDateMatches;
}

export const CostMobileCard = React.memo(function CostMobileCard({
  project: p,
  groupCosts,
  groupKey,
  isExpanded,
  toggleGroup,
  formatCurrency,
  canWrite,
  handleAddCost,
  handleDeleteCost,
  handleUpdateCost,
  currency,
  jpyRate,
  usdRate,
  paidDateStart,
  paidDateEnd,
  paidStageFilter,
  getCostPaidMatches,
}: CostMobileCardProps) {
  const pDerivedYear = p.year
    ? p.year
    : p.start
    ? Number(String(p.start).substring(0, 4))
    : undefined;

  const totalAct = groupCosts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.actual || 0), 0);
  const totalBalance = groupCosts.reduce(
    (sum, c) =>
      sum +
      ((c.actual || 0) -
        (c.firstPaid || 0) -
        (c.secondPaid || 0) -
        (c.thirdPaid || 0)),
    0
  );

  const pCleanName = p.name
    ? p.name.replace(new RegExp(`^${p.store}\\s*-\\s*${p.code}\\s*-\\s*`, 'i'), '')
    : '-';

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'mobile-card-optimized rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-[#38383b] shadow-xs hover:shadow-md p-3.5 flex flex-col gap-2.5 transition-all bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]',
        totalBalance >= 0
          ? 'border-l-[5px] border-l-emerald-500'
          : 'border-l-[5px] border-l-rose-500'
      )}
    >
      {/* Header: Left column (Badges & Title) & Right column (ACT/FORC, Balance, QuickNav) */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 w-full">
        {/* Left Column */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shrink-0">
              {pDerivedYear || p.year || '-'}
            </span>
            <span
              className={cn(
                'px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded border uppercase shrink-0',
                p.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hcm'
                  ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/80 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800'
                  : p.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hn'
                  ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'
              )}
            >
              {p.store || '-'}
            </span>
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold font-mono rounded bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800 shrink-0">
              {p.code}
            </span>
            {p.location && (
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium truncate">
                • {p.location}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Title row with expand toggle */}
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 pt-0.5">
            <button
              onClick={() => toggleGroup(groupKey)}
              className={cn(
                'flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 mt-0.5 shrink-0 rounded text-white font-extrabold text-[10px] shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer',
                groupCosts.length >= 2
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500'
                  : 'bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-600 dark:hover:bg-blue-500'
              )}
              title={isExpanded ? 'Collapse' : `Expand (${groupCosts.length})`}
            >
              {!isExpanded ? (
                <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              ) : (
                <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              )}
              <span>({groupCosts.length})</span>
            </button>
            <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#ffffff] text-sm sm:text-base leading-snug flex-1 min-w-0 break-words">
              {pCleanName}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: ACT/FORC, Balance, QuickNav */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1 shrink-0">
          <div
            className={cn(
              'text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md border font-mono flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0',
              groupCosts.some((c) => c.costType === 'forc')
                ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800'
                : 'text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/30 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800'
            )}
          >
            {groupCosts.length > 0
              ? groupCosts.some((c) => c.costType === 'forc')
                ? 'FORC:'
                : 'ACT:'
              : 'ACT:'}{' '}
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
              {formatCurrency(totalAct)}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div
            className={cn(
              'text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md border font-mono shrink-0',
              totalBalance >= 0
                ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-[#1a3821] border-emerald-200 dark:border-[#265330]'
                : 'text-red-500 dark:text-red-400 bg-red-50 dark:bg-[#3b1a1a] border-red-200 dark:border-[#5c2424]'
            )}
          >
            Bal: {formatCurrency(totalBalance)}
          </div>

          <QuickNavButton
            project={p}
            title={`Quick Navigator (${p.code})`}
            className="p-1! rounded!"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Expanded Cost Item Cards */}
      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 mt-1">
          {groupCosts.map((c) => (
            <CostMobileItemRow
              key={c.id}
              cost={c}
              project={p}
              pDerivedYear={pDerivedYear}
              canWrite={canWrite}
              currency={currency}
              jpyRate={jpyRate}
              usdRate={usdRate}
              paidDateStart={paidDateStart}
              paidDateEnd={paidDateEnd}
              paidStageFilter={paidStageFilter}
              getCostPaidMatches={getCostPaidMatches}
              handleUpdateCost={handleUpdateCost}
              handleDeleteCost={handleDeleteCost}
              formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {canWrite && isExpanded && (
        <button
          onClick={() => handleAddCost(p)}
          className="mt-2 w-full py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] text-sm font-bold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] border-dashed flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          Add Cost Entry
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

import { Project, Cost } from '../../types';
import { cn, formatDisplayDateMain } from '../../lib/utils';
import { CostEditableCell } from './CostEditableCell';

interface CostMobileItemRowProps {
