  project: Project;
  pDerivedYear?: number | string;
  canWrite: boolean;
  currency: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate: number;
  usdRate: number;
  paidDateStart: string;
  paidDateEnd: string;
  paidStageFilter: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd';
  getCostPaidMatches: (
    c: Cost,
    start: string,
    end: string,
    stage: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd'
  ) => PaidDateMatches;
  handleUpdateCost: (c: Cost, field: keyof Cost, value: any) => void;
  handleDeleteCost: (c: Cost) => void;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
}

export const CostMobileItemRow = React.memo(function CostMobileItemRow({
  cost: c,
  project: p,
  pDerivedYear,
  canWrite,
  currency,
  jpyRate,
  usdRate,
  paidDateStart,
  paidDateEnd,
  paidStageFilter,
  getCostPaidMatches,
  handleUpdateCost,
  handleDeleteCost,
  formatCurrency,
}: CostMobileItemRowProps) {
  const cBalance =
    (c.actual || 0) -
    (c.firstPaid || 0) -
    (c.secondPaid || 0) -
    (c.thirdPaid || 0);

  const {
    matches: isCostMatched,
    firstMatch: isFirstPaidMatch,
    secondMatch: isSecondPaidMatch,
    thirdMatch: isThirdPaidMatch,
  } = getCostPaidMatches(c, paidDateStart, paidDateEnd, paidStageFilter);

  return (
    <div
      key={c.id}
      className={cn(
        'p-2.5 rounded-lg border flex flex-col gap-2 transition-all',
        isCostMatched && (paidDateStart || paidDateEnd)
          ? 'bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800/80 shadow-2xs'
          : 'bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#18181a]/50 border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#38383a]'
      )}
    >
      {/* Top: Badges, Vendor, Description & Act/Forc */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shrink-0">
              {pDerivedYear || p.year || '-'}
            </span>
            <div className="text-[11px] bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800/60 inline-flex items-center gap-1 max-w-full">
              <span className="text-blue-400 shrink-0 font-normal">by</span>
              <div className="min-w-0 truncate font-semibold">
                <CostEditableCell
                  value={c.vendor}
                  onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'vendor', val)}
                  canWrite={canWrite}
                  wrap
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] mt-0.5 break-words font-medium">
            <CostEditableCell
              value={c.description}
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'description', val)}
              canWrite={canWrite}
              wrap
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {canWrite ? (
              <div className="flex bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-[#28282a] rounded-md p-0.5 shadow-inner border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleUpdateCost(c, 'costType', 'act')}
                  className={cn(
                    'px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold uppercase rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer',
                    c.costType !== 'forc'
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                      : 'text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]'
                  )}
                >
                  ACT
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleUpdateCost(c, 'costType', 'forc')}
                  className={cn(
                    'px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold uppercase rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer',
                    c.costType === 'forc'
                      ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-2xs'
                      : 'text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]'
                  )}
                >
                  FORC
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <span
                className={cn(
                  'text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border uppercase',
                  c.costType === 'forc'
                    ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800'
                    : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/30 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800'
                )}
              >
                {c.costType === 'forc' ? 'FORC' : 'ACT'}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="font-mono font-bold text-sm text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">
            <CostEditableCell
              value={c.actual}
              type="number"
              isCurrency
              currency={currency}
              jpyRate={jpyRate}
              usdRate={usdRate}
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'actual', val)}
              canWrite={canWrite}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Middle: 3-column Payments */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 py-2 px-1 bg-white/80 dark:bg-[#18181a]/60 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/70 dark:border-[#38383a] mt-1">
        <div
          className={cn(
            'flex flex-col items-center text-center min-w-0 p-1 rounded transition-all',
            isFirstPaidMatch &&
              'bg-emerald-100/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 ring-2 ring-emerald-500'
          )}
        >
          <span className="text-[9px] font-medium text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase mb-0.5">
            1st Paid
          </span>
          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] text-xs min-w-0 truncate max-w-full">
            <CostEditableCell
              value={c.firstPaid || 0}
              type="number"
              isCurrency
              currency={currency}
              jpyRate={jpyRate}
              usdRate={usdRate}
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'firstPaid', val)}
              canWrite={canWrite}
            />
          </span>
          {c.firstPaidAt && (
            <span
              className={cn(
                'text-[8px] font-mono truncate mt-0.5',
                isFirstPaidMatch
                  ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold'
                  : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold'
              )}
            >
              {formatDisplayDateMain(c.firstPaidAt)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div
          className={cn(
            'flex flex-col items-center text-center border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383a] min-w-0 p-1 rounded transition-all',
            isSecondPaidMatch &&
              'bg-emerald-100/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 ring-2 ring-emerald-500'
          )}
        >
          <span className="text-[9px] font-medium text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase mb-0.5">
            2nd Paid
          </span>
          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] text-xs min-w-0 truncate max-w-full">
            <CostEditableCell
              value={c.secondPaid || 0}
              type="number"
              isCurrency
              currency={currency}
              jpyRate={jpyRate}
              usdRate={usdRate}
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'secondPaid', val)}
              canWrite={canWrite}
            />
          </span>
          {c.secondPaidAt && (
            <span
              className={cn(
                'text-[8px] font-mono truncate mt-0.5',
                isSecondPaidMatch
                  ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold'
                  : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold'
              )}
            >
              {formatDisplayDateMain(c.secondPaidAt)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div
          className={cn(
            'flex flex-col items-center text-center border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383a] min-w-0 p-1 rounded transition-all',
            isThirdPaidMatch &&
              'bg-emerald-100/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 ring-2 ring-emerald-500'
          )}
        >
          <span className="text-[9px] font-medium text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase mb-0.5">
            3rd Paid
          </span>
          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] text-xs min-w-0 truncate max-w-full">
            <CostEditableCell
              value={c.thirdPaid || 0}
              type="number"
              isCurrency
              currency={currency}
              jpyRate={jpyRate}
              usdRate={usdRate}
              onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'thirdPaid', val)}
              canWrite={canWrite}
            />
          </span>
          {c.thirdPaidAt && (
            <span
              className={cn(
                'text-[8px] font-mono truncate mt-0.5',
                isThirdPaidMatch
                  ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold'
                  : 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold'
              )}
            >
              {formatDisplayDateMain(c.thirdPaidAt)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom: Actions & Balances */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-1 mt-0.5">
        {canWrite ? (
          <button
            onClick={() => handleDeleteCost(c)}
            className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 p-1 rounded hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Delete Cost"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div />
        )}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap justify-end">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase font-medium">
              supp fee:
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400">
              <CostEditableCell
                value={c.supportingFee}
                type="number"
                isCurrency
                currency={currency}
                jpyRate={jpyRate}
                usdRate={usdRate}
                onSave={(val) => handleUpdateCost(c, 'supportingFee', val)}
                canWrite={canWrite}
              />
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] uppercase font-medium">
              Balance:
            </span>
            <span
              className={`font-mono font-bold text-xs ${
                cBalance >= 0
                  ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                  : 'text-red-500 dark:text-red-400'
              }`}
            >
              {formatCurrency(cBalance)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CostParts/CostMobileView.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project, Cost } from '../../types';
import { CostMobileCard } from './CostMobileCard';

interface CostMobileViewProps {
  filteredProjectsForDisplay: Project[];
  visibleCount: number;
  setVisibleCount: (fn: (prev: number) => number) => void;
  expandedCodes: string[];
  toggleAll: () => void;
  toggleGroup: (key: string) => void;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
  canWrite: boolean;
  handleAddCost: (p: Project) => void;
  handleDeleteCost: (c: Cost) => void;
  handleUpdateCost: (c: Cost, field: keyof Cost, value: any) => void;
  currency: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate: number;
  usdRate: number;
  paidDateStart: string;
  paidDateEnd: string;
  paidStageFilter: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd';
  getGroupCostsForProject: (p: Project) => Cost[];
  getCostPaidMatches: (
    c: Cost,
    start: string,
    end: string,
    stage: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd'
  ) => { matches: boolean; firstMatch: boolean; secondMatch: boolean; thirdMatch: boolean };
  handleCostScroll: (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
}

export const CostMobileView = React.memo(function CostMobileView({
  filteredProjectsForDisplay,
  visibleCount,
  setVisibleCount,
  expandedCodes,
  toggleAll,
  toggleGroup,
  formatCurrency,
  canWrite,
  handleAddCost,
  handleDeleteCost,
  handleUpdateCost,
  currency,
  jpyRate,
  usdRate,
  paidDateStart,
  paidDateEnd,
  paidStageFilter,
  getGroupCostsForProject,
  getCostPaidMatches,
  handleCostScroll,
}: CostMobileViewProps) {
  return (
    <>
      <div className="xl:hidden flex justify-between items-center px-2 pb-2 mt-2">
        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
          Cost Projects ({filteredProjectsForDisplay.length})
        </span>
        <button
          onClick={toggleAll}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-medium hover:text-blue-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          {expandedCodes.length === 0 ? (
            <>
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /> Expand All
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" /> Collapse All
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        className="xl:hidden flex-grow overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-4 pb-4 px-2"
        onScroll={handleCostScroll}
      >
        {filteredProjectsForDisplay.slice(0, visibleCount).map((p) => {
          const pDerivedYear = p.year
            ? p.year
            : p.start
            ? Number(String(p.start).substring(0, 4))
            : undefined;
          const allGroupCosts = getGroupCostsForProject(p);
          const groupCosts =
            paidDateStart || paidDateEnd
              ? allGroupCosts.filter(
                  (c) =>
                    getCostPaidMatches(c, paidDateStart, paidDateEnd, paidStageFilter).matches
                )
              : allGroupCosts;
          const groupKey = `${p.code}-${pDerivedYear}-${p.store}-${p.no}`;
          const isExpanded = expandedCodes.includes(groupKey);

          return (
            <CostMobileCard
              key={`${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.no}`}
              project={p}
              groupCosts={groupCosts}
              groupKey={groupKey}
              isExpanded={isExpanded}
              toggleGroup={toggleGroup}
              formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
              canWrite={canWrite}
              handleAddCost={handleAddCost}
              handleDeleteCost={handleDeleteCost}
              handleUpdateCost={handleUpdateCost}
              currency={currency}
              jpyRate={jpyRate}
              usdRate={usdRate}
              paidDateStart={paidDateStart}
              paidDateEnd={paidDateEnd}
              paidStageFilter={paidStageFilter}
              getCostPaidMatches={getCostPaidMatches}
            />
          );
        })}

        {visibleCount < filteredProjectsForDisplay.length && (
          <div className="flex justify-center mt-4">
            <button
              onClick={() => setVisibleCount((prev) => prev + 30)}
              className="px-6 py-2 bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm cursor-pointer"
            >
              Load More Projects (
              {filteredProjectsForDisplay.length - visibleCount} remaining)
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CostParts/CostPaidDateFilterModal.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Calendar, X } from 'lucide-react';

interface CostPaidDateFilterModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  tempDateStart: string;
  tempDateEnd: string;
  handleTempStartChange: (val: string) => void;
  handleTempEndChange: (val: string) => void;
  commitDateFilter: (newStart?: string, newEnd?: string) => void;
  handleClearPaidDateFilter: () => void;
  paidDateStart: string;
  paidDateEnd: string;
  paidStageFilter: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd';
  setPaidStageFilter: (val: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd') => void;
  matchingCount: number;
}

export function CostPaidDateFilterModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  tempDateStart,
  tempDateEnd,
  handleTempStartChange,
  handleTempEndChange,
  commitDateFilter,
  handleClearPaidDateFilter,
  paidDateStart,
  paidDateEnd,
  paidStageFilter,
  setPaidStageFilter,
  matchingCount,
}: CostPaidDateFilterModalProps) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40" onClick={onClose} />
      <div
        className="absolute left-0 top-full mt-2 z-50 w-84 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-2xl p-3 flex flex-col gap-2.5 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-150"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
            <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
            <span>Filter Paid Date Range</span>
          </div>
          {(paidDateStart || paidDateEnd || tempDateStart || tempDateEnd) && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClearPaidDateFilter}
              className="text-[11px] font-bold text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-3 h-3" /> Clear
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold uppercase">
              Start (Từ ngày)
            </span>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={tempDateStart}
              onChange={(e) => handleTempStartChange(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') commitDateFilter();
              }}
              onBlur={() => commitDateFilter()}
              title="Start Date (Nhấn Enter hoặc đợi 0.5s để áp dụng)"
              className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#18181a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#555] text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs rounded px-2 py-1.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold uppercase">
              End (Đến ngày)
            </span>
            <input
              type="date"
              value={tempDateEnd}
              onChange={(e) => handleTempEndChange(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') commitDateFilter();
              }}
              onBlur={() => commitDateFilter()}
              title="End Date (Nhấn Enter hoặc đợi 0.5s để áp dụng)"
              className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#18181a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#555] text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs rounded px-2 py-1.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold uppercase">
            Stage (Đợt thanh toán)
          </span>
          <select
            value={paidStageFilter}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setPaidStageFilter(e.target.value as any);
              commitDateFilter();
            }}
            className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#18181a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#555] text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs rounded px-2 py-1.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 font-medium"
          >
            <option value="all">All Paid Stages (1st, 2nd, 3rd)</option>
            <option value="1st">1st Paid only</option>
            <option value="2nd">2nd Paid only</option>
            <option value="3rd">3rd Paid only</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336]">
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">
            Enter hoặc đợi 0.5s để lọc
          </span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {(paidDateStart || paidDateEnd) && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-900/60 dark:text-indigo-300">
                {matchingCount} matching
              </span>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                commitDateFilter();
                onClose();
              }}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Done
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Total Act/Forc
            </span>
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
              {formatCurrency(totalActAll)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Total Balance
            </span>
            <span
              className={`text-sm font-bold ${
                totalBalanceAll >= 0
                  ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                  : 'text-red-500'
              }`}
            >
              {formatCurrency(totalBalanceAll)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Supporting Fee
            </span>
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
              {formatCurrency(totalSupAll)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Remaining
            </span>
            <span
              className={`text-sm font-black ${
                totalRemainingAll >= 0
                  ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                  : 'text-red-500'
              }`}
            >
              {formatCurrency(totalRemainingAll)}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Mobile Paid Date Popover Drawer */}
        {isPaidDateFilterOpen && (
          <div
            className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-indigo-200/60 dark:border-indigo-900/40 flex flex-col gap-2.5 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-150"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                <span>Filter Paid Date (Update Date)</span>
              </div>
              {(paidDateStart ||
                paidDateEnd ||
                tempDateStart ||
                tempDateEnd) && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleClearPaidDateFilter}
                  className="text-xs font-bold text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Clear
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-semibold">
                  Start (Từ ngày)
                </span>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={tempDateStart}
                  onChange={(e) => handleTempStartChange(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') commitDateFilter();
                  }}
                  onBlur={() => commitDateFilter()}
                  title="Nhấn Enter hoặc đợi 0.5s để lọc"
                  className="bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#555] text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs rounded px-2 py-1.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase font-semibold">
                  End (Đến ngày)
                </span>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={tempDateEnd}
                  onChange={(e) => handleTempEndChange(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') commitDateFilter();
                  }}
                  onBlur={() => commitDateFilter()}
                  title="Nhấn Enter hoặc đợi 0.5s để lọc"
                  className="bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#555] text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs rounded px-2 py-1.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <select
                value={paidStageFilter}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setPaidStageFilter(e.target.value as any);
                  commitDateFilter();
                }}
                className="flex-1 bg-white dark:bg-[#18181a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#555] text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs rounded px-2 py-1.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 font-medium"
              >
                <option value="all">All Paid Stages (1st, 2nd, 3rd)</option>
                <option value="1st">1st Paid only</option>
                <option value="2nd">2nd Paid only</option>
                <option value="3rd">3rd Paid only</option>
              </select>

              {(paidDateStart || paidDateEnd) && (
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-900/60 dark:text-indigo-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                  {matchingCount} matching
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/40">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">
                Enter hoặc trễ 0.5s để lọc
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  commitDateFilter();
                  setIsPaidDateFilterOpen(false);
                }}
                className="px-3 py-1 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Done
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
});

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CostParts/CostTableRow.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project, Cost } from '../../types';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { QuickNavButton } from '../QuickNavButton';
import { QRCodeButton } from '../QRCodeButton';
import { CostDetailItemRow } from './CostDetailItemRow';

interface CostTableRowProps {
  project: Project;
  pIdx: number;
  groupCosts: Cost[];
  allGroupCosts: Cost[];
  groupKey: string;
  isExpanded: boolean;
  toggleGroup: (key: string) => void;
  visibleColumns: string[];
  handleProjectLinkClick: (p: Project) => void;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
  canWrite: boolean;
  handleAddCost: (p: Project) => void;
  handleDeleteCost: (c: Cost) => void;
  handleUpdateCost: (c: Cost, field: keyof Cost, value: any) => void;
  currency: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate: number;
  usdRate: number;
  paidDateStart: string;
  paidDateEnd: string;
  paidStageFilter: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd';
  getCostPaidMatches: (
    c: Cost,
    start: string,
    end: string,
    stage: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd'
  ) => { matches: boolean; firstMatch: boolean; secondMatch: boolean; thirdMatch: boolean };
}

export const CostTableRow = React.memo(function CostTableRow({
  project: p,
  pIdx,
  groupCosts,
  allGroupCosts,
  groupKey,
  isExpanded,
  toggleGroup,
  visibleColumns,
  handleProjectLinkClick,
  formatCurrency,
  canWrite,
  handleAddCost,
  handleDeleteCost,
  handleUpdateCost,
  currency,
  jpyRate,
  usdRate,
  paidDateStart,
  paidDateEnd,
  paidStageFilter,
  getCostPaidMatches,
}: CostTableRowProps) {
  const totalAct = groupCosts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.actual || 0), 0);
  const totalFirstPaid = groupCosts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.firstPaid || 0), 0);
  const totalSecondPaid = groupCosts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.secondPaid || 0), 0);
  const totalThirdPaid = groupCosts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.thirdPaid || 0), 0);
  const totalBalance = groupCosts.reduce(
    (sum, c) =>
      sum +
      ((c.actual || 0) -
        (c.firstPaid || 0) -
        (c.secondPaid || 0) -
        (c.thirdPaid || 0)),
    0
  );
  const totalSup = groupCosts.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.supportingFee || 0), 0);

  const hasAnyCosts = allGroupCosts.length > 0;
  const computedActual = allGroupCosts.reduce((s, c) => s + (Number(c.actual) || 0), 0);
  const computedSup = allGroupCosts.reduce((s, c) => s + (Number(c.supportingFee) || 0), 0);
  const pFin = p.financial || {
    totalApproved: p.budget || 0,
    totalActualPaid: p.actual || 0,
  };
  const trueActual = hasAnyCosts ? computedActual : pFin.totalActualPaid || p.actual || 0;
  const trueSup = hasAnyCosts ? computedSup : p.supportingFee || 0;
  const trueBudget = pFin.totalApproved || p.budget || 0;
  const pRemaining = trueBudget - trueActual + trueSup;

  return (
    <React.Fragment key={`${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.no}`}>
      <tr
        className={cn(
          'table-row-optimized border-b-2 border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]',
          pIdx % 2 === 0
            ? 'bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/80'
            : 'bg-blue-50/50 dark:bg-[#28282a]'
        )}
      >
        {visibleColumns.includes('no') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
            <button
              onClick={() => toggleGroup(groupKey)}
              className={cn(
                'flex items-center gap-1 mx-auto px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer',
                groupCosts.length >= 2
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500'
                  : 'bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-600 dark:hover:bg-blue-500'
              )}
              title={isExpanded ? 'Collapse' : `Expand (${groupCosts.length})`}
            >
              {!isExpanded ? (
                <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              ) : (
                <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              )}
              <span className="text-[10px]">({groupCosts.length})</span>
            </button>
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('year') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">
            {p.year || '-'}
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('store') && (
          <td
            className={cn(
              'px-4 py-3 font-bold',
              p.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hcm'
                ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]'
                : p.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hn'
                ? 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400'
                : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]'
            )}
          >
            {p.store || '-'}
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('code') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-extrabold uppercase">
            <span
              onClick={() => handleProjectLinkClick(p)}
              className="cursor-pointer hover:underline hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8]"
              title="Click to view details in Tasks"
            >
              {p.code}
            </span>
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('projectName') && (
          <td
            onClick={() => handleProjectLinkClick(p)}
            className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] whitespace-normal break-words min-w-[180px] cursor-pointer hover:underline hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8]"
            title="Click to view details in Tasks"
          >
            {p.name || '-'}
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('actual') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold">
            <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
              {groupCosts.length > 0 && (
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    'text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border uppercase',
                    groupCosts.some((c) => c.costType === 'forc')
                      ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800'
                      : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800'
                  )}
                >
                  {groupCosts.some((c) => c.costType === 'forc') ? 'FORC' : 'ACT'}
                </span>
              )}
              <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                {formatCurrency(totalAct)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('firstPaid') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">
            {formatCurrency(totalFirstPaid)}
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('secondPaid') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">
            {formatCurrency(totalSecondPaid)}
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('thirdPaid') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">
            {formatCurrency(totalThirdPaid)}
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('balance') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]">
            {formatCurrency(totalBalance)}
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('supportingFee') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400">
            {formatCurrency(totalSup)}
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('description') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 justify-end">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Remaining:
              </span>
              <span
                className={`text-sm font-black ${
                  pRemaining >= 0
                    ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                    : 'text-red-500'
                }`}
              >
                {formatCurrency(pRemaining)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('vendor') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] font-medium text-center">
            -
          </td>
        )}
        {visibleColumns.includes('action') && (
          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
              <QuickNavButton project={p} title={`Quick Navigator (${p.code})`} />
              <QRCodeButton
                title={p.name || p.code}
                url={`${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}?tab=cost&q=${encodeURIComponent(
                  p.code || ''
                )}`}
              />
              {canWrite && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleAddCost(p)}
                  className="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-[#333336] text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] hover:bg-blue-200 dark:hover:bg-[#444446] rounded text-[10px] font-bold shadow-sm transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
                  Add Cost
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </td>
        )}
      </tr>

      {/* Expanded Cost Rows */}
      {isExpanded &&
        groupCosts.map((c, i) => {
          const {
            firstMatch: isFirstPaidMatch,
            secondMatch: isSecondPaidMatch,
            thirdMatch: isThirdPaidMatch,
          } =
            paidDateStart || paidDateEnd
              ? getCostPaidMatches(c, paidDateStart, paidDateEnd, paidStageFilter)
              : { firstMatch: false, secondMatch: false, thirdMatch: false };

          return (
            <CostDetailItemRow
              key={c.id}
              cost={c}
              pIdx={pIdx}
              itemIdx={i}
              visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
              projectYear={p.year}
              projectStore={p.store}
              projectCode={p.code}
              canWrite={canWrite}
              handleDeleteCost={handleDeleteCost}
              handleUpdateCost={handleUpdateCost}
              currency={currency}
              jpyRate={jpyRate}
              usdRate={usdRate}
              isFirstPaidMatch={isFirstPaidMatch}
              isSecondPaidMatch={isSecondPaidMatch}
              isThirdPaidMatch={isThirdPaidMatch}
              formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
            />
          );
        })}
    </React.Fragment>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CostParts/CostTableTotalRow.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';

interface CostTableTotalRowProps {
  visibleColumns: string[];
  hasActForcFilter: string;
  setHasActForcFilter: (val: string | ((prev: string) => string)) => void;
  totalActAll: number;
  totalFirstPaidAll: number;
  totalSecondPaidAll: number;
  totalThirdPaidAll: number;
  totalBalanceAll: number;
  totalSupAll: number;
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
}

export const CostTableTotalRow = React.memo(function CostTableTotalRow({
  visibleColumns,
  hasActForcFilter,
  setHasActForcFilter,
  totalActAll,
  totalFirstPaidAll,
  totalSecondPaidAll,
  totalThirdPaidAll,
  totalBalanceAll,
  totalSupAll,
  formatCurrency,
}: CostTableTotalRowProps) {
  return (
    <tr className="bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] border-b-2 border-blue-200 text-sm">
      {visibleColumns.includes('no') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-right text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] uppercase"></td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('year') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-right text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] uppercase"></td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('store') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-right text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] uppercase"></td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('code') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-right text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] uppercase"></td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('projectName') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold text-right text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] uppercase">
          Total
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('actual') && (
        <td
          className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 cursor-pointer hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors"
          onClick={() => {
            setHasActForcFilter((prev) => (prev === 'all' ? 'has_value' : 'all'));
          }}
          title="Toggle zero Act/Forc"
        >
          <div className="flex flex-col items-end">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase opacity-70 hover:underline">
              Act/Forc {hasActForcFilter === 'all' ? '(All)' : '(!=0)'}
            </span>
            <span>{formatCurrency(totalActAll)}</span>
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('firstPaid') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">
          {formatCurrency(totalFirstPaidAll)}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('secondPaid') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">
          {formatCurrency(totalSecondPaidAll)}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('thirdPaid') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">
          {formatCurrency(totalThirdPaidAll)}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('balance') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">
          {formatCurrency(totalBalanceAll)}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('supportingFee') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400">
          {formatCurrency(totalSupAll)}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('description') && (
        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-xs"></td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('vendor') && <td className="px-4 py-3"></td>}
      {visibleColumns.includes('action') && <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center"></td>}
    </tr>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CostParts/CostTableView.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Project, Cost } from '../../types';
import { CostColWidths, PaidDateMatches } from './costTypes';
import { CostTableRow } from './CostTableRow';
import { CostTableHeader } from './CostTableHeader';
import { CostTableTotalRow } from './CostTableTotalRow';

interface CostTableViewProps {
  filteredProjectsForDisplay: Project[];
  visibleColumns: string[];
  colWidths: CostColWidths;
  handleResize: (col: keyof CostColWidths, newWidth: number) => void;
  handleToggleColumn: (colId: string) => void;
  expandedCodes: string[];
  setExpandedCodes: (codes: string[]) => void;
  sortedProjects: Project[];
  formatCurrency: (val: number | undefined) => string;
  hasActForcFilter: string;
  setHasActForcFilter: (val: string | ((prev: string) => string)) => void;
  totalActAll: number;
  totalFirstPaidAll: number;
  totalSecondPaidAll: number;
  totalThirdPaidAll: number;
  totalBalanceAll: number;
  totalSupAll: number;
  visibleCount: number;
  setVisibleCount: (fn: (prev: number) => number) => void;
  handleCostScroll: (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
  toggleGroup: (key: string) => void;
  handleProjectLinkClick: (p: Project) => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
  handleAddCost: (p: Project) => void;
  handleDeleteCost: (c: Cost) => void;
  handleUpdateCost: (c: Cost, field: keyof Cost, value: any) => void;
  currency: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD';
  jpyRate: number;
  usdRate: number;
  paidDateStart: string;
  paidDateEnd: string;
  paidStageFilter: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd';
  getGroupCostsForProject: (p: Project) => Cost[];
  getCostPaidMatches: (
    c: Cost,
    start: string,
    end: string,
    stage: 'all' | '1st' | '2nd' | '3rd'
  ) => PaidDateMatches;
}

export const CostTableView = React.memo(function CostTableView({
  filteredProjectsForDisplay,
  visibleColumns,
  colWidths,
  handleResize,
  handleToggleColumn,
  expandedCodes,
  setExpandedCodes,
  sortedProjects,
  formatCurrency,
  hasActForcFilter,
  setHasActForcFilter,
  totalActAll,
  totalFirstPaidAll,
  totalSecondPaidAll,
  totalThirdPaidAll,
  totalBalanceAll,
  totalSupAll,
  visibleCount,
  setVisibleCount,
  handleCostScroll,
  toggleGroup,
  handleProjectLinkClick,
  canWrite,
  handleAddCost,
  handleDeleteCost,
  handleUpdateCost,
  currency,
  jpyRate,
  usdRate,
  paidDateStart,
  paidDateEnd,
  paidStageFilter,
  getGroupCostsForProject,
  getCostPaidMatches,
}: CostTableViewProps) {
  const tableWidth = visibleColumns.reduce(
    (acc, col) => acc + (colWidths[col as keyof CostColWidths] || 100),
    0
  );

  return (
    <div
      className="hidden xl:block overflow-x-auto flex-grow pb-16 max-h-[78vh]"
      onScroll={handleCostScroll}
    >
      <table
        className="text-sm text-left text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] table-fixed min-w-full"
        style={{ width: `${tableWidth}px` }}
      >
        <CostTableHeader
          visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
          colWidths={colWidths}
          handleResize={handleResize}
          handleToggleColumn={handleToggleColumn}
          expandedCodes={expandedCodes}
          setExpandedCodes={setExpandedCodes}
          sortedProjects={sortedProjects}
        />
        <tbody>
          <CostTableTotalRow
            visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
            hasActForcFilter={hasActForcFilter}
            setHasActForcFilter={setHasActForcFilter}
            totalActAll={totalActAll}
            totalFirstPaidAll={totalFirstPaidAll}
            totalSecondPaidAll={totalSecondPaidAll}
            totalThirdPaidAll={totalThirdPaidAll}
            totalBalanceAll={totalBalanceAll}
            totalSupAll={totalSupAll}
            formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
          />

          {/* Progressive Rendered Project Groups & Detail Rows */}
          {filteredProjectsForDisplay.slice(0, visibleCount).map((p, pIdx) => {
            const pDerivedYear = p.year
              ? p.year
              : p.start
              ? Number(String(p.start).substring(0, 4))
              : undefined;
            const allGroupCosts = getGroupCostsForProject(p);
            const groupCosts =
              paidDateStart || paidDateEnd
                ? allGroupCosts.filter(
                    (c) =>
                      getCostPaidMatches(c, paidDateStart, paidDateEnd, paidStageFilter).matches
                  )
                : allGroupCosts;
            const groupKey = `${p.code}-${pDerivedYear}-${p.store}-${p.no}`;
            const isExpanded =
              expandedCodes.includes(groupKey) ||
              expandedCodes.includes(String(p.no)) ||
              (p.id ? expandedCodes.includes(String(p.id)) : false) ||
              (p.code ? expandedCodes.includes(String(p.code)) : false);

            return (
              <CostTableRow
                key={`${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.no}`}
                project={p}
                pIdx={pIdx}
                groupCosts={groupCosts}
                allGroupCosts={allGroupCosts}
                groupKey={groupKey}
                isExpanded={isExpanded}
                toggleGroup={toggleGroup}
                visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
                handleProjectLinkClick={handleProjectLinkClick}
                formatCurrency={formatCurrency}
                canWrite={canWrite}
                handleAddCost={handleAddCost}
                handleDeleteCost={handleDeleteCost}
                handleUpdateCost={handleUpdateCost}
                currency={currency}
                jpyRate={jpyRate}
                usdRate={usdRate}
                paidDateStart={paidDateStart}
                paidDateEnd={paidDateEnd}
                paidStageFilter={paidStageFilter}
                getCostPaidMatches={getCostPaidMatches}
              />
            );
          })}

          {visibleCount < filteredProjectsForDisplay.length && (
            <tr>
              <td colSpan={visibleColumns.length} className="py-4 text-center">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setVisibleCount((prev) => prev + 30)}
                  className="px-6 py-2 bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-full shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Load More Projects (
                  {filteredProjectsForDisplay.length - visibleCount} remaining)
                </button>
              </td>
            </tr>
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
});
