export const safeJSONParse = (data: string | null) => {
  try {
    return data ? JSON.parse(data) : {};
  } catch (e) {
    return {};
  }
};

export const safeGetStorage = (key: string) => {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(key);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Browser blocked localStorage reading offline', e);
    return null;
  }
};

export const safeSetStorage = (key: string, value: string) => {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, value);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Browser blocked localStorage write', e);
  }
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CsvExportParts/useCsvExportState.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  TAB_CONFIG,
  safeJSONParse,
  safeGetStorage,
  safeSetStorage,
} from './csvExportTypes';
import { getCellValue, executeCsvExport } from './csvExportProcessing';

export function useCsvExportState() {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [workbook, setWorkbook] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [sheetNames, setSheetNames] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [activeSheet, setActiveSheet] = useState<string>('');
  const [excelData, setExcelData] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [excelHeaders, setExcelHeaders] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [templateFile, setTemplateFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [templateData, setTemplateData] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<string>('project');
  const [showUnlockModal, setShowUnlockModal] = useState(false);
  const [passwordInput, setPasswordInput] = useState('');
  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = useState('');

  const [isLocked, setIsLocked] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    return safeGetStorage('taka_locked_project') === 'true';
  });

  const [mapping, setMapping] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetStorage('taka_mapping_project');
    const parsed = safeJSONParse(saved);
    return TAB_CONFIG['project'].columns.reduce(
      (acc: any, col: string) => ({ ...acc, [col]: parsed[col] || '' }),
      {}
    );
  });

  const [keepOriginal, setKeepOriginal] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetStorage('taka_keeporiginal_project');
    const parsed = safeJSONParse(saved);
    return TAB_CONFIG['project'].columns.reduce(
      (acc: any, col: string) => ({ ...acc, [col]: !!parsed[col] }),
      {}
    );
  });

  const [constantMapping, setConstantMapping] = useState<
    Record<string, string>
  >(() => {
    const saved = safeGetStorage('taka_constant_project');
    const parsed = safeJSONParse(saved);
    return TAB_CONFIG['project'].columns.reduce(
      (acc: any, col: string) => ({
        ...acc,
        [col]:
          parsed[col] !== undefined
            ? parsed[col]
            : col === 'delegation'
              ? 'true'
              : '',
      }),
      {}
    );
  });

  const unitSizeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (
      activeTab !== 'size_unit' ||
      !Array.isArray(excelData) ||
      excelData.length === 0
    )
      return map;

    excelData.forEach((row) => {
      if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') return;

      let u = constantMapping['unit'] || row[mapping['unit']];
      if (u === undefined || u === null || String(u).trim() === '') u = 'Temp';

      const s = constantMapping['size'] || row[mapping['size']];
      if (s !== undefined && s !== null && String(s).trim() !== '') {
        map[u] = s;
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [activeTab, excelData, mapping, constantMapping]);

  const switchTab = (tabId: string) => {
    setActiveTab(tabId);
    setFile(null);
    setExcelData([]);
    setExcelHeaders([]);
    setWorkbook(null);
    setSheetNames([]);
    setActiveSheet('');
    setTemplateFile(null);
    setTemplateData([]);
    setError('');

    const savedMapping = safeGetStorage(`taka_mapping_${tabId}`);
    const parsedMapping = safeJSONParse(savedMapping);
    setMapping(
      TAB_CONFIG[tabId].columns.reduce(
        (acc: any, col: string) => ({ ...acc, [col]: parsedMapping[col] || '' }),
        {}
      )
    );

    const savedConstant = safeGetStorage(`taka_constant_${tabId}`);
    const parsedConstant = safeJSONParse(savedConstant);
    setConstantMapping(
      TAB_CONFIG[tabId].columns.reduce((acc: any, col: string) => {
        let val = parsedConstant[col];
        if (val === undefined || !savedConstant) {
          val = col === 'delegation' ? 'true' : val || '';
        }
        return { ...acc, [col]: val };
      }, {})
    );

    const savedKeepOriginal = safeGetStorage(`taka_keeporiginal_${tabId}`);
    const parsedKeepOriginal = safeJSONParse(savedKeepOriginal);
    setKeepOriginal(
      TAB_CONFIG[tabId].columns.reduce(
        (acc: any, col: string) => ({ ...acc, [col]: !!parsedKeepOriginal[col] }),
        {}
      )
    );

    setIsLocked(safeGetStorage(`taka_locked_${tabId}`) === 'true');
  };

  const processSheet = async (worksheet: any) => {
    try {
      if (!worksheet) throw new Error('Sheet bị trống.');

      const xlsx = await import('xlsx');
      const jsonData =
        (xlsx.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { defval: '' }) as any[]) || [];
      setExcelData(jsonData);

      if (jsonData.length > 0) {
        const headers = Object.keys(jsonData[0] || {});
        setExcelHeaders(headers);

        if (!isLocked) {
          const newMapping = { ...(mapping || {}) };
          TAB_CONFIG[activeTab].columns.forEach((targetCol: string) => {
            const match = headers.find(
              (h) => h && h.toLowerCase().includes(targetCol.toLowerCase())
            );
            if (match) newMapping[targetCol] = match;
          });
          setMapping(newMapping);
        }
      } else {
        setExcelHeaders([]);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      setError('Đã xảy ra lỗi khi trích xuất dữ liệu từ Sheet này.');
      setExcelData([]);
      setExcelHeaders([]);
    }
  };

  const handleTemplateUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const uploadedFile = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!uploadedFile) return;
    setTemplateFile(uploadedFile);

    const isCSV = uploadedFile.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv');
    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onload = async (event) => {
      try {
        const result = event.target?.result;
        if (!result) throw new Error('File tải lên trống.');

        const xlsx = await import('xlsx');
        let wb;
        if (isCSV) {
          wb = xlsx.read(result, { type: 'string' });
        } else {
          wb = xlsx.read(new Uint8Array(result as ArrayBuffer), { type: 'array' });
        }

        const firstSheet = wb.SheetNames[0];
        const json = xlsx.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets[firstSheet], {
          defval: '',
        }) as any[];
        setTemplateData(json);
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(`Lỗi đọc template: ${err.message}`);
      }
    };

    if (isCSV) {
      reader.readAsText(uploadedFile, 'UTF-8');
    } else {
      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(uploadedFile);
    }
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const uploadedFile = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!uploadedFile) return;

    setError('');
    setFile(uploadedFile);
    setWorkbook(null);
    setSheetNames([]);
    setActiveSheet('');
    setExcelData([]);
    setExcelHeaders([]);

    const isCSV = uploadedFile.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv');
    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onload = async (event) => {
      try {
        const result = event.target?.result;
        if (!result) throw new Error('File tải lên trống.');

        const xlsx = await import('xlsx');
        let wb;
        try {
          if (isCSV) {
            wb = xlsx.read(result, { type: 'string' });
          } else {
            const data = new Uint8Array(result as ArrayBuffer);
            wb = xlsx.read(data, { type: 'array' });
          }
        } catch (xlsxErr) {
          console.error('XLSX Parse Error:', xlsxErr);
          throw new Error(
            'Định dạng file không được hỗ trợ hoặc cấu trúc file bị lỗi.'
          );
        }

        if (!wb.SheetNames || wb.SheetNames.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('Không thể tìm thấy sheet dữ liệu nào trong file.');
        }

        setWorkbook(wb);
        setSheetNames(wb.SheetNames);
        const firstSheet = wb.SheetNames[0];
        setActiveSheet(firstSheet);
        processSheet(wb.Sheets[firstSheet]);
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(`Không thể xử lý file: ${err.message}`);
        console.error(err);
        setExcelData([]);
      }
    };

    reader.onerror = () => {
      setError('Trình duyệt gặp lỗi trong quá trình nạp file.');
    };

    if (isCSV) {
      reader.readAsText(uploadedFile, 'UTF-8');
    } else {
      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(uploadedFile);
    }

    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const handleCancelUpload = () => {
    setFile(null);
    setWorkbook(null);
    setSheetNames([]);
    setActiveSheet('');
    setExcelData([]);
    setExcelHeaders([]);
    setError('');
  };

  const handleSaveMapping = () => {
    safeSetStorage(`taka_mapping_${activeTab}`, JSON.stringify(mapping));
    safeSetStorage(`taka_constant_${activeTab}`, JSON.stringify(constantMapping));
    safeSetStorage(`taka_keeporiginal_${activeTab}`, JSON.stringify(keepOriginal));
    safeSetStorage(`taka_locked_${activeTab}`, 'true');
    setIsLocked(true);
  };

  const handleUnlock = () => {
    if (passwordInput === '1641985') {
      safeSetStorage(`taka_locked_${activeTab}`, 'false');
      setIsLocked(false);
      setShowUnlockModal(false);
      setPasswordInput('');
      setPasswordError('');
    } else {
      setPasswordError('Mật khẩu không đúng!');
    }
  };

  const previewData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!excelData || excelData.length === 0) return [];

    if (activeTab === 'mass_task') {
      if (!templateData || templateData.length === 0) return [];
      const finalJson: any[] = [];
      for (const proj of excelData) {
        const projStore = getCellValue(
          proj,
          'store',
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,
          unitSizeMap
        );
        const projLocation = getCellValue(
          proj,
          'location',
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,
          unitSizeMap
        );
        const projCode = getCellValue(
          proj,
          'projectCode',
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,
          unitSizeMap
        );
        const projYear =
          getCellValue(
            proj,
            'projectYear',
            activeTab,
            mapping,
            constantMapping,
            keepOriginal,
            unitSizeMap
          ) ||
          getCellValue(
            proj,
            'YEAR',
            activeTab,
            mapping,
            constantMapping,
            keepOriginal,
            unitSizeMap
          );

        for (const taskDef of templateData) {
          if (finalJson.length >= 10) return finalJson;
          const taskName = taskDef['Task name'] || '';
          const tcKey = Object.keys(taskDef).find((k) => {
            const clean = k
              .toLowerCase()
              .replace(/á»¥/g, 'ụ')
              .replace(/\s+/g, '');
            return clean.includes('taskcodeph') || clean.includes('taskcodephu');
          });
          let taskCodePhu = tcKey ? taskDef[tcKey] : '';
          if (
            !keepOriginal['Task code phụ'] &&
            taskCodePhu !== undefined &&
            taskCodePhu !== null &&
            String(taskCodePhu).trim() !== ''
          ) {
            taskCodePhu = projCode
              ? `${projCode}#${String(taskCodePhu).trim()}`
              : String(taskCodePhu).trim();
          }
          let start = taskDef['start'] || '';
          let finish = taskDef['finish'] || '';

          const formatExcelDate = (val: any) => {
            if (typeof val !== 'number') return val;
            const date = new Date((val - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
            return (
              date.toLocaleDateString('en-US') +
              ' ' +
              date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
                hour: '2-digit',
                minute: '2-digit',
                hour12: false,
              })
            );
          };
          if (typeof start === 'number') start = formatExcelDate(start);
          if (typeof finish === 'number') finish = formatExcelDate(finish);

          const party = taskDef['party'] || '';
          const duration =
            taskDef['duration'] !== undefined ? taskDef['duration'] : '';
          const predKey = Object.keys(taskDef).find(
            (k) => k.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '') === 'predecessor'
          );
          const templatePred = predKey ? taskDef[predKey] : '';
          const mappedPred =
            constantMapping['predecessor'] || proj[mapping['predecessor']];
          let pred =
            mappedPred !== undefined &&
            mappedPred !== null &&
            String(mappedPred).trim() !== ''
              ? mappedPred
              : templatePred;
          if (
            !keepOriginal['predecessor'] &&
            pred !== undefined &&
            pred !== null &&
            String(pred).trim() !== ''
          ) {
            pred = projCode
              ? `${projCode}-${String(pred).trim()}`
              : String(pred).trim();
          }
          const delegation =
            taskDef['delegation'] !== undefined
              ? taskDef['delegation']
              : constantMapping['delegation'] || 'true';
          const comments =
            taskDef['comments'] !== undefined
              ? taskDef['comments']
              : constantMapping['comments'] || '';

          finalJson.push({
            store: projStore,
            location: projLocation,
            projectYear: projYear,
            projectCode: projCode,
            'Task code phụ': taskCodePhu,
            'Task name': taskName,
            start: start,
            finish: finish,
            duration: duration,
            party: party,
            predecessor: pred,
            delegation: delegation,
            comments: comments,
          });
        }
      }
      return finalJson;
    }

    return excelData.slice(0, 10).map((row) => {
      const parsedRow: any = {};
      TAB_CONFIG[activeTab].columns.forEach((c: string) => {
        parsedRow[c] = getCellValue(
          row,
          c,
          activeTab,
          mapping,
          constantMapping,
          keepOriginal,
          unitSizeMap
        );
      });
      return parsedRow;
    });
  }, [
    activeTab,
    excelData,
    templateData,
    mapping,
    constantMapping,
    keepOriginal,
    unitSizeMap,
  ]);

  const exportData = async () => {
    await executeCsvExport({
      activeTab,
      sheetNames,
      workbook,
      mapping,
      constantMapping,
      keepOriginal,
      templateData,
      excelData,
      unitSizeMap,
      setError,
    });
  };

  return {
    file,
    workbook,
    sheetNames,
    activeSheet,
    setActiveSheet,
    excelData,
    excelHeaders,
    templateFile,
    setTemplateFile,
    setTemplateData,
    error,
    activeTab,
    showUnlockModal,
    setShowUnlockModal,
    passwordInput,
    setPasswordInput,
    passwordError,
    isLocked,
    mapping,
    setMapping,
    keepOriginal,
    setKeepOriginal,
    constantMapping,
    setConstantMapping,
    switchTab,
    processSheet,
    handleTemplateUpload,
    handleFileUpload,
    handleCancelUpload,
    handleSaveMapping,
    handleUnlock,
    previewData,
    exportData,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/CsvExportTab.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { useCsvExportState } from './CsvExportParts/useCsvExportState';
import { CsvExportHeaderTabs } from './CsvExportParts/CsvExportHeaderTabs';
import { CsvExportFileSection } from './CsvExportParts/CsvExportFileSection';
import { CsvExportMappingTable } from './CsvExportParts/CsvExportMappingTable';
import { CsvExportPreviewSection } from './CsvExportParts/CsvExportPreviewSection';
import { CsvExportUnlockModal } from './CsvExportParts/CsvExportUnlockModal';

export default function CsvExportTab() {
  const {
    file,
    workbook,
    sheetNames,
    activeSheet,
    setActiveSheet,
    excelData,
    excelHeaders,
    templateFile,
    setTemplateFile,
    setTemplateData,
    error,
    activeTab,
    showUnlockModal,
    setShowUnlockModal,
    passwordInput,
    setPasswordInput,
    passwordError,
    isLocked,
    mapping,
    setMapping,
    keepOriginal,
    setKeepOriginal,
    constantMapping,
    setConstantMapping,
    switchTab,
    processSheet,
    handleTemplateUpload,
    handleFileUpload,
    handleCancelUpload,
    handleSaveMapping,
    handleUnlock,
    previewData,
    exportData,
  } = useCsvExportState();

  return (
    <div className="h-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] p-4 font-sans text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] overflow-y-auto w-full custom-scrollbar">
      <div className="max-w-[1400px] mx-auto space-y-6">
        <CsvExportHeaderTabs
          activeTab={activeTab}
          onTabChange={switchTab}
        />

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <CsvExportFileSection
              file={file}
              sheetNames={sheetNames}
              activeSheet={activeSheet}
              onSheetChange={(s) => {
                setActiveSheet(s);
                processSheet(workbook?.Sheets[s]);
              }}
              onFileUpload={handleFileUpload}
              onCancelUpload={handleCancelUpload}
              templateFile={templateFile}
              onTemplateUpload={handleTemplateUpload}
              onCancelTemplate={() => {
                setTemplateFile(null);
                setTemplateData([]);
              }}
              activeTab={activeTab}
              error={error}
            />

            <CsvExportMappingTable
              activeTab={activeTab}
              isLocked={isLocked}
              mapping={mapping}
              setMapping={setMapping}
              keepOriginal={keepOriginal}
              setKeepOriginal={setKeepOriginal}
              constantMapping={constantMapping}
              setConstantMapping={setConstantMapping}
              excelHeaders={excelHeaders}
              onLockToggle={
                isLocked ? () => setShowUnlockModal(true) : handleSaveMapping
              }
            />
          </div>

          <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
            <CsvExportPreviewSection
              activeTab={activeTab}
              previewData={previewData}
              excelData={excelData}
              file={file}
              templateFile={templateFile}
              onExport={exportData}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <CsvExportUnlockModal
          isOpen={showUnlockModal}
          onClose={() => setShowUnlockModal(false)}
          passwordInput={passwordInput}
          setPasswordInput={setPasswordInput}
          passwordError={passwordError}
          onUnlock={handleUnlock}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DebouncedSearchInput.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useTransition } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { X } from 'lucide-react';

interface DebouncedSearchInputProps extends Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'onChange'> {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  debounceMs?: number;
  triggerOnEnter?: boolean;
}

export function DebouncedSearchInput({ 
  value, 
  onChange, 
  debounceMs = 300, 
  triggerOnEnter = false, 
  ...props
}: DebouncedSearchInputProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [innerValue, setInnerValue] = useState(value || "");
  const lastReportedValue = useRef(value || "");
  const timerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const [, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const isFocusedRef = useRef(false);

  // Sync external value changes into local state (only when not actively typing/focused)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isFocusedRef.current && value !== lastReportedValue.current) {
      setInnerValue(value || "");
      lastReportedValue.current = value || "";
    }
  }, [value]);

  const commitSearch = (valToCommit: string) => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (valToCommit !== lastReportedValue.current) {
      lastReportedValue.current = valToCommit;
      startTransition(() => {
        onChange(valToCommit);
      });
    }
  };

  // Debounce mechanism: triggers filtering after user has finished typing (300ms pause)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (triggerOnEnter) return;

    if (innerValue === lastReportedValue.current) return;

    timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      if (innerValue !== lastReportedValue.current) {
        lastReportedValue.current = innerValue;
        startTransition(() => {
          onChange(innerValue);
        });
      }
    }, debounceMs);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [innerValue, onChange, debounceMs, triggerOnEnter]);

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full">
      <input
        autoCapitalize="none"
        autoCorrect="off"
        spellCheck={false}
        autoComplete="off"
        enterKeyHint="search"
        {...props}
        className={props.className ? (props.className.includes('pr-') ? props.className.replace(/pr-\d+/, 'pr-10') : props.className + ' pr-10') : 'pr-10'}
        value={innerValue}
        onChange={(e) => setInnerValue(e.target.value)}
        onFocus={(e) => {
          isFocusedRef.current = true;
          if (props.onFocus) props.onFocus(e);
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (props.onKeyDown) props.onKeyDown(e);
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && innerValue) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            setInnerValue("");
            commitSearch("");
          } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            commitSearch(innerValue);
          }
        }}
        onBlur={(e) => {
          isFocusedRef.current = false;
          if (props.onBlur) props.onBlur(e);
          commitSearch(innerValue);
        }}
      />
      {innerValue && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setInnerValue("");
            commitSearch("");
          }}
          className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors z-10"
          title={t("Clear") || "Clear"}
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DelegationCalendarParts/DelegationCalendarMonthList.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { format, startOfDay } from 'date-fns';
import { DelegationCalendarEvent } from './delegationCalendarTypes';
import { CustomEventComponent } from './DelegationCustomEvent';

interface DelegationCalendarMonthListProps {
  selectedMonthDate: Date;
  events: DelegationCalendarEvent[];
  onSelectEvent: (event: DelegationCalendarEvent) => void;
}

export const DelegationCalendarMonthList: React.FC<DelegationCalendarMonthListProps> = ({
  selectedMonthDate,
  events,
  onSelectEvent,
}) => {
  const dayEvents = events.filter(
    (e) =>
      startOfDay(e.start) <= startOfDay(selectedMonthDate) &&
      startOfDay(e.end) >= startOfDay(selectedMonthDate)
  );

  return (
    <div className="mt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] pt-4">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] mb-3">
        {format(selectedMonthDate, 'EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy')}
      </h3>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {dayEvents.length > 0 ? (
          dayEvents.map((event, idx) => (
            <div
              key={`${event.id}-${idx}`}
              className="cursor-pointer bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded p-2 hover:shadow-sm transition-shadow"
              onClick={() => onSelectEvent(event)}
            >
              <CustomEventComponent event={event} />
            </div>
          ))
        ) : (
          <div className="text-slate-400 text-sm italic px-2 py-1">
            No scheduled for this day.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DelegationCalendarParts/DelegationCustomEvent.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { DelegationCalendarEvent } from './delegationCalendarTypes';

interface CustomEventComponentProps {
  event: DelegationCalendarEvent;
}

export const CustomEventComponent: React.FC<CustomEventComponentProps> = ({
  event,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const flowTxt =
    event.resource.subTask.delegationStatus ||
    event.resource.subTask.status ||
    'Assigned';
  const isStart = event.resource.isStartNode;
  const isFinish = event.resource.isFinishNode;

  const priority = event.resource.subTask.priority || 'Mid';
  const prioColors =
    priority === 'High'
      ? 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-[#3b2a1a] text-orange-700 border-orange-200'
      : priority === 'Mid-high'
        ? 'bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-[#3b3a1a] text-yellow-700 border-yellow-200'
        : priority === 'Low'
          ? 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]'
          : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-700 border-blue-200';

  return (
    <div
      className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 w-full h-full text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
      title={`${event.resource.projectName || 'Task'} - ${event.title} (${flowTxt})`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start gap-1 font-semibold whitespace-normal leading-tight flex-wrap">
        {event.resource.projectName && (
          <span className="bg-blue-500 text-white px-1 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[9.5px] uppercase tracking-wider flex-shrink-0">
            {event.resource.projectName}
          </span>
        )}
        <span
          className="bg-blue-500 text-white px-1 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[9.5px] tracking-wider flex-shrink-0 font-bold max-w-[80px] truncate"
          title={event.resource.subTask.party || 'N/A'}
        >
          {event.resource.subTask.party || 'N/A'}
        </span>
        {isStart && (
          <span className="bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider flex-shrink-0">
            {t('Start')}
          </span>
        )}
        {isFinish && (
          <span className="bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider flex-shrink-0">
            {t('Finish')}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="line-clamp-2">{event.title}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5 flex-wrap">
        <span className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[9.5px] leading-none whitespace-nowrap border border-black/5 dark:border-white/5 font-bold">
          {flowTxt}
        </span>
        <span
          className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[9.5px] font-bold leading-none whitespace-nowrap border ${prioColors}`}
        >
          {priority}
        </span>
      </div>
      {event.resource.currentView === 'day' &&
        (event.resource.subTask.comments || event.resource.subTask.report) && (
          <div className="w-full mt-1 flex flex-col gap-1 text-[11px] font-normal text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] bg-black/5 p-1.5 rounded">
            {event.resource.subTask.comments && (
              <div className="flex gap-1 items-start">
                <span className="font-semibold shrink-0 opacity-80">

                  {event.resource.subTask.comments}

              <div className="flex gap-1 items-start">
                <span className="font-semibold shrink-0 opacity-80">
                  Report:
                </span>
                <span className="italic whitespace-pre-wrap">
                  {event.resource.subTask.report}
                </span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
    </div>
  );
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DelegationCalendarParts/DelegationCustomVerticalView.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { format, addDays, subDays, startOfDay, endOfDay } from 'date-fns';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { DelegationCalendarEvent } from './delegationCalendarTypes';

interface DelegationCustomVerticalViewProps {
  date: Date;
  events: DelegationCalendarEvent[];
  onSelectEvent?: (event: DelegationCalendarEvent) => void;
  daysCount: number;
}

export const DelegationCustomVerticalView: React.FC<DelegationCustomVerticalViewProps> = ({
  date,
  events,
  onSelectEvent,
  daysCount,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const range = useMemo(() => {
    let start: Date;
    let end: Date;
    if (daysCount === 7) {
      start = startOfDay(date);
      end = addDays(date, 6);
    } else {
      start = startOfDay(date);
      end = addDays(date, 30);
    }

    const daysArray: Date[] = [];
    let current = start;
    while (current <= end) {
      daysArray.push(current);
      current = addDays(current, 1);
    }
    return daysArray;
  }, [date, daysCount]);

  const eventsByDay = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, DelegationCalendarEvent[]>();
    range.forEach((day) => {
      map.set(day.toDateString(), []);
    });

    events.forEach((event: DelegationCalendarEvent) => {
      range.forEach((day) => {
        const dayStart = startOfDay(day);
        const dayEnd = endOfDay(day);
        if (event.start <= dayEnd && event.end >= dayStart) {
          map.get(day.toDateString())?.push(event);
        }
      });
    });

    return map;
  }, [events, range]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 overflow-y-auto h-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 rounded-b-xl">
      {range.map((day) => {
        const dayEvents = eventsByDay.get(day.toDateString()) || [];
        if (daysCount !== 7 && dayEvents.length === 0) return null;

        return (
          <div
            key={day.toDateString()}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
          >
            <div className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a]/80 px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-sm flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{format(day, 'EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy')}</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] px-2 py-1 rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-sm">
                {dayEvents.length} {dayEvents.length === 1 ? 'task' : ''}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 flex flex-col gap-2">
              {dayEvents.length > 0 ? (
                dayEvents.map((event, idx) => {
                  const flowTxt =
                    event.resource.subTask.delegationStatus ||
                    event.resource.subTask.status ||
                    'Assigned';
                  const isStart = event.resource.isStartNode;
                  const isFinish = event.resource.isFinishNode;

                  let bgColor = 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50';
                  let borderColor = 'border-slate-300 dark:border-[#555558]';

                  if (flowTxt === 'Completed') {
                    bgColor = 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-[#1a3821]';
                    borderColor = 'border-green-200';
                  } else if (
                    flowTxt === 'On process' ||
                    flowTxt === 'Accepted'
                  ) {
                    bgColor = 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a]';
                    borderColor = 'border-blue-200';
                  } else if (
                    flowTxt === 'Delayed' ||
                    [
                      'requested',
                      'hold',
                      'waiting for approval',
                      'pending completed',
                    ].includes(flowTxt.toLowerCase())
                  ) {
                    bgColor = 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-[#3b2a1a]';
                    borderColor = 'border-orange-200';
                  } else if (
                    flowTxt === 'Approved' ||
                    flowTxt === 'Rejected' ||
                    flowTxt === 'Request Delay' ||
                    flowTxt === 'Needs Rework'
                  ) {
                    bgColor = 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-[#322a36]';
                    borderColor = 'border-purple-200';
                  } else if (flowTxt === 'Assigned') {
                    bgColor = 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-[#3b2a1a]';
                    borderColor = 'border-orange-200';
                  }

                  const priority = event.resource.subTask.priority || 'Mid';
                  const prioColors =
                    priority === 'High'
                      ? 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-[#3b2a1a] text-orange-700 border-orange-200'
                      : priority === 'Mid-high'
                        ? 'bg-yellow-50 dark:bg-[#3b3a1a] text-yellow-700 border-yellow-200'
                        : priority === 'Low'
                          ? 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]'
                          : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-700 border-blue-200';

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={`${event.id}-${idx}`}
                      onClick={() => onSelectEvent && onSelectEvent(event)}
                      className={`cursor-pointer rounded border ${borderColor} ${bgColor} overflow-hidden flex flex-col sm:flex-row shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 text-xs min-h-[28px]`}
                    >
                      <div
                        className="flex-1 text-slate-900 dark:text-white px-3 py-2 font-bold whitespace-normal break-words sm:border-r border-b sm:border-b-0 border-black/10 flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap"
                        title={event.title}
                      >
                        {event.resource.projectName && (
                          <span className="bg-blue-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider flex-shrink-0">
                            {event.resource.projectName}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span
                          className="bg-blue-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] tracking-wider flex-shrink-0 max-w-[100px] truncate"
                          title={event.resource.subTask.party || 'N/A'}
                        >
                          {event.resource.subTask.party || 'N/A'}
                        </span>
                        {isStart && (
                          <span className="bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider flex-shrink-0">
                            {t('Start')}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {isFinish && (
                          <span className="bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1 py-0.5 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider flex-shrink-0">
                            {t('Finish')}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span className="leading-tight">{event.title}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 sm:max-w-[150px] sm:min-w-[120px] px-3 py-2 whitespace-normal break-words flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 border-t sm:border-t-0 border-black/5 dark:border-white/5">
                        <span
                          className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] px-1.5 py-1 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold border border-black/5 dark:border-white/5"
                          title={flowTxt}
                        >
                          {flowTxt}
                        </span>
                        <span
                          className={`px-1.5 py-1 rounded-[3px] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold border ${prioColors}`}
                          title={priority}
                        >
                          {priority}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              ) : (
                <div className="text-slate-400 text-sm italic px-2 py-1">
                  No scheduled for this day.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export const CustomWeekView: any = (props: any) => (
  <DelegationCustomVerticalView {...props} daysCount={7} />
);
CustomWeekView.range = (date: Date) => [startOfDay(date), addDays(date, 6)];
CustomWeekView.navigate = (date: Date, action: string) => {
  switch (action) {
    case 'PREV':
      return subDays(date, 7);
    case 'NEXT':
      return addDays(date, 7);
    default:
      return date;
  }
};
CustomWeekView.title = (date: Date) => {
  const start = startOfDay(date);
  const end = addDays(date, 6);
  return `${format(start, 'MMM d')} - ${format(end, 'MMM d')}`;
};

export const CustomAgendaView: any = (props: any) => (
  <DelegationCustomVerticalView {...props} daysCount={30} />
);
CustomAgendaView.range = (date: Date) => [startOfDay(date), addDays(date, 30)];
CustomAgendaView.navigate = (date: Date, action: string) => {
  switch (action) {
    case 'PREV':
      return subDays(date, 30);
    case 'NEXT':
      return addDays(date, 30);
    default:
      return date;
  }
};
CustomAgendaView.title = (date: Date) => {
  const start = startOfDay(date);
  const end = addDays(date, 30);
  return `${format(start, 'MMM d')} - ${format(end, 'MMM d')}`;
};

    group: DelegationGroup;

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DelegationCalendarParts/delegationExportUtils.ts ==================== */
import { format, addDays } from 'date-fns';
import { DelegationCalendarEvent } from './delegationCalendarTypes';

export function exportDelegationEventsToICS(events: DelegationCalendarEvent[]) {
  if (events.length === 0) {
    alert('No events to export.');
    return;
  }

  const formatDate = (date: Date) => {
    return date.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').split('.')[0] + 'Z';
  };

  const icsContent = [
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR',
    'VERSION:2.0',
    'PRODID:-//Takashimaya Project Management//Delegation Calendar//EN',
    'CALSCALE:GREGORIAN',
    'METHOD:PUBLISH',
  ];

  events.forEach((event) => {
    icsContent.push('BEGIN:VEVENT');
    icsContent.push(`UID:${event.id}@taka.app`);
    icsContent.push(`DTSTAMP:${formatDate(new Date())}`);
    if (event.allDay) {
      const startStr = format(event.start, 'yyyyMMdd');
      const endStr = format(addDays(event.start, 1), 'yyyyMMdd');
      icsContent.push(`DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:${startStr}`);
      icsContent.push(`DTEND;VALUE=DATE:${endStr}`);
    } else {
      icsContent.push(`DTSTART:${formatDate(event.start)}`);
      icsContent.push(`DTEND:${formatDate(event.end)}`);
    }
    icsContent.push(`SUMMARY:${event.title.replace(/[,;]/g, '\\$&')}`);
    if (event.resource && event.resource.group) {
      const groupDesc = `Group: ${event.resource.group.name || ''}\nTask: ${event.title}\nStatus: ${event.resource.subTask?.status || ''}`;
      icsContent.push(
        `DESCRIPTION:${groupDesc
          .replace(/\n/g, '\\n')
          .replace(/[,;]/g, '\\$&')}`
      );
    }
    icsContent.push('END:VEVENT');
  });

  icsContent.push('END:VCALENDAR');

  const blob = new Blob([icsContent.join('\r\n')], {
    type: 'text/calendar;charset=utf-8',
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `Takashimaya_Delegation_${format(new Date(), 'yyyyMMdd')}.ics`;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DelegationCalendarParts/useDelegationCalendarEvents.ts ==================== */
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { parseDateTime, getTaskStatus, getStatus } from '../../lib/utils';
import { DelegationCalendarEvent } from './delegationCalendarTypes';

interface UseDelegationCalendarEventsParams {
  groups: DelegationGroup[];
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  filterStore: string;
  filterLocation: string;
  filterParty: string;
  currentView: string;
}

export function useDelegationCalendarEvents({
  groups,
  projects,
  tasks,
  currentUser,
  filterStore,
  filterLocation,
  filterParty,
  currentView,
}: UseDelegationCalendarEventsParams) {
  const events = useMemo(() => {
    const projectMap = new Map<string, Project>();
    projects.forEach((p) => {
      if (p.code) projectMap.set(p.code, p);
    });
    const calendarEvents: DelegationCalendarEvent[] = [];

    const filteredGroups = groups.filter((g) => {
      const project =
        projectMap.get(g.projectCode) || projectMap.get(g.parentTaskId);

      if (filterStore && project && project.store !== filterStore) return false;
      if (filterLocation && project && project.location !== filterLocation)
        return false;

      return true;
    });

    filteredGroups.forEach((group) => {
      const project =
        projectMap.get(group.projectCode) || projectMap.get(group.parentTaskId);
      let subTasksToMap = group.subTasks;
      const isAdmin = currentUser.role === 'admin';

      if (!isAdmin && group.createdBy !== currentUser.id) {
        subTasksToMap = subTasksToMap.filter((st) => {
          if (
            st.createdBy === currentUser.id ||
            (st.involvedUsers && st.involvedUsers.includes(currentUser.id))
          )
            return true;
          const pLower = String(st.party || '')
            .toLowerCase()
            .trim();
          const userParties = currentUser.partyPermissions
            ? Object.keys(currentUser.partyPermissions)
                .filter((k) => currentUser.partyPermissions![k])
                .map((k) => k.toLowerCase().trim())
            : [];
          if (userParties.includes('all')) return true;
          const usernameMatch =
            pLower === String(currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase().trim();
          return userParties.includes(pLower) || usernameMatch;
        });
      }

      subTasksToMap.forEach((st) => {
        if (filterParty) {
          if (filterParty === 'unassigned') {
            if (st.party && st.party.trim() !== '') return;
          } else {
            if (st.party !== filterParty) return;
          }
        }

        const startVal =
          st.startAct ||
          group.updatedAt?.substring(0, 10) ||
          new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
        const endVal = st.finishAct || startVal;

        const start = parseDateTime(startVal);
        const end = parseDateTime(endVal);

        if (start && end) {
          const evtStart = new Date(start);
          evtStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          const evtEnd = new Date(end);
          evtEnd.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

          if (currentView === 'month') {
            calendarEvents.push({
              id: `del_${st.id}_start`,
              title: `${group.name} - ${st.name || 'Delegation'}`,
              start: evtStart,
              end: evtStart,
              allDay: true,
              resource: {
                group,
                subTask: st,
                isStartNode: true,
                projectName: project ? project.name : '',
                currentView,
              },
              colorIndex: 0,
            });
            if (evtStart.toDateString() !== evtEnd.toDateString()) {
              calendarEvents.push({
                id: `del_${st.id}_end`,
                title: `${group.name} - ${st.name || 'Delegation'}`,
                start: evtEnd,
                end: evtEnd,
                allDay: true,
                resource: {
                  group,
                  subTask: st,
                  isFinishNode: true,
                  projectName: project ? project.name : '',
                  currentView,
                },
                colorIndex: 0,
              });
            }
          } else {
            calendarEvents.push({
              id: `del_${st.id}`,
              title: `${group.name} - ${st.name || 'Delegation'}`,
              start: evtStart,
              end: evtEnd,
              allDay: true,
              resource: {
                group,
                subTask: st,
                projectName: project ? project.name : '',
                currentView,
              },
              colorIndex: 0,
            });
          }
        }
      });
    });

    calendarEvents.sort((a, b) => {
      const parentTaskA = a.resource.group.parentTaskId
        ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === a.resource.group.parentTaskId)
        : null;
      const parentTaskB = b.resource.group.parentTaskId
        ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === b.resource.group.parentTaskId)
        : null;

      let plStatusA = 'Upcoming';
      if (parentTaskA) {
        plStatusA = getTaskStatus(parentTaskA.start, parentTaskA.finish);
      } else {
        const pA =
          projectMap.get(a.resource.group.projectCode) ||
          projectMap.get(a.resource.group.parentTaskId);
        if (pA) {
          plStatusA = getStatus(
            pA.computedTakStart || pA.start,
            pA.computedTakCompl,
            pA.computedOpening || pA.opening,
            pA.code
          );
        }
      }

      let plStatusB = 'Upcoming';
      if (parentTaskB) {
        plStatusB = getTaskStatus(parentTaskB.start, parentTaskB.finish);
      } else {
        const pB =
          projectMap.get(b.resource.group.projectCode) ||
          projectMap.get(b.resource.group.parentTaskId);
        if (pB) {
          plStatusB = getStatus(
            pB.computedTakStart || pB.start,
            pB.computedTakCompl,
            pB.computedOpening || pB.opening,
            pB.code
          );
        }
      }

      const statusPriority: Record<string, number> = {
        'On process': 1,
        Handover: 2,
        Upcoming: 3,
        Completed: 4,
        Canceled: 5,
      };

      const priA = statusPriority[plStatusA] || 99;
      const priB = statusPriority[plStatusB] || 99;
      if (priA !== priB) return priA - priB;

      if (plStatusA === 'On process') {
        const today = new Date();
        today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        const finishA = parseDateTime(a.resource.subTask.finishAct);
        const finishB = parseDateTime(b.resource.subTask.finishAct);
        if (finishA && finishB) {
          const diffA = Math.abs(finishA.getTime() - today.getTime());
          const diffB = Math.abs(finishB.getTime() - today.getTime());
          if (diffA !== diffB) return diffA - diffB;
        }
      }

      const startA = a.resource.subTask.startAct || '9999-12-31';
      const startB = b.resource.subTask.startAct || '9999-12-31';
      if (startA < startB) return -1;
      if (startA > startB) return 1;

      return 0;
    });

    return calendarEvents;
  }, [
    groups,
    projects,
    tasks,
    currentUser,
    filterStore,
    filterLocation,
    filterParty,
    currentView,
  ]);

  return { events };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DelegationCalendarTab.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useMemo, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Calendar, dateFnsLocalizer, View } from 'react-big-calendar';
import { format, parse, startOfWeek, getDay, isSameDay, startOfDay } from 'date-fns';
import { enUS } from 'date-fns/locale/en-US';
import 'react-big-calendar/lib/css/react-big-calendar.css';

import { useEnrichedData } from '../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { safeSetItemLocal } from '../lib/storage';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { getDefaultStoreFilter } from '../lib/utils';

import {
  DelegationCalendarEvent,
  DelegationCalendarTabProps,
} from './DelegationCalendarParts/delegationCalendarTypes';
import {
  CustomWeekView,
  CustomAgendaView,
} from './DelegationCalendarParts/DelegationCustomVerticalView';
import { CustomEventComponent } from './DelegationCalendarParts/DelegationCustomEvent';
import { DelegationCalendarFilterToolbar } from './DelegationCalendarParts/DelegationCalendarFilterToolbar';
import { DelegationCalendarMonthList } from './DelegationCalendarParts/DelegationCalendarMonthList';
import { useDelegationCalendarEvents } from './DelegationCalendarParts/useDelegationCalendarEvents';

const locales = { 'en-US': enUS };
const localizer = dateFnsLocalizer({
  format,
  parse,
  startOfWeek,
  getDay,
  locales,
});

export function DelegationCalendarTab({
  groups,
  onTabChange,
}: DelegationCalendarTabProps) {
  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore((state) => state.currentUser)!;
  const locations = useAppStore((state) => state.locations);
  const isTasksRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.isTasksRequested);
  const setIsTasksRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsTasksRequested);
  const isDelegationsRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.isDelegationsRequested);
  const setIsDelegationsRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsDelegationsRequested);

  // Tri-Gate Lazy Loading (Rule 3)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTasksRequested) setIsTasksRequested(true);
    if (!isDelegationsRequested) setIsDelegationsRequested(true);
  }, [isTasksRequested, setIsTasksRequested, isDelegationsRequested, setIsDelegationsRequested]);

  const [currentDate, setCurrentDate] = useState(new Date());
  const [currentView, setCurrentView] = useState<View>('month');
  const [searchDate, setSearchDate] = useState('');
  const [filterStore, setFilterStore] = useState<string>(() => {
    const def = getDefaultStoreFilter(currentUser);
    return def === 'all' ? '' : def;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    safeSetItemLocal(`taka_store_filter_${currentUser.id}`, filterStore || 'all');
  }, [filterStore, currentUser.id]);

  const [filterLocation, setFilterLocation] = useState('');
  const [filterParty, setFilterParty] = useState('');
  const [selectedMonthDate, setSelectedMonthDate] = useState<Date>(new Date());

  const uniqueStores = useMemo(() => {
    return [...new Set(projects.map((p) => p.store).filter(Boolean))].sort();
  }, [projects]);

  const uniqueParties = useMemo(() => {
    const partiesList = new Set<string>();
    groups.forEach((g) =>
      g.subTasks.forEach((st) => {
        if (st.party) partiesList.add(st.party);
      })
    );
    return [...partiesList].sort();
  }, [groups]);

  const handleSearchDate = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setSearchDate(val);
    if (val) {
      const parsed = new Date(val);
      if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
        setCurrentDate(parsed);
        setCurrentView('day');
      }
    }
  };

  const { events } = useDelegationCalendarEvents({
    groups,
    projects,
    tasks,
    currentUser,
    filterStore,
    filterLocation,
    filterParty,
    currentView,
  });

  const handleExportICS = () => {
    exportDelegationEventsToICS(events);
  };

  const eventStyleGetter = (event: DelegationCalendarEvent) => {
    let backgroundColor = '#f8fafc';
    let borderColor = '#cbd5e1';

    const flowTxt =
      event.resource.subTask.delegationStatus ||
      event.resource.subTask.status ||
      'Assigned';
    if (flowTxt === 'Completed') {
      backgroundColor = '#f0fdf4';
      borderColor = '#bbf7d0';
    } else if (flowTxt === 'On process' || flowTxt === 'Accepted') {
      backgroundColor = '#eff6ff';
      borderColor = '#bfdbfe';
    } else if (
      flowTxt === 'Delayed' ||
      [
        'requested',
        'hold',
        'waiting for approval',
        'pending completed',
      ].includes(flowTxt.toLowerCase())
    ) {
      backgroundColor = '#fff7ed';
      borderColor = '#fed7aa';
    } else if (
      flowTxt === 'Approved' ||
      flowTxt === 'Rejected' ||
      flowTxt === 'Request Delay' ||
      flowTxt === 'Needs Rework'
    ) {
      backgroundColor = '#faf5ff';
      borderColor = '#e9d5ff';
    } else if (flowTxt === 'Assigned') {
      backgroundColor = '#fff7ed';
      borderColor = '#fed7aa';
    }

    return {
      style: {
        backgroundColor,
        borderRadius: '6px',
        opacity: 0.95,
        color: '#0f172a',
        border: `1px solid ${borderColor}`,
        display: 'block',
        fontSize: '11px',
        fontWeight: '600',
        padding: '3px 6px',
        lineHeight: '1.3',
        boxShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)',
      },
    };
  };

  const handleSelectEvent = (event: DelegationCalendarEvent) => {
    onTabChange('taskDelegation');
    setTimeout(() => {
      const el = document.getElementById(`delegation-group-${event.resource.group.id}`);
      if (el) {
        el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      }
    }, 300);
  };

  const CustomDateHeader = ({ label, date }: any) => {
    const dayEvents = events.filter(
      (e) =>
        startOfDay(e.start) <= startOfDay(date) &&
        startOfDay(e.end) >= startOfDay(date)
    );
    const hasEvents = dayEvents.length > 0;
    const isSelected = isSameDay(date, selectedMonthDate);

    return (
      <div
        className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer mt-1 mx-auto w-10 h-10 ${
          isSelected ? 'bg-blue-100 rounded-full' : ''
        }`}
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          setSelectedMonthDate(date);
        }}
      >
        <span
          className={`text-[13px] font-medium leading-none ${
            isSameDay(date, new Date())
              ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center'
              : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]'
          }`}
        >
          {label}
        </span>
        <div className="h-2 flex items-center justify-center mt-1">
          {hasEvents && (
            <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full"></div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-grow flex flex-col min-h-[600px] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-sm p-4">
      <style>{`
        .rbc-time-content { display: none !important; }
        .rbc-time-header-gutter { display: none !important; }
        .rbc-time-view .rbc-time-header { flex: 1 1 auto !important; min-height: 0 !important; }
        .rbc-time-header-content { flex: 1 1 auto !important; display: flex !important; flex-direction: column !important; border-left: none !important; }
        .rbc-allday-cell { flex: 1 1 auto !important; height: 100% !important; max-height: none !important; }
        .rbc-event { white-space: normal !important; word-break: break-word !important; height: auto !important; min-height: 24px; margin-bottom: 2px !important; background: transparent !important; padding: 0 !important; border: 0 !important; }
        .rbc-event-content { white-space: normal !important; word-break: break-word !important; height: 100%; display: flex; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-row-segment { display: none !important; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-month-row { flex: 1 0 50px !important; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-date-cell { text-align: center !important; padding: 0 !important; }
        .rbc-month-view .rbc-button-link { pointer-events: none !important; }
      `}</style>

      <DelegationCalendarFilterToolbar
        totalEvents={events.length}
        searchDate={searchDate}
        onSearchDateChange={handleSearchDate}
        filterStore={filterStore}
        setFilterStore={setFilterStore}
        uniqueStores={uniqueStores}
        filterLocation={filterLocation}
        setFilterLocation={setFilterLocation}
        locations={locations}
        filterParty={filterParty}
        setFilterParty={setFilterParty}
        uniqueParties={uniqueParties}
        onExportICS={handleExportICS}
      />

      <div className="flex-grow min-h-[600px]">
        <Calendar
          localizer={localizer}
          events={events}
          startAccessor="start"
          endAccessor="end"
          style={{ height: '100%', minHeight: '600px' }}
          eventPropGetter={eventStyleGetter}
          components={{
            event: CustomEventComponent as any,
            month: {
              dateHeader: CustomDateHeader,
            },
          }}
          onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent}
          date={currentDate}
          onNavigate={(newDate) => setCurrentDate(newDate)}
          view={currentView}
          onView={(newView) => setCurrentView(newView)}
          views={{
            month: true,
            week: CustomWeekView,
            day: true,
            agenda: CustomAgendaView,
          }}
          popup
        />
      </div>

      {currentView === 'month' && (
        <DelegationCalendarMonthList
          selectedMonthDate={selectedMonthDate}
          events={events}
          onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DelegationParts/MultiSelectInput.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

export function MultiSelectInput({ 
  value, 
  options, 
  onSave, 
  disabled, 
  className,
  placeholder
}: { 
  value: string; 
  options: string[]; 
  onSave: (val: string) => void; 
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
}) {
  const [val, setVal] = useState(value || '');
  const [showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions] = useState(false);
  const valRef = useRef(val);
  const valueRef = useRef(value);
  const isComponentMounted = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    isComponentMounted.current = true;
    return () => { isComponentMounted.current = false; };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setVal(value || '');
    valueRef.current = value || '';
  }, [value]);

  useEffect(() => {
    valRef.current = val;
  }, [val]);

  const currentPart = String(valRef.current || val || '').split(',').pop()?.trim() || '';
  
  // Deduplicate options case-insensitively, preferring the first encountered case
  const seenLower = new Set<string>();
  const uniqueOptions: string[] = [];
  for (const opt of options) {
    const lower = opt.toLowerCase();
    if (!seenLower.has(lower)) {
      seenLower.add(lower);
      uniqueOptions.push(opt);
    }
  }

  const suggestions = uniqueOptions.filter(v => 
    v.toLowerCase().includes(currentPart.toLowerCase()) && currentPart.toLowerCase() !== v.toLowerCase()
  );

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full">
      <input
        type="text"
        value={val}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setVal(e.target.value);
          setShowSuggestions(true);
        }}
        onFocus={() => setShowSuggestions(true)}
        onBlur={() => {
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (!isComponentMounted.current) return;
            const currentVal = valRef.current;
            const oldVal = valueRef.current;
            if (currentVal && currentVal.trim() !== '') {
              const parts = currentVal.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
              const correctedParts = parts.map(p => {
                const matchedOption = options.find(opt => opt.toLowerCase() === p.toLowerCase());
                return matchedOption || p;
              });
              const invalidParts = correctedParts.filter(p => !options.includes(p));
              if (invalidParts.length > 0) {
                setVal(oldVal || '');
              } else {
                const newParts = correctedParts.join(', ');
                setVal(newParts);
                if (newParts !== oldVal) onSave(newParts);
              }
            } else {
              if (oldVal !== '') onSave('');
            }
            setShowSuggestions(false);
          }, 200);
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            e.preventDefault();
            const currentPartStr = String(valRef.current || val || '').split(',').pop()?.trim() || '';
            const match = uniqueOptions.find(opt => opt.toLowerCase().startsWith(currentPartStr.toLowerCase()) || opt.toLowerCase().includes(currentPartStr.toLowerCase()));
            if (currentPartStr && match) {
              const parts = String(valRef.current).split(',');
              parts.pop();
              const newParts = parts.map(p => p.trim()).filter(Boolean);
              newParts.push(match);
              const newValue = newParts.join(', ');
              setVal(newValue);
              valRef.current = newValue;
            }
            setTimeout(() => {
              e.currentTarget.blur();
            }, 0);
          }
        }}
        disabled={disabled}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        className={className}
      />
      {showSuggestions && suggestions.length > 0 && (
        <div className="absolute top-full left-0 mt-1 min-w-[200px] w-full max-h-40 overflow-y-auto bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded shadow-xl z-[9999]">
          {suggestions.map(s => (
            <div 
              key={s} 
              className="px-3 py-2 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] cursor-pointer text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]"
              onMouseDown={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const parts = String(valRef.current).split(',');
                parts.pop();
                const newParts = parts.map(p => p.trim()).filter(Boolean);
                newParts.push(s);
                const newValue = newParts.join(', ') + ', ';
                setVal(newValue);
                setShowSuggestions(false);
              }}
              onClick={() => {
                const parts = String(valRef.current).split(',');
                parts.pop();
                const newParts = parts.map(p => p.trim()).filter(Boolean);
                newParts.push(s);
                const newValue = newParts.join(', ') + ', ';
                setVal(newValue);
                setShowSuggestions(false);
                onSave(newValue.trim().replace(/,\s*$/, ''));
              }}
            >
              {s}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { useLanguage } from "../lib/LanguageContext";
import { Portal } from './Portal';
import { X, Monitor, Copy, Check, ExternalLink, ShieldCheck, Zap, Info, GripHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';

interface DesktopOptimizationModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function DesktopOptimizationModal({ isOpen, onClose }: DesktopOptimizationModalProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [activeBrowser, setActiveBrowser] = useState<'chrome' | 'edge'>('chrome');
  const [copiedUrl, setCopiedUrl] = useState(false);
  const [copiedSettingsPath, setCopiedSettingsPath] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const appUrl = typeof window !== 'undefined' 
    ? `${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}`.replace(/\/+$/, '') 
    : 'https://takashimaya.app';

  const chromeSettingsUrl = 'chrome://settings/performance';
  const edgeSettingsUrl = 'edge://settings/system';

  const handleCopyUrl = async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(appUrl);
      setCopiedUrl(true);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Đã sao chép",
        message: "Đã sao chép URL ứng dụng vào bộ nhớ tạm!",
        type: "success"
      });
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedUrl(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Thông báo",
        message: "Không thể tự động sao chép. Vui lòng bôi đen và copy URL thủ công.",
        type: "info"
      });
    }
  };

  const handleCopySettings = async (path: string) => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(path);
      setCopiedSettingsPath(true);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Đã sao chép",
        message: `Đã sao chép đường dẫn ${path}`,
        type: "success"
      });
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedSettingsPath(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  return (
    <Portal>
      <div 
        className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-150" 
        onClick={onClose}
      >
        <Draggable disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768} handle=".modal-handle" bounds="parent" nodeRef={nodeRef} cancel="button, input, textarea">
          <div 
            ref={nodeRef}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] w-full max-w-2xl rounded-2xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] max-h-[90vh] pointer-events-auto"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="modal-handle cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#252528]/50">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/50">
                  <Monitor className="w-5 h-5" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                    Cấu Hình Tối Ưu Desktop & Chống Ngủ Tab
                    <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] mt-0.5">
                    Ngăn Chrome / Edge đóng băng bộ nhớ (Memory Saver) khi bạn làm việc đa nhiệm
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

                <X className="w-5 h-5" />

          {/* Body */}
          <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-5">
            {/* Lợi ích */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-900/30 flex items-start gap-2.5">

              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Footer */}
          <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#252528]/50 flex justify-end">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#38383c] hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-[#48484c] text-slate-800 dark:text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-colors shadow-sm"
            >
              Đã hiểu & Đóng
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        </Draggable>
      </div>
    </Portal>

  const setIsTasksRequested = useAppStore(state => state.setIsTasksRequested);

    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    permissionMatrix,

  const [isDesktop, setIsDesktop] = useState(() => typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerWidth >= 1280 : true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
