    message: string;
    onConfirm: () => Promise<void>;
  }>({
    isOpen: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    onConfirm: async () => {},
  });
  const [noteModalTask, setNoteModalTask] = useState<Task | null>(null);

  // Column management
  const {
    availableColumnsForUser,
    visibleColumns,
    colWidths,
    sortConfig,
    handleResize,
    handleToggleColumn,
    handleSort,
    effectiveVisibleColumns,
    totalTableWidth,
  } = useDetailColumns({ currentUser, canWrite });

  // Core Data & Virtualization Rows Hook
  const {
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    visibleCount,
    setVisibleCount,
    statusFilter,
    setStatusFilter,
    lastSelectedStatusFilterRef,
    selectedTaskIds,
    setSelectedTaskIds,
    lastCheckedTaskIdRef,
    activeProjectInView,
    delegationGroupByParentKey,
    projectInfoMap,
    getProjectInfo,
    filteredProjects,
    allVisibleTaskIds,
    lowerSearchTerm,
    taskCodeMap,
    taskActualStatusMap,
    childTasksCountMap,
    flatTableRows,
    handleSelectAllTasksInProject,
    handleToggleSelectTask,
    handleClearFocus,
    handleBackToGantt,
  } = useDetailData({
    projects,
    tasks,
    delegationGroups,
    currentUser,
    effectiveStore,
    globalYearFilter,
    setGlobalYearFilter,
    globalStoreFilter,
    setGlobalStoreFilter,
    globalLocationFilter,
    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    initialFilterCode,
    initialFocusTaskId,
    returnScrollId,
    onClearFocus,
    onBackToGantt,
    sortConfig,
    expandedCodes,
    setExpandedCodes,
    setVisibleActiveProjectIds,
    canWrite,
  });

  // Virtual Windowing Table
  const {
    tableContainerRef,
    handleTableScroll,
    startIndex,
    endIndex,
    paddingTop,
    paddingBottom,
  } = useDetailVirtualization({
    flatTableRows,
    initialFocusTaskId,
    initialFilterCode,
    visibleCount,
    setVisibleCount,
    filteredProjectsLength: filteredProjects.length,
  });

  // Reordering & Predecessor Synchronization
  const {
    isSyncingPredecessors,
    handleSyncAllPredecessors,
    isConvertingToHash,
    handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash,
  } = useDetailPredecessorSync({
    tasks,
    projects,
    hasWritePermission,
  });

  const {
    draggingTaskIds,
    dragOverTaskId,
    dropPosition,
    draggingTaskNames,
    handleSortSubTasks,
    handleMoveTask,
    handleDetailTaskDragStart,
    handleDetailTaskDragOver,
    handleDetailTaskDragLeave,
    handleDetailTaskDragEnd,
    handleDetailTaskDrop,
  } = useDetailTaskReorder({
    tasks,
    projects,
    selectedTaskIds,
    setSelectedTaskIds,
  });

  const [isSortingSubTasks, setIsSortingSubTasks] = useState(false);

  const handleSortActiveOrAll = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsSortingSubTasks(true);
    try {
      if (activeProjectInView) {
        const projTasks = tasks.filter(t => 
          (activeProjectInView.id && t.projectId ? t.projectId === activeProjectInView.id : false) ||
          (t.projectCode && String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase() === String(activeProjectInView.code).trim().toLowerCase())
        );
        await handleSortSubTasks(activeProjectInView, projTasks);
      } else if (filteredProjects && filteredProjects.length > 0) {
        for (const p of filteredProjects) {
          const projTasks = tasks.filter(t => 
            (p.id && t.projectId ? t.projectId === p.id : false) ||
            (t.projectCode && String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase() === String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase())
          );
          if (projTasks.length > 0) {
            await handleSortSubTasks(p, projTasks);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error sorting subtasks:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsSortingSubTasks(false);
    }
  }, [activeProjectInView, filteredProjects, tasks, handleSortSubTasks]);

  // Project & Task Mutations
  const {
    handleDeleteProject,
    handleUpdateProject,
  } = useDetailProjectMutations({
    projects,
    tasks,
    delegationGroups,
    currentUser,
    setConfirmModal,
  });

  const {
    handleDeleteTask,
    handleUpdateTask,
    handleSaveNotes,
  } = useDetailTaskMutations({
    tasks,
    projects,
    delegationGroups,
    currentUser,
    setConfirmModal,
  });

  // Project & Task CSV Operations
  const {
    handleExportProjects,
    handleImportProjects,
  } = useDetailProjectCsv({
    filteredProjects,
    projects,
  });

  const {
    handleExportTasks,
    handleImportTasks,
    parseCSVDate,
  } = useDetailTaskCsv({
    filteredProjects,
    projects,
    tasks,
    appUsers,
    currentUser,
  });

  // Bulk Actions
  const {
    handleBulkAction,
  } = useDetailBulkActions({
    selectedTaskIds,
    setSelectedTaskIds,
    lastCheckedTaskIdRef,
    tasks,
    projects,
    delegationGroups,
    currentUser,
  });

  // Initial Filter Code Scrolling & Backfill Missing Dates Hook
  useDetailInitialScroll({
    projects,
    tasks,
    delegationGroups,
    initialFilterCode,
    initialFocusTaskId,
    setSearchTerm,
    setStatusFilter,
  });

  const toggleGroup = useCallback((id: string) => {
    toggleProjectExpansion(id);
  }, [toggleProjectExpansion]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col flex-grow bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-sm">
      <React.Suspense fallback={null}>
        {confirmModal.isOpen && (
          <ConfirmModal 
            isOpen={confirmModal.isOpen}
            message={confirmModal.message}
            onConfirm={confirmModal.onConfirm}
            onCancel={() => setConfirmModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }))}
          />
        )}
        {!!noteModalTask && (
          <TaskNoteModal
            isOpen={!!noteModalTask}
            onClose={() => setNoteModalTask(null)}
            task={noteModalTask}
            onSave={handleSaveNotes}
            canWrite={canWrite}
          />
        )}
      </React.Suspense>

      <DetailFilterToolbar
        globalYearFilter={globalYearFilter}
        setGlobalYearFilter={setGlobalYearFilter}
        years={years}
        effectiveStore={effectiveStore}
        setGlobalStoreFilter={setGlobalStoreFilter}
        stores={stores}
        globalLocationFilter={globalLocationFilter}
        setGlobalLocationFilter={setGlobalLocationFilter}
        locationFilterOptions={locationFilterOptions}
        statusFilter={statusFilter}
        onStatusFilterChange={(val) => {
          setStatusFilter(val);
          if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
            lastSelectedStatusFilterRef.current = val;
            safeSetItemSession("taka_detail_status_filter", val);
          }
        }}
        searchTerm={searchTerm}
        onSearchTermChange={(val) => {
          setSearchTerm(val);
          if (!val) {
            setDetailTabFilterCode("");
            onClearFocus?.();
          }
        }}
        availableColumnsForUser={availableColumnsForUser}
        visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
        onToggleColumn={handleToggleColumn}
        hasWritePermission={hasWritePermission}
        isEditMode={isEditMode}
        setIsEditMode={setIsEditMode}
        canWrite={canWrite}
        onAddProject={onAddProject}
        onAddTask={onAddTask}
        activeProjectInView={activeProjectInView}
        filteredProjects={filteredProjects}
        projects={projects}
        handleSyncAllPredecessors={handleSyncAllPredecessors}
        isSyncingPredecessors={isSyncingPredecessors}
        handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash={handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash}
        isConvertingToHash={isConvertingToHash}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        handleExportProjects={handleExportProjects}
        handleImportProjects={handleImportProjects}
        handleExportTasks={handleExportTasks}
        handleImportTasks={handleImportTasks}
        parseCSVDate={parseCSVDate}
        onSortSubTasks={handleSortActiveOrAll}
        isSortingSubTasks={isSortingSubTasks}
        selectedTaskCount={selectedTaskIds.size}
        onBulkAction={handleBulkAction}
      />

      {isDesktop && (
        <DetailTableView
        tableContainerRef={tableContainerRef}
        handleTableScroll={handleTableScroll}
        totalTableWidth={totalTableWidth}
        effectiveVisibleColumns={effectiveVisibleColumns}
        colWidths={colWidths}
        canWrite={canWrite}
        selectedTaskIds={selectedTaskIds}
        allVisibleTaskIds={allVisibleTaskIds}
        expandedCodes={expandedCodes}
        setExpandedCodes={setExpandedCodes}
        filteredProjects={filteredProjects}
        availableColumnsForUser={availableColumnsForUser}
        sortConfig={sortConfig}
        onResize={handleResize}
        onToggleColumn={handleToggleColumn}
        onSort={handleSort}
        setSelectedTaskIds={setSelectedTaskIds}
        paddingTop={paddingTop}
        paddingBottom={paddingBottom}
        flatTableRows={flatTableRows}
        startIndex={startIndex}
        endIndex={endIndex}
        allowedStoreOptions={allowedStoreOptions}
        allowedLocationOptions={allowedLocationOptions}
        toggleGroup={toggleGroup}
        handleSelectAllTasksInProject={handleSelectAllTasksInProject}
        handleUpdateProject={handleUpdateProject}
        handleSortSubTasks={handleSortSubTasks}
        onEditProject={onEditProject}
        onAddTask={onAddTask}
        handleDeleteProject={handleDeleteProject}
        taskActualStatusMap={taskActualStatusMap}
        taskCodeMap={taskCodeMap}
        childTasksCountMap={childTasksCountMap}
        draggingTaskIds={draggingTaskIds}
        dragOverTaskId={dragOverTaskId}
        dropPosition={dropPosition}
        draggingTaskNames={draggingTaskNames}
        initialFocusTaskId={initialFocusTaskId}
        tasks={tasks}
        projects={projects}
        handleToggleSelectTask={handleToggleSelectTask}
        onEditTask={onEditTask}
        handleUpdateTask={handleUpdateTask}
        handleMoveTask={handleMoveTask}
        handleDeleteTask={handleDeleteTask}
        handleDetailTaskDragStart={handleDetailTaskDragStart}
        handleDetailTaskDragOver={handleDetailTaskDragOver}
        handleDetailTaskDragLeave={handleDetailTaskDragLeave}
        handleDetailTaskDragEnd={handleDetailTaskDragEnd}
        handleDetailTaskDrop={handleDetailTaskDrop}
        visibleCount={visibleCount}
        setVisibleCount={setVisibleCount}
      />
      )}

      <DetailMobileView
        filteredProjects={filteredProjects}
        expandedCodes={expandedCodes}
        setExpandedCodes={setExpandedCodes}
        visibleCount={visibleCount}
        setVisibleCount={setVisibleCount}
        projectInfoMap={projectInfoMap}
        getProjectInfo={getProjectInfo}
        sortConfig={sortConfig}
        delegationGroupByParentKey={delegationGroupByParentKey}
        initialFocusTaskId={initialFocusTaskId}
        canWrite={canWrite}
        tasks={tasks}
        projects={projects}
        lowerSearchTerm={lowerSearchTerm}
        delegationGroups={delegationGroups}
        toggleGroup={toggleGroup}
        onEditProject={onEditProject}
        onAddTask={onAddTask}
        onEditTask={onEditTask}
        handleUpdateProject={handleUpdateProject}
        handleMoveTask={handleMoveTask}
        handleUpdateTask={handleUpdateTask}
        handleDeleteTask={handleDeleteTask}
        taskCodeMap={taskCodeMap}
        taskActualStatusMap={taskActualStatusMap}
        onSortSubTasks={handleSortSubTasks}
      />

      <DetailFocusControls 
        initialFocusTaskId={initialFocusTaskId}
        onBackToGantt={handleBackToGantt}
        onClearFocus={onClearFocus ? handleClearFocus : undefined}
      />

      <DetailFloatingActionBar
        selectedCount={selectedTaskIds.size}
        canWrite={canWrite}
        onBulkAction={handleBulkAction}
        onClearSelection={() => { 
          setSelectedTaskIds(new Set()); 
          lastCheckedTaskIdRef.current = null; 
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

  globalYearFilter: string;
  setGlobalYearFilter: (v: string) => void;
  years: (number | string)[];
  effectiveStore: string;
  setGlobalStoreFilter: (v: string) => void;
  stores: string[];
  globalLocationFilter: string[];
  setGlobalLocationFilter: (v: string[]) => void;
  locationFilterOptions: string[];
  statusFilter: string;
  onStatusFilterChange: (v: string) => void;
  searchTerm: string;
  onSearchTermChange: (v: string) => void;
  availableColumnsForUser: { id: string; label: string }[];
  visibleColumns: string[];
  onToggleColumn: (col: string) => void;
  hasWritePermission: boolean;
  isEditMode: boolean;
  setIsEditMode: (v: boolean) => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
  onAddProject: () => void;
  onAddTask: (p?: Project | null) => void;
  activeProjectInView?: Project | null;
  filteredProjects: Project[];
  projects: Project[];
  handleSyncAllPredecessors: (v: boolean) => void;
  isSyncingPredecessors: boolean;
  handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash?: () => void;
  isConvertingToHash?: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  handleExportProjects: () => void;
  handleImportProjects: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  handleExportTasks: () => void;
  handleImportTasks: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  parseCSVDate?: (d: any) => string;
  onSortSubTasks?: () => void;
  isSortingSubTasks?: boolean;
  selectedTaskCount?: number;
  onBulkAction?: (action: any) => void;
}

export const DetailFilterToolbar = memo(function DetailFilterToolbar({
  globalYearFilter,
  setGlobalYearFilter,
  years,
  effectiveStore,
  setGlobalStoreFilter,
  stores,
  globalLocationFilter,
  setGlobalLocationFilter,
  locationFilterOptions,
  statusFilter,
  onStatusFilterChange,
  searchTerm,
  onSearchTermChange,
  availableColumnsForUser,
  visibleColumns,
  onToggleColumn,
  hasWritePermission,
  isEditMode,
  setIsEditMode,
  canWrite,
  onAddProject,
  onAddTask,
  activeProjectInView,
  filteredProjects,
  projects,
  handleSyncAllPredecessors,
  isSyncingPredecessors,
  handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash,
  isConvertingToHash,
  currentUser,
  handleExportProjects,
  handleImportProjects,
  handleExportTasks,
  handleImportTasks,
  parseCSVDate,
  onSortSubTasks,
  isSortingSubTasks,
  selectedTaskCount = 0,
  onBulkAction
}: DetailFilterToolbarProps) {
  return (
    <div className="px-3 sm:px-4 md:px-5 py-3 md:py-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/50 flex flex-col xl:flex-row gap-3 justify-between items-stretch xl:items-center shrink-0 print:hidden">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 w-full xl:w-auto flex-grow max-w-4xl">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 w-full">
          <select 
            value={globalYearFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setGlobalYearFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block p-2 outline-none shadow-sm min-w-[85px] sm:min-w-[95px] flex-1 sm:flex-none"
          >
            <option value="all">All Years</option>
            {years.map(y => <option key={y} value={y}>Year {y}</option>)}
          </select>
          <select 
            value={effectiveStore}
            onChange={(e) => setGlobalStoreFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block p-2 outline-none shadow-sm min-w-[85px] sm:min-w-[95px] flex-1 sm:flex-none"
          >
            {stores.length > 1 && <option value="all">All Stores</option>}
            {stores.map(s => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
          </select>
          <MultiCheckboxSelect 
            value={globalLocationFilter}
            onChange={setGlobalLocationFilter}
            options={locationFilterOptions}
            placeholder="All Locations"
            className="min-w-[95px] sm:min-w-[100px] flex-1 sm:flex-none"
          />
          <select 
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => onStatusFilterChange(e.target.value)}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block p-2 outline-none shadow-sm min-w-[95px] sm:min-w-[100px] flex-1 sm:flex-none"
          >
            <option value="all">All Status</option>
            <option value="Upcoming">Upcoming</option>
            <option value="On process">On process</option>
            <option value="On process + Upcoming 3 days">On process + Upcoming 3 days</option>
            <option value="Handover">Handover</option>
            <option value="Completed">Completed</option>
            <option value="Canceled">Canceled</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="relative w-full">
          <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3 pointer-events-none text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] z-10">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <DebouncedSearchInput 
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={onSearchTermChange}
            className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 block w-full pl-9 pr-3 p-2 outline-none shadow-sm" 
            placeholder="Search in detail..."
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Controls */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end shrink-0 self-end xl:self-center">
        <ColumnAdder 
          availableColumns={availableColumnsForUser} 
          visibleColumns={visibleColumns} 
          onAddColumn={onToggleColumn} 
        />
      </div>

      {/* Floating Edit Mode Button - z-40 cleanly below header bar and behind modals */}
      {hasWritePermission && !isEditMode && (
        <div className="fixed top-[154px] sm:top-[160px] right-4 md:right-8 z-40 flex flex-row gap-2 justify-end items-start print:hidden pointer-events-auto">
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsEditMode(true)}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-600 border border-blue-400 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 dark:hover:bg-blue-500 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all shadow-2xl hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shrink-0 touch-manipulation text-xs cursor-pointer ring-2 ring-blue-500/30"
            title="Edit Mode"
          >
            <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4 text-white pointer-events-none" />
            <span className="pointer-events-none">
              Edit Mode
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {hasWritePermission && isEditMode && (
        <div className="fixed top-[154px] sm:top-[160px] left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 px-3 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-3 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md bg-opacity-95 w-[calc(100vw-1rem)] sm:w-max max-w-[calc(100vw-1rem)] sm:max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] print:hidden pointer-events-auto">
            <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 shrink-0">
              <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" />
              <span>Editing Mode</span>
            </div>

            {canWrite && (
              <>
                <button 
                  onClick={onAddProject}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-900 dark:bg-blue-600 border border-slate-800 dark:border-blue-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-blue-500 font-bold transition-all shadow-md shrink-0 touch-manipulation text-xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                  title="Add Project"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4 pointer-events-none" />
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline pointer-events-none">
                    Add Project
                  </span>
                </button>

                <button 
                  onClick={() => {
                    const targetProj = activeProjectInView || (filteredProjects && filteredProjects.length > 0 ? filteredProjects[0] : (projects && projects.length > 0 ? projects[0] : null));
                    onAddTask(targetProj);
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-600 border border-emerald-700 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-700 font-bold transition-all shadow-md shrink-0 touch-manipulation text-xs active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
                  title={activeProjectInView?.code ? `Add Task for ${activeProjectInView.code}` : "Add New Task"}
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4 pointer-events-none" />
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline pointer-events-none">
                    {activeProjectInView?.code ? `+ Task (${activeProjectInView.code})` : 'Add New Task'}
                  </span>
                </button>

                {onSortSubTasks && (
                  <button 
                    onClick={onSortSubTasks}
                    disabled={isSortingSubTasks}
                    className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-600 border border-amber-700 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-amber-700 font-bold transition-all shadow-md shrink-0 touch-manipulation text-xs active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
                    title={activeProjectInView?.code ? `Sort sub-tasks for ${activeProjectInView.code} by Start Date & Dependencies` : "Sort sub-tasks by Start Date & Dependencies"}
                  >
                    <ArrowUpDown className={`w-4 h-4 pointer-events-none ${isSortingSubTasks ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                    <span className="hidden sm:inline pointer-events-none">
                      {isSortingSubTasks ? 'Sorting...' : (activeProjectInView?.code ? `Sort (${activeProjectInView.code})` : 'Sort Sub-tasks')}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                )}

                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleSyncAllPredecessors(true)}
                  disabled={isSyncingPredecessors}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-600 border border-indigo-700 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-indigo-700 font-bold transition-all shadow-md shrink-0 touch-manipulation text-xs active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
                  title="Fix and synchronize all predecessor references with subtask codes"
                >
                  <Wand2 className={`w-4 h-4 pointer-events-none ${isSyncingPredecessors ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline pointer-events-none">
                    {isSyncingPredecessors ? 'Syncing...' : 'Sync Predecessor'}
                  </span>
                </button>

                {handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash && (
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => handleConvertAllSubtasksToHash()}
                    disabled={isConvertingToHash}
                    className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-cyan-600 dark:bg-cyan-600 border border-cyan-700 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-cyan-700 font-bold transition-all shadow-md shrink-0 touch-manipulation text-xs active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
                    title="Scan and convert '-' to '#' for subtask codes and predecessors"
                  >
                    <Hash className={`w-4 h-4 pointer-events-none ${isConvertingToHash ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                    <span className="hidden sm:inline pointer-events-none">
                      {isConvertingToHash ? 'Converting...' : "Convert '-' to '#'"}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                )}

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onBulkAction && onBulkAction('unlink')}
                  disabled={selectedTaskCount < 1}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all shadow-md shrink-0 touch-manipulation text-xs active:scale-95 cursor-pointer",
                    selectedTaskCount >= 1
                      ? "bg-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-600 border border-amber-700 text-white hover:bg-amber-700"
                      : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336] text-slate-400 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700"
                  )}
                  title="Unlink selected tasks from parent modular link"
                >
                  <Unlink className="w-4 h-4 pointer-events-none" />
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline pointer-events-none">
                    Unlink{selectedTaskCount > 0 ? ` (${selectedTaskCount})` : ''}
                  </span>
                </button>
              </>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsEditMode(false)}
              className="flex items-center justify-center p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-[#e3e3e3] rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors shrink-0 ml-1 cursor-pointer"
              title="Done Editing"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {hasWritePermission && (
          <>
            <div className="flex gap-1 items-center">
              {currentUser.role === 'admin' && (
                <FullReplaceImport 
                  collectionName="taka_projects"
                  onImportSuccess={(count) => useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Success", message: String(`Full replace successful! Imported ${count} projects.`) })}
                  onParseRow={(row, headers) => {
                    const p: any = {};
                    let rowNo: any = null;
                    headers.forEach((h, i) => {
                      const fieldMap: any = { 'store': 'store', 'location': 'location', 'year': 'year', 'code': 'code', 'name': 'name', 'no': 'no' };
                      const target = fieldMap[h];
                      if (target) {
                        let val: any = row[i];
                        if (target === 'year' || target === 'no') val = isNaN(Number(val)) ? val : Number(val);
                        p[target] = val;
                        if (target === 'no') rowNo = val;
                      }
                    });
                    if (!p.code) return null;
                    return p;
                  }}
                  id="detail-full-import-projects-btn"
                  hiddenBtn={true}
                />
              )}
              <button id="detail-export-projects-btn" onClick={handleExportProjects} className="hidden" />
              <input id="detail-import-projects-input" type="file" accept=".csv" onChange={handleImportProjects} className="hidden" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1 items-center hidden">
              {currentUser.role === 'admin' && (
                <FullReplaceImport 
                  collectionName="taka_tasks"
                  onImportSuccess={(count) => useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Success", message: String(`Full replace successful! Imported ${count} tasks.`) })}
                  onParseRow={(row, headers) => {
                    const t: any = {};
                    headers.forEach((h, i) => {
                      let key = h;
                      if (h === 'task name') key = 'name';
                      if (h === 'projectcode') key = 'projectCode';
                      if (h === 'year' || h === 'projectyear') key = 'projectYear';
                      if (h === 'store' || h === 'projectstore') key = 'projectStore';
                      if (h === 'sub-task code' || h === 'sub task code' || h === 'subtask code' || h === 'sub_task_code' || h === 'taskcodephu' || h === 'task code phu' || h === 'task_code_phu') key = 'taskCodePhu';
                      if (h === 'orderindex' || h === 'order_index') key = 'orderIndex';
                      if (h === 'delegation' || h === 'task delegation' || h === 'task_delegation' || h === 'isdelegation') key = 'delegation';
                      if (h === 'task flexible' || h === 'task_flexible' || h === 'taskflexible' || h === 'flexible' || h === 'realtimeupdate' || h === 'realtime_update') key = 'realtimeUpdate';
                      if (['projectCode', 'projectYear', 'projectStore', 'name', 'start', 'finish', 'duration', 'party', 'predecessor', 'taskCodePhu', 'orderIndex', 'delegation', 'realtimeUpdate', 'id'].includes(key)) {
                        let val: any = row[i];
                        if (key === 'start' || key === 'finish') val = parseCSVDate(val);
                        else if (key === 'delegation' || key === 'realtimeUpdate') {
                          const strVal = String(val || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                          val = (strVal === 'true' || strVal === '1' || strVal === 'yes' || strVal === 'on');
                        } else if (key === 'projectYear') {
                          val = isNaN(Number(val)) ? val : Number(val);
                        }
                        t[key] = val;
                      }
                    });
                    if (!t.projectCode || !t.name) return null;
                    return t;
                  }}
                  onRecordSave={(record, batch) => {
                     if (record.delegation) {
                        const now = new Date().toISOString();
                        const dateStr = now.substring(0, 10);
                        const activeUser = useAppStore.getState().currentUser || currentUser;
                        const activeUserId = activeUser?.id && activeUser.id !== 'guest' ? activeUser.id : (activeUser?.username || 'system');
                        const rawParty = (record.party && record.party.trim()) ? record.party.trim() : '';
                        const parsedParty = rawParty.split(/[,;/+]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[0] || rawParty;
                        const deterministicGroupId = `del_${record.id}`;

                        if (parsedParty) {
                          const newGroup = {
                            id: deterministicGroupId,
                            parentTaskId: record.id,
                            name: record.name || 'Delegated Task',
                            projectCode: record.projectCode,
                            projectStore: record.projectStore,
                            projectYear: (record.projectYear !== undefined && record.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(record.projectYear))) ? Number(record.projectYear) : (Number(projects.find(p => p.code === record.projectCode)?.year) || new Date().getFullYear()),
                            subTasks: [{ 
                               id: generateId(), 
                               name: '', 
                               comments: '', 
                               status: 'Assigned', 
                               delegationStatus: 'Assigned', 
                               priority: 'Mid', 
                               party: parsedParty, 
                               startAct: dateStr, 
                               finishAct: dateStr, 
                               updatedAt: now 
                            }],
                            updatedAt: now,
                            createdBy: activeUserId
                          };
                          const delRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', deterministicGroupId);
                          batch.set(delRef, newGroup, { merge: true });
                        }
                     }
                  }}
                  id="detail-full-import-tasks-btn"
                  hiddenBtn={true}
                />
              )}
              <button id="detail-export-tasks-btn" onClick={handleExportTasks} className="hidden" />
              <input id="detail-import-tasks-input" type="file" accept=".csv, .xlsx, .xls" onChange={handleImportTasks} className="hidden" />
            </div>
          </>
        )}
    </div>
  );
});

import { ChevronUp, ChevronDown, Maximize2, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { FastToggle } from './FastToggle';
import { EditableCell } from './EditableCell';
import { cleanDurationString } from '../../lib/taskImportService';
import { cn, formatDisplayDateMain, calculateDays, getTaskStatus, getActStatusPercent } from '../../lib/utils';

export interface DetailMobileTaskItemProps {
  task: Task;
  project: Project;
  groupTasks: Task[];
  index: number;
  taskCode: string;
  actStatus: { label: string; color: string };
  isFocused: boolean;
  canWrite: boolean;
  isProjectDelegationOn?: boolean;
  onEditTask: (t: Task, isReadOnly?: boolean, initialTab?: string) => void;
  handleMoveTask: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[], index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => void;
  handleUpdateTask: (task: Task, updates: Partial<Task>) => void;
  handleDeleteTask: (task: Task) => void;
}

export const DetailMobileTaskItem = memo(function DetailMobileTaskItem({
  task: t,
  project: p,
  groupTasks,
  index: i,
  taskCode,
  actStatus,
  isFocused,
  canWrite,
  isProjectDelegationOn,
  onEditTask,
  handleMoveTask,
  handleUpdateTask,
  handleDeleteTask
}: DetailMobileTaskItemProps) {
  const taskStatus = getTaskStatus(t.start, t.finish);

  let taskStatusColorClass = 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 font-bold';
  if (taskStatus === 'Completed') {
    taskStatusColorClass = 'bg-emerald-600 text-white dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:text-white border-emerald-500 font-extrabold shadow-2xs';
  } else if (taskStatus === 'On process') {
    taskStatusColorClass = 'bg-amber-500 text-white dark:bg-amber-500 dark:text-white border-amber-400 font-extrabold shadow-2xs';
  }

  const delStatusText = actStatus?.label || 'Pending';
  const delStatusColorClass = actStatus?.color || 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-600';

  const showActStatus = Boolean(isProjectDelegationOn && t.delegation);

  const taskBorderAccent = taskStatus === 'Completed' 
    ? 'border-l-[4px] border-l-emerald-500' 
    : taskStatus === 'On process' 
    ? 'border-l-[4px] border-l-amber-500' 
    : 'border-l-[4px] border-l-slate-400';

  return (
    <div 
      id={`detail-task-${t.id}`} 
      style={{ contentVisibility: 'auto', containIntrinsicSize: '120px' }}
      className={cn(
        "bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-[#252528] rounded-xl p-3 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-[#444446] text-sm shadow-xs flex flex-col gap-2.5 transition-all", 
        taskBorderAccent,
        isFocused ? "ring-2 ring-inset ring-yellow-400 !bg-yellow-50 dark:!bg-yellow-900/20" : ""
      )} 
      onClick={() => canWrite && onEditTask(t, false, "chat")}
    >
      <div className="flex gap-3">
        {canWrite && (
          <div className="shrink-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center -mr-1">
            <button
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleMoveTask(p, groupTasks, i, 'up'); }}
              disabled={i === 0}
              className="p-1 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8] disabled:opacity-20 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed touch-manipulation active:scale-95"
              title="Move Up"
            >
              <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleMoveTask(p, groupTasks, i, 'down'); }}
              disabled={i === groupTasks.length - 1}
              className="p-1 text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8] disabled:opacity-20 transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed touch-manipulation active:scale-95"
              title="Move Down"
            >
              <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex flex-col w-20 shrink-0 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] gap-1 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] pr-2">
          <div className="font-mono text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-bold">{formatDisplayDateMain(t.start)}</div>
          <div className="font-mono text-pink-700 dark:text-pink-400 font-bold">{formatDisplayDateMain(t.finish)}</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] mt-1">
            {canWrite ? (
              <EditableCell
                value={t.duration !== undefined && t.duration !== null ? t.duration : calculateDays(t.start, t.finish).replace('d', '')}
                type="number"
                className="text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] font-mono font-medium text-[10px] px-0.5 py-0"
                onSave={(val) => {
                  const cleanVal = cleanDurationString(val);
                  handleUpdateTask(t, { duration: cleanVal, durationManual: true });
                }}
                canWrite={canWrite}
              />
            ) : (
              <span className="italic">{t.duration !== undefined ? `${t.duration}d` : calculateDays(t.start, t.finish)}</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-grow flex flex-col gap-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold font-mono rounded bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800 shrink-0 inline-block">
              {taskCode || t.taskCodePhu || `${p.code}#${i + 1}`}
            </span>
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#ffffff] text-sm leading-snug">
              {t.name || '(Unnamed Task)'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-medium">{t.party || ''}</span>
              {t.predecessor && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800">
                  Pred: {t.predecessor}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <FastToggle value={Boolean(t.delegation)} canWrite={canWrite} onToggle={(val) => handleUpdateTask(t, { delegation: val })} />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <div className="flex justify-between items-end pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] mt-1">
        <div className="flex gap-3 items-center">
          <button 
            onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onEditTask(t, false, "chat"); }} 
            className="text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] transition-colors touch-manipulation active:scale-95" 
            title="Open Task Modal"
          >
            <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          {canWrite && (
            <button 
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleDeleteTask(t); }} 
              className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/20 transition-colors touch-manipulation active:scale-95"
              title="Delete Task"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 items-end">
          <div className={`text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border ${taskStatusColorClass}`}>
            Pl: {taskStatus}
          </div>
          {showActStatus && (
            <div className={`text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border ${delStatusColorClass}`}>
              Act: {delStatusText} ({getActStatusPercent(delStatusText)}%)
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});
