import React, { memo, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Plus, ArrowDownUp, Maximize2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { QuickNavButton } from '../QuickNavButton';
import { DetailMobileTaskItem } from './DetailMobileTaskItem';
import { FastToggle } from './FastToggle';
import { 
  cn, 
  formatDisplayDateMain, 
  calculateDays, 
  computePlanProgressPercent, 
  computeActProgressPercent,
  computePlanProgressFromSummaries,
  computeActProgressFromSummaries,
  matchesAdvancedSearch,
  parseDateTime,
  getStatus
} from '../../lib/utils';

function parseStackedDate(dateStr: string | undefined): { month: string; day: string; year: string } | null {
  if (!dateStr) return null;
  const d = parseDateTime(dateStr);
  if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
  return {
    month: d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short' }),
    day: `${d.getDate()},`,
    year: String(d.getFullYear())
  };
}

interface DetailMobileViewProps {
  filteredProjects: Project[];
  expandedCodes: string[];
  setExpandedCodes: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  visibleCount: number;
  setVisibleCount: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
  projectInfoMap: Map<string, any>;
  getProjectInfo: (p: Project) => any;
  sortConfig: { key: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' } | null;
  delegationGroupByParentKey: Map<string, DelegationGroup>;
  initialFocusTaskId?: string;
  canWrite: boolean;
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  lowerSearchTerm: string;
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  toggleGroup: (id: string) => void;
  onEditProject?: (p: Project, isReadOnly?: boolean, initialTab?: string) => void;
  onAddTask: (p?: Project | null) => void;
  onEditTask: (t: Task, isReadOnly?: boolean, initialTab?: string) => void;
  handleUpdateProject: (p: Project, field: string, val: any) => void;
  handleMoveTask: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[], index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => void;
  handleUpdateTask: (task: Task, updates: Partial<Task>) => void;
  handleDeleteTask: (task: Task) => void;
  taskCodeMap?: Map<string, string>;
  taskActualStatusMap?: Map<string, { label: string; color: string }>;
  onSortSubTasks?: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[]) => void;
  onNavigateToDelegation?: (groupId: string, sourceTaskId?: string) => void;
}

export const DetailMobileView = memo(function DetailMobileView({
  filteredProjects,
  expandedCodes,
  setExpandedCodes,
  visibleCount,
  setVisibleCount,
  projectInfoMap,
  getProjectInfo,
  sortConfig,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  canWrite,
  lowerSearchTerm,
  delegationGroups,
  toggleGroup,
  onEditProject,
  onAddTask,
  onEditTask,
  handleUpdateProject,
  handleMoveTask,
  handleUpdateTask,
  handleDeleteTask,
  taskCodeMap,
  taskActualStatusMap,
  onSortSubTasks
}: DetailMobileViewProps) {
  const handleMobileScroll = useCallback((e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = e.currentTarget;
    const st = target.scrollTop;
    const sh = target.scrollHeight;
    const ch = target.clientHeight;

    if (sh - (st + ch) < 450) {
      if (visibleCount < filteredProjects.length) {
        setVisibleCount(prev => Math.min(prev + 25, filteredProjects.length));
      }
    }
  }, [visibleCount, filteredProjects.length, setVisibleCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!filteredProjects || filteredProjects.length === 0) return;
    const visibleSlice = filteredProjects.slice(0, visibleCount);
    const visibleIds = new Set<string>();
    for (const p of visibleSlice) {
      if (p.id) visibleIds.add(String(p.id));
      if (p.code) visibleIds.add(String(p.code));
    }
    const arr = Array.from(visibleIds).filter(Boolean);
    if (arr.length > 0) {
      useAppStore.getState().setVisibleActiveProjectIds(arr);
    }
  }, [filteredProjects, visibleCount]);

  return (
    <>
      <div className="xl:hidden flex justify-between items-center px-2 pb-2">
        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">Projects ({filteredProjects.length})</span>
        <button 
          onClick={() => setExpandedCodes(expandedCodes.length === 0 ? filteredProjects.map(p => String(p.id!)) : [])} 
          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-medium hover:text-blue-800 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          {expandedCodes.length === 0 ? (
            <><ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" /> Expand All</>
          ) : (
            <><ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" /> Collapse All</>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div 
        onScroll={handleMobileScroll}
        className="xl:hidden flex-grow overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-4 pb-16 px-2 bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-[#131314] overscroll-y-contain transition-colors"
      >
        {filteredProjects.slice(0, visibleCount).map((p) => {
          const pKey = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}-${p.id || p.no}`;
          const pInfo = projectInfoMap.get(pKey) || getProjectInfo(p);
          const rawSorted = pInfo.sortedTasks || [];
          const sortedTasks = rawSorted.filter((t: Task) => {
            if ((!t.name || !String(t.name).trim()) && (!t.start || !String(t.start).trim()) && (!t.finish || !String(t.finish).trim())) {
              return false;
            }
            return true;
          });
          const groupTasks = sortConfig ? [...sortedTasks].sort((a, b) => {
            if (!sortConfig) return 0;
            let valA = '';
            let valB = '';
            let direction = sortConfig.direction;
            if (sortConfig.key === 'start') {
              valA = a.start || '9999-12-31';
              valB = b.start || '9999-12-31';
            } else if (sortConfig.key === 'finish') {
              valA = a.finish || '9999-12-31';
              valB = b.finish || '9999-12-31';
            } else if (sortConfig.key === 'taskName') {
              valA = a.name || '';
              valB = b.name || '';
            } else if (sortConfig.key === 'duration') {
              const numA = Number(a.duration || '0');
              const numB = Number(b.duration || '0');
              if (numA < numB) return direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
              if (numA > numB) return direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
              return 0;
            }
            if (valA < valB) return direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
            if (valA > valB) return direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
            return 0;
          }) : sortedTasks;

          const computedTakStart = pInfo.computedTakStart || p.computedTakStart || p.start;
          const computedTakCompl = pInfo.computedTakCompl || p.computedTakCompl || p.handover;
          const computedOpening = p.computedOpening || p.opening;
          const rawStatus = pInfo.status || getStatus(computedTakStart, computedTakCompl, computedOpening, p.code) || p.mdStatus || (p as any).status;
          const status = (!rawStatus || rawStatus === '—' || rawStatus === '-') ? getStatus(computedTakStart, computedTakCompl, computedOpening, p.code) || 'On process' : rawStatus;
          const statusUpper = String(status || 'ON PROCESS').toUpperCase();
          
          let statusBadgeClass = 'bg-amber-500 text-white dark:bg-amber-500 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-amber-400';
          let borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-amber-500';
          let bgCardTint = 'bg-amber-50/30 dark:bg-amber-950/20';

          if (status === 'Completed' || statusUpper === 'COMPLETED') {
            statusBadgeClass = 'bg-emerald-600 text-white dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-emerald-500';
            borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-emerald-500';
            bgCardTint = 'bg-emerald-50/25 dark:bg-emerald-950/15';
          } else if (status === 'Handover' || statusUpper === 'HANDOVER') {
            statusBadgeClass = 'bg-blue-600 text-white dark:bg-blue-600 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-blue-500';
            borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-blue-500';
            bgCardTint = 'bg-blue-50/25 dark:bg-blue-950/15';
          } else if (status === 'On process' || statusUpper === 'ON PROCESS') {
            statusBadgeClass = 'bg-amber-500 text-white dark:bg-amber-500 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-amber-400';
            borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-amber-500';
            bgCardTint = 'bg-amber-50/30 dark:bg-amber-950/20';
          } else if (status === 'Canceled' || statusUpper === 'CANCELED') {
            statusBadgeClass = 'bg-rose-600 text-white dark:bg-rose-600 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-rose-500';
            borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-rose-500';
            bgCardTint = 'bg-rose-50/25 dark:bg-rose-950/15';
          } else {
            statusBadgeClass = 'bg-indigo-600 text-white dark:bg-indigo-600 dark:text-white shadow-2xs font-extrabold border-indigo-500';
            borderAccentClass = 'border-l-[5px] border-l-indigo-500';
            bgCardTint = 'bg-indigo-50/25 dark:bg-indigo-950/15';
          }

          const storeUpper = (p.store || '').toUpperCase();
          let storeBadgeClass = 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700';
          if (storeUpper === 'HCM') {
            storeBadgeClass = 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/80 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800 font-bold';
          } else if (storeUpper === 'HN') {
            storeBadgeClass = 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/80 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200/80 dark:border-rose-800 font-bold';
          }

          const effectiveTaskCount = groupTasks.length > 0 
            ? groupTasks.length 
            : (p.taskCount !== undefined 
                ? p.taskCount 
                : (p.taskSummaries?.length ?? 0));
          const isExpanded =
            expandedCodes.includes(String(p.id || '')) ||
            (p.code ? expandedCodes.includes(p.code) : false) ||
            (p.no !== undefined && p.no !== null ? expandedCodes.includes(String(p.no)) : false);

          const isProjectDelegationOn = groupTasks.some(t => Boolean(t.delegation)) || (p.taskSummaries?.some(ts => Boolean(ts.delegation)) ?? false);

          let planProgressPercent = 0;
          let actProgressPercent = 0;
          if (groupTasks.length > 0) {
            planProgressPercent = computePlanProgressPercent(groupTasks);
            actProgressPercent = computeActProgressPercent(groupTasks, delegationGroups);
          } else if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
            planProgressPercent = computePlanProgressFromSummaries(p.taskSummaries);
            actProgressPercent = computeActProgressFromSummaries(p.taskSummaries);
          } else {
            planProgressPercent = p.computedPlanProgress ?? 0;
            actProgressPercent = p.computedActProgress ?? 0;
          }

          const isProjectMatch = lowerSearchTerm
            ? matchesAdvancedSearch(lowerSearchTerm, [p.store, p.location, p.year, p.code, p.linkCodes, p.name, p.detail, (p as any).description, p.note, p.party])
            : true;
          const tasksToRender = isProjectMatch ? groupTasks : groupTasks.filter((t, idx) => {
            const taskFields = [
              t.taskCodePhu,
              `${p.code}#${(t.orderIndex !== undefined ? t.orderIndex : idx) + 1}`,
              t.name,
              t.duration,
              t.start,
              t.finish,
              t.party,
              formatDisplayDateMain(t.start),
              formatDisplayDateMain(t.finish)
            ];
            const notesFields = t.notes?.map(n => String(n.content || '')) || [];
            return matchesAdvancedSearch(lowerSearchTerm, [...taskFields, ...notesFields]);
          });

          return (
            <div 
              key={p.id || `${p.code}-${p.year}-${p.no}`} 
              id={`detail-project-${p.no ?? p.code}`}
              data-project-item="true"
              data-project-id={String(p.id || p.no || p.code)}
              data-project-code={p.code}
              data-project-year={p.year || ''}
              data-project-store={p.store || ''}
              className={cn(
                "mobile-card-optimized rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-[#38383b] shadow-xs hover:shadow-md p-3 flex flex-col gap-2.5 relative transition-all",
                bgCardTint,
                borderAccentClass
              )}
            >
              {/* Top controls: Badges & Link Codes on left, Program Status on right */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 w-full">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap min-w-0 flex-1">
                  {p.year && (
                    <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                      {p.year}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {p.store && (
                    <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] rounded border font-bold ${storeBadgeClass}`}>
                      {p.store}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold font-mono rounded bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800">
                    {p.code}
                  </span>
                  {p.linkCodes && p.linkCodes !== p.code && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-normal">
                      ({p.linkCodes})
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {p.location && (
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
                      • {p.location}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="shrink-0">
                  <div className={`text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border font-extrabold whitespace-nowrap shadow-2xs ${statusBadgeClass}`}>
                    {statusUpper === 'ON PROCESS' ? 'ON PROCESS' : (statusUpper === 'UPCOMING' ? 'UPCOMING' : (statusUpper === 'COMPLETED' ? 'COMPLETED' : statusUpper))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Project Title with Expand button on left & Quick Navigation on right (elevated on same line) */}
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 w-full">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2 flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => toggleGroup(p.id!)} 
                    className={cn(
                      "flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 mt-0.5 shrink-0 rounded text-white font-extrabold text-[10px] shadow-2xs transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer",
                      effectiveTaskCount > 0 
                        ? "bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-600 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500" 
                        : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-600 dark:hover:bg-blue-500"
                    )}
                    title={isExpanded ? "Collapse" : `Expand (${effectiveTaskCount})`}
                  >
                    {!isExpanded ? <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    <span>({effectiveTaskCount})</span>
                  </button>

                  <div 
                    onClick={() => onEditProject?.(p, !canWrite, "chat")}
                    className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#ffffff] text-sm sm:text-base leading-snug cursor-pointer hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-[#8ab4f8] transition-colors break-words flex-1 min-w-0"
                  >
                    {p.name}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Quick Navigation button placed on top right beneath status badge */}
                <div className="shrink-0 pt-0.5">
                  <QuickNavButton 
                    project={p}
                    className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 transition-colors shadow-2xs" 
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Project Dates & Metrics */}
              {(() => {
                const startParts = parseStackedDate(computedTakStart || p.start);
                const complParts = parseStackedDate(computedTakCompl || p.handover || p.opening);
                const displayParty = p.party || Array.from(new Set(groupTasks.map(t => t.party?.trim()).filter(Boolean))).join(', ');

                return (
                  <>
                    {/* Progress Bars (Plan Progress & Actual Progress) */}
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-slate-200/80 dark:border-[#38383b]">
                      {/* PLAN PRG */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full">
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-300 w-20 shrink-0">
                          PLAN PRG:
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex-1 h-2.5 sm:h-3 bg-slate-700/60 dark:bg-[#333336] rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                          <div 
                            className="h-full bg-blue-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
                            style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, planProgressPercent))}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-200 shrink-0 w-10 text-right">
                          {planProgressPercent}%
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* ACT PRG (Shown only if project delegation is green) */}
                      {isProjectDelegationOn && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full">
                          <span className="font-bold text-xs tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-300 w-20 shrink-0">
                            ACT PRG:
                          </span>
                          <div className="flex-1 h-2.5 sm:h-3 bg-slate-700/60 dark:bg-[#333336] rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                            <div 
                              className="h-full bg-emerald-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
                              style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, actProgressPercent))}%` }}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-200 shrink-0 w-10 text-right">
                            {actProgressPercent}%
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Divider */}
                    <div className="border-t border-slate-200/80 dark:border-[#38383b] my-0.5" />

                    {/* Controls Bar: Sort, Party, Toggle, Maximize, and Stacked Dates */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-0.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
                        {/* Sort Button */}
                        <button
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onSortSubTasks?.(p, groupTasks);
                          }}
                          className="px-2 py-1 rounded-md border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
                          title="Sort sub-tasks by Start Date"
                        >
                          <ArrowDownUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400" />
                          <span>Sort</span>
                        </button>

                        {/* Party / Contractor Tag */}
                        {displayParty ? (
                          <span 
                            className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-purple-500/80 dark:border-purple-500 bg-purple-100/60 dark:bg-purple-950/60 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap shadow-2xs"
                            title={`Party: ${displayParty}`}
                          >
                            {displayParty}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}

                        {/* Delegation Toggle Switch (Read-only status indicator) */}
                        <div className="flex items-center" title="Project delegation status (active when child tasks have delegation enabled)">
                          <FastToggle
                            value={isProjectDelegationOn}
                            canWrite={false}
                            readOnly={true}
                            onToggle={() => {}}
                            isSmall={true}
                          />
                        </div>

                        {/* Maximize Button */}
                        <button
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onEditProject?.(p, !canWrite, "chat");
                          }}
                          className="p-1 text-sky-500 hover:text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400 dark:hover:text-sky-300 rounded hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
                          title="Open Project Details"
                        >
                          <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      {/* Right side: Stacked Dates */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 sm:gap-4 shrink-0">
                        {startParts && (
                          <div 
                            className="flex flex-col items-center text-center font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm leading-tight text-blue-600 dark:text-sky-400 select-none"
                            title={`Start: ${formatDisplayDateMain(computedTakStart || p.start)}`}
                          >
                            <span>{startParts.month}</span>
                            <span>{startParts.day}</span>
                            <span>{startParts.year}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {complParts && (
                          <div 
                            className="flex flex-col items-center text-center font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm leading-tight text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400 select-none"
                            title={`Finish: ${formatDisplayDateMain(computedTakCompl || p.handover || p.opening)}`}
                          >
                            <span>{complParts.month}</span>
                            <span>{complParts.day}</span>
                            <span>{complParts.year}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </>
                );
              })()}

              {/* Sub-tasks section */}
              {isExpanded && (
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 mt-2" style={{ contain: 'layout' }}>
                  {tasksToRender.map((t, idx) => {
                    const taskCode = taskCodeMap?.get(t.id) || t.taskCodePhu || (p.code ? `${p.code}#${idx + 1}` : '');
                    const actStatus = taskActualStatusMap?.get(t.id) || { label: 'Pending', color: 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-600' };

                    return (
                      <DetailMobileTaskItem
                        key={t.id}
                        task={t}
                        project={p}
                        groupTasks={groupTasks}
                        index={idx}
                        taskCode={taskCode}
                        actStatus={actStatus}
                        isFocused={initialFocusTaskId === t.id}
                        canWrite={canWrite}
                        isProjectDelegationOn={isProjectDelegationOn}
                        onEditTask={onEditTask}
                        handleMoveTask={handleMoveTask}
                        handleUpdateTask={handleUpdateTask}
                        handleDeleteTask={handleDeleteTask}
                      />
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
              
              {canWrite && isExpanded && (
                <button 
                  onClick={() => onAddTask(p)}
                  className="mt-2 w-full py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] text-sm font-bold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] border-dashed flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors cursor-pointer touch-manipulation active:scale-95"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Add Task
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {visibleCount < filteredProjects.length && (
          <div className="py-6 flex justify-center w-full">
            <button 
              onClick={() => setVisibleCount(prev => Math.min(prev + 25, filteredProjects.length))}
              className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-full text-sm font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] shadow-sm hover:shadow hover:border-blue-300 dark:hover:border-blue-500 transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer touch-manipulation"
            >
              Load More Projects ({filteredProjects.length - visibleCount} remaining)
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/DetailProjectRow.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { cn, formatDisplayDateTime, calculateDays } from '../../lib/utils';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Plus, Trash2, Edit3, ArrowDownUp, GripVertical } from 'lucide-react';
import { DetailTableRow } from './detailTypes';
import { EditableCell } from './EditableCell';
import { FastToggle } from './FastToggle';
import { QuickNavButton } from '../QuickNavButton';
import { useIsRowFlashed } from '../../lib/changeFlashService';

interface DetailProjectRowProps {
  item: DetailTableRow & { type: 'project' };
  visibleColumns: string[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  isAllTasksSelected: boolean;
  allowedStoreOptions: { label: string; value: string }[];
  allowedLocationOptions: string[];
  onToggleGroup: (id: string) => void;
  onSelectAllTasksInProject: (groupTasks: Task[], select: boolean) => void;
  onUpdateProject: (p: Project, field: keyof Project, value: any) => Promise<void>;
  onSortSubTasks: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[]) => void;
  onEditProject: (p: Project) => void;
  onAddTask: (p: Project) => void;
  onDeleteProject: (p: Project) => void;
}

export const DetailProjectRow = React.memo(function DetailProjectRow({
  item,
  visibleColumns,
  canWrite,
  isAllTasksSelected,
  allowedStoreOptions,
  allowedLocationOptions,
  onToggleGroup,
  onSelectAllTasksInProject,
  onUpdateProject,
  onSortSubTasks,
  onEditProject,
  onAddTask,
  onDeleteProject,
}: DetailProjectRowProps) {
  const p = item.project;
  const isExpanded = item.isExpanded;
  const groupTasks = item.groupTasks;
  const effectiveTaskCount = item.effectiveTaskCount;
  const isProjDelegationOn = item.isProjDelegationOn;
  const planProgressPercent = item.planProgressPercent;
  const actProgressPercent = item.actProgressPercent;

  const computedStart = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (groupTasks && groupTasks.length > 0) {
      let minStart: string | undefined = undefined;
      for (const t of groupTasks) {
        if (t.start && (!minStart || t.start < minStart)) minStart = t.start;
      }
      if (minStart) return minStart;
    }
    return p.computedTakStart || p.start;
  }, [groupTasks, p.computedTakStart, p.start]);

  const computedFinish = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (groupTasks && groupTasks.length > 0) {
      let maxFinish: string | undefined = undefined;
      for (const t of groupTasks) {
        if (t.finish && (!maxFinish || t.finish > maxFinish)) maxFinish = t.finish;
      }
      if (maxFinish) return maxFinish;
    }
    return p.computedTakCompl || p.handover || p.opening;
  }, [groupTasks, p.computedTakCompl, p.handover, p.opening]);

  const computedDuration = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!computedStart || !computedFinish) return '-';
    return calculateDays(computedStart, computedFinish);
  }, [computedStart, computedFinish]);

  const { isFlashed } = useIsRowFlashed(p.id);

  return (
    <tr
      id={`detail-project-${p.no ?? p.code}`}
      data-project-item="true"
      data-project-id={String(p.id || p.no || p.code)}
      data-project-code={p.code}
      data-project-year={p.year || ''}
      data-project-store={p.store || ''}
      className={cn(
        "table-row-optimized border-b-2 border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] transition-all duration-700",
        item.projectIndex % 2 === 0 ? "bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/80" : "bg-blue-50/50 dark:bg-[#28282a]",
        isFlashed && "ring-2 ring-emerald-500/80 bg-emerald-50/90 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 z-10 shadow-sm"
      )}
    >
      {visibleColumns.includes('drag') && (
        <td className="px-2 py-2 text-center select-none w-8 text-slate-400">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200">
            <GripVertical size={14} />
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('checkbox') && (
        <td className="px-2 py-2 text-center select-none">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={isAllTasksSelected}
            onChange={(e) => onSelectAllTasksInProject(groupTasks, e.target.checked)}
            className="rounded text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 h-4 w-4 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border-slate-300 dark:border-[#444446]"
            title="Select all tasks in this project"
          />
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('no') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f5f5f7]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onToggleGroup(p.id!);
              }}
              className={cn(
                "px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white transition-all shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer font-semibold active:scale-95 touch-manipulation text-xs",
                isExpanded
                  ? "bg-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-600"
                  : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700"
              )}
              title={isExpanded ? "Collapse tasks" : `Expand tasks (${effectiveTaskCount})`}
            >
              {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              <span className="text-[10px]">({effectiveTaskCount})</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('year') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2">
          <EditableCell
            value={p.year}
            type="number"
            onSave={(val) => onUpdateProject(p, 'year', Number(val))}
            canWrite={canWrite}
          />
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('store') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2">
          <EditableCell
            value={p.store}
            type="select"
            options={allowedStoreOptions}
            className={cn(
              "font-bold",
              p.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hcm' 
                ? "text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]" 
                : p.store?.toLowerCase() === 'hn' 
                ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" 
                : "text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
            )}
            onSave={(val) => onUpdateProject(p, 'store', val)}
            canWrite={canWrite}
          />
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('location') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2">
          <EditableCell
            value={p.location}
            type="select"
            options={allowedLocationOptions}
            onSave={(val) => onUpdateProject(p, 'location', val)}
            canWrite={canWrite}
          />
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('code') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f5f5f7]">
          <EditableCell
            value={p.code}
            onSave={(val) => onUpdateProject(p, 'code', val)}
            canWrite={canWrite}
          />
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('projectName') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f5f5f7]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <EditableCell
              value={p.name}
              onSave={(val) => onUpdateProject(p, 'name', val)}
              canWrite={canWrite}
            />
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('taskName') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f5f5f7]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <EditableCell
              value={p.name}
              onSave={(val) => onUpdateProject(p, 'name', val)}
              canWrite={canWrite}
            />
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('duration') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] italic font-mono text-xs">
          {computedDuration}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('start') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-mono text-xs font-semibold">
          {formatDisplayDateTime(computedStart)}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('finish') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400 font-mono text-xs font-semibold">
          {formatDisplayDateTime(computedFinish)}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('planProgress') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <div className="w-12 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336] rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
              <div
                className="bg-blue-600 h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all"
                style={{ width: `${planProgressPercent}%` }}
              />
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
              {planProgressPercent}%
            </span>
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('actProgress') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2">
          {isProjDelegationOn ? (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <div className="w-12 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#333336] rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
                <div
                  className="bg-emerald-600 h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all"
                  style={{ width: `${actProgressPercent}%` }}
                />
              </div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
                {actProgressPercent}%
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-slate-400 font-mono text-xs">-</span>
          )}
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('predecessor') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-400">-</td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('party') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pr-1">
            <div className="flex-1 text-slate-400 text-xs">-</div>
            <FastToggle
              value={isProjDelegationOn}
              canWrite={false}
              readOnly={true}
              onToggle={() => {}}
              isSmall={true}
              title="Project delegation status (active when child tasks have delegation enabled)"
            />
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
      {visibleColumns.includes('action') && (
        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap">
            <QuickNavButton 
              project={p} 
              title={`Quick Navigator (${p.code})`} 
              className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-400 bg-transparent border-0 shadow-none"
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => onSortSubTasks(p, groupTasks)}
              className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Sort sub-tasks by Start Date"
            >
              <ArrowDownUp size={14} />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => onEditProject(p)}
              className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Edit Project"
            >
              <Edit3 size={14} />
            </button>
            {canWrite && (
              <button
                onClick={() => onAddTask(p)}
                className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded text-slate-500 hover:text-green-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Add Task to this Project"
              >
                <Plus size={14} />
              </button>
            )}
            {canWrite && (
              <button
                onClick={() => onDeleteProject(p)}
                className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded text-slate-500 hover:text-red-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Delete Project"
              >
                <Trash2 size={14} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </td>
      )}
    </tr>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/DetailTableHeader.tsx ==================== */
import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { ResizableHeader } from '../ResizableHeader';
import { Project } from '../../types';

export interface DetailTableHeaderProps {
  columnsWithWidths?: Array<{ id: string; label: string; width?: number }>;
  sortConfig: { key: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' } | null;
  onSort: (key: string) => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
  selectedTaskIds: Set<string>;
  allVisibleTaskIds: string[];
  onSelectAllVisibleTasks?: (select: boolean) => void;
  onResize: (col: string, width: number) => void;
  onResetWidth?: (col: string) => void;
  visibleColumns?: string[];
  colWidths?: Record<string, number>;
  expandedCodes?: string[];
  filteredProjects?: Project[];
  availableColumnsForUser?: { id: string; label: string }[];
  onToggleColumn?: (col: string) => void;
  onSelectAllChange?: (checked: boolean) => void;
  onToggleExpandAll?: () => void;
}

export const DetailTableHeader = memo(function DetailTableHeader({
  columnsWithWidths,
  visibleColumns,
  colWidths = {},
  canWrite,
  selectedTaskIds,
  allVisibleTaskIds,
  expandedCodes = [],
  sortConfig,
  onResize,
  onResetWidth: _onResetWidth,
  onToggleColumn,
  onSort,
  onSelectAllChange,
  onToggleExpandAll,
  onSelectAllVisibleTasks
}: DetailTableHeaderProps) {
  const isAllSelected = selectedTaskIds.size > 0 && selectedTaskIds.size === allVisibleTaskIds.length;
  const handleSelectAll = (checked: boolean) => {
    if (onSelectAllVisibleTasks) onSelectAllVisibleTasks(checked);
    if (onSelectAllChange) onSelectAllChange(checked);
  };

  // If columnsWithWidths is provided, render dynamically
  if (columnsWithWidths && columnsWithWidths.length > 0) {
    return (
      <thead className="sticky top-0 z-20 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] uppercase bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-xs">
        <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] sticky top-0 z-20">
          {columnsWithWidths.map((col) => {
            if (col.id === 'checkbox') {
              return (
                <th
                  key="checkbox"
                  style={{ width: col.width || 40 }}
                  className="px-2 py-3 text-center select-none bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]"
                >
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    title="Select All Visible Tasks"
                    onChange={(e) => handleSelectAll(e.target.checked)}
                    checked={isAllSelected}
                    className="cursor-pointer rounded border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 h-4 w-4 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500"
                  />
                </th>
              );
            }

            const isSortable = col.id === 'start' || col.id === 'finish';
            const isSorted = sortConfig?.key === col.id;

            return (
              <ResizableHeader
                key={col.id}
                width={col.width || 100}
                onResize={(w) => onResize(col.id, w)}
                className={`px-4 py-3 font-bold select-none text-left ${isSortable ? 'cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors' : ''}`}
                onClick={isSortable ? () => onSort(col.id) : undefined}
                hideable={!!onToggleColumn}
                onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn(col.id) : undefined}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  {col.id === 'no' && canWrite && !columnsWithWidths.some(c => c.id === 'checkbox') && (
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      title="Select All Visible Tasks"
                      onChange={(e) => handleSelectAll(e.target.checked)}
                      checked={isAllSelected}
                      className="cursor-pointer rounded border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 mr-1"
                    />
                  )}
                  <span>
                    {col.label}
                    {isSorted && (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? ' ↑' : ' ↓')}
                  </span>
                  {col.id === 'no' && onToggleExpandAll && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={onToggleExpandAll}
                      className="p-0.5 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 rounded transition-colors text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] cursor-pointer ml-1"
                    >
                      {expandedCodes.length === 0 ? <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {col.id === 'party' && (
                    <div className="ml-1 inline-flex items-center">
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] normal-case leading-none mr-1">deleg</span>
                      <div className="relative inline-flex h-3 w-5 items-center rounded-full bg-green-500">
                        <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 transform translate-x-2.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </ResizableHeader>
            );
          })}
        </tr>
      </thead>
    );
  }

  // Fallback to visibleColumns rendering
  const visCols = visibleColumns || [];
  return (
    <thead className="sticky top-0 z-20 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] uppercase bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-xs">
      <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] sticky top-0 z-20">
        {visCols.includes('checkbox') && (
          <th className="px-2 py-3 w-10 text-center select-none bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
            <input 
              type="checkbox" 
              title="Select All Visible Tasks"
              onChange={(e) => handleSelectAll(e.target.checked)}
              checked={isAllSelected}
              className="cursor-pointer rounded border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 h-4 w-4 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500"
            />
          </th>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('no') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.no || 60} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('no', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold text-center" 
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('no') : undefined}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
              {canWrite && !visCols.includes('checkbox') && (
                <input 
                  type="checkbox" 
                  title="Select All Visible Tasks"
                  onChange={(e) => handleSelectAll(e.target.checked)}
                  checked={isAllSelected}
                  className="cursor-pointer rounded border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 mr-1"
                />
              )}
              No.
              {onToggleExpandAll && (
                <button 
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onToggleExpandAll} 
                  className="p-0.5 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 rounded transition-colors text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {expandedCodes.length === 0 ? <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('year') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.year || 80} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('year', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold" 
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('year') : undefined}
          >
            Year
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('store') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.store || 80} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('store', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold" 
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('store') : undefined}
          >
            Store
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('location') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.location || 90} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('location', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold" 
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('location') : undefined}
          >
            Location
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('code') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.code || 90} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('code', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold" 
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('code') : undefined}
          >
            Code
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('projectName') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.projectName || 160} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('projectName', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold" 
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('projectName') : undefined}
          >
            Project Name
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('taskName') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.taskName || 180} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('taskName', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold" 
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('taskName') : undefined}
          >
            Task Name
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('duration') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.duration || 70} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('duration', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold" 
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('duration') : undefined}
          >
            Duration
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('start') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.start || 110} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('start', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors" 
            onClick={() => onSort('start')}
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('start') : undefined}
          >
            Start (Plan) {sortConfig?.key === 'start' ? (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓') : ''}
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('finish') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.finish || 110} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('finish', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] transition-colors" 
            onClick={() => onSort('finish')}
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('finish') : undefined}
          >
            Finish (Plan) {sortConfig?.key === 'finish' ? (sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? '↑' : '↓') : ''}
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('predecessor') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.predecessor || 100} 
            onResize={(w) => onResize('predecessor', w)} 
            className="px-6 py-3 font-bold" 
            hideable={!!onToggleColumn} 
            onHide={onToggleColumn ? () => onToggleColumn('predecessor') : undefined}
          >
            Predecessor
          </ResizableHeader>
        )}
        {visCols.includes('party') && (
          <ResizableHeader 
            width={colWidths.party || 90}

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { DetailTableRow, SortConfig } from './detailTypes';
import { DetailTableHeader } from './DetailTableHeader';
import { DetailProjectRow } from './DetailProjectRow';
import { DetailTaskRow } from './DetailTaskRow';

export interface DetailTableViewProps {
  tableContainerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  handleTableScroll: (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
  totalTableWidth: number;
  effectiveVisibleColumns: string[];
  colWidths: Record<string, number>;
  canWrite: boolean;
  selectedTaskIds: Set<string>;
  allVisibleTaskIds: string[];
  expandedCodes: string[];
  setExpandedCodes: (codes: string[]) => void;
  filteredProjects: Project[];
  availableColumnsForUser: { id: string; label: string }[];
  sortConfig: SortConfig | null;
  onResize: (col: string, newWidth: number) => void;
  onToggleColumn: (colId: string) => void;
  onSort: (key: string) => void;
  setSelectedTaskIds: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Set<string>>>;
  paddingTop: number;
  paddingBottom: number;
  flatTableRows: DetailTableRow[];
  startIndex: number;
  endIndex: number;
  allowedStoreOptions: { label: string; value: string }[];
  allowedLocationOptions: string[];
  toggleGroup: (id: string) => void;
  handleSelectAllTasksInProject: (groupTasks: Task[], isSelected: boolean) => void;
  handleUpdateProject: (p: Project, field: keyof Project, val: any) => Promise<void>;
  handleSortSubTasks: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[]) => void;
  onEditProject?: (p: Project, isReadOnly?: boolean, initialTab?: string) => void;
  onAddTask: (p?: Project | null) => void;
  handleDeleteProject: (p: Project) => Promise<void>;
  taskActualStatusMap: Map<string, { label: string; color: string }>;
  taskCodeMap: Map<string, string>;
  childTasksCountMap?: Map<string, number>;
  draggingTaskIds: string[];
  dragOverTaskId: string | null;
  dropPosition: 'before' | 'after' | null;
  draggingTaskNames: string;
  initialFocusTaskId?: string;
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  handleToggleSelectTask: (taskId: string, shiftKey: boolean) => void;
  onEditTask: (t: Task, isReadOnly?: boolean, initialTab?: string) => void;
  handleUpdateTask: (t: Task, updates: Partial<Task>, options?: { skipPredecessorRecalc?: boolean; skipProjectRollup?: boolean }) => Promise<void>;
  handleMoveTask: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[], index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => Promise<void>;
  handleDeleteTask: (t: Task) => Promise<void>;
  handleDetailTaskDragStart: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  handleDetailTaskDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  handleDetailTaskDragLeave: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  handleDetailTaskDragEnd: (e: React.DragEvent) => void;
  handleDetailTaskDrop: (e: React.DragEvent, targetTask: Task, targetProject: Project) => Promise<void>;
  visibleCount: number;
  setVisibleCount: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
}

export const DetailTableView = memo(function DetailTableView({
  tableContainerRef,
  handleTableScroll,
  totalTableWidth,
  effectiveVisibleColumns,
  colWidths,
  canWrite,
  selectedTaskIds,
  allVisibleTaskIds,
  expandedCodes,
  setExpandedCodes,
  filteredProjects,
  availableColumnsForUser,
  sortConfig,
  onResize,
  onToggleColumn,
  onSort,
  setSelectedTaskIds,
  paddingTop,
  paddingBottom,
  flatTableRows,
  startIndex,
  endIndex,
  allowedStoreOptions,
  allowedLocationOptions,
  toggleGroup,
  handleSelectAllTasksInProject,
  handleUpdateProject,
  handleSortSubTasks,
  onEditProject,
  onAddTask,
  handleDeleteProject,
  taskActualStatusMap,
  taskCodeMap,
  childTasksCountMap,
  draggingTaskIds,
  dragOverTaskId,
  dropPosition,
  draggingTaskNames,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  tasks,
  projects,
  handleToggleSelectTask,
  onEditTask,
  handleUpdateTask,
  handleMoveTask,
  handleDeleteTask,
  handleDetailTaskDragStart,
  handleDetailTaskDragOver,
  handleDetailTaskDragLeave,
  handleDetailTaskDragEnd,
  handleDetailTaskDrop,
  visibleCount,
  setVisibleCount
}: DetailTableViewProps) {
  return (
    <div className="hidden xl:block flex-grow pb-16">
      <div 
        ref={tableContainerRef}
        onScroll={handleTableScroll}
        className="overflow-auto border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-xs bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20]"
        style={{ height: "calc(100vh - 210px)", minHeight: "520px" }}
      >
        <table 
          className="text-sm text-left text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] table-fixed min-w-full"
          style={{ width: `${totalTableWidth}px` }}
        >
          <DetailTableHeader
            visibleColumns={effectiveVisibleColumns}
            colWidths={colWidths}
            canWrite={canWrite}
            selectedTaskIds={selectedTaskIds}
            allVisibleTaskIds={allVisibleTaskIds}
            expandedCodes={expandedCodes}
            filteredProjects={filteredProjects}
            availableColumnsForUser={availableColumnsForUser}
            sortConfig={sortConfig}
            onResize={onResize}
            onToggleColumn={onToggleColumn}
            onSort={onSort}
            onSelectAllChange={(checked) => {
              if (checked) {
                setSelectedTaskIds(new Set(allVisibleTaskIds));
              } else {
                setSelectedTaskIds(new Set());
              }
            }}
            onToggleExpandAll={() => setExpandedCodes(expandedCodes.length === 0 ? filteredProjects.map(p => String(p.id!)) : [])}
          />
          <tbody>
            {paddingTop > 0 && (
              <tr style={{ height: `${paddingTop}px` }}>
                <td colSpan={effectiveVisibleColumns.length} style={{ padding: 0, border: 'none' }} />
              </tr>
            )}
            {flatTableRows.slice(startIndex, endIndex).map((item) => {
              if (item.type === "project") {
                const groupTasks = item.groupTasks;
                const isAllTasksSelected = groupTasks.length > 0 && groupTasks.every(t => selectedTaskIds.has(t.id));
                return (
                  <DetailProjectRow
                    key={item.key}
                    item={item}
                    visibleColumns={effectiveVisibleColumns}
                    canWrite={canWrite}
                    isAllTasksSelected={isAllTasksSelected}
                    allowedStoreOptions={allowedStoreOptions}
                    allowedLocationOptions={allowedLocationOptions}
                    onToggleGroup={toggleGroup}
                    onSelectAllTasksInProject={handleSelectAllTasksInProject}
                    onUpdateProject={handleUpdateProject}
                    onSortSubTasks={handleSortSubTasks}
                    onEditProject={onEditProject || (() => {})}
                    onAddTask={onAddTask}
                    onDeleteProject={handleDeleteProject}
                  />
                );
              }
              const t = item.task;
              const actStatus = taskActualStatusMap.get(t.id) || { label: 'Pending', color: 'bg-slate-50 text-slate-600' };
              const childCount = (childTasksCountMap?.get(t.id) || 0) + (t.taskCodePhu && t.taskCodePhu !== t.id ? (childTasksCountMap?.get(t.taskCodePhu) || 0) : 0);
              return (
                <DetailTaskRow
                  key={item.key}
                  item={item}
                  visibleColumns={effectiveVisibleColumns}
                  canWrite={canWrite}
                  isSelected={selectedTaskIds.has(t.id)}
                  isDragging={draggingTaskIds.includes(t.id)}
                  isDragOver={dragOverTaskId === t.id}
                  dropPosition={dragOverTaskId === t.id ? dropPosition : null}
                  draggingTaskNames={draggingTaskNames}
                  taskCode={taskCodeMap.get(t.id) || ''}
                  isFocused={initialFocusTaskId === t.id}
                  delStatusText={actStatus.label}
                  delStatusColorClass={actStatus.color}
                  childTasksCount={childCount}
                  onToggleSelectTask={handleToggleSelectTask}
                  onEditTask={onEditTask}
                  onUpdateTask={handleUpdateTask}
                  onMoveTask={handleMoveTask}
                  onDeleteTask={handleDeleteTask}
                  onDragStart={handleDetailTaskDragStart}
                  onDragOver={handleDetailTaskDragOver}
                  onDragLeave={handleDetailTaskDragLeave}
                  onDragEnd={handleDetailTaskDragEnd}
                  onDrop={handleDetailTaskDrop}
                />
              );
            })}
            {paddingBottom > 0 && (
              <tr style={{ height: `${paddingBottom}px` }}>
                <td colSpan={effectiveVisibleColumns.length} style={{ padding: 0, border: 'none' }} />
              </tr>
            )}
            {visibleCount < filteredProjects.length && (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={effectiveVisibleColumns.length} className="py-4 text-center bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/90 backdrop-blur-sm border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446]">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setVisibleCount(prev => Math.min(prev + 30, filteredProjects.length))}
                    className="px-6 py-2 bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-full shadow-xs transition-colors text-sm cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
                  >
                    Load More Projects ({filteredProjects.length - visibleCount} remaining)
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

import React from 'react';

import { FastToggle } from './FastToggle';

interface DetailTaskRowProps {
  item: DetailTableRow & { type: 'task' };
  visibleColumns: string[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  isSelected: boolean;
  isDragging: boolean;
  isDragOver: boolean;
  dropPosition: 'before' | 'after' | null;
  draggingTaskNames: string;
  taskCode: string;
  isFocused: boolean;
  delStatusText: string;
  delStatusColorClass: string;
  childTasksCount: number;
  tasks?: Task[];
  projects?: Project[];
  onToggleSelectTask: (id: string, shiftKey: boolean) => void;
  onEditTask: (t: Task) => void;
  onUpdateTask: (t: Task, updates: Partial<Task>) => Promise<void>;
  onMoveTask: (p: Project, groupTasks: Task[], index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => Promise<void>;
  onDeleteTask: (t: Task) => void;
  onDragStart: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  onDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  onDragLeave: (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => void;
  onDragEnd: (e: React.DragEvent) => void;
  onDrop: (e: React.DragEvent, targetTask: Task, targetProject: Project) => Promise<void>;
}

export const DetailTaskRow = React.memo(function DetailTaskRow({

}: DetailTaskRowProps) {

      className={cn(

      )}

            )}
            <span className="font-semibold">{i + 1}</span>
            {childTasksCount > 0 && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/90 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-200 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-600 shadow-2xs flex items-center gap-0.5 leading-none" title={`${childTasksCount} task con`}>

            )}

      )}

          )}

      )}
    </tr>
