/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/EditableCell.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { formatDisplayDateTime, getDefaultDatetimeLocal, cn } from '../../lib/utils';

export const EditableCell = React.memo(function EditableCell({ 
  value, 
  type = 'text', 
  options, 
  onSave, 
  canWrite, 
  isDate = false,
  listId,
  className
}: { 
  value: any, 
  type?: string, 
  options?: ({label: string, value: string} | string)[], 
  onSave: (val: any) => void, 
  canWrite: boolean, 
  isDate?: boolean,
  listId?: string,
  className?: string
}) {
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [val, setVal] = useState(value !== undefined && value !== null ? value : '');
  // Đang gõ thì KHÔNG cho dữ liệu từ store/server ghi đè ô (chống "giật ngược" khi đang nhập)
  const editingRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editingRef.current) return;
    setVal(value !== undefined && value !== null ? value : '');
  }, [value]);

  const finishEditing = () => {
    editingRef.current = false;
    setIsEditing(false);
  };

  const handleBlur = () => {
    finishEditing();
    if (type === 'number') {
      const parsed = Number(String(val).replace(',', '.').trim());
      if (Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
        // Nhập sai định dạng số: trả về giá trị cũ, không lưu
        setVal(value !== undefined && value !== null ? value : '');
        return;
      }
      if (parsed !== value) onSave(parsed);
      return;
    }
    if (val !== value) {
      onSave(val);
    }
  };

  const handleEditClick = () => {
    editingRef.current = true;
    setIsEditing(true);
    if (isDate && (!val || val === '')) {
      setVal(getDefaultDatetimeLocal());
    }
  };

  if (!canWrite) {
    return <span className={className}>{isDate ? formatDisplayDateTime(value) : (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '' ? value : '-')}</span>;
  }

  if (isEditing) {
    if (type === 'select') {
      return (
        <select
          autoFocus
          value={val}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setVal(e.target.value);
            finishEditing();
            if (e.target.value !== value) {
              onSave(e.target.value);
            }
          }}
          onBlur={finishEditing}
          className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-400 rounded px-1 py-0.5 outline-none text-inherit font-inherit text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
        >
          <option value="">-</option>
          {options?.map(opt => {
            const optVal = typeof opt === 'string' ? opt : opt.value;
            const optLbl = typeof opt === 'string' ? opt : opt.label;
            return <option key={optVal} value={optVal}>{optLbl}</option>;
          })}
        </select>
      );
    }

    return (
      <input
        autoFocus
        type={type === 'number' ? 'text' : type}
        value={val}
        {...(type === 'number' ? { inputMode: 'decimal' } : {})}
        onChange={(e) => setVal(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={handleBlur}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter') e.currentTarget.blur();
          if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            setVal(value !== undefined && value !== null ? value : '');
            finishEditing();
          }
        }}
        list={listId}
        className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-400 rounded px-1 py-0.5 outline-none text-inherit font-inherit text-slate-900 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]"
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div 
      onClick={handleEditClick} 
      className={cn(
        "cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] px-1 py-0.5 rounded border border-transparent hover:border-slate-200 min-h-[24px] break-words whitespace-normal",
        className
      )}
    >
      {isDate ? formatDisplayDateTime(value) : (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '' ? value : '-')}
    </div>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/FastToggle.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

export const FastToggle = ({
  value,
  canWrite,
  onToggle,
  isSmall = false,
  readOnly = false,
  title,
}: {
  value: boolean;
  canWrite: boolean;
  onToggle: (val: boolean) => void;
  isSmall?: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  title?: string;
}) => {
  const [localVal, setLocalVal] = React.useState(value);
  React.useEffect(() => { setLocalVal(value); }, [value]);
  
  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (readOnly || !canWrite) return;
    const newVal = !localVal;
    setLocalVal(newVal); // Optimistically update local state immediately
    
    // Yield to the browser so the CSS animation starts smoothly before any heavy re-renders
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        onToggle(newVal); // Trigger parent update
      }, 0);
    });
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleClick}
      disabled={readOnly || !canWrite}
      title={title}
      className={cn(
        "relative inline-flex items-center rounded-full transition-colors focus:outline-none shrink-0",
        isSmall ? "h-3.5 w-6" : "h-4 w-7",
        localVal ? "bg-green-500" : "bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700",
        readOnly ? "cursor-default" : (!canWrite && "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed")
      )}
    >
      <span
        className={cn(
          "inline-block transform rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] transition-transform",
          isSmall ? "h-2.5 w-2.5" : "h-3 w-3",
          localVal ? (isSmall ? "translate-x-3" : "translate-x-3.5") : "translate-x-0.5"
        )}
      />
    </button>
  );
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/PredecessorEditableCell.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { Plus, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { PredecessorSearchSuggest, PredecessorChange } from '../TaskModalParts/PredecessorSearchSuggest';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { splitPredecessors } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { parsePredecessorToken } from '../../lib/predecessorMatchUtils';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

type PanelLayout =
  | { mode: 'sheet' }
  | { mode: 'pop'; left: number; width: number; maxH: number; top?: number; bottom?: number };

const CHIP_STYLE = [
  'border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:border-blue-800/60 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]',
  'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:border-rose-800/60 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300',
];

export const PredecessorEditableCell = React.memo(function PredecessorEditableCell({
  value,
  onSave,
  canWrite,
  task,
}: {
  value: any;
  onSave: (updates: Partial<Task>) => void | Promise<void>;
  canWrite: boolean;
  task: Task;
  // giữ nguyên chữ ký cũ để không phải sửa nơi gọi
  tasks?: Task[];
  projects?: Project[];
}) {
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [layout, setLayout] = useState<PanelLayout | null>(null);
  const anchorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const text = value !== undefined && value !== null ? String(value) : '';
  const tokens = useMemo(() => splitPredecessors(text), [text]);

  /* ----- Vị trí khung chỉnh sửa (popover trên máy tính / bottom-sheet trên điện thoại) ----- */
  const computeLayout = useCallback(() => {
    const el = anchorRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const vw = window.innerWidth;
    const vh = window.innerHeight;
    if (vw < 640) {
      setLayout({ mode: 'sheet' });
      return;
    }
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const width = Math.min(400, vw - 16);
    const left = Math.max(8, Math.min(r.left, vw - width - 8));
    const spaceBelow = vh - r.bottom - 8;
    const spaceAbove = r.top - 8;
    if (spaceBelow >= 360 || spaceBelow >= spaceAbove) {
      setLayout({ mode: 'pop', left, width, top: r.bottom + 4, maxH: Math.max(240, spaceBelow - 4) });
    } else {
      setLayout({ mode: 'pop', left, width, bottom: vh - r.top + 4, maxH: Math.max(240, spaceAbove - 4) });
    }
  }, []);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditing) return;
    computeLayout();
    window.addEventListener('resize', computeLayout);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', computeLayout, true);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', computeLayout);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', computeLayout, true);
    };
  }, [isEditing, computeLayout]);

  /* ----- Đóng khi bấm ra ngoài / nhấn Escape ----- */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditing) return;
    const onDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node;
      if (panelRef.current?.contains(target) || anchorRef.current?.contains(target)) return;
      setIsEditing(false);
    };
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setIsEditing(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    };
  }, [isEditing]);

  const handleChange = async (c: PredecessorChange) => {
    await onSave({
      predecessor: c.predecessor,
      predecessorTaskIds: c.predecessorTaskIds,
      predecessors: c.predecessors,
    } as Partial<Task>);
  };

  /* ----- Hiển thị dạng thẻ dễ đọc ----- */
  const chips =
    tokens.length > 0 ? (
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
        {tokens.slice(0, 2).map((tok, i) => {
          const { query, suffix } = parsePredecessorToken(tok);
          return (
            <span
              key={`${tok}-${i}`}
              title={tok}
              className={cn(
                'inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1 rounded-md border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px]',
                CHIP_STYLE[i] || CHIP_STYLE[1]
              )}
            >
              <b className="truncate font-mono">{query || tok}</b>
              {suffix && (
                <span className="shrink-0 rounded bg-white/70 px-1 font-mono text-[10px] font-extrabold dark:bg-black/30">
                  {suffix.replace(/^(FS|SS|FF|SF)?([+-])(\d.*)$/i, (_m, r, sg, n) => `${r || ''} ${sg === '-' ? '−' : '+'}${n}d`).trim()}
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    ) : null;

  if (!canWrite) {
    return chips ? <div className="w-full">{chips}</div> : <span className="text-slate-400">-</span>;
  }

  const panelContent = (
    <>
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-400">Predecessor</div>
          <div className="truncate text-[13px] font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#f3f3f3]">{task?.name}</div>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsEditing(false)}
          className="inline-flex min-h-[40px] shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 px-3.5 text-[12px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm hover:bg-blue-700 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
        >
          <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Xong
        </button>
      </div>
      <PredecessorSearchSuggest task={task} canWrite={canWrite} onChange={handleChange} />
    </>
  );

  return (
    <>
      <div
        ref={anchorRef}
        role="button"
        tabIndex={0}
        onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
            e.preventDefault();
            setIsEditing(true);
          }
        }}
        className={cn(
          'group flex min-h-[32px] w-full cursor-pointer items-center rounded-md px-0.5 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#202023]',
          isEditing && 'bg-blue-50/60 ring-1 ring-blue-300 dark:bg-blue-950/20 dark:ring-blue-700'
        )}
      >
        {chips || (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md border border-dashed border-slate-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-400 group-hover:border-blue-400 group-hover:text-blue-500 dark:border-slate-600 dark:text-slate-500">
            <Plus className="h-3 w-3" /> Thêm
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {isEditing &&
        layout &&
        createPortal(
          layout.mode === 'sheet' ? (
            <>
              <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[190] bg-black/40" onClick={() => setIsEditing(false)} />
              <div
                ref={panelRef}
                role="dialog"
                className="fixed inset-x-2 bottom-2 z-[200] max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 pb-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] shadow-2xl dark:border-[#444446] dark:bg-[#1c1c1f]"
              >
                {panelContent}
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div
              ref={panelRef}
              role="dialog"
              className="fixed z-[200] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-2xl dark:border-[#444446] dark:bg-[#1c1c1f]"
              style={{
                left: layout.left,
                width: layout.width,
                maxHeight: layout.maxH,
                ...(layout.top !== undefined ? { top: layout.top } : {}),
                ...(layout.bottom !== undefined ? { bottom: layout.bottom } : {}),
              }}
            >
              {panelContent}
            </div>
          ),
          document.body
        )}
    </>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/detailCsvUtils.ts ==================== */
export const formatToCSVDate = (isoString: string | undefined): string => {
  if (!isoString) return '';
  const d = new Date(isoString);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return isoString;
  const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const year = d.getFullYear();
  const hour = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const minute = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${month}/${day}/${year} ${hour}:${minute}`;
};

export const parseCSVDate = (csvDate: any): string => {
  if (!csvDate) return '';
  const str = String(csvDate).trim();
  if (str.includes('T')) return str;
  const parts = str.split(' ');
  if (parts.length >= 2) {
    const dateParts = parts[0].split(/[\/\-]/);
    const timeParts = parts[1].split(':');
    if (dateParts.length === 3 && timeParts.length >= 2) {
      if (dateParts[0].length === 4) {
        const year = dateParts[0];
        const month = dateParts[1].padStart(2, '0');
        const day = dateParts[2].padStart(2, '0');
        const hour = timeParts[0].padStart(2, '0');
        const minute = timeParts[1].padStart(2, '0');
        return `${year}-${month}-${day}T${hour}:${minute}`;
      }
      const month = dateParts[0].padStart(2, '0');
      const day = dateParts[1].padStart(2, '0');
      const year = dateParts[2];
      const hour = timeParts[0].padStart(2, '0');
      const minute = timeParts[1].padStart(2, '0');
      return `${year}-${month}-${day}T${hour}:${minute}`;
    }
  }
  return str;
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/detailTaskImportExecutor.ts ==================== */
import { Task, Project, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { undoManager } from '../../lib/undoManager';
import { formatToDatetimeLocal, getDefaultDatetimeLocal } from '../../lib/utils';
import { getTasksForProject, calculateProjectComputedDates, syncProjectDatesToFirestore } from '../../lib/projectDatesService';
import { 
  calculateDatesFromPredecessorsAndDuration, 
  rollupParentTaskDates, 
  batchSaveTasksToFirestore 
} from '../../lib/taskImportService';
import { healAllTasksPredecessors } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { findAffectedProjects } from '../../lib/taskStateService';
import { buildCanonicalProjectKey, normalizeTaskNameForComparison } from '../../lib/taskDeduplicationService';

interface ExecuteImportTasksParams {
  rawParsedRowsByProject: Map<string, Array<{ rowData: any; originalCsvIndex: number }>>;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
}

export async function executeImportTasks({
  rawParsedRowsByProject,
  projects,
  tasks,
  appUsers,
  currentUser
}: ExecuteImportTasksParams): Promise<{ count: number }> {
  // Build fast multi-index maps for existing tasks
  const existingTasksById = new Map<string, Task>();
  const existingTasksByName = new Map<string, Task>();
  const existingTasksByNorm = new Map<string, Task>();
  const existingTasksByCode = new Map<string, Task>();

  tasks.forEach(tsk => {
    existingTasksById.set(tsk.id, tsk);
    const prjKey = buildCanonicalProjectKey(tsk.projectCode, tsk.projectYear, tsk.projectStore, projects);
    const pCode = String(tsk.projectCode || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (tsk.name) {
      const nameKey = `${prjKey}:::${String(tsk.name).trim().toLowerCase()}`;
      existingTasksByName.set(nameKey, tsk);
      const norm = normalizeTaskNameForComparison(tsk.name, tsk.projectCode);
      if (norm) {
        existingTasksByNorm.set(`${pCode}:::norm:::${norm}`, tsk);
      }
    }
    if (tsk.taskCodePhu) {
      const codeKey = `${pCode}:::code:::${String(tsk.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase()}`;
      existingTasksByCode.set(codeKey, tsk);
    }
  });

  const previousStates = new Map<string, any>();
  const newIds = new Set<string>();
  const tasksToImport: Task[] = [];
  const processedImportTasksMap = new Map<string, Task>();

  // Process rows project by project
  rawParsedRowsByProject.forEach((items, prjKey) => {
    const sortedItems = [...items].sort((a, b) => {
      const codeA = String(a.rowData.taskCodePhu || '').trim();
      const codeB = String(b.rowData.taskCodePhu || '').trim();
      const numMatchA = codeA.match(/-(\d+)$/);
      const numMatchB = codeB.match(/-(\d+)$/);
      if (numMatchA && numMatchB) {
        const numA = parseInt(numMatchA[1], 10);
        const numB = parseInt(numMatchB[1], 10);
        if (numA !== numB) return numA - numB;
      } else if (codeA && codeB) {
        const comp = codeA.localeCompare(codeB, undefined, { numeric: true });
        if (comp !== 0) return comp;
      } else if (codeA && !codeB) {
        return -1;
      } else if (!codeA && codeB) {
        return 1;
      }

      if (a.rowData.orderIndex !== undefined && b.rowData.orderIndex !== undefined && a.rowData.orderIndex !== '' && b.rowData.orderIndex !== '') {
        const ordA = Number(a.rowData.orderIndex);
        const ordB = Number(b.rowData.orderIndex);
        if (!isNaN(ordA) && !isNaN(ordB) && ordA !== ordB) return ordA - ordB;
      }
      return a.originalCsvIndex - b.originalCsvIndex;
    });

    sortedItems.forEach((item, index) => {
      const t = item.rowData;
      // Dùng index thực tế của dòng trong file CSV để đánh số lại, đảm bảo không nhảy cóc
      const taskOrderIndex = index; 
      const exactProjectCode = String(t.projectCode || '').trim();
      
      // Ép buộc tạo Subtask code: Lấy tuyệt đối Project Code + # + (Thứ tự dòng + 1)
      const taskCodePhu = `${exactProjectCode}#${taskOrderIndex + 1}`;

      const canonicalPrjKey = buildCanonicalProjectKey(t.projectCode, t.projectYear, t.projectStore, projects);
      const pCode = exactProjectCode.toLowerCase();
      const rawName = String(t.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const normName = normalizeTaskNameForComparison(t.name, t.projectCode);
      const nameKey = `${canonicalPrjKey}:::${rawName}`;
      const normKey = `${pCode}:::norm:::${normName}`;
      const codeKey = `${pCode}:::code:::${String(taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase()}`;

      // Match against existing tasks in priority:
      // 1. Matched in current import batch (by exact name, norm name, or code)
      // 2. By ID
      // 3. By exact project + name
      // 4. By normalized project + name
      // 5. By project + taskCodePhu
      let existing: Task | undefined = processedImportTasksMap.get(nameKey) ||
                                       (normName ? processedImportTasksMap.get(normKey) : undefined) ||
                                       (taskCodePhu ? processedImportTasksMap.get(codeKey) : undefined);
      if (!existing && t.id) {
        existing = existingTasksById.get(t.id);
      }
      if (!existing && nameKey) {
        existing = existingTasksByName.get(nameKey);
      }
      if (!existing && normKey) {
        existing = existingTasksByNorm.get(normKey);
      }
      if (!existing && taskCodePhu) {
        existing = existingTasksByCode.get(codeKey);
      }

      const id = existing ? existing.id : `t_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}_${tasksToImport.length}`;

      if (existing) {
        if (!previousStates.has(id)) {
          previousStates.set(id, existing);
        }
      } else {
        newIds.add(id);
      }

      let updatedComments = existing?.comments ? [...existing.comments] : [];
      if (t.importComment !== undefined) {
        const importedCommentText = String(t.importComment).trim();
        if (importedCommentText === '[DELETE]' || importedCommentText === '[CLEAR]') {
          updatedComments = [];
        } else if (importedCommentText) {
          const existingText = updatedComments.map(c => {
            const author = appUsers.find(u => 
              u.id === c.userId || 
              (u.username && String(u.username).toLowerCase() === String(c.userId).toLowerCase())
            );
            const name = c.userName || author?.username || c.userId || '';
            return `${name ? name + ': ' : ''}${c.text}`;
          }).join(' | ');

          if (importedCommentText !== existingText) {
            const activeUser = useAppStore.getState().currentUser || currentUser;
            const activeUserId = activeUser?.id && activeUser.id !== 'guest' ? activeUser.id : (activeUser?.username || 'system');
            const activeUserName = (activeUser?.username && activeUser.username !== 'Guest') ? activeUser.username : (activeUser?.name || activeUser?.email || 'User');

            let commentText = importedCommentText;
            let commentUserId = activeUserId;
            let commentUserName = activeUserName;
            const prefixMatch = importedCommentText.match(/^([^:\n]+):\s*(.+)$/s);
            if (prefixMatch) {
              const potentialName = prefixMatch[1].trim();
              const potentialText = prefixMatch[2].trim();
              const matchedUser = appUsers.find(u => 
                (u.username && u.username.toLowerCase() === potentialName.toLowerCase()) ||
                (u.id && u.id.toLowerCase() === potentialName.toLowerCase()) ||
                (u.email && u.email.toLowerCase() === potentialName.toLowerCase())
              );
              if (matchedUser) {
                commentUserId = matchedUser.id;
                commentUserName = matchedUser.username || potentialName;
                commentText = potentialText;
              }
            }

            updatedComments.push({
              id: `c_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`,
              text: commentText,
              createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              userId: commentUserId,
              userName: commentUserName
            });
          }
        }
      }
      delete t.importComment;

      if (!existing) {
        const defaultToday = getDefaultDatetimeLocal();
        if (!t.start) t.start = defaultToday;
        if (!t.finish) t.finish = t.start || defaultToday;
        if (!t.baselineStart) t.baselineStart = t.start || defaultToday;
        if (!t.baselineFinish) t.baselineFinish = t.finish || defaultToday;
        if (t.duration === undefined || t.duration === null || String(t.duration).trim() === '') {
          t.duration = "0";
        }
      }

      const finalTask: Task = existing
        ? {
            ...existing,
            ...t,
            id: existing.id,
            comments: updatedComments,
            orderIndex: taskOrderIndex,
            taskCodePhu,
            durationManual: true,
            finishManual: false,
            startManual: false,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          }
        : {
            ...t,
            id,
            comments: updatedComments,
            orderIndex: taskOrderIndex,
            taskCodePhu,
            durationManual: true,
            finishManual: false,
            startManual: false,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          };

      if (finalTask.start && finalTask.duration !== undefined && finalTask.duration !== '') {
        const s = new Date(finalTask.start);
        const days = parseFloat(String(finalTask.duration));
        if (!isNaN(s.getTime()) && !isNaN(days)) {
          const f = new Date(s.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
          finalTask.finish = formatToDatetimeLocal(f);
          finalTask.durationManual = true;
        }
      } else if (finalTask.start && finalTask.finish) {
        const s = new Date(finalTask.start);
        const f = new Date(finalTask.finish);
        if (!isNaN(s.getTime()) && !isNaN(f.getTime())) {
          const diffDays = (f.getTime() - s.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
          finalTask.duration = String(diffDays >= 0 ? Number(diffDays.toFixed(2)) : 0);
          finalTask.durationManual = true;
        }
      } else if (finalTask.start) {
        finalTask.duration = finalTask.duration || "0";
        finalTask.finish = finalTask.finish || finalTask.start;
        finalTask.durationManual = true;
      }

      // Register immediately into lookup maps to prevent duplicate tasks within same import
      processedImportTasksMap.set(nameKey, finalTask);
      if (normKey) processedImportTasksMap.set(normKey, finalTask);
      if (codeKey) processedImportTasksMap.set(codeKey, finalTask);
      existingTasksByName.set(nameKey, finalTask);
      if (normKey) existingTasksByNorm.set(normKey, finalTask);
      existingTasksByCode.set(codeKey, finalTask);
      existingTasksById.set(finalTask.id, finalTask);

      const existingIndex = tasksToImport.findIndex(tk => tk.id === finalTask.id);
      if (existingIndex >= 0) {
        tasksToImport[existingIndex] = finalTask;
      } else {
        tasksToImport.push(finalTask);
      }
    });
  });

  // Resolve parent-child hierarchy across imported tasks and existing tasks
  const lookupTaskMap = new Map<string, Task>();
  tasks.forEach(t => lookupTaskMap.set(t.id, t));
  tasksToImport.forEach(t => lookupTaskMap.set(t.id, t));

  tasksToImport.forEach(t => {
    let resolvedParentId: string | undefined = undefined;

    if (t.parentTaskId && lookupTaskMap.has(t.parentTaskId)) {
      resolvedParentId = t.parentTaskId;
    } else if ((t as any).parentTaskCode) {
      const pCode = String((t as any).parentTaskCode).trim().toLowerCase();
      const cleanNumMatch = pCode.match(/^#?(\d+)$/);
      const targetIndex = cleanNumMatch ? parseInt(cleanNumMatch[1], 10) - 1 : -1;

      const matchedParent = Array.from(lookupTaskMap.values()).find(
        pt => pt.projectCode === t.projectCode &&
              (pt.projectYear == t.projectYear || (!pt.projectYear && !t.projectYear)) &&
              (pt.projectStore == t.projectStore || (!pt.projectStore && !t.projectStore)) &&
              (
                String(pt.taskCodePhu || '').trim().toLowerCase() === pCode ||
                String(pt.id).toLowerCase() === pCode ||
                (cleanNumMatch && String(pt.taskCodePhu || '').trim().toLowerCase().endsWith(`#${cleanNumMatch[1]}`)) ||
                (targetIndex >= 0 && pt.orderIndex === targetIndex)
              )
      );
      if (matchedParent && matchedParent.id !== t.id) {
        resolvedParentId = matchedParent.id;
      }
    } else if ((t as any).parentTaskName) {
      const pName = String((t as any).parentTaskName).trim().toLowerCase();
      const matchedParent = Array.from(lookupTaskMap.values()).find(
        pt => pt.projectCode === t.projectCode &&
              (pt.projectYear == t.projectYear || (!pt.projectYear && !t.projectYear)) &&
              (pt.projectStore == t.projectStore || (!pt.projectStore && !t.projectStore)) &&
              String(pt.name || '').trim().toLowerCase() === pName
      );
      if (matchedParent && matchedParent.id !== t.id) {
        resolvedParentId = matchedParent.id;
      }
    }

    if (resolvedParentId && resolvedParentId !== t.id) {
      t.parentTaskId = resolvedParentId;
      (t as any).parentId = resolvedParentId;
    } else if (resolvedParentId === t.id) {
      delete t.parentTaskId;
      delete (t as any).parentId;
    }

    delete (t as any).parentTaskCode;
    delete (t as any).parentTaskName;
    delete (t as any).isParent;
    delete (t as any).level;
  });

  // Calculate dates from predecessors and duration
  useAppStore.getState().optimisticUpdateTasks(tasksToImport);

  const allCurrentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
  const calculatedTasks = calculateDatesFromPredecessorsAndDuration(
    tasksToImport,
    allCurrentTasks,
    projects
  );

  const tasksMapAfterCalc = new Map<string, Task>();
  allCurrentTasks.forEach(t => tasksMapAfterCalc.set(t.id, t));
  calculatedTasks.forEach(t => tasksMapAfterCalc.set(t.id, t));
  const allTasksWithCalc = Array.from(tasksMapAfterCalc.values());
  const { updatedParents, allTasksMap } = rollupParentTaskDates(allTasksWithCalc);

  const tasksToSaveMap = new Map<string, Task>();
  calculatedTasks.forEach(t => tasksToSaveMap.set(t.id, t));
  updatedParents.forEach(p => tasksToSaveMap.set(p.id, p));
  const rawTasksToSave = Array.from(tasksToSaveMap.values());

  // Auto-heal predecessor string codes on imported CSV/Excel tasks
  const healed = healAllTasksPredecessors(rawTasksToSave, projects);
  const finalTasksToSave = healed.updatedTasks;

  // Optimistic update
  useAppStore.getState().optimisticUpdateTasks(finalTasksToSave);

  // Sync project summaries
  const finalFullTasksList = Array.from(allTasksMap.values());
  const affectedProjects = findAffectedProjects(finalTasksToSave, projects);
  const delegationGroups = useAppStore.getState().delegationGroups;
  const currentProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
  const updatedProjects = currentProjects.map(proj => {
    const isAffected = affectedProjects.some(ap => ap.id === proj.id);
    if (!isAffected) return proj;
    const pTasks = getTasksForProject(proj, finalFullTasksList);
    const computed = calculateProjectComputedDates(proj, pTasks, delegationGroups);
    return { ...proj, ...computed };
  });
  useAppStore.getState().setProjects(updatedProjects);

  // Save to Firestore
  const activeUser = useAppStore.getState().currentUser || currentUser;
  await batchSaveTasksToFirestore(finalTasksToSave, activeUser);

  for (const p of affectedProjects) {
    const pTasks = getTasksForProject(p, finalFullTasksList);
    const computed = calculateProjectComputedDates(p, pTasks, delegationGroups);
    await syncProjectDatesToFirestore(p.id, computed);
  }

  if (finalTasksToSave.length > 0) {
    undoManager.push({
      description: 'Import Tasks',
      revert: async () => {
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        previousStates.forEach((oldData, id) => {
          batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id), oldData);
        });
        newIds.forEach(id => {
          batch.delete(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id));
        });
        await batch.commit();
      }
    });
  }

  return { count: tasksToImport.length };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/detailTaskImportParser.ts ==================== */
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { parseCSV } from '../../lib/csvUtils';
import { cleanDurationString } from '../../lib/taskImportService';
import { parseCSVDate } from './detailCsvUtils';

export async function parseTasksFile(
  file: File,
  projects: Project[]
): Promise<Map<string, Array<{ rowData: any; originalCsvIndex: number }>>> {
  let rows: string[][] = [];
  const fileName = file.name.toLowerCase();

  if (fileName.endsWith('.xlsx') || fileName.endsWith('.xls')) {
    const XLSX = await import('xlsx');
    const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: 'array' });
    const sheetName = workbook.SheetNames.includes('tasks') ? 'tasks' : workbook.SheetNames[0];
    const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
    const rawRows: any[][] = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1, defval: '', raw: false });
    rows = rawRows.map(row => row.map((cell: any) => String(cell !== null && cell !== undefined ? cell : '').trim()));
  } else {
    const text = await file.text();
    rows = parseCSV(text);
  }

  if (!rows || rows.length < 2) {
    throw new Error('CSV file is empty or format is invalid.');
  }

  const headers = rows[0].map(h => h.trim().toLowerCase());
  const dataRows = rows.slice(1);

  // Field validation
  for (let idx = 0; idx < dataRows.length; idx++) {
    const row = dataRows[idx];
    if (row.every(c => !String(c).trim())) continue;

    let hasYear = false;
    let hasStore = false;
    let hasCode = false;

    headers.forEach((h, i) => {
      const val = String(row[i] || '').trim();
      if ((h === 'year' || h === 'projectyear') && val) hasYear = true;
      if ((h === 'store' || h === 'projectstore') && val) hasStore = true;
      if ((h === 'code' || h === 'projectcode') && val) hasCode = true;
    });

    if (!hasYear || !hasStore || !hasCode) {
      throw new Error(`Row ${idx + 2} is missing Year, Store, or Project Code. All imported data must include these three fields.`);
    }
  }

  const rawParsedRowsByProject = new Map<string, Array<{ rowData: any; originalCsvIndex: number }>>();

  dataRows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
    if (row.length < headers.length) return;
    const t: any = {};

    headers.forEach((h, i) => {
      let key = h;
      if (h === 'task name') key = 'name';
      if (h === 'projectcode') key = 'projectCode';
      if (h === 'year' || h === 'projectyear') key = 'projectYear';
      if (h === 'store' || h === 'projectstore') key = 'projectStore';
      if (h === 'sub-task code' || h === 'sub task code' || h === 'subtask code' || h === 'sub_task_code' || h === 'taskcodephu' || h === 'task code phu' || h === 'task_code_phu') {
        key = 'taskCodePhu';
      }
      if (h === 'orderindex' || h === 'order_index') key = 'orderIndex';
      if (h === 'delegation' || h === 'task delegation' || h === 'task_delegation' || h === 'isdelegation') {
        key = 'delegation';
      }
      if (h === 'task flexible' || h === 'task_flexible' || h === 'taskflexible' || h === 'flexible' || h === 'realtimeupdate' || h === 'realtime_update') {
        key = 'realtimeUpdate';
      }
      if (h === 'comments' || h === 'comment') {
        key = 'importComment';
      }
      if (h === 'parent task code' || h === 'parenttaskcode' || h === 'parent_task_code' || h === 'parent code' || h === 'parent_code' || h === 'task mẹ code' || h === 'task me code') {
        key = 'parentTaskCode';
      }
      if (h === 'parent task name' || h === 'parenttaskname' || h === 'parent_task_name' || h === 'parent name' || h === 'parent_name' || h === 'task mẹ name' || h === 'task me name' || h === 'task mẹ' || h === 'task me' || h === 'parent task' || h === 'parenttask') {
        key = 'parentTaskName';
      }
      if (h === 'parenttaskid' || h === 'parent_task_id' || h === 'parent id' || h === 'parentid') {
        key = 'parentTaskId';
      }
      if (h === 'is parent' || h === 'is_parent' || h === 'isparent') {
        key = 'isParent';
      }
      if (h === 'level' || h === 'wbs level' || h === 'wbs_level') {
        key = 'level';
      }

      if (['projectCode', 'projectYear', 'projectStore', 'name', 'start', 'finish', 'duration', 'party', 'predecessor', 'taskCodePhu', 'orderIndex', 'delegation', 'realtimeUpdate', 'importComment', 'parentTaskId', 'parentTaskCode', 'parentTaskName', 'isParent', 'level'].includes(key)) {
        let val: any = row[i];
        if (key === 'start' || key === 'finish') {
          val = parseCSVDate(val);
        } else if (key === 'duration') {
          val = cleanDurationString(val);
        } else if (key === 'delegation' || key === 'realtimeUpdate') {
          const strVal = String(val || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          val = (strVal === 'true' || strVal === '1' || strVal === 'yes' || strVal === 'on');
        } else if (key === 'projectYear') {
          val = isNaN(Number(val)) ? val : Number(val);
        }
        t[key] = val;
      }
    });

    if (t.projectCode && t.name) {
      if (!t.projectYear || !t.projectStore) {
        const possibleProjects = projects.filter(p => String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase() === String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase());
        if (possibleProjects.length === 1) {
          if (!t.projectYear) t.projectYear = possibleProjects[0].year;
          if (!t.projectStore) t.projectStore = possibleProjects[0].store;
        }
      }

      if (!t.projectYear) {
        const matchedProj = projects.find(p => String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase() === String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase());
        t.projectYear = (matchedProj?.year && !isNaN(Number(matchedProj.year))) ? Number(matchedProj.year) : new Date().getFullYear();
      }

      if (t.projectYear !== undefined && !isNaN(Number(t.projectYear))) {
        t.projectYear = Number(t.projectYear);
      } else {
        t.projectYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      }

      const yearKey = t.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
      const storeKey = t.projectStore ? String(t.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
      const prjKey = `${String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase()}_${yearKey}_${storeKey}`;

      if (!rawParsedRowsByProject.has(prjKey)) {
        rawParsedRowsByProject.set(prjKey, []);
      }
      rawParsedRowsByProject.get(prjKey)!.push({ rowData: t, originalCsvIndex: rowIndex });
    }
  });

  return rawParsedRowsByProject;
}

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailBulkActions.ts ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc, deleteField } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { generateId } from '../../lib/utils';
import { saveTaskStateUnified, deleteTaskStateUnified } from '../../lib/taskStateService';

interface UseDetailBulkActionsParams {
  selectedTaskIds: Set<string>;
  setSelectedTaskIds: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Set<string>>>;
  lastCheckedTaskIdRef: React.MutableRefObject<string | null>;
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
}

export function useDetailBulkActions({
  selectedTaskIds,
  setSelectedTaskIds,
  lastCheckedTaskIdRef,
  tasks,
  projects,
  delegationGroups,
  currentUser,
}: UseDetailBulkActionsParams) {
  const handleBulkAction = async (action: 'delegation_on' | 'delegation_off' | 'flexible_on' | 'flexible_off' | 'baseline' | 'unlink' | 'delete') => {
    if (selectedTaskIds.size === 0) return;

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const prevTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;

    // Special handler: Unlink modular tasks
    if (action === 'unlink') {
      const targetIds = Array.from(selectedTaskIds);
      const targetSet = new Set(targetIds);

      const parentCodeSet = new Set<string>();
      prevTasks.forEach(t => {
        if (targetSet.has(t.id) && t.taskCodePhu) {
          parentCodeSet.add(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
        }
      });

      const allIdsToUnlink = new Set<string>();
      targetIds.forEach(id => allIdsToUnlink.add(id));
      prevTasks.forEach(t => {
        const rawParent = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
        if (rawParent) {
          const rawStr = String(rawParent).trim().toLowerCase();
          if (targetSet.has(String(rawParent)) || parentCodeSet.has(rawStr)) {
            allIdsToUnlink.add(t.id);
          }
        }
      });

      const unlinkedArray = Array.from(allIdsToUnlink);

      // 1. 0ms Optimistic UI update in Zustand
      const updatedTasks = prevTasks.map(t =>
        allIdsToUnlink.has(t.id)
          ? { ...t, parentTaskId: undefined, parentId: undefined, updatedAt: now }
          : t
      );
      useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);
      setSelectedTaskIds(new Set());
      lastCheckedTaskIdRef.current = null;

      // 2. Update Dexie (IndexedDB)
      try {
        const { localDb } = await import('../../lib/localDb');
        await Promise.all(
          unlinkedArray.map(id => (localDb.tasks.update as any)(id, { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now }))
        );
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[useDetailBulkActions] Dexie update failed:', e);
      }

      // 3. Write batch to Firestore
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      unlinkedArray.forEach(id => {
        const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id);
        batch.update(docRef, { parentTaskId: deleteField(), parentId: null, updatedAt: now });
      });

      try {
        await batch.commit();
        const { recordBatchDeltas } = await import('../../lib/deltaSyncService');
        const deltaItems: any[] = unlinkedArray.map(id => {
          const t = prevTasks.find(item => item.id === id);
          return {
            docId: id,
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
            action: 'update',
            isPatch: true,
            data: { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now },
            year: t?.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
          };
        });
        if (deltaItems.length > 0) {
          recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
        }
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Success",
          message: `Unlinked ${unlinkedArray.length} modular task(s).`
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error(err);
        useAppStore.getState().setTasks(prevTasks);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Error",
          message: "Failed to unlink tasks on server. Changes reverted."
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      let updateCount = 0;

      Array.from(selectedTaskIds).forEach(taskId => {
        const docRef = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_tasks", taskId);
        
        if (action === 'delete') {
          batch.delete(docRef);
          updateCount++;
        } else {
          const payload: any = { updatedAt: now };
          if (action === 'delegation_on') {
            payload.delegation = true;
            const task = tasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
            if (task) {
              const deterministicGroupId = `del_${task.id}`;
              const existingGroup = delegationGroups.find(g => g.parentTaskId === task.id || g.id === deterministicGroupId);
              if (!existingGroup) {
                 const dateStr = now.substring(0, 10);
                 const activeUser = useAppStore.getState().currentUser || currentUser;
                 const activeUserId = activeUser?.id && activeUser.id !== 'guest' ? activeUser.id : (activeUser?.username || 'system');
                 const rawParty = (task.party && task.party.trim()) ? task.party.trim() : (activeUser?.username || '');
                 const parsedParty = rawParty.split(/[,;/+]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[0] || rawParty;
                 const newGroup = {
                   id: deterministicGroupId,
                   parentTaskId: task.id,
                   name: task.name || 'Delegated Task',
                   projectCode: task.projectCode,
                   projectStore: task.projectStore,
                   projectYear: (task.projectYear !== undefined && task.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(task.projectYear))) ? Number(task.projectYear) : (Number(projects.find(p => p.code === task.projectCode)?.year) || new Date().getFullYear()),
                   subTasks: [{
                       id: generateId(),
                       name: '',
                       comments: '',
                       status: 'Assigned',
                       delegationStatus: 'Assigned',
                       priority: 'Mid',
                       party: parsedParty,
                       startAct: dateStr,
                       finishAct: dateStr,
                       updatedAt: now
                    }],
                   updatedAt: now,
                   createdBy: activeUserId
                 };
                 const delRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', deterministicGroupId);
                 batch.set(delRef, newGroup, { merge: true });
              }
            }
          }
          if (action === 'delegation_off') payload.delegation = false;
          if (action === 'flexible_on') payload.realtimeUpdate = true;
          if (action === 'flexible_off') payload.realtimeUpdate = false;
          
          if (action === 'baseline') {
            const task = tasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
            if (task) {
              payload.baselineStart = task.start;
              payload.baselineFinish = task.finish;
            }
          }
          
          batch.update(docRef, payload);
          updateCount++;
        }
      });

      if (updateCount > 0) {
        if (action === 'delete') {
          const selectedObjs = tasks.filter(t => selectedTaskIds.has(t.id));
          deleteTaskStateUnified(selectedObjs.length > 0 ? selectedObjs : Array.from(selectedTaskIds));
        } else {
          const updatedTasksList: (Partial<Task> & { id: string })[] = [];
          Array.from(selectedTaskIds).forEach(taskId => {
            const task = tasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
            if (task) {
              const u: any = { id: taskId, updatedAt: now };
              if (action === 'delegation_on') u.delegation = true;
              if (action === 'delegation_off') u.delegation = false;
              if (action === 'flexible_on') u.realtimeUpdate = true;
              if (action === 'flexible_off') u.realtimeUpdate = false;
              if (action === 'baseline') {
                u.baselineStart = task.start;
                u.baselineFinish = task.finish;
              }
              updatedTasksList.push(u);
            }
          });
          if (updatedTasksList.length > 0) {
            saveTaskStateUnified(updatedTasksList);
          }
        }

        try {
          await batch.commit();
        } catch (error: any) {
          console.error("Batch commit failed", error);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
          return;
        }

        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Success", message: `Successfully ${action === 'delete' ? 'deleted' : 'updated'} ${updateCount} tasks.` });
        setSelectedTaskIds(new Set());
        lastCheckedTaskIdRef.current = null;
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error(e);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: e.message });
    }
  };

  return {
    handleBulkAction,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailColumns.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { AppUser } from '../../types';
import { safeGetDeviceItemLocal, safeSetDeviceItemLocal, getDeviceScreenType } from '../../lib/storage';
import { AVAILABLE_COLUMNS, SortConfig } from './detailTypes';

interface UseDetailColumnsParams {
  currentUser: AppUser;
  canWrite: boolean;
}

export function useDetailColumns({ currentUser, canWrite }: UseDetailColumnsParams) {
  const availableColumnsForUser = useMemo(() => {
    return AVAILABLE_COLUMNS;
  }, []);

  const [visibleColumns, setVisibleColumns] = useState<string[]>(availableColumnsForUser.map(c => c.id));
  const [colWidths, setColWidths] = useState<Record<string, number>>({
    checkbox: 44,
    no: 90,
    year: 80,
    store: 80,
    location: 120,
    code: 130,
    projectName: 220,
    taskName: 250,
    duration: 100,
    start: 200,
    finish: 200,
    predecessor: 140,
    party: 150,
    action: 160
  });

  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState<SortConfig | null>(null);
  const prevScreenTypeRef = useRef(getDeviceScreenType());

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadDeviceConfig = () => {
      const saved = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_detail_col_widths', currentUser.id);
      if (saved) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
          if (parsed.action && parsed.action < 160) {
            parsed.action = 160;
          }
          setColWidths(parsed);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        }
      }
      
      const savedCols = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_detail_visible_cols', currentUser.id);
      if (savedCols) {
        try {
          let parsed = JSON.parse(savedCols);
          if (!parsed.includes('action')) parsed.push('action');
          setVisibleColumns(parsed);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        }
      } else {
        const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768;
        if (isMobile) {
          setVisibleColumns(['no', 'code', 'projectName', 'taskName', 'action']);
        } else {
          setVisibleColumns(availableColumnsForUser.map(c => c.id));
        }
      }
    };

    loadDeviceConfig();

    const handleResize = () => {
      const currentScreenType = getDeviceScreenType();
      if (currentScreenType !== prevScreenTypeRef.current) {
        prevScreenTypeRef.current = currentScreenType;
        loadDeviceConfig();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, [currentUser.role, currentUser.id, availableColumnsForUser]);

  const handleResize = (col: string, newWidth: number) => {
    setColWidths(prev => {
      const updated = { ...prev, [col]: newWidth };
      safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_detail_col_widths', JSON.stringify(updated), currentUser.id);
      return updated;
    });
  };

  const handleToggleColumn = (colId: string) => {
    setVisibleColumns(prev => {
      const next = prev.includes(colId) ? prev.filter(id => id !== colId) : [...prev, colId];
      safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_detail_visible_cols', JSON.stringify(next), currentUser.id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleSort = (key: string) => {
    setSortConfig(prev => {
      if (prev && prev.key === key) {
        if (prev.direction === 'asc') return { key, direction: 'desc' };
        return null;
      }
      return { key, direction: 'asc' };
    });
  };

  const effectiveVisibleColumns = useMemo(() => {
    if (canWrite) {
      return ['checkbox', ...visibleColumns.filter(c => c !== 'checkbox')];
    }
    return visibleColumns.filter(c => c !== 'checkbox');
  }, [canWrite, visibleColumns]);

  const totalTableWidth = useMemo(() => {
    return effectiveVisibleColumns.reduce((acc, col) => acc + (colWidths[col] || (col === 'checkbox' ? 44 : 100)), 0);
  }, [effectiveVisibleColumns, colWidths]);

  return {
    availableColumnsForUser,
    visibleColumns,
    setVisibleColumns,
    colWidths,
    setColWidths,
    sortConfig,
    setSortConfig,
    handleResize,
    handleToggleColumn,
    handleSort,
    effectiveVisibleColumns,
    totalTableWidth,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailData.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useDeferredValue, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { 
  getTaskStatus, 
  parseDateTime, 
  formatDisplayDateMain, 
  formatDisplayDateTime, 
  resolveActualStatus, 
  matchesAdvancedSearch 
} from '../../lib/utils';
import { computeTaskCode, computeAllTaskCodes } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { safeGetItemSession, safeSetItemSession } from '../../lib/storage';
import { SortConfig } from './detailTypes';
import { useDetailProjectInfo } from './useDetailProjectInfo';
import { useDetailFlatRows } from './useDetailFlatRows';
import { useDetailFocusTracking } from './useDetailFocusTracking';

interface UseDetailDataParams {
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  effectiveStore: string;
  globalYearFilter: string;
  setGlobalYearFilter: (year: string) => void;
  globalStoreFilter: string;
  setGlobalStoreFilter: (store: string) => void;
  globalLocationFilter: string[];
  setGlobalLocationFilter: (locs: string[]) => void;
  initialFilterCode?: string;
  initialFocusTaskId?: string;
  returnScrollId?: string;
  onClearFocus?: () => void;
  onBackToGantt?: () => void;
  sortConfig: SortConfig | null;
  expandedCodes: string[];
  setExpandedCodes: (codes: string[]) => void;
  setVisibleActiveProjectIds: (ids: string[]) => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
}

export function useDetailData({
  projects,
  tasks,
  delegationGroups,
  currentUser: _currentUser,
  effectiveStore,
  globalYearFilter,
  setGlobalYearFilter,
  globalStoreFilter,
  setGlobalStoreFilter,
  globalLocationFilter,
  setGlobalLocationFilter,
  initialFilterCode,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  returnScrollId: _returnScrollId,
  onClearFocus,
  onBackToGantt,
  sortConfig,
  expandedCodes,
  setExpandedCodes,
  setVisibleActiveProjectIds,
}: UseDetailDataParams) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const deferredSearchTerm = useDeferredValue(searchTerm);
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(30);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState(() => safeGetItemSession("taka_detail_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days');
  const lastSelectedStatusFilterRef = useRef<string>(safeGetItemSession("taka_detail_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days');
  const lastSelectedLocationFilterRef = useRef<string[]>(globalLocationFilter);
  const wasSearchingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isSearching = !!deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!wasSearchingRef.current && isSearching) {
      if (statusFilter !== 'all') {
        lastSelectedStatusFilterRef.current = statusFilter;
        safeSetItemSession("taka_detail_status_filter", statusFilter);
      }
      lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current = globalLocationFilter;
      setStatusFilter('all');
      wasSearchingRef.current = true;
    } else if (wasSearchingRef.current && !isSearching) {
      const restored = lastSelectedStatusFilterRef.current || safeGetItemSession("taka_detail_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days';
      setStatusFilter(restored);
      setGlobalLocationFilter(lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current || []);
      wasSearchingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [deferredSearchTerm]);

  const [selectedTaskIds, setSelectedTaskIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const lastCheckedTaskIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Focus & Viewport Tracking Hook
  const {
    activeProjectInView,
    handleClearFocus,
    handleBackToGantt,
  } = useDetailFocusTracking({
    projects,
    tasks,
    initialFilterCode,
    initialFocusTaskId,
    onClearFocus,
    onBackToGantt,
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    globalYearFilter,
    setGlobalYearFilter,
    globalStoreFilter,
    setGlobalStoreFilter,
    statusFilter,
    setStatusFilter,
    expandedCodes,
    setExpandedCodes,
  });

  // Project Info Map & Helpers Hook
  const {
    tasksByProjectKey,
    projectInfoMap,
    getProjectInfo,
  } = useDetailProjectInfo({ projects, tasks });

  // Auto-jump to matched project location(s) when searching (Debounced)
  useEffect(() => {
    const term = deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!term) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const matchedProjects = projects.filter(p => {
        const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year) : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : null);
        if (globalYearFilter !== 'all' && pYear !== globalYearFilter) return false;
        if (effectiveStore !== 'all' && p.store !== effectiveStore) return false;

        const groupTasks = tasksByProjectKey.get(`${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}`) || [];
        const isMatch = matchesAdvancedSearch(
          term,
          [p.store, p.location, p.year, p.code, p.linkCodes, p.name, p.detail, (p as any).description, p.note, p.party],
          [],
          (tLower) => {
            const summariesMatch = p.taskSummaries?.some(ts =>
              String(ts.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(tLower)
            ) || false;
            const taskMatches = groupTasks.some((t, idx) => {
              const taskFields = [
                t.taskCodePhu,
                `${p.code}#${(t.orderIndex !== undefined ? t.orderIndex : idx) + 1}`,
                t.name,
                t.duration,
                t.start,
                t.finish,
                t.party,
                formatDisplayDateMain(t.start),
                formatDisplayDateTime(t.start),
                formatDisplayDateMain(t.finish),
                formatDisplayDateTime(t.finish)
              ];
              const fieldMatch = taskFields.some(val => String(val || "").toLowerCase().includes(tLower));
              const notesMatch = t.notes?.some(n => String(n.content || '').toLowerCase().includes(tLower)) || false;
              return fieldMatch || notesMatch;
            });
            return summariesMatch || taskMatches;
          }
        );
        return isMatch;
      });

      const matchedLocations = Array.from(
        new Set(matchedProjects.map(p => p.location).filter((loc): loc is string => !!loc && loc.trim() !== ''))
      );
      if (matchedLocations.length > 0) {
        const currentLocs = globalLocationFilter || [];
        const isSame = currentLocs.length === matchedLocations.length && currentLocs.every(l => matchedLocations.includes(l));
        if (!isSame) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter(matchedLocations);
        }
      }
    }, 350);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [deferredSearchTerm, projects, tasksByProjectKey, globalYearFilter, effectiveStore, globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  const delegationGroupByParentKey = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, DelegationGroup>();
    delegationGroups.forEach(g => {
      if (g.parentTaskId) {
        const keyWithStore = `${g.parentTaskId}-${g.projectStore || ''}`;
        map.set(keyWithStore, g);
        if (!map.has(g.parentTaskId)) {
          map.set(g.parentTaskId, g);
        }
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [delegationGroups]);

  useEffect(() => { setVisibleCount(20); }, [searchTerm, globalStoreFilter, globalYearFilter, globalLocationFilter, statusFilter]);

  const filteredProjects = useMemo(() => {
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const todayTime = today.getTime();

    return projects.filter(p => {
      const pKey = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}-${p.id || p.no}`;
      const info = projectInfoMap.get(pKey) || getProjectInfo(p);
      const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (info.computedTakStart ? String(info.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : null));
      if (globalYearFilter !== 'all' && (pYear === null || pYear !== String(globalYearFilter).trim())) return false;
      if (effectiveStore !== 'all' && (!p.store || String(p.store).toUpperCase().trim() !== effectiveStore.toUpperCase().trim())) return false;
      if (globalLocationFilter.length > 0 && (!p.location || !globalLocationFilter.includes(p.location))) return false;

      let matchesStatus = true;
      if (statusFilter === 'On process + Upcoming 3 days') {
        if (info.status === 'On process') {
          matchesStatus = true;
        } else if (info.status === 'Upcoming') {
          const dStart = parseDateTime(info.start);
          if (dStart) {
            dStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
            const diffTime = dStart.getTime() - todayTime;
            const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            matchesStatus = diffDays <= 3 && diffDays >= 0;
          } else {
            matchesStatus = false;
          }
        } else {
          matchesStatus = false;
        }
      } else {
        matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'all' || info.status === statusFilter;
      }
      if (!matchesStatus) return false;

      const groupTasks = info.sortedTasks || tasksByProjectKey.get(`${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}`) || [];
      if (deferredSearchTerm) {
        const isMatch = matchesAdvancedSearch(
          deferredSearchTerm,
          [p.store, p.location, p.year, p.code, p.linkCodes, p.name, p.detail, (p as any).description, p.note, p.party],
          [],
          (term) => {
            const summariesMatch = p.taskSummaries?.some(ts =>
              String(ts.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(term)
            ) || false;
            const taskMatches = groupTasks.some((t, idx) => {
              const taskFields = [
                t.taskCodePhu,
                `${p.code}#${(t.orderIndex !== undefined ? t.orderIndex : idx) + 1}`,
                t.name,
                t.duration,
                t.start,
                t.finish,
                t.party,
                formatDisplayDateMain(t.start),
                formatDisplayDateTime(t.start),
                formatDisplayDateMain(t.finish),
                formatDisplayDateTime(t.finish)
              ];
              const fieldMatch = taskFields.some(val => String(val || "").toLowerCase().includes(term));
              const notesMatch = t.notes?.some(n => String(n.content || '').toLowerCase().includes(term)) || false;
              return fieldMatch || notesMatch;
            });
            return summariesMatch || taskMatches;
          }
        );
        if (!isMatch) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [projects, projectInfoMap, getProjectInfo, globalYearFilter, effectiveStore, globalLocationFilter, statusFilter, deferredSearchTerm, tasksByProjectKey]);

  // Ensure visibleCount is large enough to render target project row
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialFilterCode) return;
    const filterClean = String(initialFilterCode).trim().toUpperCase();
    const projIdx = filteredProjects.findIndex(p => {
      const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const pId = String(p.id || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      return pId === filterClean || pCode === filterClean || (pCode && filterClean.startsWith(pCode));
    });
    if (projIdx >= 0 && projIdx >= visibleCount) {
      setVisibleCount(projIdx + 25);
    }
  }, [initialFilterCode, filteredProjects, visibleCount]);

  const prevVisibleIdsRef = useRef<string>("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const targetProjects = filteredProjects.length > 0
      ? filteredProjects.slice(0, visibleCount)
      : projects.filter(p => {
          const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year) : (p.computedTakStart ? String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : null));
          if (globalYearFilter !== 'all' && pYear !== globalYearFilter) return false;
          if (effectiveStore !== 'all' && p.store !== effectiveStore) return false;
          if (globalLocationFilter.length > 0 && (!p.location || !globalLocationFilter.includes(p.location))) return false;
          return true;
        }).slice(0, visibleCount);

    const visibleIds = targetProjects.map(p => String(p.id || p.no));
    const idsKey = visibleIds.join(',');
    if (prevVisibleIdsRef.current !== idsKey) {
      prevVisibleIdsRef.current = idsKey;
      setVisibleActiveProjectIds(visibleIds);
    }
  }, [filteredProjects, projects, visibleCount, globalYearFilter, effectiveStore, globalLocationFilter, setVisibleActiveProjectIds]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      useAppStore.getState().setVisibleActiveProjectIds([]);
    };
  }, []);

  const allVisibleTaskIds = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjects.slice(0, visibleCount).flatMap(p => {
      const pKey = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}-${p.id || p.no}`;
      const pInfo = projectInfoMap.get(pKey) || getProjectInfo(p);
      return (pInfo.sortedTasks || []).map(t => t.id);
    });
  }, [filteredProjects, visibleCount, projectInfoMap, getProjectInfo]);

  const lowerSearchTerm = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();

  // Task code & status maps
  const taskCodeMap = useMemo(() => {
    return computeAllTaskCodes(projects, tasks);
  }, [projects, tasks]);

  const taskActualStatusMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, { label: string; color: string }>();
    for (let idx = 0; idx < tasks.length; idx++) {
      const t = tasks[idx];
      const taskStatus = getTaskStatus(t.start, t.finish);
      const delegationGroup = delegationGroupByParentKey.get(t.id);
      const actStatus = resolveActualStatus(taskStatus, delegationGroup?.subTasks || [], t);
      map.set(t.id, actStatus);
    }
    return map;
  }, [tasks, delegationGroupByParentKey]);

  // Pre-indexed O(1) map of subtask counts per parent to avoid 250,000 array filters in DetailTaskRow
  const childTasksCountMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    for (let idx = 0; idx < tasks.length; idx++) {
      const child = tasks[idx];
      if (child.parentTaskId) {
        map.set(child.parentTaskId, (map.get(child.parentTaskId) || 0) + 1);
      }
    }
    return map;
  }, [tasks]);

  // Virtual Windowing Flat Rows
  const flatTableRows = useDetailFlatRows({
    filteredProjects,
    visibleCount,
    projectInfoMap,
    getProjectInfo,
    sortConfig,
    expandedCodes,
    delegationGroups,
    lowerSearchTerm,
    taskCodeMap,
  });

  // Selection handlers
  const handleSelectAllTasksInProject = useCallback((groupTasks: Task[], select: boolean) => {
    setSelectedTaskIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      groupTasks.forEach(t => {
        if (select) next.add(t.id);
        else next.delete(t.id);
      });
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const handleToggleSelectTask = useCallback((taskId: string, shiftKey: boolean) => {
    const strTaskId = String(taskId);
    setSelectedTaskIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(Array.from(prev).map(String));
      const isChecked = !next.has(strTaskId);
      if (isChecked) {
        if (shiftKey && lastCheckedTaskIdRef.current && lastCheckedTaskIdRef.current !== strTaskId) {
          const visibleIds = allVisibleTaskIds.map(String);
          const lastIdx = visibleIds.indexOf(lastCheckedTaskIdRef.current);
          const currentIdx = visibleIds.indexOf(strTaskId);
          if (lastIdx !== -1 && currentIdx !== -1) {
            const minIdx = Math.min(lastIdx, currentIdx);
            const maxIdx = Math.max(lastIdx, currentIdx);
            for (let idx = minIdx; idx <= maxIdx; idx++) {
              next.add(visibleIds[idx]);
            }
          } else {
            next.add(strTaskId);
          }
        } else {
          next.add(strTaskId);
        }
        lastCheckedTaskIdRef.current = strTaskId;
      } else {
        next.delete(strTaskId);
        lastCheckedTaskIdRef.current = null;
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, [allVisibleTaskIds]);

  return {
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    deferredSearchTerm,
    visibleCount,
    setVisibleCount,
    statusFilter,
    setStatusFilter,
    lastSelectedStatusFilterRef,
    selectedTaskIds,
    setSelectedTaskIds,
    lastCheckedTaskIdRef,
    activeProjectInView,
    delegationGroupByParentKey,
    projectInfoMap,
    getProjectInfo,
    filteredProjects,
    allVisibleTaskIds,
    lowerSearchTerm,
    taskCodeMap,
    taskActualStatusMap,
    childTasksCountMap,
    flatTableRows,
    handleSelectAllTasksInProject,
    handleToggleSelectTask,
    handleClearFocus,
    handleBackToGantt,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailFlatRows.ts ==================== */
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { Project, DelegationGroup } from '../../types';
import { matchesAdvancedSearch, computePlanProgressPercent, computeActProgressPercent, computePlanProgressFromSummaries, computeActProgressFromSummaries } from '../../lib/utils';
import { DetailTableRow, SortConfig } from './detailTypes';
import { ProjectInfo } from './useDetailProjectInfo';

interface UseDetailFlatRowsParams {
  filteredProjects: Project[];
  visibleCount: number;
  projectInfoMap: Map<string, ProjectInfo>;
  getProjectInfo: (p: Project) => ProjectInfo;
  sortConfig: SortConfig | null;
  expandedCodes: string[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  lowerSearchTerm: string;
  taskCodeMap: Map<string, string>;
}

export function useDetailFlatRows({
  filteredProjects,
  visibleCount,
  projectInfoMap,
  getProjectInfo,
  sortConfig,
  expandedCodes,
  delegationGroups,
  lowerSearchTerm,
  taskCodeMap,
}: UseDetailFlatRowsParams) {
  const flatTableRows = useMemo<DetailTableRow[]>(() => {
    const rows: DetailTableRow[] = [];
    const visibleProjects = filteredProjects.slice(0, visibleCount);

    visibleProjects.forEach((p, pIdx) => {
      const pKey = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}-${p.id || p.no}`;
      const pInfo = projectInfoMap.get(pKey) || getProjectInfo(p);
      const sortedTasks = pInfo.sortedTasks || [];

      const groupTasks = sortConfig ? [...sortedTasks].sort((a, b) => {
        let valA = '';
        let valB = '';
        let direction = 'asc';
        
        if (sortConfig.key === 'start') {
          valA = a.start || '9999-12-31';
          valB = b.start || '9999-12-31';
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'finish') {
          valA = a.finish || '9999-12-31';
          valB = b.finish || '9999-12-31';
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'taskName') {
          valA = a.name || '';
          valB = b.name || '';
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'code') {
          const codeA = a.taskCodePhu || '';
          const codeB = b.taskCodePhu || '';
          direction = sortConfig.direction;
          const comp = codeA.localeCompare(codeB, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
          return direction === 'asc' ? comp : -comp;
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'no') {
          const ordA = a.orderIndex !== undefined ? a.orderIndex : 0;
          const ordB = b.orderIndex !== undefined ? b.orderIndex : 0;
          direction = sortConfig.direction;
          return direction === 'asc' ? ordA - ordB : ordB - ordA;
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'duration') {
          valA = a.duration || '0';
          valB = b.duration || '0';
          direction = sortConfig.direction;
          const numA = Number(valA);
          const numB = Number(valB);
          if (!isNaN(numA) && !isNaN(numB)) {
            return direction === 'asc' ? numA - numB : numB - numA;
          }
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'party') {
          valA = a.party || '';
          valB = b.party || '';
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'predecessor') {
          valA = a.predecessor || '';
          valB = b.predecessor || '';
        }

        direction = sortConfig.direction;
        return direction === 'asc' ? valA.localeCompare(valB) : valB.localeCompare(valA);
      }) : sortedTasks;

      const isExpanded =
        expandedCodes.includes(String(p.id || '')) ||
        (p.code ? expandedCodes.includes(p.code) : false) ||
        (p.no !== undefined && p.no !== null ? expandedCodes.includes(String(p.no)) : false);
      const isProjDelegationOn = groupTasks.some(t => Boolean(t.delegation)) || (p.taskSummaries?.some(ts => Boolean(ts.delegation)) ?? false);

      const validGroupTasks = groupTasks.map(t => ({
        ...t,
        name: t.name && String(t.name).trim() ? t.name : (t.taskCodePhu || 'Task')
      }));

      const isProjectMatch = lowerSearchTerm
        ? matchesAdvancedSearch(lowerSearchTerm, [p.store, p.location, p.year, p.code, p.linkCodes, p.name, p.detail, (p as any).description, p.note, p.party])
        : true;

      const tasksToRender = isProjectMatch
        ? validGroupTasks
        : lowerSearchTerm 
          ? validGroupTasks.filter(t => {
              const code = taskCodeMap.get(t.id) || '';
              const commentsMatch = t.comments?.some(c => String(c.text || '').toLowerCase().includes(lowerSearchTerm));
              const notesMatch = t.notes?.some(n => String(n.content || '').toLowerCase().includes(lowerSearchTerm));
              return (
                String(t.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(lowerSearchTerm) ||
                code.toLowerCase().includes(lowerSearchTerm) ||
                String(t.party || '').toLowerCase().includes(lowerSearchTerm) ||
                commentsMatch ||
                notesMatch
              );
            })
          : validGroupTasks;

      const summaryCount = (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries)) ? p.taskSummaries.length : (p.taskCount || 0);
      const effectiveTaskCount = (lowerSearchTerm && !isProjectMatch) ? tasksToRender.length : Math.max(validGroupTasks.length, summaryCount);

      let planProgressPercent = 0;
      let actProgressPercent = 0;

      // Prefer real-time summary data for progress if available and potentially more up-to-date than loaded tasks
      if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.length > validGroupTasks.length) {
        planProgressPercent = computePlanProgressFromSummaries(p.taskSummaries);
        actProgressPercent = computeActProgressFromSummaries(p.taskSummaries);
      } else if (validGroupTasks.length > 0) {
        planProgressPercent = computePlanProgressPercent(validGroupTasks);
        actProgressPercent = computeActProgressPercent(validGroupTasks, delegationGroups);
      } else {
        planProgressPercent = p.computedPlanProgress ?? 0;
        actProgressPercent = p.computedActProgress ?? 0;
      }

      rows.push({
        type: 'project',
        key: `proj-${p.id || p.no}`,
        project: p,
        projectIndex: pIdx,
        effectiveTaskCount,
        isExpanded,
        groupTasks,
        isProjDelegationOn,
        planProgressPercent,
        actProgressPercent,
      });

      if (isExpanded) {
        tasksToRender.forEach((t) => {
          const originalIndex = groupTasks.findIndex(gt => gt.id === t.id);
          const i = originalIndex !== -1 ? originalIndex : 0;
          rows.push({
            type: 'task',
            key: `task-${t.id}`,
            task: t,
            taskIndex: i,
            project: p,
            projectIndex: pIdx,
            groupTasks,
            isProjDelegationOn,
          });
        });
      }
    });

    return rows;
  }, [filteredProjects, visibleCount, projectInfoMap, getProjectInfo, sortConfig, expandedCodes, delegationGroups, lowerSearchTerm, taskCodeMap]);

  return flatTableRows;
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailFocusTracking.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { scrollToElement } from '../../lib/utils';

interface UseDetailFocusTrackingParams {
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  initialFilterCode?: string;
  initialFocusTaskId?: string;
  onClearFocus?: () => void;
  onBackToGantt?: () => void;
  searchTerm: string;
  setSearchTerm: (term: string) => void;
  globalYearFilter: string;
  setGlobalYearFilter: (year: string) => void;
  globalStoreFilter: string;
  setGlobalStoreFilter: (store: string) => void;
  statusFilter: string;
  setStatusFilter: (status: string) => void;
  expandedCodes: string[];
  setExpandedCodes: (codes: string[]) => void;
}

export function useDetailFocusTracking({
  projects,
  tasks,
  initialFilterCode,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  onClearFocus,
  onBackToGantt,
  searchTerm,
  setSearchTerm,
  globalYearFilter,
  setGlobalYearFilter,
  globalStoreFilter,
  setGlobalStoreFilter,
  statusFilter,
  setStatusFilter,
  expandedCodes,
  setExpandedCodes,
}: UseDetailFocusTrackingParams) {
  const setDetailTabFilterCode = useAppStore(state => state.setDetailTabFilterCode);
  const [activeProjectInView, setActiveProjectInView] = useState<Project | null>(null);
  const lastFocusedTaskIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Smart Viewport Project Tracking using IntersectionObserver (Debounced to protect 60fps scrolling)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const visibleEntriesMap = new Map<Element, IntersectionObserverEntry>();
    let debounceTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

    const updateActiveProject = () => {
      let topProjectEl: Element | null = null;
      let minTop = Infinity;

      visibleEntriesMap.forEach((entry, el) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          const top = entry.boundingClientRect.top;
          if (top >= 0 && top < minTop) {
            minTop = top;
            topProjectEl = el;
          } else if (topProjectEl === null) {
            topProjectEl = el;
          }
        }
      });

      if (topProjectEl) {
        const code = (topProjectEl as HTMLElement).getAttribute('data-project-code');
        const year = (topProjectEl as HTMLElement).getAttribute('data-project-year');
        const store = (topProjectEl as HTMLElement).getAttribute('data-project-store');
        if (code) {
          const found = projects.find(
            (p) =>
              p.code === code &&
              (String(p.year || '') === String(year || '') || (!p.year && !year)) &&
              (String(p.store || '') === String(store || '') || (!p.store && !store))
          );
          if (found) {
            setActiveProjectInView((prev) => {
              if (
                prev &&
                prev.code === found.code &&
                String(prev.year || '') === String(found.year || '') &&
                String(prev.store || '') === String(found.store || '')
              ) {
                return prev;
              }
              return found;
            });
          }
        }
      }
    };

    const scheduleUpdate = () => {
      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      debounceTimer = setTimeout(updateActiveProject, 200);
    };

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            visibleEntriesMap.set(entry.target, entry);
          } else {
