            visibleEntriesMap.delete(entry.target);
          }
        });
        scheduleUpdate();
      },
      {
        root: null,
        rootMargin: '-60px 0px -40% 0px',
        threshold: [0, 0.5, 1.0],
      }
    );

    const observeVisibleElements = () => {
      const projectElements = document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-project-item="true"]');
      projectElements.forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));
    };

    const frameId = requestAnimationFrame(observeVisibleElements);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      observer.disconnect();
      visibleEntriesMap.clear();
    };
  }, [projects]);

  const handleClearFocus = useCallback(() => {
    let parentProjectCode = '';
    if (initialFocusTaskId) {
      const focusedTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === initialFocusTaskId);
      if (focusedTask) {
        parentProjectCode = focusedTask.projectCode || '';
      }
    }
    if (!parentProjectCode && initialFilterCode) {
      const matched = projects.find(p => p.code && (initialFilterCode === p.code || initialFilterCode.startsWith(p.code + '-')));
      parentProjectCode = matched?.code || initialFilterCode;
    }
    setSearchTerm(parentProjectCode);
    setDetailTabFilterCode(parentProjectCode);
    lastFocusedTaskIdRef.current = null;
    onClearFocus?.();
  }, [initialFocusTaskId, initialFilterCode, tasks, projects, onClearFocus, setDetailTabFilterCode, setSearchTerm]);

  // Escape key triggers Clear Search / Clear Focus when not in modals
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        const state = useAppStore.getState();
        const hasOpenModal =
          state.isProjectModalOpen ||
          state.isTaskModalOpen ||
          state.isUserModalOpen ||
          state.isLoginModalOpen ||
          state.isCalendarSyncModalOpen;
        if (hasOpenModal) return;

        if (searchTerm) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const activeElement = document.activeElement;
          if (activeElement && typeof (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur === "function") {
            (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur();
          }
          setSearchTerm("");
          setDetailTabFilterCode("");
          onClearFocus?.();
        } else if (initialFocusTaskId) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const activeElement = document.activeElement;
          if (activeElement && typeof (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur === "function") {
            (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur();
          }
          handleClearFocus();
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [searchTerm, initialFocusTaskId, handleClearFocus, setDetailTabFilterCode, onClearFocus, setSearchTerm]);

  const handleBackToGantt = () => {
    if (onBackToGantt) {
      onBackToGantt();
    } else {
      if (onClearFocus) onClearFocus();
      useAppStore.getState().setActiveTab('gantt');
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialFocusTaskId && initialFocusTaskId !== lastFocusedTaskIdRef.current) {
      const task = tasks.find((t) => t.id === initialFocusTaskId);
      if (task) {
        const p = projects.find(
          (proj) =>
            String(proj.code || "").trim().toLowerCase() === String(task.projectCode || "").trim().toLowerCase() &&
            (!task.projectStore || !proj.store || String(proj.store).trim().toLowerCase() === String(task.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase()) &&
            (!task.projectYear || !proj.year || String(proj.year).trim() === String(task.projectYear).trim())
        ) || projects.find(
          (proj) => String(proj.code || "").trim().toLowerCase() === String(task.projectCode || "").trim().toLowerCase()
        );
        lastFocusedTaskIdRef.current = initialFocusTaskId;
        const subTaskCode = task.taskCodePhu || (p ? `${p.code}#${(task.orderIndex !== undefined ? task.orderIndex : 0) + 1}` : '') || task.projectCode;
        if (subTaskCode) {
          setSearchTerm(subTaskCode);
          setDetailTabFilterCode(subTaskCode);
        }
        if (p) {
          if (p.year && globalYearFilter !== 'all' && String(p.year) !== String(globalYearFilter)) {
            setGlobalYearFilter(String(p.year));
          }
          if (p.store && globalStoreFilter !== 'all' && String(p.store) !== String(globalStoreFilter)) {
            setGlobalStoreFilter(p.store);
          }
          if (statusFilter !== 'all') {
            setStatusFilter('all');
          }
          const newCodes = new Set(expandedCodes);
          if (p.id) newCodes.add(String(p.id));
          if (p.code) newCodes.add(p.code);
          if (p.no !== undefined && p.no !== null) newCodes.add(String(p.no));
          if (newCodes.size !== expandedCodes.length) {
            setExpandedCodes(Array.from(newCodes));
          }
          const tryScroll = (attempts = 0) => {
            const el = document.getElementById(`detail-task-${initialFocusTaskId}`);
            if (el) {
              scrollToElement(el);
            } else if (attempts < 15) {
              setTimeout(() => tryScroll(attempts + 1), 80);
            }
          };
          requestAnimationFrame(() => tryScroll(0));
        } else if (task.projectCode) {
          if (statusFilter !== 'all') {
            setStatusFilter('all');
          }
        }
      }
    } else if (!initialFocusTaskId && lastFocusedTaskIdRef.current) {
      lastFocusedTaskIdRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [initialFocusTaskId, tasks, projects, globalYearFilter, globalStoreFilter, statusFilter, setGlobalYearFilter, setGlobalStoreFilter, expandedCodes, setExpandedCodes, setDetailTabFilterCode, setSearchTerm, setStatusFilter]);

  return {
    activeProjectInView,
    handleClearFocus,
    handleBackToGantt,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailInitialScroll.ts ==================== */
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup } from '../../types';
import { scrollToElement } from '../../lib/utils';
import {
  backfillMissingProjectDates,
  getAppBootAgeMs,
  BOOT_SYNC_GUARD_MS,
} from '../../lib/projectDatesService';

interface UseDetailInitialScrollParams {
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  initialFilterCode?: string;
  initialFocusTaskId?: string;
  setSearchTerm: (term: string) => void;
  setStatusFilter: (status: string) => void;
}

export function useDetailInitialScroll({
  projects,
  tasks,
  delegationGroups,
  initialFilterCode,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  setSearchTerm,
  setStatusFilter,
}: UseDetailInitialScrollParams) {

  // Initial Filter Code Scrolling & Tri-Gate Lazy Loading Target
  const lastProcessedFilterCodeRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      initialFilterCode &&
      initialFilterCode !== lastProcessedFilterCodeRef.current
    ) {
      lastProcessedFilterCodeRef.current = initialFilterCode;
      setSearchTerm(initialFilterCode);
      setStatusFilter('all');

      const filterUpper = String(initialFilterCode).trim().toUpperCase();
      const matchedProj =
        projects.find(
          (p) => String(p.code || '').trim().toUpperCase() === filterUpper
        ) ||
        projects.find(
          (p) =>
            p.code &&
            filterUpper.startsWith(String(p.code).trim().toUpperCase() + '-')
        ) ||
        projects.find(
          (p) =>
            p.code && filterUpper.includes(String(p.code).trim().toUpperCase())
        );

      // Keep parent row collapsed by default (Tri-Gate Lazy Loading rule).
      // If initialFocusTaskId is present, useDetailFocusTracking will scroll directly to the task.
      if (!initialFocusTaskId) {
        const tryScrollToProject = (attempts = 0) => {
          let el: HTMLElement | null = null;
          if (filterUpper.includes('#')) {
            const matchedTask = tasks.find((t) => 
              (t.taskCodePhu && String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toUpperCase() === filterUpper) ||
              (matchedProj && matchedProj.code && `${matchedProj.code}#${(t.orderIndex !== undefined ? t.orderIndex : 0) + 1}`.toUpperCase() === filterUpper)
            );
            if (matchedTask) {
              el = document.getElementById(`detail-task-${matchedTask.id}`);
            }
          }
          if (!el) {
            const pCode = matchedProj?.code || initialFilterCode;
            const pId = matchedProj?.id;
            el =
              (matchedProj
                ? document.getElementById(
                    `detail-project-${matchedProj.no ?? matchedProj.code}`
                  )
                : null) ||
              (pCode ? document.querySelector(`[data-project-code="${pCode}"]`) : null) ||
              (pCode ? document.querySelector(`[data-project-code="${pCode.toUpperCase()}"]`) : null) ||
              (pId ? document.querySelector(`[data-project-id="${pId}"]`) : null);
          }
          if (el && el instanceof HTMLElement) {
            scrollToElement(el);
          } else if (attempts < 12) {
            setTimeout(() => tryScrollToProject(attempts + 1), 80);
          }
        };
        requestAnimationFrame(() => tryScrollToProject(0));
      }
    } else if (
      !initialFilterCode &&
      lastProcessedFilterCodeRef.current !== null
    ) {
      lastProcessedFilterCodeRef.current = null;
      if (!initialFocusTaskId) setSearchTerm('');
    }
  }, [
    initialFilterCode,
    initialFocusTaskId,
    projects,
    setSearchTerm,
    setStatusFilter,
  ]);
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailOptions.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Project, Task, AppUser, AppRole, PermissionMatrix } from '../../types';
import { getUserAllowedStores } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLocationOptions } from '../../hooks/useLocationOptions';

interface UseDetailOptionsParams {
  currentUser: AppUser;
  locations: string[];
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  globalYearFilter: string;
  globalLocationFilter: string[];
  setGlobalLocationFilter: (locs: string[]) => void;
  permissionMatrix: PermissionMatrix;
}

export function useDetailOptions({
  currentUser,
  locations,
  projects,
  tasks,
  globalYearFilter,
  globalLocationFilter,
  setGlobalLocationFilter,
  permissionMatrix,
}: UseDetailOptionsParams) {
  const isAdmin = currentUser.role === 'admin';
  const role = currentUser.role as AppRole;
  const isArchiveYear = globalYearFilter !== 'all' && Number(globalYearFilter) < new Date().getFullYear();
  const hasWritePermission = (isAdmin || !!permissionMatrix[role]?.Write?.detail) && !isArchiveYear;
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const canWrite = hasWritePermission && isEditMode;

  const allowedStores = useMemo(() => getUserAllowedStores(currentUser), [currentUser]);
  const stores = allowedStores;

  const allowedStoreOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const allowed = getUserAllowedStores(currentUser);
    return allowed.map(s => ({ label: s, value: s }));
  }, [currentUser]);

  const locationFilterOptions = useLocationOptions();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (locationFilterOptions.length > 0 && globalLocationFilter.length > 0) {
      const valid = globalLocationFilter.filter(loc => locationFilterOptions.includes(loc));
      if (valid.length !== globalLocationFilter.length) {
        setGlobalLocationFilter(valid);
      }
    }
  }, [locationFilterOptions, globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  const allowedLocationOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (currentUser.role === 'admin') return Array.from(new Set(locations));
    return Array.from(new Set(locations)).filter(loc => 
      currentUser.locationPermissions?.['all'] || currentUser.locationPermissions?.[loc.toLowerCase()]
    );
  }, [locations, currentUser]);

  const years = useMemo(() => {
    const projYears = projects.map(p => {
      if (p.year) return String(p.year);
      if (p.start) return String(p.start).substring(0, 4);
      return null;
    }).filter(Boolean) as string[];
    const taskYears = tasks.map(t => {
      if (t.projectYear) return String(t.projectYear);
      if (t.start) return String(t.start).substring(0, 4);
      return null;
    }).filter(Boolean) as string[];
    const baseYears = ['2026', '2027'];
    const unique = Array.from(new Set([...projYears, ...taskYears, ...baseYears])).filter(Boolean).sort();
    return unique.length > 0 ? unique : ['2026', '2027'];
  }, [projects, tasks]);

  return {
    isAdmin,
    role,
    isArchiveYear,
    hasWritePermission,
    isEditMode,
    setIsEditMode,
    canWrite,
    stores,
    allowedStoreOptions,
    locationFilterOptions,
    allowedLocationOptions,
    years,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailProjectCsv.ts ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { downloadCSV, parseCSV, generateCSV } from '../../lib/csvUtils';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch, setDoc } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { undoManager } from '../../lib/undoManager';
import { recordDelta } from '../../lib/deltaSyncService';

interface UseDetailProjectCsvParams {
  filteredProjects: Project[];
  projects: Project[];
}

export function useDetailProjectCsv({ filteredProjects, projects }: UseDetailProjectCsvParams) {
  const handleExportProjects = () => {
    const headers = ['store', 'location', 'year', 'code', 'name'];
    const data = filteredProjects.map(p => [
      p.store || '', p.location || '', p.year || '', p.code || '', p.name || ''
    ]);
    const csv = generateCSV(headers, data);
    downloadCSV(csv, 'taka_projects_filtered.csv');
  };

  const handleImportProjects = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = async (event) => {
      try {
        const text = event.target?.result as string;
        const rows = parseCSV(text);
        
        if (rows.length < 2) {
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: 'CSV file is empty or has no data rows.' });
          return;
        }

        const headers = rows[0].map(h => h.trim().toLowerCase());
        const dataRows = rows.slice(1);

        // Required Field Validation
        let hasError = false;
        let errorMsg = '';
        for (let idx = 0; idx < dataRows.length; idx++) {
          const row = dataRows[idx];
          if (row.every(c => !String(c).trim())) continue;
          
          let hasYear = false, hasStore = false, hasCode = false;
          headers.forEach((h, i) => {
            const val = String(row[i] || '').trim();
            if ((h === 'year' || h === 'projectyear') && val) hasYear = true;
            if ((h === 'store' || h === 'projectstore') && val) hasStore = true;
            if ((h === 'code' || h === 'projectcode') && val) hasCode = true;
          });
          
          if (!hasYear || !hasStore || !hasCode) {
            hasError = true;
            errorMsg = `Row ${idx + 2} is missing Year, Store, or Code. All imported data must include these three fields.`;
            break;
          }
        }
        
        if (hasError) {
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: 'Import failed: ' + errorMsg });
          return;
        }

        let maxNo = projects.length > 0 ? Math.max(...projects.map(p => {
          const n = Number(p.no);
          return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
        })) : 0;

        const processedProjects = new Map<string, Project>();
        projects.forEach(p => {
          const key = `${String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(p.year || '').trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(p.store || '').trim().toLowerCase()}`;
          processedProjects.set(key, p);
        });

        const previousStates = new Map<string, any>();
        const newIds = new Set<string>();
        let importCount = 0;

        for (const row of dataRows) {
          if (row.length < headers.length) continue;
          const p: any = {};
          headers.forEach((h, i) => {
            const fieldMap: Record<string, keyof Project> = {
              'store': 'store',
              'projectstore': 'store',
              'location': 'location',
              'year': 'year',
              'projectyear': 'year',
              'code': 'code',
              'projectcode': 'code',
              'name': 'name',
              'task name': 'name'
            };
            
            const targetField = fieldMap[h];
            if (targetField) {
              let val: any = row[i];
              if (targetField === 'year') {
                val = !isNaN(Number(val)) ? Number(val) : String(val).trim();
              }
              p[targetField] = val;
            }
          });
          
          if (p.code && p.year) {
            const key = `${String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(p.year).trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(p.store || '').trim().toLowerCase()}`;
            const existing = processedProjects.get(key);
            let no = existing ? existing.no : null;
            let docId = existing ? (existing.id || String(existing.no)) : null;
            
            if (!no) {
              maxNo++;
              no = maxNo;
              docId = String(no);
              newIds.add(docId);
            } else if (!docId) {
              docId = String(no);
            }
            
            if (docId && !previousStates.has(docId) && existing) {
              previousStates.set(docId, existing);
            }
            
            const finalProject = existing ? { ...existing, ...p } : { ...p, no };
            
            // Remove computed fields and undefined values before saving to Firestore
            const toSave = { ...finalProject };
            if (toSave.year !== undefined && toSave.year !== null && toSave.year !== '' && !isNaN(Number(toSave.year))) {
              toSave.year = Number(toSave.year);
            }
            delete (toSave as any).id;
            delete (toSave as any).computedTakStart;
            delete (toSave as any).computedTakCompl;
            delete (toSave as any).computedOpening;
            
            Object.keys(toSave).forEach(key => {
              if ((toSave as any)[key] === undefined) {
                delete (toSave as any)[key];
              }
            });

            processedProjects.set(key, finalProject);
            setDoc(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId!), toSave);
            recordDelta({
              docId: docId!,
              collectionName: 'taka_projects',
              action: existing ? 'update' : 'create',
              data: toSave,
              year: String(toSave.year || '')
            }).catch(console.error);
            importCount++;
          }
        }
        
        if (importCount > 0) {
          undoManager.push({
            description: 'Import Projects',
            revert: async () => {
              const batch = writeBatch(db);
              previousStates.forEach((oldData, id) => {
                const toSave = { ...oldData };
                delete toSave.computedTakStart;
                delete toSave.computedTakCompl;
                delete toSave.computedOpening;
                delete toSave.id;
                batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', id), toSave);
              });
              newIds.forEach(id => {
                batch.delete(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', id));
              });
              try {
                batch.commit().catch(e => console.error("Batch commit failed", e));
              } catch (error: any) {
                console.error("Batch commit failed", error);
                useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
                return;
              }
            }
          });
        }
        
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Success", message: `Import Projects completed! Processed ${importCount} projects.` });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Import error:', err);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: 'Error importing CSV: ' + (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)) });
      } finally {
        e.target.value = '';
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  return {
    handleExportProjects,
    handleImportProjects,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailProjectInfo.ts ==================== */
import { useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { sortGroupTasks } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { getStatus } from '../../lib/utils';

export interface ProjectInfo {
  status: string;
  start: string;
  finish: string;
  computedTakStart?: string;
  computedTakCompl?: string;
  computedOpening?: string;
  sortedTasks: Task[];
}

interface UseDetailProjectInfoParams {
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
}

export function useDetailProjectInfo({ projects, tasks }: UseDetailProjectInfoParams) {
  const { tasksByProjectId, tasksByProjectKey, tasksByCodeMap } = useMemo(() => {
    const idMap = new Map<string, Task[]>();
    const keyMap = new Map<string, Task[]>();
    const codeMap = new Map<string, Task[]>();
    for (let idx = 0; idx < tasks.length; idx++) {
      const t = tasks[idx];
      if (t.isDeleted) continue;
      if (t.projectId) {
        const pIdStr = String(t.projectId);
        let pList = idMap.get(pIdStr);
        if (!pList) {
          pList = [];
          idMap.set(pIdStr, pList);
        }
        pList.push(t);
      }
      const key = `${t.projectCode || ''}-${t.projectYear || ''}-${t.projectStore || ''}`;
      let list = keyMap.get(key);
      if (!list) {
        list = [];
        keyMap.set(key, list);
      }
      list.push(t);
      if (t.projectCode) {
        const c = String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase();
        let cList = codeMap.get(c);
        if (!cList) {
          cList = [];
          codeMap.set(c, cList);
        }
        cList.push(t);
      }
    }
    return { tasksByProjectId: idMap, tasksByProjectKey: keyMap, tasksByCodeMap: codeMap };
  }, [tasks]);

  const projectInfoMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, ProjectInfo>();

    projects.forEach(p => {
      const mergedTasksMap = new Map<string, Task>();

      if (p.id && tasksByProjectId.has(String(p.id))) {
        tasksByProjectId.get(String(p.id))!.forEach(t => {
          if (t && (t.id || t.name)) mergedTasksMap.set(String(t.id || t.name), t);
        });
      }

      const key = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}`;
      const foundByKey = tasksByProjectKey.get(key);
      if (foundByKey && foundByKey.length > 0) {
        foundByKey.forEach(t => {
          if (t && (t.id || t.name)) mergedTasksMap.set(String(t.id || t.name), t);
        });
      }

      const pCode = String(p.code || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      if (pCode) {
        const candidateTasks = tasksByCodeMap.get(pCode) || [];
        candidateTasks.forEach(t => {
          const matchesStore = !t.projectStore || !p.store || String(t.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() === String(p.store).trim().toLowerCase();
          const matchesYear = !t.projectYear || !p.year || String(t.projectYear).trim() === String(p.year).trim();
          if (matchesStore && matchesYear && t && (t.id || t.name)) {
            mergedTasksMap.set(String(t.id || t.name), t);
          }
        });
      }

      let rawGroupTasks: Task[] = Array.from(mergedTasksMap.values());
      if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
        // Merge: In-memory tasks take precedence, but keep all summary tasks to ensure the count is correct
        const existingMap = new Map<string, any>();
        rawGroupTasks.forEach(t => {
          if (t.id) existingMap.set(String(t.id).toLowerCase(), t);
          if (t.taskCodePhu) existingMap.set(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase(), t);
          const nameKey = String(t.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          if (nameKey) existingMap.set(nameKey, t);
        });

        const merged = [...rawGroupTasks];
        p.taskSummaries.forEach((ts, idx) => {
          const tsId = ts.id ? String(ts.id).toLowerCase() : '';
          const tsCode = ts.taskCodePhu ? String(ts.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
          const tsName = ts.name ? String(ts.name).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
          const match = (tsId && existingMap.has(tsId)) ||
                        (tsCode && existingMap.has(tsCode)) ||
                        (tsName && existingMap.has(tsName));
          if (!match) {
            merged.push({
              id: ts.id || `ts_${p.code || p.id}_${p.store || 'HCM'}_${p.year || ''}_${idx}`,
              name: ts.name || `Task ${idx + 1}`,
              start: ts.start || p.computedTakStart || p.start || '',
              finish: ts.finish || p.computedTakCompl || p.handover || '',
              projectCode: p.code || '',
              projectStore: p.store || 'HCM',
              projectYear: p.year ? String(p.year) : '',
              party: ts.party || p.party || '',
              runningStatus: ts.runningStatus || 'On process',
              duration: ts.duration || '',
              parentTaskId: ts.parentTaskId,
              taskCodePhu: ts.taskCodePhu || (p.code ? `${p.code}#${idx + 1}` : undefined),
              orderIndex: ts.orderIndex !== undefined ? ts.orderIndex : idx,
              projectId: p.id,
              ...ts
            } as Task);
          }
        });
        rawGroupTasks = merged;
      }
      const sortedTasks = sortGroupTasks(rawGroupTasks || []);
      let computedTakStart = p.computedTakStart || p.start;
      let computedTakCompl: string | undefined = p.computedTakCompl || p.handover;
      let computedOpening = p.computedOpening || p.opening;

      if (sortedTasks.length > 0) {
        let minStart: string | undefined = undefined;
        let maxFinish: string | undefined = undefined;
        for (let i = 0; i < sortedTasks.length; i++) {
          const t = sortedTasks[i];
          if (t.start && (!minStart || t.start < minStart)) {
            minStart = t.start;
          }
          if (t.finish && (!maxFinish || t.finish > maxFinish)) {
            maxFinish = t.finish;
          }
          const name = String(t.name || '').toLowerCase();
          if (name.includes('opening') || name.includes('open')) {
            if (t.finish && (!computedOpening || t.finish > computedOpening)) {
              computedOpening = t.finish;
            }
          }
        }
        if (minStart) computedTakStart = minStart;
        if (maxFinish) computedTakCompl = maxFinish;
      } else if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
        let minStart: string | undefined = undefined;
        let maxFinish: string | undefined = undefined;
        for (let i = 0; i < p.taskSummaries.length; i++) {
          const ts = p.taskSummaries[i];
          if (ts.start && (!minStart || ts.start < minStart)) {
            minStart = ts.start;
          }
          if (ts.finish && (!maxFinish || ts.finish > maxFinish)) {
            maxFinish = ts.finish;
          }
          const name = String(ts.name || '').toLowerCase();
          if (name.includes('opening') || name.includes('open')) {
            if (ts.finish && (!computedOpening || ts.finish > computedOpening)) {
              computedOpening = ts.finish;
            }
          }
        }
        if (minStart) computedTakStart = minStart;
        if (maxFinish) computedTakCompl = maxFinish;
      }

      const status = p.computedStatus || getStatus(computedTakStart, computedTakCompl, computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
      const finish = computedTakCompl || computedOpening || p.opening || '9999-12-31';
      const pUniqueKey = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}-${p.id || p.no}`;
      map.set(pUniqueKey, {
        status,
        start: computedTakStart || '9999-12-31',
        finish,
        computedTakStart,
        computedTakCompl,
        computedOpening,
        sortedTasks
      });
    });
    return map;
  }, [projects, tasksByProjectKey, tasksByCodeMap]);

  const getProjectInfo = useCallback((p: Project): ProjectInfo => {
    const pUniqueKey = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}-${p.id || p.no}`;
    const cached = projectInfoMap.get(pUniqueKey);
    if (cached) return cached;
    
    let rawGroupTasks = p.id ? tasksByProjectId.get(String(p.id)) : undefined;
    if (!rawGroupTasks || rawGroupTasks.length === 0) {
      const key = `${p.code || ''}-${p.year || ''}-${p.store || ''}`;
      rawGroupTasks = tasksByProjectKey.get(key);
    }
    if (!rawGroupTasks || rawGroupTasks.length === 0) {
      const pCode = String(p.code || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      const candidateTasks = tasksByCodeMap.get(pCode) || [];
      rawGroupTasks = candidateTasks.filter(t => {
        const matchesStore = !t.projectStore || !p.store || String(t.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() === String(p.store).trim().toLowerCase();
        const matchesYear = !t.projectYear || !p.year || String(t.projectYear).trim() === String(p.year).trim();
        return matchesStore && matchesYear;
      });
    }
    if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
      // Merge: In-memory tasks take precedence, but keep all summary tasks to ensure the count is correct
      const existingMap = new Map<string, any>();
      rawGroupTasks?.forEach(t => {
        if (t.id) existingMap.set(String(t.id).toLowerCase(), t);
        if (t.taskCodePhu) existingMap.set(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase(), t);
        const nameKey = String(t.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (nameKey) existingMap.set(nameKey, t);
      });

      const merged = [...(rawGroupTasks || [])];
      p.taskSummaries.forEach((ts, idx) => {
        const tsId = ts.id ? String(ts.id).toLowerCase() : '';
        const tsCode = ts.taskCodePhu ? String(ts.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        const tsName = ts.name ? String(ts.name).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
        const match = (tsId && existingMap.has(tsId)) ||
                      (tsCode && existingMap.has(tsCode)) ||
                      (tsName && existingMap.has(tsName));
        if (!match) {
          merged.push({
            id: ts.id || `ts_${p.code || p.id}_${p.store || 'HCM'}_${p.year || ''}_${idx}`,
            name: ts.name || `Task ${idx + 1}`,
            start: ts.start || p.computedTakStart || p.start || '',
            finish: ts.finish || p.computedTakCompl || p.handover || '',
            projectCode: p.code || '',
            projectStore: p.store || 'HCM',
            projectYear: p.year ? String(p.year) : '',
            party: ts.party || p.party || '',
            runningStatus: ts.runningStatus || 'On process',
            duration: ts.duration || '',
            parentTaskId: ts.parentTaskId,
            taskCodePhu: ts.taskCodePhu || (p.code ? `${p.code}#${idx + 1}` : undefined),
            orderIndex: ts.orderIndex !== undefined ? ts.orderIndex : idx,
            projectId: p.id,
            ...ts
          } as Task);
        }
      });
      rawGroupTasks = merged;
    }
    const sortedTasks = sortGroupTasks(rawGroupTasks || []);
    let computedTakStart = p.computedTakStart || p.start;
    let computedTakCompl: string | undefined = p.computedTakCompl || p.handover;
    let computedOpening = p.computedOpening || (p.openingMode === 'manual' ? p.opening : '');

    if (sortedTasks.length > 0) {
      let minStart: string | undefined = undefined;
      let maxFinish: string | undefined = undefined;
      let hasOpeningTask = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < sortedTasks.length; i++) {
        const t = sortedTasks[i];
        if (t.start && (!minStart || t.start < minStart)) minStart = t.start;
        if (t.finish && (!maxFinish || t.finish > maxFinish)) maxFinish = t.finish;
        const name = String(t.name || '').toLowerCase();
        if (name.includes('opening') || name.includes('open')) {
          if (t.finish && (!hasOpeningTask || t.finish > computedOpening)) {
            computedOpening = t.finish;
            hasOpeningTask = true;
          }
        }
      }
      if (minStart) computedTakStart = minStart;
      if (maxFinish) computedTakCompl = maxFinish;
      if (!hasOpeningTask && p.openingMode !== 'manual') {
        computedOpening = '';
      }
    } else if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
      let minStart: string | undefined = undefined;
      let maxFinish: string | undefined = undefined;
      let hasOpeningTask = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < p.taskSummaries.length; i++) {
        const ts = p.taskSummaries[i];
        if (ts.start && (!minStart || ts.start < minStart)) minStart = ts.start;
        if (ts.finish && (!maxFinish || ts.finish > maxFinish)) maxFinish = ts.finish;
        const name = String(ts.name || '').toLowerCase();
        if (name.includes('opening') || name.includes('open')) {
          if (ts.finish && (!hasOpeningTask || ts.finish > computedOpening)) {
            computedOpening = ts.finish;
            hasOpeningTask = true;
          }
        }
      }
      if (minStart) computedTakStart = minStart;
      if (maxFinish) computedTakCompl = maxFinish;
      if (!hasOpeningTask && p.openingMode !== 'manual') {
        computedOpening = '';
      }
    }

    const status = p.computedStatus || getStatus(computedTakStart, computedTakCompl, computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
    const finish = computedTakCompl || computedOpening || p.opening || '9999-12-31';
    return { status, start: computedTakStart || '9999-12-31', finish, sortedTasks, computedTakStart, computedTakCompl, computedOpening };
  }, [projectInfoMap, tasksByProjectKey, tasksByCodeMap]);

  return {
    tasksByProjectKey,
    tasksByCodeMap,
    projectInfoMap,
    getProjectInfo,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailProjectMutations.ts ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch, setDoc } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { undoManager } from '../../lib/undoManager';
import { extractStorageUrls, deleteStorageFiles } from '../../lib/storageUtils';
import { getProjectCodeChangePredecessorUpdates } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { generateId } from '../../lib/utils';
import { deleteTaskStateUnified } from '../../lib/taskStateService';

interface UseDetailProjectMutationsParams {
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  setConfirmModal: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    onConfirm: () => Promise<void>;
  }>>;
}

export function useDetailProjectMutations({
  projects,
  tasks,
  delegationGroups,
  currentUser,
  setConfirmModal,
}: UseDetailProjectMutationsParams) {
  const handleDeleteProject = async (p: Project) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: 'Delete Project',
      message: `Delete project ${p.code} and all associated tasks and data?`,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          const { deleteProjectStateUnified } = await import('../../lib/taskStateService');
          await deleteProjectStateUnified(p.id || String(p.no) || p.code, p);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Success",
            message: `Deleted project ${p.code} successfully.`,
            type: "success"
          });
        } catch (e: any) {
          console.error("Delete project error:", e);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Error",
            message: e?.message || "Failed to delete project.",
            type: "error"
          });
        }
      }
    });
  };

  const handleUpdateProject = async (p: Project, field: keyof Project, value: any) => {
    try {
      if ((field === 'code' || field === 'year' || field === 'store') && value !== p[field]) {
        const newCode = field === 'code' ? value : p.code;
        const newYear = field === 'year' ? value : p.year;
        const newStore = field === 'store' ? value : p.store;
        const isDuplicate = projects.some(proj => 
          proj.no !== p.no &&
          String(proj.code).trim().toLowerCase() === String(newCode).trim().toLowerCase() &&
          String(proj.year) === String(newYear) &&
          String(proj.store) === String(newStore)
        );
        if (isDuplicate) {
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: `Project code "${newCode}" already exists in year ${newYear} - Store ${newStore}. Please enter a different code.` });
          return;
        }
      }

      if ((field === 'code' || field === 'year' || field === 'store') && value !== p[field]) {
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        const docId = p.id || p.id!;
        const pRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId);
        const dataToSave = { ...p, [field]: value, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        
        // Remove id and computed fields before saving
        delete (dataToSave as any).id;
        delete (dataToSave as any).computedTakStart;
        delete (dataToSave as any).computedTakCompl;
        delete (dataToSave as any).computedOpening;
        
        // Sanitize dataToSave
        Object.keys(dataToSave).forEach(key => {
          if ((dataToSave as any)[key] === undefined) delete (dataToSave as any)[key];
        });
        batch.set(pRef, dataToSave);

        const projectCodeUpdate = field === 'code' ? value : p.code;
        const projectYearUpdate = field === 'year' ? value : p.year;
        const projectStoreUpdate = field === 'store' ? value : p.store;

        // Compute cascaded code & predecessor updates across all tasks
        const { taskUpdates, predecessorUpdates } = getProjectCodeChangePredecessorUpdates(
          p,
          projectCodeUpdate,
          projectYearUpdate,
          projectStoreUpdate,
          tasks,
          projects
        );

        // Update all tasks with this project identity
        const relatedTasks = tasks.filter(t => 
          t.projectCode === p.code && 
          (t.projectYear == p.year || (!t.projectYear && !p.year)) &&
          (t.projectStore == p.store || (!t.projectStore && !p.store))
        );
        const relatedTaskIds = new Set(relatedTasks.map(t => t.id));

        relatedTasks.forEach(t => {
          const tRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id);
          const tUpdate = taskUpdates.get(t.id) || {
            projectCode: projectCodeUpdate,
            projectYear: projectYearUpdate,
            projectStore: projectStoreUpdate
          };
          const pu = predecessorUpdates.find(item => item.id === t.id);
          const payload: any = {
            ...tUpdate,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          };
          if (pu) {
            payload.predecessor = pu.predecessor;
          }
          batch.update(tRef, payload);
        });

        // Update predecessor for tasks in other projects that reference this project
        predecessorUpdates.forEach(pu => {
          if (!relatedTaskIds.has(pu.id)) {
            const tRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', pu.id);
            batch.update(tRef, {
              predecessor: pu.predecessor,
              updatedAt: pu.updatedAt
            });
          }
        });
        
        // Update all costs with this project identity from memory store (Zero-read optimization)
        const storeCosts = useAppStore.getState().costs || [];
        const relatedCosts = storeCosts.filter(c => {
          const matchesCode = c.projectCode === p.code;
          const matchesYear = c.projectYear == p.year || (!c.projectYear && !p.year);
          const matchesStore = c.projectStore == p.store || (!c.projectStore && !p.store);
          return matchesCode && matchesYear && matchesStore;
        });
        relatedCosts.forEach(c => {
          const cRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', c.id);
          batch.update(cRef, { 
            projectCode: projectCodeUpdate,
            projectYear: projectYearUpdate,
            projectStore: projectStoreUpdate
          });
        });

        // Optimistic update in Zustand store (0ms UI latency)
        const predMap = new Map(predecessorUpdates.map(pu => [pu.id, pu.predecessor]));
        const updatedTasks = tasks.map(t => {
          const tUpdate = taskUpdates.get(t.id);
          const newPred = predMap.get(t.id);
          if (tUpdate || newPred !== undefined) {
            return {
              ...t,
              ...(tUpdate || {}),
              ...(newPred !== undefined ? { predecessor: newPred, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : {})
            };
          }
          return t;
        });
        useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);
        const updatedProjects = projects.map(proj => proj.id === p.id ? { ...proj, ...dataToSave, id: p.id, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : proj);
        useAppStore.getState().setProjects(updatedProjects);

        batch.commit().catch(e => {
          console.error("Batch commit failed", e);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
        });
        
        undoManager.push({
          description: `Update Project Identity: ${p.code}(${p.year || ''}) -> ${projectCodeUpdate}(${projectYearUpdate || ''})`,
          revert: async () => {
            const revertBatch = writeBatch(db);
            revertBatch.set(pRef, p);
            relatedTasks.forEach(t => {
              const tRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id);
              revertBatch.update(tRef, { 
                projectCode: p.code, 
                projectYear: p.year,
                projectStore: p.store,
                ...(t.taskCodePhu !== undefined ? { taskCodePhu: t.taskCodePhu } : {}),
                ...(t.predecessor !== undefined ? { predecessor: t.predecessor } : {})
              });
            });
            predecessorUpdates.forEach(pu => {
              if (!relatedTaskIds.has(pu.id)) {
                const originalTask = tasks.find(st => st.id === pu.id);
                revertBatch.update(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', pu.id), {
                  predecessor: originalTask?.predecessor || ''
                });
              }
            });
            relatedCosts.forEach(c => {
              const cRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_costs', c.id);
              revertBatch.update(cRef, { projectCode: p.code, projectYear: p.year, projectStore: p.store });
            });
            revertBatch.commit().catch(console.error);
          }
        });
      } else {
        const docId = p.id || p.id!;
        const pRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId);
        const dataToSave = { ...p, [field]: value, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        
        // Remove id and computed fields before saving
        delete (dataToSave as any).id;
        delete (dataToSave as any).computedTakStart;
        delete (dataToSave as any).computedTakCompl;
        delete (dataToSave as any).computedOpening;
        
        // Sanitize dataToSave to remove any undefined fields
        Object.keys(dataToSave).forEach(key => {
          if ((dataToSave as any)[key] === undefined) {
            delete (dataToSave as any)[key];
          }
        });
        
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        batch.set(pRef, dataToSave);

        if (field === 'delegation' && value === true) {
           const existingGroup = delegationGroups.find(g => g.parentTaskId === p.code && (!g.projectStore || g.projectStore === p.store) && (!g.projectYear || String(g.projectYear) === String(p.year)));
           const storeKey = p.store || 'HCM';
           const yearKey = (p.year !== undefined && p.year !== null && !isNaN(Number(p.year))) ? Number(p.year) : new Date().getFullYear();
           const deterministicGroupId = existingGroup?.id || `del_proj_${p.code}_${storeKey}_${yearKey}`;
           
           if (!existingGroup) {
              const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
              const newGroup: DelegationGroup = {
                id: deterministicGroupId,
                parentTaskId: p.code,
                name: p.name || 'Delegated Project',
                projectCode: p.code,
                projectStore: p.store,
                projectYear: yearKey,
                subTasks: [{ 
                   id: generateId(), 
                   name: '', 
                   comments: '', 
                   status: 'Assigned', 
                   delegationStatus: 'Assigned', 
                   priority: 'Mid', 
                   party: currentUser.username || '', 
                   startAct: dateStr, 
                   finishAct: dateStr, 
                   updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() 
                }],
                updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                createdBy: currentUser.id
              };
              const delRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', deterministicGroupId);
              batch.set(delRef, newGroup, { merge: true });
           }
        }
        
        try {
          await batch.commit();
        } catch (error: any) {
          console.error("Batch commit failed", error);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
          return;
        }
        
        undoManager.push({
          description: `Update Project: ${p.code}`,
          revert: async () => {
            setDoc(pRef, p);
          }
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  return {
    handleDeleteProject,
    handleUpdateProject,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailTaskCsv.ts ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Project, Task, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { downloadCSV, generateCSV } from '../../lib/csvUtils';
import { sortGroupTasks } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { formatToCSVDate, parseCSVDate } from './detailCsvUtils';
import { parseTasksFile } from './detailTaskImportParser';
import { executeImportTasks } from './detailTaskImportExecutor';

interface UseDetailTaskCsvParams {
  filteredProjects: Project[];
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  appUsers: AppUser[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
}

export function useDetailTaskCsv({
  filteredProjects,
  projects,
  tasks,
  appUsers,
  currentUser,
}: UseDetailTaskCsvParams) {
  const handleExportTasks = () => {
    const headers = [
      'store',
      'location',
      'projectYear',
      'projectCode',
      'Sub-task code',
      'Task name',
      'Parent task code',
      'start',
      'finish',
      'duration',
      'party',
      'predecessor',
      'delegation',
      'task flexible',
      'comments'
    ];

    const filteredTasksToExport: Task[] = [];
    filteredProjects.forEach(p => {
      const groupTasks = sortGroupTasks(tasks.filter(t => 
        t.projectCode === p.code && 
        (t.projectYear == p.year || (!t.projectYear && !p.year)) &&
        (t.projectStore == p.store || (!t.projectStore && !p.store))
      ));
      filteredTasksToExport.push(...groupTasks);
    });

    const data = filteredTasksToExport.map((t, idx) => {
      const p = projects.find(proj => 
        proj.code === t.projectCode && 
        (t.projectYear == proj.year || (!t.projectYear && !proj.year)) &&
        (t.projectStore == proj.store || (!t.projectStore && !proj.store))
      );
      const subTaskCode = t.taskCodePhu || (p ? `${p.code}#${t.orderIndex !== undefined ? t.orderIndex + 1 : idx + 1}` : '');
      const parentTask = t.parentTaskId ? tasks.find(pt => String(pt.id) === String(t.parentTaskId)) : null;

      const commentsText = t.comments && t.comments.length > 0 
        ? t.comments.map(c => {
            const author = appUsers.find(u => 
              u.id === c.userId || 
              (u.username && String(u.username).toLowerCase() === String(c.userId).toLowerCase())
            );
            const name = c.userName || author?.username || c.userId || '';
            return `${name ? name + ': ' : ''}${c.text}`;
          }).join(' | ') 
        : '';

      return [
        t.projectStore || p?.store || '',
        p?.location || '',
        t.projectYear || p?.year || '',
        t.projectCode || '', 
        subTaskCode,
        t.name || '', 
        parentTask ? (parentTask.taskCodePhu || parentTask.name || '') : '',
        formatToCSVDate(t.start), 
        formatToCSVDate(t.finish), 
        t.duration !== undefined ? t.duration : '',
        t.party || '',
        t.predecessor || '',
        t.delegation ? 'true' : 'false',
        t.realtimeUpdate ? 'true' : 'false',
        commentsText
      ];
    });

    const csv = generateCSV(headers, data);
    downloadCSV(csv, 'taka_tasks_filtered.csv');
  };

  const handleImportTasks = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    try {
      const rawParsedRowsByProject = await parseTasksFile(file, projects);
      const { count } = await executeImportTasks({
        rawParsedRowsByProject,
        projects,
        tasks,
        appUsers,
        currentUser
      });

      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Import Tasks completed! Processed ${count} tasks without duplicates.`
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Import error:", err);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Notice",
        message: "Failed to import file: " + (err?.message || "File processing error"),
        type: "error"
      });
    } finally {
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  return {
    handleExportTasks,
    handleImportTasks,
    parseCSVDate,
    formatToCSVDate,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailTaskMutations.ts ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Project, Task, DelegationGroup, AppUser, TaskNote } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { undoManager } from '../../lib/undoManager';
import { extractStorageUrls, deleteStorageFiles } from '../../lib/storageUtils';
import { 
  buildTaskNoMap, 
  splitPredecessors, 
  parsePredecessors, 
  computeTaskCode, 
  updatePredecessorsStrings, 
  calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors, 
  scheduleDependentTasks 
} from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { parseDateTime, formatToDatetimeLocal, generateId } from '../../lib/utils';
import { cleanDurationString, rollupParentTaskDates } from '../../lib/taskImportService';
import { normalizeTaskNameForComparison } from '../../lib/taskDeduplicationService';
import { ensureProjectTasksLoaded, saveTaskStateUnified, deleteTaskStateUnified } from '../../lib/taskStateService';
import { recordBatchDeltas } from '../../lib/deltaSyncService';
import { createPatchDeltaItem } from '../../lib/deltaPatchService';
import { TakaDeltaItem } from '../../types';

interface UseDetailTaskMutationsParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  setConfirmModal: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    onConfirm: () => Promise<void>;
  }>>;
}

export function useDetailTaskMutations({
  tasks,
  projects,
  delegationGroups,
  currentUser,
  setConfirmModal,
}: UseDetailTaskMutationsParams) {
  const handleDeleteTask = async (t: Task) => {
    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: 'Delete Task',
      message: 'Delete this Task?',
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
          const batch = writeBatch(db);
          batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id), { id: t.id, isDeleted: true, updatedAt: nowIso }, { merge: true });
          
          const urlsToDelete = extractStorageUrls(t);
          if (urlsToDelete.length > 0) { 
             deleteStorageFiles(urlsToDelete).catch(console.error);
          }
          
          // Delete related delegations for this task from memory store (Zero-read optimization)
          const storeDelegations = useAppStore.getState().delegationGroups || [];
          const relatedDelGroups = storeDelegations.filter(d => d.parentTaskId === t.id || d.id === `del_${t.id}`);
          const delegationsToDelete = relatedDelGroups.map(d => ({ id: d.id, data: d }));
          relatedDelGroups.forEach(d => {
            batch.delete(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', d.id));
          });

          try {
            await batch.commit();
          } catch (error: any) {
            console.error("Batch commit failed", error);
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
            return;
          }

          // Xóa tức thì khỏi Zustand store & đồng bộ lại tiến độ/mốc ngày của Project
          deleteTaskStateUnified([t]);
          
          undoManager.push({
            description: `Delete Task: ${t.name}`,
            revert: async () => {
              const revertBatch = writeBatch(db);
              revertBatch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id), t);
              delegationsToDelete.forEach(d => {
                revertBatch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', d.id), d.data);
              });
              revertBatch.commit().catch(console.error);
            }
          });
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        }
      }
    });
  };

  const handleUpdateTask = async (
    t: Task, 
    updates: Partial<Task>, 
    _options?: { skipPredecessorRecalc?: boolean; skipProjectRollup?: boolean }
  ) => {
    try {
      if (updates.name && updates.name !== t.name) {
        const currentProject = projects.find(p => 
          p.code === t.projectCode &&
          (String(p.year || '') === String(t.projectYear || '') || (!p.year && !t.projectYear)) &&
          (String(p.store || '') === String(t.projectStore || '') || (!p.store && !t.projectStore))
        );
        if (currentProject) {
          const normUpdateName = normalizeTaskNameForComparison(updates.name, currentProject.code);
          const isDuplicate = tasks.some(tsk => {
            if (tsk.id === t.id || tsk.isDeleted) return false;
            const sameProject = tsk.projectCode === currentProject.code &&
                   (String(tsk.projectYear || '') === String(currentProject.year || '') || (!tsk.projectYear && !currentProject.year)) &&
                   (String(tsk.projectStore || '') === String(currentProject.store || '') || (!tsk.projectStore && !currentProject.store));
            if (!sameProject) return false;

            if (tsk.name.trim().toLowerCase() === (updates.name || '').trim().toLowerCase()) return true;
            const tNorm = normalizeTaskNameForComparison(tsk.name, tsk.projectCode);
            return !!(normUpdateName && tNorm && normUpdateName === tNorm);
          });
          if (isDuplicate) {
            useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: `Task name "${updates.name}" already exists in project ${currentProject.code} (${currentProject.year} - ${currentProject.store}). Please enter a different name.` });
            return;
          }
        }
      }

      if (updates.predecessor !== undefined && updates.predecessor !== t.predecessor) {
        let val = updates.predecessor;
        const taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);
        let parts = splitPredecessors(val, taskNoMap);
        if (parts.length > 2) parts = parts.slice(0, 2);
        
        if (parts.length >= 2) {
          updates.durationManual = false;
          if (!/FF|SF/i.test(parts[1])) {
            if (!/SS|FS/i.test(parts[1])) parts[1] += "FF";
            else parts[1] = parts[1].replace(/SS|FS/ig, "FF");
          }
          updates.predecessor = parts.join(', ');
        }
        parsePredecessors(updates.predecessor, taskNoMap, t);
      }

      let predecessorUpdates: { id: string; predecessor: string; updatedAt: string }[] = [];
      if (updates.taskCodePhu !== undefined && updates.taskCodePhu !== t.taskCodePhu) {
        const oldCode = (t.taskCodePhu || computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, t)).trim();
        const newCode = (updates.taskCodePhu || computeTaskCode(projects, tasks.map(item => item.id === t.id ? { ...item, ...updates } : item), { ...t, ...updates })).trim();
        if (oldCode && newCode && oldCode.toLowerCase() !== newCode.toLowerCase()) {
          const map = new Map<string, string>();
          map.set(oldCode.toLowerCase(), newCode);
          predecessorUpdates = updatePredecessorsStrings(map, tasks, projects);
        }
      }

      let targetTaskId = t.id;
      if (targetTaskId && targetTaskId.startsWith('ts_')) {
        let realTask = tasks.find(tsk => 
          !tsk.id.startsWith('ts_') &&
          tsk.projectCode === t.projectCode &&
          ((t.taskCodePhu && tsk.taskCodePhu === t.taskCodePhu) ||
           (t.name && tsk.name && tsk.name.trim().toLowerCase() === t.name.trim().toLowerCase()))
        );
        if (!realTask && t.projectCode) {
          try {
            const { collection, query, where, getDocs } = await import('firebase/firestore');
            const q = query(
              collection(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks'),
              where('projectCode', '==', t.projectCode)
            );
            const snap = await getDocs(q);
            const loaded: Task[] = [];
            snap.forEach(d => {
              const dt = { id: d.id, ...d.data() } as Task;
              if (!dt.isDeleted) loaded.push(dt);
            });
            if (loaded.length > 0) {
              const latestTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || tasks;
              useAppStore.getState().setTasks([...latestTasks.filter(tsk => !tsk.id.startsWith('ts_')), ...loaded]);
              realTask = loaded.find(tsk =>
                (t.taskCodePhu && tsk.taskCodePhu === t.taskCodePhu) ||
                (t.name && tsk.name && tsk.name.trim().toLowerCase() === t.name.trim().toLowerCase())
              );
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn("Failed to fetch real task for ts_ in Firestore:", err);
          }
        }
        if (realTask) {
          targetTaskId = realTask.id;
        } else {
          targetTaskId = `t_${Date.now()}_${generateId().substring(0, 8)}`;
        }
      }
      const tRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', targetTaskId);
      
      let newT = { ...t, id: targetTaskId, ...updates, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      if (updates.predecessor !== undefined) {
        let currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || tasks;
        let taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, currentTasks);
        let parts = splitPredecessors(updates.predecessor, taskNoMap);
        if (parts.length >= 2) {
          newT.durationManual = false;
        }
        newT.realtimeUpdate = Boolean(updates.predecessor.trim());
        let parsed = parsePredecessors(updates.predecessor, taskNoMap, newT);
        
        if (updates.predecessor.trim() && (!parsed.length || parsed.some(p => !p.task))) {
          for (const token of parts) {
            const cleanToken = token.replace(/(fs|ss|ff|sf|[+-]\s*\d+|\s+\d+)$/i, '').trim();
            const matchedProj = projects.find(p => p.code && cleanToken.toLowerCase().startsWith(p.code.toLowerCase()));
            if (matchedProj && matchedProj.code !== t.projectCode) {
              const loaded = await ensureProjectTasksLoaded(matchedProj.code);
              if (loaded.length > 0) {
                currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || currentTasks;
                taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, currentTasks);
                parsed = parsePredecessors(updates.predecessor, taskNoMap, newT);
              }
            }
          }
        }
        const calcResult = calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors(newT, parsed);
        if (calcResult) {
          newT.start = calcResult.start;
          newT.finish = calcResult.finish;
          newT.duration = calcResult.duration;
          newT.durationManual = calcResult.durationManual;
        }
      } else if (newT.predecessor) {
        newT.realtimeUpdate = Boolean(newT.predecessor.trim());
      }
      
      if (updates.finish !== undefined) {
        if (newT.start && newT.finish) {
          const s = parseDateTime(newT.start);
          const f = parseDateTime(newT.finish);
          if (s && f && !isNaN(s.getTime()) && !isNaN(f.getTime())) {
            const diffDays = (f.getTime() - s.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
            newT.duration = String(diffDays >= 0 ? Number(diffDays.toFixed(2)) : 0);
          }
        }
      } else if (updates.start !== undefined) {
        if (newT.durationManual) {
          if (newT.start && newT.duration !== undefined && newT.duration !== '') {
            const s = parseDateTime(newT.start);
            if (s && !isNaN(s.getTime())) {
              const days = parseFloat(String(newT.duration));
              if (!isNaN(days) && days >= 0) {
                const f = new Date(s.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
                newT.finish = formatToDatetimeLocal(f);
              }
            }
          }
        } else {
          if (newT.start && newT.finish) {
            const s = parseDateTime(newT.start);
            const f = parseDateTime(newT.finish);
            if (s && f && !isNaN(s.getTime()) && !isNaN(f.getTime())) {
              const diffDays = (f.getTime() - s.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
              newT.duration = String(diffDays >= 0 ? Number(diffDays.toFixed(2)) : 0);
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (updates.duration !== undefined) {
        newT.duration = cleanDurationString(updates.duration);
        newT.durationManual = true;
        if (newT.start && newT.duration !== '') {
          const s = parseDateTime(newT.start);
          if (s && !isNaN(s.getTime())) {
            const days = parseFloat(newT.duration);
            if (!isNaN(days) && days >= 0) {
              const f = new Date(s.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
              newT.finish = formatToDatetimeLocal(f);
            }
          }
        }
      } else if (updates.predecessor === undefined) {
        if (newT.durationManual) {
          if (newT.start && newT.duration !== undefined && newT.duration !== '') {
            const s = parseDateTime(newT.start);
            if (s && !isNaN(s.getTime())) {
              const days = parseFloat(String(newT.duration));
              if (!isNaN(days) && days >= 0) {
                const f = new Date(s.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
                newT.finish = formatToDatetimeLocal(f);
              }
            }
          }
        } else {
          if (newT.start && newT.finish) {
            const s = parseDateTime(newT.start);
            const f = parseDateTime(newT.finish);
            if (s && f && !isNaN(s.getTime()) && !isNaN(f.getTime())) {
              const diffDays = (f.getTime() - s.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
              newT.duration = String(diffDays >= 0 ? Number(diffDays.toFixed(2)) : 0);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const updatesToDependents = scheduleDependentTasks(newT, tasks, projects);
      const batch = writeBatch(db);

      const scheduledUpdatedTask = updatesToDependents.find(d => d.id === newT.id);
      if (scheduledUpdatedTask) {
        newT = scheduledUpdatedTask as any;
      }

      const allCurrentTasksWithScheduled = tasks.map(tsk => {
        if (tsk.id === newT.id) return newT;
        const dep = updatesToDependents.find(d => d.id === tsk.id);
        return dep || tsk;
      });
      if (!allCurrentTasksWithScheduled.some(tsk => tsk.id === newT.id)) {
        allCurrentTasksWithScheduled.push(newT);
      }
      const { updatedParents } = rollupParentTaskDates(allCurrentTasksWithScheduled);

      batch.set(tRef, newT, { merge: true });

      // Rule 9 Mandate: Parent task rollups are computed 100% in-memory on client.
      // We keep updatedParents in memory via saveTaskStateUnified below, but do NOT issue Firestore writeBatch for parent tasks.

      if (updates.delegation === true) {
         const deterministicGroupId = `del_${t.id}`;
         const existingGroup = delegationGroups.find(g => g.parentTaskId === t.id || g.id === deterministicGroupId);
         if (!existingGroup) {
            const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
            const rawParty = (t.party && t.party.trim()) ? t.party.trim() : (currentUser.username || '');
            const parsedParty = rawParty.split(/[,;/+]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)[0] || rawParty;
            const newGroup: DelegationGroup = {
              id: deterministicGroupId,
              parentTaskId: t.id,
              name: t.name || 'Delegated Task',
              projectCode: t.projectCode,
              projectStore: t.projectStore,
              projectYear: (t.projectYear !== undefined && t.projectYear !== null && !isNaN(Number(t.projectYear))) ? Number(t.projectYear) : (Number(projects.find(p => p.code === t.projectCode)?.year) || new Date().getFullYear()),
              subTasks: [{ 
                 id: generateId(), 
                 name: '', 
                 comments: '', 
                 status: 'Assigned', 
                 delegationStatus: 'Assigned', 
                 priority: 'Mid', 
                 party: parsedParty, 
                 startAct: dateStr, 
                 finishAct: dateStr, 
                 updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() 
              }],
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
              createdBy: currentUser.id
            };
            const delRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_delegation_groups', deterministicGroupId);
            batch.set(delRef, newGroup, { merge: true });
         }
      }

      const depUpdates = updatesToDependents.filter(d => d.id !== newT.id);
      depUpdates.forEach(depTask => {
        const depRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', depTask.id);
        batch.set(depRef, { ...depTask, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }, { merge: true });
      });

      predecessorUpdates.forEach(pu => {
        if (pu.id !== t.id && !updatesToDependents.some(d => d.id === pu.id)) {
          const pRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', pu.id);
          batch.update(pRef, { predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt });
        }
      });
      
      const allUpdatesToSave = [
        newT,
        ...depUpdates,
        ...updatedParents.filter(pt => pt.id !== newT.id && !depUpdates.some(d => d.id === pt.id)),
        ...predecessorUpdates.filter(pu => pu.id !== t.id && !depUpdates.some(d => d.id === pu.id))
      ];
      saveTaskStateUnified(allUpdatesToSave);

      try {
        await batch.commit();

        const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = allUpdatesToSave.map((item) => {
          const prev = tasks.find((tsk) => tsk.id === item.id);
          return createPatchDeltaItem({
            docId: item.id,
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
            previous: prev,
            updated: item,
            action: 'update',
            year: (item as any).projectYear ? String((item as any).projectYear) : (t.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined),
          });
        });
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser.username || currentUser.id).catch(() => {});
      } catch (error: any) {
        console.error("Batch commit failed", error);
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Save Failed", message: "Network error or permission denied. Data was not saved.", type: "error" });
        saveTaskStateUnified([t, ...depUpdates.map(d => tasks.find(tsk => tsk.id === d.id) || d)]);
        return;
      }
      
      undoManager.push({
        description: `Update Task Schedule: ${t.name}`,
        revert: async () => {
          const revertBatch = writeBatch(db);
          revertBatch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id), t);
          updatesToDependents.forEach(depTask => {
            const originalDep = tasks.find(tsk => tsk.id === depTask.id);
            if (originalDep) {
              revertBatch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', depTask.id), originalDep);
            }
          });
          revertBatch.commit().catch(console.error);
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveNotes = async (taskId: string, notes: TaskNote[]) => {
    const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === taskId);
    if (t) {
      await handleUpdateTask(t, { notes });
    }
  };

  return {
    handleDeleteTask,
    handleUpdateTask,
    handleSaveNotes,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/DetailTabParts/useDetailVirtualization.ts ==================== */
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { DetailTableRow } from './detailTypes';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

export interface UseDetailVirtualizationParams {
  flatTableRows: DetailTableRow[];
  initialFocusTaskId?: string;
  initialFilterCode?: string;
  visibleCount: number;
  setVisibleCount: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
  filteredProjectsLength: number;
}

const OVERSCAN = 10;

export function useDetailVirtualization({
  flatTableRows,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  initialFilterCode,
  visibleCount,
  setVisibleCount,
  filteredProjectsLength,
}: UseDetailVirtualizationParams) {
  const tableContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [scrollTop, setScrollTop] = useState(0);
  const [containerHeight, setContainerHeight] = useState(650);
  const scrollRafIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const flatTableRowsRef = useRef(flatTableRows);
  useEffect(() => {
    flatTableRowsRef.current = flatTableRows;
  }, [flatTableRows]);

  const { totalHeight, rowOffsets } = useMemo(() => {
    const totalRows = flatTableRows.length;
    const offsets = new Float64Array(totalRows + 1);
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < totalRows; i++) {
      offsets[i] = sum;
      sum += (flatTableRows[i].type === 'project' ? 42 : 36);
    }
    offsets[totalRows] = sum;
    return { totalHeight: sum, rowOffsets: offsets };
  }, [flatTableRows]);

  const { startIndex, endIndex, paddingTop, paddingBottom } = useMemo(() => {
    const totalRows = flatTableRows.length;
    if (totalRows === 0) {
      return { startIndex: 0, endIndex: 0, paddingTop: 0, paddingBottom: 0 };
    }
    let low = 0;
    let high = totalRows - 1;
    let start = 0;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
      if (rowOffsets[mid + 1] <= Math.max(0, scrollTop)) {
        low = mid + 1;
      } else {
        start = mid;
        high = mid - 1;
      }
    }

    const viewStart = Math.max(0, start - OVERSCAN);
    const bottomTarget = scrollTop + containerHeight;

    low = start;
    high = totalRows - 1;
    let end = totalRows - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = (low + high) >> 1;
      if (rowOffsets[mid] < bottomTarget) {
        end = mid;
        low = mid + 1;
      } else {
        high = mid - 1;
      }
    }

    const viewEnd = Math.min(totalRows, end + 1 + OVERSCAN);
    const topPad = rowOffsets[viewStart] || 0;
    const bottomPad = Math.max(0, totalHeight - (rowOffsets[viewEnd] || totalHeight));

    return {
      startIndex: viewStart,
      endIndex: viewEnd,
      paddingTop: topPad,
      paddingBottom: bottomPad,
    };
  }, [rowOffsets, totalHeight, scrollTop, containerHeight, flatTableRows.length]);

  const handleTableScroll = useCallback((e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = e.currentTarget;
    const st = target.scrollTop;
    const sh = target.scrollHeight;
    const ch = target.clientHeight;
    
    if (scrollRafIdRef.current !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(scrollRafIdRef.current);
    }
    scrollRafIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      setScrollTop(st);
      scrollRafIdRef.current = null;
    });

    if (sh - (st + ch) < 400) {
      if (visibleCount < filteredProjectsLength) {
        setVisibleCount(prev => Math.min(prev + 30, filteredProjectsLength));
      }
    }
  }, [visibleCount, filteredProjectsLength, setVisibleCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = tableContainerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const h = entry.contentRect.height;
        if (h > 0) setContainerHeight(h);
      }
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const lastScrolledTargetRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tableContainerRef.current) return;
    const targetKey = `${initialFocusTaskId || ''}_${initialFilterCode || ''}`;
    if (targetKey === '_') {
      lastScrolledTargetRef.current = null;
      return;
    }
    if (lastScrolledTargetRef.current === targetKey) return;

    let targetIdx = -1;
    let offsetAdjustment = 40;

    // 1. Prioritize task if explicit initialFocusTaskId provided
    if (initialFocusTaskId) {
      targetIdx = flatTableRows.findIndex(
        r => r.type === 'task' && r.task.id === initialFocusTaskId
      );
      offsetAdjustment = 100;
    }

    // 2. Fallback to project row if navigated to project or task row not yet expanded
    if (targetIdx === -1 && initialFilterCode) {
      const filterClean = String(initialFilterCode).trim().toUpperCase();
      targetIdx = flatTableRows.findIndex(r => {
        if (r.type !== 'project' || !r.project) return false;
        const p = r.project;
        const pCode = String(p.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        const pId = String(p.id || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        return pId === filterClean || pCode === filterClean || (pCode && filterClean.startsWith(pCode));
      });
      offsetAdjustment = 30;
    }

    if (targetIdx >= 0 && rowOffsets[targetIdx] !== undefined) {
      const targetScroll = Math.max(0, rowOffsets[targetIdx] - offsetAdjustment);
      tableContainerRef.current.scrollTo({ top: targetScroll, behavior: 'smooth' });
      lastScrolledTargetRef.current = targetKey;
    }
  }, [initialFocusTaskId, initialFilterCode, flatTableRows, rowOffsets]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!flatTableRows || flatTableRows.length === 0) return;
    const visibleSlice = flatTableRows.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
    const visibleIds = new Set<string>();
    for (const row of visibleSlice) {
      if (row.type === 'project' && row.project) {
        if (row.project.id) visibleIds.add(String(row.project.id));
        if (row.project.code) visibleIds.add(String(row.project.code));
      } else if (row.type === 'task' && row.task) {
        if (row.task.projectId) visibleIds.add(String(row.task.projectId));
        if (row.task.projectCode) visibleIds.add(String(row.task.projectCode));
      }
    }
    const arr = Array.from(visibleIds).filter(Boolean);
    if (arr.length > 0) {
      useAppStore.getState().setVisibleActiveProjectIds(arr);
    }
  }, [flatTableRows, startIndex, endIndex]);

  return {
    tableContainerRef,
    handleTableScroll,
    startIndex,
    endIndex,
    paddingTop,
    paddingBottom,
    scrollTop,
    containerHeight,
    rowOffsets,
    totalHeight,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx ==================== */
import React, { Component, ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from "react";

interface Props {
  children?: ReactNode;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  errorInfo: ErrorInfo | null;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  public state: State = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null,
    errorInfo: null
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error, errorInfo: null };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    console.error("Uncaught error:", error, errorInfo);
    this.setState({ errorInfo });
  }

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div style={{ padding: "20px", background: "red", color: "white", zIndex: 9999, position: 'relative' }}>
          <h1>Something went wrong.</h1>
          <pre>{this.state.error && this.state.error.toString()}</pre>
          <pre>{this.state.errorInfo && this.state.errorInfo.componentStack}</pre>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}
