/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttProjectRow.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { getStatus, computeActProgressPercent, computeActProgressFromSummaries } from '../../lib/utils';
import { formatGanttDate, renderGanttDateCell } from './GanttUtils';
import { GanttBar } from './GanttBar';
import { GanttBaseline } from './GanttBaseline';

export interface GanttProjectRowProps {
  p: Project;
  pIdx: number;
  projectTasks?: Task[];
  isExpanded: boolean;
  expandedModularTasks?: string[];
  setExpandedModularTasks?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  isEditMode?: boolean;
  canWrite?: boolean;
  selectedProjectSet?: Set<string>;
  selectedProjectIds?: string[];
  selectedTaskIds?: string[];
  selectedTaskSet?: Set<string>;
  setSelectedProjectIds?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  setSelectedTaskIds?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  toggleProject?: (id: string) => void;
  toggleProjectExpansion?: (id: string) => void;
  isResizingSide?: boolean;
  startResizingSide?: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  sideWidth: number;
  showStart?: boolean;
  startColWidth?: number;
  showFinish?: boolean;
  finishColWidth?: number;
  showParty?: boolean;
  partyColWidth?: number;
  showDuration?: boolean;
  durationColWidth?: number;
  showPredecessor?: boolean;
  predecessorColWidth?: number;
  timeUnits?: any[];
  delegationGroups?: any[];
  getRowVisibilityClass?: (id: string) => string;
  startDate: Date;
  dayWidth: number;
  activeTooltip: string | null;
  setActiveTooltip: (id: string | null) => void;
  getBarColor?: (status: string, duration?: string | number) => string;
  isHideMode?: boolean;
  toggleHideRow?: (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  handleTogglePin?: (p: any) => void | Promise<void>;
  onNavigateToLayout?: (
    store: string,
    location: string,
    projectCode?: string,
    sourceTaskId?: string,
  ) => void;
}

export const GanttProjectRow: React.FC<GanttProjectRowProps> = React.memo(({
  p, pIdx, projectTasks = [], isExpanded, expandedModularTasks = [], setExpandedModularTasks, isEditMode = false, canWrite = false,
  selectedProjectSet = new Set(), selectedProjectIds = [], selectedTaskIds = [], selectedTaskSet = new Set(), setSelectedProjectIds, setSelectedTaskIds,
  toggleProject, toggleProjectExpansion, isResizingSide = false, startResizingSide,
  sideWidth, showStart = false, startColWidth = 80, showFinish = false, finishColWidth = 80, showParty = false, partyColWidth = 70, showDuration = false, durationColWidth = 50, showPredecessor = false, predecessorColWidth = 90,
  timeUnits = [], delegationGroups = [], getRowVisibilityClass = () => '', startDate, dayWidth, activeTooltip, setActiveTooltip, getBarColor = () => 'bg-blue-500',
  isHideMode = false, toggleHideRow, handleTogglePin, onNavigateToLayout
}) => {
  const setQuickNavTarget = useAppStore(state => state.setQuickNavTarget);
  const handleToggle = toggleProjectExpansion || toggleProject;
  const pStart = p.computedTakStart || p.start;
  const pEnd = p.computedTakCompl || p.handover;

  let projectDuration = "-";
  if (pStart && pEnd) {
    const sD = new Date(pStart);
    const eD = new Date(pEnd);
    if (!isNaN(sD.getTime()) && !isNaN(eD.getTime())) {
      const days = Math.round((eD.getTime() - sD.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      projectDuration = String(days);
    }
  }

  const baseStatus = p.computedStatus || getStatus(pStart, pEnd, p.computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
  const pActPrg = projectTasks && projectTasks.length > 0
    ? computeActProgressPercent(projectTasks, delegationGroups)
    : (p.computedActProgress && p.computedActProgress > 0 
        ? p.computedActProgress 
        : (p.taskSummaries && p.taskSummaries.length > 0 ? computeActProgressFromSummaries(p.taskSummaries) : (p.computedActProgress ?? 0)));
  const effectiveProjectStatus = pActPrg >= 100 
    ? 'Completed' 
    : (p.computedActStatus && p.computedActStatus !== 'Planned' ? p.computedActStatus : baseStatus);
  const pStatus = effectiveProjectStatus;
  const effectiveTaskCount = p.taskCount !== undefined ? p.taskCount : (projectTasks ? projectTasks.length : 0);
  const canToggle = effectiveTaskCount > 0 || Boolean(p.id);

  const rowId = `project-${p.no}`;

  // Find modular parent tasks belonging to this project
  const projectModularParentIds = React.useMemo(() => {
    const childParentIds = new Set<string>();
    (projectTasks || []).forEach((t) => {
      if (t.parentTaskId) {
        childParentIds.add(String(t.parentTaskId));
      }
    });
    return (projectTasks || [])
      .filter((t) => childParentIds.has(String(t.id)))
      .map((t) => String(t.id));
  }, [projectTasks]);

  const hasModularTasks = projectModularParentIds.length > 0;
  const isProjectModularExpanded =
    hasModularTasks &&
    projectModularParentIds.some((id) => expandedModularTasks.includes(id));

  const handleToggleProjectModular = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!hasModularTasks) return;
    if (isProjectModularExpanded) {
      setExpandedModularTasks((prev) =>
        prev.filter((id) => !projectModularParentIds.includes(id))
      );
    } else {
      setExpandedModularTasks((prev) =>
        Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...projectModularParentIds]))
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      id={`gantt-project-row-${p.no}`}
      className={cn(
        "flex h-12 min-h-[48px] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] transition-colors relative group project-row",
        "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a]",
        getRowVisibilityClass(rowId)
      )}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "print-sticky-x sticky left-0 z-30 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] flex items-center shrink-0 overflow-hidden",
          "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] group-hover:bg-slate-50 dark:group-hover:bg-[#28282a]"
        )}
        style={{ width: sideWidth, minWidth: sideWidth, maxWidth: sideWidth }}
      >
        {/* Project Name Column */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 p-1.5 flex items-center overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 w-full relative min-w-0">
            {isEditMode && (() => {
              const pKey = String(p.id || p.no);
              const pCodeNorm = String(p.code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
              const pYearNorm = p.year !== undefined && p.year !== null ? String(p.year).trim() : '';
              const pStoreNorm = p.store ? String(p.store).trim().toLowerCase() : '';
              const allStoreTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || [];

              // 1. Gather all tasks directly associated with this project
              const taskMap = new Map<string, Task>();
              (projectTasks || []).forEach(t => { if (t && t.id && !t.isDeleted) taskMap.set(t.id, t); });

              allStoreTasks.forEach(t => {
                if (!t || !t.id || t.isDeleted) return;
                if (p.id && String(t.projectId) === String(p.id)) {
                  taskMap.set(t.id, t);
                  return;
                }
                if (t.projectCode) {
                  const codes = String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase().split(/[,;/]+/).map(s => s.trim());
                  if (codes.includes(pCodeNorm)) {
                    if (pYearNorm && t.projectYear && String(t.projectYear).trim() !== pYearNorm) return;
                    if (pStoreNorm && t.projectStore && String(t.projectStore).trim().toLowerCase() !== pStoreNorm) return;
                    taskMap.set(t.id, t);
                  }
                }
              });

              // 2. Also include any subtasks whose parent belongs to this project
              const parentIdSet = new Set(Array.from(taskMap.keys()));
              const parentCodeSet = new Set(
                Array.from(taskMap.values())
                  .map(t => t.taskCodePhu ? String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() : '')
                  .filter(Boolean)
              );

              allStoreTasks.forEach(t => {
                if (!t || !t.id || t.isDeleted || taskMap.has(String(t.id))) return;
                const rawParent = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
                if (rawParent) {
                  const rawStr = String(rawParent).trim().toLowerCase();
                  if (parentIdSet.has(String(rawParent)) || parentCodeSet.has(rawStr)) {
                    taskMap.set(String(t.id), t);
                  }
                }
              });

              const allProjectTasks = Array.from(taskMap.values());
              const pTaskIds = allProjectTasks.map(t => String(t.id)).filter(Boolean);
              const sTaskSet = selectedTaskSet || new Set((selectedTaskIds || []).map(String));
              const isAllTasksSelected = pTaskIds.length > 0 && pTaskIds.every(id => sTaskSet.has(id));
              const isSomeTasksSelected = !isAllTasksSelected && pTaskIds.some(id => sTaskSet.has(id));
              const isChecked = pTaskIds.length > 0 ? isAllTasksSelected : Boolean(selectedProjectSet?.has(pKey) || selectedProjectSet?.has(String(p.no)) || (p.id && selectedProjectSet?.has(String(p.id))));

              return (
                <label
                  className="flex items-center justify-center p-1 shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                >
                  <input
                    ref={(el) => {
                      if (el) el.indeterminate = isSomeTasksSelected;
                    }}
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={isChecked}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      // If not all tasks are selected, clicking toggles ON to select all.
                      // If all tasks were already selected, clicking toggles OFF to deselect all.
                      const willCheck = !isAllTasksSelected;
                      const currentProjectIds = (selectedProjectIds || []).map(String);
                      const projectKeys = [pKey, String(p.id), String(p.no)].filter(Boolean).map(String);

                      if (willCheck) {
                        if (setSelectedProjectIds) {
                          setSelectedProjectIds(Array.from(new Set([...currentProjectIds, ...projectKeys])));
                        }
                        if (setSelectedTaskIds) {
                          setSelectedTaskIds((prev: any) => Array.from(new Set([...(prev || []).map(String), ...pTaskIds])));
                        }
                      } else {
                        if (setSelectedProjectIds) {
                          const removeSet = new Set(projectKeys);
                          setSelectedProjectIds(currentProjectIds.filter(id => !removeSet.has(id)));
                        }
                        if (setSelectedTaskIds) {
                          const pTaskSet = new Set(pTaskIds);
                          setSelectedTaskIds((prev: any) => (prev || []).map(String).filter((id: string) => !pTaskSet.has(id)));
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded border-slate-300 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 bg-white cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all touch-manipulation"
                  />
                </label>
              );
            })()}
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  if (canToggle && handleToggle) {
                    handleToggle(p.id!);
                  }
                }}
                disabled={!canToggle}
                className={cn(
                  "p-0.5 rounded shrink-0 active:scale-90 transition-all touch-manipulation",
                  !canToggle
                    ? "opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600"
                    : isExpanded
                    ? "text-slate-600 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] cursor-pointer"
                    : "text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] cursor-pointer"
                )}
                title={
                  !canToggle
                    ? "Project has no tasks"
                    : isExpanded
                    ? "Collapse this project"
                    : `Expand this project (${effectiveTaskCount} tasks)`
                }
              >
                {isExpanded ? (
                  <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 pointer-events-none" />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 pointer-events-none" />
                )}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleToggleProjectModular}
                disabled={!hasModularTasks}
                className={cn(
                  "p-0.5 rounded shrink-0 active:scale-90 transition-all touch-manipulation",
                  !hasModularTasks
                    ? "opacity-25 cursor-not-allowed bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600"
                    : isProjectModularExpanded
                    ? "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white dark:bg-purple-600 dark:hover:bg-purple-500 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-purple-400/50 cursor-pointer"
                    : "bg-purple-100 hover:bg-purple-200 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/60 dark:hover:bg-purple-900/90 dark:text-purple-200 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-600/70 cursor-pointer"
                )}
                title={
                  !hasModularTasks
                    ? "Project has no modular tasks"
                    : isProjectModularExpanded
                    ? "Collapse modular tasks of this project"
                    : "Expand modular tasks of this project"
                }
              >
                {isProjectModularExpanded ? (
                  <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 pointer-events-none" />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 pointer-events-none" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                if (isEditMode) return;
                e.stopPropagation();
                // Open Quick Nav when clicking project row
                setQuickNavTarget({
                  project: p,
                  task: undefined,
                  taskCode: p.code,
                });
              }}
              onDoubleClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (handleToggle) handleToggle(p.id!);
              }}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-1 flex-1 min-w-0 text-left hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] p-1 rounded transition-colors group/pname overflow-hidden",
                !isEditMode ? "cursor-pointer" : ""
              )}
              title={
                !isEditMode
                  ? `Quick Navigator - Project: ${p.name} (${p.code})`
                  : p.name
              }
            >
              <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0 flex-1 justify-center gap-0.5 overflow-hidden">
                <span 
                  className={cn(
                    "font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm truncate text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-tight",
                    !isEditMode && "group-hover/pname:text-blue-500 dark:group-hover/pname:text-blue-400 transition-colors"
                  )} 
                  title={p.name}
                >
                  {p.name}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate font-mono flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap leading-none">
                  <span className="px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold font-mono rounded bg-[#142340] text-[#60a5fa] border border-[#1d4ed8] shrink-0 leading-none">
                    {p.code}
                  </span>
                  <span className="px-1 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold rounded bg-[#142340] text-[#60a5fa] border border-[#1d4ed8] uppercase shrink-0 leading-none">
                    {p.store}
                  </span>
                  {p.location && (
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-medium leading-none">
                      • {p.location}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="text-amber-400 text-[9px] font-bold leading-none">●</span>
                </span>
              </div>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Extra Columns inside Side Container */}
        {showStart && (
          <div
            className="border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: startColWidth, minWidth: startColWidth, maxWidth: startColWidth }}
          >
            {renderGanttDateCell(pStart, "text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]")}
          </div>
        )}

        {showFinish && (
          <div
            className="border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: finishColWidth, minWidth: finishColWidth, maxWidth: finishColWidth }}
          >
            {renderGanttDateCell(pEnd, "text-pink-700 dark:text-pink-400")}
          </div>
        )}

        {showParty && (
          <div
            className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383] border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full"
            style={{ width: partyColWidth, minWidth: partyColWidth, maxWidth: partyColWidth }}
          >
            {p.party || "-"}
          </div>
        )}

        {showDuration && (
          <div
            className="font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#838383] border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 flex items-center justify-center font-bold shrink-0 h-full"
            style={{ width: durationColWidth, minWidth: durationColWidth, maxWidth: durationColWidth }}
          >
            {projectDuration}
          </div>
        )}

        {showPredecessor && (
          <div
            className="font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full"
            style={{ width: predecessorColWidth, minWidth: predecessorColWidth, maxWidth: predecessorColWidth }}
          >
            -
          </div>
        )}

        {startResizingSide && (
          <div
            className={cn(
              "absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1.5 cursor-col-resize hover:bg-blue-400 z-40 transition-colors pointer-events-auto",
              isResizingSide ? "bg-blue-500" : "bg-transparent group-hover/header:bg-slate-200 dark:group-hover/header:bg-slate-600"
            )}
            onMouseDown={startResizingSide}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Right Timeline Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 relative h-full flex items-center">
        <GanttBar
          startStr={pStart}
          endStr={pEnd}
          status={pStatus}
          label={p.name}
          id={rowId}
          extraVars={{ actPrg: pActPrg, duration: projectDuration }}
          startDate={startDate}
          dayWidth={dayWidth}
          activeTooltip={activeTooltip}
          setActiveTooltip={setActiveTooltip}
          isEditMode={isEditMode}
          getBarColor={getBarColor}
        />
        <GanttBaseline
          baselineStart={p.baselineStart || (p as any).baseStart}
          baselineFinish={p.baselineFinish || (p as any).baseFinish}
          startStr={p.computedTakStart || p.start}
          endStr={p.computedTakCompl || p.opening || p.handover}
          type="project"
          startDate={startDate}
          dayWidth={dayWidth}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}, (prev, next) => {
  const prevModularExpanded = prev.projectTasks?.some(t => prev.expandedModularTasks?.includes(String(t.id)));
  const nextModularExpanded = next.projectTasks?.some(t => next.expandedModularTasks?.includes(String(t.id)));
  if (prevModularExpanded !== nextModularExpanded) return false;

  const prevSelected = prev.selectedProjectSet ? prev.selectedProjectSet.has(String(prev.p.no)) : false;
  const nextSelected = next.selectedProjectSet ? next.selectedProjectSet.has(String(next.p.no)) : false;

  return prev.isExpanded === next.isExpanded &&
         prev.isEditMode === next.isEditMode &&
         prev.canWrite === next.canWrite &&
         prevSelected === nextSelected &&
         prev.sideWidth === next.sideWidth &&
         prev.startColWidth === next.startColWidth &&
         prev.finishColWidth === next.finishColWidth &&
         prev.partyColWidth === next.partyColWidth &&
         prev.durationColWidth === next.durationColWidth &&
         prev.showStart === next.showStart &&
         prev.showFinish === next.showFinish &&
         prev.showParty === next.showParty &&
         prev.showDuration === next.showDuration &&
         prev.showPredecessor === next.showPredecessor &&
         prev.predecessorColWidth === next.predecessorColWidth &&
         prev.timeUnits?.length === next.timeUnits?.length &&
         prev.p === next.p &&
         prev.projectTasks === next.projectTasks &&
         prev.startDate?.getTime() === next.startDate?.getTime() &&
         prev.dayWidth === next.dayWidth &&
         (prev.activeTooltip === `project-${prev.p.no}` || next.activeTooltip === `project-${next.p.no}` ? prev.activeTooltip === next.activeTooltip : true);
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttSumBadge.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Calculator } from 'lucide-react';

export interface GanttSumBadgeProps {
  isEditMode?: boolean;
  sumMode?: 'none' | 'duration';
  selectedTaskCount?: number;
  selectedProjectCount?: number;
  computedSum?: number | null;
  sumDuration?: number | null;
}

export const GanttSumBadge: React.FC<GanttSumBadgeProps> = React.memo(({
  isEditMode = true,
  sumMode = 'duration',
  selectedTaskCount,
  selectedProjectCount,
  computedSum,
  sumDuration,
}) => {
  const finalSum = sumDuration !== undefined ? sumDuration : computedSum;
  if (finalSum === null || finalSum === undefined) {
    return null;
  }
  if (!isEditMode && sumDuration === undefined) {
    return null;
  }
  if (sumMode === 'none' && sumDuration === undefined) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[200] bg-slate-900 dark:bg-white text-white dark:text-slate-900 px-6 py-4 rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-4">
      <div className="p-2 bg-emerald-500 rounded-full">
        <Calculator className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col">
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 font-medium">Calculated Sum</span>
        <span className="text-xl font-bold">
          {finalSum} Days
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

GanttSumBadge.displayName = 'GanttSumBadge';


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttTableView.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project, Task, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { TimeUnit, GanttTableRow as GanttRowType, DependencyLine } from './ganttTypes';
import { GanttColumnWidths } from './useGanttColumnResize';
import { GanttProjectRow } from './GanttProjectRow';
import { GanttTaskRow } from './GanttTaskRow';
import { GanttTimelineHeader } from './GanttTimelineHeader';
import { GanttGridOverlay } from './GanttGridOverlay';
import { GanttTodayLine } from './GanttTodayLine';
import { GanttDependencyLinks } from './GanttDependencyLinks';
import { GanttSumBadge } from './GanttSumBadge';
import { GanttExportOverlay } from './GanttExportOverlay';
import { GanttEmptyState } from './GanttEmptyState';
import { GanttLeftHeader } from './GanttLeftHeader';
import { useGanttZoomAndPan } from './useGanttZoomAndPan';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { safeSetItemSession } from '../../lib/storage';

interface GanttTableViewProps {
  tableContainerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  mainScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  topScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  handleCombinedMainScroll: (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
  handleTopScroll: (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
  flatGanttRows?: GanttRowType[];
  visibleGanttRows: GanttRowType[];
  paddingTop: number;
  paddingBottom: number;
  totalDays: number;
  dayWidth: number;
  sideWidth: number;
  setSideWidth: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
  startResizingSide: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  colWidths?: GanttColumnWidths;
  startResizingColumn?: (colKey: keyof GanttColumnWidths, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  timeUnits: TimeUnit[];
  startDate: Date;
  customToday: Date;
  setCustomToday: (d: Date) => void;
  isDraggingToday: boolean;
  setIsDraggingToday: (v: boolean) => void;
  getDateFromOffsetPx: (offsetPx: number) => Date;
  activeTooltip: string | null;
  setActiveTooltip: (id: string | null) => void;
  getBarColor: (status: string, duration?: string | number) => string;
  visibleColumns: string[];
  handleToggleColumn?: (colId: string) => void;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  delegationGroups: any[];
  currentUser: AppUser | null;
  canWrite: boolean;
  isEditMode: boolean;
  isHideMode: boolean;
  toggleHideRow: (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  getRowVisibilityClass: (id: string) => string;
  selectedTaskSet: Set<string>;
  selectedTaskIds: string[];
  setSelectedTaskIds: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  selectedProjectSet: Set<string>;
  selectedProjectIds?: string[];
  setSelectedProjectIds?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  handleTaskCheckboxChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement> | React.MouseEvent, id: string, isShift?: boolean, orderedTaskIds?: string[]) => void;
  handleToggleSelectAll: () => void;
  isAllSelected: boolean;
  toggleProjectExpansion: (id: string) => void;
  toggleModularParent: (taskId: string | number) => void;
  handleGroupModularTasks: (parentTaskId: string, childTaskIds: string[]) => void;
  handleUnlinkModularTasks: (childTaskIds: string[]) => void;
  handleTogglePin: (p: Project) => Promise<void>;
  initialFocusTaskId?: string | null;
  ganttTabFocusTaskId?: string | null;
  draggingTaskIds: string[];
  handleTaskDragStart: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleTaskDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleContainerDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent) => void;
  handleTaskDragLeave: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleTaskDrop: (e: React.DragEvent, targetTask: Task, parentProject?: Project) => Promise<void> | void;
  handleTaskDragEnd: () => void;
  dragOverTaskId: string | null;
  dropPosition: 'before' | 'after' | null;
  dependencyLines: DependencyLine[];
  computedSum: number | null;
  isExporting: boolean;
  onNavigateToTaskDetail?: (taskId: string) => void;
  onNavigateToLayout?: (store: string, location: string, projectCode?: string, sourceTaskId?: string) => void;
  paginatedProjects?: Project[];
  expandedModularTasks?: string[];
  setExpandedModularTasks?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  getGroupTasksForProject?: (p: Project) => Task[];
}

export function GanttTableView({
  tableContainerRef,
  mainScrollRef,
  topScrollRef,
  handleCombinedMainScroll,
  handleTopScroll,
  flatGanttRows = [],
  visibleGanttRows,
  paddingTop,
  paddingBottom,
  totalDays,
  dayWidth,
  sideWidth,
  startResizingSide,
  colWidths,
  startResizingColumn,
  timeUnits,
  startDate,
  customToday,
  setCustomToday,
  isDraggingToday,
  setIsDraggingToday,
  getDateFromOffsetPx,
  activeTooltip,
  setActiveTooltip,
  getBarColor,
  visibleColumns,
  handleToggleColumn,
  projects,
  tasks,
  delegationGroups,
  currentUser,
  canWrite,
  isEditMode,
  isHideMode,
  toggleHideRow,
  getRowVisibilityClass,
  selectedTaskSet,
  selectedTaskIds,
  setSelectedTaskIds,
  selectedProjectSet,
  selectedProjectIds = [],
  setSelectedProjectIds,
  handleTaskCheckboxChange,
  handleToggleSelectAll,
  isAllSelected,
  toggleProjectExpansion,
  toggleModularParent,
  handleGroupModularTasks,
  handleUnlinkModularTasks,
  handleTogglePin,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  ganttTabFocusTaskId,
  draggingTaskIds,
  handleTaskDragStart,
  handleTaskDragOver,
  handleContainerDragOver,
  handleTaskDragLeave,
  handleTaskDrop,
  handleTaskDragEnd,
  dragOverTaskId,
  dropPosition,
  dependencyLines,
  computedSum,
  isExporting,
  onNavigateToTaskDetail,
  onNavigateToLayout,
  paginatedProjects,
  expandedModularTasks = [],
  setExpandedModularTasks,
  getGroupTasksForProject
}: GanttTableViewProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const expandedProjects = useAppStore((state) => state.expandedProjectIds);
  const setExpandedProjectIds = useAppStore((state) => state.setExpandedProjectIds);

  const currentProjects = (paginatedProjects && paginatedProjects.length > 0) ? paginatedProjects : projects;
  const isAllExpanded = currentProjects.length > 0 && currentProjects.every((p) => expandedProjects.includes(p.id!));

  const handleToggleExpandAll = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (isAllExpanded) {
      setExpandedProjectIds([]);
    } else {
      setExpandedProjectIds(currentProjects.map((p) => p.id!).filter(Boolean) as string[]);
    }
  };

  // Find all modular parent task IDs for currently displayed/searched projects
  const currentModularParentIds = useMemo(() => {
    const parentIdSet = new Set<string>();

    currentProjects.forEach((p) => {
      const pTasks = getGroupTasksForProject ? getGroupTasksForProject(p) : [];
      if (!pTasks || pTasks.length === 0) return;

      const projectTaskById = new Map<string, Task>();
      const projectTaskByCode = new Map<string, Task>();
      pTasks.forEach((t) => {
        if (t.id) projectTaskById.set(String(t.id), t);
        if (t.taskCodePhu) {
          projectTaskByCode.set(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase(), t);
        }
      });

      pTasks.forEach((t) => {
        const rawParentId = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
        if (rawParentId) {
          const parentKey = String(rawParentId).trim().toLowerCase();
          const matchedParent = projectTaskById.get(String(rawParentId)) || projectTaskByCode.get(parentKey);
          const effectiveParentId = matchedParent ? String(matchedParent.id) : String(rawParentId);
          parentIdSet.add(effectiveParentId);
        }
      });
    });

    return Array.from(parentIdSet);
  }, [currentProjects, getGroupTasksForProject]);

  const hasModularTasks = currentModularParentIds.length > 0;
  const isAnyModularExpanded =
    hasModularTasks &&
    currentModularParentIds.some((id) => expandedModularTasks.includes(id));

  const handleToggleExpandAllModular = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!hasModularTasks || !setExpandedModularTasks) return;

    if (isAnyModularExpanded) {
      const toRemove = new Set(currentModularParentIds);
      setExpandedModularTasks((prev) => {
        const next = prev.filter((id) => !toRemove.has(id));
        safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_modular_expanded", JSON.stringify(next));
        return next;
      });
    } else {
      setExpandedModularTasks((prev) => {
        const next = Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...currentModularParentIds]));
        safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_modular_expanded", JSON.stringify(next));
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  const showStart = visibleColumns.includes('start');
  const showFinish = visibleColumns.includes('finish');
  const showParty = visibleColumns.includes('party');
  const showDuration = visibleColumns.includes('duration');
  const showPredecessor = visibleColumns.includes('predecessor');

  const startColWidth = colWidths?.start ?? 85;
  const finishColWidth = colWidths?.finish ?? 85;
  const partyColWidth = colWidths?.party ?? 80;
  const durationColWidth = colWidths?.duration ?? 60;
  const predecessorColWidth = colWidths?.predecessor ?? 90;

  const totalTimelineWidth = totalDays * dayWidth;

  const { isPanning, handlePointerDown } = useGanttZoomAndPan({
    mainScrollRef,
    topScrollRef,
    sideWidth
  });

  const allOrderedTaskIds = useMemo(() => {
    const fromRows = (flatGanttRows && flatGanttRows.length > 0 ? flatGanttRows : visibleGanttRows)
      .filter(r => r.type === 'task')
      .map(r => r.task.id);
    if (fromRows.length > 0) return fromRows;
    const fallbackIds: string[] = [];
    currentProjects.forEach(p => {
      const pTasks = getGroupTasksForProject ? getGroupTasksForProject(p) : [];
      pTasks.forEach(t => {
        if (t && t.id && !t.isDeleted && !fallbackIds.includes(t.id)) fallbackIds.push(t.id);
      });
    });
    return fallbackIds;
  }, [flatGanttRows, visibleGanttRows, currentProjects, getGroupTasksForProject]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={tableContainerRef}
      onDragOver={handleContainerDragOver}
      className="flex-grow overflow-hidden flex flex-col bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] relative min-h-0 select-none"
    >
      {/* Top Synchronized Timeline Header */}
      <div
        ref={topScrollRef}
        onScroll={handleTopScroll}
        className="overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-hidden border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#18181a] flex shrink-0"
      >
        {/* Left Side Header */}
        <GanttLeftHeader
          sideWidth={sideWidth}
          isEditMode={isEditMode}
          isAllSelected={isAllSelected}
          handleToggleSelectAll={handleToggleSelectAll}
          isAllExpanded={isAllExpanded}
          handleToggleExpandAll={handleToggleExpandAll}
          isAllModularExpanded={isAnyModularExpanded}
          handleToggleExpandAllModular={handleToggleExpandAllModular}
          hasModularTasks={hasModularTasks}
          visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
          colWidths={colWidths}
          handleToggleColumn={handleToggleColumn}
          startResizingColumn={startResizingColumn}
        />

        {/* Right Side Timeline Units Header */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-visible" style={{ width: `${totalTimelineWidth}px` }}>
          <GanttTimelineHeader timeUnits={timeUnits} dayWidth={dayWidth} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Scrollable Table & Timeline Canvas */}
      <div
        ref={mainScrollRef}
        onScroll={handleCombinedMainScroll}
        onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
        className={cn(
          "flex-grow overflow-auto relative flex min-h-0",
          isPanning ? "cursor-grabbing select-none" : "cursor-grab"
        )}
      >
        {/* Left Side Resizable Divider Bar */}
        <div
          onMouseDown={startResizingSide}
          className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 z-40 w-1.5 cursor-col-resize hover:bg-blue-500 active:bg-blue-600 transition-colors"
          style={{ left: `${sideWidth - 1}px` }}
        />

        {/* Rows Virtual Container */}
        <div
          className="flex flex-col relative w-full"
          style={{
            minWidth: `${sideWidth + totalTimelineWidth}px`,
            paddingTop: `${paddingTop}px`,
            paddingBottom: `${paddingBottom}px`
          }}
        >
          {/* Background Grid Lines */}
          <GanttGridOverlay
            totalDays={totalDays}
            dayWidth={dayWidth}
            sideWidth={sideWidth}
            timeUnits={timeUnits}
          />

          {/* Today Indicator Line */}
          <GanttTodayLine
            customToday={customToday}
            setCustomToday={setCustomToday}
            isDraggingToday={isDraggingToday}
            setIsDraggingToday={setIsDraggingToday}
            startDate={startDate}
            dayWidth={dayWidth}
            sideWidth={sideWidth}
            showStart={showStart}
            startColWidth={startColWidth}
            showFinish={showFinish}
            finishColWidth={finishColWidth}
            showParty={showParty}
            partyColWidth={partyColWidth}
            showDuration={showDuration}
            durationColWidth={durationColWidth}
            showPredecessor={showPredecessor}
            predecessorColWidth={predecessorColWidth}
            getDateFromOffsetPx={getDateFromOffsetPx}
          />

          {/* SVG Dependency Lines */}
          {dependencyLines.length > 0 && (
            <GanttDependencyLinks dependencyLines={dependencyLines} />
          )}

          {/* Virtualized Rows List */}
          {visibleGanttRows.length === 0 ? (
            <GanttEmptyState />
          ) : (
            visibleGanttRows.map((row) => {
              if (row.type === 'project') {
                return (
                  <GanttProjectRow
                    key={row.key}
                    p={row.project}
                    pIdx={row.projectIndex}
                    projectTasks={getGroupTasksForProject ? getGroupTasksForProject(row.project) : []}
                    isExpanded={row.isExpanded}
                    expandedModularTasks={expandedModularTasks}
                    setExpandedModularTasks={setExpandedModularTasks}
                    toggleProjectExpansion={toggleProjectExpansion}
                    sideWidth={sideWidth}
                    showStart={showStart}
                    startColWidth={startColWidth}
                    showFinish={showFinish}
                    finishColWidth={finishColWidth}
                    showParty={showParty}
                    partyColWidth={partyColWidth}
                    showDuration={showDuration}
                    durationColWidth={durationColWidth}
                    showPredecessor={showPredecessor}
                    predecessorColWidth={predecessorColWidth}
                    startDate={startDate}
                    dayWidth={dayWidth}
                    activeTooltip={activeTooltip}
                    setActiveTooltip={setActiveTooltip}
                    isEditMode={isEditMode}
                    canWrite={canWrite}
                    selectedProjectSet={selectedProjectSet}
                    selectedProjectIds={selectedProjectIds}
                    selectedTaskSet={selectedTaskSet}
                    selectedTaskIds={selectedTaskIds}
                    setSelectedProjectIds={setSelectedProjectIds}
                    setSelectedTaskIds={setSelectedTaskIds}
                    getBarColor={getBarColor}
                    handleTogglePin={handleTogglePin}
                    getRowVisibilityClass={getRowVisibilityClass}
                    isHideMode={isHideMode}
                    toggleHideRow={toggleHideRow}
                  />
                );
              }

              return (
                <GanttTaskRow
                  key={row.key}
                  t={row.task}
                  taskIndex={row.taskIndex}
                  p={row.project}
                  isChild={row.isChild}
                  parentTask={row.parentTask}
                  hasChildren={row.hasChildren}
                  childCount={row.childCount}
                  childTasks={row.type === 'task' ? row.childTasks : undefined}
                  isModularExpanded={row.isModularExpanded}
                  projects={projects}
                  tasks={tasks}
                  delegationGroups={delegationGroups}
                  isHighlightDelegationOn={false}
                  currentUser={currentUser}
                  selectedTaskSet={selectedTaskSet}
                  selectedTaskIds={selectedTaskIds}
                  setSelectedTaskIds={setSelectedTaskIds}
                  isEditMode={isEditMode}
                  canWrite={canWrite}
                  handleGroupModularTasks={handleGroupModularTasks}
                  handleUnlinkModularTasks={handleUnlinkModularTasks}
                  toggleModularParent={toggleModularParent}
                  getRowVisibilityClass={getRowVisibilityClass}
                  sideWidth={sideWidth}
                  showStart={showStart}
                  startColWidth={startColWidth}
                  showFinish={showFinish}
                  finishColWidth={finishColWidth}
                  showParty={showParty}
                  partyColWidth={partyColWidth}
                  showDuration={showDuration}
                  durationColWidth={durationColWidth}
                  showPredecessor={showPredecessor}
                  predecessorColWidth={predecessorColWidth}
                  timeUnits={timeUnits}
                  startDate={startDate}
                  dayWidth={dayWidth}
                  activeTooltip={activeTooltip}
                  setActiveTooltip={setActiveTooltip}
                  getBarColor={getBarColor}
                  initialFocusTaskId={initialFocusTaskId}
                  ganttTabFocusTaskId={ganttTabFocusTaskId}
                  draggingTaskIds={draggingTaskIds}
                  handleTaskDragStart={handleTaskDragStart}
                  handleTaskDragOver={handleTaskDragOver}
                  handleTaskDragLeave={handleTaskDragLeave}
                  handleTaskDrop={handleTaskDrop}
                  handleTaskDragEnd={handleTaskDragEnd}
                  dragOverTaskId={dragOverTaskId}
                  dropPosition={dropPosition}
                  handleTaskCheckboxChange={(e, id, isShift) => handleTaskCheckboxChange(e, id, isShift, allOrderedTaskIds)}
                  isHideMode={isHideMode}
                  toggleHideRow={toggleHideRow}
                  onNavigateToTaskDetail={onNavigateToTaskDetail}
                />
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Floating Sum Duration Badge */}
      {computedSum !== null && (
        <GanttSumBadge sumDuration={computedSum} />
      )}

      {/* Fullscreen Export Overlay */}
      {isExporting && (
        <GanttExportOverlay />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttTaskLeftColumns.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, GripVertical, EyeOff, Unlink } from 'lucide-react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { cn } from './GanttUtils';
import { computeTaskCode } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface GanttTaskLeftColumnsProps {
  t: Task;
  taskIndex?: number;
  taskCode?: string;
  projects?: Project[];
  tasks?: Task[];
  isChild: boolean;
  parentTask?: Task;
  hasChildren: boolean;
  childCount: number;
  isModularExpanded: boolean;
  toggleModularParent: (taskId: string | number) => void;
  selectedTaskSet: Set<string>;
  handleTaskCheckboxChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement> | React.MouseEvent, id: string, isShift?: boolean) => void;
  isHideMode: boolean;
  toggleHideRow: (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  isDragging: boolean;
  handleTaskDragStart: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleTaskDragEnd: () => void;
  isEditMode?: boolean;
  isFocused?: boolean;
  onNavigateToTaskDetail?: (taskId: string) => void;
  handleUnlinkModularTasks?: (childTaskIds: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
}

export function GanttTaskLeftColumns({
  t,
  taskIndex,
  taskCode: propTaskCode,
  projects = [],
  tasks = [],
  isChild,
  hasChildren,
  childCount,
  isModularExpanded,
  toggleModularParent,
  selectedTaskSet,
  handleTaskCheckboxChange,
  isHideMode,
  toggleHideRow,
  isDragging,
  handleTaskDragStart,
  handleTaskDragEnd,
  isEditMode = false,
  isFocused = false,
  onNavigateToTaskDetail,
  handleUnlinkModularTasks
}: GanttTaskLeftColumnsProps) {
  const isSelected = selectedTaskSet.has(String(t.id)) || selectedTaskSet.has(t.id);
  const taskCode = propTaskCode || (projects.length > 0 && tasks.length > 0 ? computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, t) : (t.taskCodePhu || ''));
  const shiftClickedRef = useRef(false);
  const isParentTask = hasChildren || childCount > 0 || Boolean((t as any).isModularParent);

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center w-full h-full overflow-hidden">
      {/* Selection Checkbox & Drag Handle & Hide Button - ONLY in Edit Mode */}
      {isEditMode ? (
        <div className="w-10 px-1 py-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 shrink-0 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336]">
          {isHideMode ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => toggleHideRow(`task-${t.id}`, e)}
              className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-amber-500 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Hide this task"
            >
              <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
              {!isParentTask ? (
                <div
                  draggable
                  onDragStart={(e) => handleTaskDragStart(e, t.id)}
                  onDragEnd={handleTaskDragEnd}
                  className="cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-0.5"
                  title="Drag to reorder task"
                >
                  <GripVertical className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 p-0.5 cursor-not-allowed" title="Dragging disabled for parent tasks">
                  <GripVertical className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-30" />
                </div>
              )}
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={isSelected}
                onPointerDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.shiftKey) shiftClickedRef.current = true;
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.shiftKey) shiftClickedRef.current = true;
                }}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  if (e.shiftKey) shiftClickedRef.current = true;
                }}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const isShift = Boolean(
                    shiftClickedRef.current ||
                    (e.nativeEvent as MouseEvent)?.shiftKey ||
                    (e as any).shiftKey ||
                    (window.event as any)?.shiftKey
                  );
                  shiftClickedRef.current = false;
                  handleTaskCheckboxChange(e, String(t.id), isShift);
                }}
                className="rounded border-slate-600 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 w-3.5 h-3.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="w-10 px-1 py-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-semibold select-none">
          {taskIndex !== undefined ? taskIndex + 1 : (t.orderIndex !== undefined ? t.orderIndex + 1 : '#')}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Task Name Column with indentation for child tasks */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 px-2 py-1 flex items-center gap-1 overflow-hidden">
        {isChild && <div className="w-3 shrink-0" />}
        
        {hasChildren && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => toggleModularParent(t.id)}
            className="p-0.5 rounded bg-purple-600 text-white hover:bg-purple-700 shadow-xs shrink-0 cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-90"
            title="Toggle Grouped Tasks"
          >
            {isModularExpanded ? (
              <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white font-bold stroke-[2.5]" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white font-bold stroke-[2.5]" />
            )}
          </button>
        )}

        {(isChild || Boolean(t.parentTaskId)) && handleUnlinkModularTasks && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              handleUnlinkModularTasks([String(t.id)]);
            }}
            className="p-0.5 rounded text-amber-600 hover:text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 dark:hover:text-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-50 dark:hover:bg-amber-950/50 shrink-0 cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-90"
            title="Unlink child task from parent group"
          >
            <Unlink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        )}

        <div 
          onClick={(e) => {
            if (isEditMode) return;
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (onNavigateToTaskDetail) {
              onNavigateToTaskDetail(t.id);
            }
          }}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate flex-1 min-w-0 p-0.5 rounded transition-colors group/tname overflow-hidden",
            !isEditMode ? "cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]" : ""
          )}
          title={isEditMode ? (isParentTask ? `Parent task (${t.name}) - Dragging disabled` : `Click and drag row to reorder task (${t.name})`) : `Click to view task in Task Detail (${t.name})`}
        >
          {isEditMode && (
            (t.party?.toLowerCase().includes('tenant') || t.party?.toLowerCase().includes('contractor') || t.party?.toLowerCase().includes('nt') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('tenant') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('design guideline') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('opening') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('fit-out') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('shop drawing') || t.name?.toLowerCase().includes('re-instatement')) ? (
              <span className="text-blue-400 text-[10px] shrink-0 font-black">▶</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-emerald-400 text-xs shrink-0">📌</span>
            )
          )}

          <span className="text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 truncate font-semibold flex-1 min-w-0 group-hover/tname:text-blue-600 dark:group-hover/tname:text-[#8ab4f8]" title={t.name}>
            {t.name || '(Unnamed Task)'}
          </span>

          {hasChildren && (
            <span className="text-[10px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold shrink-0">
              ({childCount})
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttTaskRow.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { Project, Task, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { getTaskStatus, computeActProgressPercent, resolveActualStatus, getUserDelegationRoleForTask, parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { computeTaskCode } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { GanttBar } from './GanttBar';
import { GanttBaseline } from './GanttBaseline';
import { GanttTaskLeftColumns } from './GanttTaskLeftColumns';
import { cn, formatGanttDate, renderGanttDateCell } from './GanttUtils';
import { useIsRowFlashed } from '../../lib/changeFlashService';

export interface GanttTaskRowProps {
  t: Task;
  taskIndex?: number;
  isChild: boolean;
  parentTask?: Task;
  hasChildren: boolean;
  childCount: number;
  childTasks?: Task[];
  isModularExpanded: boolean;
  p: Project;
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  delegationGroups: any[];
  isHighlightDelegationOn: boolean;
  currentUser: AppUser | null;
  selectedTaskSet: Set<string>;
  selectedTaskIds: string[];
  setSelectedTaskIds: (ids: string[] | ((prev: string[]) => string[])) => void;
  isEditMode: boolean;
  canWrite: boolean;
  handleGroupModularTasks: (parentTaskId: string, childTaskIds: string[]) => void;
  handleUnlinkModularTasks: (childTaskIds: string[]) => void;
  toggleModularParent: (taskId: string | number) => void;
  getRowVisibilityClass: (id: string) => string;
  sideWidth: number;
  showStart: boolean;
  startColWidth: number;
  showFinish: boolean;
  finishColWidth: number;
  showParty: boolean;
  partyColWidth: number;
  showDuration: boolean;
  durationColWidth: number;
  showPredecessor?: boolean;
  predecessorColWidth?: number;
  timeUnits: any[];
  startDate: Date;
  dayWidth: number;
  activeTooltip: string | null;
  setActiveTooltip: (id: string | null) => void;
  getBarColor: (status: string, duration?: string | number) => string;
  initialFocusTaskId?: string | null;
  ganttTabFocusTaskId?: string | null;
  draggingTaskIds: string[];
  handleTaskDragStart: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleTaskDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleTaskDragLeave: (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => void;
  handleTaskDrop: (e: React.DragEvent, targetTask: Task, parentProject?: Project) => void | Promise<void>;
  handleTaskDragEnd: () => void;
  dragOverTaskId: string | null;
  dropPosition: 'before' | 'inside' | 'after' | null;
  handleTaskCheckboxChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement> | React.MouseEvent, id: string, isShift?: boolean) => void;
  isHideMode: boolean;
  toggleHideRow: (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  onNavigateToTaskDetail?: (taskId: string) => void;
}

export const GanttTaskRow = React.memo(function GanttTaskRow({
  t,
  taskIndex,
  isChild,
  parentTask,
  hasChildren,
  childCount,
  childTasks,
  isModularExpanded,
  p,
  projects,
  tasks,
  delegationGroups,
  isHighlightDelegationOn,
  currentUser,
  selectedTaskSet,
  selectedTaskIds,
  setSelectedTaskIds,
  isEditMode,
  canWrite,
  handleGroupModularTasks,
  handleUnlinkModularTasks,
  toggleModularParent,
  getRowVisibilityClass,
  sideWidth,
  showStart,
  startColWidth,
  showFinish,
  finishColWidth,
  showParty,
  partyColWidth,
  showDuration,
  durationColWidth,
  showPredecessor = false,
  predecessorColWidth = 90,
  timeUnits,
  startDate,
  dayWidth,
  activeTooltip,
  setActiveTooltip,
  getBarColor,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  ganttTabFocusTaskId,
  draggingTaskIds,
  handleTaskDragStart,
  handleTaskDragOver,
  handleTaskDragLeave,
  handleTaskDrop,
  handleTaskDragEnd,
  dragOverTaskId,
  dropPosition,
  handleTaskCheckboxChange,
  isHideMode,
  toggleHideRow,
  onNavigateToTaskDetail
}: GanttTaskRowProps) {
  const isSelected = selectedTaskSet.has(String(t.id)) || selectedTaskSet.has(t.id);
  const isTarget = dragOverTaskId === t.id;
  const isDragging = draggingTaskIds.includes(t.id);
  const isFocused = initialFocusTaskId === t.id || ganttTabFocusTaskId === t.id;

  const userRole = currentUser ? getUserDelegationRoleForTask(t, currentUser, delegationGroups || []) : null;
  const highlightRole = isHighlightDelegationOn ? userRole : null;

  const planStatus = getTaskStatus(t.start, t.finish);
  const linkedGroup = (delegationGroups || []).find((g: any) => g.taskId === t.id || g.parentTaskId === t.id);
  const actStatusObj = resolveActualStatus(planStatus, linkedGroup?.subTasks || []);
  const actPrg = computeActProgressPercent([t], delegationGroups || []);
  const taskCode = computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, t);

  // Compute accurate lifecycle status taking into account runningStatus, delegation, approvals, progress, and dates
  let effectiveStatus = planStatus;
  const running = (t.runningStatus || '').toLowerCase();
  const actLabel = (actStatusObj.label || '').toLowerCase();

  if (running.includes('complete') || t.approval === 'Approved' || actPrg >= 100 || actLabel.includes('complete')) {
    effectiveStatus = 'Completed';
  } else if (running.includes('delay') || actLabel.includes('reject') || actLabel.includes('delay')) {
    effectiveStatus = 'Delayed';
  } else if (running.includes('cancel')) {
    effectiveStatus = 'Canceled';
  } else if (running.includes('process') || running.includes('progress') || (actPrg > 0 && actPrg < 100) || actLabel.includes('progress') || actLabel.includes('process')) {
    effectiveStatus = 'On process';
  } else if (running.includes('upcoming') || actLabel.includes('planned') || actLabel.includes('upcoming')) {
    effectiveStatus = 'Upcoming';
  } else {
    // Check if task is overdue (past finish date but not completed)
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const dFinish = parseDateTime(t.finish);
    if (dFinish) dFinish.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    if (dFinish && today > dFinish && actPrg < 100 && t.approval !== 'Approved') {
      effectiveStatus = 'Delayed';
    }
  }

  const onProcessChildTasks = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!hasChildren || !childTasks || childTasks.length === 0) return [];

    return childTasks
      .filter((ct) => {
        const plSt = getTaskStatus(ct.start, ct.finish);
        const lg = (delegationGroups || []).find((g: any) => g.taskId === ct.id || g.parentTaskId === ct.id);
        const actStObj = resolveActualStatus(plSt, lg?.subTasks || []);
        const prg = computeActProgressPercent([ct], delegationGroups || []);
        const running = (ct.runningStatus || '').toLowerCase();
        const actLabel = (actStObj.label || '').toLowerCase();

        if (running.includes('complete') || ct.approval === 'Approved' || prg >= 100 || actLabel.includes('complete')) {
          return false;
        }

        if (
          running.includes('process') ||
          running.includes('progress') ||
          actLabel.includes('process') ||
          actLabel.includes('progress') ||
          plSt === 'On process'
        ) {
          return true;
        }

        if (prg > 0 && prg < 100) {
          return true;
        }

        return false;
      })
      .map((ct) => {
        const ctPrg = computeActProgressPercent([ct], delegationGroups || []);
        const ctCode = ct.taskCodePhu || computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, ct);
        return {
          id: String(ct.id),
          name: ct.name,
          taskCode: ctCode,
          actPrg: ctPrg,
          start: ct.start,
          finish: ct.finish,
          duration: ct.duration,
        };
      });
  }, [hasChildren, childTasks, delegationGroups, projects, tasks]);

  const extraVars = {
    actStatus: effectiveStatus,
    actStatusColor: actStatusObj.color,
    party: t.party,
    actPrg,
    duration: t.duration,
    taskCode,
    predecessors: t.predecessor,
    highlight: highlightRole,
    hasChildren,
    childCount,
    task: t,
    tasks,
    projects,
    canWrite,
    onNavigateToTaskDetail,
    onProcessChildTasks,
  };

  const { isFlashed } = useIsRowFlashed(t.id);
  const isParentTask = hasChildren || childCount > 0 || Boolean((t as any).isModularParent);

  return (
    <div
      id={`gantt-task-row-${t.id}`}
      draggable={isEditMode && !isParentTask}
      onDragStart={(e) => {
        if (!isEditMode || isParentTask) {
          e.preventDefault();
          return;
        }
        const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
        if (target.closest('input, button, a, [role="button"]')) {
          e.preventDefault();
          return;
        }
        handleTaskDragStart(e, t.id);
      }}
      onDragEnd={() => isEditMode && !isParentTask && handleTaskDragEnd()}
      onDragOver={(e) => isEditMode && handleTaskDragOver(e, t.id)}
      onDragLeave={(e) => isEditMode && handleTaskDragLeave(e, t.id)}
      onDrop={(e) => isEditMode && handleTaskDrop(e, t, p)}
      className={cn(
        "flex h-10 min-h-[40px] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 transition-all duration-700 relative group",
        getRowVisibilityClass(`task-${t.id}`),
        isSelected ? "bg-blue-50/50 dark:bg-blue-950/30" : "hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40",
        isEditMode && !isParentTask && "cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:bg-blue-50/70 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/30",
        isEditMode && isParentTask && "hover:bg-purple-50/40 dark:hover:bg-purple-950/20 cursor-default",
        isDragging && "opacity-40",
        isTarget && dropPosition === 'before' && "border-t-2 border-t-blue-500",
        isTarget && dropPosition === 'after' && "border-b-2 border-b-blue-500",
        isFlashed && "ring-2 ring-emerald-500/80 bg-emerald-50/80 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 z-20 shadow-sm"
      )}
    >
      {/* Left Side Columns Container */}
      <div
        className="sticky left-0 z-20 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] flex border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0 h-full items-center overflow-hidden"
        style={{ width: `${sideWidth}px` }}
      >
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 h-full flex items-center overflow-hidden">
          <GanttTaskLeftColumns
            t={t}
            taskIndex={taskIndex}
            taskCode={taskCode}
            projects={projects}
            tasks={tasks}
            isChild={isChild}
            parentTask={parentTask}
            hasChildren={hasChildren}
            childCount={childCount}
            isModularExpanded={isModularExpanded}
            toggleModularParent={toggleModularParent}
            selectedTaskSet={selectedTaskSet}
            handleTaskCheckboxChange={handleTaskCheckboxChange}
            isHideMode={isHideMode}
            toggleHideRow={toggleHideRow}
            isDragging={isDragging}
            handleTaskDragStart={handleTaskDragStart}
            handleTaskDragEnd={handleTaskDragEnd}
            isEditMode={isEditMode}
            isFocused={isFocused}
            onNavigateToTaskDetail={onNavigateToTaskDetail}
            handleUnlinkModularTasks={handleUnlinkModularTasks}
          />
        </div>

        {showStart && (
          <div
            className="border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: startColWidth, minWidth: startColWidth, maxWidth: startColWidth }}
          >
            {renderGanttDateCell(t.start, "text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]")}
          </div>
        )}

        {showFinish && (
          <div
            className="border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: finishColWidth, minWidth: finishColWidth, maxWidth: finishColWidth }}
          >
            {renderGanttDateCell(t.finish, "text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400")}
          </div>
        )}

        {showParty && (
          <div
            className="text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full"
            style={{ width: partyColWidth, minWidth: partyColWidth, maxWidth: partyColWidth }}
          >
            {t.party || "-"}
          </div>
        )}

        {showDuration && (
          <div
            className="font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] p-1 flex items-center justify-center font-bold shrink-0 h-full"
            style={{ width: durationColWidth, minWidth: durationColWidth, maxWidth: durationColWidth }}
          >
            {t.duration ? `${t.duration}d` : "-"}
          </div>
        )}

        {showPredecessor && (
          <div
            className="font-mono text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-semibold border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 h-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ width: predecessorColWidth, minWidth: predecessorColWidth, maxWidth: predecessorColWidth }}
            title={t.predecessor || ""}
          >
            <span className="truncate">{t.predecessor || "-"}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Right Timeline Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 relative h-full flex items-center">
        {/* Baseline Bar (from baselineStart/baseStart or plan start to baselineFinish/baseFinish or plan finish) */}
        <GanttBaseline
          baselineStart={t.baselineStart || (t as any).baseStart}
          baselineFinish={t.baselineFinish || (t as any).baseFinish}
          startStr={t.start}
          endStr={t.finish}
          startDate={startDate}
          dayWidth={dayWidth}
        />

        {/* Task Main Gantt Bar */}
        <GanttBar
          id={`task-${t.id}`}
          label={t.name}
          startStr={t.start}
          endStr={t.finish}
          status={effectiveStatus}
          extraVars={extraVars}
          startDate={startDate}
          dayWidth={dayWidth}
          activeTooltip={activeTooltip}
          setActiveTooltip={setActiveTooltip}
          isEditMode={isEditMode}
          getBarColor={getBarColor}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

import React from 'react';

export interface GanttTimelineHeaderProps {
  timeUnits: Array<{
    date: Date;
    days: number;
    label?: string;
    labelPrimary?: string;
    labelSecondary?: string;
  }>;
  dayWidth: number;
}

export const GanttTimelineHeader: React.FC<GanttTimelineHeaderProps> = React.memo(({
  timeUnits,
  dayWidth,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing" title="Wheel to Zoom, Click & Drag to Pan">
      {timeUnits.map((unit) => {
        const width = unit.days * dayWidth;
        return (
          <div
            key={unit.date.getTime()}
            className="flex flex-col justify-center items-center border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-center shrink-0 px-1 py-1"
            style={{
              width: `${width}px`,
              minWidth: `${width}px`,
              maxWidth: `${width}px`,
            }}
          >
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] truncate">
              {unit.labelPrimary || unit.label}
            </div>
            {unit.labelSecondary && (
              <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] truncate">
                {unit.labelSecondary}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttTodayLine.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { format } from 'date-fns';

export interface GanttTodayLineProps {
  showToday?: boolean;
  sideWidth?: number;
  showStart?: boolean;
  startColWidth?: number;
  showFinish?: boolean;
  finishColWidth?: number;
  showParty?: boolean;
  partyColWidth?: number;
  showDuration?: boolean;
  durationColWidth?: number;
  showPredecessor?: boolean;
  predecessorColWidth?: number;
  todayLeftPx?: number;
  customToday: Date;
  setCustomToday?: (d: Date) => void;
  isDraggingToday?: boolean;
  setIsDraggingToday?: (v: boolean) => void;
  startDate?: Date;
  dayWidth?: number;
  getDateFromOffsetPx?: (offsetPx: number) => Date;
}

export const GanttTodayLine: React.FC<GanttTodayLineProps> = React.memo(({
  showToday = true,
  sideWidth = 0,
  showStart = false,
  startColWidth = 0,
  showFinish = false,
  finishColWidth = 0,
  showParty = false,
  partyColWidth = 0,
  showDuration = false,
  durationColWidth = 0,
  showPredecessor = false,
  predecessorColWidth = 0,
  todayLeftPx,
  customToday,
  setCustomToday,
  isDraggingToday,
  setIsDraggingToday,
  startDate,
  dayWidth = 30,
  getDateFromOffsetPx,
}) => {
  if (!showToday) return null;

  let calculatedTodayLeft = todayLeftPx;
  if (calculatedTodayLeft === undefined && startDate) {
    const diffDays = (customToday.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
    calculatedTodayLeft = diffDays * dayWidth;
  }

  const leftPosition = sideWidth + (calculatedTodayLeft || 0);

  const formattedDate = format(customToday, 'dd/MM/yyyy');

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (!setIsDraggingToday || !setCustomToday || !getDateFromOffsetPx) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDraggingToday(true);

    const onMouseMove = (moveEvent: MouseEvent) => {
      const containerRect = (e.currentTarget.parentElement?.parentElement as HTMLElement)?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!containerRect) return;
      const mouseOffset = moveEvent.clientX - containerRect.left - sideWidth;
      const newDate = getDateFromOffsetPx(mouseOffset);
      setCustomToday(newDate);
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingToday(false);
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 pointer-events-none z-[60] group/today"
      style={{ left: `${leftPosition}px`, width: '0px' }}
      title={`Today: ${formattedDate}`}
    >
      {/* Today Pin Header Badge centered directly above the vertical line */}
      <div 
        onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
        className="sticky top-1.5 z-[65] select-none pointer-events-auto cursor-ew-resize flex flex-col items-center -translate-x-1/2"
      >
        <div className="bg-[#f43f5e] text-white font-extrabold text-[9px] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full shadow-lg tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap ring-1 ring-white/40 border border-white/20">
          <span>TODAY</span>
          <span className="opacity-95 font-mono font-bold">({formattedDate})</span>
        </div>
        {/* Pointer arrow connecting badge center directly to the line */}
        <div className="w-0 h-0 border-x-4 border-x-transparent border-t-4 border-t-[#f43f5e] -mt-[1px]" />
      </div>

      {/* Glowing Today Line centered at the exact middle */}
      <div className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 left-0 -translate-x-1/2 w-0.5 bg-[#f43f5e] shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(244,63,94,0.7)]" />
    </div>
  );
});

GanttTodayLine.displayName = 'GanttTodayLine';

export function GanttToolbar({
  globalYearFilter,
  setGlobalYearFilter,
  uniqueYears,
  effectiveStore,
  setGlobalStoreFilter,
  uniqueStores,
  globalLocationFilter,
  setGlobalLocationFilter,
  locationOptions,
  filterProjectStatus,
  onStatusFilterChange,
  isTasksLoading,
  canWrite,
  isEditMode,
  setIsEditMode,
  isHighlightDelegationOn,
  setIsHighlightDelegationOn,
  selectedProjectIds,
  selectedTaskIds,
  setSelectedProjectIds,
  setSelectedTaskIds,
  handleSetTextColor,
  handleSetBaselineSelected,
  handleUnlinkModularTasks,
  isTaskModularModalOpen = false,
  setIsTaskModularModalOpen,
  sumMode,
  setSumMode,
  handleDeleteSelected,
  isHideMode,
  setIsHideMode,
  hiddenRows,
  setHiddenRows,
  handleExportToPDF,
  isExporting,
  tempStartDate,
  setTempStartDate,
  tempEndDate,
  setTempEndDate,
  setFilterStartDate,
  setFilterEndDate,
  visibleColumns,
  handleToggleColumn,
  handleTodayClick,
  viewMode,
  setViewMode,
  scaleInput,
  setScaleInput,
  dayWidth,
  setDayWidth,
  isWidthChanged,
  setIsWidthChanged,
  saveDayWidth,
  searchTerm,
  setSearchTerm,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  ganttTabFocusTaskId,
  ganttTabFilterProjectId,
  handleClearFocus,
}: GanttToolbarProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const tasks = useAppStore((state) => state.tasks);

  const activeFocusTaskId = initialFocusTaskId || ganttTabFocusTaskId;
  const focusedTask = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeFocusTaskId || !tasks) return null;
    return tasks.find(t => String(t.id) === String(activeFocusTaskId)) || null;
  }, [activeFocusTaskId, tasks]);

  return (
    <div className="p-2 sm:p-3 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#121214] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col gap-2 shrink-0 print:hidden rounded-t-xl text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
      {/* Row 1: 4 Compact Filter Boxes in 2x2 grid on mobile and 4 cols on desktop */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-2 justify-between items-stretch lg:items-center w-full">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 flex-grow w-full">
          {/* Col 1: Year */}
          <select
            value={globalYearFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setGlobalYearFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/80 text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-xs rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 outline-none shadow-xs font-medium cursor-pointer h-8"

          {/* Col 2: Store */}

            ))}
          </select>

          {/* Col 3: Location */}

            value={globalLocationFilter}

            options={locationOptions}

            className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/80 rounded-lg text-xs"
          />

          {/* Col 4: Status */}
          <select
            value={filterProjectStatus}
            onChange={(e) => onStatusFilterChange(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/80 text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-xs rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 outline-none shadow-xs font-medium cursor-pointer h-8"
