    </div>
  );
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttToolbarActions.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Palette, Play, Layers, Unlink, Trash2, Eye, EyeOff, Save, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

interface GanttToolbarActionsProps {
  selectedProjectIds: string[];
  selectedTaskIds: string[];
  handleSetTextColor: (color: string | null) => void;
  handleSetBaselineSelected: () => void;
  handleUnlinkModularTasks?: (childTaskIds?: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
  setIsTaskModularModalOpen: (val: boolean) => void;
  sumMode: "none" | "duration";
  setSumMode: (val: "none" | "duration") => void;
  handleDeleteSelected: () => void;
  isHideMode: boolean;
  setIsHideMode: (val: boolean) => void;
  hiddenRows: string[];
  setHiddenRows: (rows: string[]) => void;
  handleExportToPDF: () => void;
  isExporting: boolean;
}

const COLOR_OPTIONS = [
  { label: 'Default', color: null, bg: 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700' },
  { label: 'Red', color: '#ef4444', bg: 'bg-red-500' },
  { label: 'Blue', color: '#3b82f6', bg: 'bg-blue-500' },
  { label: 'Green', color: '#10b981', bg: 'bg-emerald-500' },
  { label: 'Amber', color: '#f59e0b', bg: 'bg-amber-500' },
  { label: 'Purple', color: '#8b5cf6', bg: 'bg-purple-500' },
];

export function GanttToolbarActions({
  selectedProjectIds,
  selectedTaskIds,
  handleSetTextColor,
  handleSetBaselineSelected,
  handleUnlinkModularTasks,
  setIsTaskModularModalOpen,
  sumMode,
  setSumMode,
  handleDeleteSelected,
  isHideMode,
  setIsHideMode,
  hiddenRows,
  setHiddenRows,
  handleExportToPDF,
  isExporting
}: GanttToolbarActionsProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [isColorMenuOpen, setIsColorMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const colorMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const totalSelected = selectedProjectIds.length + selectedTaskIds.length;

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (colorMenuRef.current && !colorMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsColorMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
      {/* Color Palette Menu */}
      <div className="relative" ref={colorMenuRef}>
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={totalSelected === 0}
          onClick={() => setIsColorMenuOpen(!isColorMenuOpen)}
          className={cn(
            "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
            totalSelected > 0
              ? "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-50"
              : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400"
          )}
          title={t('Set text color for selected items')}
        >
          <Palette className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-500" />
          <span className="hidden xl:inline">{t('Color')}</span>
        </button>

        {isColorMenuOpen && (
          <div className="absolute top-full left-0 mt-1 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-xl p-2 z-50 flex items-center gap-1.5 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
            {COLOR_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
              <button
                key={opt.label}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  handleSetTextColor(opt.color);
                  setIsColorMenuOpen(false);
                }}
                className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full ${opt.bg} border-2 border-white dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm hover:scale-110 transition-transform`}
                title={opt.label}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Set Baseline */}
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={totalSelected === 0}
        onClick={handleSetBaselineSelected}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          totalSelected > 0
            ? "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-50"
            : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400"
        )}
        title={t('Set baseline dates for selected items')}
      >
        <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
        <span className="hidden xl:inline">{t('Baseline')}</span>
      </button>

      {/* Group Modular Tasks */}
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={selectedTaskIds.length < 1}
        onClick={() => setIsTaskModularModalOpen(true)}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          selectedTaskIds.length >= 1
            ? "bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/40 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 hover:bg-purple-100 cursor-pointer"
            : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400"
        )}
        title={t('Group selected tasks into a parent modular task')}
      >
        <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        <span className="hidden xl:inline">{t('Modular')}</span>
      </button>

      {/* Unlink Selected Tasks from Parent Link */}
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={selectedTaskIds.length < 1}
        onClick={() => {
          if (handleUnlinkModularTasks) {
            handleUnlinkModularTasks(selectedTaskIds);
          }
        }}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          selectedTaskIds.length >= 1
            ? "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-100 cursor-pointer"
            : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400"
        )}
        title={t('Unlink selected tasks from parent modular link')}
      >
        <Unlink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
        <span>{t('Unlink')}{selectedTaskIds.length > 0 ? ` (${selectedTaskIds.length})` : ''}</span>
      </button>

      {/* Sum Duration */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setSumMode(sumMode === 'none' ? 'duration' : 'none')}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          sumMode !== 'none'
            ? "bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-600 text-white shadow-xs"
            : "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-50"
        )}
        title={t('Toggle sum duration calculation for selected tasks')}
      >
        <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs">∑</span>
        <span className="hidden xl:inline">{t('Sum')}</span>
      </button>

      {/* Delete Selected */}
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={totalSelected === 0}
        onClick={handleDeleteSelected}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          totalSelected > 0
            ? "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 border-red-200 dark:border-red-900 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-100"
            : "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400"
        )}
        title={t('Delete selected projects or tasks')}
      >
        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        <span className="hidden xl:inline">{t('Delete')} ({totalSelected})</span>
      </button>

      {/* Hide / Unhide Mode */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsHideMode(!isHideMode)}
        className={cn(
          "p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95",
          isHideMode
            ? "bg-amber-500 border-amber-500 text-white shadow-xs"
            : "bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] hover:bg-slate-50"
        )}
        title={t('Toggle Hide Rows Mode')}
      >
        {isHideMode ? <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />}
        <span className="hidden xl:inline">{isHideMode ? t('Done') : t('Hide Rows')}</span>
      </button>

      {/* PDF Export */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleExportToPDF}
        disabled={isExporting}
        className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-xs shadow-xs transition-colors active:scale-95 shrink-0"
        title="Export Gantt Timeline as PDF"
      >
        {isExporting ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : null}
        <span>{t('PDF')}</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import { ViewMode } from './ganttTypes';

interface GanttToolbarDateFilterProps {
  handleTodayClick: () => void;
  viewMode: ViewMode;
  setViewMode: (mode: ViewMode) => void;
  scaleInput: string;
  setScaleInput: (val: string) => void;
  dayWidth: number;
  setDayWidth: (val: number) => void;
  isWidthChanged: boolean;
  setIsWidthChanged: (val: boolean) => void;
  saveDayWidth: () => void;
  tempStartDate: string;
  setTempStartDate: (val: string) => void;
  tempEndDate: string;
  setTempEndDate: (val: string) => void;
  setFilterStartDate: (val: string) => void;
  setFilterEndDate: (val: string) => void;

export function GanttToolbarDateFilter({
  handleTodayClick,
  viewMode,
  setViewMode,
  scaleInput,
  setScaleInput,
  dayWidth,
  setDayWidth,
  isWidthChanged,
  setIsWidthChanged,
  saveDayWidth,
  tempStartDate,
  setTempStartDate,
  tempEndDate,
  setTempEndDate,
  setFilterStartDate,
  setFilterEndDate
}: GanttToolbarDateFilterProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [isDateFilterOpen, setIsDateFilterOpen] = useState(false);
  const dateFilterRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dateFilterRef.current && !dateFilterRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setIsDateFilterOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const handleApplyDateRange = () => {
    setFilterStartDate(tempStartDate);
    setFilterEndDate(tempEndDate);
    setIsDateFilterOpen(false);
  };

  const handleResetDateRange = () => {
    setTempStartDate('');
    setTempEndDate('');
    setFilterStartDate('');
    setFilterEndDate('');
    setIsDateFilterOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
      {/* Date Range Popover */}
      <div className="relative" ref={dateFilterRef}>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsDateFilterOpen(!isDateFilterOpen)}
          className={cn(
            "px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-xs cursor-pointer",
            tempStartDate || tempEndDate
              ? "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#182338] border-blue-600 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold"
              : "bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700/80 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#252528]"
          )}
          title={t('Filter Date Range')}
        >
          <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
          <span>{t('Date Filter')}</span>
        </button>

        {isDateFilterOpen && (
          <div className="absolute top-full left-0 mt-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl shadow-2xl p-3 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2.5 w-64 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-200">
              <span>{t('Filter Timeline Range')}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsDateFilterOpen(false)}
                className="p-0.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-slate-200"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">{t('From Date')}:</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={tempStartDate}
                onChange={(e) => setTempStartDate(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#141416] border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">{t('To Date')}:</label>
              <input
                type="date"

                onChange={(e) => setTempEndDate(e.target.value)}

              <button

        title="Jump timeline to Today"

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttTooltipPredecessor.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { PredecessorSearchSuggest } from '../TaskModalParts/PredecessorSearchSuggest';
import { resolvePredecessorString } from '../../lib/predecessorMatchUtils';
import { 
  buildTaskNoMap, 
  parsePredecessors, 
  calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors, 
  scheduleDependentTasks, 
  splitPredecessors 
} from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { ensureProjectTasksLoaded } from '../../lib/taskStateService';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { Edit2, Check, X, Link, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

interface GanttTooltipPredecessorProps {
  task: Task;
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  canWrite: boolean;
  isEditing?: boolean;
  setIsEditing?: (val: boolean) => void;
  onEditingChange?: (isEditing: boolean) => void;
  compact?: boolean;
}

export const GanttTooltipPredecessor = React.memo(function GanttTooltipPredecessor({
  task,
  tasks,
  projects,
  canWrite,
  isEditing: controlledIsEditing,
  setIsEditing: controlledSetIsEditing,
  onEditingChange,
  compact = false,
}: GanttTooltipPredecessorProps) {
  const [internalIsEditing, setInternalIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const isEditing = controlledIsEditing !== undefined ? controlledIsEditing : internalIsEditing;
  const setIsEditing = (val: boolean) => {
    if (controlledSetIsEditing) controlledSetIsEditing(val);
    else setInternalIsEditing(val);
    if (onEditingChange) onEditingChange(val);
  };

  const [val, setVal] = useState(task.predecessor || '');
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEditing) {
      setVal(task.predecessor || '');
    }
  }, [task.predecessor, isEditing]);

  const handleStartEdit = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!canWrite) return;
    setIsEditing(true);
    onEditingChange?.(true);
  };

  const handleCancel = (e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    setIsEditing(false);
    setVal(task.predecessor || '');
    onEditingChange?.(false);
  };

  const handleSave = async (rawVal: string) => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const context = {
        projectId: task?.projectId,
        projectCode: task?.projectCode,
        projectYear: task?.projectYear,
        projectStore: task?.projectStore,
        projectLocation: task?.location,
      };

      const resolved = resolvePredecessorString(rawVal, tasks, projects, task?.projectCode, context);
      setVal(resolved);

      if (resolved === (task.predecessor || '')) {
        setIsEditing(false);
        onEditingChange?.(false);
        setIsSaving(false);
        return;
      }

      let currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || tasks;
      const updatedTask: Task = {
        ...task,
        predecessor: resolved,
        realtimeUpdate: Boolean(resolved.trim()),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      // 1. Build map and parse predecessors
      let taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, currentTasks);
      let parsed = parsePredecessors(resolved, taskNoMap, updatedTask);

      // 2. Load external project tasks if not resolved
      if (resolved.trim() && (!parsed.length || parsed.some((p) => !p.task))) {
        const parts = splitPredecessors(resolved, Array.from(taskNoMap.keys()));
        for (const token of parts) {
          const cleanToken = token.replace(/(fs|ss|ff|sf|[+-]\s*\d+|\s+\d+)$/i, '').trim();
          const matchedProj = projects.find((p) => p.code && cleanToken.toLowerCase().startsWith(p.code.toLowerCase()));
          if (matchedProj && matchedProj.code !== task.projectCode) {
            const loaded = await ensureProjectTasksLoaded(matchedProj.code);
            if (loaded.length > 0) {
              currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks || currentTasks;
              taskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, currentTasks);
              parsed = parsePredecessors(resolved, taskNoMap, updatedTask);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // 3. Recalculate dates for updatedTask
      const calcResult = calculateTaskDatesFromPredecessors(updatedTask, parsed);
      if (calcResult) {
        updatedTask.start = calcResult.start;
        updatedTask.finish = calcResult.finish;
        updatedTask.duration = calcResult.duration;
        updatedTask.durationManual = calcResult.durationManual;
      }

      // 4. Schedule dependent tasks cascading
      const updatesToDependents = scheduleDependentTasks(updatedTask, currentTasks, projects);

      // 5. Update Zustand store (0ms optimistic)
      const allTasksMap = new Map(currentTasks.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
      allTasksMap.set(updatedTask.id, updatedTask);
      updatesToDependents.forEach((u) => {
        const t = allTasksMap.get(u.id);
        if (t) {
          allTasksMap.set(u.id, {
            ...t,
            start: u.start,
            finish: u.finish,
            duration: u.duration,
            updatedAt: u.updatedAt,
          });
        }
      });
      useAppStore.getState().setTasks(Array.from(allTasksMap.values()));

      // 6. Persist to Firestore
      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', updatedTask.id), updatedTask, { merge: true });
      updatesToDependents.forEach((u) => {
        batch.set(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', u.id), u, { merge: true });
      });
      batch.commit().catch((err) => {
        console.error('Failed to persist task predecessor update:', err);
      });

      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: 'Predecessor Updated',
        message: resolved ? `Linked to ${resolved}` : 'Predecessor removed',
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error saving predecessor:', err);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: 'Update Failed',
        message: err.message || 'Could not update predecessor',
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
      setIsEditing(false);
      onEditingChange?.(false);
    }
  };

  if (!canWrite && !task.predecessor) {
    return null;
  }

  if (isEditing) {
    return (
      <div 
        ref={containerRef} 
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} 
        onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/95 dark:bg-slate-950/95 border border-blue-500/50 shadow-md my-1 w-full min-w-[240px] max-w-[320px] max-h-[360px] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-300">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Link className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-400" />
            Edit Predecessor
          </span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isSaving}
              onClick={handleCancel}
              className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded transition-colors"
              title="Close"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="w-full relative" onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            handleCancel();
          }
        }}>
        <PredecessorSearchSuggest 
          task={task}
          canWrite={canWrite}
        />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (compact) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-slate-400">Pred:</span>
        {task.predecessor ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            <span 
              className="font-mono text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-300 bg-blue-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-700/50 max-w-[180px] truncate"
              title={task.predecessor}
            >
              {task.predecessor}
            </span>
            {canWrite && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleStartEdit}
                className="p-0.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-300 hover:bg-slate-700/80 rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Edit Predecessor"
              >
                <Edit2 className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : canWrite ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleStartEdit}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
            Add Predecessor
          </button>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-slate-400">N/A</span>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 flex-1 min-w-[120px]">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
          Predecessors
        </span>
        {canWrite && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleStartEdit}
            className="text-[10px] text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer"
            title={task.predecessor ? "Edit Predecessor" : "Add Predecessor"}
          >
            {task.predecessor ? (
              <>
                <Edit2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                Edit
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Plus className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                Add
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {task.predecessor ? (
        <div 
          onClick={canWrite ? handleStartEdit : undefined}
          className={cn(
            "font-medium font-mono text-[11px] text-blue-300 bg-blue-950/50 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-blue-800/60 whitespace-normal break-words shadow-xs",
            canWrite ? "cursor-pointer hover:border-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-900/50 transition-colors" : ""
          )}
          title={task.predecessor}
        >
          {task.predecessor}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={canWrite ? handleStartEdit : undefined}
          className="text-left text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-300 italic px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-500/70 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Plus className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-400" />
          <span>Add Predecessor...</span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});




/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/GanttUtils.tsx ==================== */
import React from "react";
import { parseDateTime, cn } from "../../lib/utils";

export { cn };

export const formatGanttDate = (dateStr: string | undefined): string => {
  if (!dateStr) return "";
  const d = parseDateTime(dateStr);
  if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) return dateStr || "";

  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
  const month = months[d.getMonth()];
  const year = d.getFullYear();

  const hasExplicitTime = dateStr.includes('T') || (dateStr.includes(':') && (d.getHours() !== 0 || d.getMinutes() !== 0));
  if (hasExplicitTime) {
    const hours = d.getHours();
    const minutes = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    const period = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    const displayHours = hours % 12 || 12;
    return `${day} ${month} ${year}, ${displayHours}:${minutes} ${period}`;
  }
  return `${day} ${month} ${year}`;
};

export const renderGanttDateCell = (dateStr: string | undefined, colorClass?: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) {
    return <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono text-xs">-</span>;
  }
  const d = parseDateTime(dateStr);
  if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) {
    return <span className={cn("font-mono text-[11px] leading-tight", colorClass)}>{dateStr}</span>;
  }

  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];
  const month = months[d.getMonth()];
  const year = d.getFullYear();
  const dateFormatted = `${day} ${month} ${year}`;

  const hasExplicitTime = dateStr.includes('T') || (dateStr.includes(':') && (d.getHours() !== 0 || d.getMinutes() !== 0));
  const hours = d.getHours();
  const minutes = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  const period = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  const displayHours = hours % 12 || 12;
  const timeFormatted = `${displayHours}:${minutes} ${period}`;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center leading-tight whitespace-nowrap select-none py-0.5 w-full text-center">
      <span className={cn("font-mono font-bold tracking-tight text-[11px] leading-tight", colorClass || "text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200")}>
        {dateFormatted}
      </span>
      {hasExplicitTime && (
        <span className="text-[9.5px] font-mono font-medium tracking-tighter opacity-70 leading-none mt-0.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          {timeFormatted}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const positionTooltip = (
  tooltipOrEvent: HTMLElement | null | React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent | { clientX: number; clientY: number },
  xOrTooltip?: number | HTMLElement | null,
  yCoord?: number
) => {
  let tooltip: HTMLElement | null = null;
  let clientX = 0;
  let clientY = 0;

  if (tooltipOrEvent && typeof (tooltipOrEvent as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect === 'function' && typeof xOrTooltip === 'number') {
    tooltip = tooltipOrEvent as HTMLElement;
    clientX = xOrTooltip;
    clientY = typeof yCoord === 'number' ? yCoord : 0;
  } else if (xOrTooltip && typeof (xOrTooltip as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect === 'function') {
    tooltip = xOrTooltip as HTMLElement;
    const e = tooltipOrEvent as any;
    if ('touches' in e && e.touches.length > 0) {
      clientX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      clientY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    } else {
      clientX = e.clientX || 0;
      clientY = e.clientY || 0;
    }
  }

  if (!tooltip) return;

  const tw = tooltip.offsetWidth || 250;
  const th = tooltip.offsetHeight || 150;

  let x = clientX + 15;
  let y = clientY + 15;

  if (x + tw > window.innerWidth - 10) {
    x = window.innerWidth - tw - 15;
    if (x < 10) x = 10;
  }

  if (y + th > window.innerHeight - 10) {
    y = window.innerHeight - th - 15;
    if (y < 10) y = 10;
  }

  tooltip.style.zIndex = '999999';
  tooltip.style.left = `${Math.max(10, x)}px`;
  tooltip.style.top = `${Math.max(10, y)}px`;
};

/**
 * Tự động căn chỉnh lại vị trí của Tooltip trên màn hình để không bao giờ bị tràn ra ngoài màn hình
 * (đặc biệt khi mở panel Edit Predecessor hoặc danh sách gợi ý).
 */
export const ensureTooltipInViewport = (tooltip: HTMLElement | null) => {
  if (!tooltip) return;
  const rect = tooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
  const tw = rect.width || tooltip.offsetWidth || 340;
  const th = rect.height || tooltip.offsetHeight || 200;

  let x = rect.left;
  let y = rect.top;

  let changed = false;

  if (x + tw > window.innerWidth - 10) {
    x = Math.max(10, window.innerWidth - tw - 15);
    changed = true;
  }

  if (y + th > window.innerHeight - 10) {
    y = Math.max(10, window.innerHeight - th - 15);
    changed = true;
  }

  if (x < 10) { x = 10; changed = true; }
  if (y < 10) { y = 10; changed = true; }

  if (changed) {
    tooltip.style.left = `${x}px`;
    tooltip.style.top = `${y}px`;
  }
};

export const getBarColor = (status: string, duration?: string | number): string => {
  if (
    duration !== undefined &&
    duration !== "" &&
    parseFloat(String(duration)) === 0
  ) {
    return "bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 border border-amber-600";
  }
  const s = String(status || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  if (s === "completed" || s === "done") {
    return "bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 border border-emerald-600";
  }
  if (s === "on process" || s === "in progress") {
    return "bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 border border-blue-600";
  }
  if (s === "delayed" || s === "delay" || s === "overdue") {
    return "bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-600 border border-rose-600";
  }
  if (s === "upcoming" || s === "planned") {
    return "bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-500 dark:hover:bg-slate-400 border border-slate-500/80";
  }
  if (s === "handover") {
    return "bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 border border-blue-600";
  }
  if (s === "canceled" || s === "cancelled") {
    return "bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-400 text-slate-600 border border-slate-400";
  }
  return "bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-500 border border-slate-500/80";
};

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttBarDateDrag.ts ==================== */
import React, { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { parseDateTime, formatToDatetimeLocal } from '../../lib/utils';

export interface UseGanttBarDateDragParams {
  taskId: string;
  startStr?: string;
  endStr?: string;
  dayWidth: number;
  isEditMode?: boolean;
  onUpdateTaskDates?: (taskId: string, start: string, end: string) => void;
}

export function useGanttBarDateDrag({
  taskId,
  startStr,
  endStr,
  dayWidth,
  isEditMode = false,
  onUpdateTaskDates,
}: UseGanttBarDateDragParams) {
  const [isDraggingDate, setIsDraggingDate] = useState(false);
  const [dragType, setDragType] = useState<'move' | 'resize-start' | 'resize-end' | null>(null);
  const [deltaDays, setDeltaDays] = useState(0);
  const [previewStart, setPreviewStart] = useState(startStr || '');
  const [previewEnd, setPreviewEnd] = useState(endStr || '');

  const dragStartXRef = useRef(0);
  const initialDatesRef = useRef<{ start: Date; end: Date } | null>(null);

  const handleDragStart = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent | React.PointerEvent, type: 'move' | 'resize-start' | 'resize-end') => {
      if (!isEditMode) return;
      e.stopPropagation();

      const dStart = parseDateTime(startStr);
      const dEnd = parseDateTime(endStr);
      if (!dStart || !dEnd) return;

      setIsDraggingDate(true);
      setDragType(type);
      dragStartXRef.current = e.clientX;
      initialDatesRef.current = { start: new Date(dStart), end: new Date(dEnd) };
      setDeltaDays(0);
      setPreviewStart(startStr || '');
      setPreviewEnd(endStr || '');
    },
    [isEditMode, startStr, endStr]
  );

  const handleBarDragStart = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.PointerEvent) => handleDragStart(e, 'move');
  const handleLeftResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.PointerEvent) => handleDragStart(e, 'resize-start');
  const handleRightResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.PointerEvent) => handleDragStart(e, 'resize-end');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDraggingDate) return;

    const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!initialDatesRef.current || !dragType) return;

      const diffX = e.clientX - dragStartXRef.current;
      const days = Math.round(diffX / dayWidth);
      setDeltaDays(days);

      const msPerDay = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      const newStart = new Date(initialDatesRef.current.start.getTime());
      const newEnd = new Date(initialDatesRef.current.end.getTime());

      if (dragType === 'move') {
        newStart.setTime(newStart.getTime() + days * msPerDay);
        newEnd.setTime(newEnd.getTime() + days * msPerDay);
      } else if (dragType === 'resize-start') {
        newStart.setTime(newStart.getTime() + days * msPerDay);
        if (newStart.getTime() > newEnd.getTime()) {
          newStart.setTime(newEnd.getTime());
        }
      } else if (dragType === 'resize-end') {
        newEnd.setTime(newEnd.getTime() + days * msPerDay);
        if (newEnd.getTime() < newStart.getTime()) {
          newEnd.setTime(newStart.getTime());
        }
      }

      setPreviewStart(formatToDatetimeLocal(newStart));
      setPreviewEnd(formatToDatetimeLocal(newEnd));
    };

    const handlePointerUp = () => {
      if (isDraggingDate && onUpdateTaskDates && (previewStart !== startStr || previewEnd !== endStr)) {
        onUpdateTaskDates(taskId, previewStart, previewEnd);
      }
      setIsDraggingDate(false);
      setDragType(null);
      initialDatesRef.current = null;
    };

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingDate, dragType, dayWidth, taskId, onUpdateTaskDates, previewStart, previewEnd, startStr, endStr]);

  return {
    isDraggingDate,
    deltaDays,
    previewStart,
    previewEnd,
    handleBarDragStart,
    handleLeftResizeStart,
    handleRightResizeStart,
    handleDragEnd: () => setIsDraggingDate(false), // fallback
  };
}

export default useGanttBarDateDrag;


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttBatchOps.ts ==================== */
import React, { useState, useMemo, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Task, Project, AppUser, TakaDeltaItem } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc, deleteField } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { safeGetItemSession, safeSetItemSession } from '../../lib/storage';
import { recordBatchDeltas, recordDelta } from '../../lib/deltaSyncService';
import { deleteTaskStateUnified } from '../../lib/taskStateService';

interface UseGanttBatchOpsParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  paginatedProjects: Project[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
  getGroupTasksForProject: (p: Project) => Task[];
  setConfirmModal: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    onConfirm: () => Promise<void>;
  }>>;
}

export function useGanttBatchOps({
  tasks,
  projects,
  paginatedProjects,
  currentUser,
  getGroupTasksForProject,
  setConfirmModal
}: UseGanttBatchOpsParams) {
  const [selectedTaskIds, setSelectedTaskIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const lastSelectedTaskIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedProjectIds, setSelectedProjectIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [sumMode, setSumMode] = useState<"none" | "duration">("none");
  const [isHighlightDelegationOn, setIsHighlightDelegationOn] = useState(false);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);

  // Modular task states
  const [isTaskModularModalOpen, setIsTaskModularModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [expandedModularTasks, setExpandedModularTasks] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_modular_expanded");
    return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
  });

  const selectedTaskSet = useMemo(() => new Set(selectedTaskIds), [selectedTaskIds]);
  const selectedProjectSet = useMemo(() => new Set(selectedProjectIds), [selectedProjectIds]);
  const expandedModularSet = useMemo(() => new Set(expandedModularTasks), [expandedModularTasks]);

  const toggleModularParent = useCallback((taskId: string | number) => {
    const idStr = String(taskId);
    setExpandedModularTasks(prev => {
      const next = prev.includes(idStr) ? prev.filter(id => id !== idStr) : [...prev, idStr];
      safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_modular_expanded", JSON.stringify(next));
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  // Hidden rows state
  const [hiddenRows, setHiddenRows] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_hidden_rows");
    return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
  });
  const [isHideMode, setIsHideMode] = useState(false);
  const hiddenRowsSet = useMemo(() => new Set(hiddenRows), [hiddenRows]);

  const toggleHideRow = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setHiddenRows(prev => {
      const next = prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter(r => r !== id) : [...prev, id];
      safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_hidden_rows", JSON.stringify(next));
      return next;
    });
  };

  const getRowVisibilityClass = (id: string) => {
    return hiddenRowsSet.has(id) ? (isHideMode ? "opacity-30 line-through" : "hidden") : "";
  };

  // Checkbox selection with Shift-range
  const isShiftHeldRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Shift') isShiftHeldRef.current = true;
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
        if (target && (target.tagName === 'INPUT' || target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || target.isContentEditable)) {
          return;
        }
        setSelectedTaskIds((prev) => (prev.length > 0 ? [] : prev));
        setSelectedProjectIds((prev) => (prev.length > 0 ? [] : prev));
      }
    };
    const onKeyUp = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Shift') isShiftHeldRef.current = false;
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleTaskCheckboxChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement> | React.MouseEvent, taskId: string, isShiftClick?: boolean, orderedTaskIds?: string[]) => {
      const isShift = isShiftClick !== undefined
        ? isShiftClick
        : Boolean((e.nativeEvent as MouseEvent)?.shiftKey ?? (e as React.MouseEvent).shiftKey ?? (window.event as any)?.shiftKey ?? isShiftHeldRef.current);
      const isChecked = 'checked' in e.target ? (e.target as HTMLInputElement).checked : true;
      const strTaskId = String(taskId);

      if (isChecked) {
        if (isShift && lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current && lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current !== strTaskId) {
          const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
          const candidateIds = orderedTaskIds && orderedTaskIds.length > 0 
            ? orderedTaskIds.map(String) 
            : currentTasks.map(t => String(t.id));
          let startIdx = candidateIds.indexOf(lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current);
          let endIdx = candidateIds.indexOf(strTaskId);
          let targetList = candidateIds;
          if (startIdx === -1 || endIdx === -1) {
            const allStoreIds = currentTasks.map(t => String(t.id));
            const sIdx = allStoreIds.indexOf(lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current);
            const eIdx = allStoreIds.indexOf(strTaskId);
            if (sIdx !== -1 && eIdx !== -1) {
              startIdx = sIdx;
              endIdx = eIdx;
              targetList = allStoreIds;
            }
          }
          if (startIdx !== -1 && endIdx !== -1) {
            const range = targetList.slice(Math.min(startIdx, endIdx), Math.max(startIdx, endIdx) + 1);
            setSelectedTaskIds(prev => Array.from(new Set([...prev.map(String), ...range])));
          } else {
            setSelectedTaskIds(prev => Array.from(new Set([...prev.map(String), strTaskId])));
          }
        } else {
          setSelectedTaskIds(prev => Array.from(new Set([...prev.map(String), strTaskId])));
        }
        lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current = strTaskId;
      } else {
        if (isShift && lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current && lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current !== strTaskId) {
          const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
          const candidateIds = orderedTaskIds && orderedTaskIds.length > 0 
            ? orderedTaskIds.map(String) 
            : currentTasks.map(t => String(t.id));
          let startIdx = candidateIds.indexOf(lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current);
          let endIdx = candidateIds.indexOf(strTaskId);
          let targetList = candidateIds;
          if (startIdx === -1 || endIdx === -1) {
            const allStoreIds = currentTasks.map(t => String(t.id));
            const sIdx = allStoreIds.indexOf(lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current);
            const eIdx = allStoreIds.indexOf(strTaskId);
            if (sIdx !== -1 && eIdx !== -1) {
              startIdx = sIdx;
              endIdx = eIdx;
              targetList = allStoreIds;
            }
          }
          if (startIdx !== -1 && endIdx !== -1) {
            const rangeSet = new Set(targetList.slice(Math.min(startIdx, endIdx), Math.max(startIdx, endIdx) + 1));
            setSelectedTaskIds(prev => prev.map(String).filter(id => !rangeSet.has(id)));
          } else {
            setSelectedTaskIds(prev => prev.map(String).filter(id => id !== strTaskId));
          }
        } else {
          setSelectedTaskIds(prev => prev.map(String).filter(id => id !== strTaskId));
        }
        lastSelectedTaskIdRef.current = strTaskId;
      }
    },
    []
  );

  // Group / Unlink modular tasks
  const handleGroupModularTasks = async (parentTaskId: string, childTaskIds: string[]) => {
    if (!parentTaskId || !childTaskIds || childTaskIds.length === 0) return;

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const prevTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
    const childIdSet = new Set(childTaskIds.map(String));
    const parentIdStr = String(parentTaskId);

    // 0ms Optimistic UI update
    const updatedTasks = prevTasks.map((t) => {
      const tIdStr = String(t.id);
      if (childIdSet.has(tIdStr)) {
        return { ...t, parentTaskId: parentIdStr, parentId: parentIdStr, updatedAt: now };
      }
      if (tIdStr === parentIdStr) {
        return { ...t, isModularParent: true, updatedAt: now };
      }
      return t;
    });
    useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);

    // Auto-expand the parent task in Gantt view so grouped subtasks appear immediately!
    setExpandedModularTasks(prev => {
      const nextSet = new Set(prev.map(String));
      nextSet.add(parentIdStr);
      return Array.from(nextSet);
    });

    setIsTaskModularModalOpen(false);
    setSelectedTaskIds([]);

    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    childTaskIds.forEach((id) => {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', String(id));
      batch.set(docRef, { parentTaskId: parentIdStr, parentId: parentIdStr, updatedAt: now }, { merge: true });
    });
    const parentDocRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', parentIdStr);
    batch.set(parentDocRef, { isModularParent: true, updatedAt: now }, { merge: true });

    // Update Dexie (IndexedDB)
    try {
      const { localDb } = await import('../../lib/localDb');
      await Promise.all([
        ...childTaskIds.map(id => (localDb.tasks.update as any)(String(id), { parentTaskId: parentIdStr, parentId: parentIdStr, updatedAt: now })),
        (localDb.tasks.update as any)(parentIdStr, { isModularParent: true, updatedAt: now })
      ]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[useGanttBatchOps] Dexie update on group failed:', e);
    }

    try {
      await batch.commit();
      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = [
        ...childTaskIds.map(id => {
          const t = prevTasks.find(item => String(item.id) === String(id));
          return {
            docId: String(id),
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
            action: 'update' as const,
            isPatch: true,
            data: { parentTaskId: parentIdStr, parentId: parentIdStr, updatedAt: now },
            year: t?.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
          };
        }),
        {
          docId: parentIdStr,
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
          action: 'update' as const,
          isPatch: true,
          data: { isModularParent: true, updatedAt: now },
        }
      ];
      recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});

      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Grouped ${childTaskIds.length} tasks under parent modular task.`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[handleGroupModularTasks] Batch commit error:', err);
      useAppStore.getState().setTasks(prevTasks);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Error",
        message: "Failed to group tasks on server. Changes reverted."
      });
    }
  };

  const handleUnlinkModularTasks = async (childTaskIds?: string[]) => {
    const targetIds = childTaskIds && childTaskIds.length > 0 ? childTaskIds : selectedTaskIds;
    if (!targetIds || targetIds.length === 0) return;

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const prevTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
    const targetSet = new Set(targetIds.map(String));

    // Collect all task IDs that need unlinking:
    const parentCodeSet = new Set<string>();
    prevTasks.forEach(t => {
      if (targetSet.has(String(t.id)) && t.taskCodePhu) {
        parentCodeSet.add(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
      }
    });

    const allIdsToUnlink = new Set<string>();
    targetIds.forEach(id => allIdsToUnlink.add(String(id)));
    prevTasks.forEach(t => {
      const rawParent = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
      if (rawParent) {
        const rawStr = String(rawParent).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (targetSet.has(String(rawParent)) || parentCodeSet.has(rawStr)) {
          allIdsToUnlink.add(String(t.id));
        }
      }
    });

    const unlinkedArray = Array.from(allIdsToUnlink);

    // 0ms Optimistic UI update
    const updatedTasks = prevTasks.map((t) => {
      if (!allIdsToUnlink.has(String(t.id))) return t;
      const copy: any = { ...t, parentTaskId: undefined, parentId: undefined, updatedAt: now };
      delete copy.parentTask;
      delete copy.parentTaskCode;
      delete copy.parentCode;
      return copy as Task;
    });
    useAppStore.getState().setTasks(updatedTasks);
    setIsTaskModularModalOpen(false);
    setSelectedTaskIds([]);

    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    unlinkedArray.forEach((id) => {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', String(id));
      batch.set(docRef, { parentTaskId: deleteField(), parentId: null, updatedAt: now }, { merge: true });
    });

    // Update Dexie (IndexedDB)
    try {
      const { localDb } = await import('../../lib/localDb');
      await Promise.all(
        unlinkedArray.map(id => (localDb.tasks.update as any)(String(id), { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now }))
      );
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[useGanttBatchOps] Dexie update on unlink failed:', e);
    }

    try {
      await batch.commit();
      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = unlinkedArray.map(id => {
        const t = prevTasks.find(item => String(item.id) === String(id));
        return {
          docId: String(id),
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
          action: 'update' as const,
          isPatch: true,
          data: { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now },
          year: t?.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
        };
      });
      if (deltaItems.length > 0) {
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
      }
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Unlinked ${unlinkedArray.length} modular task(s).`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[handleUnlinkModularTasks] Batch commit error:', err);
      useAppStore.getState().setTasks(prevTasks);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Error",
        message: "Failed to unlink tasks on server. Changes reverted."
      });
    }
  };

  // Batch text color update
  const handleSetTextColor = async (color: string | null) => {
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id);
      batch.update(docRef, { textColor: color, updatedAt: now });
    });

    try {
      await batch.commit();
      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = selectedTaskIds.map(id => {
        const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
        return {
          docId: id,
          collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
          action: 'update',
          isPatch: true,
          data: { textColor: color, updatedAt: now },
          year: t?.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
        };
      });
      recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Updated text color for ${selectedTaskIds.length} tasks.`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Batch baseline update
  const handleSetBaselineSelected = async () => {
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
      const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
      if (t && t.start && t.finish) {
        const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id);
        batch.update(docRef, {
          baselineStart: t.start,
          baselineFinish: t.finish,
          updatedAt: now
        });
      }
    });

    try {
      await batch.commit();
      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = [];
      selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
        const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
        if (t && t.start && t.finish) {
          deltaItems.push({
            docId: id,
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
            action: 'update',
            isPatch: true,
            data: { baselineStart: t.start, baselineFinish: t.finish, updatedAt: now },
            year: t.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
          });
        }
      });
      if (deltaItems.length > 0) {
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
      }
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Saved baseline dates for selected tasks.`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Batch realtime sync toggle
  const handleToggleRealtimeUpdate = async () => {
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
      const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
      if (t) {
        const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id);
        batch.update(docRef, {
          realtimeUpdate: !t.realtimeUpdate,
          updatedAt: now
        });
      }
    });

    try {
      await batch.commit();
      const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = [];
      selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
        const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
        if (t) {
          deltaItems.push({
            docId: id,
            collectionName: 'taka_tasks',
            action: 'update',
            isPatch: true,
            data: { realtimeUpdate: !t.realtimeUpdate, updatedAt: now },
            year: t.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear) : undefined,
          });
        }
      });
      if (deltaItems.length > 0) {
        recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
      }
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: `Toggled realtime sync on selected tasks.`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Toggle Pin project
  const handleTogglePin = async (p: Project) => {
    const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', p.id);
    try {
      await writeBatch(db).update(docRef, {
        isPinned: !p.isPinned,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      }).commit();
      recordDelta({
        docId: p.id,
        collectionName: 'taka_projects',
        action: 'update',
        isPatch: true,
        data: { isPinned: !p.isPinned, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() },
        year: p.year ? String(p.year) : undefined,
        updatedBy: currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username,
      }).catch(() => {});
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  // Batch delete selected tasks/projects
  const handleDeleteSelected = () => {
    const total = selectedTaskIds.length + selectedProjectIds.length;
    if (total === 0) return;

    setConfirmModal({
      isOpen: true,
      title: "Delete Selected Items",
      message: `Are you sure you want to delete ${total} selected item(s)? This action cannot be undone.`,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        const currentTasks = useAppStore.getState().tasks;
        const currentProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
        const deletedTaskIds = [...selectedTaskIds];
        const deletedProjectIds = [...selectedProjectIds];
        const taskSet = new Set(deletedTaskIds.map(String));
        const projSet = new Set(deletedProjectIds.map(String));

        // If any deleted task is a parent task, unlink its subtasks so they don't break
        const parentCodeSet = new Set<string>();
        currentTasks.forEach(t => {
          if (taskSet.has(String(t.id)) && t.taskCodePhu) {
            parentCodeSet.add(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
          }
        });

        const childrenToUnlink = currentTasks.filter(t => {
          if (taskSet.has(String(t.id))) return false; // will be deleted anyway
          const rawParent = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
          if (rawParent) {
            const rawStr = String(rawParent).trim().toLowerCase();
            return taskSet.has(String(rawParent)) || parentCodeSet.has(rawStr);
          }
          return false;
        });

        // 1. Optimistic UI update (0ms)
        if (deletedTaskIds.length > 0) {
          deleteTaskStateUnified(deletedTaskIds).catch(() => {});
          if (childrenToUnlink.length > 0) {
            const unlinkedChildIds = new Set(childrenToUnlink.map(c => String(c.id)));
            const tasksAfterUnlink = useAppStore.getState().tasks.map(t => 
              unlinkedChildIds.has(String(t.id)) ? { ...t, parentTaskId: undefined, parentId: undefined, updatedAt: now } : t
            );
            useAppStore.getState().setTasks(tasksAfterUnlink);
          }
        }

        if (deletedProjectIds.length > 0) {
          const remainingProjects = currentProjects.filter(p => 
            !projSet.has(String(p.id)) && !projSet.has(String(p.no))
          );
          useAppStore.getState().setProjects(remainingProjects);
          try {
            const { localDb } = await import('../../lib/localDb');
            await localDb.projects.bulkDelete(deletedProjectIds);
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        if (childrenToUnlink.length > 0) {
          try {
            const { localDb } = await import('../../lib/localDb');
            await Promise.all(
              childrenToUnlink.map(c => (localDb.tasks.update as any)(c.id, { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now }))
            );
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        setSelectedTaskIds([]);
        setSelectedProjectIds([]);

        // 2. Commit batch to Firestore
        const batch = writeBatch(db);
        deletedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
          const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', id);
          batch.delete(docRef);
        });
        childrenToUnlink.forEach(child => {
          const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', child.id);
          batch.update(docRef, { parentTaskId: deleteField(), parentId: null, updatedAt: now });
        });
        deletedProjectIds.forEach(id => {
          const p = currentProjects.find(item => String(item.id) === id || String(item.no) === id);
          const docId = p?.id ? String(p.id) : id;
          const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_projects', docId);
          batch.delete(docRef);
        });

        try {
          await batch.commit();
          const deltaItems: TakaDeltaItem[] = [
            ...deletedTaskIds.map(id => ({
              docId: id,
              collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
              action: 'delete' as const,
              isPatch: false,
              data: null
            })),
            ...childrenToUnlink.map(child => ({
              docId: child.id,
              collectionName: 'taka_tasks' as const,
              action: 'update' as const,
              isPatch: true,
              data: { parentTaskId: null, parentId: null, updatedAt: now }
            })),
            ...deletedProjectIds.map(id => {
              const p = currentProjects.find(item => String(item.id) === id || String(item.no) === id);
              const docId = p?.id ? String(p.id) : id;
              return {
                docId,
                collectionName: 'taka_projects' as const,
                action: 'delete' as const,
                isPatch: false,
                data: null
              };
            })
          ];
          if (deltaItems.length > 0) {
            recordBatchDeltas(deltaItems, currentUser?.email || currentUser?.username).catch(() => {});
          }

          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Success",
            message: `Deleted ${total} item(s).`
          });
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(err);
          useAppStore.getState().setToast({
            title: "Error",
            message: "Failed to delete item(s) on server."
          });
        }
      }
    });
  };

  // Computed sum duration
  const computedSum = useMemo(() => {
    if (sumMode !== 'duration') return null;
    let sum = 0;
    selectedTaskIds.forEach(id => {
      const t = tasks.find(item => item.id === id);
      if (t && t.duration) {
        sum += Number(t.duration) || 0;
      }
    });
    return sum;
  }, [sumMode, selectedTaskIds, tasks]);

  const isAllSelected = useMemo(() => {
    if (paginatedProjects.length === 0) return false;
    return paginatedProjects.every(p => {
      const pTasks = getGroupTasksForProject(p);
      return pTasks.length > 0 && pTasks.every(t => selectedTaskSet.has(t.id));
    });
  }, [paginatedProjects, getGroupTasksForProject, selectedTaskSet]);

  const handleToggleSelectAll = useCallback(() => {
    if (isAllSelected) {
      setSelectedTaskIds([]);
      setSelectedProjectIds([]);
    } else {
      const allIds: string[] = [];
      const projIds: string[] = [];
      paginatedProjects.forEach(p => {
        projIds.push(p.id || p.code);
        const pTasks = getGroupTasksForProject(p);
        pTasks.forEach(t => allIds.push(t.id));
      });
      setSelectedTaskIds(allIds);
      setSelectedProjectIds(projIds);
    }
  }, [isAllSelected, paginatedProjects, getGroupTasksForProject]);

  return {
    selectedTaskIds,
    setSelectedTaskIds,
    selectedProjectIds,
    setSelectedProjectIds,
    selectedTaskSet,
    selectedProjectSet,
    isAllSelected,
    handleToggleSelectAll,
    handleTaskCheckboxChange,
    handleDeleteSelected,
    handleSetTextColor,
    handleSetBaselineSelected,
    handleToggleRealtimeUpdate,
    handleTogglePin,
    handleGroupModularTasks,
    handleUnlinkModularTasks,
    isTaskModularModalOpen,
    setIsTaskModularModalOpen,
    expandedModularTasks,
    setExpandedModularTasks,
    expandedModularSet,
    toggleModularParent,
    sumMode,
    setSumMode,
    computedSum,
    isHighlightDelegationOn,
    setIsHighlightDelegationOn,
    isEditMode,
    setIsEditMode,
    isHideMode,
    setIsHideMode,
    hiddenRows,
    setHiddenRows,
    hiddenRowsSet,
    toggleHideRow,
    getRowVisibilityClass
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttColumnResize.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { safeGetDeviceItemLocal, safeSetDeviceItemLocal } from '../../lib/storage';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

export interface GanttColumnWidths {
  start: number;
  finish: number;
  party: number;
  duration: number;
  predecessor: number;
}

export const DEFAULT_GANTT_COL_WIDTHS: GanttColumnWidths = {
  start: 85,
  finish: 85,
  party: 80,
  duration: 60,
  predecessor: 90,
};

export function useGanttColumnResize() {
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser);
  
  const [colWidths, setColWidths] = useState<GanttColumnWidths>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_col_widths', currentUser?.id);
      if (saved) {
        return { ...DEFAULT_GANTT_COL_WIDTHS, ...JSON.parse(saved) };
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return DEFAULT_GANTT_COL_WIDTHS;
  });

  const resizingColRef = useRef<{
    colKey: keyof GanttColumnWidths;
    startX: number;
    startWidth: number;
  } | null>(null);

  const startResizingColumn = useCallback((colKey: keyof GanttColumnWidths, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();

    const startX = e.clientX;
    const startWidth = colWidths[colKey] || DEFAULT_GANTT_COL_WIDTHS[colKey];
    resizingColRef.current = { colKey, startX, startWidth };

    const onMouseMove = (moveEvent: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!resizingColRef.current) return;
      const { colKey: key, startX: sX, startWidth: sW } = resizingColRef.current;
      const delta = moveEvent.clientX - sX;
      
      const minW = key === 'duration' ? 35 : 45;
      const maxW = 350;
      const newWidth = Math.max(minW, Math.min(maxW, Math.round(sW + delta)));

      setColWidths(prev => {
        return { ...prev, [key]: newWidth };
      });
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
      if (resizingColRef.current) {
        setColWidths(latest => {
          safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_col_widths', JSON.stringify(latest), currentUser?.id);
          return latest;
        });
        resizingColRef.current = null;
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
  }, [colWidths, currentUser?.id]);

  return {
    colWidths,
    setColWidths,
    startResizingColumn,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttDependencies.ts ==================== */
import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { DependencyLine, GanttTableRow } from './ganttTypes';
import { computeTaskCode } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';

interface UseGanttDependenciesParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  delegationGroups: any[];
  visibleGanttRows?: GanttTableRow[];
  startDate?: Date;
  dayWidth?: number;
  sideWidth?: number;
  paddingTop?: number;
  showStart?: boolean;
  startColWidth?: number;
  showFinish?: boolean;
  finishColWidth?: number;
  showParty?: boolean;
  partyColWidth?: number;
  showDuration?: boolean;
  durationColWidth?: number;
  showPredecessor?: boolean;
  predecessorColWidth?: number;
}

function generateOrthogonalPath(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number): string {
  const r = 5;
  const minGap = 20;

  if (Math.abs(y1 - y2) < 1) {
    return `M ${x1} ${y1} L ${x2} ${y2}`;
  }

  const isDown = y2 > y1;
  const dy = isDown ? r : -r;

  if (x2 >= x1 + minGap) {
    const xMid = Math.round(x1 + Math.min(24, (x2 - x1) / 2));
    return [
      `M ${x1} ${y1}`,
      `L ${xMid - r} ${y1}`,
      `Q ${xMid} ${y1} ${xMid} ${y1 + dy}`,
      `L ${xMid} ${y2 - dy}`,
      `Q ${xMid} ${y2} ${xMid + r} ${y2}`,
      `L ${x2} ${y2}`,
    ].join(' ');
  }

  const marginOut = 14;
  const marginIn = 14;
  const yMid = Math.round(y1 + (y2 - y1) / 2);

  return [
    `M ${x1} ${y1}`,
    `L ${x1 + marginOut - r} ${y1}`,
    `Q ${x1 + marginOut} ${y1} ${x1 + marginOut} ${y1 + dy}`,
    `L ${x1 + marginOut} ${yMid - dy}`,
    `Q ${x1 + marginOut} ${yMid} ${x1 + marginOut - r} ${yMid}`,
    `L ${x2 - marginIn + r} ${yMid}`,
    `Q ${x2 - marginIn} ${yMid} ${x2 - marginIn} ${yMid + dy}`,
    `L ${x2 - marginIn} ${y2 - dy}`,
    `Q ${x2 - marginIn} ${y2} ${x2 - marginIn + r} ${y2}`,
    `L ${x2} ${y2}`,
  ].join(' ');
}

export function useGanttDependencies({
  tasks,
  projects,
  delegationGroups,
  visibleGanttRows = [],
  startDate,
  dayWidth = 24,
  sideWidth = 220,
  paddingTop = 0,
  showStart = false,
  startColWidth = 80,
  showFinish = false,
  finishColWidth = 80,
  showParty = false,
  partyColWidth = 70,
  showDuration = false,
  durationColWidth = 50,
  showPredecessor = false,
  predecessorColWidth = 90,
}: UseGanttDependenciesParams) {
  const [activeTooltip, setActiveTooltip] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const taskNoMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Task>();
    tasks.forEach(t => {
      if (t.taskCodePhu) {
        map.set(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toUpperCase(), t);
      }
      if (t.id) {
        map.set(String(t.id).trim().toUpperCase(), t);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [tasks]);

  const taskCodeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Task>();
    tasks.forEach(t => {
      const code = computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, t);
      if (code) {
        map.set(code.trim().toUpperCase(), t);
      }
      if (t.taskCodePhu) {
        map.set(t.taskCodePhu.trim().toUpperCase(), t);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [tasks, projects]);

  const delegationGroupByTaskId = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, any>();
    delegationGroups.forEach(g => {
      if (g.subTasks) {
        g.subTasks.forEach((st: any) => {
          if (st.taskId) {
            map.set(st.taskId, g);
          }
        });
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [delegationGroups]);

  const dependencyLines = useMemo(() => {
    if (!startDate || visibleGanttRows.length === 0) return [];

    const taskPosMap = new Map<string, { xStart: number; xEnd: number; yCenter: number; t: Task }>();
    let currentY = paddingTop;
    const timelineLeft = sideWidth + (showStart ? startColWidth : 0) + (showFinish ? finishColWidth : 0) + (showParty ? partyColWidth : 0) + (showDuration ? durationColWidth : 0) + (showPredecessor ? predecessorColWidth : 0);

    visibleGanttRows.forEach((row) => {
      const rowHeight = row.type === 'project' ? 40 : 36;
      const yCenter = currentY + rowHeight / 2;
      currentY += rowHeight;

      if (row.type === 'task' && row.task) {
        const t = row.task;
        const dStart = t.start ? parseDateTime(t.start) : null;
        const dEnd = t.finish ? parseDateTime(t.finish) : null;
        if (dStart && dEnd) {
          const startDays = (dStart.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
          const endDays = (dEnd.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) + 1;
          const xStart = timelineLeft + Math.max(0, startDays * dayWidth);
          const xEnd = timelineLeft + Math.max(0, endDays * dayWidth);

          const posObj = { xStart, xEnd, yCenter, t };
          taskPosMap.set(t.id, posObj);
          if (t.taskCodePhu) {
            taskPosMap.set(t.taskCodePhu.trim().toUpperCase(), posObj);
          }
          const computedCode = computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, t);
          if (computedCode) {
            taskPosMap.set(computedCode.trim().toUpperCase(), posObj);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    const lines: DependencyLine[] = [];

    visibleGanttRows.forEach((row) => {
      if (row.type !== 'task' || !row.task) return;
      const succTask = row.task;
      if (!succTask.predecessor) return;

      const succPos = taskPosMap.get(succTask.id);
      if (!succPos) return;

      const predCodes = String(succTask.predecessor)
        .split(/[,;]/)
        .map((s) => s.trim().toUpperCase())
        .filter(Boolean);

      predCodes.forEach((code) => {
        const predPos = taskPosMap.get(code);
        if (!predPos) return;

        const x1 = predPos.xEnd;
        const y1 = predPos.yCenter;
        const x2 = succPos.xStart;
        const y2 = succPos.yCenter;

        const d = generateOrthogonalPath(x1, y1, x2, y2);

        lines.push({
          id: `${predPos.t.id}->${succTask.id}`,
          d,
          fromTaskId: predPos.t.id,
          toTaskId: succTask.id,
          fromTaskCode: predPos.t.taskCodePhu || computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, predPos.t),
          fromTaskName: predPos.t.name,
          toTaskCode: succTask.taskCodePhu || computeTaskCode(projects, tasks, succTask),
          toTaskName: succTask.name,
          color: '#2563eb',
        });
      });
    });

    return lines;
  }, [
    visibleGanttRows,
    startDate,
    dayWidth,
    sideWidth,
    paddingTop,
    showStart,
    startColWidth,
    showFinish,
    finishColWidth,
    showParty,
    partyColWidth,
    showDuration,
    durationColWidth,
    showPredecessor,
    predecessorColWidth,
    projects,
    tasks,
  ]);

  return {
    activeTooltip,
    setActiveTooltip,
    dependencyLines,
    taskNoMap,
    taskCodeMap,
    delegationGroupByTaskId,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttDragReorder.ts ==================== */
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { writeBatch } from '../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { 
  buildTaskNoMap, 
  getPredecessorCodeUpdates, 
  updatePredecessorsStrings, 
  healAllTasksPredecessors 
} from '../../lib/ganttUtils';

interface UseGanttDragReorderParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  mainScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
}

export function useGanttDragReorder({
  tasks,
  projects,
  mainScrollRef
}: UseGanttDragReorderParams) {
  const [dragOverTaskId, setDragOverTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dropPosition, setDropPosition] = useState<'before' | 'after' | null>(null);
  const [draggingTaskIds, setDraggingTaskIds] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const dragScrollInterval = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const dragMouseY = useRef<number>(0);

  const startDragAutoScroll = useCallback(() => {
    if (dragScrollInterval.current) return;
    dragScrollInterval.current = setInterval(() => {
      const container = mainScrollRef.current;
      if (!container) return;
      const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      const y = dragMouseY.current;
      const threshold = 60;
      const maxSpeed = 15;

      if (y < rect.top + threshold && y > rect.top - 50) {
        const factor = Math.max(0, (rect.top + threshold - y) / threshold);
        container.scrollTop -= Math.round(maxSpeed * factor);
      } else if (y > rect.bottom - threshold && y < rect.bottom + 50) {
        const factor = Math.max(0, (y - (rect.bottom - threshold)) / threshold);
        container.scrollTop += Math.round(maxSpeed * factor);
      }
    }, 16);
  }, [mainScrollRef]);

  const stopDragAutoScroll = useCallback(() => {
    if (dragScrollInterval.current) {
      clearInterval(dragScrollInterval.current);
      dragScrollInterval.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      stopDragAutoScroll();
    };
  }, [stopDragAutoScroll]);

  const handleTaskDragStart = (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const targetTask = tasks.find(t => String(t.id) === String(taskId));
    const isParentTask = targetTask && (
      Boolean((targetTask as any).isModularParent) ||
      tasks.some(other => {
        const rawParent = other.parentTaskId || (other as any).parentId;
        if (!rawParent) return false;
        const rawStr = String(rawParent).trim().toLowerCase();
        return String(rawParent) === String(targetTask.id) ||
          (targetTask.taskCodePhu && rawStr === String(targetTask.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
      })
    );
    if (isParentTask) {
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    setDraggingTaskIds([taskId]);
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', taskId);
    startDragAutoScroll();
  };

  const handleTaskDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    dragMouseY.current = e.clientY;

    if (draggingTaskIds.includes(taskId)) return;

    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const relativeY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const isTopHalf = relativeY < rect.height / 2;
    const pos = isTopHalf ? 'before' : 'after';

    if (dragOverTaskId !== taskId || dropPosition !== pos) {
      setDragOverTaskId(taskId);
      setDropPosition(pos);
    }
  };

  const handleContainerDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    dragMouseY.current = e.clientY;
  };

  const handleTaskDragLeave = (e: React.DragEvent, taskId: string) => {
    if (e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node)) return;
    if (dragOverTaskId === taskId) {
      setDragOverTaskId(null);
      setDropPosition(null);
    }
  };

  const handleTaskDragEnd = () => {
    setDraggingTaskIds([]);
    setDragOverTaskId(null);
    setDropPosition(null);
    stopDragAutoScroll();
  };

  const handleTaskDrop = async (e: React.DragEvent, targetTask: Task, parentProject?: Project) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    stopDragAutoScroll();

    const draggedId = draggingTaskIds[0] || e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    if (!draggedId || draggedId === targetTask.id) {
      handleTaskDragEnd();
      return;
    }

    const draggedTask = tasks.find(t => t.id === draggedId);
    if (!draggedTask) {
      handleTaskDragEnd();
      return;
    }

    // Reorder inside the same project & parent group
    const pCode = targetTask.projectCode || draggedTask.projectCode;

    // Check if draggedTask is a parent task (has child tasks in the store)
    const childTasksOfDragged = tasks.filter(t => {
      if (!t || t.id === draggedTask.id) return false;
      const rawPId = String(t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId || '').trim();
      if (!rawPId) return false;
      return (
        rawPId === String(draggedTask.id) ||
        (draggedTask.taskCodePhu && rawPId.toLowerCase() === String(draggedTask.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase())
      );
    });
    const isParentTask = childTasksOfDragged.length > 0;

    // Determine targetParentId:
    // 1) If draggedTask is a parent task (task gộp cha), force targetParentId to null (root level).
    // 2) If draggedTask is a child task, check if targetTask is a parent task or subtask.
    let targetParentId: string | null = null;
    if (isParentTask) {
      targetParentId = null;
    } else {
      const targetIsParent = tasks.some(t => {
        if (!t || t.id === targetTask.id) return false;
        const rawPId = String(t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId || '').trim();
        return rawPId === String(targetTask.id) || (targetTask.taskCodePhu && rawPId.toLowerCase() === String(targetTask.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase());
      });

      if (targetIsParent && !targetTask.parentTaskId && !(targetTask as any).parentId) {
        // Dropped onto a parent task -> attach as child of targetTask
        targetParentId = targetTask.id;
      } else {
        // Otherwise match targetTask's parentTaskId
        targetParentId = targetTask.parentTaskId || (targetTask as any).parentId || null;
      }
    }

    // Sibling tasks (either root tasks of the project or child tasks of the same parent)
    const siblingTasks = tasks
      .filter(t => 
        (t.projectCode || '') === (pCode || '') && 
        (t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId || null) === targetParentId
      )
      .sort((a, b) => (a.orderIndex !== undefined ? a.orderIndex : ((a as any).order || 0)) - (b.orderIndex !== undefined ? b.orderIndex : ((b as any).order || 0)));

    const cleanList = siblingTasks.filter(t => t.id !== draggedTask.id);
    const targetIdx = cleanList.findIndex(t => t.id === targetTask.id);
    const insertIdx = targetIdx === -1 ? cleanList.length : (dropPosition === 'before' ? targetIdx : targetIdx + 1);

    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
    const movedTask: Task = {
      ...draggedTask,
      parentTaskId: targetParentId || undefined,
      updatedAt: nowIso
    };
    if (targetParentId) {
      (movedTask as any).parentId = targetParentId;
    } else {
      delete (movedTask as any).parentId;
    }
    cleanList.splice(insertIdx, 0, movedTask);

    const oldTaskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, tasks);

    const reorderedWithOrder = cleanList.map((t, idx) => {
      const pCodeVal = t.projectCode || '';
      const newCode = pCodeVal ? `${pCodeVal}#${idx + 1}` : (t.taskCodePhu || '');
      return {
        ...t,
        orderIndex: idx,
        order: (idx + 1) * 10,
        taskCodePhu: newCode || t.taskCodePhu,
        updatedAt: nowIso
      };
    });

    const updatesMap = new Map<string, Task>();
    reorderedWithOrder.forEach(t => updatesMap.set(t.id, t));

    // Preserve parent-child relationships: ensure all child tasks point to parent's canonical ID
