    const parentCodeToIdMap = new Map<string, string>();
    reorderedWithOrder.forEach(pt => {
      parentCodeToIdMap.set(pt.id, pt.id);
      if (pt.taskCodePhu) parentCodeToIdMap.set(pt.taskCodePhu.trim().toLowerCase(), pt.id);
    });

    let allUpdatedTasks = tasks.map(t => {
      const updatedSibling = updatesMap.get(t.id);
      if (updatedSibling) return updatedSibling;

      // Check if this task is a child of any reordered parent task
      const rawPId = String(t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId || '').trim();
      if (rawPId) {
        const canonicalParentId = parentCodeToIdMap.get(rawPId) || parentCodeToIdMap.get(rawPId.toLowerCase());
        if (canonicalParentId && (t.parentTaskId !== canonicalParentId || (t as any).parentId !== canonicalParentId)) {
          const res = {
            ...t,
            parentTaskId: canonicalParentId,
            updatedAt: nowIso
          };
          (res as any).parentId = canonicalParentId;
          return res;
        }
      }
      return t;
    });
    const newTaskNoMap = buildTaskNoMap(projects, allUpdatedTasks);
    const oldCodeToNewCode = getPredecessorCodeUpdates(oldTaskNoMap, newTaskNoMap, projects, allUpdatedTasks);
    const predUpdates = updatePredecessorsStrings(oldCodeToNewCode, allUpdatedTasks, projects, oldTaskNoMap);

    if (predUpdates.length > 0) {
      const predMap = new Map(predUpdates.map(pu => [pu.id, pu]));
      allUpdatedTasks = allUpdatedTasks.map(t => {
        const pu = predMap.get(t.id);
        return pu ? { ...t, predecessor: pu.predecessor, updatedAt: pu.updatedAt } : t;
      });
    }

    const healed = healAllTasksPredecessors(allUpdatedTasks, projects);
    if (healed.changedCount > 0) {
      allUpdatedTasks = healed.updatedTasks;
    }

    // 0ms Optimistic UI update in Zustand
    useAppStore.getState().optimisticUpdateTasks(allUpdatedTasks);

    // Save to Firestore in batch with dirty-checking to eliminate redundant writes
    const batch = writeBatch(db);
    let writeCount = 0;

    allUpdatedTasks.forEach(t => {
      const orig = tasks.find(o => o.id === t.id);
      
      // Dirty check: Only write to Firestore if fields actually changed
      const isNew = !orig;
      const orderChanged = orig ? (orig as any).order !== (t as any).order : true;
      const orderIndexChanged = orig ? orig.orderIndex !== t.orderIndex : true;
      const codeChanged = orig ? orig.taskCodePhu !== t.taskCodePhu : true;
      const predChanged = orig ? orig.predecessor !== t.predecessor : true;
      const parentChanged = orig ? (orig.parentTaskId || null) !== (t.parentTaskId || null) : true;

      if (isNew || orderChanged || orderIndexChanged || codeChanged || predChanged || parentChanged) {
        const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_tasks', t.id);
        batch.update(docRef, {
          order: (t as any).order,
          orderIndex: t.orderIndex,
          taskCodePhu: t.taskCodePhu,
          predecessor: t.predecessor,
          parentTaskId: t.parentTaskId || null,
          parentId: t.parentTaskId || null,
          updatedAt: t.updatedAt
        });
        writeCount++;
      }
    });

    if (writeCount > 0) {
      try {
        await batch.commit();
        useAppStore.getState().setToast({
          title: "Success",
          message: `Reordered task ${draggedTask.name}`
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Task reorder error:", err);
      }
    }

    handleTaskDragEnd();
  };

  return {
    dragOverTaskId,
    dropPosition,
    draggingTaskIds,
    handleTaskDragStart,
    handleTaskDragOver,
    handleContainerDragOver,
    handleTaskDragLeave,
    handleTaskDragEnd,
    handleTaskDrop
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttExport.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface UseGanttExportParams {
  tableRef: React.RefObject<HTMLTableElement | HTMLDivElement | null>;
}

export function useGanttExport({ tableRef }: UseGanttExportParams) {
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState(false);

  const handleExportToPDF = async () => {
    const el = tableRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    setIsExporting(true);
    useAppStore.getState().setToast({
      title: "Exporting PDF",
      message: "Rendering high-resolution vector layout..."
    });

    try {
      const html2canvas = (await import('html2canvas')).default;
      const { jsPDF } = await import('jspdf');

      const canvas = await html2canvas(el as HTMLElement, {
        scale: 2,
        useCORS: true,
        logging: false,
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff'
      });

      const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      const pdf = new jsPDF({
        orientation: 'landscape',
        unit: 'px',
        format: [canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2]
      });

      pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', 0, 0, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
      pdf.save(`taka_gantt_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.pdf`);

      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: "Gantt chart exported to PDF."
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("PDF export error:", err);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Export Error",
        message: "Failed to export PDF.",
        type: "error"
      });
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExportToPNG = useCallback(async () => {
    const el = tableRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      const html2canvas = (await import('html2canvas')).default;
      const canvas = await html2canvas(el as HTMLElement, {
        scale: 2,
        useCORS: true,
        logging: false,
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff'
      });

      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.download = `taka_gantt_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.png`;
      link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      link.click();

      useAppStore.getState().setToast({
        title: "Success",
        message: "Gantt chart exported to PNG."
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("PNG export error:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  }, [tableRef]);

  return {
    isExporting,
    isPrinting,
    setIsPrinting,
    handleExportToPDF,
    handleExportToPNG
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttFocus.ts ==================== */
import React, { useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Task, Project } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { safeSetItemSession } from '../../lib/storage';

export interface UseGanttFocusParams {
  tasks: Task[];
  projects: Project[];
  initialFocusTaskId?: string | null;
  ganttTabFocusTaskId?: string | null;
  setGanttTabFocusTaskId: (id: string | null) => void;
  setExpandedModularTasks: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>;
  mainScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  topScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  startDate: Date;
  dayWidth: number;
  sideWidth: number;
  onClearFocus?: () => void;
}

export function useGanttFocus({
  tasks,
  projects,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  ganttTabFocusTaskId,
  setGanttTabFocusTaskId,
  setExpandedModularTasks,
  mainScrollRef,
  topScrollRef,
  startDate,
  dayWidth,
  sideWidth,
  onClearFocus,
}: UseGanttFocusParams) {
  const activeFocusId = ganttTabFocusTaskId || initialFocusTaskId || null;

  const focusedTask = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeFocusId || !tasks || tasks.length === 0) return null;
    const cleanId = String(activeFocusId).replace('task-', '').trim();
    return tasks.find(t => String(t.id) === cleanId) || null;
  }, [activeFocusId, tasks]);

  const focusedProject = useMemo(() => {
    if (!focusedTask || !projects || projects.length === 0) return null;
    return projects.find(
      p => (p.id && String(p.id) === String(focusedTask.projectId)) ||
           (p.code && focusedTask.projectCode && p.code.trim().toUpperCase() === focusedTask.projectCode.trim().toUpperCase())
    ) || null;
  }, [focusedTask, projects]);

  const lastFocusedIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Clear focus helper
  const handleClearFocus = useCallback(() => {
    setGanttTabFocusTaskId(null);
    useAppStore.getState().setGanttTabFilterProjectId('');
    if (onClearFocus) onClearFocus();
  }, [setGanttTabFocusTaskId, onClearFocus]);

  // Locate task: smoothly scroll horizontally to task bar and vertically to task row
  const locateTask = useCallback(() => {
    if (!focusedTask || !mainScrollRef.current) return;
    const scrollContainer = mainScrollRef.current;

    // 1. Horizontal Timeline centering
    const dStart = parseDateTime(focusedTask.start);
    const dFinish = parseDateTime(focusedTask.finish);

    let targetScrollLeft = scrollContainer.scrollLeft;
    if (dStart && startDate) {
      const diffMs = dStart.getTime() - startDate.getTime();
      const diffDays = diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
      const taskLeftPx = diffDays * dayWidth;
      const durationDays = dFinish ? Math.max(1, (dFinish.getTime() - dStart.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) : 1;
      const taskCenterPx = taskLeftPx + (durationDays * dayWidth) / 2;
      const visibleTimelineWidth = Math.max(150, scrollContainer.clientWidth - sideWidth);
      targetScrollLeft = Math.max(0, taskCenterPx - visibleTimelineWidth / 2);
    }

    // 2. Vertical Row centering
    const rowEl = document.getElementById(`gantt-task-row-${focusedTask.id}`);
    let targetScrollTop = scrollContainer.scrollTop;
    if (rowEl) {
      const containerRect = scrollContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
      const rowRect = rowEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const currentTopOffset = rowRect.top - containerRect.top;
      targetScrollTop = scrollContainer.scrollTop + currentTopOffset - (containerRect.height / 2) + (rowRect.height / 2);
    }

    scrollContainer.scrollTo({
      left: targetScrollLeft,
      top: Math.max(0, targetScrollTop),
      behavior: 'smooth'
    });

    if (topScrollRef.current) {
      topScrollRef.current.scrollTo({
        left: targetScrollLeft,
        behavior: 'smooth'
      });
    }
  }, [focusedTask, startDate, dayWidth, sideWidth, mainScrollRef, topScrollRef]);

  // Auto-Reveal & Auto-Center when activeFocusId changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeFocusId || !focusedTask) return;

    // Only trigger full auto-reveal on new focus selection
    const isNewFocus = lastFocusedIdRef.current !== activeFocusId;
    lastFocusedIdRef.current = activeFocusId;

    if (!isNewFocus) return;

    // A. Auto-reveal parent project
    const pId = focusedProject?.id || (focusedTask.projectId ? String(focusedTask.projectId) : null);
    if (pId) {
      const currentExpandedProjects = useAppStore.getState().expandedProjectIds;
      if (!currentExpandedProjects.includes(pId)) {
        useAppStore.getState().setExpandedProjectIds([...currentExpandedProjects, pId]);
      }
    }

    // B. Auto-reveal parent modular task (if child task)
    if (focusedTask.parentTaskId) {
      const ancestorIds: string[] = [];
      let curParentId: any = focusedTask.parentTaskId;
      const visited = new Set<string>();

      while (curParentId && !visited.has(String(curParentId))) {
        const parentIdStr = String(curParentId);
        visited.add(parentIdStr);
        ancestorIds.push(parentIdStr);
        const parent = tasks.find(
          t => String(t.id) === parentIdStr ||
               (t.taskCodePhu && String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase() === parentIdStr.toLowerCase())
        );
        curParentId = parent?.parentTaskId;
      }

      if (ancestorIds.length > 0) {
        setExpandedModularTasks(prev => {
          const next = Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...ancestorIds]));
          safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_modular_expanded", JSON.stringify(next));
          return next;
        });
      }
    }

    // C. Auto-center with cascading timeouts to allow DOM & virtualization to mount row
    const timer1 = setTimeout(() => {
      locateTask();
    }, 120);

    const timer2 = setTimeout(() => {
      locateTask();
    }, 320);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer1);
      clearTimeout(timer2);
    };
  }, [activeFocusId, focusedTask, focusedProject, tasks, setExpandedModularTasks, locateTask]);

  // Global Escape keyboard shortcut to exit Focus Mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeFocusId) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleClearFocus();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [activeFocusId, handleClearFocus]);

  return {
    activeFocusId,
    focusedTask,
    focusedProject,
    locateTask,
    handleClearFocus,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttLayoutState.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  safeGetDeviceItemLocal,
  safeSetDeviceItemLocal,
  getDeviceScreenType,
} from '../../lib/storage';

export function useGanttLayoutState(currentUserId?: string) {
  const [filterStartDate, setFilterStartDate] = useState('');
  const [filterEndDate, setFilterEndDate] = useState('');
  const [tempStartDate, setTempStartDate] = useState('');
  const [tempEndDate, setTempEndDate] = useState('');

  const [sideWidth, setSideWidth] = useState<number>(() => {
    const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768;
    if (isMobile) {
      const savedMobile = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_side_width', currentUserId);
      return savedMobile
        ? Math.max(140, Math.min(260, Number(savedMobile)))
        : Math.max(160, Math.min(220, Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.52)));
    }
    const saved = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_side_width', currentUserId);
    return saved ? Math.max(180, Math.min(600, Number(saved))) : 360;
  });

  const [visibleColumns, setVisibleColumns] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    const saved = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_visible_columns', currentUserId);
    if (saved) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(saved);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768;
    return isMobile ? ['start', 'finish'] : ['start', 'finish', 'party', 'duration'];
  });

  const prevScreenTypeRef = useRef(getDeviceScreenType());

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      const currentScreenType = getDeviceScreenType();
      if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
        const maxMobileWidth = Math.max(
          160,
          Math.min(220, Math.floor(window.innerWidth * 0.52))
        );
        setSideWidth((prev) => Math.min(prev, maxMobileWidth));
      }

      if (currentScreenType !== prevScreenTypeRef.current) {
        prevScreenTypeRef.current = currentScreenType;
        const savedCols = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_visible_columns', currentUserId);
        if (savedCols) {
          try {
            setVisibleColumns(JSON.parse(savedCols));
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        const savedSide = safeGetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_side_width', currentUserId);
        if (savedSide) {
          setSideWidth(Number(savedSide));
        }
      }
    };
    handleResize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, [currentUserId]);

  const handleToggleColumn = (colId: string) => {
    setVisibleColumns((prev) => {
      const next = prev.includes(colId) ? prev.filter((id) => id !== colId) : [...prev, colId];
      safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_visible_columns', JSON.stringify(next), currentUserId);
      return next;
    });
  };

  return {
    filterStartDate,
    setFilterStartDate,
    filterEndDate,
    setFilterEndDate,
    tempStartDate,
    setTempStartDate,
    tempEndDate,
    setTempEndDate,
    sideWidth,
    setSideWidth,
    visibleColumns,
    handleToggleColumn,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttProjectsFilter.ts ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useDeferredValue, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Project, Task, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { 
  getStatus, 
  getProjectDatesAndStatus,
  matchProjectStatusFilter,
  parseDateTime, 
  getUserAllowedStores, 
  getEffectiveStoreFilter, 
  matchesAdvancedSearch 
} from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLocationOptions } from '../../hooks/useLocationOptions';
import { safeGetItemSession, safeSetItemSession } from '../../lib/storage';

interface UseGanttProjectsFilterParams {
  projects: Project[];
  tasks: Task[];
  delegationGroups: any[];
  currentUser: AppUser;
}

export function useGanttProjectsFilter({
  projects,
  tasks,
  delegationGroups,
  currentUser
}: UseGanttProjectsFilterParams) {
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setGlobalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalYearFilter);
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const setGlobalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalStoreFilter);
  const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);
  const globalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalLocationFilter);
  const setGlobalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalLocationFilter);
  const setExpandedProjects = useAppStore(state => state.setExpandedProjectIds);
  const ganttTabFilterProjectId = useAppStore(state => state.ganttTabFilterProjectId);
  const setGanttTabFilterProjectId = useAppStore(state => state.setGanttTabFilterProjectId);

  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(() => safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_search") || "");
  const deferredSearchTerm = useDeferredValue(searchTerm);

  // Sync QuickNav targeted project filter
  useEffect(() => {
    if (ganttTabFilterProjectId) {
      const targetProj = projects.find(
        p => (p.id && String(p.id) === String(ganttTabFilterProjectId)) ||
             (p.code && String(p.code).trim().toUpperCase() === String(ganttTabFilterProjectId).trim().toUpperCase())
      );
      const codeToDisplay = targetProj?.code || ganttTabFilterProjectId;
      setSearchTerm(codeToDisplay);
      setFilterProjectStatus('all');
    }
  }, [ganttTabFilterProjectId, projects]);

  const [filterProjectStatus, setFilterProjectStatus] = useState<string>(() => {
    if ((safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_search") || "").trim()) return 'all';
    return safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days';
  });

  const lastSelectedStatusFilterRef = useRef<string>(
    safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days'
  );
  const lastSelectedLocationFilterRef = useRef<string[]>(globalLocationFilter);
  const wasSearchingRef = useRef<boolean>(!!(safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_search") || "").trim());

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_search", searchTerm);
      if (ganttTabFilterProjectId) {
        const targetProj = projects.find(
          p => (p.id && String(p.id) === String(ganttTabFilterProjectId)) ||
               (p.code && String(p.code).trim().toUpperCase() === String(ganttTabFilterProjectId).trim().toUpperCase())
        );
        const expectedCode = targetProj?.code || ganttTabFilterProjectId;
        if (!searchTerm.trim() || searchTerm.trim().toUpperCase() !== expectedCode.trim().toUpperCase()) {
          setGanttTabFilterProjectId('');
        }
      }
    }, 350);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchTerm, ganttTabFilterProjectId, setGanttTabFilterProjectId, projects]);

  const onStatusFilterChange = useCallback((status: string) => {
    setFilterProjectStatus(status);
    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
      lastSelectedStatusFilterRef.current = status;
      safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_status_filter", status);
    }
  }, [searchTerm]);

  // Status & Location filter preservation during search
  useEffect(() => {
    const isSearching = !!deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!wasSearchingRef.current && isSearching) {
      if (filterProjectStatus !== 'all') {
        lastSelectedStatusFilterRef.current = filterProjectStatus;
        safeSetItemSession("taka_gantt_status_filter", filterProjectStatus);
      }
      lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current = globalLocationFilter;
      setFilterProjectStatus('all');
      wasSearchingRef.current = true;
    } else if (wasSearchingRef.current && !isSearching) {
      const restored = lastSelectedStatusFilterRef.current || safeGetItemSession("taka_gantt_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days';
      setFilterProjectStatus(restored);
      setGlobalLocationFilter(lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current || []);
      wasSearchingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [deferredSearchTerm]);

  const uniqueYears = useMemo(() => {
    const yearsSet = new Set<string>();
    projects.forEach(p => {
      if (p.year) yearsSet.add(String(p.year));
      else if (p.computedTakStart) yearsSet.add(String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4));
      else if (p.start) yearsSet.add(String(p.start).substring(0, 4));
    });
    ['2026', '2027'].forEach(y => yearsSet.add(y));
    return Array.from(yearsSet).sort();
  }, [projects]);

  const uniqueStores = useMemo(() => getUserAllowedStores(currentUser), [currentUser]);
  const locationOptions = useLocationOptions();

  // Index tasks by project ID, project key, and code
  const tasksByProjectId = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Task[]>();
    tasks.forEach(t => {
      if (t.projectId) {
        const pId = String(t.projectId);
        if (!map.has(pId)) map.set(pId, []);
        map.get(pId)!.push(t);
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [tasks]);

  const tasksByProject = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Task[]>();
    tasks.forEach(t => {
      const key = `${String(t.projectCode || '').trim().toUpperCase()}_${String(t.projectYear || '').trim()}_${String(t.projectStore || '').trim().toUpperCase()}`;
      if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, []);
      map.get(key)!.push(t);
    });
    return map;
  }, [tasks]);

  const tasksMapByCode = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, Task[]>();
    tasks.forEach(t => {
      const code = String(t.projectCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (!map.has(code)) map.set(code, []);
      map.get(code)!.push(t);
    });
    return map;
  }, [tasks]);

  const getGroupTasksForProject = useCallback(
    (p: Project): Task[] => {
      if (p.id && tasksByProjectId.has(String(p.id))) {
        const found = tasksByProjectId.get(String(p.id))!;
        if (found.length > 0) return found;
      }
      const key = `${String(p.code || '').trim().toUpperCase()}_${String(p.year || '').trim()}_${String(p.store || '').trim().toUpperCase()}`;
      const foundByKey = tasksByProject.get(key);
      if (foundByKey && foundByKey.length > 0) return foundByKey;

      const foundByCode = tasksMapByCode.get(String(p.code || '').trim().toUpperCase());
      if (foundByCode && foundByCode.length > 0) return foundByCode;

      if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
        return p.taskSummaries.map((ts, idx) => ({
          id: ts.id || `ts_${p.code || p.id}_${p.store || 'HCM'}_${p.year || ''}_${idx}`,
          name: ts.name || `Task ${idx + 1}`,
          start: ts.start || p.computedTakStart || p.start || '',
          finish: ts.finish || p.computedTakCompl || p.handover || '',
          projectCode: p.code || '',
          projectStore: p.store || 'HCM',
          projectYear: p.year ? String(p.year) : '',
          party: ts.party || p.party || '',
          runningStatus: ts.runningStatus || 'On process',
          duration: ts.duration || '',
          parentTaskId: ts.parentTaskId,
          taskCodePhu: ts.taskCodePhu || (p.code ? `${p.code}-${idx + 1}` : undefined),
          orderIndex: ts.orderIndex !== undefined ? ts.orderIndex : idx,
          projectId: p.id,
          ...ts
        } as Task));
      }

      return [];
    },
    [tasksByProjectId, tasksByProject, tasksMapByCode]
  );

  // Pre-indexed Search Pool Cache to eliminate Garbage Collection pauses on mobile Safari
  const projectSearchIndex = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, { pPool: (string | number | undefined | null)[]; tPools: (string | number | undefined | null)[][] }>();
    projects.forEach(p => {
      const pTasks = getGroupTasksForProject(p);
      const pPool = [p.code, p.name, p.store, p.location, p.year, p.detail, p.party];
      const tPools = pTasks.map(t => [
        t.name,
        t.taskCodePhu,
        t.party,
        t.runningStatus,
        t.predecessor,
        ...(t.notes ? t.notes.map(n => n.content) : [])
      ]);
      map.set(p.id || p.code, { pPool, tPools });
    });
    return map;
  }, [projects, getGroupTasksForProject]);

  const filteredProjects = useMemo(() => {
    return projects.filter(p => {
      // Strict single-project isolation when navigated via Quick Navigation
      if (ganttTabFilterProjectId) {
        const isTarget = (p.id && String(p.id) === String(ganttTabFilterProjectId)) ||
                         (p.code && String(p.code).trim().toUpperCase() === String(ganttTabFilterProjectId).trim().toUpperCase());
        return isTarget;
      }

      const { computedTakStart, status } = getProjectDatesAndStatus(p, tasks);
      const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (computedTakStart ? String(computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : null);
      const matchesYear = globalYearFilter === 'all' || (pYear !== null && pYear === String(globalYearFilter).trim());
      const matchesStore = effectiveStore === 'all' || (Boolean(p.store) && String(p.store).toUpperCase().trim() === effectiveStore.toUpperCase().trim());
      const matchesLocation = globalLocationFilter.length === 0 || (p.location && globalLocationFilter.includes(p.location));

      const matchesStatus = matchProjectStatusFilter(status, filterProjectStatus, computedTakStart);

      if (!matchesYear || !matchesStore || !matchesLocation || !matchesStatus) return false;

      if (!deferredSearchTerm.trim()) return true;

      const indexed = projectSearchIndex.get(p.id || p.code);
      if (indexed) {
        if (matchesAdvancedSearch(deferredSearchTerm, [...indexed.pPool, status])) return true;
        return indexed.tPools.some(tPool => matchesAdvancedSearch(deferredSearchTerm, tPool));
      }

      return matchesAdvancedSearch(deferredSearchTerm, [p.code, p.name, p.store, p.location, status]);
    });
  }, [
    projects,
    ganttTabFilterProjectId,
    globalYearFilter,
    effectiveStore,
    globalLocationFilter,
    filterProjectStatus,
    deferredSearchTerm,
    projectSearchIndex
  ]);

  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(20);

  const sortedProjects = useMemo(() => {
    return [...filteredProjects].sort((a, b) => {
      const startA = a.computedTakStart || '9999-12-31';
      const startB = b.computedTakStart || '9999-12-31';
      if (startA !== startB) return startA.localeCompare(startB);
      return a.code.localeCompare(b.code);
    });
  }, [filteredProjects]);

  const paginatedProjects = useMemo(() => {
    return sortedProjects.slice(0, visibleCount);
  }, [sortedProjects, visibleCount]);

  const handleLoadMore = useCallback(() => {
    setVisibleCount(prev => Math.min(prev + 20, sortedProjects.length));
  }, [sortedProjects.length]);

  // Search filter operates on Project Summaries + loaded tasks first (Tri-Gate Lazy Loading).
  // Projects remain in summarized/collapsed state until user taps Expand (+), which triggers Delta Sync task fetching.
  const lastAutoExpandedSearchRef = useRef<string>('');
  useEffect(() => {
    const term = deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!term) {
      lastAutoExpandedSearchRef.current = '';
    }
  }, [deferredSearchTerm]);

  return {
    globalYearFilter,
    setGlobalYearFilter,
    globalStoreFilter,
    setGlobalStoreFilter,
    effectiveStore,
    globalLocationFilter,
    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    filterProjectStatus,
    onStatusFilterChange,
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    deferredSearchTerm,
    uniqueYears,
    uniqueStores,
    locationOptions,
    tasksByProject,
    tasksMapByCode,
    getGroupTasksForProject,
    filteredProjects,
    sortedProjects,
    paginatedProjects,
    visibleCount,
    setVisibleCount,
    handleLoadMore
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttTimeline.ts ==================== */
import React, { useState, useMemo, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { parseDateTime } from '../../lib/utils';
import { ViewMode, TimeUnit } from './ganttTypes';
import { useSyncScroll } from './GanttHooks';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';

interface UseGanttTimelineParams {
  filterStartDate: string;
  filterEndDate: string;
  printDateRangeOverride?: { start: Date; end: Date };
  paginatedProjects?: Project[];
  tasks?: Task[];
  getGroupTasksForProject?: (p: Project) => Task[];
  globalYearFilter?: string;
}

export function useGanttTimeline({
  filterStartDate,
  filterEndDate,
  printDateRangeOverride,
  paginatedProjects,
  tasks,
  getGroupTasksForProject,
  globalYearFilter
}: UseGanttTimelineParams) {
  const viewMode = useAppStore((state) => state.ganttViewMode);
  const setViewMode = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttViewMode);
  const dayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.ganttDayWidth);
  const setDayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttDayWidth);
  const scaleInput = useAppStore((state) => state.ganttScaleInput);
  const setScaleInput = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttScaleInput);
  const isWidthChanged = useAppStore((state) => state.isGanttWidthChanged);
  const setIsWidthChanged = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsGanttWidthChanged);
  const saveDayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.saveGanttDayWidth);

  const [customToday, setCustomToday] = useState<Date>(() => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    return d;
  });
  const [isDraggingToday, setIsDraggingToday] = useState(false);

  const { topScrollRef, mainScrollRef, handleTopScroll, handleMainScroll } = useSyncScroll();

  // Timeline Units, StartDate, EndDate, TotalDays
  const { timeUnits, startDate, endDate, totalDays } = useMemo(() => {
    if (printDateRangeOverride) {
      const s = new Date(printDateRangeOverride.start);
      s.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      const e = new Date(printDateRangeOverride.end);
      e.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      const diffDays = Math.ceil((e.getTime() - s.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;
      
      const units: TimeUnit[] = [];
      let curr = new Date(s);
      while (curr <= e) {
        units.push({
          date: new Date(curr),
          label: `${curr.getDate()}/${curr.getMonth() + 1}`,
          days: 1
        });
        curr.setDate(curr.getDate() + 1);
      }
      return { timeUnits: units, startDate: s, endDate: e, totalDays: Math.max(diffDays, 1) };
    }

    let start = filterStartDate ? parseDateTime(filterStartDate) : null;
    let end = filterEndDate ? parseDateTime(filterEndDate) : null;

    if (!start || !end) {
      let minFound: Date | null = null;
      let maxFound: Date | null = null;

      if (paginatedProjects && paginatedProjects.length > 0) {
        paginatedProjects.forEach((p) => {
          const pStart = p.start ? parseDateTime(p.start) : (p.computedTakStart ? parseDateTime(p.computedTakStart) : null);
          const pEnd = p.opening ? parseDateTime(p.opening) : (p.computedOpening ? parseDateTime(p.computedOpening) : (p.handover ? parseDateTime(p.handover) : (p.computedTakCompl ? parseDateTime(p.computedTakCompl) : null)));

          if (pStart) {
            if (!minFound || pStart < minFound) minFound = pStart;
          }
          if (pEnd) {
            if (!maxFound || pEnd > maxFound) maxFound = pEnd;
          }

          if (getGroupTasksForProject) {
            const groupTasks = getGroupTasksForProject(p);
            groupTasks.forEach((t) => {
              const tStart = t.start ? parseDateTime(t.start) : null;
              const tEnd = t.finish ? parseDateTime(t.finish) : null;
              if (tStart) {
                if (!minFound || tStart < minFound) minFound = tStart;
              }
              if (tEnd) {
                if (!maxFound || tEnd > maxFound) maxFound = tEnd;
              }
            });
          }
        });
      }

      if (minFound && maxFound) {
        // Expand start to 1st day of month
        const s = new Date(minFound);
        s.setDate(1);
        s.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        // Expand end to last day of month
        const e = new Date(maxFound);
        e.setMonth(e.getMonth() + 1, 0);
        e.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

        if (!start) start = s;
        if (!end) end = e;
      } else {
        const targetYear = globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== 'all' && !isNaN(parseInt(globalYearFilter, 10))
          ? parseInt(globalYearFilter, 10)
          : new Date().getFullYear();

        if (!start) {
          start = new Date(targetYear, 0, 1);
        }
        if (!end) {
          end = new Date(targetYear, 11, 31);
        }
      }
    }

    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    end.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const units: TimeUnit[] = [];
    let curr = new Date(start);

    if (viewMode === 'weekly') {
      while (curr <= end) {
        units.push({
          date: new Date(curr),
          label: `W${Math.ceil(curr.getDate() / 7)} - ${curr.getMonth() + 1}/${curr.getFullYear()}`,
          labelPrimary: `W${Math.ceil(curr.getDate() / 7)}`,
          labelSecondary: `${curr.getMonth() + 1}/${curr.getFullYear()}`,
          days: 7
        });
        curr.setDate(curr.getDate() + 7);
      }
    } else if (viewMode === 'quarterly') {
      while (curr <= end) {
        const q = Math.floor(curr.getMonth() / 3) + 1;
        units.push({
          date: new Date(curr),
          label: `Q${q} ${curr.getFullYear()}`,
          labelPrimary: `Q${q}`,
          labelSecondary: String(curr.getFullYear()),
          days: 90
        });
        curr.setMonth(curr.getMonth() + 3);
      }
    } else {
      // Monthly default
      while (curr <= end) {
        const daysInMonth = new Date(curr.getFullYear(), curr.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
        units.push({
          date: new Date(curr),
          label: `${curr.toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'short' })} ${curr.getFullYear()}`,
          labelPrimary: curr.toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'short' }),
          labelSecondary: String(curr.getFullYear()),
          days: daysInMonth
        });
        curr.setMonth(curr.getMonth() + 1, 1);
      }
    }

    const totalDaysCount = Math.max(
      Math.ceil((end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1,
      1
    );

    return {
      timeUnits: units,
      startDate: start,
      endDate: end,
      totalDays: totalDaysCount
    };
  }, [filterStartDate, filterEndDate, printDateRangeOverride, paginatedProjects, getGroupTasksForProject, globalYearFilter, viewMode]);

  const calculateDateOffsetPx = useCallback(
    (targetDate: Date | null | undefined): number => {
      if (!targetDate || !startDate) return 0;
      const diffMs = targetDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime();
      const diffDays = diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
      return diffDays * dayWidth;
    },
    [startDate, dayWidth]
  );

  const getDateFromOffsetPx = useCallback(
    (offsetPx: number): Date => {
      const diffDays = offsetPx / dayWidth;
      const d = new Date(startDate);
      d.setDate(d.getDate() + Math.round(diffDays));
      return d;
    },
    [startDate, dayWidth]
  );

  const scrollToToday = useCallback(
    (smooth = true) => {
      const offsetPx = calculateDateOffsetPx(customToday);
      if (mainScrollRef.current) {
        const targetScroll = Math.max(0, offsetPx - 400);
        mainScrollRef.current.scrollTo({
          left: targetScroll,
          behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto'
        });
      }
    },
    [calculateDateOffsetPx, customToday, mainScrollRef]
  );

  const handleTodayClick = useCallback(() => {
    scrollToToday(true);
  }, [scrollToToday]);

  return {
    viewMode,
    setViewMode,
    dayWidth,
    setDayWidth,
    isWidthChanged,
    setIsWidthChanged,
    scaleInput,
    setScaleInput,
    saveDayWidth,
    customToday,
    setCustomToday,
    isDraggingToday,
    setIsDraggingToday,
    timeUnits,
    startDate,
    endDate,
    totalDays,
    calculateDateOffsetPx,
    getDateFromOffsetPx,
    scrollToToday,
    handleTodayClick,
    topScrollRef,
    mainScrollRef,
    handleTopScroll,
    handleMainScroll
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttVirtualization.ts ==================== */
import React, { useState, useMemo, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { GanttTableRow } from './ganttTypes';
import { sortGroupTasks } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';

interface UseGanttVirtualizationParams {
  paginatedProjects: Project[];
  expandedProjects: string[];
  expandedModularSet: Set<string>;
  hiddenRowsSet: Set<string>;
  getGroupTasksForProject: (p: Project) => Task[];
  tableContainerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  handleMainScroll: (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
}

export function useGanttVirtualization({
  paginatedProjects,
  expandedProjects,
  expandedModularSet,
  hiddenRowsSet,
  getGroupTasksForProject,
  tableContainerRef,
  handleMainScroll
}: UseGanttVirtualizationParams) {
  const [scrollTop, setScrollTop] = useState(0);
  const [viewportHeight, setViewportHeight] = useState(800);
  const scrollRafRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = tableContainerRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        setViewportHeight(entry.contentRect.height || 800);
      }
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [tableContainerRef]);

  const handleCombinedMainScroll = useCallback((e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    handleMainScroll(e);
    const top = e.currentTarget.scrollTop;
    if (scrollRafRef.current !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(scrollRafRef.current);
    }
    scrollRafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      setScrollTop(top);
    });
  }, [handleMainScroll]);

  // Flatten Gantt Rows
  const flatGanttRows = useMemo(() => {
    const rows: GanttTableRow[] = [];

    paginatedProjects.forEach((p, pIdx) => {
      const pId = p.id || p.code;
      const isProjectExpanded = expandedProjects.includes(pId);
      const isProjectHidden = hiddenRowsSet.has(`proj-${pId}`);

      rows.push({
        type: 'project',
        key: `proj-${pId}`,
        project: p,
        projectIndex: pIdx,
        isExpanded: isProjectExpanded,
        isHidden: isProjectHidden
      });

      if (!isProjectExpanded) return;

      const rawTasks = getGroupTasksForProject(p).filter(t => {
        if ((!t.name || !String(t.name).trim()) && (!t.start || !String(t.start).trim()) && (!t.finish || !String(t.finish).trim())) {
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      });
      if (!rawTasks || rawTasks.length === 0) return;

      const pTasks = sortGroupTasks(rawTasks);

      // Create index map for sequential numbering
      const pTaskIndexMap = new Map<string, number>();
      pTasks.forEach((t, idx) => {
        if (t.id) pTaskIndexMap.set(t.id, idx);
      });

      // Group parent and child tasks
      const parentTasks: Task[] = [];
      const childTasksMap = new Map<string, Task[]>();

      // 1. Index tasks in project by ID and taskCodePhu for robust parent matching
      const projectTaskById = new Map<string, Task>();
      const projectTaskByCode = new Map<string, Task>();
      pTasks.forEach(t => {
        if (t.id) projectTaskById.set(String(t.id), t);
        if (t.taskCodePhu) {
          projectTaskByCode.set(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase(), t);
        }
      });

      // 2. Identify tasks that are referenced as parent tasks by other tasks in this project
      const parentTaskIdsInProject = new Set<string>();
      pTasks.forEach(t => {
        const rawParentId = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
        if (rawParentId) {
          const parentKey = String(rawParentId).trim().toLowerCase();
          const matchedParent = projectTaskById.get(String(rawParentId)) || projectTaskByCode.get(parentKey);
          if (matchedParent && String(matchedParent.id) !== String(t.id)) {
            parentTaskIdsInProject.add(String(matchedParent.id));
          }
        }
      });

      // 3. Partition tasks into root parentTasks vs childTasksMap
      pTasks.forEach(t => {
        const isSelfParent = parentTaskIdsInProject.has(String(t.id));
        const rawParentId = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;

        // If t is a parent task containing subtasks, it MUST be a root parent task (cannot be hidden as a child)
        if (rawParentId && !isSelfParent) {
          const parentKey = String(rawParentId).trim().toLowerCase();
          const matchedParent = projectTaskById.get(String(rawParentId)) || projectTaskByCode.get(parentKey);

          // ONLY treat as child if matchedParent exists in this project and is not self
          if (matchedParent && String(matchedParent.id) !== String(t.id)) {
            const effectiveParentId = String(matchedParent.id);
            if (!childTasksMap.has(effectiveParentId)) {
              childTasksMap.set(effectiveParentId, []);
            }
            childTasksMap.get(effectiveParentId)!.push(t);
            return;
          }
        }

        // If no valid matched parent exists in this project, or t is a parent task itself,
        // treat t as a root parent task so it is ALWAYS rendered and NEVER lost!
        parentTasks.push(t);
      });

      const sortedParentTasks = sortGroupTasks(parentTasks);

      sortedParentTasks.forEach((t, ptIdx) => {
        const isTaskHidden = hiddenRowsSet.has(`task-${t.id}`);
        const rawChildren = childTasksMap.get(String(t.id)) || childTasksMap.get(t.id) || [];
        const children = sortGroupTasks(rawChildren);
        const hasChildren = children.length > 0;
        const isModularExpanded = expandedModularSet.has(String(t.id)) || expandedModularSet.has(t.id);
        const tIndex = pTaskIndexMap.get(t.id) ?? ptIdx;

        rows.push({
          type: 'task',
          key: `task-${t.id}`,
          task: t,
          taskIndex: tIndex,
          project: p,
          isChild: false,
          hasChildren,
          childCount: children.length,
          childTasks: children,
          isModularExpanded,
          isHidden: isTaskHidden
        });

        if (hasChildren && isModularExpanded) {
          children.forEach((ct, ctIdx) => {
            const isChildHidden = hiddenRowsSet.has(`task-${ct.id}`);
            const ctIndex = pTaskIndexMap.get(ct.id) ?? (tIndex + ctIdx + 1);
            rows.push({
              type: 'task',
              key: `task-${ct.id}`,
              task: ct,
              taskIndex: ctIndex,
              project: p,
              parentTask: t,
              isChild: true,
              hasChildren: false,
              childCount: 0,
              isModularExpanded: false,
              isHidden: isChildHidden
            });
          });
        }
      });

      // 4. Safety Net: Render any leftover tasks in childTasksMap that were not in sortedParentTasks
      const renderedParentIds = new Set(sortedParentTasks.map(pt => String(pt.id)));
      childTasksMap.forEach((leftoverChildren, pId) => {
        if (!renderedParentIds.has(String(pId))) {
          leftoverChildren.forEach(ct => {
            const isChildHidden = hiddenRowsSet.has(`task-${ct.id}`);
            const ctIndex = pTaskIndexMap.get(ct.id) ?? 0;
            rows.push({
              type: 'task',
              key: `task-${ct.id}`,
              task: ct,
              taskIndex: ctIndex,
              project: p,
              isChild: false,
              hasChildren: false,
              childCount: 0,
              isModularExpanded: false,
              isHidden: isChildHidden
            });
          });
        }
      });
    });

    return rows;
  }, [
    paginatedProjects,
    expandedProjects,
    expandedModularSet,
    hiddenRowsSet,
    getGroupTasksForProject
  ]);

  // Index row heights and offsets
  const { totalHeight, rowOffsets } = useMemo(() => {
    let currentOffset = 0;
    const offsets: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < flatGanttRows.length; i++) {
      offsets.push(currentOffset);
      const row = flatGanttRows[i];
      if (row.isHidden) {
        currentOffset += 0;
      } else if (row.type === 'project') {
        currentOffset += 48; // project row height (h-12)
      } else {
        currentOffset += 40; // task row height (h-10)
      }
    }

    return { totalHeight: currentOffset, rowOffsets: offsets };
  }, [flatGanttRows]);

  // Virtual window slice indices
  const { startIndex, endIndex, paddingTop, paddingBottom } = useMemo(() => {
    if (flatGanttRows.length === 0) {
      return { startIndex: 0, endIndex: 0, paddingTop: 0, paddingBottom: 0 };
    }

    const bufferPx = 300;
    const startY = Math.max(0, scrollTop - bufferPx);
    const endY = scrollTop + viewportHeight + bufferPx;

    let s = 0;
    let e = flatGanttRows.length;

    // Binary search startIndex
    let low = 0;
    let high = flatGanttRows.length - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
      if (rowOffsets[mid] < startY) {
        s = mid;
        low = mid + 1;
      } else {
        high = mid - 1;
      }
    }

    // Binary search endIndex
    low = s;
    high = flatGanttRows.length - 1;
    while (low <= high) {
      const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
      if (rowOffsets[mid] <= endY) {
        e = mid + 1;
        low = mid + 1;
      } else {
        high = mid - 1;
      }
    }

    const topPad = rowOffsets[s] || 0;
    const bottomPad = Math.max(0, totalHeight - (rowOffsets[e] || totalHeight));

    return {
      startIndex: s,
      endIndex: Math.min(e, flatGanttRows.length),
      paddingTop: topPad,
      paddingBottom: bottomPad
    };
  }, [flatGanttRows.length, rowOffsets, scrollTop, viewportHeight, totalHeight]);

  const visibleGanttRows = useMemo(() => {
    return flatGanttRows.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
  }, [flatGanttRows, startIndex, endIndex]);

  return {
    flatGanttRows,
    visibleGanttRows,
    startIndex,
    endIndex,
    paddingTop,
    paddingBottom,
    totalHeight,
    scrollTop,
    viewportHeight,
    handleCombinedMainScroll
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/Gantt/useGanttZoomAndPan.ts ==================== */
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface UseGanttZoomAndPanParams {
  mainScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  topScrollRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  sideWidth: number;
}

export function useGanttZoomAndPan({
  mainScrollRef,
  topScrollRef,
  sideWidth
}: UseGanttZoomAndPanParams) {
  const dayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.ganttDayWidth);
  const setDayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttDayWidth);
  const setScaleInput = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttScaleInput);
  const setIsWidthChanged = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsGanttWidthChanged);

  const [isPanning, setIsPanning] = useState(false);
  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);
  const dragStartRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; scrollLeft: number; scrollTop: number }>({
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    scrollLeft: 0,
    scrollTop: 0
  });

  // Target scroll position during focal point zoom
  const targetScrollLeftRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // 1. Mouse Wheel Zoom Listener with Focal Point Preservation
  useEffect(() => {
    const mainEl = mainScrollRef.current;
    const topEl = topScrollRef.current;
    if (!mainEl) return;

    const handleWheelZoom = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      // Trigger zoom on Ctrl/Meta/Alt + wheel OR wheel when over top timeline header
      const isZoomGesture = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey || (topEl && topEl.contains(e.target as Node));
      
      if (!isZoomGesture) {
        return; // Allow standard native scrolling
      }

      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();

      const currentWidth = useAppStore.getState().ganttDayWidth;
      const zoomIn = e.deltaY < 0;

      // Calculate smooth exponential zoom step
      const factor = zoomIn ? 1.15 : 0.85;
      let newWidth = currentWidth * factor;

      // Clamp between 0.8px and 120px
      newWidth = Math.max(0.8, Math.min(120, newWidth));
      newWidth = Math.round(newWidth * 100) / 100; // 2 decimal places

      if (Math.abs(newWidth - currentWidth) < 0.01) return;

      // Calculate Focal Point under Mouse Cursor
      const rect = mainEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const cursorX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const currentScrollLeft = mainEl.scrollLeft;
      
      // Effective X in timeline space
      const cursorXInTimeline = currentScrollLeft + cursorX - sideWidth;

      if (cursorXInTimeline > 0 && currentWidth > 0) {
        const daysFromStart = cursorXInTimeline / currentWidth;
        const newCursorXInTimeline = daysFromStart * newWidth;
        const newScrollLeft = Math.max(0, newCursorXInTimeline - (cursorX - sideWidth));
        targetScrollLeftRef.current = newScrollLeft;
      }

      // Update Zustand Store & UI scale input
      setDayWidth(newWidth);
      const newScaleVal = String(Math.round((newWidth / 8) * 75));
      setScaleInput(newScaleVal);
      setIsWidthChanged(true);
    };

    // Attach wheel event with passive: false so preventDefault() works reliably
    mainEl.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheelZoom, { passive: false });
    if (topEl) {
      topEl.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheelZoom, { passive: false });
    }

    return () => {
      mainEl.removeEventListener('wheel', handleWheelZoom);
      if (topEl) {
        topEl.removeEventListener('wheel', handleWheelZoom);
      }
    };
  }, [mainScrollRef, topScrollRef, sideWidth, setDayWidth, setScaleInput, setIsWidthChanged]);

  // Apply target scroll position after dayWidth re-render
  useEffect(() => {
    if (targetScrollLeftRef.current !== null && mainScrollRef.current) {
      const target = targetScrollLeftRef.current;
      targetScrollLeftRef.current = null;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (mainScrollRef.current) {
          mainScrollRef.current.scrollLeft = target;
        }
      });
    }
  }, [dayWidth, mainScrollRef]);

  // 2. Drag-to-Pan Pointer Handlers
  const handlePointerDown = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const targetEl = e.target as HTMLElement;

    // Ignore clicks on interactive components
    if (
      targetEl.closest('button') ||
      targetEl.closest('input') ||
      targetEl.closest('select') ||
      targetEl.closest('a') ||
      targetEl.closest('.gantt-bar') ||
      targetEl.closest('.cursor-col-resize') ||
      targetEl.closest('.cursor-row-resize') ||
      targetEl.closest('.gantt-tooltip')
    ) {
      return;
    }

    // Left click (button 0) or Middle click (button 1)
    if (e.button === 0 || e.button === 1) {
      const scrollEl = mainScrollRef.current;
      if (!scrollEl) return;

      isDraggingRef.current = true;
      setIsPanning(true);

      dragStartRef.current = {
        x: e.clientX,
        y: e.clientY,
        scrollLeft: scrollEl.scrollLeft,
        scrollTop: scrollEl.scrollTop
      };

      if (e.button === 1) {
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    }
  }, [mainScrollRef]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!isDraggingRef.current || !mainScrollRef.current) return;

      const dx = e.clientX - dragStartRef.current.x;
      const dy = e.clientY - dragStartRef.current.y;

      mainScrollRef.current.scrollLeft = dragStartRef.current.scrollLeft - dx;
      mainScrollRef.current.scrollTop = dragStartRef.current.scrollTop - dy;
    };

    const handlePointerUp = () => {
      if (isDraggingRef.current) {
        isDraggingRef.current = false;
        setIsPanning(false);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', handlePointerUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', handlePointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp);
      window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', handlePointerUp);
    };
  }, [mainScrollRef]);

  return {
    isPanning,
    handlePointerDown
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/GanttTab.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, Suspense } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { useLanguage } from '../lib/LanguageContext';
import { lazyWithRetry } from '../lib/lazyWithRetry';
import { safeGetDeviceItemLocal, safeSetDeviceItemLocal, getDeviceScreenType } from '../lib/storage';
import { GanttTabProps } from './Gantt/ganttTypes';
import { useGanttLayoutState } from './Gantt/useGanttLayoutState';
import { useGanttProjectsFilter } from './Gantt/useGanttProjectsFilter';
import { useGanttTimeline } from './Gantt/useGanttTimeline';
import { useGanttVirtualization } from './Gantt/useGanttVirtualization';
import { useGanttDependencies } from './Gantt/useGanttDependencies';
import { useGanttDragReorder } from './Gantt/useGanttDragReorder';
import { useGanttColumnResize } from './Gantt/useGanttColumnResize';
import { useGanttBatchOps } from './Gantt/useGanttBatchOps';
import { useGanttExport } from './Gantt/useGanttExport';
import { GanttToolbar } from './Gantt/GanttToolbar';
import { GanttTableView } from './Gantt/GanttTableView';
import { useGanttFocus } from './Gantt/useGanttFocus';
import { getBarColor } from './Gantt/GanttUtils';

const TaskModularModal = lazyWithRetry(
  () => import('./TaskModularModal').then(m => ({ default: m.TaskModularModal })),
  'TaskModularModal'
);
const ConfirmModal = lazyWithRetry(
  () => import('./ConfirmModal').then(m => ({ default: m.ConfirmModal })),
  'ConfirmModal'
);

export function GanttTab({
  onNavigateToTaskDetail,
  onNavigateToLayout,
  initialFocusTaskId,
  onClearFocus,
  printDateRangeOverride
}: GanttTabProps) {
  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups: delegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const isTasksLoading = useAppStore(state => state.isTasksLoading);
  const isTasksRequested = useAppStore(state => state.isTasksRequested);
  const setIsTasksRequested = useAppStore(state => state.setIsTasksRequested);
  const ganttTabFocusTaskId = useAppStore(state => state.ganttTabFocusTaskId);
  const setGanttTabFocusTaskId = useAppStore(state => state.setGanttTabFocusTaskId);
  const ganttTabFilterProjectId = useAppStore(state => state.ganttTabFilterProjectId);
  const setGanttTabFilterProjectId = useAppStore(state => state.setGanttTabFilterProjectId);
  const expandedProjects = useAppStore(state => state.expandedProjectIds);
  const toggleProjectExpansion = useAppStore(state => state.toggleProjectExpansion);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTasksRequested) {
      setIsTasksRequested(true);
    }
  }, [isTasksRequested, setIsTasksRequested]);

  const [confirmModal, setConfirmModal] = useState<{
    isOpen: boolean;
    title: string;
    message: string;
    onConfirm: () => Promise<void>;
  }>({
    isOpen: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    onConfirm: async () => {}
  });

  const {
    filterStartDate,
    setFilterStartDate,
    filterEndDate,
    setFilterEndDate,
    tempStartDate,
    setTempStartDate,
    tempEndDate,
    setTempEndDate,
    sideWidth,
    setSideWidth,
    visibleColumns,
    handleToggleColumn,
  } = useGanttLayoutState(currentUser?.id);

  const tableContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // 1. Projects Filter & Search
  const {
    globalYearFilter,
    setGlobalYearFilter,
    effectiveStore,
    setGlobalStoreFilter,
    globalLocationFilter,
    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    filterProjectStatus,
    onStatusFilterChange,
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    uniqueYears,
    uniqueStores,
    locationOptions,
    getGroupTasksForProject,
    paginatedProjects
  } = useGanttProjectsFilter({
    projects,
    tasks,
    delegationGroups,
    currentUser
  });

  // 2. Timeline and Date Offset Calculations
  const {
    viewMode,
    setViewMode,
    dayWidth,
    setDayWidth,
    isWidthChanged,
    setIsWidthChanged,
    scaleInput,
    setScaleInput,
    saveDayWidth,
    customToday,
    setCustomToday,
    isDraggingToday,
    setIsDraggingToday,
    timeUnits,
    startDate,
    totalDays,
    getDateFromOffsetPx,
    handleTodayClick,
    topScrollRef,
    mainScrollRef,
    handleTopScroll,
    handleMainScroll
  } = useGanttTimeline({
    filterStartDate,
    filterEndDate,
    printDateRangeOverride,
    paginatedProjects,
    tasks,
    getGroupTasksForProject,
    globalYearFilter
  });

  // 3. Batch Operations & Selection
  const {
    selectedTaskIds,
    setSelectedTaskIds,
    selectedProjectIds,
    setSelectedProjectIds,
    selectedTaskSet,
    selectedProjectSet,
    isAllSelected,
    handleToggleSelectAll,
    handleTaskCheckboxChange,
    handleDeleteSelected,
    handleSetTextColor,
    handleSetBaselineSelected,
    handleToggleRealtimeUpdate,
    handleTogglePin,
    handleGroupModularTasks,
    handleUnlinkModularTasks,
    isTaskModularModalOpen,
    setIsTaskModularModalOpen,
    expandedModularTasks,
    setExpandedModularTasks,
    expandedModularSet,
    toggleModularParent,
    sumMode,
    setSumMode,
    computedSum,
    isHighlightDelegationOn,
    setIsHighlightDelegationOn,
    isEditMode,
    setIsEditMode,
    isHideMode,
    setIsHideMode,
    hiddenRows,
    setHiddenRows,
    hiddenRowsSet,
    toggleHideRow,
    getRowVisibilityClass
  } = useGanttBatchOps({
    tasks,
    projects,
    paginatedProjects,
    currentUser,
    getGroupTasksForProject,
    setConfirmModal
  });

  // 4. Virtualization Engine
  const {
    flatGanttRows,
    visibleGanttRows,
    paddingTop,
    paddingBottom,
    handleCombinedMainScroll
  } = useGanttVirtualization({
    paginatedProjects,
    expandedProjects,
    expandedModularSet,
    hiddenRowsSet,
    getGroupTasksForProject,
    tableContainerRef,
    handleMainScroll
  });

  // 5. Dependencies and Tooltips
  const {
    activeTooltip,
    setActiveTooltip,
    dependencyLines
  } = useGanttDependencies({
    tasks,
    projects,
    delegationGroups,
    visibleGanttRows,
    startDate,
    dayWidth,
    sideWidth,
    paddingTop,
    showStart: visibleColumns.includes('start'),
    showFinish: visibleColumns.includes('finish'),
    showParty: visibleColumns.includes('party'),
    showDuration: visibleColumns.includes('duration'),
    showPredecessor: visibleColumns.includes('predecessor')
  });

  // 6. Drag & Drop Task Reordering
  const {
    dragOverTaskId,
    dropPosition,
    draggingTaskIds,
    handleTaskDragStart,
    handleTaskDragOver,
    handleContainerDragOver,
    handleTaskDragLeave,
    handleTaskDrop,
    handleTaskDragEnd
  } = useGanttDragReorder({
    tasks,
    projects,
    mainScrollRef
  });

  // 7. PDF / PNG Export
  const { isExporting, handleExportToPDF } = useGanttExport({
    tableRef: tableContainerRef
  });

  // 8. Dynamic Column Width Resizing
  const { colWidths, startResizingColumn } = useGanttColumnResize();

  // Resizing side width
  const startResizingSide = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const startX = e.clientX;
    const startW = sideWidth;

    const onMouseMove = (moveEvent: MouseEvent) => {
      const delta = moveEvent.clientX - startX;
      const newW = Math.max(180, Math.min(600, startW + delta));
      setSideWidth(newW);
      safeSetDeviceItemLocal('taka_gantt_side_width', String(newW), currentUser?.id);
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
  }, [sideWidth]);

  // Auto-scroll to Today on tab mount
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      handleTodayClick();
    }, 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [handleTodayClick]);

  // 9. Focus Mode, Auto-Reveal & Auto-Center
  const {
    activeFocusId,
    focusedTask,
    focusedProject,
    locateTask,
    handleClearFocus
  } = useGanttFocus({
    tasks,
    projects,
    initialFocusTaskId,
    ganttTabFocusTaskId,
    setGanttTabFocusTaskId,
    setExpandedModularTasks,
    mainScrollRef,
    topScrollRef,
    startDate,
    dayWidth,
    sideWidth,
    onClearFocus: () => {
      setSearchTerm('');
      if (onClearFocus) onClearFocus();
    }
  });

  const isArchiveYear = globalYearFilter !== 'all' && Number(globalYearFilter) < new Date().getFullYear();
  const canWrite = (
    currentUser.role === 'admin' || 
    currentUser.canWrite === true || 
    !!permissionMatrix[currentUser.role]?.Write?.detail || 
    !!permissionMatrix[currentUser.role]?.Write?.report ||
    !!(permissionMatrix[currentUser.role]?.Write as any)?.gantt
  ) && !isArchiveYear;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col flex-grow bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-sm min-h-0">
      {/* Top Filter & Toolbar */}
      <GanttToolbar
        globalYearFilter={globalYearFilter}
        setGlobalYearFilter={setGlobalYearFilter}
        uniqueYears={uniqueYears}
        effectiveStore={effectiveStore}
        setGlobalStoreFilter={setGlobalStoreFilter}
        uniqueStores={uniqueStores}
        globalLocationFilter={globalLocationFilter}
        setGlobalLocationFilter={setGlobalLocationFilter}
        locationOptions={locationOptions}
        filterProjectStatus={filterProjectStatus}
        onStatusFilterChange={onStatusFilterChange}
        isTasksLoading={isTasksLoading}
        canWrite={canWrite}
        isEditMode={isEditMode}
        setIsEditMode={setIsEditMode}
        isHighlightDelegationOn={isHighlightDelegationOn}
        setIsHighlightDelegationOn={setIsHighlightDelegationOn}
        selectedProjectIds={selectedProjectIds}
        selectedTaskIds={selectedTaskIds}
        setSelectedProjectIds={setSelectedProjectIds}
        setSelectedTaskIds={setSelectedTaskIds}
        handleSetTextColor={handleSetTextColor}
        handleSetBaselineSelected={handleSetBaselineSelected}
        handleToggleRealtimeUpdate={handleToggleRealtimeUpdate}
        handleUnlinkModularTasks={handleUnlinkModularTasks}
        isTaskModularModalOpen={isTaskModularModalOpen}
        setIsTaskModularModalOpen={setIsTaskModularModalOpen}
        sumMode={sumMode}
        setSumMode={setSumMode}
        handleDeleteSelected={handleDeleteSelected}
        handleDragStart={() => {}}
        isHideMode={isHideMode}
        setIsHideMode={setIsHideMode}
        hiddenRows={hiddenRows}
        setHiddenRows={setHiddenRows}
        handleExportToPDF={handleExportToPDF}
        isExporting={isExporting}
        tempStartDate={tempStartDate}
        setTempStartDate={setTempStartDate}
        tempEndDate={tempEndDate}
        setTempEndDate={setTempEndDate}
        setFilterStartDate={setFilterStartDate}
        setFilterEndDate={setFilterEndDate}
        visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
        handleToggleColumn={handleToggleColumn}
        handleTodayClick={handleTodayClick}
        viewMode={viewMode}
        setViewMode={setViewMode}
        scaleInput={scaleInput}
        setScaleInput={setScaleInput}
        dayWidth={dayWidth}
        setDayWidth={setDayWidth}
        isWidthChanged={isWidthChanged}
        setIsWidthChanged={setIsWidthChanged}
        saveDayWidth={saveDayWidth}
        searchTerm={searchTerm}
        setSearchTerm={setSearchTerm}
        initialFocusTaskId={initialFocusTaskId}
        ganttTabFocusTaskId={ganttTabFocusTaskId}
        ganttTabFilterProjectId={ganttTabFilterProjectId}
        handleClearFocus={handleClearFocus}
      />

      {/* Main Gantt Table View */}
      <GanttTableView
        tableContainerRef={tableContainerRef}
        mainScrollRef={mainScrollRef}
        topScrollRef={topScrollRef}
        handleCombinedMainScroll={handleCombinedMainScroll}
        handleTopScroll={handleTopScroll}
        flatGanttRows={flatGanttRows}
        visibleGanttRows={visibleGanttRows}
        paddingTop={paddingTop}
        paddingBottom={paddingBottom}
        totalDays={totalDays}
        dayWidth={dayWidth}
        sideWidth={sideWidth}
        setSideWidth={setSideWidth}
        startResizingSide={startResizingSide}
        colWidths={colWidths}
        startResizingColumn={startResizingColumn}
        timeUnits={timeUnits}
        startDate={startDate}
        customToday={customToday}
        setCustomToday={setCustomToday}
        isDraggingToday={isDraggingToday}
        setIsDraggingToday={setIsDraggingToday}
        getDateFromOffsetPx={getDateFromOffsetPx}
        activeTooltip={activeTooltip}
        setActiveTooltip={setActiveTooltip}
        getBarColor={getBarColor}
        visibleColumns={visibleColumns}
        handleToggleColumn={handleToggleColumn}
        projects={projects}
        tasks={tasks}
        delegationGroups={delegationGroups}
        currentUser={currentUser}
        canWrite={canWrite}
        isEditMode={isEditMode}
        isHideMode={isHideMode}
        toggleHideRow={toggleHideRow}
        getRowVisibilityClass={getRowVisibilityClass}
        selectedTaskSet={selectedTaskSet}
        selectedTaskIds={selectedTaskIds}
        setSelectedTaskIds={setSelectedTaskIds}
        selectedProjectSet={selectedProjectSet}
        selectedProjectIds={selectedProjectIds}
        setSelectedProjectIds={setSelectedProjectIds}
        handleTaskCheckboxChange={handleTaskCheckboxChange}
        handleToggleSelectAll={handleToggleSelectAll}
        isAllSelected={isAllSelected}
        toggleProjectExpansion={toggleProjectExpansion}
        toggleModularParent={toggleModularParent}
        handleGroupModularTasks={handleGroupModularTasks}
        handleUnlinkModularTasks={handleUnlinkModularTasks}
        handleTogglePin={handleTogglePin}
        initialFocusTaskId={initialFocusTaskId}
        ganttTabFocusTaskId={ganttTabFocusTaskId}
        draggingTaskIds={draggingTaskIds}
        handleTaskDragStart={handleTaskDragStart}
        handleTaskDragOver={handleTaskDragOver}
        handleContainerDragOver={handleContainerDragOver}
        handleTaskDragLeave={handleTaskDragLeave}
        handleTaskDrop={handleTaskDrop}
        handleTaskDragEnd={handleTaskDragEnd}
        dragOverTaskId={dragOverTaskId}
        dropPosition={dropPosition}
        dependencyLines={dependencyLines}
        computedSum={computedSum}
        isExporting={isExporting}
        onNavigateToTaskDetail={onNavigateToTaskDetail}
        onNavigateToLayout={onNavigateToLayout}
        paginatedProjects={paginatedProjects}
        expandedModularTasks={expandedModularTasks}
        setExpandedModularTasks={setExpandedModularTasks}
        getGroupTasksForProject={getGroupTasksForProject}
      />

      {/* Task Modular Grouping Modal */}
      {isTaskModularModalOpen && (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <TaskModularModal
            isOpen={isTaskModularModalOpen}
            onClose={() => setIsTaskModularModalOpen(false)}
            selectedTaskIds={selectedTaskIds}
            tasks={tasks}
            projects={projects}
            onGroupTasks={handleGroupModularTasks}
            onUnlinkTasks={handleUnlinkModularTasks}
          />
        </Suspense>
      )}

      {/* Confirm Modal */}
      {confirmModal.isOpen && (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <ConfirmModal
            isOpen={confirmModal.isOpen}
            title={confirmModal.title}
            message={confirmModal.message}
            onConfirm={confirmModal.onConfirm}
            onCancel={() => setConfirmModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }))}
          />
        </Suspense>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

export default GanttTab;

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/GeneralTabParts/GeneralCanvasView.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { DragOverTarget, SortConfig } from './generalTypes';
import { drawGeneralCanvas, resolveCanvasClick } from './generalCanvasUtils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { Pin, ChevronUp, ChevronDown, CheckCircle2, ArrowUp, ArrowDown } from 'lucide-react';

interface GeneralCanvasViewProps {
  wrapperRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  canvasRef: React.RefObject<HTMLCanvasElement | null>;
  paginatedProjects: Project[];
  pinnedProjects: string[];
  sortConfig: SortConfig | null;
  setSortConfig: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<SortConfig | null>>;
  theme: string;
  flashToggle: boolean;
  searchTerm: string;
  globalYearFilter: string;
  globalStoreFilter: string;
  globalLocationFilter: string[];
  statusFilter: string;
  draggedPinnedId: string | null;
  dragOverTarget: DragOverTarget | null;
  justDroppedId: string | null;
  onProjectClick: (p: Project) => void;
  handlePinToggle: (e: React.MouseEvent, projectId: string) => void;
  handleMovePinned: (e: React.MouseEvent, projectId: string, direction: 'up' | 'down') => void;
  handleRowDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent, targetProject: Project, idx: number) => void;
  handleRowDrop: (e: React.DragEvent, targetId: string, position: 'above' | 'below') => void;
  handleCanvasDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => void;
  handleCanvasDrop: (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => void;
}

export function GeneralCanvasView({
  wrapperRef,
  canvasRef,
  paginatedProjects,
  pinnedProjects,
  sortConfig,
  setSortConfig,
  theme,
  flashToggle,
  searchTerm,
  globalYearFilter,
  globalStoreFilter,
  globalLocationFilter,
  statusFilter,
  draggedPinnedId,
  dragOverTarget,
  justDroppedId,
  onProjectClick,
  handlePinToggle,
  handleMovePinned,
  handleRowDragOver,
  handleRowDrop,
  handleCanvasDragOver,
  handleCanvasDrop
}: GeneralCanvasViewProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const wrapper = wrapperRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !wrapper) return;

    drawGeneralCanvas({
      canvas,
      wrapper,
      paginatedProjects,
      pinnedProjects,
      sortConfig,
      theme,
      flashToggle,
      t
    });
  }, [
    paginatedProjects, 
    pinnedProjects, 
    searchTerm, 
    globalYearFilter, 
    globalStoreFilter, 
    globalLocationFilter, 
    statusFilter, 
    flashToggle, 
    sortConfig, 
    theme,
    t,
    canvasRef,
    wrapperRef
  ]);

  const onCanvasClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const wrapper = wrapperRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !wrapper) return;

    resolveCanvasClick({
      e,
      canvas,
      wrapper,
      paginatedProjects,
      onProjectClick,
      handlePinToggle,
      setSortConfig,
      t
    });
  };

  return (
    <div ref={wrapperRef} className="hidden xl:block flex-grow overflow-auto border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] relative">
      <canvas 
        ref={canvasRef} 
        onClick={onCanvasClick}
        onDragOver={handleCanvasDragOver}
        onDrop={handleCanvasDrop}
        className="block cursor-pointer"
      />
      
      {/* Full-width drag-over drop target zones when dragging */}
      {draggedPinnedId && paginatedProjects.map((p, idx) => {
        if (!p.id || !pinnedProjects.includes(p.id)) return null;
        const isSource = p.id === draggedPinnedId;
        const isTarget = dragOverTarget?.id === p.id;
        return (
          <div
            key={`drop-zone-${p.id}`}
            className={`absolute left-0 right-0 z-20 min-w-[1100px] transition-colors pointer-events-auto ${
              isSource 
                ? 'opacity-40 bg-slate-200/50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 border-2 border-dashed border-blue-400' 
                : isTarget 
                  ? 'bg-blue-500/10 dark:bg-blue-400/10' 
                  : 'hover:bg-blue-500/5'
            }`}
            style={{ top: 60 + idx * 70, height: 70 }}
            onDragOver={(e) => handleRowDragOver(e, p, idx)}
            onDrop={(e) => dragOverTarget && handleRowDrop(e, p.id!, dragOverTarget.position)}
          >
            {isSource && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center pl-28 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 select-none">
                <span>{t('Moving project')}: {p.code} - {p.name}</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      {/* High-visibility glowing insertion beam during drag */}
      {draggedPinnedId && dragOverTarget && (
        <div
          className="absolute left-0 right-0 min-w-[1100px] z-30 pointer-events-none transition-all duration-75"
          style={{
            top: (dragOverTarget.position === 'above' 
              ? 60 + dragOverTarget.index * 70 
              : 60 + (dragOverTarget.index + 1) * 70) - 2,
          }}
        >
          <div className="w-full h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 via-indigo-500 to-blue-600 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(37,99,235,0.9)] rounded-full relative">
            <div className="absolute -left-1 -top-1 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-blue-600 ring-4 ring-blue-300 dark:ring-blue-800" />
            <div className="absolute -top-3.5 left-28 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-lg border border-blue-300/40 animate-pulse">
              {dragOverTarget.position === 'above' ? (
                <>
                  <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{t('Insert above')}: {dragOverTarget.projectCode}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{t('Insert below')}: {dragOverTarget.projectCode}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Success pulse highlight overlay on the newly dropped row */}
      {justDroppedId && (
        paginatedProjects.map((p, idx) => {
          if (p.id !== justDroppedId) return null;
          return (
            <div
              key={`just-dropped-${p.id}`}
              className="absolute left-0 right-0 min-w-[1100px] h-[70px] bg-emerald-500/15 dark:bg-emerald-400/15 border-2 border-emerald-500 z-30 pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-between px-6 animate-pulse rounded-lg transition-all duration-700"
              style={{ top: 60 + idx * 70 }}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold text-xs bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow border border-emerald-500/50">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                <span>{t('Position updated successfully!')}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })
      )}

      {/* Action overlay (drag handle, pin button, and quick up/down) for projects on Canvas */}
      {paginatedProjects.map((p, idx) => {
        if (!p.id) return null;
        const isPinned = pinnedProjects.includes(p.id);
        const pinnedIndex = pinnedProjects.indexOf(p.id);
        return (
          <div 
            key={`row-ctrl-${p.id}`}
            className="absolute left-0 flex items-center gap-1 z-10 pl-2 pointer-events-auto"
            style={{ 
              top: 60 + idx * 70, 
              width: isPinned ? 58 : 36,
              height: 70 
            }}
          >
            {isPinned ? (
              <>
                {/* Quick 1-click reorder buttons (Move Up / Down) placed where drag handle was */}
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 w-5 h-7">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={pinnedIndex === 0}
                    onClick={(e) => handleMovePinned(e, p.id!, 'up')}
                    className={`p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors ${pinnedIndex === 0 ? 'invisible pointer-events-none' : ''}`}
                    title={t('Move up')}
                  >
                    <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={pinnedIndex === pinnedProjects.length - 1}
                    onClick={(e) => handleMovePinned(e, p.id!, 'down')}
                    className={`p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors ${pinnedIndex === pinnedProjects.length - 1 ? 'invisible pointer-events-none' : ''}`}
                    title={t('Move down')}
                  >
                    <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    handlePinToggle(e, p.id!);
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-7 rounded hover:bg-blue-100/70 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:text-red-500 dark:hover:text-red-400 transition-colors"
                  title={t('Unpin')}
                >
                  <Pin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                </button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handlePinToggle(e, p.id!);
                }}
                className="flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-7 rounded opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 text-slate-300 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all"
                title={t('Pin to top')}
              >
                <Pin className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
