const statusWeight: Record<string, number> = {
  'On process': 1,
  'Upcoming': 2,
  'Completed': 3,
  'Handover': 4,
  'Canceled': 5
};

export function useGeneralData({
  projects,
  tasks,
  currentUser
}: UseGeneralDataParams) {
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setGlobalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalYearFilter);
  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const setGlobalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalStoreFilter);
  const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);
  const globalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalLocationFilter);
  const setGlobalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalLocationFilter);
  const pinnedProjects = useAppStore(state => state.pinnedProjects);
  const setPinnedProjects = useAppStore(state => state.setPinnedProjects);
  const theme = useAppStore(state => state.theme);

  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const deferredSearchTerm = useDeferredValue(searchTerm);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState(() => safeGetItemSession("taka_general_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days');
  const lastSelectedStatusFilterRef = useRef<string>(safeGetItemSession("taka_general_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days');
  const lastSelectedLocationFilterRef = useRef<string[]>(globalLocationFilter);
  const wasSearchingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  const [flashToggle, setFlashToggle] = useState(true);
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState<SortConfig | null>(null);
  const [visibleCount, setVisibleCount] = useState(20);

  // Status and Location Filter Preservation when Searching
  useEffect(() => {
    const isSearching = !!deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!wasSearchingRef.current && isSearching) {
      if (statusFilter !== 'all') {
        lastSelectedStatusFilterRef.current = statusFilter;
        safeSetItemSession("taka_general_status_filter", statusFilter);
      }
      lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current = globalLocationFilter;
      setStatusFilter('all');
      wasSearchingRef.current = true;
    } else if (wasSearchingRef.current && !isSearching) {
      const restored = lastSelectedStatusFilterRef.current || safeGetItemSession("taka_general_status_filter") || 'On process + Upcoming 3 days';
      setStatusFilter(restored);
      setGlobalLocationFilter(lastSelectedLocationFilterRef.current || []);
      wasSearchingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [deferredSearchTerm]);

  // Auto-jump to matched project location(s) when searching (Debounced)
  useEffect(() => {
    const term = deferredSearchTerm.trim();
    if (!term) return;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      const matchedProjects = projects.filter(p => {
        const status = getStatus(p.computedTakStart, p.computedTakCompl, p.computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
        const searchFields = [p.no, p.store, p.code, p.linkCodes, p.name, p.detail, (p as any).description, p.note, p.party, status, p.year];
        const matchesSearch = matchesAdvancedSearch(term, searchFields);
        const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year) : (p.computedTakStart ? String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : null);
        const matchesYear = globalYearFilter === 'all' || pYear === globalYearFilter;
        const matchesStore = effectiveStore === 'all' || p.store === effectiveStore;
        return matchesSearch && matchesYear && matchesStore;
      });
      const matchedLocations = Array.from(
        new Set(matchedProjects.map(p => p.location).filter((loc): loc is string => !!loc && loc.trim() !== ''))
      );
      if (matchedLocations.length > 0) {
        const currentLocs = globalLocationFilter || [];
        const isSame = currentLocs.length === matchedLocations.length && currentLocs.every(l => matchedLocations.includes(l));
        if (!isSame) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter(matchedLocations);
        }
      }
    }, 350);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [deferredSearchTerm, projects, globalYearFilter, effectiveStore, globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  // Handle Escape key globally to clear search when not in modal
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && searchTerm) {
        const state = useAppStore.getState();
        const hasOpenModal =
          state.isProjectModalOpen ||
          state.isTaskModalOpen ||
          state.isUserModalOpen ||
          state.isLoginModalOpen ||
          state.isCalendarSyncModalOpen;
        if (hasOpenModal) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const activeElement = document.activeElement;
        if (activeElement && typeof (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur === "function") {
          (activeElement as HTMLElement).blur();
        }
        setSearchTerm("");
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [searchTerm]);

  const years = useMemo(() => {
    const projYears = projects.map(p => {
      if (p.year) return String(p.year);
      if (p.computedTakStart) return String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4);
      return null;
    }).filter(Boolean) as string[];
    const taskYears = tasks.map(t => {
      if (t.projectYear) return String(t.projectYear);
      if (t.start) return String(t.start).substring(0, 4);
      return null;
    }).filter(Boolean) as string[];
    const baseYears = ['2026', '2027'];
    const unique = Array.from(new Set([...projYears, ...taskYears, ...baseYears])).filter(Boolean).sort();
    return unique.length > 0 ? unique : ['2026', '2027'];
  }, [projects, tasks, currentUser?.role]);

  const allowedStores = useMemo(() => getUserAllowedStores(currentUser), [currentUser]);
  const stores = allowedStores;
  const locationOptions = useLocationOptions();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (locationOptions.length > 0 && globalLocationFilter.length > 0) {
      const valid = globalLocationFilter.filter(loc => locationOptions.includes(loc));
      if (valid.length !== globalLocationFilter.length) {
        setGlobalLocationFilter(valid);
      }
    }
  }, [locationOptions, globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  const filteredProjects = useMemo(() => {
    // Pre-calculate project dates & status once (O(N)) to eliminate O(N log N) recalculations during sorting
    const infoMap = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof getProjectDatesAndStatus>>();
    projects.forEach(p => {
      const pKey = p.id || p.code || String(p.no || '');
      infoMap.set(pKey, getProjectDatesAndStatus(p, tasks));
    });

    const getMemoizedInfo = (p: Project) => {
      const pKey = p.id || p.code || String(p.no || '');
      return infoMap.get(pKey) || getProjectDatesAndStatus(p, tasks);
    };

    return projects.filter(p => {
      const { computedTakStart, computedTakCompl, computedOpening, status } = getMemoizedInfo(p);
      const searchFields = [p.no, p.store, p.code, p.linkCodes, p.name, p.detail, (p as any).description, p.note, p.party, status, p.year];
      const matchesSearch = matchesAdvancedSearch(deferredSearchTerm, searchFields);
      const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year).trim() : (computedTakStart ? String(computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : null));
      const matchesYear = globalYearFilter === 'all' || (pYear !== null && pYear === String(globalYearFilter).trim());
      const matchesStore = effectiveStore === 'all' || (Boolean(p.store) && String(p.store).toUpperCase().trim() === effectiveStore.toUpperCase().trim());
      const matchesLocation = globalLocationFilter.length === 0 || (p.location && globalLocationFilter.includes(p.location));

      const matchesStatus = matchProjectStatusFilter(status, statusFilter, computedTakStart);

      return matchesSearch && matchesYear && matchesStore && matchesLocation && matchesStatus;
    }).sort((a, b) => {
      const isPinnedA = a.id && pinnedProjects.includes(a.id);
      const isPinnedB = b.id && pinnedProjects.includes(b.id);
      
      if (isPinnedA !== isPinnedB) {
        return isPinnedA ? -1 : 1;
      }
      if (isPinnedA && isPinnedB) {
        const orderA = pinnedProjects.indexOf(a.id as string);
        const orderB = pinnedProjects.indexOf(b.id as string);
        if (orderA !== orderB) return orderA - orderB;
      }

      const infoA = getMemoizedInfo(a);
      const infoB = getMemoizedInfo(b);

      if (sortConfig) {
        let valA = '';
        let valB = '';
        if (sortConfig.key === 'start') {
          valA = infoA.computedTakStart || '9999-12-31';
          valB = infoB.computedTakStart || '9999-12-31';
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'handover') {
          valA = infoA.computedTakCompl || '9999-12-31';
          valB = infoB.computedTakCompl || '9999-12-31';
        } else if (sortConfig.key === 'opening') {
          valA = infoA.computedOpening || a.opening || '9999-12-31';
          valB = infoB.computedOpening || b.opening || '9999-12-31';
        }
        
        if (valA < valB) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        if (valA > valB) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        return 0;
      }

      const statusA = infoA.status;
      const statusB = infoB.status;
      
      const weightA = statusWeight[statusA] || 99;
      const weightB = statusWeight[statusB] || 99;
      if (weightA !== weightB) {
        return weightA - weightB;
      }

      // Special sorting for 'On process' : prioritize finish date proximity to today
      if (statusA === 'On process') {
        const today = new Date();
        today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        
        const finishA = parseDateTime(a.computedTakCompl || a.handover || a.computedOpening || a.opening);
        const finishB = parseDateTime(b.computedTakCompl || b.handover || b.computedOpening || b.opening);
        
        if (finishA && finishB) {
          const diffA = Math.abs(finishA.getTime() - today.getTime());
          const diffB = Math.abs(finishB.getTime() - today.getTime());
          if (diffA !== diffB) {
            return diffA - diffB;
          }
        } else if (finishA) {
          return -1;
        } else if (finishB) {
          return 1;
        }
      }

      const startA = a.computedTakStart || '9999-12-31';
      const startB = b.computedTakStart || '9999-12-31';
      if (startA !== startB) {
        return startA.localeCompare(startB);
      }

      const complA = a.computedTakCompl || '9999-12-31';
      const complB = b.computedTakCompl || '9999-12-31';
      if (complA !== complB) {
        return complA.localeCompare(complB);
      }

      const openA = a.computedOpening || a.opening || '9999-12-31';
      const openB = b.computedOpening || b.opening || '9999-12-31';
      if (openA !== openB) {
        return openA.localeCompare(openB);
      }
      
      return a.code.localeCompare(b.code) || String(a.year || '').localeCompare(String(b.year || ''));
    });
  }, [projects, tasks, deferredSearchTerm, globalYearFilter, effectiveStore, globalLocationFilter, statusFilter, pinnedProjects, sortConfig]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => setFlashToggle(prev => !prev), 600);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const paginatedProjects = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredProjects.slice(0, visibleCount);
  }, [filteredProjects, visibleCount]);

  return {
    globalYearFilter,
    setGlobalYearFilter,
    globalStoreFilter,
    setGlobalStoreFilter,
    effectiveStore,
    globalLocationFilter,
    setGlobalLocationFilter,
    pinnedProjects,
    setPinnedProjects,
    theme,
    searchTerm,
    setSearchTerm,
    deferredSearchTerm,
    statusFilter,
    setStatusFilter,
    lastSelectedStatusFilterRef,
    flashToggle,
    sortConfig,
    setSortConfig,
    visibleCount,
    setVisibleCount,
    years,
    stores,
    locationOptions,
    filteredProjects,
    paginatedProjects
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/GeneralTabParts/useGeneralDragDrop.ts ==================== */
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { DragOverTarget } from './generalTypes';

interface UseGeneralDragDropParams {
  projects: Project[];
  paginatedProjects: Project[];
  pinnedProjects: string[];
  setPinnedProjects: (ids: string[]) => void;
  canvasRef: React.RefObject<HTMLCanvasElement | null>;
  t: (key: string) => string;
}

export function useGeneralDragDrop({
  projects,
  paginatedProjects,
  pinnedProjects,
  setPinnedProjects,
  canvasRef,
  t
}: UseGeneralDragDropParams) {
  const [draggedPinnedId, setDraggedPinnedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOverTarget, setDragOverTarget] = useState<DragOverTarget | null>(null);
  const [justDroppedId, setJustDroppedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successToast, setSuccessToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const toastTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const triggerSuccessFeedback = (id: string, message: string) => {
    setJustDroppedId(id);
    setSuccessToast(message);
    if (toastTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(toastTimeoutRef.current);
    toastTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setJustDroppedId(null);
      setSuccessToast(null);
    }, 2400);
  };

  const reorderPinnedProjects = (
    currentPinned: string[],
    draggedId: string,
    targetId: string,
    position: 'above' | 'below'
  ): string[] => {
    if (draggedId === targetId) return currentPinned;
    const listWithoutDragged = currentPinned.filter(id => id !== draggedId);
    const targetIndexInCleanList = listWithoutDragged.indexOf(targetId);
    if (targetIndexInCleanList === -1) return currentPinned;
    const insertIndex = position === 'above' ? targetIndexInCleanList : targetIndexInCleanList + 1;
    const result = [...listWithoutDragged];
    result.splice(insertIndex, 0, draggedId);
    return result;
  };

  const handlePinToggle = (e: React.MouseEvent, projectId: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (pinnedProjects.includes(projectId)) {
      setPinnedProjects(pinnedProjects.filter(id => id !== projectId));
    } else {
      setPinnedProjects([...pinnedProjects, projectId]);
    }
  };

  const handleMovePinned = (e: React.MouseEvent, projectId: string, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const currIdx = pinnedProjects.indexOf(projectId);
    if (currIdx === -1) return;
    const newIdx = direction === 'up' ? currIdx - 1 : currIdx + 1;
    if (newIdx < 0 || newIdx >= pinnedProjects.length) return;
    const newPinned = [...pinnedProjects];
    const [moved] = newPinned.splice(currIdx, 1);
    newPinned.splice(newIdx, 0, moved);
    setPinnedProjects(newPinned);
    
    const proj = projects.find(p => p.id === projectId);
    triggerSuccessFeedback(
      projectId,
      direction === 'up'
        ? `Đã di chuyển ${proj?.code || 'dự án'} lên vị trí ${newIdx + 1}`
        : `Đã di chuyển ${proj?.code || 'dự án'} xuống vị trí ${newIdx + 1}`
    );
  };

  const handleDragStart = (e: React.DragEvent, id: string) => {
    setDraggedPinnedId(id);
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', id);
  };

  const handleRowDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent, targetProject: Project, idx: number) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!draggedPinnedId || !targetProject.id || draggedPinnedId === targetProject.id) {
      return;
    }
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const relativeY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const isAbove = relativeY < rect.height / 2;
    const position = isAbove ? 'above' : 'below';

    if (dragOverTarget?.id !== targetProject.id || dragOverTarget?.position !== position) {
      setDragOverTarget({
        id: targetProject.id,
        position,
        index: idx,
        projectCode: targetProject.code,
        projectName: targetProject.name,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleRowDrop = (e: React.DragEvent, targetId: string, position: 'above' | 'below') => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!draggedPinnedId || draggedPinnedId === targetId) {
      setDraggedPinnedId(null);
      setDragOverTarget(null);
      return;
    }

    const newPinned = reorderPinnedProjects(pinnedProjects, draggedPinnedId, targetId, position);
    setPinnedProjects(newPinned);

    const movedProj = projects.find(p => p.id === draggedPinnedId);
    const targetProj = projects.find(p => p.id === targetId);
    const code = movedProj?.code || 'Dự án';

    triggerSuccessFeedback(
      draggedPinnedId,
      position === 'above'
        ? `Đã chuyển ${code} lên trước ${targetProj?.code || ''}!`
        : `Đã chuyển ${code} xuống sau ${targetProj?.code || ''}!`
    );

    setDraggedPinnedId(null);
    setDragOverTarget(null);
  };

  const handleDragEnd = () => {
    setDraggedPinnedId(null);
    setDragOverTarget(null);
  };

  const handleCanvasDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!draggedPinnedId) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;

    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const headerHeight = 60;
    const rowHeight = 70;

    if (y > headerHeight) {
      const idx = Math.floor((y - headerHeight) / rowHeight);
      if (idx >= 0 && idx < paginatedProjects.length) {
        const targetProject = paginatedProjects[idx];
        if (targetProject.id && pinnedProjects.includes(targetProject.id) && targetProject.id !== draggedPinnedId) {
          const rowY = headerHeight + idx * rowHeight;
          const relativeY = y - rowY;
          const position = relativeY < rowHeight / 2 ? 'above' : 'below';

          setDragOverTarget({
            id: targetProject.id,
            position,
            index: idx,
            projectCode: targetProject.code,
            projectName: targetProject.name,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const handleCanvasDrop = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!draggedPinnedId) return;
    if (dragOverTarget && dragOverTarget.id !== draggedPinnedId) {
      handleRowDrop(e, dragOverTarget.id, dragOverTarget.position);
    } else {
      setDraggedPinnedId(null);
      setDragOverTarget(null);
    }
  };

  return {
    draggedPinnedId,
    dragOverTarget,
    justDroppedId,
    successToast,
    handlePinToggle,
    handleMovePinned,
    handleDragStart,
    handleRowDragOver,
    handleRowDrop,
    handleDragEnd,
    handleCanvasDragOver,
    handleCanvasDrop
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/GeneralTabParts/useGeneralGoogleSync.ts ==================== */
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Project, DelegationGroup, AppUser } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { getStatus, formatDisplayDateMain } from '../../lib/utils';

interface UseGeneralGoogleSyncParams {
  currentUser: AppUser;
  projects: Project[];
  delegationGroups: DelegationGroup[];
}

export function useGeneralGoogleSync({
  currentUser,
  projects,
  delegationGroups
}: UseGeneralGoogleSyncParams) {
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);

  const handleGoogleSync = async () => {
    if (currentUser.role !== 'admin') return;
    if (!useAppStore.getState().isDelegationsRequested) {
      useAppStore.getState().setIsDelegationsRequested(true);
    }
    const WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwPAZcZ8wGQ1CVPYn_5h4arJ2dqX7T9rpWPMAmEuc3Q2G4BB7l59Mbxb8Ep0aQE6GA1/exec';
    
    setIsSyncing(true);
    
    const projectsData = projects.map(p => {
      const pYear = p.year ? String(p.year) : (p.computedTakStart ? String(p.computedTakStart).substring(0, 4) : '');
      const status = getStatus(p.computedTakStart, p.computedTakCompl, p.computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
      
      const projectDelegations = delegationGroups.filter(g => g.projectCode === p.code);
      let delegationTaskStr = '';
      if (projectDelegations.length > 0) {
        delegationTaskStr = projectDelegations.map(g => {
          let st = g.subTasks?.[0]?.delegationStatus || g.subTasks?.[0]?.status || 'Assigned';
          if (st === 'Accepted') st = 'On process';
          return `${g.name} (${st})`;
        }).join('; ');
      }
      
      const now = new Date();
      let activeTaskNames: string[] = [];
      if (p.taskSummaries) {
        const activeTasks = p.taskSummaries.filter(t => {
          if (!t.start || !t.finish) return false;
          const start = new Date(t.start);
          const finish = new Date(t.finish);
          return now >= start && now <= finish;
        });
        activeTaskNames = activeTasks.map(t => t.name);
      }
      let taskLines: string[] = [];
      activeTaskNames.forEach(name => {
        taskLines.push(...name.split('\n').filter((l: string) => l.trim() !== ''));
      });
      let detailString = taskLines.length > 0 ? taskLines.join('\n') : (p.detail || '');
      
      return {
        projectId: p.id || p.no, // Unique ID for upsert
        year: pYear,
        store: p.store || '',
        location: p.location || '',
        code: p.code || '',
        linkCodes: p.linkCodes || p.code || '',
        projectName: p.name || '',
        status: status,
        detail: detailString,
        startPlan: p.computedTakStart ? formatDisplayDateMain(p.computedTakStart) : '',
        finishPlan: p.computedTakCompl ? formatDisplayDateMain(p.computedTakCompl) : '',
        delegationTask: delegationTaskStr
      };
    });

    try {
      await fetch(WEBHOOK_URL, {
        method: 'POST',
        mode: 'no-cors',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'upsert', projects: projectsData })
      });
      
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Notice", message: "Sent project sync request to Google Sheets!" });
    } catch(err) {
      console.error(err);
      useAppStore.getState().setToast({ title: "Error", message: (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)) });
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    isSyncing,
    handleGoogleSync
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/GlobalFleetMonitorView.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { collection, onSnapshot, query, orderBy, doc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import {   db, APP_ID , writeBatch , deleteDoc } from "../lib/firebase";
import { DevicePerformanceData } from "../store/usePerformanceStore";
import { reportDevicePerformance, getOrCreateDeviceId } from "../lib/deviceTelemetry";
import { useAppStore } from "../store/useAppStore";
import { matchesAdvancedSearch } from "../lib/utils";
import { DebouncedSearchInput } from './DebouncedSearchInput';
import {
  Smartphone,
  Monitor,
  Laptop,
  Server,
  HardDrive,
  RefreshCw,
  Radio,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  Trash2,
  ShieldAlert,
  Search,
  Filter,
  Users,
} from "lucide-react";

export function GlobalFleetMonitorView() {
  const [devices, setDevices] = useState<DevicePerformanceData[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const setToast = useAppStore((state) => state.setToast);
  const currentDeviceId = getOrCreateDeviceId();

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    const colRef = collection(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_device_metrics");
    const q = query(colRef);

    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(
      q,
      (snapshot) => {
        const loaded: DevicePerformanceData[] = [];
        const now = Date.now();

        snapshot.forEach((docSnap) => {
          const data = docSnap.data() as DevicePerformanceData;
          // Determine activity status: active within 3 mins = online, within 15 mins = idle, else offline
          const diffMs = now - (data.lastActiveTimestamp || 0);
          let status: "online" | "idle" | "offline" = "offline";
          if (diffMs < 3 * 60 * 1000) {
            status = "online";
          } else if (diffMs < 15 * 60 * 1000) {
            status = "idle";
          }

          loaded.push({
            ...data,
            deviceId: docSnap.id,
            status,
          });
        });

        // Sort: Current device first, then most recently active
        loaded.sort((a, b) => {
          if (a.deviceId === currentDeviceId) return -1;
          if (b.deviceId === currentDeviceId) return 1;
          return (b.lastActiveTimestamp || 0) - (a.lastActiveTimestamp || 0);
        });

        setDevices(loaded);
        setIsLoading(false);
      },
      (err) => {
        console.error("Error listening to taka_device_metrics:", err);
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    );

    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, [currentDeviceId]);

  const handleManualSyncThisDevice = async () => {
    setIsRefreshing(true);
    await reportDevicePerformance(true);
    setTimeout(() => setIsRefreshing(false), 600);
    setToast({
      title: "Đồng bộ thành công",
      message: "Chỉ số thiết bị hiện tại đã được cập nhật lên hệ thống.",
      type: "success",
    });
  };

  const handleClearStaleDevices = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm("Bạn có muốn xóa dữ liệu của các thiết bị không hoạt động trên 24 giờ khỏi bảng theo dõi?")) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const now = Date.now();
      const twentyFourHours = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      const stale = devices.filter((d) => d.deviceId !== currentDeviceId && now - (d.lastActiveTimestamp || 0) > twentyFourHours);

      if (stale.length === 0) {
        setToast({ title: "Thông báo", message: "Không có thiết bị cũ nào quá 24h cần xóa." });
        return;
      }

      const batch = writeBatch(db);
      stale.forEach((d) => {
        const ref = doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_device_metrics", d.deviceId);
        batch.delete(ref);
      });
      batch.commit().catch(e => console.error("Batch commit failed", e));

      setToast({
        title: "Đã dọn dẹp",
        message: `Đã xóa ${stale.length} thiết bị cũ không còn hoạt động.`,
        type: "success",
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setToast({ title: "Lỗi", message: "Không thể dọn dẹp thiết bị.", type: "error" });
    }
  };

  // Aggregated fleet metrics
  const totalFleetServerReads = devices.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.serverReads || 0), 0);
  const totalFleetCacheReads = devices.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.cacheReads || 0), 0);
  const totalFleetOps = totalFleetServerReads + totalFleetCacheReads;
  const fleetHitRate = totalFleetOps > 0 ? ((totalFleetCacheReads / totalFleetOps) * 100).toFixed(1) : "100.0";
  const onlineCount = devices.filter((d) => d.status === "online").length;

  const filteredDevices = devices.filter((d) => {
    if (roleFilter !== "all" && d.userRole !== roleFilter) return false;
    if (searchTerm) {
      return matchesAdvancedSearch(searchTerm, [d.deviceName, d.userName, d.platform, d.deviceId]);
    }
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {/* Fleet KPI Summary Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5">
        {/* Total Fleet Server Reads */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#27272a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a1a1aa]">
              Tổng Server Reads (All)
            </span>
            <Server className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {totalFleetServerReads.toLocaleString()}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">docs</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              Từ tất cả các máy kết nối
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Total Fleet Cache Reads */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#27272a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a1a1aa]">
              Cache Tiết Kiệm (All)
            </span>
            <HardDrive className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                {totalFleetCacheReads.toLocaleString()}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">docs</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> Đọc trực tiếp từ thiết bị
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Fleet Cache Hit Rate */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#27272a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a1a1aa]">
              Tỷ Lệ Cache Toàn Mạng
            </span>
            <Radio className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {fleetHitRate}%
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#3f3f46] h-1.5 rounded-full mt-2 overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="bg-emerald-500 h-full rounded-full transition-all"
                style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, parseFloat(fleetHitRate)))}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Active Connected Devices */}
        <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#27272a] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a1a1aa]">
              Thiết Bị Đang Kết Nối
            </span>
            <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-2xl font-black text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
                {onlineCount}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-500">/ {devices.length} thiết bị</span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
              Đang hoạt động trong 3 phút qua
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Fleet Filter Bar & Controls */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#27272a] rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] p-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-grow max-w-md">
          <div className="relative w-full">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 z-10 pointer-events-none" />
            <DebouncedSearchInput
              placeholder="Tìm theo tên máy, người dùng, hệ điều hành (Windows, iPhone...)..."
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(val) => setSearchTerm(val)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-1.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1f1f22] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] rounded-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
            />
          </div>
          <select
            value={roleFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setRoleFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1f1f22] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] rounded-lg text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none"
          >
            <option value="all">Tất cả vai trò</option>
            <option value="admin">Admin</option>
            <option value="user">User</option>
            <option value="guest">Guest</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={handleManualSyncThisDevice}
            disabled={isRefreshing}
            title="Nhấn để gửi báo cáo số liệu của máy này lên bảng theo dõi (Chế độ thủ công, không tốn lượt ghi tự động)"
            className="px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isRefreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            {isRefreshing ? "Đang gửi..." : "Đồng bộ thủ công máy này"}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handleClearStaleDevices}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium bg-white dark:bg-[#27272a] hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#323236] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            Dọn máy offline (&gt;24h)
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Info notice explaining manual sync zero-cost mode */}
      <div className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800/40 text-[11px] text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            <strong>Chế độ Thủ Công (Tiết Kiệm Tuyệt Đối 0 VNĐ):</strong> Ứng dụng đã tắt hoàn toàn tiến trình ghi tự động ngầm. Khi muốn cập nhật chỉ số của máy nào lên bảng điều khiển này, người dùng tại máy đó chỉ cần bấm nút <strong>"Đồng bộ thủ công máy này"</strong> (chỉ tốn đúng 1 lượt Write duy nhất khi bấm).
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Devices List Table */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#27272a] rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#1f1f22] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3f3f46] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a1a1aa] font-semibold uppercase text-[10px] tracking-wider">
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Thiết bị & Người dùng</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-3">Nền tảng / Trình duyệt</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">Server Reads</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">Cache Reads</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right">Cache Rate</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-3 text-center">Trạng thái</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Hoạt động gần nhất</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-[#3f3f46]">
              {isLoading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={7} className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                    <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-blue-500" />
                    Đang nạp danh sách thiết bị...
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : filteredDevices.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={7} className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-slate-400 italic">
                    Không tìm thấy thiết bị nào phù hợp với bộ lọc.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredDevices.map((dev) => {
                  const isCurrent = dev.deviceId === currentDeviceId;
                  const isMobile = dev.platform?.includes("iPhone") || dev.platform?.includes("Android");

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={dev.deviceId}
                      className={`hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#323236] transition-colors ${
                        isCurrent ? "bg-blue-50/40 dark:bg-blue-950/20" : ""
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* Device & User */}
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <div
                            className={`p-2 rounded-lg shrink-0 ${
                              isCurrent
                                ? "bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/50 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300"
                                : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#3f3f46] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {isMobile ? <Smartphone className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Laptop className="w-4 h-4" />}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#ededed] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              {dev.userName}
                              {isCurrent && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-blue-600 text-white">
                                  Máy này (Current)
                                </span>
                              )}
                              <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#3f3f46] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 uppercase font-mono">
                                {dev.userRole}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                              ID: {dev.deviceId.substring(0, 14)}...
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Platform */}
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium">
                        <div>{dev.deviceName}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{dev.platform}</div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Server Reads */}
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold">
                        {dev.serverReads > 0 ? (
                          <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
                            {dev.serverReads.toLocaleString()}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">0</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Cache Reads */}
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        {dev.cacheReads.toLocaleString()}
                      </td>

                      {/* Cache Hit Rate */}
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right">
                        <span
                          className={`font-black ${
                            dev.cacheHitRate >= 90
                              ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                              : dev.cacheHitRate >= 50
                              ? "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                              : "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {dev.cacheHitRate}%
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Status */}
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-center">
                        {dev.status === "online" ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-300/40">
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
                            Online
                          </span>
                        ) : dev.status === "idle" ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-300/40">
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
                            Chờ (Idle)
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#3f3f46] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-400" />
                            Offline
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Last Active */}
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono text-[11px]">
                        <div>{dev.lastActiveAt || "-"}</div>
                        {dev.sessionDurationSec ? (
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                            Đã mở {Math.floor(dev.sessionDurationSec / 60)} phút
                          </div>
                        ) : null}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEnrichedData } from '../hooks/useEnrichedData';

  Maximize,

  ScanQrCode,
  Settings,
  Sun,

  Upload,
  Download,

interface HeaderProps {
  cloudStatus: "online" | "syncing" | "offline";
  onLoginClick: () => void;
  onLogoutClick: () => void;
  onTabChange: (tab: TabId) => void;
  activeTab: TabId;
  notificationCount?: number;
  onUndo?: () => void;
  canUndo?: boolean;
  hasDataToUndo?: boolean;
  undoDescription?: string;
  onRedo?: () => void;
  canRedo?: boolean;
  hasDataToRedo?: boolean;
  redoDescription?: string;
  onToggleTheme?: () => void;
  onPrintClick?: () => void;
  isFocusMode?: boolean;
  onToggleFocusMode?: () => void;
  isPrintPreview?: boolean;
  onPrintPreviewToggle?: () => void;
  onDeepLink?: (scannedText: string) => void;
  onQuickNavigate?: (targetTab: TabId, target: any) => void;
}

export function Header({
  cloudStatus, onLoginClick, onLogoutClick, onTabChange, activeTab, notificationCount = 0, onUndo, canUndo = false, hasDataToUndo = false, undoDescription, onRedo, canRedo = false, hasDataToRedo = false, redoDescription, onToggleTheme, isFocusMode = false, onToggleFocusMode, onPrintClick, isPrintPreview = false, onPrintPreviewToggle, onDeepLink, onQuickNavigate}: HeaderProps) {

  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks, visibleDelegationGroups: delegationGroups } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  const theme = useAppStore(state => state.theme);
  const appUsers = useAppStore(state => state.appUsers);
  const subAppUsers = useAppStore(state => state.subAppUsers);
  const parties = useAppStore(state => state.parties);
  const [isQRScannerOpen, setIsQRScannerOpen] = useState(false);

  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isShortcutsOpen, setIsShortcutsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(new Date());
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const { language, setLanguage, t } = useLanguage();
  
  const currency = useAppStore(state => state.currency);
  const setCurrency = useAppStore(state => state.setCurrency);
  const showQuickAccessToolbar = useAppStore(state => state.showQuickAccessToolbar);
  const canWriteImportCsv = currentUser?.role === 'admin' || !!permissionMatrix[currentUser?.role as AppRole]?.Write?.importCsv;
  const jpyRate = useAppStore(state => state.jpyRate);
  const usdRate = useAppStore(state => state.usdRate);

  const ganttViewMode = useAppStore(state => state.ganttViewMode);
  const setGanttViewMode = useAppStore(state => state.setGanttViewMode);
  const ganttDayWidth = useAppStore(state => state.ganttDayWidth);
  const setGanttDayWidth = useAppStore(state => state.setGanttDayWidth);
  const ganttScaleInput = useAppStore(state => state.ganttScaleInput);
  const setGanttScaleInput = useAppStore(state => state.setGanttScaleInput);
  const isGanttWidthChanged = useAppStore(state => state.isGanttWidthChanged);
  const setIsGanttWidthChanged = useAppStore(state => state.setIsGanttWidthChanged);
  const saveGanttDayWidth = useAppStore(state => state.saveGanttDayWidth);

  const handleCurrencyClick = () => {
    let nextCurrency: 'VND' | 'JPY' | 'USD' = 'VND';
    if (currency === 'VND') nextCurrency = 'JPY';
    else if (currency === 'JPY') nextCurrency = 'USD';
    setCurrency(nextCurrency);
  };

  const handleCurrencyContextMenu = async (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (currentUser.role !== 'admin') return;
    const jpyInput = window.prompt("Enter JPY exchange rate (e.g. 160):", jpyRate.toString());
    if (jpyInput !== null) {
      const parsedJpy = parseFloat(jpyInput);
      if (!isNaN(parsedJpy)) {
        useAppStore.getState().setJpyRate(parsedJpy);
        try {
          setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_settings", "exchange_rates"), { jpyRate: parsedJpy }, { merge: true });
        } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
      }
    }
    const usdInput = window.prompt("Enter USD exchange rate (e.g. 25000):", usdRate.toString());
    if (usdInput !== null) {
      const parsedUsd = parseFloat(usdInput);
      if (!isNaN(parsedUsd)) {
        useAppStore.getState().setUsdRate(parsedUsd);
        try {
          setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_settings", "exchange_rates"), { usdRate: parsedUsd }, { merge: true });
        } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => setCurrentTime(new Date()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsMenuOpen(false);
      }
    }
    function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        setIsMenuOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, []);

  const formatCompactTime = (date: Date) => {
    const day = date.getDate().toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const month = date.toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'short' });
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    const hours = date.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const mins = date.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const secs = date.getSeconds().toString().padStart(2, '0');
    return `${day} ${month} ${year} ${hours}:${mins}:${secs}`;
  };

  const formatFullTime = (date: Date) => {
    return date.toLocaleString('en-US', {
      weekday: 'long',
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit',
      hour12: false,
    });
  };

  const statusColors = {
    online: "text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50/90 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-[#1a3821] dark:border-[#265330] dark:text-emerald-400",
    syncing: "text-blue-700 bg-blue-50/90 border-blue-200 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:border-[#444446] dark:text-[#8ab4f8]",
    offline: "text-red-700 bg-red-50/90 border-red-200 dark:bg-[#3b1a1a] dark:border-[#5c2424] dark:text-red-400",
  };

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-[#333336] py-2 px-3 sm:px-4 mb-2.5 rounded-t-xl transition-all min-w-0 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 sm:gap-3">
      {/* Left: Brand Identity & Menu */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-2.5 min-w-0 shrink">
        <div ref={menuRef} className="relative shrink-0">
          <button
            title="Menu"
            onClick={() => setIsMenuOpen(!isMenuOpen)}
            className="h-8 w-8 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] rounded-lg transition-colors outline-none cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
          >
            <Menu className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>

          <HeaderMenuDrawer
            isMenuOpen={isMenuOpen}
            setIsMenuOpen={setIsMenuOpen}
            currentUser={currentUser}
            activeTab={activeTab}
            onTabChange={onTabChange}
            onLoginClick={onLoginClick}
            onLogoutClick={onLogoutClick}
            onToggleTheme={onToggleTheme}
            theme={theme}
            canWriteImportCsv={canWriteImportCsv}
            isPrintPreview={isPrintPreview}
            onPrintPreviewToggle={onPrintPreviewToggle}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Japanese Takashimaya Logo */}
        <div className="w-8 h-8 sm:w-8.5 sm:h-8.5 bg-white dark:bg-[#28282a] border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xs shrink-0 transition-colors">
          <svg
            className="w-5.5 h-5.5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6 text-red-600 dark:text-red-500"
            viewBox="0 0 100 100"
            fill="currentColor"
          >
            <circle
              cx="50"
              cy="50"
              r="45"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="8"
            />
            <text
              x="50"
              y="65"
              fontFamily="Arial"
              fontSize="50"
              textAnchor="middle"
              fill="currentColor"
              fontWeight="bold"
            >
              高
            </text>
          </svg>
        </div>

        {/* Title & Status Badge Lockup */}
        <div className="min-w-0 flex flex-col justify-center shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-1.5 min-w-0">
            <h1 className="text-xs sm:text-sm md:text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#f3f3f3] leading-tight shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap">
              T-Project
            </h1>
            <span
              className={cn(
                "text-[10px] uppercase font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md border hidden md:inline-flex items-center gap-1",
                statusColors[cloudStatus],
              )}
            >
              <span className={cn(
                "w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full",
                cloudStatus === "online" ? "bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" : cloudStatus === "syncing" ? "bg-blue-500 animate-pulse" : "bg-red-500"
              )} />
              {cloudStatus === "online"
                ? t("Cloud Online")
                : cloudStatus === "syncing"
                  ? t("Syncing...")
                  : t("Offline")}
            </span>
            <span
              className={cn(
                "w-2 h-2 rounded-full md:hidden shrink-0",
                cloudStatus === "online"
                  ? "bg-emerald-500"
                  : cloudStatus === "syncing"
                    ? "bg-blue-500"
                    : "bg-red-500",
              )}
              title={`Cloud status: ${cloudStatus}`}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5 min-w-0">
            <span
              className={cn(
                "px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider",
                currentUser.role === "admin"
                  ? "bg-blue-600 text-white"
                  : currentUser.role === "user"
                    ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white dark:bg-emerald-700"
                    : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3]",
              )}
            >
              {currentUser.role === "admin"
                ? t("ADMIN")
                : String(currentUser.username || t("GUEST")).toUpperCase()}
            </span>
            <span className="hidden xl:inline text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400 dark:text-[#838383]">
              • {t("Cloud Sync Enabled")}
            </span>

            {/* Active Child Tab Indicator on iPad/Tablet */}
            {(() => {
              const tabInfoMap: Partial<Record<TabId, { label: string; icon: React.ElementType }>> = {
                calendar: { label: t("Calendar"), icon: Calendar },
                gantt: { label: t("Gantt"), icon: BarChartHorizontal },
                layout: { label: "Layout", icon: LayoutDashboard },
                summary: { label: t("Summary"), icon: FileText },
                general: { label: t("General"), icon: LayoutDashboard },
                detail: { label: t("Task detail"), icon: List },
                budget: { label: t("Budget"), icon: PieChart },
                taskDelegation: { label: t("Delegation"), icon: List },
                taskDelegationCalendar: { label: t("Del. Calendar"), icon: Calendar },
                cost: { label: t("Cost"), icon: DollarSign },
                accControl: { label: t("Access"), icon: Shield },
                audit: { label: "Audit Log", icon: Shield },
                notification: { label: t("Notifs"), icon: Bell },
                setting: { label: t("Settings"), icon: Settings },
                manual: { label: t("Manual"), icon: HelpCircle },
              };
              const currentTabInfo = tabInfoMap[activeTab];
              if (!currentTabInfo) return null;
              const ActiveIcon = currentTabInfo.icon;
              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onTabChange(activeTab)}
                  className="hidden sm:inline-flex lg:hidden px-2 py-0.2 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white dark:bg-blue-500 dark:hover:bg-blue-600 shadow-2xs items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer select-none shrink-0"
                  title={`Active tab: ${currentTabInfo.label}`}
                >
                  <ActiveIcon className="w-2.5 h-2.5 shrink-0 text-white" />
                  <span className="font-extrabold tracking-wide whitespace-nowrap">
                    On {currentTabInfo.label}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })()}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Header Controls Group (Always visible on Mobile, iPad & Desktop) */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-1.5 shrink-0 ml-auto">
          {/* Undo and Redo Controls */}
          <HeaderUndoRedoControls
            onUndo={onUndo}
            canUndo={canUndo}
            hasDataToUndo={hasDataToUndo}
            undoDescription={undoDescription}
            onRedo={onRedo}
            canRedo={canRedo}
            hasDataToRedo={hasDataToRedo}
            redoDescription={redoDescription}
          />

          {/* Currency Selector (Visible on Main Header) */}
          <button 
            onClick={handleCurrencyClick}
            onContextMenu={handleCurrencyContextMenu}
            className="h-8 px-2 sm:px-2.5 min-w-[50px] sm:min-w-[64px] bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#c3c3c3] rounded-lg transition-colors border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-2xs text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold font-mono flex items-center justify-center active:scale-95 touch-manipulation shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
            title={
              currency === 'VND'
                ? (currentUser.role === 'admin' ? "Currency: '000 VND (Right-click to set exchange rates)" : "Currency: '000 VND")
                : (currentUser.role === 'admin'
                    ? `Currency: ${currency} (1 ${currency} = ${currency === 'JPY' ? jpyRate.toLocaleString('en-US') : usdRate.toLocaleString('en-US')} VND - Right-click to set exchange rates)`
                    : `Currency: ${currency} (1 ${currency} = ${currency === 'JPY' ? jpyRate.toLocaleString('en-US') : usdRate.toLocaleString('en-US')} VND)`
                  )
            }
          >
            {currency === 'VND' ? "'000 VND" : currency === 'JPY' ? '万円' : 'USD'}
          </button>

          {/* QR Scanner Button */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsQRScannerOpen(true)}
            className="h-8 w-8 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded-lg transition-colors border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-2xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
            title="Scan QR Code"
          >
            <ScanQrCode className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>

          {/* Notification Bell */}
          <button
            onClick={() => onTabChange("notification")}
            className="relative h-8 w-8 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#28282a] hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300 rounded-lg transition-colors focus:outline-none shrink-0"
            title="Notifications"
          >
            <Bell className="w-4.5 h-4.5" />
            {notificationCount > 0 && (
              <span className="absolute top-1 right-1 w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full border border-white dark:border-[#1e1e20] text-[8px] font-bold text-white flex items-center justify-center">
                {notificationCount > 9 ? "9+" : notificationCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Right: Quick Access & Controls Toolbar */}
      <div className="hidden md:flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5 shrink-0 ml-auto min-w-0">
        {showQuickAccessToolbar && (
          <>
            {/* Search Command Palette */}
            <button
              onClick={() => useAppStore.getState().setIsCommandPaletteOpen(true)}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-2xs text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation flex items-center gap-1.5"
              title="Open Command Palette (Ctrl+K)"
            >
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
              <span className="hidden lg:inline font-medium">Search...</span>
              <kbd className="hidden xl:inline-block text-[9px] font-mono font-bold bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] px-1 py-0.2 rounded text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]">
                ⌘K
              </kbd>
            </button>

            {/* Currency Rates Indicator */}
            {currency === 'JPY' && (
              <span className="h-8 px-2 text-[11px] font-mono font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-[#28282a]/60 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#444446]/60 rounded-lg hidden 2xl:flex items-center whitespace-nowrap">
                1 JPY = {jpyRate.toLocaleString('en-US')} VND
              </span>
            )}
            {currency === 'USD' && (
              <span className="h-8 px-2 text-[11px] font-mono font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-[#28282a]/60 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#444446]/60 rounded-lg hidden 2xl:flex items-center whitespace-nowrap">
                1 USD = {usdRate.toLocaleString('en-US')} VND
              </span>
            )}

            {/* Read-only Lock Indicator */}
            {currency !== 'VND' && (
              <span 
                title={`Converted to ${currency}. Switch to VND to edit numbers.`}
                className="h-8 px-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-lg bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 shadow-2xs shrink-0 cursor-default"
              >
                <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span className="hidden xl:inline">Read-only</span>
              </span>
            )}

            {/* Theme Toggle */}
            {onToggleTheme && (
              <button
                onClick={onToggleTheme}
                className="h-8 w-8 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] rounded-lg transition-colors border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-2xs active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
                title="Toggle Theme"
              >
                {theme === "dark" ? <Sun className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Moon className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Language Switcher */}
            <button onClick={() => setLanguage(language === 'en' ? 'ja' : 'en')}
              className="h-8 px-2 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] dark:hover:bg-[#333336] rounded-lg transition-colors border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] shadow-2xs active:scale-95 touch-manipulation flex items-center justify-center"
              title="Toggle Language"
            >
              {language === 'en' ? (
                <span className="text-sm leading-none" role="img" aria-label="English">🇬🇧</span>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-sm leading-none" role="img" aria-label="Japanese">🇯🇵</span>
              )}
            </button>

            {/* Realtime Clock Widget */}
            <div 
              title={`Today: ${formatFullTime(currentTime)}`}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold border border-blue-100 dark:border-[#444446] hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs transition-colors shrink-0 select-none whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]" />
              <span>{formatCompactTime(currentTime)}</span>
            </div>

            {/* Ribbon Display Options on Header */}
            <RibbonDisplayMenu variant="header" className="hidden lg:inline-flex shrink-0" />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      {isQRScannerOpen && (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <QRScannerModal 
            isOpen={isQRScannerOpen} 
            onClose={() => setIsQRScannerOpen(false)} 
            onScan={(url) => {
              if (!url) return;
              setIsQRScannerOpen(false);
              if (onDeepLink) {
                onDeepLink(url);
              } else {
                window.location.href = url;
              }
            }} 
          />
        </Suspense>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/HeaderParts/HeaderMenuDrawer.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Settings, Calendar, SlidersHorizontal, Sun, Moon, Upload, Download, ShieldAlert, Printer } from 'lucide-react';
import { AppUser, TabId } from '../../types';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';

interface HeaderMenuDrawerProps {
  isMenuOpen: boolean;
  setIsMenuOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  currentUser: AppUser;
  activeTab: TabId;
  onTabChange: (tab: TabId) => void;
  onLoginClick: () => void;
  onLogoutClick: () => void;
  onToggleTheme?: () => void;
  theme: 'light' | 'dark';
  canWriteImportCsv?: boolean;
  isPrintPreview?: boolean;
  onPrintPreviewToggle?: () => void;
}

export function HeaderMenuDrawer({
  isMenuOpen,
  setIsMenuOpen,
  currentUser,
  activeTab,
  onTabChange,
  onLoginClick,
  onLogoutClick,
  onToggleTheme,
  theme,
  canWriteImportCsv = false,
  isPrintPreview = false,
  onPrintPreviewToggle,
}: HeaderMenuDrawerProps) {
  const { language, setLanguage, t } = useLanguage();

  const ganttViewMode = useAppStore((state) => state.ganttViewMode);
  const setGanttViewMode = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttViewMode);
  const ganttDayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.ganttDayWidth);
  const setGanttDayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttDayWidth);
  const ganttScaleInput = useAppStore((state) => state.ganttScaleInput);
  const setGanttScaleInput = useAppStore((state) => state.setGanttScaleInput);
  const isGanttWidthChanged = useAppStore((state) => state.isGanttWidthChanged);
  const setIsGanttWidthChanged = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsGanttWidthChanged);
  const saveGanttDayWidth = useAppStore((state) => state.saveGanttDayWidth);

  if (!isMenuOpen) return null;

  return (
    <>
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 z-[9998] bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-[0.5px]"
        onClick={() => setIsMenuOpen(false)}
      />
      <div className="absolute top-10 left-0 w-64 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-2xl z-[9999] overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
        <div className="py-1.5">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              if (currentUser.role === 'guest') onLoginClick();
              else onLogoutClick();
              setIsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-bold hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] mb-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span
              className={cn(
                'w-2 h-2 rounded-full',
                currentUser.role === 'guest'
                  ? 'bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-600'
                  : 'bg-emerald-500'
              )}
            />
            {currentUser.role === 'guest' ? t('Login') : t('Logout')}
          </button>

          {currentUser.role !== 'guest' && (
            <button
              title={t('Settings')}
              onClick={() => {
                onTabChange('setting');
                setIsMenuOpen(false);
              }}
              className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] mb-1 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Settings className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3]" />
              {t('Settings')}
            </button>
          )}

          {currentUser.role !== 'guest' && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                onTabChange('accControl');
                setIsMenuOpen(false);
              }}
              className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] cursor-pointer"
            >
              {t('Acc control')}
            </button>
          )}

          {currentUser.role === 'admin' && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                onTabChange('audit');
                setIsMenuOpen(false);
              }}
              className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] cursor-pointer"
            >
              Audit Log
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              useAppStore.getState().setIsCalendarSyncModalOpen(true);
              setIsMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" />
            <span>Đồng bộ Apple Calendar (iOS)</span>
          </button>

          {/* Quick Utilities in Hamburger Menu */}
          <div className="py-2 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446]">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 px-3 py-1">
              {onToggleTheme && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    onToggleTheme();
                    setIsMenuOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {theme === 'dark' ? (
                    <Sun className="w-4 h-4 mb-1 text-amber-500" />
                  ) : (
                    <Moon className="w-4 h-4 mb-1 text-slate-600" />
                  )}
                  <span>{theme === 'dark' ? 'Light Mode' : 'Dark Mode'}</span>
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setLanguage(language === 'en' ? 'ja' : 'en');
                  setIsMenuOpen(false);
                }}
                className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#28282a] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#333336] text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span className="text-base leading-none mb-1">
                  {language === 'en' ? '🇬🇧' : '🇯🇵'}
                </span>
                <span>{language === 'en' ? 'English' : '日本語'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Gantt View & Scale Controls (ONLY shown when activeTab === 'gantt') */}
            {activeTab === 'gantt' && (
              <div className="mt-2 px-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] flex flex-col gap-2.5">
                {/* VIEW Switch */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">
                  <span className="uppercase text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-bold">
                    {t('VIEW')}
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        const nextMode =
                          ganttViewMode === 'monthly'
                            ? 'weekly'
                            : ganttViewMode === 'weekly'
                            ? 'quarterly'
                            : 'monthly';
                        setGanttViewMode(nextMode);
                      }}
                      className="relative inline-flex h-5 w-10 items-center rounded-full bg-blue-600 transition-colors focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <span
                        className={cn(
                          'inline-block h-3.5 w-3.5 transform rounded-full bg-white transition-transform',
                          ganttViewMode === 'monthly'
                            ? 'translate-x-5.5'
                            : ganttViewMode === 'weekly'
                            ? 'translate-x-3'
                            : 'translate-x-0.5'
                        )}
                      />
                    </button>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] capitalize min-w-[55px] text-right">
                      {ganttViewMode}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* SCALE Controls */}
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3]">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="uppercase text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-bold">
                      {t('SCALE')}
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        max="150"
                        value={ganttScaleInput}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          const val = e.target.value;
                          setGanttScaleInput(val);
                          const num = Number(val);
                          if (!isNaN(num) && num >= 0 && num <= 150) {
                            const calculatedDayWidth =
                              num === 0
                                ? 0.6
                                : Math.max(
                                    0.6,
                                    Math.round((num / 75) * 8 * 10) / 10
                                  );
                            setGanttDayWidth(calculatedDayWidth);
                            setIsGanttWidthChanged(true);
                          }
                        }}
                        className="w-12 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-center font-mono font-bold bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1c1c1e] border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#444446] text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded outline-none"
                      />
                      <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-[#a3a3a3] font-bold">
                        %
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="range"
                      min="0.6"
                      max="20"
                      step="0.2"
                      value={ganttDayWidth}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const num = Number(e.target.value);
                        setGanttDayWidth(num);
                        setGanttScaleInput(
                          String(Math.round((num / 8) * 75))
                        );
                        setIsGanttWidthChanged(true);
                      }}
                      className="flex-1 h-1.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-blue-500"
                    />
                    {isGanttWidthChanged && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={saveGanttDayWidth}
                        className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-white bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 rounded shadow-2xs cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                      >
                        Save
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {activeTab === 'layout' && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setIsMenuOpen(false);
                setTimeout(() => {
                  window.dispatchEvent(
                    new CustomEvent('open-layout-edit-mode')
                  );
                }, 50);
              }}
              className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-purple-50 dark:hover:bg-purple-950/30 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#444446] cursor-pointer"
            >
              <SlidersHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
              <span className="font-semibold text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300">
                Edit Mode
              </span>
            </button>
          )}

          {currentUser.role !== 'guest' && activeTab === 'detail' && (
            <>
              {canWriteImportCsv && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    document.getElementById('detail-import-projects-input')?.click();
                    setIsMenuOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                  Import Project
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  document.getElementById('detail-export-projects-btn')?.click();
                  setIsMenuOpen(false);
                }}
                className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-[#e3e3e3] font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#333336]/50 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                Export Project
              </button>
              {currentUser.role === 'admin' && (
                <button
