/* ==================== FILE: src/components/HeaderParts/HeaderUndoRedoControls.tsx ==================== */
import { Undo2, Redo2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useLanguage } from '../../lib/LanguageContext';

export interface HeaderUndoRedoControlsProps {
  onUndo?: () => void;
  canUndo?: boolean;
  hasDataToUndo?: boolean;
  undoDescription?: string;
  onRedo?: () => void;
  canRedo?: boolean;
  hasDataToRedo?: boolean;
  redoDescription?: string;
}

export const HeaderUndoRedoControls: React.FC<HeaderUndoRedoControlsProps> = ({
  onUndo,
  canUndo = false,
  hasDataToUndo = false,
  undoDescription,
  onRedo,
  canRedo = false,
  hasDataToRedo = false,
  redoDescription,
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  if (!onUndo && !onRedo) return null;

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
      {onUndo && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onUndo}
          disabled={!canUndo && !hasDataToUndo}
          title={undoDescription || t('Undo last action')}
          className={cn(
            'px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation',
            canUndo || hasDataToUndo
              ? 'bg-amber-100 hover:bg-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/80 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700'
              : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
          )}
        >
          <Undo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span className="hidden md:inline">{t('Undo')}</span>
        </button>
      )}

      {onRedo && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRedo}
          disabled={!canRedo && !hasDataToRedo}
          title={redoDescription || t('Redo last action')}
          className={cn(
            'px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation',
            canRedo || hasDataToRedo
              ? 'bg-blue-100 hover:bg-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/80 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700'
              : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#28282a] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
          )}
        >
          <Redo2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span className="hidden md:inline">{t('Redo')}</span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default HeaderUndoRedoControls;

export interface LayoutTabProps {

  initialProjectCode?: string;

  onBackToGantt?: () => void;
}

export function LayoutTab({ 
  initialStore: propInitialStore,
  initialLocation: propInitialLocation,
  initialProjectCode: propInitialProjectCode,
  onClearFocus,
  onBackToGantt
}: LayoutTabProps) {

    targetUnitSearch,
    setTargetUnitSearch,
    showSuggestions,
    setShowSuggestions,
    searchContainerRef,
    filteredUnitSuggestions,
    handleSelectSearchUnit,
    handleClearSearchAndFocus,
    isFullscreenView,
    setIsFullscreenView,
  } = useLayoutTabData({

    propInitialProjectCode,

  });

          onUnitSelected={undefined}
          onClearFocus={handleClearSearchAndFocus}
          isLiveMapMode={isLiveMapMode}
          url={url}
          getCleanUrl={getCleanUrl}
          fallbackSvg={fallbackSvg}
          isEditing={isEditing}
          setIsEditing={setIsEditing}
        />
      )}

      <div className="flex-grow flex flex-col p-2.5 sm:p-4 md:p-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 relative h-full print:p-0 print:m-0 print:bg-white print:border-none print:shadow-none">
        <LayoutTabFilterToolbar
          activeStore={activeStore}
          allowedStores={allowedStores}
          setGlobalStoreFilter={setGlobalStoreFilter}
          locFilterStr={locFilterStr}
          availableLocations={availableLocations}
          setGlobalLocationFilter={setGlobalLocationFilter}
          effectiveYear={effectiveYear}
          availableYears={availableYears}
          setGlobalYearFilter={setGlobalYearFilter}
          onBackToGantt={onBackToGantt}
          isLiveMapMode={isLiveMapMode}
          setIsLiveMapMode={setIsLiveMapMode}
          onRefresh={() => setCacheBuster(Date.now())}
          canWrite={canWrite}
          isExporting={isExporting}
          exportStatusMessage={exportStatusMessage}
          onTriggerReExport={handleTriggerReExport}
          isAdmin={isAdmin}
          isEditing={isEditing}
          setIsEditing={setIsEditing}
          editUrl={editUrl}
          setEditUrl={setEditUrl}
          url={url}
          onSaveUrl={handleSave}
          unitSearchInput={unitSearchInput}

          setTargetUnitSearch={setTargetUnitSearch}

          setShowSuggestions={setShowSuggestions}
          searchContainerRef={searchContainerRef}
          filteredUnitSuggestions={filteredUnitSuggestions}
          onSelectSearchUnit={handleSelectSearchUnit}
          onClearSearchAndFocus={handleClearSearchAndFocus}
        />

        <div className="flex-grow flex w-full min-h-[460px] h-[calc(100dvh-175px)] sm:h-[calc(100vh-195px)] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 rounded-2xl shadow-inner border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden relative print:h-[100vh] print:w-full print:min-h-0 print:border-none print:shadow-none print:rounded-none print:bg-white">

          ) : isLiveMapMode ? (

import React from 'react';
import { Palette, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

export interface LayoutBottomActionBarProps {
  hoverInfo: any;
  layoutTooltipVisibility: any;
  activeGroups: any[];
  totalFloorAlerts: number;
  filterOnlyAlerts: boolean;
  setFilterOnlyAlerts: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  onOpenLegendModal: () => void;
}

export const LayoutBottomActionBar: React.FC<LayoutBottomActionBarProps> = React.memo(({
  hoverInfo,
  layoutTooltipVisibility,
  activeGroups,
  totalFloorAlerts,
  filterOnlyAlerts,
  setFilterOnlyAlerts,
  onOpenLegendModal,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className={`absolute bottom-3 sm:bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20 flex items-center gap-2 transition-all duration-150 hide-on-actual-print print:hidden ${hoverInfo?.visible ? 'max-sm:opacity-0 max-sm:pointer-events-none' : 'opacity-100'}`}>
      <button 
        onClick={onOpenLegendModal} 
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 sm:px-3.5 py-1.5 sm:py-2 backdrop-blur-md border shadow-xl rounded-full text-xs font-bold active:scale-95 touch-manipulation transition-all whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer",
          layoutTooltipVisibility?.legendColor !== false
            ? "bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white border-purple-500"
            : "bg-slate-700/90 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-200 border-slate-600"
        )}
      >
        <Palette className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4" /> 
        <span>Color Legend</span>
        {layoutTooltipVisibility?.legendColor !== false && activeGroups.length > 0 && (
          <span className="bg-white/25 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono">
            {activeGroups.length}
          </span>
        )}
        {layoutTooltipVisibility?.legendColor === false && (
          <span className="bg-black/30 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[9px] font-medium text-slate-300">
            Off
          </span>
        )}
      </button>

      {totalFloorAlerts > 0 && (
        <button
          onClick={() => setFilterOnlyAlerts(prev => !prev)}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 sm:px-3.5 py-1.5 sm:py-2 backdrop-blur-md border shadow-xl rounded-full text-xs font-bold active:scale-95 touch-manipulation transition-all whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer",
            filterOnlyAlerts
              ? "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white border-red-500 shadow-red-500/20 ring-2 ring-red-400"
              : "bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-800/95 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/60"
          )}
          title={filterOnlyAlerts ? "Click to show all units" : "Highlight only units with active alerts"}
        >
          <AlertTriangle className={cn("w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4", filterOnlyAlerts ? "text-white" : "text-red-500 animate-pulse")} />
          <span>{filterOnlyAlerts ? "Show All" : "Focus Alerts"}</span>
          <span className={cn(
            "px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold",
            filterOnlyAlerts ? "bg-white/25 text-white" : "bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/60 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300"
          )}>
            {totalFloorAlerts}
          </span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

  touchStateRef: React.MutableRefObject<any>;
  pendingTouchRef: React.MutableRefObject<any>;
  rafTouchIdRef: React.MutableRefObject<number | null>;
  isInteractingRef: React.MutableRefObject<boolean>;
  fitToScreen: (animated?: boolean) => void;
  lastWheelPointerRef: React.MutableRefObject<any>;
  pendingWheelDeltaRef: React.MutableRefObject<number>;
  rafWheelIdRef: React.MutableRefObject<number | null>;
  wheelTimeoutRef: React.MutableRefObject<NodeJS.Timeout | null>;
  bgImage: any;
  version: any;
  visibleUnits: any[];
  layoutTooltipVisibility: any;
  focusedUnitId: string | null;
  selectedLegendGroupId: string | null;
  getContrastStyle: (color: string) => ContrastStyle;
  aggregatedData: Record<string, any>;
  focusedUnit: any;
  handleMouseEnterUnit: (unit: any, e: any) => void;
  handleMouseMoveUnit: (unit: any, e: any) => void;
  handleMouseLeaveUnit: (unit: any, e: any) => void;
  handleClickUnit: (unit: any, e: any) => void;
  handleTapUnit: (unit: any, e: any) => void;
  hasStoredUnitImages: (key: string | undefined | null, store?: string) => boolean;
  storeFilter?: string;
}

export const LayoutCanvasViewport: React.FC<LayoutCanvasViewportProps> = React.memo(({
  containerRef,
  stageRef,
  dimensions,
  stageScale,
  setStageScale,
  stagePos,
  setStagePos,
  pixelRatio,
  isProjectModalOpen,
  miniGanttProject,
  handleDragStart,
  handleDragMove,
  handleDragEnd,
  stopInertia,
  isPinnedRef,
  setHoverInfo,
  touchStateRef,
  pendingTouchRef,
  rafTouchIdRef,
  isInteractingRef,
  fitToScreen,
  lastWheelPointerRef,
  pendingWheelDeltaRef,
  rafWheelIdRef,
  wheelTimeoutRef,
  bgImage,
  version,
  visibleUnits,
  layoutTooltipVisibility,
  focusedUnitId,
  selectedLegendGroupId,
  getContrastStyle,
  aggregatedData,
  focusedUnit,
  handleMouseEnterUnit,
  handleMouseMoveUnit,
  handleMouseLeaveUnit,
  handleClickUnit,
  handleTapUnit,
  hasStoredUnitImages,
  storeFilter,
}) => {
  return (
    <div 
      id="live-layout-canvas-container"
      ref={containerRef} 
      className="flex-grow w-full h-full relative cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing"
      style={{ touchAction: 'none' }}
    >
      <Stage 
        ref={stageRef} 
        width={dimensions.width} 
        height={dimensions.height}
        scaleX={stageScale}
        scaleY={stageScale}
        x={stagePos.x}
        y={stagePos.y}
        pixelRatio={pixelRatio}
        draggable={!isProjectModalOpen && !miniGanttProject}
        style={{ touchAction: 'none', userSelect: 'none', WebkitUserSelect: 'none' }}
        onDragStart={handleDragStart}
        onDragMove={handleDragMove}
        onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
        onClick={(e) => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
          stopInertia();
          if (e.target === stageRef.current) {
            isPinnedRef.current = false;
            setHoverInfo(null);
          }
        }}
        onTap={(e) => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
          stopInertia();
          if (e.target === stageRef.current) {
            isPinnedRef.current = false;
            setHoverInfo(null);
          }
        }}
        onDblClick={() => {
          if (isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
          stopInertia();
          const stage = stageRef.current;
          if (!stage) return;
          const pointer = stage.getPointerPosition();
          if (!pointer) return;
          const oldScale = stage.scaleX();
          const newScale = oldScale > 2.5 ? Math.max(0.1, oldScale / 2.2) : Math.min(20, oldScale * 2.2);
          const mousePointTo = {
            x: (pointer.x - stage.x()) / oldScale,
            y: (pointer.y - stage.y()) / oldScale,
          };
          const newPos = {
            x: pointer.x - mousePointTo.x * newScale,
            y: pointer.y - mousePointTo.y * newScale,
          };
          stage.to({
            scaleX: newScale,
            scaleY: newScale,
            x: newPos.x,
            y: newPos.y,
            duration: 0.22,
            easing: (window as any).Konva?.Easings?.EaseOut,
            onFinish: () => {
              setStageScale(newScale);
              setStagePos(newPos);
            }
          });
        }}
        onTouchStart={(e) => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
          stopInertia();
          if (e.evt.touches.length === 2) {
            const touch1 = e.evt.touches[0];
            const touch2 = e.evt.touches[1];
            const dist = Math.hypot(touch1.clientX - touch2.clientX, touch1.clientY - touch2.clientY);
            const center = {
              x: (touch1.clientX + touch2.clientX) / 2,
              y: (touch1.clientY + touch2.clientY) / 2,
            };
            touchStateRef.current = { lastDist: dist, lastCenter: center, lastTap: 0 };
            const stage = stageRef.current;
            if (stage) stage.draggable(false);
            isInteractingRef.current = true;
            setHoverInfo(null);
          } else if (e.evt.touches.length === 1) {
            const now = Date.now();
            if (now - touchStateRef.current.lastTap < 300) {
              fitToScreen(true);
              touchStateRef.current.lastTap = 0;
            } else {
              touchStateRef.current.lastTap = now;
            }
          }
        }}
        onTouchMove={(e) => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (e.evt.touches.length === 2) {
            e.evt.preventDefault();
            const touch1 = e.evt.touches[0];
            const touch2 = e.evt.touches[1];
            const dist = Math.hypot(touch1.clientX - touch2.clientX, touch1.clientY - touch2.clientY);
            const center = {
              x: (touch1.clientX + touch2.clientX) / 2,
              y: (touch1.clientY + touch2.clientY) / 2,
            };
            pendingTouchRef.current = { dist, center };

            if (rafTouchIdRef.current === null) {
              rafTouchIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                rafTouchIdRef.current = null;
                if (!pendingTouchRef.current) return;
                const { dist: curDist, center: curCenter } = pendingTouchRef.current;
                const { lastDist, lastCenter } = touchStateRef.current;
                const stage = stageRef.current;
                if (stage && lastDist > 0 && lastCenter) {
                  const oldScale = stage.scaleX();
                  const scaleDelta = curDist / lastDist;
                  const newScale = Math.max(0.04, Math.min(oldScale * scaleDelta, 20));
                  
                  const stageBox = stage.container().getBoundingClientRect();
                  const lastPointerX = lastCenter.x - stageBox.left;
                  const lastPointerY = lastCenter.y - stageBox.top;
                  const currentPointerX = curCenter.x - stageBox.left;
                  const currentPointerY = curCenter.y - stageBox.top;

                  const worldPointX = (lastPointerX - stage.x()) / oldScale;
                  const worldPointY = (lastPointerY - stage.y()) / oldScale;

                  const newPos = {
                    x: currentPointerX - worldPointX * newScale,
                    y: currentPointerY - worldPointY * newScale,
                  };

                  stage.scale({ x: newScale, y: newScale });
                  stage.position(newPos);
                  stage.batchDraw();

                  touchStateRef.current.lastDist = curDist;
                  touchStateRef.current.lastCenter = curCenter;
                }
              });
            }
          }
        }}
        onTouchEnd={() => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (rafTouchIdRef.current !== null) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(rafTouchIdRef.current);
            rafTouchIdRef.current = null;
          }
          pendingTouchRef.current = null;
          touchStateRef.current.lastDist = 0;
          touchStateRef.current.lastCenter = null;
          const stage = stageRef.current;
          if (stage) {
            stage.draggable(true);
            setStageScale(stage.scaleX());
            setStagePos({ x: stage.x(), y: stage.y() });
          }
          isInteractingRef.current = false;
        }}
        onWheel={(e) => {
          if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) return;
          if (isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
          e.evt.preventDefault();
          stopInertia();
          const stage = stageRef.current;
          if (!stage) return;
          
          isInteractingRef.current = true;
          setHoverInfo(null);

          const pointer = stage.getPointerPosition();
          if (!pointer) return;

          lastWheelPointerRef.current = pointer;
          pendingWheelDeltaRef.current += e.evt.deltaY;

          if (rafWheelIdRef.current === null) {
            rafWheelIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
              rafWheelIdRef.current = null;
              const currentStage = stageRef.current;
              const ptr = lastWheelPointerRef.current;
              if (!currentStage || !ptr) return;

              const deltaY = pendingWheelDeltaRef.current;
              pendingWheelDeltaRef.current = 0;

              const oldScale = currentStage.scaleX();
              const zoomFactor = Math.exp(-deltaY * 0.0008);
              const newScale = Math.max(0.04, Math.min(oldScale * zoomFactor, 20));

              const mousePointTo = {
                x: (ptr.x - currentStage.x()) / oldScale,
                y: (ptr.y - currentStage.y()) / oldScale,
              };

              const newPos = {
                x: ptr.x - mousePointTo.x * newScale,
                y: ptr.y - mousePointTo.y * newScale,
              };

              currentStage.scale({ x: newScale, y: newScale });
              currentStage.position(newPos);
              currentStage.batchDraw();

              if (wheelTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(wheelTimeoutRef.current);
              wheelTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
                setStageScale(currentStage.scaleX());
                setStagePos({ x: currentStage.x(), y: currentStage.y() });
                isInteractingRef.current = false;
              }, 120);
            });
          }
        }}
      >
        <LayoutKonvaLayers
          bgImage={bgImage}
          version={version}
          visibleUnits={visibleUnits}
          layoutTooltipVisibility={layoutTooltipVisibility}
          focusedUnitId={focusedUnitId}
          selectedLegendGroupId={selectedLegendGroupId}
          getContrastStyle={getContrastStyle}
          stageScale={stageScale}
          aggregatedData={aggregatedData}
          focusedUnit={focusedUnit}
          onMouseEnterUnit={handleMouseEnterUnit}
          onMouseMoveUnit={handleMouseMoveUnit}
          onMouseLeaveUnit={handleMouseLeaveUnit}
          onClickUnit={handleClickUnit}
          onTapUnit={handleTapUnit}
          hasStoredUnitImages={hasStoredUnitImages}
          storeFilter={storeFilter}
        />
      </Stage>
    </div>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/LayoutColorLegendBar.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import {
  Palette,
  ChevronUp,
  ChevronDown,
  Download,
  RefreshCw,
  FileText,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Printer,
  GripHorizontal,
  Compass,
  Search,
  X,
  Layers
} from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

export type LegendDockPosition = 'top-right' | 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-left';

export interface LayoutColorLegendBarProps {
  layoutTooltipVisibility: any;
  activeGroups: any[];
  selectedLegendGroupId: string | null;
  setSelectedLegendGroupId: (id: string | null) => void;
  setShowLegendModal?: (show: boolean) => void;
  isLegendStripCollapsed?: boolean;
  setIsLegendStripCollapsed?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  canWrite?: boolean;
  handleTriggerExport?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  isExporting?: boolean;
  exportStatus?: string;
  handleExport?: (type: 'jpeg' | 'pdf') => void;
  setIsPrintPreview?: (show: boolean) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_DOCK_STORAGE_KEY = 'taka_layout_legend_dock_pos';

export const LayoutColorLegendBar: React.FC<LayoutColorLegendBarProps> = React.memo(({
  layoutTooltipVisibility,
  activeGroups,
  selectedLegendGroupId,
  setSelectedLegendGroupId,
  setShowLegendModal,
  isLegendStripCollapsed: propIsCollapsed,
  setIsLegendStripCollapsed: propSetIsCollapsed,
  canWrite = false,
  handleTriggerExport,
  isExporting = false,
  exportStatus = '',
  handleExport,
  setIsPrintPreview,
}) => {
  const [internalCollapsed, setInternalCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [showExportMenu, setShowExportMenu] = useState(false);
  const [groupSearch, setGroupSearch] = useState('');
  const [dockPosition, setDockPosition] = useState<LegendDockPosition>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(DEFAULT_DOCK_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved === 'top-right' || saved === 'bottom-right' || saved === 'bottom-left') {
        return saved;
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
    return 'top-right';
  });

  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const exportMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const isCollapsed = propIsCollapsed !== undefined ? propIsCollapsed : internalCollapsed;
  const toggleCollapsed = () => {
    if (propSetIsCollapsed) {
      propSetIsCollapsed(!isCollapsed);
    } else {
      setInternalCollapsed(prev => !prev);
    }
  };

  const cycleDockPosition = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setDockPosition(prev => {
      let next: LegendDockPosition = 'top-right';
      if (prev === 'top-right') next = 'bottom-right';
      else if (prev === 'bottom-right') next = 'bottom-left';
      else next = 'top-right';
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(DEFAULT_DOCK_STORAGE_KEY, next);
      } catch {
        // Ignore
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Close export menu when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (exportMenuRef.current && !exportMenuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setShowExportMenu(false);
      }
    };
    if (showExportMenu) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [showExportMenu]);

  // Filter active groups based on groupSearch
  const filteredGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (!groupSearch.trim()) return activeGroups;
    const q = groupSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
    return activeGroups.filter(g => g.name?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [activeGroups, groupSearch]);

  if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.legendColor === false) return null;

  // Dock positioning classes
  const dockClasses = {
    'top-right': 'top-14 sm:top-16 right-2.5 sm:right-4',
    'bottom-right': 'bottom-3 sm:bottom-4 right-2.5 sm:right-4',
    'bottom-left': 'bottom-3 sm:bottom-4 left-2.5 sm:left-4',
  }[dockPosition];

  return (
    <Draggable
      handle=".legend-drag-handle"
      cancel="button, input, select, textarea, .no-drag"
      nodeRef={nodeRef}
      bounds="parent"
    >
      <div
        ref={nodeRef}
        className={cn(
          "absolute z-30 pointer-events-auto hide-on-actual-print print:hidden transition-shadow select-none",
          dockClasses,
          isCollapsed ? "max-w-xs" : "w-[300px] sm:w-[340px]"
        )}
      >
        <div className="bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#1a1a1c]/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-[#333336] shadow-2xl p-2 sm:p-2.5 transition-all text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
          {/* Header Bar */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5">
            {/* Grip Handle + Palette Icon + Title */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
              <span
                className="legend-drag-handle p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors shrink-0"
                title="Drag to reposition anywhere on canvas"
              >
                <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={toggleCollapsed}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 p-1 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/80 transition-colors text-left cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation min-w-0"
                title={isCollapsed ? "Expand Color Legend" : "Collapse Color Legend"}
              >
                <span className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/70 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-300 shrink-0 shadow-2xs">
                  <Palette className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4" />
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap">
                  Color Legend
                </span>
                {activeGroups.length > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-extrabold font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-purple-100/90 dark:bg-purple-900/60 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 shrink-0">
                    {activeGroups.length}
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Header Action Tools */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
              {/* Clear Filter Button */}
              {selectedLegendGroupId && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedLegendGroupId(null)}
                  className="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 hover:bg-purple-100 dark:hover:bg-purple-950 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/60 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all whitespace-nowrap"
                  title="Clear active group filter"
                >
                  Clear Filter
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Dock Position Switcher */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={cycleDockPosition}
                className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 active:scale-95"
                title={`Dock Position: ${dockPosition} (Click to switch Top-Right / Bottom-Right / Bottom-Left)`}
              >
                <Compass className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>

              {/* View All Groups Details Modal */}
              {setShowLegendModal && activeGroups.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowLegendModal(true)}
                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 active:scale-95"
                  title="Open full groups modal"
                >
                  <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Export Menu Dropdown */}
              <div className="relative" ref={exportMenuRef}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowExportMenu(prev => !prev)}
                  disabled={isExporting}
                  className={cn(
                    "p-1 rounded-lg transition-all border active:scale-95 cursor-pointer touch-manipulation shrink-0",
                    isExporting
                      ? "bg-amber-500 text-white border-amber-600 animate-pulse"
                      : "bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
                  )}
                  title="Export floor plan or sync"
                >
                  {isExporting ? (
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-white" />
                  ) : (
                    <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                </button>

                {/* Export Dropdown Popover */}
                {showExportMenu && (
                  <div className="absolute top-full right-0 mt-1.5 w-56 bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-2 flex flex-col gap-1 z-40 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
                    <div className="px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                      Export Options
                    </div>

                    {canWrite && handleTriggerExport && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setShowExportMenu(false);
                          handleTriggerExport();
                        }}
                        className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-emerald-950/40 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                      >
                        <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 text-emerald-600" />
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-bold">Sync to Cloud R2</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-normal">Auto-sync all floor layouts</div>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    )}

                    {handleExport && (
                      <>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setShowExportMenu(false);
                            handleExport('jpeg');
                          }}
                          className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                        >
                          <ImageIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 text-blue-500" />
                          <div>
                            <div className="font-bold">Export Image (JPEG)</div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-normal">High-resolution layout capture</div>
                          </div>
                        </button>

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setShowExportMenu(false);
                            handleExport('pdf');
                          }}
                          className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                        >
                          <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 text-rose-500" />
                          <div>
                            <div className="font-bold">Export PDF</div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-normal">Architectural A3/A4 document</div>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                      </>
                    )}

                    {setIsPrintPreview && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setShowExportMenu(false);
                          setIsPrintPreview(true);
                        }}
                        className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pt-1.5 active:scale-95"
                      >
                        <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 text-purple-500" />
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-bold">Print Preview</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-normal">Direct blueprint print layout</div>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Collapse / Expand Toggle Button */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={toggleCollapsed}
                className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 active:scale-95"
                title={isCollapsed ? "Expand legend list" : "Collapse legend list"}
              >
                {isCollapsed ? <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Body List (Visible when Expanded) */}
          {!isCollapsed && (
            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 mt-1.5 space-y-2 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
              {/* Optional Search if more than 5 groups */}
              {activeGroups.length > 5 && (
                <div className="relative">
                  <Search className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={groupSearch}
                    onChange={(e) => setGroupSearch(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Search groups..."
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg pl-7 pr-6 py-1 text-[11px] placeholder-slate-400 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-purple-500"
                  />
                  {groupSearch && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setGroupSearch('')}
                      className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Group Swatches */}
              {activeGroups.length === 0 ? (
                /* Default Project Status Legend */
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 shadow-2xs">
                    <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 shrink-0 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-white/50 dark:ring-black/30" />
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">Completed</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 shadow-2xs">
                    <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-blue-500 shrink-0 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-white/50 dark:ring-black/30" />
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">On Process</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 shadow-2xs">
                    <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-500 shrink-0 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-white/50 dark:ring-black/30" />
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">Upcoming</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 shadow-2xs">
                    <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-rose-500 shrink-0 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-white/50 dark:ring-black/30" />
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">Delay</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                /* Custom Classification Groups */
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 max-h-[220px] sm:max-h-[260px] overflow-y-auto pr-0.5 touch-pan-y overscroll-contain">
                  {filteredGroups.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 text-center py-3 italic">
                      No matching groups found
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    filteredGroups.map((g: any) => {
                      const isSelected = selectedLegendGroupId === g.id;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={g.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setSelectedLegendGroupId(isSelected ? null : g.id)}
                          className={cn(
                            "flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition-all border cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation shadow-2xs text-left",
                            isSelected
                              ? "bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/80 border-purple-500 text-purple-950 dark:text-purple-100 ring-2 ring-purple-400/50 font-bold"
                              : "bg-slate-50/90 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/80 border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200"
                          )}
                          title={`Click to ${isSelected ? 'clear highlight' : 'highlight on canvas'} group ${g.name}`}
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                            <span
                              className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full shrink-0 shadow-2xs border border-black/15 ring-1 ring-white/50"
                              style={{ backgroundColor: g.color }}
                            />
                            <span className="truncate text-[11px] font-semibold">
                              {g.name}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 shrink-0">
                            {g.matchCount} {g.matchCount === 1 ? 'unit' : 'units'}
                          </span>
                        </button>
                      );
                    })
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Draggable>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/LayoutColorLegendModal.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { Palette, X, GripHorizontal, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { useOverlayStack } from '../../lib/zIndexManager';

export interface LayoutColorLegendModalProps {
  showLegendModal: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  activeGroups: any[];
  selectedLegendGroupId: string | null;
  setSelectedLegendGroupId: (id: string | null) => void;
}

export const LayoutColorLegendModal: React.FC<LayoutColorLegendModalProps> = ({
  showLegendModal,
  onClose,
  activeGroups,
  selectedLegendGroupId,
  setSelectedLegendGroupId,
}) => {
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const zInfo = useOverlayStack({
    layer: 'MODAL_BASE',
    isOpen: showLegendModal,
    onClose,
    closeOnTabChange: true,
  });

  if (!showLegendModal) return null;

  const content = (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-0 ${zInfo.zClass} bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-3 animate-in fade-in duration-150 hide-on-actual-print print:hidden`}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <Draggable
        handle=".modal-handle"
        cancel="button, input, select, textarea, .no-drag"
        nodeRef={nodeRef}
        bounds="parent"
      >
        <div
          ref={nodeRef}
          className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md p-5 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 shadow-2xl space-y-4 max-h-[85vh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col select-none"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="modal-handle flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-base text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
              <span className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200">
                <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <Palette className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
              <span>Color Legend & Group Inspector</span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Close modal"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Active Groups Section */}
          <div className="space-y-3 flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="text-[11px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 tracking-wider">
                Active Classification Groups ({activeGroups.length})
              </div>
              {selectedLegendGroupId && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSelectedLegendGroupId(null)}
                  className="text-xs text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 hover:underline font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Clear filter
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {activeGroups.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 italic py-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 rounded-xl p-3 text-center border border-dashed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                Map colors currently reflect standard project progress status or have no custom classification groups.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {activeGroups.map((g: any) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedLegendGroupId === g.id;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={g.id}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedLegendGroupId(isSelected ? null : g.id)}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/40 border-purple-400 shadow-sm ring-2 ring-purple-400/40'
                          : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <div
                            className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full shadow-xs border border-black/15 shrink-0"
                            style={{ backgroundColor: g.color }}
                          />
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">
                            {g.name}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          {isSelected && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 flex items-center gap-0.5">
                              <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> Filtered
                            </span>
                          )}
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {g.matchCount} {g.matchCount === 1 ? 'unit' : 'units'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {g.matchedUnits && g.matchedUnits.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">
                          {g.matchedUnits.slice(0, 15).map((u: any) => (
                            <span
                              key={u.id}
                              className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"
                            >
                              {u.name}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                          {g.matchedUnits.length > 15 && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 self-center">
                              +{g.matchedUnits.length - 15} more...
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Footer */}
          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="w-full py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Draggable>
    </div>
  );

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    return createPortal(content, document.body);
  }
  return content;
};

            >

            <button 
              onClick={handleExport}
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition-colors shadow-sm active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
            >
              <Download className="w-4 h-4" /> Export HD Image
            </button>
            {canWrite && (
              <button 
                onClick={() => {
                  onClose();
                  onOpenR2Config();
                }}
                className="col-span-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition-colors border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
              >
                <Settings className="w-4 h-4" /> R2 Storage Config
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    return createPortal(content, document.body);
  }
  return content;
};

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/LayoutKonvaLayers.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { FastLayer, Layer, Image as KonvaImage, Rect, Circle, Path, Line, Text, Group } from 'react-konva';

export interface LayoutKonvaLayersProps {
  bgImage: HTMLImageElement | null;
  version: any;
  visibleUnits: any[];
  layoutTooltipVisibility: any;
  focusedUnitId: string | null;
  selectedLegendGroupId: string | null;
  getContrastStyle: (fillColor: string) => { text: string; shapeStroke: string };
  stageScale: number;
  aggregatedData: Record<string, any>;
  focusedUnit: any;
  onMouseEnterUnit: (unit: any, e: any) => void;
  onMouseMoveUnit: (unit: any, e: any) => void;
  onMouseLeaveUnit: (unit: any, e: any) => void;
  onClickUnit: (unit: any, e: any) => void;
  onTapUnit: (unit: any, e: any) => void;
  hasStoredUnitImages: (codeOrName: string | undefined | null, store?: string) => boolean;
  storeFilter?: string;
}

export const LayoutKonvaLayers: React.FC<LayoutKonvaLayersProps> = React.memo(({
  bgImage,
  version,
  visibleUnits,
  layoutTooltipVisibility,
  focusedUnitId,
  selectedLegendGroupId,
  getContrastStyle,
  stageScale,
  aggregatedData,
  focusedUnit,
  onMouseEnterUnit,
  onMouseMoveUnit,
  onMouseLeaveUnit,
  onClickUnit,
  onTapUnit,
  hasStoredUnitImages,
  storeFilter,
}) => {
  const isDarkMode = typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
  const isLegendColorOn = layoutTooltipVisibility?.legendColor !== false;
  const currentZoom = stageScale || 1;

  return (
    <>
      {/* Layer 1: Static FastLayer for background CAD layout image to bypass hit-graph calculations */}
      <FastLayer listening={false}>
        {bgImage && (
          <KonvaImage
            image={bgImage}
            listening={false}
            perfectDrawEnabled={false}
            x={version.imagePos?.x || 0}
            y={version.imagePos?.y || 0}
            scaleX={version.imageScale || 1}
            scaleY={version.imageScale || 1}
            rotation={version.backgroundRotation || 0}
          />
        )}
      </FastLayer>

      {/* Layer 2: Interactive unit shapes, text, and alert badges */}
      <Layer id="units-interactive-layer">
        {visibleUnits.map((unit: any) => {
          const hasColor = Boolean(unit.targetColor);
          const fillColor = isLegendColorOn && hasColor ? unit.targetColor : "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.001)";
          const isFocused = focusedUnitId === unit.id;
          const isDimmed = isLegendColorOn && hasColor && selectedLegendGroupId !== null && unit.targetGroupId !== selectedLegendGroupId;
          const contrast = isLegendColorOn && hasColor 
            ? getContrastStyle(fillColor) 
            : { text: isDarkMode ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b', shapeStroke: isDarkMode ? 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.35)' : 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.45)' };
          
          const displayOpacity = !isLegendColorOn || !hasColor
            ? (isFocused ? 1.0 : 0.5)
            : (isFocused 
                ? 1.0 
                : isDimmed 
                ? 0.2 
                : Math.max(0.82, unit.targetOpacity ?? 0.85));
          
          const commonProps = {
            id: unit.id,
            fill: fillColor,
            opacity: displayOpacity,
            stroke: isFocused ? '#f59e0b' : (isDimmed ? '#94a3b8' : contrast.shapeStroke),
            strokeWidth: isFocused ? 3 : (hasColor ? 1.5 : 1),
            strokeScaleEnabled: false,
            perfectDrawEnabled: false,
            x: unit.x || 0,
            y: unit.y || 0,
            rotation: unit.rotation || 0,
            onMouseEnter: (e: any) => onMouseEnterUnit(unit, e),
            onMouseMove: (e: any) => onMouseMoveUnit(unit, e),
            onMouseLeave: (e: any) => onMouseLeaveUnit(unit, e),
            onClick: (e: any) => onClickUnit(unit, e),
            onTap: (e: any) => onTapUnit(unit, e),
          };

          // Calculated font size for optimal legibility
          const unitW = unit.textWidth || 100;
          const unitH = unit.textHeight || 30;
          const baseFont = Math.max(10, Math.min(18, Math.round(Math.min(unitW, unitH * 2.2) / 5.5)));
          const dynamicFontSize = Math.max(9, Math.min(22, baseFont / Math.max(0.65, Math.min(currentZoom, 1.8))));

          // Badge placement coordinates
          let badgeX = (unit.textX || unit.x || 0) + (unit.textWidth || unit.width || 100) - 8;
          let badgeY = (unit.textY || unit.y || 0) + 8;
          let imgBadgeX = (unit.textX || unit.x || 0) + 8;
          let imgBadgeY = (unit.textY || unit.y || 0) + 8;
          if (unit.type === 'circle') {
            const r = unit.radius || 20;
            badgeX = (unit.x || 0) + r * 0.6;
            badgeY = (unit.y || 0) - r * 0.6;
            imgBadgeX = (unit.x || 0) - r * 0.6;
            imgBadgeY = (unit.y || 0) - r * 0.6;
          }
          const uCode = String(unit.name || unit.id || unit.code || '').toLowerCase();
          const unitData = (uCode && aggregatedData[uCode]) ? aggregatedData[uCode] : null;
          const hasAlert = Boolean(unitData?.alerts?.hasAlert);
          const hasImage = Boolean(
            unitData?.hasImage || 
            unit.imageUrl || 
            unit.thumbnail || 
            unit.image || 
            hasStoredUnitImages(unit.name, storeFilter) ||
            hasStoredUnitImages(unit.id, storeFilter) ||
            hasStoredUnitImages(unit.code, storeFilter)
          );
          const badgeRadius = Math.max(4.5, Math.min(8.5, 6.5 / Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.4, stageScale || 1))));
          const badgeFontSize = Math.max(6.5, Math.min(10.5, 8.5 / Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.4, stageScale || 1))));
          const imgPathScale = (badgeRadius * 1.3) / 24;

          // Dynamic Level of Detail (LOD) threshold:
          // Only rasterize expensive text & alert badges when zoom level is legible (scale >= 0.22) or if focused
          const showTextAndBadge = isFocused || (stageScale || 1) >= 0.22;

          return (
            <React.Fragment key={unit.id}>
              {unit.type === 'rect' && (
                <Rect {...commonProps} width={unit.width} height={unit.height} cornerRadius={4} />
              )}
              {unit.type === 'circle' && (
                <Circle {...commonProps} radius={unit.radius} />
              )}
              {unit.type === 'polygon' && (
                unit.svgPath ? (
                  <Path {...commonProps} data={unit.svgPath} />
                ) : (
                  <Line {...commonProps} points={unit.points} closed={true} />
                )
              )}

              {hasColor && unit.name && showTextAndBadge && (
                <Text 
                  text={unit.name}
                  x={unit.textX}
                  y={unit.textY}
                  width={unit.textWidth}
                  height={unit.textHeight}
                  rotation={unit.rotation || 0}
                  align="center"
                  verticalAlign="middle"
                  fontSize={dynamicFontSize}
                  fontStyle="bold"
                  fontFamily="system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif"
                  fill={contrast.text}
                  strokeScaleEnabled={false}
                  perfectDrawEnabled={false}
                  wrap="none"
                  ellipsis={true}
                  listening={false}
                />
              )}

              {/* Smart Alert Badge (Rendered ONLY when unit is colored, has real alerts, and LOD permits) */}
              {hasColor && hasAlert && unitData?.alerts && showTextAndBadge && (
                <Group x={badgeX} y={badgeY} listening={false}>
                  <Circle
                    radius={badgeRadius}
                    fill={unitData.alerts.level === 'critical' ? '#ef4444' : '#f59e0b'}
                    stroke="#ffffff"
                    strokeWidth={Math.max(1, 1.5 / Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.4, stageScale || 1)))}
                    strokeScaleEnabled={false}
                    perfectDrawEnabled={false}
                  />
                  <Text
                    text={unitData.alerts.count > 1 ? String(unitData.alerts.count) : '!'}
                    x={-badgeRadius}
                    y={-badgeRadius + 0.5}
                    width={badgeRadius * 2}
                    height={badgeRadius * 2}
                    align="center"
                    verticalAlign="middle"
                    fontSize={badgeFontSize}
                    fontStyle="bold"
                    fill="#ffffff"
                    fontFamily="system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif"
                    strokeScaleEnabled={false}
                    perfectDrawEnabled={false}
                  />
                </Group>
              )}

              {/* Thumbnail / Image Indicator Badge (Rendered when project has attached photos/thumbnails) */}
              {hasImage && showTextAndBadge && (
                <Group x={imgBadgeX} y={imgBadgeY} listening={false}>
                  <Circle
                    radius={badgeRadius}
                    fill="#2563eb"
                    stroke="#ffffff"
                    strokeWidth={Math.max(1, 1.5 / Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.4, stageScale || 1)))}
                    strokeScaleEnabled={false}
                    perfectDrawEnabled={false}
                  />
                  <Path
                    data="M19 3H5c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h14c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V5c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm0 16H5V5h14v14zm-5.04-6.71l-2.75 3.54-1.96-2.36L6.5 17h11l-3.54-4.71z"
                    fill="#ffffff"
                    scaleX={imgPathScale}
                    scaleY={imgPathScale}
                    x={-badgeRadius * 0.65}
                    y={-badgeRadius * 0.65}
                    strokeScaleEnabled={false}
                    perfectDrawEnabled={false}
                  />
                </Group>
              )}
            </React.Fragment>
          );
        })}
      </Layer>

      {/* Layer 3: Dynamic Isolated Overlay Layer for Focused Unit Golden Ring */}
      <Layer id="overlay-highlight-layer" listening={false}>
        {focusedUnit && (
          <Group listening={false}>
            <Rect
              x={(focusedUnit.textX || focusedUnit.x || 0) - 4}
              y={(focusedUnit.textY || focusedUnit.y || 0) - 4}
              width={(focusedUnit.textWidth || focusedUnit.width || 100) + 8}
              height={(focusedUnit.textHeight || focusedUnit.height || 40) + 8}
              stroke="#f59e0b"
              strokeWidth={2.5}
              strokeScaleEnabled={false}
              dash={[6, 4]}
              cornerRadius={6}
              shadowColor="#f59e0b"
              shadowBlur={10}
              shadowOpacity={0.8}
              listening={false}
              perfectDrawEnabled={false}
            />
          </Group>
        )}
      </Layer>
    </>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/LayoutMiniGanttModal.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { BarChartHorizontal, Calendar, Layers } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { useOverlayStack } from '../../lib/zIndexManager';
import { formatMonthDay, useMiniGanttData } from './useMiniGanttData';
import { MiniGanttHeader } from './MiniGanttHeader';
import { MiniGanttRowItem } from './MiniGanttRowItem';

interface LayoutMiniGanttModalProps {
  project: Project;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const LayoutMiniGanttModal: React.FC<LayoutMiniGanttModalProps> = ({
  project,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Handle ESC key to close (AGENTS.md Rule 6)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  const {
    orderedGanttRows,
    timelineBounds,
    todayData,
    stats,
    handleOpenFullGantt,
  } = useMiniGanttData(project, onClose);

  const zInfo = useOverlayStack({
    layer: 'MINI_GANTT',
    isOpen,
    onClose,
    closeOnTabChange: true,
  });

  if (!isOpen || !project) return null;

  const modalContent = (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-0 ${zInfo.zClass} pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 overscroll-contain`}
      onWheel={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      onTouchStart={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      onTouchEnd={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
    >
      {/* Semi-transparent backdrop for focus */}
      <div
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          onClose();
        }}
        onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        onTouchStart={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/40 dark:bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs pointer-events-auto transition-opacity cursor-pointer overscroll-contain"
      />

      {/* Draggable Window (AGENTS.md Rule 11) */}
      <Draggable
        handle=".modal-handle"
        cancel="button, input, select, textarea, .no-drag"
        nodeRef={nodeRef}
        bounds="parent"
      >
        <div
          ref={nodeRef}
          onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          onTouchStart={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          onTouchEnd={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          onWheel={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          className="relative pointer-events-auto bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] rounded-xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col w-full max-w-3xl max-h-[85vh] overflow-hidden select-none animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 overscroll-contain"
          style={{ cursor: 'default' }}
        >
          {/* 1. Header (Handle) */}
          <MiniGanttHeader project={project} onClose={onClose} />

          {/* 2. Project Stats & Timeline Range Sub-header */}
          <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap text-xs shrink-0">
            {/* Left: Overall Dates */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium">Timeline:</span>
                <span className="font-bold font-mono text-[11px] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">
                  {formatMonthDay(timelineBounds.startDate)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-400">→</span>
                <span className="font-bold font-mono text-[11px] text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400">
                  {formatMonthDay(timelineBounds.finishDate)}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-medium">
                  ({timelineBounds.totalDays}d)
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Right: Task Status Badges matching GanttTab */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
              {todayData.isInTimeline && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-extrabold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-rose-400 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800/80">
                  Today: {todayData.formattedToday}
                </span>
              )}
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                {stats.total} Tasks
              </span>
              {stats.completed > 0 && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-green-50 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-950/60 dark:text-green-400 border border-green-200 dark:border-green-800/80">
                  {stats.completed} Completed
                </span>
              )}
              {stats.inProgress > 0 && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800/80">
                  {stats.inProgress} On process
                </span>

              {stats.upcoming > 0 && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                  {stats.upcoming} Upcoming
                </span>
              )}
              {stats.milestone > 0 && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 dark:bg-orange-950/60 dark:text-orange-400 border border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-800/80">
                  {stats.milestone} Milestone
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 3. Gantt Chart Area */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto min-h-[220px] max-h-[55vh] flex flex-col bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c]">
            {orderedGanttRows.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                <Layers className="w-10 h-10 mb-2 opacity-30 text-slate-400" />
                <div className="font-semibold text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                  No tasks registered for this project yet
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 max-w-sm">
                  Tasks will appear here once defined in Task Detail or Gantt chart.
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="min-w-[550px] flex flex-col">
                {/* Timeline Grid Header */}
                <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-[#202022] backdrop-blur-xs text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  {/* Left Column: Task Name & Dates */}
                  <div className="w-[240px] sm:w-[270px] px-3 py-1.5 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] shrink-0 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>Task</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-medium">
                      Dates (Start - End)
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {/* Right Column: Time Scale Markers */}
                  <div className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 relative flex justify-between uppercase tracking-wider overflow-visible">
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">
                      {formatMonthDay(timelineBounds.startDate)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="hidden sm:inline">Timeline Progress</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400">
                      {formatMonthDay(timelineBounds.finishDate)}
                    </span>

                    {/* Today Pin Header Marker */}
                    {todayData.isInTimeline && (
                      <div
                        className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 -translate-x-1/2 flex flex-col items-center pointer-events-none z-20"
                        style={{
                          left: `calc(12px + (100% - 24px) * ${todayData.percent / 100})`,
                        }}
                        title={`Today: ${todayData.formattedToday}`}
                      >
                        <div className="bg-red-500 dark:bg-rose-500 text-white font-extrabold text-[8px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded shadow-xs tracking-wider flex items-center gap-0.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                          <span>TODAY</span>
                          <span className="opacity-90 font-mono">
                            ({todayData.formattedToday})
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="w-0.5 flex-1 bg-red-500 dark:bg-rose-500 shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(239,68,68,0.5)]" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Task Rows */}
                <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800/60">
                  {orderedGanttRows.map(({ task: t, isChild }, idx) => (
                    <MiniGanttRowItem
                      key={t.id || idx}
                      task={t}
                      isChild={isChild}
                      timelineBounds={timelineBounds}
                      todayData={todayData}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* 4. Footer Summary */}
          <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#202022] border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383a] flex items-center justify-between text-xs shrink-0">
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Drag header to move &bull; Esc to close
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleOpenFullGantt}
              className="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
            >
              <BarChartHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Full Gantt View</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Draggable>
    </div>
  );

  return createPortal(modalContent, document.body);
};

export default LayoutMiniGanttModal;

                  </div>
                ) : (
