  () => import('./LayoutMiniGanttModal').then(m => ({ default: m.LayoutMiniGanttModal })),
  'LayoutMiniGanttModal'
);

interface LiveCanvasProps {
  config: any;
  storeFilter: string;
  locationFilter: string;
  yearFilter?: string;
  targetUnitSearch?: string | null;
  onUnitSelected?: (unit: any) => void;
  onClearFocus?: () => void;
  onRefreshConfig?: () => Promise<void> | void;
  onOpenR2Config: () => void;
  canWrite: boolean;
}

export const LiveCanvas = React.memo(function LiveCanvas({
  config,
  storeFilter,
  locationFilter,
  yearFilter,
  targetUnitSearch,
  onUnitSelected,
  onClearFocus,
  onRefreshConfig,
  onOpenR2Config,
  canWrite,
}: LiveCanvasProps) {
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const layoutTooltipVisibility = useAppStore(state => state.layoutTooltipVisibility);
  const setLayoutTooltipVisibility = useAppStore(state => state.setLayoutTooltipVisibility);
  const resetLayoutTooltipVisibility = useAppStore(state => state.resetLayoutTooltipVisibility);
  const setEditingProject = useAppStore(state => state.setEditingProject);
  const setIsProjectModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.setIsProjectModalOpen);
  const isProjectModalOpen = useAppStore(state => state.isProjectModalOpen);
  const quickNavTarget = useAppStore(state => state.quickNavTarget);
  const setModalInitialTab = useAppStore(state => state.setModalInitialTab);
  const isPrintPreview = useAppStore(state => state.isPrintPreview);
  const setIsPrintPreview = useAppStore(state => state.setIsPrintPreview);

  const [filterOnlyAlerts, setFilterOnlyAlerts] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSmartAlertCollapsed, setIsSmartAlertCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [miniGanttProject, setMiniGanttProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);
  const isAnyModalActive = Boolean(quickNavTarget) || isProjectModalOpen || Boolean(miniGanttProject);

  const savedTooltipStateRef = React.useRef<{
    hoverInfo: any;
    isPinned: boolean;
  } | null>(null);
  const prevIsAnyModalActiveRef = React.useRef(isAnyModalActive);

  const [showMenu, setShowMenu] = useState(false);
  const [showLegendModal, setShowLegendModal] = useState(false);
  const [isLegendStripCollapsed, setIsLegendStripCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('taka_layout_legend_collapsed');
      if (saved !== null) return saved === 'true';
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
    return false;
  });
  const [selectedLegendGroupId, setSelectedLegendGroupId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const deferredSearchQuery = useDeferredValue(searchQuery);
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);
  const [exportStatus, setExportStatus] = useState('');

  // 1. Floor data & versions resolution hook
  const {
    version,
    units,
    locationVersions,
    availableStoreVersions,
    bgImage,
    unitImagesRev,
    hasStoredUnitImages,
    selectedVersionId,
    setSelectedVersionId,
    targetLoc,
    effectiveLayoutYear,
  } = useLayoutFloorData({
    config,
    storeFilter,
    locationFilter,
    yearFilter,
  });

  // 2. Stage interactions, zoom & pan engine
  const stageInteractions = useLayoutStageInteractions({
    bgImage,
    version,
    units,
    targetUnitSearch,
    onUnitSelected,
    onClearFocus,
    availableStoreVersions,
    selectedVersionId,
    setSelectedVersionId,
    storeFilter,
    targetLoc,
    isProjectModalOpen,
    miniGanttProject,
  });

  // 3. Financial, project, and thematic aggregates hook
  const {
    aggregatedData,
    activeGroups,
    totalFloorAlerts,
    focusedUnit,
    visibleUnits,
    hasUserAccessInStoreYear,
    restrictedProjectCodes,
  } = useLayoutAggregates({
    units,
    version,
    storeFilter,
    locationFilter,
    targetLoc,
    effectiveLayoutYear,
    hasStoredUnitImages,
    unitImagesRev,
    focusedUnitId: stageInteractions.focusedUnitId,
    filterOnlyAlerts,
    deferredSearchQuery,
    stageScale: stageInteractions.stageScale,
    stagePos: stageInteractions.stagePos,
    dimensions: stageInteractions.dimensions,
  });

  // Synchronize latest aggregated data with stage interaction callbacks
  stageInteractions.updateAggregatedData(aggregatedData, restrictedProjectCodes);

  // Auto-hide Tooltip when QuickNav / MiniGantt / ProjectModal is active, and Auto-restore when closed
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!prevIsAnyModalActiveRef.current && isAnyModalActive) {
      if (stageInteractions.hoverInfo && stageInteractions.hoverInfo.visible) {
        savedTooltipStateRef.current = {
          hoverInfo: stageInteractions.hoverInfo,
          isPinned: stageInteractions.isPinnedRef.current,
        };
      }
    } else if (prevIsAnyModalActiveRef.current && !isAnyModalActive) {
      if (savedTooltipStateRef.current) {
        const saved = savedTooltipStateRef.current;
        savedTooltipStateRef.current = null;
        stageInteractions.isPinnedRef.current = saved.isPinned;
        stageInteractions.setHoverInfo(saved.hoverInfo);
        if (saved.hoverInfo?.clientX != null && saved.hoverInfo?.clientY != null) {
          setTimeout(() => {
            stageInteractions.updateTooltipPos(saved.hoverInfo.clientX, saved.hoverInfo.clientY);
          }, 30);
        }
      }
    }
    prevIsAnyModalActiveRef.current = isAnyModalActive;
  }, [isAnyModalActive, stageInteractions]);

  // Reset focus, tooltips, alert filters, legend filters, mini gantt, and fit screen whenever store, location, or year changes
  const prevFilterScopeRef = React.useRef<string>('');
  useEffect(() => {
    const currentScope = `${storeFilter}_${targetLoc}_${effectiveLayoutYear}`;
    if (prevFilterScopeRef.current && prevFilterScopeRef.current !== currentScope) {
      stageInteractions.setFocusedUnitId(null);
      stageInteractions.setHoverInfo(null);
      stageInteractions.isPinnedRef.current = false;
      savedTooltipStateRef.current = null;
      setFilterOnlyAlerts(false);
      setSelectedLegendGroupId(null);
      setMiniGanttProject(null);
      setShowLegendModal(false);
      if (stageInteractions.focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(stageInteractions.focusedTimerRef.current);
      onClearFocus?.();
      stageInteractions.fitToScreen(true);
    }
    prevFilterScopeRef.current = currentScope;
  }, [storeFilter, targetLoc, effectiveLayoutYear, onClearFocus, stageInteractions]);

  // Listen for Edit Mode trigger from hamburger menu
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOpenEditMode = () => {
      setShowMenu(true);
    };
    window.addEventListener("open-layout-edit-mode", handleOpenEditMode);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("open-layout-edit-mode", handleOpenEditMode);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleTriggerExport = async () => {
    if (!canWrite) {
      alert('⚠️ You do not have Write permission to trigger export.');
      return;
    }
    if (isExporting) return;
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setExportStatus('Step 1/4: Loading data from Cloudflare R2...');
      const targetStore = (storeFilter === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM') as 'HCM' | 'HN';
      const res = await executeTriggerExportProcess(targetStore, (status) => {
        setExportStatus(status);
      });
      setIsExporting(false);
      setExportStatus('');
      alert(`✅ ${res.message}`);
      if (onRefreshConfig) {
        await onRefreshConfig();
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Lỗi khi Trigger Export:", err);
      setIsExporting(false);
      setExportStatus('');
      alert(`⚠️ Lỗi khi Trigger Export:\n${err?.message || err}`);
    }
  };

  const isIOS = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && (/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) || (navigator.userAgent.includes("Mac") && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1));
  const pixelRatio = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (isIOS ? 1 : Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.25)) : 1;

  if (!hasUserAccessInStoreYear) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 text-slate-400 p-6 text-center select-none">
        <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/40 flex items-center justify-center mb-3 shadow-inner">
          <ShieldAlert className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 opacity-80" />
        </div>
        <p className="text-base font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
          No authorized projects or tasks found ({globalYearFilter || 'Selected Year'})
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 max-w-md leading-relaxed">
          Floor layout and live metrics are restricted and hidden for accounts without active assignments in this timeframe.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!version || !version.id) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 text-slate-400 p-6 text-center select-none">
        <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-900/20 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800/40 flex items-center justify-center mb-3 shadow-inner">
          <Layers className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 opacity-80" />
        </div>
        <p className="text-base font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
          Chưa có dữ liệu Layout cho {storeFilter} • {targetLoc} ({globalYearFilter || 'Tất cả năm'})
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 max-w-md leading-relaxed">
          Bộ lọc và dữ liệu mặt bằng đồng bộ trực tiếp theo các phiên bản tại tab Review. Hãy tạo hoặc gán phiên bản tại tab Picture Mapping để hiển thị tại đây.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 overflow-hidden relative select-none [background-image:linear-gradient(to_right,#e5e7eb_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#e5e7eb_1px,transparent_1px)] dark:[background-image:linear-gradient(to_right,#1e293b_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#1e293b_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:20px_20px] print:bg-white print:bg-none print:p-0 print:m-0 print:border-none">
      
      {/* Clean High-Contrast Print Legend Overlay - Renders only on print & print preview */}
      <LayoutPrintLegendOverlay
        storeFilter={storeFilter}
        targetLoc={targetLoc}
        version={version}
        activeGroups={activeGroups}
      />
      
      {/* Floating Focus Unit Banner with Cancel / Exit Button */}
      <LayoutFocusBanner
        focusedUnitId={stageInteractions.focusedUnitId}
        units={units}
        onClearFocus={() => {
          stageInteractions.setFocusedUnitId(null);
          stageInteractions.setHoverInfo(null);
          if (stageInteractions.focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(stageInteractions.focusedTimerRef.current);
          stageInteractions.fitToScreen(true);
          onClearFocus?.();
        }}
      />

      {/* Floating Top-Left Controls: Location & Layout Version Switcher */}
      <LayoutFloorVersionSelector
        storeFilter={storeFilter}
        targetLoc={targetLoc}
        locationVersions={locationVersions}
        version={version}
        setSelectedVersionId={setSelectedVersionId}
      />

      {/* Floating Top-Right Controls */}
      <LayoutZoomControls
        totalFloorAlerts={totalFloorAlerts}
        filterOnlyAlerts={filterOnlyAlerts}
        setFilterOnlyAlerts={setFilterOnlyAlerts}
        stageScale={stageInteractions.stageScale}
        onZoomIn={stageInteractions.handleZoomIn}
        onZoomOut={stageInteractions.handleZoomOut}
        onFitToScreen={() => stageInteractions.fitToScreen(true)}
      />

      {/* Active Alert Filter Banner */}
      {filterOnlyAlerts && (
        <div className="absolute top-14 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20 flex items-center gap-2 bg-red-600 text-white px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-150 hide-on-actual-print print:hidden">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-white animate-pulse" />
          <span>Showing {totalFloorAlerts} unit{totalFloorAlerts > 1 ? 's' : ''} with active alerts</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setFilterOnlyAlerts(false)}
            className="ml-1 bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            Show All
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Compact Color Legend Bar with Export Integration */}
      <LayoutColorLegendBar
        layoutTooltipVisibility={layoutTooltipVisibility}
        activeGroups={activeGroups}
        selectedLegendGroupId={selectedLegendGroupId}
        setSelectedLegendGroupId={setSelectedLegendGroupId}
        setShowLegendModal={setShowLegendModal}
        isLegendStripCollapsed={isLegendStripCollapsed}
        setIsLegendStripCollapsed={setIsLegendStripCollapsed}
        canWrite={canWrite}
        handleTriggerExport={handleTriggerExport}
        isExporting={isExporting}
        exportStatus={exportStatus}
        handleExport={stageInteractions.handleExport}
        setIsPrintPreview={setIsPrintPreview}
      />

      {/* Full Color Legend Modal / Drawer (iOS friendly) */}
      <LayoutColorLegendModal
        showLegendModal={showLegendModal}
        onClose={() => setShowLegendModal(false)}
        activeGroups={activeGroups}
        selectedLegendGroupId={selectedLegendGroupId}
        setSelectedLegendGroupId={setSelectedLegendGroupId}
      />

      {/* Floating Edit Mode Drawer / Modal */}
      <LayoutEditModeModal
        showMenu={showMenu}
        onClose={() => setShowMenu(false)}
        searchQuery={searchQuery}
        setSearchQuery={setSearchQuery}
        isSmartAlertCollapsed={isSmartAlertCollapsed}
        setIsSmartAlertCollapsed={setIsSmartAlertCollapsed}
        layoutTooltipVisibility={layoutTooltipVisibility}
        setLayoutTooltipVisibility={setLayoutTooltipVisibility}
        resetLayoutTooltipVisibility={resetLayoutTooltipVisibility}
        canWrite={canWrite}
        handleTriggerExport={handleTriggerExport}
        isExporting={isExporting}
        exportStatus={exportStatus}
        setIsPrintPreview={setIsPrintPreview}
        isPrintPreview={isPrintPreview}
        handleExport={stageInteractions.handleExport}
        onOpenR2Config={onOpenR2Config}
      />

      {/* Tooltip (Auto-hidden when any Modal or QuickNav is active) */}
      {!isAnyModalActive && stageInteractions.hoverInfo && stageInteractions.hoverInfo.visible && (
        <div className="hide-on-actual-print print:hidden">
          <LayoutUnitTooltip
            hoverInfo={stageInteractions.hoverInfo}
            tooltipRef={stageInteractions.tooltipRef}
            containerRef={stageInteractions.containerRef}
            onClose={() => {
              savedTooltipStateRef.current = null;
              stageInteractions.isPinnedRef.current = false;
              stageInteractions.setHoverInfo(null);
              if (stageInteractions.focusedUnitId) {
                stageInteractions.setFocusedUnitId(null);
                if (stageInteractions.focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(stageInteractions.focusedTimerRef.current);
                stageInteractions.fitToScreen(true);
                onClearFocus?.();
              }
            }}
            onOpenMiniGantt={(project) => {
              if (stageInteractions.hoverInfo && stageInteractions.hoverInfo.visible) {
                savedTooltipStateRef.current = {
                  hoverInfo: stageInteractions.hoverInfo,
                  isPinned: stageInteractions.isPinnedRef.current,
                };
              }
              setMiniGanttProject(project);
            }}
            onEditProject={(project, _isReadOnly, tab) => {
              if (stageInteractions.hoverInfo && stageInteractions.hoverInfo.visible) {
                savedTooltipStateRef.current = {
                  hoverInfo: stageInteractions.hoverInfo,
                  isPinned: stageInteractions.isPinnedRef.current,
                };
              }
              setEditingProject(project);
              setModalInitialTab(tab || 'details');
              setIsProjectModalOpen(true);
            }}
            canWrite={canWrite}
            storeFilter={storeFilter}
            onFocusUnit={(unitTarget) => {
              stageInteractions.zoomAndPanToUnit(unitTarget);
            }}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* JIT Mounted Draggable Mini Gantt Modal */}
      {miniGanttProject && (
        <React.Suspense fallback={null}>
          <LayoutMiniGanttModal
            project={miniGanttProject}
            isOpen={Boolean(miniGanttProject)}
            onClose={() => setMiniGanttProject(null)}
          />
        </React.Suspense>
      )}

      {/* Canvas Viewport */}
      <LayoutCanvasViewport
        containerRef={stageInteractions.containerRef}
        stageRef={stageInteractions.stageRef}
        dimensions={stageInteractions.dimensions}
        stageScale={stageInteractions.stageScale}
        setStageScale={stageInteractions.setStageScale}
        stagePos={stageInteractions.stagePos}
        setStagePos={stageInteractions.setStagePos}
        pixelRatio={pixelRatio}
        isProjectModalOpen={isProjectModalOpen}
        miniGanttProject={miniGanttProject}
        handleDragStart={stageInteractions.handleDragStart}
        handleDragMove={stageInteractions.handleDragMove}
        handleDragEnd={stageInteractions.handleDragEnd}
        stopInertia={stageInteractions.stopInertia}
        isPinnedRef={stageInteractions.isPinnedRef}
        setHoverInfo={stageInteractions.setHoverInfo}
        touchStateRef={stageInteractions.touchStateRef}
        pendingTouchRef={stageInteractions.pendingTouchRef}
        rafTouchIdRef={stageInteractions.rafTouchIdRef}
        isInteractingRef={stageInteractions.isInteractingRef}
        fitToScreen={stageInteractions.fitToScreen}
        lastWheelPointerRef={stageInteractions.lastWheelPointerRef}
        pendingWheelDeltaRef={stageInteractions.pendingWheelDeltaRef}
        rafWheelIdRef={stageInteractions.rafWheelIdRef}
        wheelTimeoutRef={stageInteractions.wheelTimeoutRef}
        bgImage={bgImage}
        version={version}
        visibleUnits={visibleUnits}
        layoutTooltipVisibility={layoutTooltipVisibility}
        focusedUnitId={stageInteractions.focusedUnitId}
        selectedLegendGroupId={selectedLegendGroupId}
        getContrastStyle={getContrastStyle}
        aggregatedData={aggregatedData}
        focusedUnit={focusedUnit}
        handleMouseEnterUnit={stageInteractions.handleMouseEnterUnit}
        handleMouseMoveUnit={stageInteractions.handleMouseMoveUnit}
        handleMouseLeaveUnit={stageInteractions.handleMouseLeaveUnit}
        handleClickUnit={stageInteractions.handleClickUnit}
        handleTapUnit={stageInteractions.handleTapUnit}
        hasStoredUnitImages={hasStoredUnitImages}
        storeFilter={storeFilter}
      />
    </div>
  );
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/MiniGanttHeader.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { GripHorizontal, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { QuickNavButton } from '../QuickNavButton';
import { cn } from '../../lib/utils';

interface MiniGanttHeaderProps {
  project: Project;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const MiniGanttHeader: React.FC<MiniGanttHeaderProps> = ({ project, onClose }) => {
  const storeDisplay = (project.store || 'HCM').toUpperCase();
  const isHcm = storeDisplay === 'HCM';

  return (
    <div className="modal-handle cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#252528] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#38383a] flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
        <div className="p-1 rounded text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300">
          <GripHorizontal className="w-4 h-4" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap min-w-0">
          <span
            className={cn(
              'text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border shrink-0',
              isHcm
                ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] dark:border-blue-800/80'
                : 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-400 dark:border-red-800/80'
            )}
          >
            {storeDisplay}
          </span>
          <span className="font-mono font-extrabold text-sm text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] tracking-tight">
            {project.code}
          </span>
          <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600">|</span>
          <span className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 truncate max-w-[200px] sm:max-w-[320px]">
            {project.name}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Header Action Buttons */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 no-drag">
        <QuickNavButton
          project={project}
          title={`Quick Navigator (${project.code})`}
          className="no-drag"
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            onClose();
          }}
          onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          className="no-drag p-1 rounded-md text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-200/60 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/60 transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation"
          title="Close Mini Gantt (Esc)"
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/MiniGanttRowItem.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Task } from '../../types';
import { parseDateTime, getTaskStatus, cn } from '../../lib/utils';
import { formatMonthDay, getBarColor } from './useMiniGanttData';

interface MiniGanttRowItemProps {
  task: Task;
  isChild: boolean;
  timelineBounds: {
    startDate: Date;
    finishDate: Date;
    totalDays: number;
  };
  todayData: {
    today: Date;
    formattedToday: string;
    percent: number;
    isInTimeline: boolean;
  };
}

export const MiniGanttRowItem: React.FC<MiniGanttRowItemProps> = React.memo(
  ({ task: t, isChild, timelineBounds, todayData }) => {
    const tStart = parseDateTime(t.start);
    const tFinish = parseDateTime(t.finish);
    const rawDuration = parseFloat(String(t.duration ?? ''));
    const isMilestone = !isNaN(rawDuration) && rawDuration === 0;
    const duration = isMilestone ? 0 : isNaN(rawDuration) || rawDuration <= 0 ? 1 : rawDuration;

    const sFormatted = formatMonthDay(tStart);
    const fFormatted = formatMonthDay(tFinish);

    let computedStatus = getTaskStatus(t.start, t.finish);
    const statusStr = (t.runningStatus || '').toLowerCase();
    if (t.approval === 'Approved' || statusStr.includes('complete')) {
      computedStatus = 'Completed';
    } else if (statusStr.includes('cancel')) {
      computedStatus = 'Canceled';
    } else if (statusStr.includes('handover')) {
      computedStatus = 'Handover';
    } else if (statusStr.includes('process') || statusStr.includes('progress')) {
      computedStatus = 'On process';
    }

    const barColor = getBarColor(computedStatus, t.duration);

    let leftPercent = 0;
    let widthPercent = 10;

    const effectiveStart = tStart || tFinish;
    const effectiveFinish = tFinish || tStart;

    if (effectiveStart && effectiveFinish) {
      const offsetDays = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.round((effectiveStart.getTime() - timelineBounds.startDate.getTime()) / 86400000)
      );
      const taskDays = isMilestone
        ? 0
        : Math.max(
            1,
            Math.round((effectiveFinish.getTime() - effectiveStart.getTime()) / 86400000) + 1
          );
      leftPercent = Math.min(
        98,
        Math.max(0, (offsetDays / timelineBounds.totalDays) * 100)
      );
      widthPercent = isMilestone
        ? 0
        : Math.min(
            100 - leftPercent,
            Math.max(2.5, (taskDays / timelineBounds.totalDays) * 100)
          );
    }

    return (
      <div
        className={cn(
          'flex items-center hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#252528]/50 transition-colors group h-9',
          isChild && 'bg-slate-50/40 dark:bg-[#1a1a1c]/40'
        )}
      >
        {/* Task Info Cell: Name & Dates */}
        <div className="w-[240px] sm:w-[270px] px-3 py-1 border-r border-slate-100 dark:border-[#333336] shrink-0 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
            {isChild && (
              <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono text-[11px] select-none pl-1.5 shrink-0">
                ↳
              </span>
            )}
            {(() => {
              const displayCode = t.taskCodePhu || (t.orderIndex !== undefined && t.orderIndex !== null ? `#${t.orderIndex + 1}` : '');
              if (!displayCode) return null;
              return (
                <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] font-bold shrink-0">
                  {displayCode}
                </span>
              );
            })()}
            <span
              className={cn(
                'text-xs truncate flex-1',
                isChild
                  ? 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-normal'
                  : 'text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 font-medium'
              )}
              title={`${t.taskCodePhu || (t.orderIndex !== undefined ? `#${t.orderIndex + 1} ` : '')}${t.name}${
                sFormatted || fFormatted ? ` (${sFormatted || ''} - ${fFormatted || ''})` : ''
              }`}
            >
              {t.name}
            </span>
          </div>
          {(sFormatted || fFormatted) && (
            <span
              className="font-mono text-[10px] shrink-0 tabular-nums font-semibold flex items-center gap-0.5"
              title={`Start: ${t.start || 'N/A'} • Finish: ${t.finish || 'N/A'}${
                isMilestone ? ' • Milestone (0d)' : ''
              }`}
            >
              {isMilestone ? (
                <span className="text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-bold">
                  <span className="text-[8px]">◆</span>
                  <span>{sFormatted || fFormatted}</span>
                </span>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {sFormatted && (
                    <span className="text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]">{sFormatted}</span>
                  )}
                  {sFormatted && fFormatted && sFormatted !== fFormatted && (
                    <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-normal">-</span>
                  )}
                  {fFormatted && sFormatted !== fFormatted && (
                    <span className="text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400">{fFormatted}</span>
                  )}
                  {!sFormatted && fFormatted && (
                    <>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-normal">→</span>
                      <span className="text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400">{fFormatted}</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Gantt Bar Cell */}
        <div className="flex-1 px-3 py-1 relative h-full flex items-center">
          {/* Background Grid Lines (25%, 50%, 75%) */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex pointer-events-none opacity-20">
            <div className="w-1/4 border-r border-dashed border-slate-400" />
            <div className="w-1/4 border-r border-dashed border-slate-400" />
            <div className="w-1/4 border-r border-dashed border-slate-400" />
          </div>

          {/* Vertical Today Line through task rows */}
          {todayData.isInTimeline && (
            <div
              className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 -translate-x-1/2 pointer-events-none z-10"
              style={{ left: `calc(12px + (100% - 24px) * ${todayData.percent / 100})` }}
            >
              <div className="w-0.5 h-full bg-red-500/80 dark:bg-rose-500/80 shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(239,68,68,0.4)]" />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Task Bar / Milestone diamond matching GanttTab */}
          {isMilestone ? (
            <div
              className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex items-center cursor-pointer group/bar z-20"
              style={{ left: `${leftPercent}%` }}
              title={`${t.name}\nMilestone (0d): ${t.start || t.finish || 'N/A'}\nStatus: ${computedStatus}${
                t.party ? `\nParty: ${t.party}` : ''
              }`}
            >
              <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rotate-45 rounded-xs shadow-md bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 transition-transform group-hover/bar:scale-125 border border-white dark:border-[#1a1a1c]" />
              <span className="ml-1.5 text-[9px] font-extrabold text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400 whitespace-nowrap drop-shadow-xs bg-orange-50/80 dark:bg-orange-950/60 px-1 py-0.2 rounded border border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-900/40">
                0d
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div
              className={cn(
                'relative h-5 rounded-md shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center overflow-hidden cursor-pointer',
                barColor
              )}
              style={{
                left: `${leftPercent}%`,
                width: `${widthPercent}%`,
              }}
              title={`${t.name}\nStart: ${t.start || 'N/A'}\nFinish: ${t.finish || 'N/A'}\nDuration: ${duration}d\nStatus: ${computedStatus}${
                t.party ? `\nParty: ${t.party}` : ''
              }`}
            >
              {computedStatus === 'Completed' && (
                <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 bottom-0 w-full bg-black/15 pointer-events-none" />
              )}

              {widthPercent > 12 && (
                <span className="relative z-10 px-1.5 text-[9px] font-extrabold text-white truncate drop-shadow-xs">
                  {duration}d
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
);

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/TooltipDetailsSection.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../../lib/utils';

interface TooltipDetailsSectionProps {
  v: any;
  taskLines: string[];
  detailText: string;
  descriptionText: string;
}

export const TooltipDetailsSection: React.FC<TooltipDetailsSectionProps> = ({
  v,
  taskLines,
  detailText,
  descriptionText,
}) => {
  const uniqueTaskLines = Array.from(new Set((taskLines || []).map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean)));
  const hasDetails = (v.detail && (uniqueTaskLines.length > 0 || detailText)) || (v.description && (descriptionText || detailText));
  if (!hasDetails) return null;

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-[#161618] rounded-lg p-2 sm:p-2.5 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-[#2e2e32] text-xs shadow-2xs flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
      {/* Active Subtasks / Detail */}
      {v.detail && uniqueTaskLines.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
          <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
            Detail
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
            {uniqueTaskLines.map((line, idx) => (
              <div 
                key={idx} 
                className={`font-medium text-xs leading-tight ${idx % 2 === 0 ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]' : 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400'}`}
              >
                • {line}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Description (p.detail or descriptionText) */}
      {(uniqueTaskLines.length === 0 ? (v.detail && detailText) : (v.description && (detailText || descriptionText))) && (
        <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-0.5", v.detail && uniqueTaskLines.length > 0 ? "pt-1 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-[#2e2e32]" : "")}>
          <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
            {uniqueTaskLines.length > 0 ? 'Description' : 'Detail'}
          </div>
          <div className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
            {detailText || descriptionText}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/TooltipImageGalleryPanel.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  Plus, 
  X, 
  Link as LinkIcon, 
  Check, 
  Maximize2, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Copy, 
  Trash2,
  Upload,
  Loader2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { TooltipImageItem } from './tooltipTypes';
import { normalizeImageUrl } from '../LayoutUnitLightboxModal';
import { uploadPictureToTakaFolder } from '../../../lib/r2StorageUtils';
import { TooltipZoomableThumbnail } from './TooltipZoomableThumbnail';

interface TooltipImageGalleryPanelProps {
  showImagePanel: boolean;
  setShowImagePanel: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  showAddLinkInput: boolean;
  setShowAddLinkInput: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  newLinkInput: string;
  setNewLinkInput: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string>>;
  allUnitImages: TooltipImageItem[];
  copiedLink: string | null;
  handleAddCustomImage: (e?: React.FormEvent, customUrl?: string) => void;
  handleDeleteCustomImage: (id: string, urlToDelete?: string) => void;
  handleCopyLink: (url: string) => void;
  setEnlargedImage: (img: { url: string; title?: string; initialScale?: number } | null) => void;
  unitCode?: string;
  activeStore?: string;
}

export const TooltipImageGalleryPanel: React.FC<TooltipImageGalleryPanelProps> = ({
  showImagePanel,
  setShowImagePanel,
  showAddLinkInput,
  setShowAddLinkInput,
  newLinkInput,
  setNewLinkInput,
  allUnitImages,
  copiedLink,
  handleAddCustomImage,
  handleDeleteCustomImage,
  handleCopyLink,
  setEnlargedImage,
  unitCode,
  activeStore = 'HCM',
}) => {
  const [addMode, setAddMode] = useState<'link' | 'picture'>('link');
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploadSuccessUrl, setUploadSuccessUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  if (!showImagePanel && !showAddLinkInput) return null;

  const handlePictureFileSelected = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
    const file = files[0];

    setIsUploading(true);
    setUploadError(null);
    setUploadSuccessUrl(null);

    try {
      const res = await uploadPictureToTakaFolder(file, unitCode, activeStore);
      if (res.success && res.publicUrl) {
        const feedback = `${res.publicUrl}${(res as any).compressionInfo || ''}`;
        setUploadSuccessUrl(feedback);
        setNewLinkInput(res.publicUrl);
        // Save link immediately into gallery
        handleAddCustomImage(undefined, res.publicUrl);
        setTimeout(() => setUploadSuccessUrl(null), 4500);
      } else {
        setUploadError(res.error || 'Upload failed');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setUploadError(err?.message || 'Lỗi kết nối upload');
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full bg-slate-50/95 dark:bg-[#161618] rounded-xl p-2.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] shadow-inner flex flex-col gap-2 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 my-1">
      {/* Panel Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 pb-1.5 border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 min-w-0">
          <ImageIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] shrink-0" />
          <span className="truncate">Hình ảnh liên kết ({activeStore})</span>
          <span className={cn(
            "text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-mono shrink-0 font-bold",
            activeStore.toUpperCase() === 'HN'
              ? "bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-950/80 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400"
              : "bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-700 dark:text-[#8ab4f8]"
          )}>
            {allUnitImages.length}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
          {/* Top "+ Thêm" Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowAddLinkInput(prev => !prev)}
            className={cn(
              "px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer shadow-xs",
              showAddLinkInput 
                ? "bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200" 
                : "bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white"
            )}
            title={showAddLinkInput ? "Đóng ô nhập link" : "Thêm link ảnh / bài viết"}
          >
            <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>Thêm</span>
          </button>
          {/* Close Image Panel Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setShowImagePanel(false);
              setShowAddLinkInput(false);
            }}
            className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded hover:bg-slate-200/60 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Đóng bảng ảnh"
          >
            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Add / Post Link Input or Upload Picture Section (Only visible when clicking "+ Thêm") */}
      {showAddLinkInput && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 w-full animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-150 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-[#1a1a1c] border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-900 rounded-xl p-2 shadow-xs">
          {/* Mode Switcher Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-1.5 gap-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setAddMode('link');
                  setUploadError(null);
                }}
                className={cn(
                  "px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer",
                  addMode === 'link'
                    ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-2xs"
                    : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200"
                )}
              >
                <LinkIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Dán Link URL</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setAddMode('picture');
                  setUploadError(null);
                }}
                className={cn(
                  "px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer",
                  addMode === 'picture'
                    ? "bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-2xs"
                    : "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-200"
                )}
              >
                <Upload className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Add Picture (Upload R2)</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setNewLinkInput('');
                setShowAddLinkInput(false);
                setUploadError(null);
              }}
              className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Đóng"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Mode 1: Dán Link URL */}
          {addMode === 'link' && (
            <form onSubmit={handleAddCustomImage} className="flex gap-1.5 items-center w-full pt-0.5">
              <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
                <LinkIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                <input 
                  type="url"
                  value={newLinkInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewLinkInput(e.target.value)}
                  onFocus={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  placeholder="Dán link ảnh hoặc link bài viết (https://...)..."
                  className="w-full pl-7 pr-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#1e1e20] border border-blue-400 dark:border-blue-500 rounded-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-400 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 transition-all font-mono"
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!newLinkInput.trim()}
                className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation shrink-0 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
                title="Xác nhận thêm link"
              >
                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>OK</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          )}

          {/* Mode 2: Add Picture (Auto upload R2) */}
          {addMode === 'picture' && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 w-full pt-0.5">
              <input 
                type="file"
                ref={fileInputRef}
                accept="image/*"
                className="hidden"
                onChange={handlePictureFileSelected}
              />

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={isUploading}
                  onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}

                >
                  {isUploading ? (
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                  <span>{isUploading ? "Đang upload lên R2..." : "Chọn Ảnh Từ Máy / Chụp Ảnh"}</span>
                </button>

                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-mono shrink-0 truncate max-w-[210px]">
                  <span>Thư mục R2:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">Taka-Pm-folder/</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {uploadError && (
                <div className="text-[10px] font-medium text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/60 p-1.5 rounded-md border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/80 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span>⚠️ {uploadError}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {uploadSuccessUrl && (
                <div className="text-[10px] font-medium text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 p-1.5 rounded-md border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/80 flex items-center gap-1 truncate font-mono">
                  <span>✅ Đã lưu link R2:</span>
                  <span className="truncate">{uploadSuccessUrl}</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Image & Link Thumbnail List */}
      {allUnitImages.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-3.5 px-2 bg-white/60 dark:bg-[#1e1e20]/60 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-400 text-xs flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
          <ImageIcon className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600" />
          <span>Chưa có hình ảnh. Bấm nút <b>+ Thêm</b> ở trên để dán link ảnh/bài viết.</span>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 max-h-[70vh] sm:max-h-[460px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-0.5">
          {allUnitImages.map((img) => (
            <div 
              key={img.id}
              className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1e1e20] rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#333336] p-2 flex flex-col gap-1.5 shadow-2xs group hover:border-blue-300 dark:hover:border-blue-800 transition-colors"
            >
              {/* Thumbnail Image Container with Pinch / Wheel / Double-tap Auto-Fullscreen Zoom */}
              <TooltipZoomableThumbnail
                img={img}
                onOpenFullscreen={(target) => setEnlargedImage(target)}
              />

              {/* Link Address and Action Buttons (Only shown when clicking "+ Thêm") */}
              {showAddLinkInput && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 pt-0.5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <LinkIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                    <a 
                      href={img.url} 
                      target="_blank" 
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="text-[10px] font-mono text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] hover:underline truncate"
                      title={img.url}
                    >
                      {img.url}
                    </a>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleCopyLink(img.url)}
                      className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 rounded hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
                      title={copiedLink === img.url ? "Đã sao chép link!" : "Sao chép link"}
                    >
                      {copiedLink === img.url ? (
                        <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-green-500" />
                      ) : (
                        <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                      )}
                    </button>
                    <a
                      href={img.url}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 rounded hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
                      title="Mở link trong tab mới"
                    >
                      <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </a>
                    {img.isCustom && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onPointerDown={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                        }}
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteCustomImage(img.id, img.url);
                        }}
                        className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-400 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95 touch-manipulation flex items-center justify-center"
                        title="Xóa link này"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-500 hover:text-red-600" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/TooltipMetaRow.tsx ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { MessageSquare, BarChartHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';
import { Project } from '../../../types';
import { cn, parseDateTime } from '../../../lib/utils';

interface TooltipMetaRowProps {
  v: any;
  p?: Project;
  floorValue?: any;
  dataSize?: number;
  commentsCount: number;
  computedTakStart?: string;
  computedTakCompl?: string;
  onEditProject?: (project: Project, isReadOnly?: boolean, tab?: 'details' | 'chat' | 'delegation') => void;
  onOpenMiniGantt?: (project: Project) => void;
}

export const TooltipMetaRow: React.FC<TooltipMetaRowProps> = ({
  v,
  p,
  floorValue,
  dataSize = 0,
  commentsCount,
  computedTakStart,
  computedTakCompl,
  onEditProject,
  onOpenMiniGantt,
}) => {
  if (!v.floor && !v.area && !v.startDate && !v.endDate && commentsCount === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-0.5 pt-1.5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap">
      {/* Left Side: Floor, Area & Comment Symbol */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
        {/* Floor Badge */}
        {v.floor && floorValue && (
          <div className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
            <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-medium uppercase">Floor:</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">{floorValue}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Area (if available) */}
        {v.area && dataSize > 0 && (
          <div className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
            <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-medium uppercase">DT:</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">{Number(dataSize).toLocaleString('en-US')} m²</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Project Chat / Comment Symbol Button */}
        {p && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onEditProject?.(p, false, 'chat');
            }}
            className={cn(
              "flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer shrink-0",
              commentsCount > 0 
                ? "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800/80 hover:bg-blue-100" 
                : "bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 border-slate-200 dark:border-[#444446] hover:text-blue-500"
            )}
            title="Open Project Comments"
          >
            <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            {commentsCount > 0 && <span>{commentsCount}</span>}
          </button>
        )}

        {/* Modular Mini Gantt Button (Next to comments button) */}
        {p && onOpenMiniGantt && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onOpenMiniGantt(p);
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800/80 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/60 transition-all active:scale-95 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-xs"
            title="Open Mini Gantt Timeline"
          >
            <BarChartHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Gantt</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Right Side: Start Date (Blue) & Finish Date (Pink) */}
      {(v.startDate || v.endDate) && (computedTakStart || computedTakCompl) && (
        <div className="flex gap-2 sm:gap-2.5 text-[11px] font-bold leading-tight shrink-0 ml-auto items-center">
          {v.startDate && computedTakStart && (
            <div className="text-blue-600 dark:text-[#8ab4f8] text-right">
              {(() => {
                const d = parseDateTime(computedTakStart);
                if (!d) return null;
                return (
                  <>
                    <div>{d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })},</div>
                    <div>{d.getFullYear()}</div>
                  </>
                );
              })()}
            </div>
          )}
          {v.endDate && computedTakCompl && (
            <div className="text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400 text-right">
              {(() => {
                const d = parseDateTime(computedTakCompl);
                if (!d) return null;
                return (
                  <>
                    <div>{d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })},</div>
                    <div>{d.getFullYear()}</div>
                  </>
                );
              })()}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/TooltipZoomableThumbnail.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Maximize2, ZoomIn } from 'lucide-react';
import { TooltipImageItem } from './tooltipTypes';
import { normalizeImageUrl } from '../LayoutUnitLightboxModal';

interface TooltipZoomableThumbnailProps {
  img: TooltipImageItem;
  onOpenFullscreen: (img: { url: string; title?: string; initialScale?: number }) => void;
}

export const TooltipZoomableThumbnail: React.FC<TooltipZoomableThumbnailProps> = ({
  img,
  onOpenFullscreen,
}) => {
  const [previewScale, setPreviewScale] = useState(1);
  const [isPinching, setIsPinching] = useState(false);
  const [showZoomHint, setShowZoomHint] = useState(false);
  const [isImgError, setIsImgError] = useState(false);

  const touchStateRef = useRef<{
    initialDist: number;
    triggered: boolean;
  } | null>(null);

  const singleTouchStartRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; time: number } | null>(null);
  const lastTapRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // 1. Pinch-to-zoom & Drag-to-zoom gesture on touch devices (iOS / iPad / mobile)
  const handleTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (e.touches.length === 2) {
      const p1 = e.touches[0];
      const p2 = e.touches[1];
      const dist = Math.hypot(p2.clientX - p1.clientX, p2.clientY - p1.clientY);
      touchStateRef.current = { initialDist: dist, triggered: false };
      setIsPinching(true);
      setShowZoomHint(true);
      singleTouchStartRef.current = null;
    } else if (e.touches.length === 1) {
      singleTouchStartRef.current = {
        x: e.touches[0].clientX,
        y: e.touches[0].clientY,
        time: Date.now(),
      };
    }
  };

  const handleTouchMove = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (e.touches.length === 2 && touchStateRef.current) {
      const p1 = e.touches[0];
      const p2 = e.touches[1];
      const currentDist = Math.hypot(p2.clientX - p1.clientX, p2.clientY - p1.clientY);
      const ratio = currentDist / Math.max(touchStateRef.current.initialDist, 1);

      // User spreading fingers to zoom into thumbnail
      if (ratio > 1.05) {
        if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
        setPreviewScale(Math.min(2.2, ratio));

        // When zoom expansion crosses threshold, auto-expand to fullscreen and continue zooming
        if (ratio >= 1.15 && !touchStateRef.current.triggered) {
          touchStateRef.current.triggered = true;
          const targetScale = Math.min(4, Math.max(1.35, ratio * 1.3));
          onOpenFullscreen({
            url: img.url,
            title: img.title,
            initialScale: targetScale,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const handleTouchEnd = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    singleTouchStartRef.current = null;
    if (touchStateRef.current) {
      touchStateRef.current = null;
      setIsPinching(false);
      setPreviewScale(1);
      setTimeout(() => setShowZoomHint(false), 800);
      return;
    }

    // Double-tap zoom detection for single touch
    if (e.changedTouches.length === 1) {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastTapRef.current < 320) {
        // Double-tap detected -> auto open fullscreen at 2x zoom
        lastTapRef.current = 0;
        if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
        onOpenFullscreen({
          url: img.url,
          title: img.title,
          initialScale: 2.0,
        });
      } else {
        lastTapRef.current = now;
      }
    }
  };

  // Regular click to open full display mode directly
  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    onOpenFullscreen({
      url: img.url,
      title: img.title,
      initialScale: 1,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
      onTouchMove={handleTouchMove}
      onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
      onTouchCancel={handleTouchEnd}
      onClick={handleClick}
      onMouseEnter={() => setShowZoomHint(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setShowZoomHint(false)}
      className="relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/80 w-full max-h-[190px] sm:max-h-[280px] flex items-center justify-center group/thumb p-1 touch-manipulation cursor-pointer"
      title="Click to view full display HD"
    >
      {!isImgError ? (
        <img
          src={normalizeImageUrl(img.url)}
          alt={img.title}
          loading="lazy"
          decoding="async"
          onError={() => setIsImgError(true)}
          style={{
            transform: previewScale > 1 ? `scale(${previewScale})` : undefined,
            transition: isPinching ? 'none' : 'transform 0.15s ease-out',
          }}
          draggable={false}
          className="w-full h-auto max-h-[180px] sm:max-h-[270px] object-contain hover:scale-[1.01] duration-150 rounded-md select-none"
        />
      ) : (
        <div
          className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400 p-3 text-center w-full"
        >
          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
            Web Link / Article Preview
          </span>
          <span className="truncate max-w-[200px] text-[9px] font-mono text-blue-500">
            {img.url}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Floating Action Bar: Maximize & Zoom HD */}
      <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 opacity-90 group-hover/thumb:opacity-100 transition-opacity z-10">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleClick}
          className="p-1.5 bg-black/75 hover:bg-black/95 text-white rounded-md backdrop-blur-xs transition-all active:scale-90 cursor-pointer shadow-md flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-medium"
          title="Zoom HD Fullscreen (Escape to close)"
        >
          <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Zoom HD</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Interactive Micro-badge feedback */}
      {(showZoomHint || previewScale > 1) && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-2 left-2 bg-slate-900/85 backdrop-blur-xs text-white text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full pointer-events-none flex items-center gap-1 font-mono shadow-md animate-in fade-in duration-100 z-10">
          <ZoomIn className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-blue-400" />
          <span>
            {previewScale > 1
              ? `Zooming ${(previewScale * 100).toFixed(0)}%...`
              : 'Click to open full display'}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default TooltipZoomableThumbnail;


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/tooltipStoreIsolation.test.ts ==================== */
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { extractProjectMetadata, projectMatchesScope } from '../../../lib/utils';

// Simple in-memory localStorage mock for node test environment
const mockStorage: Record<string, string> = {};
const mockLocalStorage = {
  getItem: (k: string) => mockStorage[k] ?? null,
  setItem: (k: string, v: string) => { mockStorage[k] = String(v); },
  removeItem: (k: string) => { delete mockStorage[k]; },
  clear: () => {
    Object.keys(mockStorage).forEach(k => delete mockStorage[k]);
  }
};

describe('Tooltip Store Isolation (HCM vs HN)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockLocalStorage.clear();
  });

  it('partitions localStorage keys by store strictly', () => {
    const hnUnitKey = 'taka_unit_images_HN_1F-01';
    const hcmUnitKey = 'taka_unit_images_HCM_1F-01';

    const hnImages = [
      { id: 'img_1', url: 'https://hcm.taka-pm.org/Taka-Pm-folder/HN_1F-01_photo.jpg', title: 'HN Photo', store: 'HN' }
    ];
    const hcmImages = [
      { id: 'img_2', url: 'https://hcm.taka-pm.org/Taka-Pm-folder/HCM_1F-01_photo.jpg', title: 'HCM Photo', store: 'HCM' }
    ];

    mockLocalStorage.setItem(hnUnitKey, JSON.stringify(hnImages));
    mockLocalStorage.setItem(hcmUnitKey, JSON.stringify(hcmImages));

    // When reading HN partition
    const loadedHn = JSON.parse(mockLocalStorage.getItem(hnUnitKey) || '[]');
    expect(loadedHn).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(loadedHn[0].store).toBe('HN');
    expect(loadedHn[0].title).toBe('HN Photo');

    // When reading HCM partition
    const loadedHcm = JSON.parse(mockLocalStorage.getItem(hcmUnitKey) || '[]');
    expect(loadedHcm).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(loadedHcm[0].store).toBe('HCM');
    expect(loadedHcm[0].title).toBe('HCM Photo');

    // Cross-check: HCM partition does not contain HN image
    expect(loadedHcm.some((item: any) => item.store === 'HN')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('migrates legacy un-prefixed key when viewing HN and prevents it from leaking into HCM', () => {
    const unitCode = 'L3-314';
    const legacyKey = `taka_unit_images_${unitCode}`;
    const hnStoreKey = `taka_unit_images_HN_${unitCode}`;
    const hcmStoreKey = `taka_unit_images_HCM_${unitCode}`;

    // Simulate legacy un-prefixed image added while in HN
    const legacyData = [
      { id: 'img_legacy', url: 'https://hcm.taka-pm.org/Taka-Pm-folder/Slide6.JPG', title: 'Salomon HN' }
    ];
    mockLocalStorage.setItem(legacyKey, JSON.stringify(legacyData));

    // HCM check should not see legacy items as HCM
    expect(mockLocalStorage.getItem(hcmStoreKey)).toBeNull();

    // Migrate when HN accesses it
    const legacyRaw = mockLocalStorage.getItem(legacyKey);
    if (legacyRaw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(legacyRaw);
      const tagged = parsed.map((item: any) => ({ ...item, store: 'HN' }));
      mockLocalStorage.setItem(hnStoreKey, JSON.stringify(tagged));
      mockLocalStorage.removeItem(legacyKey);
    }

    // After migration:
    expect(mockLocalStorage.getItem(legacyKey)).toBeNull(); // Legacy removed
    expect(JSON.parse(mockLocalStorage.getItem(hnStoreKey) || '[]')).toHaveLength(1); // Saved to HN
    expect(mockLocalStorage.getItem(hcmStoreKey)).toBeNull(); // HCM remains clean
  });

  it('correctly isolates project metadata matching between HCM and HN', () => {
    const hnProject = {
      id: 'proj_hn_1',
      code: 'L1-112',
      name: 'MBB - Dior Pop-up',
      store: 'HN',
      year: 2027,
    };

    const hcmProject = {
      id: 'proj_hcm_1',
      code: 'L1-112',
      name: 'HCM Cosmetics',
      store: 'HCM',
      year: 2026,
    };

    const hnMeta = extractProjectMetadata(hnProject);
    const hcmMeta = extractProjectMetadata(hcmProject);

    expect(hnMeta.store).toBe('HN');
    expect(hcmMeta.store).toBe('HCM');

    // Matching scope test
    expect(projectMatchesScope(hnMeta, { store: 'HN' })).toBe(true);
    expect(projectMatchesScope(hnMeta, { store: 'HCM' })).toBe(false);

    expect(projectMatchesScope(hcmMeta, { store: 'HCM' })).toBe(true);
    expect(projectMatchesScope(hcmMeta, { store: 'HN' })).toBe(false);
  });
});


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/tooltipTypes.ts ==================== */
import React from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../../types';

export interface TooltipHoverInfo {
  visible: boolean;
  data: any;
  unitName: string;
  clientX?: number;
  clientY?: number;
  unitScreenBounds?: {
    left: number;
    right: number;
    top: number;
    bottom: number;
    centerX: number;
    centerY: number;
  };
}

export interface LayoutUnitTooltipProps {
  hoverInfo: TooltipHoverInfo;
  tooltipRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  containerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  onClose: () => void;
  onEditProject?: (project: Project, isReadOnly?: boolean, tab?: 'details' | 'chat' | 'delegation') => void;
  onOpenMiniGantt?: (project: Project) => void;
  onFocusUnit?: (unitName: string) => void;
  canWrite?: boolean;
  storeFilter?: string;
}

export interface TooltipImageItem {
  id: string;
  url: string;
  title: string;
  source: string;
  isCustom?: boolean;
}

export function getMdStatusColorClass(mdStatus: string): string {
  if (!mdStatus) return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700';
  
  const s = mdStatus.trim().toLowerCase();

  // 1. Signed agreement / Contract Signed / Fully Executed / Finalized (Emerald Green)
  if (s === 'signed agreement' || s.includes('signed agreement') || s.includes('contract signed') || s.includes('executed') || s.includes('fully signed') || s.includes('finalized') || s.includes('agreement signed')) {
    return 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800/80';
  }

  // 2. MOU signed / LOI Signed / Pre-Agreed (Teal / Cyan)
  if (s === 'mou signed' || s.includes('mou') || s.includes('loi') || s.includes('loa') || s.includes('pre-agreed') || s.includes('intent')) {
    return 'bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 border-teal-300 dark:bg-teal-950/70 dark:text-teal-300 dark:border-teal-800/80';
  }

  // 3. Verbally agreed / Verbal / Initial Talk (Warm Amber / Gold)
  if (s === 'verbally agreed' || s.includes('verbal') || s.includes('initial agreement') || s.includes('talks agreed')) {
    return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800/80';
  }

  // 4. negotiation / Discussion / Under Review (Sky Blue)
  if (s === 'negotiation' || s.includes('negotiat') || s.includes('discuss') || s.includes('proposal') || s.includes('offer') || s.includes('review') || s.includes('draft') || s.includes('pending')) {
    return 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 border-sky-300 dark:bg-sky-950/70 dark:text-sky-300 dark:border-sky-800/80';
  }

  // 5. approached / Contacted / Outreach (Indigo)
  if (s === 'approached' || s.includes('approach') || s.includes('contact') || s.includes('reach')) {
    return 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-300 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-800/80';
  }

  // 6. Rejected / Cancelled / Refused (Rose / Red)
  if (s === 'rejected' || s.includes('reject') || s.includes('cancel') || s.includes('terminat') || s.includes('drop') || s.includes('vacant') || s.includes('hold') || s.includes('fail') || s.includes('refus')) {
    return 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-300 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800/80';
  }

  // Default Fallback
  return 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700';
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/useTooltipImages.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Project } from '../../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc, deleteField } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { setDoc } from '../../../lib/firestoreWrites';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../../lib/firebase';
import { extractAllProjectCodes, projectMatchesUnitCode, extractProjectMetadata } from '../../../lib/utils';
import { TooltipImageItem } from './tooltipTypes';
import { deleteR2ImageCleanly } from '../../../lib/r2StorageUtils';
import { recordDelta } from '../../../lib/deltaSyncService';

interface UseTooltipImagesParams {
  p?: Project;
  data: any;
  unitCode: string;
  tooltipRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  positionTooltip: (forceRecalculate?: boolean) => void;
  storeFilter?: string;
}

export function useTooltipImages({
  p,
  data,
  unitCode,
  tooltipRef,
  positionTooltip,
  storeFilter,
}: UseTooltipImagesParams) {
  const [showImagePanel, setShowImagePanel] = useState(false);
  const [showAddLinkInput, setShowAddLinkInput] = useState(false);
  const [newLinkInput, setNewLinkInput] = useState('');
  const [copiedLink, setCopiedLink] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [enlargedImage, setEnlargedImage] = useState<{ url: string; title?: string; initialScale?: number } | null>(null);
  const [customUnitImages, setCustomUnitImages] = useState<Array<{ id: string; url: string; title?: string; createdAt?: string; store?: string }>>([]);

  const activeStore = (
    p?.store ||
    data?.store ||
    (p ? extractProjectMetadata(p).store : '') ||
    (storeFilter && storeFilter.toUpperCase() !== 'ALL' ? storeFilter : '') ||
    'HCM'
  ).toUpperCase().trim();

  const cleanCode = String(data?.code || unitCode || 'default').trim();
  const activeUnitStorageKey = `taka_unit_images_${activeStore}_${cleanCode}`;

  // Load custom images from localStorage with strict store separation
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // 1. Primary: load store-partitioned key
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(activeUnitStorageKey);
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
          const matching = parsed.filter(item => !item.store || item.store.toUpperCase() === activeStore);
          setCustomUnitImages(matching);
          return;
        }
      }

      // 2. Legacy key check: only migrate to HN if currently in HN (never load into HCM!)
      const legacyKey = `taka_unit_images_${cleanCode}`;
      const legacySaved = localStorage.getItem(legacyKey);
      if (legacySaved) {
        try {
          const parsedLegacy = JSON.parse(legacySaved);
          if (Array.isArray(parsedLegacy) && parsedLegacy.length > 0) {
            if (activeStore === 'HN') {
              const tagged = parsedLegacy.map(item => ({ ...item, store: 'HN' }));
              localStorage.setItem(activeUnitStorageKey, JSON.stringify(tagged));
              localStorage.removeItem(legacyKey);
              setCustomUnitImages(tagged);
              return;
            }
          }
        } catch {}
      }

      setCustomUnitImages([]);
    } catch {
      setCustomUnitImages([]);
    }
  }, [activeUnitStorageKey, activeStore, cleanCode]);

  // Reset panel open state when unit changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setShowImagePanel(false);
    setShowAddLinkInput(false);
  }, [data.code, unitCode]);

  // Re-evaluate position & smoothly scroll tooltip down to reveal image panel expanding below description box when image button is pressed
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tooltipRef.current) {
      if (showImagePanel) {
        positionTooltip(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (tooltipRef.current) {
            tooltipRef.current.scrollTo({
              top: tooltipRef.current.scrollHeight,
              behavior: 'smooth'
            });
          }
        }, 50);
      }
    }
  }, [showImagePanel, positionTooltip, tooltipRef]);

  // Close enlarged image modal with Escape key
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enlargedImage) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setEnlargedImage(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [enlargedImage]);

  const handleAddCustomImage = (e?: React.FormEvent, customUrl?: string) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    const targetUrl = customUrl || newLinkInput;
    const trimmed = targetUrl.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;

    const newEntry = {
      id: `img_${Date.now()}`,
      url: trimmed,
      title: `Link ${customUnitImages.length + 1}`,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      store: activeStore,
    };
    const updated = [newEntry, ...customUnitImages];
    setCustomUnitImages(updated);
    setNewLinkInput('');
    setShowAddLinkInput(false);

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(activeUnitStorageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch {}

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taka_unit_images_changed'));
    }

    // Persist link to project ONLY IF project strictly belongs to activeStore
    try {
      const allProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
      const targetProj = (p && extractProjectMetadata(p).store === activeStore ? p : null) || allProjects.find(item => {
        if (item.id === p?.id && extractProjectMetadata(item).store === activeStore) return true;
        const itemStore = extractProjectMetadata(item).store;
        if (itemStore && itemStore !== activeStore) return false;
        const itemCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(item).map(c => c.toLowerCase());
        const targetCode = String(data.code || unitCode || '').toLowerCase();
        return itemCodes.includes(targetCode) || projectMatchesUnitCode(itemCodes, targetCode);
      });

      if (targetProj && extractProjectMetadata(targetProj).store === activeStore) {
        // Purge any legacy fake "Link / Photo:" tasks from taskSummaries to keep the task list & detail box clean
        const cleanedSummaries = (targetProj.taskSummaries || []).filter(
          ts => !ts.name?.startsWith('Link / Photo:') && !ts.name?.startsWith('http://') && !ts.name?.startsWith('https://')
        );

        const existingLinks: any[] = Array.isArray(targetProj.imageLinks) ? targetProj.imageLinks : [];
        const hasLinkAlready = existingLinks.some(l => (typeof l === 'string' ? l === trimmed : l?.url === trimmed));
        const newLinkObj = {
          id: newEntry.id,
          url: trimmed,
          title: newEntry.title,
          createdAt: newEntry.createdAt,
          store: activeStore,
        };
        const updatedImageLinks = hasLinkAlready ? existingLinks : [newLinkObj, ...existingLinks];

        const updatedProject: Project = {
          ...targetProj,
          taskSummaries: cleanedSummaries,
          imageUrl: targetProj.imageUrl || trimmed,
          thumbnail: targetProj.thumbnail || trimmed,
          imageLinks: updatedImageLinks,
        };

        // 1. Instant Zustand 0ms optimistic update
        useAppStore.getState().setProjects(
          allProjects.map(proj => proj.id === targetProj.id ? updatedProject : proj)
        );

        // 2. Cloud Firestore persistence for real-time multi-device sync (iOS <-> Desktop)
        if (targetProj.id) {
          const updateData = {
            taskSummaries: cleanedSummaries,
            imageUrl: updatedProject.imageUrl,
            thumbnail: updatedProject.thumbnail,
            imageLinks: updatedImageLinks,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
          setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_projects", targetProj.id), updateData, { merge: true }).catch(err => {
            console.error("Failed to sync to Firestore:", err);
          });
          recordDelta({
            docId: targetProj.id,
            collectionName: 'taka_projects',
            action: 'update',
            data: updateData,
            year: String(targetProj.year || '')
          }).catch(console.error);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error updating project image link:", err);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteCustomImage = (id: string, urlToDelete?: string) => {
    const updated = customUnitImages.filter(item => item.id !== id && (urlToDelete ? item.url !== urlToDelete : true));
    setCustomUnitImages(updated);
    try {
      if (updated.length === 0) {
        localStorage.removeItem(activeUnitStorageKey);
        localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${activeStore}_${data.code || ''}`);
        localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${activeStore}_${unitCode || ''}`);
        if (p?.code) localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${activeStore}_${p.code}`);
        // Also remove legacy keys if any
        localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${cleanCode}`);
        localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${data.code || ''}`);
        localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${unitCode || ''}`);
        if (p?.code) localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${p.code}`);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem(activeUnitStorageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      }
    } catch {}

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taka_unit_images_changed'));
    }

    // Clean up from project.taskSummaries & project.imageLinks ONLY if project belongs to activeStore
    try {
      const targetUrl = urlToDelete || customUnitImages.find(item => item.id === id)?.url;
      if (targetUrl) {
        deleteR2ImageCleanly(targetUrl).catch(err => {
          console.warn("[R2 Purge] Deep clean error:", err);
        });
      }

      const allProjects = useAppStore.getState().projects;
      const targetProj = (p && extractProjectMetadata(p).store === activeStore ? p : null) || allProjects.find(item => {
        if (item.id === p?.id && extractProjectMetadata(item).store === activeStore) return true;
        const itemStore = extractProjectMetadata(item).store;
        if (itemStore && itemStore !== activeStore) return false;
        const itemCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(item).map(c => c.toLowerCase());
        const targetCode = String(data.code || unitCode || '').toLowerCase();
        return itemCodes.includes(targetCode) || projectMatchesUnitCode(itemCodes, targetCode);
      });

      if (targetProj && extractProjectMetadata(targetProj).store === activeStore) {
