        const filteredSummaries = (targetProj.taskSummaries || []).filter(
          ts => ts.link !== urlToDelete && ts.imageUrl !== urlToDelete && !ts.name?.includes(urlToDelete || '') && !ts.name?.startsWith('Link / Photo:')
        );
        const existingLinks: any[] = Array.isArray(targetProj.imageLinks) ? targetProj.imageLinks : [];
        const updatedImageLinks = existingLinks.filter(l => {
          const lUrl = typeof l === 'string' ? l : l?.url;
          const lId = typeof l === 'object' ? l?.id : null;
          if (id && lId === id) return false;
          if (urlToDelete && lUrl === urlToDelete) return false;
          return true;
        });

        const newImageUrl = targetProj.imageUrl === urlToDelete ? '' : targetProj.imageUrl;
        const newThumbnail = targetProj.thumbnail === urlToDelete ? '' : targetProj.thumbnail;
        const newPhoto = (targetProj as any).photo === urlToDelete ? '' : (targetProj as any).photo;
        const newImage = (targetProj as any).image === urlToDelete ? '' : (targetProj as any).image;

        const updatedProject: Project = {
          ...targetProj,
          taskSummaries: filteredSummaries,
          imageUrl: newImageUrl,
          thumbnail: newThumbnail,
          photo: newPhoto,
          image: newImage,
          imageLinks: updatedImageLinks,
        } as Project;

        useAppStore.getState().setProjects(
          allProjects.map(proj => proj.id === targetProj.id ? updatedProject : proj)
        );

        if (targetProj.id) {
          const firestoreUpdate: Record<string, any> = {
            taskSummaries: filteredSummaries,
            imageLinks: updatedImageLinks,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          };
          if (targetProj.imageUrl === urlToDelete) {
            firestoreUpdate.imageUrl = deleteField();
          }
          if (targetProj.thumbnail === urlToDelete) {
            firestoreUpdate.thumbnail = deleteField();
          }
          if ((targetProj as any).photo === urlToDelete) {
            firestoreUpdate.photo = deleteField();
          }
          if ((targetProj as any).image === urlToDelete) {
            firestoreUpdate.image = deleteField();
          }

          setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_projects", targetProj.id), firestoreUpdate, { merge: true }).catch(console.error);
          recordDelta({
            docId: targetProj.id,
            collectionName: 'taka_projects',
            action: 'update',
            data: firestoreUpdate,
            year: String(targetProj.year || '')
          }).catch(console.error);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error removing from project taskSummaries:", err);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyLink = (url: string) => {
    try {
      navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url);
      setCopiedLink(url);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedLink(null), 2000);
    } catch {}
  };

  // Consolidate all image items (user-added cloud links, taskSummaries, layout image/thumbnail, project attachments)
  const allUnitImages = useMemo(() => {
    const list: TooltipImageItem[] = [];
    const seenUrls = new Set<string>();

    const projStore = p ? extractProjectMetadata(p).store : '';
    const isProjMatchingStore = !p || !projStore || !activeStore || projStore === activeStore;

    // 1. Cloud-backed project.imageLinks (Realtime synchronized across iOS, Android, and Desktop)
    if (isProjMatchingStore && p?.imageLinks && Array.isArray(p.imageLinks)) {
      p.imageLinks.forEach((imgItem: any, idx: number) => {
        const url = typeof imgItem === 'string' ? imgItem : imgItem?.url;
        const itemStore = typeof imgItem === 'object' ? imgItem?.store : '';
        if (url && typeof url === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(url)) {
          if (!itemStore || itemStore.toUpperCase() === activeStore) {
            seenUrls.add(url);
            list.push({
              id: typeof imgItem === 'object' && imgItem.id ? imgItem.id : `img_cloud_${idx}`,
              url: url,
              title: (typeof imgItem === 'object' && imgItem.title) || `Link ${list.length + 1}`,
              source: `${activeStore} Link`,
              isCustom: true,
            });
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // 2. Project taskSummaries links (Prioritized cloud-backed task summarize, strictly matching store)
    if (isProjMatchingStore && p?.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries)) {
      p.taskSummaries.forEach((ts, tsIdx) => {
        const url = ts.link || ts.imageUrl || ts.thumbnail || (typeof ts.name === 'string' ? ts.name.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/)?.[0] : null);
        if (url && typeof url === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(url)) {
          seenUrls.add(url);
          list.push({
            id: `ts_${ts.id || tsIdx}_${url.slice(-8)}`,
            url: url,
            title: ts.name || `Task Summary Link ${list.length + 1}`,
            source: 'Task Summarize',
            isCustom: true,
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // 3. Custom user-posted links from localStorage (fallback for offline/local cache, strictly filtered by activeStore)
    customUnitImages.forEach((c) => {
      if (c.url && !seenUrls.has(c.url)) {
        if (!c.store || c.store.toUpperCase() === activeStore) {
          seenUrls.add(c.url);
          list.push({
            id: c.id,
            url: c.url,
            title: c.title || 'Attached Link',
            source: `${activeStore} Link`,
            isCustom: true,
          });
        }
      }
    });

    // 3. Project direct image / thumbnail fields (strictly matching activeStore)
    if (isProjMatchingStore) {
      if (p?.thumbnail && typeof p.thumbnail === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(p.thumbnail)) {
        seenUrls.add(p.thumbnail);
        list.push({
          id: 'proj_thumb',
          url: p.thumbnail,
          title: 'Project Thumbnail',
          source: 'Project Data',
          isCustom: true,
        });
      }
      if (p?.imageUrl && typeof p.imageUrl === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(p.imageUrl)) {
        seenUrls.add(p.imageUrl);
        list.push({
          id: 'proj_image',
          url: p.imageUrl,
          title: 'Project Image',
          source: 'Project Data',
          isCustom: true,
        });
      }
      if ((p as any)?.image && typeof (p as any).image === 'string' && !seenUrls.has((p as any).image)) {
        seenUrls.add((p as any).image);
        list.push({
          id: 'proj_img',
          url: (p as any).image,
          title: 'Project Image',
          source: 'Project Data',
          isCustom: true,
        });
      }
      if ((p as any)?.photo && typeof (p as any).photo === 'string' && !seenUrls.has((p as any).photo)) {
        seenUrls.add((p as any).photo);
        list.push({
          id: 'proj_photo',
          url: (p as any).photo,
          title: 'Project Photo',
          source: 'Project Data',
          isCustom: true,
        });
      }
    }

    // 4. Unit image from layout data (strictly matching activeStore)
    const dataStore = (data.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
    const isDataMatchingStore = !dataStore || !activeStore || dataStore === activeStore;
    if (isDataMatchingStore) {
      if (data.imageUrl && typeof data.imageUrl === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(data.imageUrl)) {
        seenUrls.add(data.imageUrl);
        list.push({
          id: 'data_image',
          url: data.imageUrl,
          title: 'Unit Layout Image',
          source: 'Layout Data',
        });
      }
      if (data.thumbnail && typeof data.thumbnail === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(data.thumbnail)) {
        seenUrls.add(data.thumbnail);
        list.push({
          id: 'data_thumb',
          url: data.thumbnail,
          title: 'Unit Thumbnail',
          source: 'Layout Data',
        });
      }
      if (data.image && typeof data.image === 'string' && !seenUrls.has(data.image)) {
        seenUrls.add(data.image);
        list.push({
          id: 'data_img',
          url: data.image,
          title: 'Floor Image',
          source: 'Layout Data',
        });
      }
    }

    // 5. Project comments attachments (strictly matching activeStore)
    if (isProjMatchingStore && p?.comments && Array.isArray(p.comments)) {
      p.comments.forEach((c, cIdx) => {
        if (c.attachments && Array.isArray(c.attachments)) {
          c.attachments.forEach((att, aIdx) => {
            if (att.url && !seenUrls.has(att.url)) {
              seenUrls.add(att.url);
              list.push({
                id: `comm_${cIdx}_${aIdx}`,
                url: att.url,
                title: att.name || `Attachment ${list.length + 1}`,
                source: `Comment by ${c.userName || 'User'}`,
              });
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }

    return list;
  }, [customUnitImages, activeStore, data.store, data.imageUrl, data.thumbnail, data.image, p, p?.comments, p?.taskSummaries, p?.thumbnail, p?.imageUrl, (p as any)?.image, (p as any)?.photo]);

  return {
    showImagePanel,
    setShowImagePanel,
    showAddLinkInput,
    setShowAddLinkInput,
    newLinkInput,
    setNewLinkInput,
    copiedLink,
    enlargedImage,
    setEnlargedImage,
    allUnitImages,
    handleAddCustomImage,
    handleDeleteCustomImage,
    handleCopyLink,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/TooltipParts/useTooltipPosition.ts ==================== */
import { useRef, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';
import { TooltipHoverInfo } from './tooltipTypes';

interface UseTooltipPositionParams {
  hoverInfo: TooltipHoverInfo;
  tooltipRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  containerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>;
  showImagePanel: boolean;
}

export function useTooltipPosition({
  hoverInfo,
  tooltipRef,
  containerRef,
  showImagePanel,
}: UseTooltipPositionParams) {
  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);
  const hasUserDraggedRef = useRef(false);
  const hasInitialPositionRef = useRef(false);
  const dragStartRef = useRef<{ startX: number; startY: number; initialLeft: number; initialTop: number }>({
    startX: 0,
    startY: 0,
    initialLeft: 0,
    initialTop: 0
  });

  const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (e.button !== 0 && e.pointerType === 'mouse') return;
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button') || (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('a') || (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('input')) {
      return;
    }
    const el = tooltipRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    hasUserDraggedRef.current = true;
    dragStartRef.current = {
      startX: e.clientX,
      startY: e.clientY,
      initialLeft: rect.left,
      initialTop: rect.top
    };
    try {
      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    const el = tooltipRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - dragStartRef.current.startX;
    const dy = e.clientY - dragStartRef.current.startY;
    const newLeft = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - el.offsetWidth - 8, dragStartRef.current.initialLeft + dx));
    const newTop = Math.max(60, Math.min(window.innerHeight - el.offsetHeight - 8, dragStartRef.current.initialTop + dy));
    el.style.left = `${newLeft}px`;
    el.style.top = `${newTop}px`;
    el.style.right = 'auto';
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!isDraggingRef.current) return;
    isDraggingRef.current = false;
    try {
      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  // Reset user dragged flag and initial position flag whenever a new unit is searched/focused
  useEffect(() => {
    hasUserDraggedRef.current = false;
    hasInitialPositionRef.current = false;
  }, [hoverInfo.unitName, hoverInfo.clientX, hoverInfo.clientY]);

  // Auto Anti-Collision & Obstruction-Proof Positioning Engine
  const positionTooltip = useCallback((forceRecalculate = false) => {
    if (!tooltipRef.current || hasUserDraggedRef.current) return;
    if (hasInitialPositionRef.current && !forceRecalculate) return;

    const el = tooltipRef.current;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const tooltipWidth = rect.width > 0 ? rect.width : 350;
    const tooltipHeight = rect.height > 0 ? rect.height : 220;

    const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
    const visualVp = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.visualViewport : null;
    const viewportHeight = visualVp ? visualVp.height : window.innerHeight;
    const isMobile = viewportWidth < 640;

    const pad = 12;
    // Bottom clearance: 80px on mobile to leave room for Menu button & Home indicator, 64px on desktop
    const bottomMargin = isMobile ? 80 : 64;

    // Calculate safe top clearance to ensure the tooltip is NEVER covered by the App Header or Layout toolbars
    let safeTop = isMobile ? 152 : 115;

    // 1. Check if the map container element exists
    const containerEl = containerRef?.current || (typeof document !== 'undefined' ? (document.getElementById('live-layout-canvas-container') || document.querySelector('.cursor-grab')) : null);
    if (containerEl) {
      const cRect = containerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (cRect.top > 0) {
        // Place below the container top and clear floating top controls (HCM • L1 & Zoom)
        safeTop = Math.max(safeTop, cRect.top + (isMobile ? 48 : 42));
      }
    }

    // 2. Also inspect the App Header (.sticky or header)
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const headerEl = document.querySelector('.sticky.top-0') || document.querySelector('header');
      if (headerEl) {
        const hRect = headerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (hRect.bottom > 0) {
          safeTop = Math.max(safeTop, hRect.bottom + (isMobile ? 64 : 50));
        }
      }
    }

    const bounds = hoverInfo.unitScreenBounds;

    if (isMobile) {
      // Mobile: Horizontal Auto-Centering with 12px margin
      const left = pad;
      const right = pad;
      
      let top = safeTop;
      if (!showImagePanel && bounds) {
        if (bounds.centerY > viewportHeight * 0.52) {
          top = safeTop;
        } else {
          top = Math.max(safeTop, viewportHeight - tooltipHeight - bottomMargin);
        }
      }

      el.style.position = 'fixed';
      el.style.zIndex = '999999';
      el.style.left = `${left}px`;
      el.style.right = `${right}px`;
      el.style.top = `${Math.max(safeTop, top)}px`;
      el.style.width = `calc(100vw - ${pad * 2}px)`;
      el.style.maxWidth = '420px';
      el.style.maxHeight = `calc(${Math.max(160, viewportHeight - safeTop - bottomMargin)}px)`;
      el.style.margin = '0 auto';
      el.style.transform = 'none';
    } else {
      // Desktop / Tablet: Smart 4-Way Anti-Obstruction Clamping
      let left: number;
      let top: number;

      if (bounds) {
        const spaceRight = viewportWidth - bounds.right;
        const spaceLeft = bounds.left;

        if (spaceRight >= tooltipWidth + pad + 20) {
          // Place cleanly to the right of the unit
          left = bounds.right + 24;
        } else if (spaceLeft >= tooltipWidth + pad + 20) {
          // Place cleanly to the left of the unit
          left = bounds.left - tooltipWidth - 24;
        } else {
          left = Math.max(pad, viewportWidth - tooltipWidth - pad);
        }
        top = Math.max(safeTop, Math.min(bounds.top, viewportHeight - tooltipHeight - bottomMargin));
      } else {
        const clientX = hoverInfo.clientX !== undefined ? hoverInfo.clientX : viewportWidth / 2;
        const clientY = hoverInfo.clientY !== undefined ? hoverInfo.clientY : viewportHeight / 2;

        left = clientX + 16;
        if (left + tooltipWidth > viewportWidth - pad) {
          left = clientX - tooltipWidth - 16;
        }
        left = Math.max(pad, Math.min(left, viewportWidth - tooltipWidth - pad));

        top = clientY + 16;
        if (top + tooltipHeight > viewportHeight - bottomMargin) {
          top = clientY - tooltipHeight - 16;
        }
        top = Math.max(safeTop, Math.min(top, viewportHeight - tooltipHeight - bottomMargin));
      }

      el.style.position = 'fixed';
      el.style.zIndex = '999999';
      el.style.left = `${left}px`;
      el.style.right = 'auto';
      el.style.top = `${top}px`;
      el.style.width = '370px';
      el.style.maxWidth = `calc(100vw - ${pad * 2}px)`;
      el.style.maxHeight = `calc(${Math.max(160, viewportHeight - safeTop - bottomMargin)}px)`;
      el.style.margin = '0';
      el.style.transform = 'none';
    }

    hasInitialPositionRef.current = true;
  }, [hoverInfo.clientX, hoverInfo.clientY, hoverInfo.unitScreenBounds, tooltipRef, containerRef, showImagePanel]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    positionTooltip();
  }, [positionTooltip]);

  // Handle browser window resize cleanly without jumping on internal input focus or size changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tooltipRef.current) return;
    const handleWindowResize = () => {
      positionTooltip(true);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleWindowResize);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleWindowResize);
    };
  }, [positionTooltip, tooltipRef]);

  return {
    handlePointerDown,
    handlePointerMove,
    handlePointerUp,
    positionTooltip,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/layoutDataAggregator.ts ==================== */
import { Project } from '../../types';
import { 
  getStatus, 
  computeProjectActStatus, 
  extractAllProjectCodes, 
  projectMatchesUnitCode, 
  extractProjectMetadata, 
  projectMatchesScope 
} from '../../lib/utils';

export interface BuildAggregatedUnitDataParams {
  units: any[];
  summaryData: any[];
  enrichedProjects: Project[];
  tasks: any[];
  projectLinkData: any[];
  storeFilter: string;
  locationFilter: string;
  targetLoc: string;
  effectiveLayoutYear: string;
  delegationGroups: any[];
  layoutTooltipVisibility: any;
  restrictedProjectCodes: Set<string>;
  hasStoredUnitImages: (key: string | undefined | null, store?: string) => boolean;
}

export function buildAggregatedUnitData({
  units,
  summaryData,
  enrichedProjects,
  tasks,
  projectLinkData,
  storeFilter,
  locationFilter,
  targetLoc,
  effectiveLayoutYear,
  delegationGroups,
  layoutTooltipVisibility,
  restrictedProjectCodes,
  hasStoredUnitImages,
}: BuildAggregatedUnitDataParams) {
  const dataMap: Record<string, any> = {};
  
  units.forEach((u: any) => {
    const uName = (u?.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!uName) return;
    const isRestricted = restrictedProjectCodes.has(uName);
    dataMap[uName] = {
      name: u.name || '',
      id: u.id,
      unit: u.name || '',
      isRestricted,
      hasImage: Boolean(u.imageUrl || u.thumbnail || u.image),
      year: effectiveLayoutYear,
      size: 0, sales: 0, salesByCp: 0, salesByHcmcate: 0,
      profit: 0, profitByCp: 0, profitByHcmcate: 0,
      margin: 0, marginByCp: 0, hcmSalesEffi: 0, hcmMargin: 0,
      mdStatus: "", task: "", projectStatus: "", actStatus: "",
      endDate: "", status: "", vendorCode: "",
      brandCode: "", brandName: "", classCode: "", floor: u.location || locationFilter || "",
      appProjectStatus: "", appProjectBudget: 0, appProjectActual: 0, appProjectCode: "", appProjectYear: "", projectName: "", startDate: "", handoverDate: "", openingDate: "", detail: "", party: "",
      appProjectMdStatus: "", appMdStatus: "", appProjectActStatus: "", appActStatus: "", appProjectDetail: "", appDetail: "", appProjectDescription: "", appDescription: "", appProjectParty: "", appParty: ""
    };
  });

  summaryData.forEach((sumData) => {
    const key = sumData.unit?.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (key && dataMap[key]) {
      if (dataMap[key].isRestricted || restrictedProjectCodes.has(key)) {
        dataMap[key].isRestricted = true;
        return;
      }
      Object.assign(dataMap[key], {
          size: sumData.size || 0,
          sales: sumData.salesAmount || 0,
          profit: sumData.profitAmount || 0,
          margin: sumData.margin || 0,
          hcmSalesEffi: sumData.hcmSalesEffi || 0,
          mdStatus: sumData.mdStatus || "",
          projectStatus: sumData.projectStatus || "",
          status: sumData.status || "",
          brandName: sumData.brandName || "",
          floor: dataMap[key].floor || (sumData as any).floor || "",
      });
    }
  });

  // Pre-index tasks by code map and projectId for O(1) lookup (Filtered by store and year)
  const tasksByCodeMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
  const tasksByProjIdMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
  tasks.forEach(t => {
    if (!t || !t.name) return;
    const tStore = String(t.projectStore || t.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
    if (tStore && tStore !== 'ALL' && storeFilter && storeFilter !== 'all' && tStore !== storeFilter.toUpperCase().trim()) return;
    const tYear = String(t.projectYear || t.year || '').trim();
    if (tYear && tYear !== 'ALL' && effectiveLayoutYear && effectiveLayoutYear !== 'all' && tYear !== String(effectiveLayoutYear).trim()) return;

    if (t.projectId) {
      const pId = String(t.projectId).trim().toLowerCase();
      let list = tasksByProjIdMap.get(pId);
      if (!list) {
        list = [];
        tasksByProjIdMap.set(pId, list);
      }
      list.push(t);
    }
    if (t.projectCode) {
      const rawCode = String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase();
      const codeParts = rawCode.split(/[+;,/]/).map(c => c.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      codeParts.forEach(c => {
        let list = tasksByCodeMap.get(c);
        if (!list) {
          list = [];
          tasksByCodeMap.set(c, list);
        }
        list.push(t);
      });
    }
  });

  // Pre-index projectLink: maps unit name -> list of linked project codes
  const unitToProjectCodesMap = new Map<string, string[]>();
  projectLinkData.forEach((pl: any) => {
    const u = String(pl?.unit || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const pCode = String(pl?.code || pl?.projectCode || pl?.project || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (u && pCode) {
      if (!unitToProjectCodesMap.has(u)) unitToProjectCodesMap.set(u, []);
      unitToProjectCodesMap.get(u)!.push(pCode);
    }
  });

  const now = new Date();
  enrichedProjects.forEach((p) => {
    if (!p.code && !p.linkCodes) return;

    const pMeta = extractProjectMetadata(p);

    if (!projectMatchesScope(pMeta, { store: storeFilter, location: targetLoc, year: effectiveLayoutYear })) {
      return;
    }

    const pCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(p);
    const status = getStatus(p.computedTakStart || p.start, p.computedTakCompl || p.handover, p.computedOpening || p.opening, p.code);
    
    const seenTaskKeys = new Set<string>();
    const allMatchedTasks: any[] = [];
    const addTaskIfUnique = (t: any) => {
      if (!t) return;
      const key = t.id 
        ? String(t.id).trim().toLowerCase()
        : `${String(t.name || '').trim().toLowerCase()}_${String(t.start || t.startDate || '').trim()}_${String(t.finish || t.endDate || '').trim()}`;
      if (!seenTaskKeys.has(key)) {
        seenTaskKeys.add(key);
        allMatchedTasks.push(t);
      }
    };

    if (p.id) {
      const pIdLower = String(p.id).trim().toLowerCase();
      const list = tasksByProjIdMap.get(pIdLower);
      if (list) list.forEach(addTaskIfUnique);
    }
    if (p.no) {
      const pNoLower = String(p.no).trim().toLowerCase();
      const list = tasksByProjIdMap.get(pNoLower);
      if (list) list.forEach(addTaskIfUnique);
    }
    pCodes.forEach(c => {
      const list = tasksByCodeMap.get(c);
      if (list) list.forEach(addTaskIfUnique);
    });
    if (p.code) {
      const pCodeLower = String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase();
      const list = tasksByCodeMap.get(pCodeLower);
      if (list) list.forEach(addTaskIfUnique);
    }
    // Only supplement from p.taskSummaries if not already captured from real tasks
    if (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries)) {
      p.taskSummaries.forEach(addTaskIfUnique);
    }
    const allTaskNames = Array.from(new Set(allMatchedTasks.map((t: any) => t.name).filter(Boolean)));

    const activeTasks = allMatchedTasks.filter((t: any) => {
      const startStr = t.start || t.startDate || t.takStart;
      const finishStr = t.finish || t.end || t.endDate || t.takCompl || t.handover;
      if (!startStr || !finishStr) return false;
      const start = new Date(startStr);
      const finish = new Date(finishStr);
      return now >= start && now <= finish;
    });
    const activeTaskNames = Array.from(new Set(activeTasks.map(t => t.name).filter(Boolean)));

    const isUrlOrImageLine = (str: string | undefined | null) => {
      if (!str || typeof str !== 'string') return false;
      const lower = str.toLowerCase().trim();
      return (
        lower.startsWith('http://') ||
        lower.startsWith('https://') ||
        lower.startsWith('link / photo:') ||
        lower.startsWith('link:') ||
        lower.startsWith('photo:') ||
        lower.startsWith('image:') ||
        lower.includes('.jpg') ||
        lower.includes('.jpeg') ||
        lower.includes('.png') ||
        lower.includes('.webp') ||
        lower.includes('.gif')
      );
    };

    const cleanAllTaskNames = Array.from(new Set(allTaskNames.filter(t => !isUrlOrImageLine(t))));
    const cleanActiveTaskNames = Array.from(new Set(activeTaskNames.filter(t => !isUrlOrImageLine(t))));

    const taskSummaryStr = cleanAllTaskNames.length > 0 
      ? cleanAllTaskNames.join('; ')
      : (cleanActiveTaskNames.join('; ') || (p.taskSummaries?.map((t: any) => t.name).filter((n: string) => !isUrlOrImageLine(n)).join('; ') || ''));

    let taskLines: string[] = [];
    cleanActiveTaskNames.forEach(name => {
      taskLines.push(...name.split('\n').map((l: string) => l.trim()).filter((l: string) => l !== '' && !isUrlOrImageLine(l)));
    });
    taskLines = Array.from(new Set(taskLines));

    const actStatus = (p as any).computedActStatus || (p as any).actStatus || computeProjectActStatus(p, delegationGroups);
    const detailStr = p.detail || '';
    const descStr = p.detail || (p as any).description || '';
    const partyStr = p.party || (p as any).contractor || '';
    const mdStatusStr = p.mdStatus || '';

    const targetUnitKeys = new Set<string>();
    Object.keys(dataMap).forEach(uKey => {
      const uEntry = dataMap[uKey];
      if (!uEntry) return;
      const uStore = (uEntry.store || storeFilter || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      const uLoc = (uEntry.location || targetLoc || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      const uYr = String(uEntry.year || effectiveLayoutYear || '').trim();

      // Strict Store, Location, and Year Isolation
      if (pMeta.store && uStore && uStore !== 'ALL' && uStore !== 'all' && pMeta.store !== uStore) return;
      const isStorewide = pMeta.location === 'ALL' || pMeta.location === 'STORE' || pMeta.location === 'STOREWIDE' || pMeta.location === 'WHOLE STORE' || pMeta.location === 'ALL FLOORS';
      if (pMeta.location && uLoc && !isStorewide && pMeta.location !== uLoc) return;
      if (pMeta.year && uYr && uYr !== 'ALL' && uYr !== 'all' && pMeta.year !== uYr) return;

      const linkedCodes = [
        ...(unitToProjectCodesMap.get(uKey.toLowerCase()) || []),
        ...(uEntry.name ? (unitToProjectCodesMap.get(uEntry.name.toLowerCase()) || []) : []),
        ...(uEntry.id ? (unitToProjectCodesMap.get(uEntry.id.toLowerCase()) || []) : []),
      ];
      const isLinkedViaProjectLink = linkedCodes.some(lc => 
        pCodes.some(pc => pc.toLowerCase() === lc.toLowerCase() || projectMatchesUnitCode([pc], lc))
      );

      const isExactCode = pCodes.some(c => c.toLowerCase() === uKey.toLowerCase() || (uEntry.name && c.toLowerCase() === uEntry.name.toLowerCase()));
      if (isExactCode || isLinkedViaProjectLink || projectMatchesUnitCode(pCodes, uKey) || (uEntry.name && projectMatchesUnitCode(pCodes, uEntry.name))) {
        targetUnitKeys.add(uKey);
      }
    });

    targetUnitKeys.forEach(code => {
       if (dataMap[code]) {
          const uStore = (dataMap[code]?.store || pMeta.store || storeFilter || '').toUpperCase().trim();
          dataMap[code].matchedProject = p;
          dataMap[code].hasAppProject = true;
          dataMap[code].appProjectStatus = status;
          dataMap[code].appProjectBudget = p.budget || 0;
          dataMap[code].appProjectActual = p.actual || 0;
          dataMap[code].appProjectCode = String(p.code);
          dataMap[code].appProjectYear = pMeta.year || (p.year ? String(p.year) : '');
          dataMap[code].year = pMeta.year || (p.year ? String(p.year) : '') || dataMap[code].year || '';
          dataMap[code].floor = (p as any).floor || p.location || dataMap[code].floor || targetLoc || '';
          dataMap[code].appProjectFloor = (p as any).floor || p.location || dataMap[code].floor || targetLoc || '';
          dataMap[code].appFloor = (p as any).floor || p.location || dataMap[code].floor || targetLoc || '';
          dataMap[code].projectName = p.name || "";
          dataMap[code].startDate = p.start || p.computedTakStart || "";
          dataMap[code].handoverDate = p.handover || p.computedTakCompl || "";
          dataMap[code].openingDate = p.opening || p.computedOpening || "";
          dataMap[code].detail = detailStr;
          dataMap[code].task = taskSummaryStr;
          dataMap[code].taskLines = taskLines;
          dataMap[code].taskSummaries = allMatchedTasks;
          dataMap[code].activeTasks = activeTaskNames;
          dataMap[code].mdStatus = mdStatusStr || dataMap[code].mdStatus || "";
          dataMap[code].actStatus = actStatus || dataMap[code].actStatus || "";
          dataMap[code].party = partyStr;
          dataMap[code].projectStatus = status || dataMap[code].projectStatus || "";
          dataMap[code].status = status || dataMap[code].status || "";

          dataMap[code].appProjectMdStatus = mdStatusStr;
          dataMap[code].appMdStatus = mdStatusStr;

          dataMap[code].appProjectActStatus = actStatus;
          dataMap[code].appActStatus = actStatus;

          dataMap[code].appProjectDetail = detailStr;
          dataMap[code].appDetail = detailStr;

          dataMap[code].appProjectDescription = descStr;
          dataMap[code].appDescription = descStr;

          dataMap[code].appProjectParty = partyStr;
          dataMap[code].appParty = partyStr;

          dataMap[code].matchedTasks = allMatchedTasks;
          dataMap[code].subTasks = allMatchedTasks.length > 0 ? allMatchedTasks : (p.taskSummaries || []);
          dataMap[code].planProgressPercent = p.computedPlanProgress ?? 0;
          dataMap[code].actProgressPercent = p.computedActProgress ?? 0;

          const hasProjectImages = Boolean(
            (p.thumbnail && typeof p.thumbnail === 'string' && p.thumbnail.trim()) ||
            (p.imageUrl && typeof p.imageUrl === 'string' && p.imageUrl.trim()) ||
            ((p as any).image && typeof (p as any).image === 'string' && (p as any).image.trim()) ||
            ((p as any).photo && typeof (p as any).photo === 'string' && (p as any).photo.trim()) ||
            (p.taskSummaries && Array.isArray(p.taskSummaries) && p.taskSummaries.some((ts: any) => ts.link || ts.imageUrl || ts.thumbnail || (typeof ts.name === 'string' && ts.name.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/)))) ||
            (p.comments && Array.isArray(p.comments) && p.comments.some((c: any) => c.attachments && c.attachments.length > 0)) ||
            (p as any).imageUrl || (p as any).thumbnail || (p as any).image ||
            dataMap[code].imageUrl || dataMap[code].thumbnail || dataMap[code].image ||
            hasStoredUnitImages(code, uStore) ||
            hasStoredUnitImages(p.code, uStore)
          );
          dataMap[code].hasImage = hasProjectImages || dataMap[code].hasImage;

          const todayStr = now.toISOString().split('T')[0];
          const alertReasons: string[] = [];
          let alertLevel: 'critical' | 'warning' | null = null;

          const isProjectCompleted = (p.computedActProgress ?? 0) >= 100 || 
            String(status).toLowerCase() === 'completed' || 
            String(actStatus).toLowerCase() === 'completed';

          if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.notifications !== false && !isProjectCompleted) {
            const subTasksList = allMatchedTasks.length > 0 ? allMatchedTasks : (p.taskSummaries || []);
            let overdueCount = 0;
            if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.alertOverdue !== false) {
              subTasksList.forEach((st: any) => {
                if (st.finish && st.finish < todayStr) {
                  const prog = st.progress ?? st.computedActProgress ?? 0;
                  if (prog < 100 && st.status !== 'Completed' && st.status !== 'Done' && st.status !== 'Canceled') {
                    overdueCount++;
                  }
                }
              });
            }

            let isDelayed = false;
            if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.alertDelay !== false) {
              const lowerStat = String(status).toLowerCase();
              const lowerAct = String(actStatus).toLowerCase();
              isDelayed = lowerStat.includes('delay') || lowerStat.includes('late') || lowerAct.includes('delay') || lowerAct.includes('late');
            }

            if (isDelayed && overdueCount > 0) {
              alertReasons.push(`Project delayed (${overdueCount} overdue task${overdueCount > 1 ? 's' : ''})`);
              alertLevel = 'critical';
            } else if (isDelayed) {
              alertReasons.push('Project delayed');
              alertLevel = 'critical';
            } else if (overdueCount > 0) {
              alertReasons.push(`${overdueCount} overdue task${overdueCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
              alertLevel = 'critical';
            }

            if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.alertHandover !== false) {
              const hDate = p.handover || p.computedTakCompl;
              if (hDate && hDate >= todayStr && (p.computedActProgress ?? 0) < 100) {
                const diffDays = Math.ceil((new Date(hDate).getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                if (diffDays >= 0 && diffDays <= 3) {
                  alertReasons.push(`Handover ${diffDays === 0 ? 'Today' : 'in ' + diffDays + 'd'}`);
                  if (!alertLevel) alertLevel = 'warning';
                }
              }
            }

            if (layoutTooltipVisibility?.alertOpening !== false) {
              const oDate = p.opening || p.computedOpening;
              if (oDate && oDate >= todayStr && (p.computedActProgress ?? 0) < 100) {
                const diffDays = Math.ceil((new Date(oDate).getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                if (diffDays >= 0 && diffDays <= 5) {
                  const actProg = p.computedActProgress ?? 0;
                  if (actProg < 80 && layoutTooltipVisibility?.alertOpeningRisk !== false) {
                    alertReasons.push(`Opening at risk (<80% prg, ${diffDays === 0 ? 'Today' : 'in ' + diffDays + 'd'})`);
                    alertLevel = 'critical';
                  } else if (diffDays <= 3) {
                    alertReasons.push(`Opening ${diffDays === 0 ? 'Today' : 'in ' + diffDays + 'd'}`);
                    if (!alertLevel) alertLevel = 'warning';
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }

          dataMap[code].alerts = {
            hasAlert: alertReasons.length > 0,
            level: alertLevel,
            count: alertReasons.length,
            reasons: alertReasons
          };
       }
    });
  });

  return dataMap;
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/layoutStageUtils.ts ==================== */
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { extractFloorFromCodeOrName } from './layoutTabSearchUtils';

export interface UnitFocalPointResult {
  targetUnit: any;
  cx: number;
  cy: number;
  uW: number;
  uH: number;
}

export function calculateUnitFocalPoint(
  targetUnitOrName: string | any,
  units: any[],
  aggregatedData: Record<string, any>,
  restrictedProjectCodes: Set<string>
): UnitFocalPointResult | null {
  if (!targetUnitOrName || !Array.isArray(units) || units.length === 0) return null;

  let targetUnit: any = null;
  if (typeof targetUnitOrName === 'object' && targetUnitOrName?.id) {
    targetUnit = targetUnitOrName;
  } else {
    const q = String(targetUnitOrName).toLowerCase().trim();
    const qFloor = extractFloorFromCodeOrName(q);

    const isDifferentFloor = (u: any) => {
      if (!qFloor) return false;
      const uFloor = extractFloorFromCodeOrName(u.name || u.label || u.id);
      if (uFloor && uFloor.toUpperCase() !== qFloor.toUpperCase()) {
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    };

    // 1. Direct exact match by unit name, id, or label
    targetUnit = units.find((u: any) => {
      if (isDifferentFloor(u)) return false;
      return (
        (u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim() === q || 
        String(u.id).toLowerCase() === q ||
        (u.label && String(u.label).toLowerCase().trim() === q)
      );
    });

    // 2. Exact match in aggregated data (project code, brand name, unit, project name)
    if (!targetUnit) {
      targetUnit = units.find((u: any) => {
        if (isDifferentFloor(u)) return false;
        const uName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        const d = aggregatedData[uName];
        if (!d) return false;
        const matchCode = d.appProjectCode && String(d.appProjectCode).toLowerCase().trim() === q;
        const matchName = d.projectName && String(d.projectName).toLowerCase().trim() === q;
        const matchBrand = d.brandName && String(d.brandName).toLowerCase().trim() === q;
        const matchUnit = d.unit && String(d.unit).toLowerCase().trim() === q;
        return matchCode || matchName || matchBrand || matchUnit;
      });
    }

    // 3. Direct store lookup fallback if aggregatedData not ready or project not yet linked in dataMap
    if (!targetUnit) {
      try {
        const globalProjects = (useAppStore.getState?.() as any)?.projects || [];
        const matchedProj = globalProjects.find((p: any) => 
          (p.code && String(p.code).toLowerCase().trim() === q) ||
          (p.id && String(p.id).toLowerCase().trim() === q) ||
          (p.name && String(p.name).toLowerCase().trim() === q) ||
          ((p as any).unit && String((p as any).unit).toLowerCase().trim() === q)
        );
        if (matchedProj) {
          const pCodes = [
            matchedProj.code,
            (matchedProj as any).unit,
            matchedProj.name,
            ...((matchedProj as any).linkCodes || [])
          ].filter(Boolean).map((s: string) => String(s).toLowerCase().trim());

          targetUnit = units.find((u: any) => {
            if (isDifferentFloor(u)) return false;
            const uName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            const uId = String(u.id || '').toLowerCase().trim();
            return pCodes.includes(uName) || pCodes.includes(uId);
          });
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    // 4. Normalized exact match (without hyphens/dots/spaces)
    if (!targetUnit) {
      const normQ = q.replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '');
      if (normQ.length >= 2) {
        targetUnit = units.find((u: any) => {
          if (isDifferentFloor(u)) return false;
          const normUName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '');
          const normUId = String(u.id || '').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '');
          return normUName === normQ || normUId === normQ;
        });
      }
    }

    // 5. Prefix / Stem match ONLY if same floor and significant length
    if (!targetUnit && q.length >= 3) {
      targetUnit = units.find((u: any) => {
        if (isDifferentFloor(u)) return false;
        const uName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (uName.length < 3) return false;
        return (
          uName.startsWith(q + '-') ||
          uName.startsWith(q + '_') ||
          q.startsWith(uName + '-') ||
          q.startsWith(uName + '_')
        );
      });
    }
  }

  if (!targetUnit) return null;

  const targetUName = (targetUnit.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (restrictedProjectCodes.has(targetUName) || aggregatedData[targetUName]?.isRestricted) {
    return null;
  }

  let cx = targetUnit.x || 0;
  let cy = targetUnit.y || 0;
  let uW = 100;
  let uH = 60;

  if (targetUnit.type === 'rect') {
    uW = Math.abs(targetUnit.width || 100);
    uH = Math.abs(targetUnit.height || 60);
    cx = (targetUnit.x || 0) + uW / 2;
    cy = (targetUnit.y || 0) + uH / 2;
  } else if (targetUnit.type === 'circle') {
    const r = targetUnit.radius || 30;
    uW = r * 2;
    uH = r * 2;
    cx = targetUnit.x || 0;
    cy = targetUnit.y || 0;
  } else if (targetUnit.type === 'polygon' && targetUnit.points && targetUnit.points.length >= 2) {
    let sumX = 0, sumY = 0, count = 0;
    let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < targetUnit.points.length; i += 2) {
      const px = targetUnit.points[i];
      const py = targetUnit.points[i + 1];
      sumX += px;
      sumY += py;
      count++;
      minX = Math.min(minX, px);
      maxX = Math.max(maxX, px);
      minY = Math.min(minY, py);
      maxY = Math.max(maxY, py);
    }
    cx = count > 0 ? sumX / count : 0;
    cy = count > 0 ? sumY / count : 0;
    uW = maxX > minX ? maxX - minX : 100;
    uH = maxY > minY ? maxY - minY : 60;
  } else {
    cx = (targetUnit.textX || targetUnit.x || 0) + (targetUnit.textWidth || 100) / 2;
    cy = (targetUnit.textY || targetUnit.y || 0) + (targetUnit.textHeight || 30) / 2;
  }

  return { targetUnit, cx, cy, uW, uH };
}

export function computeTooltipPosition(
  clientX: number,
  clientY: number,
  tooltipWidth: number,
  tooltipHeight: number,
  viewportWidth: number,
  viewportHeight: number
) {
  const isMobile = viewportWidth < 640;
  const pad = 12;
  const bottomMargin = isMobile ? 84 : 72;

  let safeTop = isMobile ? 120 : 100;
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    const headerEl = document.querySelector('header') || document.querySelector('.sticky.top-0');
    if (headerEl) {
      const hRect = headerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (hRect.bottom > 0) {
        safeTop = Math.max(safeTop, hRect.bottom + 8);
      }
    }
  }

  if (isMobile) {
    let top: number;
    if (clientY > viewportHeight * 0.52) {
      top = safeTop;
    } else {
      top = Math.max(safeTop, viewportHeight - tooltipHeight - bottomMargin);
    }

    return {
      position: 'fixed' as const,
      zIndex: 999999,
      left: `${pad}px`,
      right: `${pad}px`,
      top: `${top}px`,
      width: `calc(100vw - ${pad * 2}px)`,
      maxWidth: '420px',
      maxHeight: `calc(${viewportHeight - safeTop - bottomMargin}px)`,
      margin: '0 auto',
      transform: 'none',
    };
  }

  let left = clientX + 16;
  if (left + tooltipWidth > viewportWidth - pad) {
    left = clientX - tooltipWidth - 16;
  }
  left = Math.max(pad, Math.min(left, viewportWidth - tooltipWidth - pad));

  let top = clientY + 16;
  if (top + tooltipHeight > viewportHeight - bottomMargin) {
    top = clientY - tooltipHeight - 16;
  }
  top = Math.max(safeTop, Math.min(top, viewportHeight - tooltipHeight - bottomMargin));

  return {
    position: 'fixed' as const,
    zIndex: 999999,
    left: `${left}px`,
    right: 'auto',
    top: `${top}px`,
    width: '350px',
    maxWidth: `calc(100vw - ${pad * 2}px)`,
    maxHeight: `calc(${viewportHeight - safeTop - bottomMargin}px)`,
    margin: '0',
    transform: 'none',
  };
}

export function exportStageHighRes(
  stage: any,
  bgImage: any,
  version: any,
  units: any[],
  dpi: number = 200
) {
  if (!stage) return null;

  let contentX = 0;
  let contentY = 0;
  let contentW = 1000;
  let contentH = 800;

  if (bgImage) {
    const imgNaturalW = (bgImage as HTMLImageElement).naturalWidth || bgImage.width || 1000;
    const imgNaturalH = (bgImage as HTMLImageElement).naturalHeight || bgImage.height || 800;
    const imgScale = version?.imageScale || 1;
    contentW = imgNaturalW * imgScale;
    contentH = imgNaturalH * imgScale;
    contentX = version?.imagePos?.x || 0;
    contentY = version?.imagePos?.y || 0;
  } else if (units && units.length > 0) {
    let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
    units.forEach((u: any) => {
      const ux = u.x || 0;
      const uy = u.y || 0;
      const uw = u.width || 100;
      const uh = u.height || 100;
      minX = Math.min(minX, ux);
      minY = Math.min(minY, uy);
      maxX = Math.max(maxX, ux + uw);
      maxY = Math.max(maxY, uy + uh);
    });
    if (minX !== Infinity && maxX > minX) {
      contentX = minX;
      contentY = minY;
      contentW = Math.max(100, maxX - minX);
      contentH = Math.max(100, maxY - minY);
    }
  }

  const oldW = stage.width();
  const oldH = stage.height();
  const oldScaleX = stage.scaleX();
  const oldScaleY = stage.scaleY();
  const oldX = stage.x();
  const oldY = stage.y();

  const targetW = Math.max(100, Math.round(contentW));
  const targetH = Math.max(100, Math.round(contentH));
  stage.width(targetW);
  stage.height(targetH);
  stage.scale({ x: 1, y: 1 });
  stage.position({ x: -contentX, y: -contentY });
  stage.batchDraw();

  const exportRatio = Math.min(2.5, Math.max(1.0, dpi / 96));
  const dataUrl = stage.toDataURL({
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    width: targetW,
    height: targetH,
    pixelRatio: exportRatio,
    mimeType: 'image/jpeg',
    quality: 0.94
  });

  stage.width(oldW);
  stage.height(oldH);
  stage.scale({ x: oldScaleX, y: oldScaleY });
  stage.position({ x: oldX, y: oldY });
  stage.batchDraw();

  return {
    dataUrl,
    width: Math.round(targetW * exportRatio),
    height: Math.round(targetH * exportRatio),
  };
}

export function triggerStageDownload(stage: any) {
  if (!stage) return;
  const dataURL = stage.toDataURL({ pixelRatio: 2 });
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.download = `Thematic_Map_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.png`;
  link.href = dataURL;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
}

export function findUnitInOtherFloorVersions(q: string, availableStoreVersions: any[]) {
  if (!q || !Array.isArray(availableStoreVersions) || availableStoreVersions.length === 0) return null;
  const qLower = String(q).toLowerCase().trim();

  // 1. Direct version unit matching
  const matched = availableStoreVersions.find((v: any) => {
    if (v?.groupMappings) {
      const inGroup = Object.values(v.groupMappings).some((m: any) => 
        Array.isArray(m) && m.some(id => String(id).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower)
      );
      if (inGroup) return true;
    }
    const unitList = (Array.isArray(v?.mapUnits) ? v.mapUnits : (Array.isArray(v?.units) ? v.units : []));
    if (unitList.length > 0) {
      const inUnits = unitList.some((u: any) => 
        (u.name && String(u.name).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower) ||
        (u.id && String(u.id).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower) ||
        (u.label && String(u.label).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower)
      );
      if (inUnits) return true;
    }
    return false;
  });

  if (matched) return matched;

  // 2. Fallback: If q is a project code/name, find its floor location and matching version
  try {
    const globalProjects = (useAppStore.getState?.() as any)?.projects || [];
    const p = globalProjects.find((proj: any) => 
      (proj.code && String(proj.code).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower) ||
      (proj.id && String(proj.id).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower) ||
      (proj.name && String(proj.name).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower) ||
      ((proj as any).unit && String((proj as any).unit).toLowerCase().trim() === qLower)
    );
    if (p) {
      const pFloor = (p.location && p.location !== 'all' && p.location !== 'ALL') ? p.location : ((p as any).floor || extractFloorFromCodeOrName(p.code) || extractFloorFromCodeOrName((p as any).unit));
      if (pFloor && pFloor.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
        const pLoc = String(pFloor).trim().toUpperCase();
        const verForLoc = availableStoreVersions.find((v: any) => 
          String(v.location || '').trim().toUpperCase() === pLoc
        );
        if (verForLoc) return verForLoc;
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  // 3. Fallback: If q contains floor pattern (e.g. "L3-303-1" -> "L3")
  const qFloor = extractFloorFromCodeOrName(q);
  if (qFloor && qFloor.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
    const floorLoc = qFloor.toUpperCase();
    const verForLoc = availableStoreVersions.find((v: any) => 
      String(v.location || '').trim().toUpperCase() === floorLoc
    );
    if (verForLoc) return verForLoc;
  }

  return null;
}

export function hasAggregatedDataChanged(prev: any, next: any): boolean {
  if (!prev || !next) return true;
  return (
    prev.code !== next.code ||
    prev.status !== next.status ||
    prev.budget !== next.budget ||
    prev.actual !== next.actual ||
    prev.commentsCount !== next.commentsCount ||
    prev.planProgress !== next.planProgress ||
    prev.actProgress !== next.actProgress ||
    prev.matchedTasksCount !== next.matchedTasksCount
  );
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/layoutTabSearchUtils.ts ==================== */
export interface UnitSuggestionItem {
  unit: string;
  location?: string;
  brand?: string;
  project?: string;
  code?: string;
  description?: string;
}

export const extractFloorFromCodeOrName = (str?: string | null): string | null => {
  if (!str) return null;
  const s = String(str).trim();
  const m = s.match(/(?:^|[^a-zA-Z0-9])(B\d|L\d|\d+F|\d+L|GF|MF|RF|BASEMENT\s*\d?|LEVEL\s*\d?|FLOOR\s*\d?)(?:[^a-zA-Z0-9]|$)/i);
  if (m) {
    let token = m[1].toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (token.startsWith('BASEMENT')) token = token.replace('BASEMENT', 'B') || 'B1';
    if (token.startsWith('LEVEL')) token = token.replace('LEVEL', 'L') || 'L1';
    if (token.startsWith('FLOOR')) token = token.replace('FLOOR', 'L') || 'L1';
    if (/^\d+F$/.test(token)) token = 'L' + token.replace('F', '');
    if (/^\d+L$/.test(token)) token = 'L' + token.replace('L', '');
    return token;
  }
  return null;
};

export const isValidUrl = (val: any): boolean => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return false;
  const str = String(val).trim();
  if (str === '' || str === '0' || str === '_' || str.toLowerCase() === 'null') return false;
  return true;
};

export function buildUnitSuggestions(
  storeUnits: any[],
  projects: any[],
  activeStore: string,
  availableLocations: string[],
  isAdmin: boolean
): UnitSuggestionItem[] {
  const map = new globalThis.Map<string, UnitSuggestionItem>();
  const allowedLocsSet = new Set(availableLocations.map(l => String(l).toLowerCase().trim()));

  storeUnits.forEach((u: any) => {
    if (u?.name) {
      let loc = u.location || '';
      if (!loc) {
        const m = String(u.name).match(/^(L\d|B\d|\d+F|\d+L|GF|MF|RF)/i);
        if (m) loc = m[1].toUpperCase();
      }
      if (isAdmin || !loc || allowedLocsSet.has(loc.toLowerCase().trim())) {
        const uName = String(u.name).trim();
        const key = `${uName.toLowerCase()}_${loc.toLowerCase().trim()}`;
        map.set(key, {
          unit: uName,
          location: loc,
          brand: '',
          project: '',
          code: uName
        });
      }
    }
  });

  projects.forEach((p: any) => {
    if (!p.store || p.store === activeStore || activeStore === 'all') {
      let loc = p.location || '';
      if (!loc) {
        const m = String(p.code || p.unit || '').match(/^(L\d|B\d|\d+F|\d+L|GF|MF|RF)/i);
        if (m) loc = m[1].toUpperCase();
      }
      if (isAdmin || !loc || allowedLocsSet.has(loc.toLowerCase().trim())) {
        const primaryCode = String(p.unit || p.code || p.name || '').trim();
        if (primaryCode) {
          const key = `${primaryCode.toLowerCase()}_${(p.code || '').toLowerCase().trim()}_${loc.toLowerCase().trim()}`;
          const existing = map.get(key) || { unit: primaryCode, location: loc, brand: '', project: '', code: '', description: '' };
          const desc = p.detail || (p as any).description || p.note || '';
          map.set(key, {
            unit: primaryCode,
            location: loc || existing.location || '',
            brand: p.brandName || existing.brand || '',
            project: p.name || existing.project || '',
            code: p.code || existing.code || primaryCode,
            description: desc || existing.description || ''
          });
        }
      }
    }
  });

  return Array.from(map.values());
}

export function scoreAndFilterUnitSuggestions(
  unitSuggestions: UnitSuggestionItem[],
  unitSearchInput: string,
  currentLocationFilter: string
): UnitSuggestionItem[] {
  if (!unitSearchInput.trim()) return [];
  
  const norm = (s: string) =>
    (s || '')
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize('NFD')
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
      .trim();

  const qRaw = unitSearchInput.toLowerCase().trim();
  const q = norm(unitSearchInput);
  const currentLoc = norm(currentLocationFilter || '');

  const scoredList: Array<{ item: UnitSuggestionItem; score: number }> = [];

  unitSuggestions.forEach((item) => {
    const uRaw = (item.unit || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const bRaw = (item.brand || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const pRaw = (item.project || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const cRaw = (item.code || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const lRaw = (item.location || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const dRaw = (item.description || '').toLowerCase().trim();

    const uNorm = norm(item.unit);
    const bNorm = norm(item.brand || '');
    const pNorm = norm(item.project || '');
    const cNorm = norm(item.code || '');
    const lNorm = norm(item.location || '');
    const dNorm = norm(item.description || '');

    let score = 0;

    if (bNorm === q || bRaw === qRaw) score = 12000;
    else if (uNorm === q || uRaw === qRaw) score = 11000;
    else if (cNorm === q || cRaw === qRaw) score = 10000;
    else if (pNorm === q || pRaw === qRaw) score = 9000;
    else if (bNorm.startsWith(q) || bRaw.startsWith(qRaw)) score = 8000;
    else if (uNorm.startsWith(q) || uRaw.startsWith(qRaw)) score = 7000;
    else if (cNorm.startsWith(q) || cRaw.startsWith(qRaw)) score = 6000;
    else if (pNorm.startsWith(q) || pRaw.startsWith(qRaw)) score = 5000;
    else {
      const bWords = bNorm.split(/[\s\-_\/.,;]+/);
      const uWords = uNorm.split(/[\s\-_\/.,;]+/);
      const cWords = cNorm.split(/[\s\-_\/.,;]+/);
      const pWords = pNorm.split(/[\s\-_\/.,;]+/);
      const dWords = dNorm.split(/[\s\-_\/.,;]+/);

      if (bWords.some(w => w.startsWith(q))) score = 4000;
      else if (uWords.some(w => w.startsWith(q))) score = 3500;
      else if (cWords.some(w => w.startsWith(q))) score = 3000;
      else if (pWords.some(w => w.startsWith(q))) score = 2500;
      else if (dWords.some(w => w.startsWith(q))) score = 2200;
      else if (bNorm.includes(q) || bRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 2000;
      else if (uNorm.includes(q) || uRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 1700;
      else if (cNorm.includes(q) || cRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 1400;
      else if (pNorm.includes(q) || pRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 1100;
      else if (dNorm.includes(q) || dRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 900;
      else if (lNorm.includes(q) || lRaw.includes(qRaw)) score = 600;
    }

    if (score > 0) {
      const matchLen = (bNorm.includes(q) ? bNorm.length : (uNorm.includes(q) ? uNorm.length : (cNorm.includes(q) ? cNorm.length : pNorm.length))) || 50;
      score += Math.max(0, 100 - Math.min(matchLen, 100));

      if (currentLoc && lNorm === currentLoc) {
        score += 50;
      }

      scoredList.push({ item, score });
    }
  });

  scoredList.sort((a, b) => {
    if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
    return (a.item.unit || '').localeCompare(b.item.unit || '');
  });

  return scoredList.map(s => s.item);
}

export function resolveTargetFloorForUnit(
  unitItem: { unit: string; location?: string; brand?: string; project?: string; code?: string },
  projects: any[]
): string {
  if (unitItem.location && unitItem.location.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
    return String(unitItem.location).trim().toUpperCase();
  }
  const qCode = String(unitItem.unit).trim().toLowerCase();
  const matchedP = projects.find(p => 
    ((p as any).unit && String((p as any).unit).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (p.code && String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (p.name && String(p.name).trim().toLowerCase() === String(unitItem.project || '').trim().toLowerCase())
  );
  if (matchedP?.location && matchedP.location.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
    return String(matchedP.location).trim().toUpperCase();
  }
  const extracted = extractFloorFromCodeOrName(unitItem.unit) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(matchedP?.code) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(matchedP?.name);
  return extracted || '';
}

export function resolveInitialTargetLocation(
  initialLocation: string,
  initialProjectCode: string,
  projects: any[],
  tasks: any[],
  allStoreVersions: any[],
  unitInfo: any[]
): string {
  let targetLoc = (initialLocation && initialLocation !== 'all') ? String(initialLocation).trim().toUpperCase() : '';
  if (!initialProjectCode || targetLoc) return targetLoc;

  const qCode = String(initialProjectCode).trim().toLowerCase();

  // 1. Search in projects
  const matched = projects.find(p => 
    (p.code && String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    ((p as any).unit && String((p as any).unit).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (p.name && String(p.name).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (p.id && String(p.id).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode)
  );
  if (matched?.location && matched.location.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
    return String(matched.location).trim().toUpperCase();
  }

  // 2. Search in project tasks
  const matchedTask = tasks.find(t => 
    (t.projectCode && String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (matched?.id && (t as any).projectId === matched.id)
  );
  if ((matchedTask as any)?.location && (matchedTask as any).location.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
    return String((matchedTask as any).location).trim().toUpperCase();
  }

  // 3. Search in unitInfo
  const matchedUInfo = unitInfo.find((u: any) => 
    (u.unit && String(u.unit).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (u.name && String(u.name).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
    (u.unitId && String(u.unitId).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode)
  );
  if (matchedUInfo?.floor || matchedUInfo?.location) {
    return String(matchedUInfo.floor || matchedUInfo.location).trim().toUpperCase();
  }

  // 4. Search in store versions
  for (const v of allStoreVersions) {
    if (!v.location) continue;
    if (v.groupMappings) {
      const hasUnit = Object.values(v.groupMappings).some((arr: any) => 
        Array.isArray(arr) && arr.some(id => String(id).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode)
      );
      if (hasUnit) {
        return String(v.location).trim().toUpperCase();
      }
    }
    if ((v as any).mapUnits && Array.isArray((v as any).mapUnits)) {
      const hasUnit = (v as any).mapUnits.some((u: any) => 
        (u.name && String(u.name).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode) ||
        (u.id && String(u.id).trim().toLowerCase() === qCode)
      );
      if (hasUnit) {
        return String(v.location).trim().toUpperCase();
      }
    }
  }

  // 5. Regex extraction
  const extracted = extractFloorFromCodeOrName(initialProjectCode) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(matched?.code) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName(matched?.name) ||
    extractFloorFromCodeOrName((matched as any)?.unit);

  return extracted || '';
}

export function sortLocationsByFloorRank(locList: string[]): string[] {
  const floorRank = (name: string) => {
    const n = name.toUpperCase().trim();
    if (n.startsWith('B')) {
      const num = parseInt(n.replace('B', ''), 10) || 1;
      return -100 + num;
    }
    if (n === 'GF' || n === 'G') return 0;
    if (n === 'MF' || n === 'M') return 0.5;
    if (n.startsWith('L')) {
      const num = parseInt(n.replace('L', ''), 10) || 1;
      return num;
    }
    if (/^\d+F$/.test(n)) {
      return parseInt(n.replace('F', ''), 10) || 1;
    }
    return 100;
  };

  return [...locList].sort((a, b) => floorRank(a) - floorRank(b) || a.localeCompare(b));
}

export interface ContrastStyle {
  text: string;
  shapeStroke: string;
}

// Calculate high-contrast text color based on background perceived luminance (No drop shadow, razor-sharp vector text)
export function getContrastStyle(hexColor: string): ContrastStyle {
  if (!hexColor || typeof hexColor !== 'string') {
    return {
      text: '#ffffff',
      shapeStroke: '#ffffff',
    };
  }
  let c = hexColor.replace('#', '').trim();
  if (c.length === 3) c = c.split('').map(x => x + x).join('');
  if (c.length !== 6) {
    return {
      text: '#ffffff',
      shapeStroke: '#ffffff',
    };
  }
  const r = parseInt(c.substring(0, 2), 16) || 0;
  const g = parseInt(c.substring(2, 4), 16) || 0;
  const b = parseInt(c.substring(4, 6), 16) || 0;
  // Perceived luminance (YIQ standard)
  const yiq = (r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) / 1000;
  
  if (yiq >= 145) {
    // Light / bright color background -> Crisp deep dark slate text (#0f172a)
    return {
      text: '#0f172a',
      shapeStroke: '#1e293b',
    };
  } else {
    // Dark / saturated color background -> Crisp pure white text (#ffffff)
    return {
      text: '#ffffff',
      shapeStroke: '#ffffff',
    };
  }
}

  centerY: number;
}

  clientY?: number;
  unitScreenBounds?: UnitScreenBounds;
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/useLayoutAggregates.ts ==================== */
import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { useSummaryData } from '../PictureMapping/lib/summaryData';
import { useDataStore } from '../PictureMapping/DataContext';
import { useDynamicUnitSummary } from '../PictureMapping/lib/dynamicSummaryEngine';
import { buildAggregatedUnitData } from './layoutDataAggregator';

const EMPTY_RESTRICTED_SET = new Set<string>();

interface UseLayoutAggregatesProps {
  units: any[];
  version: any;
  storeFilter: string;
  locationFilter: string;
  targetLoc: string;
  effectiveLayoutYear: string;
  hasStoredUnitImages: (key: string | undefined | null, store?: string) => boolean;
  unitImagesRev: number;
  focusedUnitId: string | null;
  filterOnlyAlerts: boolean;
  deferredSearchQuery: string;
  stageScale: number;
  stagePos: { x: number; y: number };
  dimensions: { width: number; height: number };
}

export function useLayoutAggregates({
  units,
  version,
  storeFilter,
  locationFilter,
  targetLoc,
  effectiveLayoutYear,
  hasStoredUnitImages,
  unitImagesRev,
  focusedUnitId,
  filterOnlyAlerts,
  deferredSearchQuery,
  stageScale,
  stagePos,
  dimensions,
}: UseLayoutAggregatesProps) {
  const { enrichedProjects, filteredTasks: tasks } = useEnrichedData();
  const allProjects = useAppStore(state => state.projects);
  const currUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser);
  const delegationGroups = useAppStore(state => state.delegationGroups);
  const layoutTooltipVisibility = useAppStore(state => state.layoutTooltipVisibility);
  const summaryData = useSummaryData({ store: storeFilter, location: targetLoc, year: effectiveLayoutYear });

  // Compute set of project codes that the current user is NOT allowed to access (RBAC)
  const restrictedProjectCodes = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currUser || currUser.role === 'admin') return EMPTY_RESTRICTED_SET;

    const allowedCodeSet = new Set<string>();
    enrichedProjects.forEach(p => {
      if (p.code) allowedCodeSet.add(String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase());
      if (p.linkCodes) {
        p.linkCodes.split(/[+;,/]/).forEach(c => {
          if (c.trim()) allowedCodeSet.add(c.trim().toLowerCase());
        });
      }
    });

    const restrictedSet = new Set<string>();
    allProjects.forEach(p => {
      const rawCodes = (p.linkCodes && p.linkCodes.trim()) ? p.linkCodes : String(p.code || '');
      const pCodes = rawCodes.split(/[+;,/]/).map(c => c.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
      pCodes.forEach(code => {
        if (!allowedCodeSet.has(code)) {
          restrictedSet.add(code);
        }
      });
    });

    return restrictedSet;
  }, [allProjects, enrichedProjects, currUser]);

  // Build aggregatedData using pure aggregation engine
  const aggregatedData = useMemo(() => {
    const projectLinkData = useDataStore.getState().projectLink || [];
    return buildAggregatedUnitData({
      units,
      summaryData,
      enrichedProjects,
      tasks,
      projectLinkData,
      storeFilter,
      locationFilter,
      targetLoc,
      effectiveLayoutYear,
      delegationGroups,
      layoutTooltipVisibility,
      restrictedProjectCodes,
      hasStoredUnitImages,
    });
  }, [units, summaryData, enrichedProjects, tasks, storeFilter, locationFilter, targetLoc, effectiveLayoutYear, delegationGroups, layoutTooltipVisibility, restrictedProjectCodes, hasStoredUnitImages, unitImagesRev]);

  const { summaryMap: dynamicSummaryMap } = useDynamicUnitSummary({
    units,
    activeVersion: version,
    store: (version?.store as any) || (storeFilter === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM'),
    location: version?.location || targetLoc,
    year: effectiveLayoutYear,
  });

  // Evaluate rules on the fly: STRICTLY depends ONLY on Task Summaries & Projects in active Year, Store, Location!
  const { unitColorMap, unitGroupMap, unitOpacityMap, activeGroups } = useMemo(() => {
    const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {};
    const groupMap: Record<string, string> = {};
    const opacityMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    const groupsInUseMap = new Map<string, any>();
    
    if (!version || !version.groups) return { unitColorMap: colorMap, unitGroupMap: groupMap, unitOpacityMap: opacityMap, activeGroups: [] };

    units.forEach((u: any) => {
      const uName = String(u.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
      if (restrictedProjectCodes.has(uName) || aggregatedData[uName]?.isRestricted) return;

      const dynamicItem = dynamicSummaryMap.get(u.id) || (uName ? dynamicSummaryMap.get(uName) : null);
      if (!dynamicItem?.hasAppProject) {
        return;
      }

      if (dynamicItem.matchedGroupId && dynamicItem.color) {
        colorMap[u.id] = dynamicItem.color;
        groupMap[u.id] = dynamicItem.matchedGroupId;
        opacityMap[u.id] = dynamicItem.opacity ?? 0.85;
      }
    });

    const matchedUnitsByGroup = new Map<string, any[]>();
    units.forEach((u: any) => {
      const gid = groupMap[u.id];
      if (gid) {
        let list = matchedUnitsByGroup.get(gid);
        if (!list) {
          list = [];
          matchedUnitsByGroup.set(gid, list);
        }
        list.push({ id: u.id, name: u.name });
      }
    });

    version.groups.forEach((group: any) => {
      const matchedUnits = matchedUnitsByGroup.get(group.id) || [];
      if (matchedUnits.length > 0) {
        groupsInUseMap.set(group.id, { ...group, matchCount: matchedUnits.length, matchedUnits });
      }
    });

    return { unitColorMap: colorMap, unitGroupMap: groupMap, unitOpacityMap: opacityMap, activeGroups: Array.from(groupsInUseMap.values()) };
  }, [version?.groups, units, aggregatedData, dynamicSummaryMap, restrictedProjectCodes]);

  // Total count of units with alerts on this floor
  const totalFloorAlerts = useMemo(() => {
    let count = 0;
    units.forEach((u: any) => {
      const uName = (u?.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
      if (uName && aggregatedData[uName]?.alerts?.hasAlert) {
        count++;
      }
    });
    return count;
  }, [units, aggregatedData]);

  // Filter only units and precalculate bounds
  const displayedUnits = useMemo(() => {
    return units
      .filter((unit: any) => {
        if (unit.visible === false) return false;

        const uName = (unit.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        const uData = (uName && aggregatedData[uName]) ? aggregatedData[uName] : {};
        const isRestricted = restrictedProjectCodes.has(uName) || uData?.isRestricted;

        if (isRestricted) {
          return false;
        }

        const isFocused = focusedUnitId === unit.id;

        if (filterOnlyAlerts && !isFocused) {
          if (!uData?.alerts?.hasAlert) {
            return false;
          }
        }

        if (deferredSearchQuery.trim()) {
          const q = deferredSearchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
          const matchName = (unit.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
          const matchBrand = (uData.brandName || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
          const matchProject = (uData.projectName || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
          const matchCode = (uData.appProjectCode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
          const matchDesc = (uData.appProjectDescription || uData.appDescription || uData.appProjectDetail || uData.appDetail || uData.detail || uData.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
          if (!matchName && !matchBrand && !matchProject && !matchCode && !matchDesc) {
            return false;
          }
        }
        return true;
      })
      .map((unit: any) => {
        const targetColor = unitColorMap[unit.id] || null;
        const targetOpacity = unitOpacityMap[unit.id] ?? 0.85;
        
        let minX = 0;
        let maxX = 0;
        let minY = 0;
        let maxY = 0;
        let textX = unit.x || 0;
        let textY = unit.y || 0;
        let textWidth = 100;
        let textHeight = 30;

        let svgPath = '';
        if (unit.type === 'rect') {
          minX = unit.x || 0;
          minY = unit.y || 0;
          maxX = minX + (unit.width || 100);
          maxY = minY + (unit.height || 30);
          textX = minX;
          textY = minY;
          textWidth = unit.width || 100;
          textHeight = unit.height || 30;
        } else if (unit.type === 'circle') {
          const r = unit.radius || 20;
          minX = (unit.x || 0) - r;
          maxX = (unit.x || 0) + r;
          minY = (unit.y || 0) - r;
          maxY = (unit.y || 0) + r;
          textX = minX;
          textY = minY;
          textWidth = r * 2;
          textHeight = r * 2;
        } else if (unit.type === 'polygon' && unit.points && unit.points.length >= 2) {
          minX = Infinity;
          maxX = -Infinity;
          minY = Infinity;
          maxY = -Infinity;
          let pathStr = `M ${unit.points[0]} ${unit.points[1]}`;
          for (let i = 0; i < unit.points.length; i += 2) {
            const px = unit.points[i];
            const py = unit.points[i + 1];
            if (px < minX) minX = px;
            if (px > maxX) maxX = px;
            if (py < minY) minY = py;
            if (py > maxY) maxY = py;
            if (i > 0) {
              pathStr += ` L ${px} ${py}`;
            }
          }
          pathStr += ' Z';
          svgPath = pathStr;
          if (minX === Infinity) { minX = 0; maxX = 100; minY = 0; maxY = 30; }
          const offsetX = unit.x || 0;
          const offsetY = unit.y || 0;
          minX = minX + offsetX;
          maxX = maxX + offsetX;
          minY = minY + offsetY;
          maxY = maxY + offsetY;
          textX = minX;
          textY = minY;
          textWidth = Math.max(20, maxX - minX);
          textHeight = Math.max(20, maxY - minY);
        }

        return {
          ...unit,
          targetColor,
          targetOpacity,
          targetGroupId: unitGroupMap[unit.id],
          minX,
          maxX,
          minY,
          maxY,
          svgPath,
          textX,
          textY,
          textWidth,
          textHeight,
        };
      });
  }, [units, unitColorMap, unitGroupMap, unitOpacityMap, deferredSearchQuery, aggregatedData, dynamicSummaryMap, focusedUnitId, filterOnlyAlerts]);

  // Focused unit object for Isolated Overlay Highlight Layer
  const focusedUnit = useMemo(() => {
    if (!focusedUnitId) return null;
    return displayedUnits.find((u: any) => u.id === focusedUnitId) || null;
  }, [displayedUnits, focusedUnitId]);

  // Viewport Spatial Culling (Loại bỏ các shape nằm ngoài khung nhìn khi Zoom để tối ưu GPU/FPS)
  const prevVisibleUnitsRef = useRef<any[]>([]);
  const prevVisibleUnitsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const visibleUnits = useMemo(() => {
    const scale = stageScale || 1;
    const vpW = dimensions.width || 800;
    const vpH = dimensions.height || 600;

    let filtered = displayedUnits;
    if (scale > 0.35 && displayedUnits.length > 40) {
      const bufferPadding = Math.max(150, 300 / scale);
      const minWorldX = (-stagePos.x / scale) - bufferPadding;
      const maxWorldX = ((vpW - stagePos.x) / scale) + bufferPadding;
      const minWorldY = (-stagePos.y / scale) - bufferPadding;
      const maxWorldY = ((vpH - stagePos.y) / scale) + bufferPadding;

      filtered = displayedUnits.filter((unit: any) => {
        if (unit.id === focusedUnitId || deferredSearchQuery.trim()) {
          return true;
        }

        const uMinX = unit.minX ?? unit.x ?? 0;
        const uMaxX = unit.maxX ?? (uMinX + (unit.width || 100));
        const uMinY = unit.minY ?? unit.y ?? 0;
        const uMaxY = unit.maxY ?? (uMinY + (unit.height || 30));

        return uMaxX >= minWorldX && uMinX <= maxWorldX && uMaxY >= minWorldY && uMinY <= maxWorldY;
      });
    }

    if (filtered === displayedUnits) {
      return displayedUnits;
    }

    const key = `${effectiveLayoutYear}_${storeFilter}_${targetLoc}_` + filtered.map((u: any) => `${u.id}:${u.targetColor || ''}:${u.targetGroupId || ''}:${u.targetOpacity ?? ''}`).join('|');
    if (key === prevVisibleUnitsKeyRef.current) {
      return prevVisibleUnitsRef.current;
    }
    prevVisibleUnitsKeyRef.current = key;
    prevVisibleUnitsRef.current = filtered;
    return filtered;
  }, [displayedUnits, stageScale, stagePos.x, stagePos.y, dimensions.width, dimensions.height, focusedUnitId, deferredSearchQuery, effectiveLayoutYear, storeFilter, targetLoc]);

  // Security defense: If non-admin user has NO accessible tasks or projects in this store & year, do not render layout
  const hasUserAccessInStoreYear = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currUser || currUser.role === 'admin') return true;

    const isInternalRole = ['manager', 'staff', 'cp'].includes(String(currUser.role || '').toLowerCase());
    const hasStorePerm = storeFilter === 'HN'
      ? Boolean(currUser.storePermissions?.hn)
      : (storeFilter === 'HCM' ? Boolean(currUser.storePermissions?.hcm) : true);

    if (isInternalRole && hasStorePerm && !currUser.byPartyAccess) {
      return true;
    }

    const yr = effectiveLayoutYear;
    if (yr === 'all') return true;
    const hasProj = enrichedProjects.some(p => {
      if (storeFilter !== 'all') {
        const pStore = String(p.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
        if (pStore && pStore !== storeFilter.toUpperCase()) return false;
      }
      const pYear = String(p.year || '').trim();
      return pYear === yr;
    });
    if (hasProj) return true;
    const hasTask = tasks.some(t => {
      if (storeFilter !== 'all') {
        const tStore = String(t.projectStore || '').toUpperCase().trim();
        if (tStore && tStore !== storeFilter.toUpperCase()) return false;
      }
      const tYear = String(t.projectYear || '').trim();
      return tYear === yr;
    });
    return hasTask;
  }, [currUser, enrichedProjects, tasks, storeFilter, effectiveLayoutYear]);

  return {
    aggregatedData,
    activeGroups,
    totalFloorAlerts,
    displayedUnits,
    focusedUnit,
    visibleUnits,
    hasUserAccessInStoreYear,
    restrictedProjectCodes,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/useLayoutFloorData.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { useDataStore } from '../PictureMapping/DataContext';
import { preloadFloorImages } from '../../lib/imageDBCache';
import { resolveR2UrlToHttp } from '../PictureMapping/lib/r2Upload';
import { useOffscreenImage } from '../../hooks/useOffscreenImage';

interface UseLayoutFloorDataProps {
  config: any;
  storeFilter: string;
  locationFilter: string;
  yearFilter?: string;
}

export function useLayoutFloorData({
  config,
  storeFilter,
  locationFilter,
  yearFilter,
}: UseLayoutFloorDataProps) {
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const localStoreLocationData = useDataStore((state) => state.storeLocationData);
  const localStore = useDataStore((state) => state.store);
  const localLocation = useDataStore((state) => state.location);
  const localMapUnits = useDataStore((state) => state.mapUnits);
  const localMapVersions = useDataStore((state) => state.mapVersions);
  const localActiveMapVersionId = useDataStore((state) => state.activeMapVersionId);
  const getAllStoreVersions = useDataStore((state) => state.getAllStoreVersions);

  const [selectedVersionId, setSelectedVersionId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const targetLoc = locationFilter !== 'all' ? locationFilter : 'L1';

  const activeYear = (
    (yearFilter && yearFilter !== 'all' ? yearFilter : '') ||
    (globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== 'all' ? globalYearFilter : '') ||
    (storeFilter === 'HN' ? '2027' : '2026')
  ).trim();

  // 1. Gather all store versions across all sources (Zustand helper, local partitions, cloud partitions, and root config)
  const prevAvailVersionsRef = useRef<any[]>([]);
  const prevAvailVersionsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const availableStoreVersions = useMemo(() => {
    const versionsMap = new Map<string, any>();

    // From Zustand store helper
    try {
      const targetStoreParam = (storeFilter === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM');
      const storeVers = getAllStoreVersions(targetStoreParam);
      if (Array.isArray(storeVers)) {
        storeVers.forEach(v => {
          if (v?.id) versionsMap.set(v.id, v);
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // From local in-memory partitions
    if (localStoreLocationData) {
      Object.entries(localStoreLocationData).forEach(([key, part]: [string, any]) => {
        if (key.startsWith(`${storeFilter}_`) && Array.isArray(part?.mapVersions)) {
          part.mapVersions.forEach((v: any) => {
            if (v?.id) versionsMap.set(v.id, { ...v, location: v.location || key.split('_')[1] });
          });
        }
      });
    }

    // From cloud config partitions
    if (config?.storeLocationData) {
      Object.entries(config.storeLocationData).forEach(([key, part]: [string, any]) => {
        if (key.startsWith(`${storeFilter}_`) && Array.isArray(part?.mapVersions)) {
          part.mapVersions.forEach((v: any) => {
            if (v?.id) {
              const existing = versionsMap.get(v.id) || {};
              const resolvedBg = (existing.backgroundUrl && !existing.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://'))
                ? existing.backgroundUrl
                : (v.backgroundUrl && !v.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://'))
                  ? v.backgroundUrl
                  : (existing.backgroundUrl || v.backgroundUrl);
              versionsMap.set(v.id, { 
                ...v, 
                ...existing, 
                backgroundUrl: resolvedBg,
                location: existing.location || v.location || key.split('_')[1] 
              });
            }
          });
        }
      });
    }
