    // From cloud config root versions (legacy fallback for HCM only)
    if (storeFilter === 'HCM' && Array.isArray(config?.versions)) {
      config.versions.forEach((v: any) => {
        if (v?.id) {
          const existing = versionsMap.get(v.id) || {};
          const resolvedBg = (existing.backgroundUrl && !existing.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://'))
            ? existing.backgroundUrl
            : (v.backgroundUrl && !v.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://'))
              ? v.backgroundUrl
              : (existing.backgroundUrl || v.backgroundUrl);
          versionsMap.set(v.id, { 
            ...v, 
            ...existing, 
            backgroundUrl: resolvedBg,
            store: existing.store || v.store || 'HCM' 
          });
        }
      });
    }

    const finalVersions = Array.from(versionsMap.values());
    const key = `${storeFilter}_${finalVersions.map(v => `${v?.id || ''}_${v?.backgroundUrl || ''}`).join('|')}`;
    if (key === prevAvailVersionsKeyRef.current) {
      return prevAvailVersionsRef.current;
    }
    prevAvailVersionsKeyRef.current = key;
    prevAvailVersionsRef.current = finalVersions;
    return finalVersions;
  }, [getAllStoreVersions, storeFilter, localStoreLocationData, config]);

  // Pre-cache all floor maps for this store into IndexedDB
  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableStoreVersions.length > 0) {
      const urls = availableStoreVersions
        .map(v => v?.backgroundUrl)
        .filter((u): u is string => typeof u === 'string' && u.length > 0 && !u.startsWith('r2://'));
      if (urls.length > 0) {
        preloadFloorImages(urls);
      }
    }
  }, [availableStoreVersions]);

  // 2. Filter versions specific to targetLoc (e.g. L2) and year from Picture Mapping / global setting
  const prevLocationVersionsRef = useRef<any[]>([]);
  const prevLocationVersionsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const locationVersions = useMemo(() => {
    if (availableStoreVersions.length === 0) return [];
    
    const tLoc = targetLoc.toUpperCase().trim();
    const tokenRegex = new RegExp(`(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9])${tLoc}([^a-zA-Z0-9]|$)`, 'i');

    const matched = availableStoreVersions.filter(v => {
      const vLoc = (v.location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      const vName = (v.name || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      return vLoc === tLoc || (vLoc === '' && tokenRegex.test(vName));
    });

    let result = matched;
    if (matched.length === 0) {
      result = [];
    } else if (activeYear && activeYear !== 'all') {
      const targetYear = String(activeYear).trim();
      const yearMatched = matched.filter(v => String(v.year || '').trim() === targetYear);
      if (yearMatched.length > 0) {
        result = yearMatched;
      } else {
        result = [...matched].sort((a, b) => {
          const yA = Number(a.year) || 0;
          const yB = Number(b.year) || 0;
          return yB - yA;
        });
      }
    }

    const key = `${targetLoc}_${activeYear}_${result.map(v => v?.id || '').join('|')}`;
    if (key === prevLocationVersionsKeyRef.current) {
      return prevLocationVersionsRef.current;
    }
    prevLocationVersionsKeyRef.current = key;
    prevLocationVersionsRef.current = result;
    return result;
  }, [availableStoreVersions, targetLoc, activeYear]);

  // 3. Resolve active version & units
  const { r2Version, r2Units } = useMemo(() => {
    const targetStoreParam = (storeFilter === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM') as 'HCM' | 'HN';
    const tLoc = targetLoc.toUpperCase().trim();
    const pKey = `${targetStoreParam}_${tLoc}`;
    
    const localPart = localStoreLocationData?.[pKey] || (
      localStore === targetStoreParam && String(localLocation).toUpperCase().trim() === tLoc
        ? { mapUnits: localMapUnits, mapVersions: localMapVersions, activeMapVersionId: localActiveMapVersionId }
        : null
    );
    const cloudPart = config?.storeLocationData?.[pKey];
    const partition = (localPart && Array.isArray(localPart.mapVersions) && localPart.mapVersions.length > 0)
      ? localPart
      : cloudPart;

    // Pick version: check selectedVersionId first, then localActiveMapVersionId from Picture tab, then partition.activeMapVersionId, then matching location versions
    let v: any = null;
    if (selectedVersionId && locationVersions.some(lv => lv.id === selectedVersionId)) {
      v = locationVersions.find(lv => lv.id === selectedVersionId);
    } else if (localActiveMapVersionId && locationVersions.some(lv => lv.id === localActiveMapVersionId)) {
      v = locationVersions.find(lv => lv.id === localActiveMapVersionId);
    } else if (partition?.activeMapVersionId && locationVersions.some(lv => lv.id === partition.activeMapVersionId)) {
      v = locationVersions.find(lv => lv.id === partition.activeMapVersionId);
    } else if (locationVersions.length > 0) {
      // Prioritize version for this floor with dynamic rules or groups
      v = locationVersions.find(lv => lv.isDynamicActive !== false && Array.isArray(lv.groups) && lv.groups.length > 0) ||
          locationVersions.find(lv => Array.isArray(lv.groups) && lv.groups.length > 0) ||
          locationVersions[0];
    }

    if (!v) {
      return { r2Version: null, r2Units: [] };
    }

    // Resolve backgroundUrl if empty or r2://
    let bgUrl = v.backgroundUrl || '';
    if (!bgUrl || bgUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
      // Scan all cloud partitions and versions for resolved signed URL
      if (cloudPart?.mapVersions) {
        const matchingCloudV = cloudPart.mapVersions.find((cv: any) => cv.id === v.id || cv.name === v.name);
        if (matchingCloudV?.backgroundUrl && !matchingCloudV.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
          bgUrl = matchingCloudV.backgroundUrl;
        }
      }
      if ((!bgUrl || bgUrl.startsWith('r2://')) && config?.storeLocationData) {
        for (const part of Object.values(config.storeLocationData) as any[]) {
          const matchingCloudV = part?.mapVersions?.find((cv: any) => cv.id === v.id || cv.name === v.name);
          if (matchingCloudV?.backgroundUrl && !matchingCloudV.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
            bgUrl = matchingCloudV.backgroundUrl;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      if ((!bgUrl || bgUrl.startsWith('r2://')) && config?.version?.backgroundUrl && !config.version.backgroundUrl.startsWith('r2://')) {
        if (config.version.id === v.id || config.version.name === v.name) {
          bgUrl = config.version.backgroundUrl;
        }
      }
    }
    const finalVersion = { ...v, backgroundUrl: bgUrl };
    const vLoc = (finalVersion.location || targetLoc || '').toUpperCase().trim();

    let candidateUnits: any[] = [];
    if (Array.isArray(finalVersion?.mapUnits) && finalVersion.mapUnits.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = finalVersion.mapUnits;
    } else if (localStore === targetStoreParam && String(localLocation).toUpperCase().trim() === tLoc && Array.isArray(localMapUnits) && localMapUnits.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = localMapUnits;
    } else if (localStoreLocationData?.[pKey]?.mapUnits && Array.isArray(localStoreLocationData[pKey].mapUnits) && localStoreLocationData[pKey].mapUnits.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = localStoreLocationData[pKey].mapUnits;
    } else if (config?.storeLocationData?.[pKey]?.mapUnits && Array.isArray(config.storeLocationData[pKey].mapUnits) && config.storeLocationData[pKey].mapUnits.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = config.storeLocationData[pKey].mapUnits;
    } else if (targetStoreParam === 'HCM' && Array.isArray(config?.mapUnits) && config.mapUnits.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = config.mapUnits;
    } else if (targetStoreParam === 'HCM' && Array.isArray(config?.units) && config.units.length > 0) {
      candidateUnits = config.units;
    }

    // Sanitize, filter strictly to target floor & year, and deduplicate overlapping ghost shapes
    const unitsMap = new Map<string, any>();
    const seenCoordinates = new Map<string, string>(); // geometryKey -> id
    const seenUnitNames = new Map<string, string>(); // lowercase clean unit name -> id

    candidateUnits.forEach((u: any) => {
      if (!u || (!u.id && !u.name)) return;
      if (!u.type && !u.points && !(u.width && u.height)) return;

      const uLoc = String(u.location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      const uStore = String(u.store || '').toUpperCase().trim();

      // Store check
      if (uStore && uStore !== 'ALL' && uStore !== targetStoreParam) return;

      // Year check
      const uYr = String(u.year || '').trim();
      if (uYr && uYr !== 'ALL' && activeYear && activeYear !== 'all' && uYr !== activeYear) return;

      // Strict Floor check: accept units explicitly matching current floor, matching active version floor, or storewide
      const isStorewideUnit = uLoc === 'STORE' || uLoc === 'ALL' || uLoc === 'STOREWIDE' || uLoc === 'ALL FLOORS';
      if (uLoc && !isStorewideUnit && uLoc !== tLoc && uLoc !== vLoc) {
        return;
      }

      const id = String(u.id || u.name);
      const cleanName = String(u.name || '').trim();
      const lowerName = cleanName.toLowerCase();

      const taggedUnit = {
        ...u,
        id,
        name: cleanName,
        store: targetStoreParam,
        location: uLoc || tLoc,
      };

      // Geometry hash for deduplication (rect, circle, polygon)
      let coordKey = '';
      if (u.type === 'rect' && u.width > 0 && u.height > 0) {
        coordKey = `rect_${Math.round(u.x || 0)}_${Math.round(u.y || 0)}_${Math.round(u.width || 0)}_${Math.round(u.height || 0)}`;
      } else if (u.type === 'circle' && u.radius > 0) {
        coordKey = `circle_${Math.round(u.x || 0)}_${Math.round(u.y || 0)}_${Math.round(u.radius || 0)}`;
      } else if (u.type === 'polygon' && Array.isArray(u.points) && u.points.length >= 4) {
        let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
        for (let i = 0; i < u.points.length; i += 2) {
          const px = u.points[i];
          const py = u.points[i + 1];
          if (px < minX) minX = px;
          if (px > maxX) maxX = px;
          if (py < minY) minY = py;
          if (py > maxY) maxY = py;
        }
        coordKey = `poly_${Math.round(minX)}_${Math.round(minY)}_${Math.round(maxX - minX)}_${Math.round(maxY - minY)}`;
      }

      // Check Coordinate Collision: If two shapes occupy the exact same geometry spot
      if (coordKey && seenCoordinates.has(coordKey)) {
        const prevId = seenCoordinates.get(coordKey)!;
        const prev = unitsMap.get(prevId);
        if (!prev?.name && taggedUnit.name) {
          unitsMap.delete(prevId);
          unitsMap.set(id, taggedUnit);
          seenCoordinates.set(coordKey, id);
          if (lowerName) seenUnitNames.set(lowerName, id);
        }
        return;
      }

      // Check Name Collision: If two units on the same floor have the exact same unit name
      if (lowerName && seenUnitNames.has(lowerName)) {
        const prevId = seenUnitNames.get(lowerName)!;
        const prev = unitsMap.get(prevId);
        if (!prev || (!prev.type && taggedUnit.type)) {
          unitsMap.delete(prevId);
          unitsMap.set(id, taggedUnit);
          seenUnitNames.set(lowerName, id);
          if (coordKey) seenCoordinates.set(coordKey, id);
        }
        return;
      }

      if (coordKey) seenCoordinates.set(coordKey, id);
      if (lowerName) seenUnitNames.set(lowerName, id);
      unitsMap.set(id, taggedUnit);
    });

    const finalUnitsList = Array.from(unitsMap.values());
    return { r2Version: finalVersion, r2Units: finalUnitsList };
  }, [
    config, storeFilter, targetLoc, localStoreLocationData, localStore, localLocation,
    localMapUnits, localMapVersions, localActiveMapVersionId, selectedVersionId,
    locationVersions
  ]);

  const version = r2Version;
  const units = r2Units;

  const [resolvedBgUrl, setResolvedBgUrl] = useState<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const rawUrl = version?.backgroundUrl || '';
    if (!rawUrl) {
      setResolvedBgUrl(prev => prev === '' ? prev : '');
      return;
    }
    if (rawUrl.startsWith('r2://') || (!rawUrl.startsWith('http://') && !rawUrl.startsWith('https://') && !rawUrl.startsWith('data:') && !rawUrl.startsWith('blob:'))) {
      resolveR2UrlToHttp(rawUrl).then(url => {
        if (isMounted) setResolvedBgUrl(prev => prev === (url || rawUrl) ? prev : (url || rawUrl));
      }).catch(() => {
        if (isMounted) setResolvedBgUrl(prev => prev === rawUrl ? prev : rawUrl);
      });
    } else {
      setResolvedBgUrl(prev => prev === rawUrl ? prev : rawUrl);
    }
    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, [version?.backgroundUrl]);

  const [bgImage] = useOffscreenImage(resolvedBgUrl || version?.backgroundUrl || '', 'anonymous');

  // Helper to accurately check if unit has user-attached images in localStorage partitioned by store
  const hasStoredUnitImages = useCallback((key: string | undefined | null, overrideStore?: string): boolean => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !key) return false;
    try {
      const activeStore = (overrideStore || (storeFilter === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM')).toUpperCase();
      const storeKey = `taka_unit_images_${activeStore}_${key}`;
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(storeKey);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return true;
      }
      // Migrate legacy un-prefixed key for HN if present
      if (activeStore === 'HN') {
        const legacyRaw = localStorage.getItem(`taka_unit_images_${key}`);
        if (legacyRaw) {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(legacyRaw);
            if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
              const tagged = parsed.map((item: any) => ({ ...item, store: 'HN' }));
              localStorage.setItem(storeKey, JSON.stringify(tagged));
              localStorage.removeItem(`taka_unit_images_${key}`);
              return true;
            }
          } catch {}
        }
      }
      return false;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }, [storeFilter]);

  // Realtime image change subscription to update canvas badges instantly upon add/delete in Tooltip
  const [unitImagesRev, setUnitImagesRev] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorageChange = () => {
      setUnitImagesRev(prev => prev + 1);
    };
    window.addEventListener('taka_unit_images_changed', handleStorageChange);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('taka_unit_images_changed', handleStorageChange);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);
    };
  }, []);

  // Reset selected version and ensure useDataStore partition syncs when locationFilter, storeFilter, or globalYearFilter changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedVersionId(prev => prev !== null ? null : prev);
    const targetStore = (storeFilter === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM') as 'HCM' | 'HN';
    const targetFloor = locationFilter && locationFilter !== 'all' ? locationFilter : 'L1';
    if (!targetFloor || targetFloor.trim() === '' || targetFloor.toUpperCase() === 'ALL') {
      return;
    }
    const currStore = useDataStore.getState().store;
    const currLocation = useDataStore.getState().location;
    if (currStore !== targetStore || currLocation !== targetFloor) {
      useDataStore.getState().setStoreAndLocation(targetStore, targetFloor);
    }
  }, [locationFilter, storeFilter, globalYearFilter]);

  const effectiveLayoutYear = String(
    activeYear || 
    version?.year || 
    (storeFilter === 'HN' ? '2027' : '2026')
  ).trim();

  return {
    version,
    units,
    locationVersions,
    availableStoreVersions,
    bgImage,
    resolvedBgUrl,
    unitImagesRev,
    hasStoredUnitImages,
    selectedVersionId,
    setSelectedVersionId,
    targetLoc,
    activeYear,
    effectiveLayoutYear,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/useLayoutGestures.ts ==================== */
import { useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import Konva from 'konva';

interface UseLayoutGesturesProps {
  stageRef: React.RefObject<any>;
  containerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  dimensions: { width: number; height: number };
  stageScale: number;
  setStageScale: (s: number) => void;
  stagePos: { x: number; y: number };
  setStagePos: (pos: { x: number; y: number }) => void;
  bgImage: any;
  version: any;
  units: any[];
  setHoverInfo: (info: any) => void;
}

export function useLayoutGestures({
  stageRef,
  containerRef,
  dimensions,
  stageScale,
  setStageScale,
  stagePos,
  setStagePos,
  bgImage,
  version,
  units,
  setHoverInfo,
}: UseLayoutGesturesProps) {
  const isInteractingRef = useRef(false);
  const wheelTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const pendingWheelDeltaRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const rafWheelIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const rafTouchIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const pendingTouchRef = useRef<{ dist: number; center: { x: number; y: number } } | null>(null);
  const lastWheelPointerRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);

  const touchStateRef = useRef<{
    lastDist: number;
    lastCenter: { x: number; y: number } | null;
    lastTap: number;
  }>({
    lastDist: 0,
    lastCenter: null,
    lastTap: 0,
  });

  const dragVelocityTrackerRef = useRef<{
    history: Array<{ x: number; y: number; time: number }>;
  }>({
    history: [],
  });
  const rafInertiaIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const stopInertia = useCallback(() => {
    if (rafInertiaIdRef.current !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafInertiaIdRef.current);
      rafInertiaIdRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  // Cleanup timers & RAFs on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (wheelTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(wheelTimeoutRef.current);
      if (rafWheelIdRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafWheelIdRef.current);
      if (rafInertiaIdRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafInertiaIdRef.current);
      if (rafTouchIdRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(rafTouchIdRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Auto-fit floor plan background & units to perfectly fit and center in the viewport
  const fitToScreen = useCallback((animated: boolean = false) => {
    stopInertia();
    const containerW = containerRef.current?.offsetWidth || dimensions.width;
    const containerH = containerRef.current?.offsetHeight || dimensions.height;
    if (containerW <= 0 || containerH <= 0) return;

    let contentW = 1000;
    let contentH = 800;
    let contentX = 0;
    let contentY = 0;

    if (bgImage) {
      const imgNaturalW = (bgImage as HTMLImageElement).naturalWidth || bgImage.width || 1000;
      const imgNaturalH = (bgImage as HTMLImageElement).naturalHeight || bgImage.height || 800;
      const imgScale = version?.imageScale || 1;
      contentW = imgNaturalW * imgScale;
      contentH = imgNaturalH * imgScale;
      contentX = version?.imagePos?.x || 0;
      contentY = version?.imagePos?.y || 0;
    } else if (units && units.length > 0) {
      let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
      units.forEach((u: any) => {
        const ux = u.x || 0;
        const uy = u.y || 0;
        const uw = u.width || 100;
        const uh = u.height || 100;
        minX = Math.min(minX, ux);
        minY = Math.min(minY, uy);
        maxX = Math.max(maxX, ux + uw);
        maxY = Math.max(maxY, uy + uh);
      });
      if (minX !== Infinity && maxX > minX) {
        contentX = minX;
        contentY = minY;
        contentW = Math.max(100, maxX - minX);
        contentH = Math.max(100, maxY - minY);
      }
    }

    const pad = containerW < 640 ? 12 : 24;
    const availW = Math.max(10, containerW - pad * 2);
    const availH = Math.max(10, containerH - pad * 2);

    const scaleX = availW / contentW;
    const scaleY = availH / contentH;
    const fitScale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);
    const clampedScale = Math.max(0.01, Math.min(fitScale, 10));

    const contentCenterX = contentX + contentW / 2;
    const contentCenterY = contentY + contentH / 2;
    const posX = containerW / 2 - contentCenterX * clampedScale;
    const posY = containerH / 2 - contentCenterY * clampedScale;

    const newPos = { x: posX, y: posY };

    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (stage) {
      if (animated) {
        stage.to({
          scaleX: clampedScale,
          scaleY: clampedScale,
          x: posX,
          y: posY,
          duration: 0.22,
          easing: Konva.Easings.EaseOut,
          onFinish: () => {
            setStageScale(clampedScale);
            setStagePos(newPos);
          }
        });
      } else {
        stage.scale({ x: clampedScale, y: clampedScale });
        stage.position(newPos);
        stage.batchDraw();
        setStageScale(clampedScale);
        setStagePos(newPos);
      }
    } else {
      setStageScale(clampedScale);
      setStagePos(newPos);
    }
  }, [bgImage, version?.id, version?.imageScale, version?.imagePos?.x, version?.imagePos?.y, units, dimensions.width, dimensions.height, containerRef, stageRef, setStageScale, setStagePos, stopInertia]);

  // Inertia momentum panning handlers
  const handleDragStart = useCallback(() => {
    if (document.body.classList.contains('lightbox-open')) {
      const stage = stageRef.current;
      if (stage) stage.stopDrag();
      return;
    }
    stopInertia();
    isInteractingRef.current = true;
    setHoverInfo((current: any) => (current ? null : current));
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (stage) {
      dragVelocityTrackerRef.current.history = [
        { x: stage.x(), y: stage.y(), time: performance.now() }
      ];
    }
  }, [stageRef, setHoverInfo, stopInertia]);

  const handleDragMove = useCallback(() => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) return;
    const now = performance.now();
    const history = dragVelocityTrackerRef.current.history;
    history.push({ x: stage.x(), y: stage.y(), time: now });
    while (history.length > 2 && now - history[0].time > 100) {
      history.shift();
    }
  }, [stageRef]);

  const handleDragEnd = useCallback(() => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) {
      isInteractingRef.current = false;
      return;
    }

    const history = dragVelocityTrackerRef.current.history;
    const now = performance.now();
    while (history.length > 2 && now - history[0].time > 100) {
      history.shift();
    }

    let vx = 0;
    let vy = 0;
    if (history.length >= 2) {
      const oldest = history[0];
      const newest = history[history.length - 1];
      const dt = newest.time - oldest.time;
      if (dt > 10 && dt < 150) {
        vx = (newest.x - oldest.x) / dt;
        vy = (newest.y - oldest.y) / dt;
      }
    }

    const speed = Math.hypot(vx, vy);
    if (speed > 0.12) {
      const maxSpeed = 3.0;
      if (speed > maxSpeed) {
        const ratio = maxSpeed / speed;
        vx *= ratio;
        vy *= ratio;
      }

      let currentVx = vx;
      let currentVy = vy;
      let lastTime = performance.now();

      const step = (time: number) => {
        const frameDt = Math.min(32, time - lastTime);
        lastTime = time;

        const friction = Math.pow(0.925, frameDt / 16.6);
        currentVx *= friction;
        currentVy *= friction;

        const currentStage = stageRef.current;
        if (!currentStage) {
          isInteractingRef.current = false;
          return;
        }

        const nextX = currentStage.x() + currentVx * frameDt;
        const nextY = currentStage.y() + currentVy * frameDt;

        currentStage.position({ x: nextX, y: nextY });
        currentStage.batchDraw();

        if (Math.hypot(currentVx, currentVy) > 0.02) {
          rafInertiaIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
        } else {
          rafInertiaIdRef.current = null;
          setStagePos({ x: currentStage.x(), y: currentStage.y() });
          isInteractingRef.current = false;
        }
      };

      rafInertiaIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    } else {
      setStagePos({ x: stage.x(), y: stage.y() });
      isInteractingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, [stageRef, setStagePos]);

  const handleZoomIn = useCallback(() => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) return;
    const oldScale = stage.scaleX();
    const newScale = Math.min(oldScale * 1.3, 20);
    const center = { x: dimensions.width / 2, y: dimensions.height / 2 };
    const mousePointTo = {
      x: (center.x - stage.x()) / oldScale,
      y: (center.y - stage.y()) / oldScale,
    };
    const newPos = {
      x: center.x - mousePointTo.x * newScale,
      y: center.y - mousePointTo.y * newScale,
    };
    stage.to({
      scaleX: newScale,
      scaleY: newScale,
      x: newPos.x,
      y: newPos.y,
      duration: 0.18,
      easing: Konva.Easings.EaseOut,
      onFinish: () => {
        setStageScale(newScale);
        setStagePos(newPos);
      }
    });
  }, [dimensions.width, dimensions.height, stageRef, setStageScale, setStagePos]);

  const handleZoomOut = useCallback(() => {
    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (!stage) return;
    const oldScale = stage.scaleX();
    const newScale = Math.max(oldScale / 1.3, 0.04);
    const center = { x: dimensions.width / 2, y: dimensions.height / 2 };
    const mousePointTo = {
      x: (center.x - stage.x()) / oldScale,
      y: (center.y - stage.y()) / oldScale,
    };
    const newPos = {
      x: center.x - mousePointTo.x * newScale,
      y: center.y - mousePointTo.y * newScale,
    };
    stage.to({
      scaleX: newScale,
      scaleY: newScale,
      x: newPos.x,
      y: newPos.y,
      duration: 0.18,
      easing: Konva.Easings.EaseOut,
      onFinish: () => {
        setStageScale(newScale);
        setStagePos(newPos);
      }
    });
  }, [dimensions.width, dimensions.height, stageRef, setStageScale, setStagePos]);

  return {
    isInteractingRef,
    wheelTimeoutRef,
    pendingWheelDeltaRef,
    rafWheelIdRef,
    rafTouchIdRef,
    pendingTouchRef,
    lastWheelPointerRef,
    touchStateRef,
    dragVelocityTrackerRef,
    rafInertiaIdRef,
    stopInertia,
    fitToScreen,
    handleDragStart,
    handleDragMove,
    handleDragEnd,
    handleZoomIn,
    handleZoomOut,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/useLayoutStageInteractions.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import Konva from 'konva';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { HoverInfo } from './layoutViewerTypes';
import { useLayoutGestures } from './useLayoutGestures';
import { useLayoutWindowListeners } from './useLayoutWindowListeners';
import { 
  calculateUnitFocalPoint, 
  computeTooltipPosition, 
  exportStageHighRes, 
  triggerStageDownload, 
  findUnitInOtherFloorVersions,
  hasAggregatedDataChanged
} from './layoutStageUtils';

interface UseLayoutStageInteractionsProps {
  bgImage: any;
  version: any;
  units: any[];
  targetUnitSearch?: string | null;
  onUnitSelected?: (unit: any) => void;
  onClearFocus?: () => void;
  availableStoreVersions: any[];
  selectedVersionId: string | null;
  setSelectedVersionId: (id: string | null) => void;
  storeFilter: string;
  targetLoc: string;
  isProjectModalOpen: boolean;
  miniGanttProject: any;
}

export function useLayoutStageInteractions({
  bgImage,
  version,
  units,
  targetUnitSearch,
  onUnitSelected,
  onClearFocus,
  availableStoreVersions,
  selectedVersionId,
  setSelectedVersionId,
  storeFilter,
  targetLoc,
  isProjectModalOpen,
  miniGanttProject,
}: UseLayoutStageInteractionsProps) {
  const isPrintPreview = useAppStore(state => state.isPrintPreview);

  const stageRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const tooltipRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState({ width: 800, height: 600 });
  const [hoverInfo, setHoverInfo] = useState<HoverInfo | null>(null);
  const isPinnedRef = useRef(false);
  const [stageScale, setStageScale] = useState(1);
  const [stagePos, setStagePos] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [focusedUnitId, setFocusedUnitId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const focusedTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const lastHandledSearchRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Mutable refs for data aggregates to eliminate circular dependencies and prevent infinite loops
  const aggregatedDataRef = useRef<Record<string, any>>({});
  const restrictedProjectCodesRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Zoom & Pan smoothly to target unit and highlight it
  const zoomAndPanToUnit = useCallback((targetUnitOrName: string | any) => {
    const focalPoint = calculateUnitFocalPoint(
      targetUnitOrName,
      units,
      aggregatedDataRef.current,
      restrictedProjectCodesRef.current
    );
    if (!focalPoint) return false;

    const { targetUnit, cx, cy } = focalPoint;

    const containerW = containerRef.current?.offsetWidth || dimensions.width || 800;
    const containerH = containerRef.current?.offsetHeight || dimensions.height || 600;

    const targetScale = 0.7;

    // Center unit perfectly at exact 50% width and 50% height of viewport
    const targetScreenCenterX = containerW * 0.50;
    const targetScreenCenterY = containerH * 0.50;

    const posX = targetScreenCenterX - cx * targetScale;
    const posY = targetScreenCenterY - cy * targetScale;
    const newPos = { x: posX, y: posY };

    setStageScale(targetScale);
    setStagePos(newPos);

    const stage = stageRef.current;
    if (stage) {
      stage.scale({ x: targetScale, y: targetScale });
      stage.position(newPos);
      stage.batchDraw();
      stage.to({
        scaleX: targetScale,
        scaleY: targetScale,
        x: posX,
        y: posY,
        duration: 0.35,
        easing: Konva.Easings.EaseInOut,
        onFinish: () => {
          setStageScale(targetScale);
          setStagePos(newPos);
        }
      });
    }

    setFocusedUnitId(targetUnit.id);
    if (focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusedTimerRef.current);

    isPinnedRef.current = false;
    setHoverInfo(null);

    return true;
  }, [units, dimensions.width, dimensions.height]);

  const updateAggregatedData = useCallback((data: Record<string, any>, restricted: Set<string>) => {
    aggregatedDataRef.current = data;
    restrictedProjectCodesRef.current = restricted;

    // If there is an active search query waiting to be focused and not yet focused, retry zooming now that aggregates are available
    if (targetUnitSearch && String(targetUnitSearch).trim() && !focusedUnitId) {
      const q = String(targetUnitSearch).trim();
      const success = zoomAndPanToUnit(q);
      if (success) {
        lastHandledSearchRef.current = q;
      }
    }
  }, [targetUnitSearch, focusedUnitId, zoomAndPanToUnit]);

  // Kinetic inertia, gestures and zoom engine
  const gestures = useLayoutGestures({
    stageRef,
    containerRef,
    dimensions,
    stageScale,
    setStageScale,
    stagePos,
    setStagePos,
    bgImage,
    version,
    units,
    setHoverInfo,
  });

  const {
    fitToScreen,
    stopInertia,
    handleDragStart,
    handleDragMove,
    handleDragEnd,
    handleZoomIn,
    handleZoomOut,
  } = gestures;

  // Export handlers
  const handleExport = useCallback(() => triggerStageDownload(stageRef.current), []);

  // Global window references for export
  useEffect(() => {
    (window as any).__taka_layout_stage = stageRef.current;
    (window as any).__taka_layout_export = (dpi: number = 200) => {
      return exportStageHighRes(stageRef.current, bgImage, version, units, dpi);
    };

    return () => {
      if ((window as any).__taka_layout_stage === stageRef.current) {
        (window as any).__taka_layout_stage = null;
        (window as any).__taka_layout_export = null;
      }
    };
  }, [bgImage, version, units]);

  const fitToScreenRef = useRef(fitToScreen);
  fitToScreenRef.current = fitToScreen;

  // Trigger fitToScreen when background image or partition version changes
  const lastFloorVersionKeyRef = useRef<string>('');
  useEffect(() => {
    // If version has a background URL, wait for bgImage to load before auto-fitting to prevent jumping
    if (version?.backgroundUrl && !bgImage) {
      return;
    }
    const currentKey = `${storeFilter}_${targetLoc}_${version?.year || ''}_${version?.id || ''}`;
    const floorChanged = lastFloorVersionKeyRef.current !== currentKey;
    if (floorChanged) {
      lastFloorVersionKeyRef.current = currentKey;
      if (!targetUnitSearch && !focusedUnitId && !lastHandledSearchRef.current) {
        fitToScreenRef.current();
      }
    }
  }, [storeFilter, targetLoc, version?.year, version?.id, version?.backgroundUrl, bgImage, targetUnitSearch, focusedUnitId]);

  // Sync with incoming targetUnitSearch prop from toolbar / Quick Navigation
  useEffect(() => {
    if (targetUnitSearch && String(targetUnitSearch).trim()) {
      const q = String(targetUnitSearch).trim();
      
      const tryZoom = () => {
        const success = zoomAndPanToUnit(q);
        if (success) {
          lastHandledSearchRef.current = q;
        } else {
          const foundInOther = findUnitInOtherFloorVersions(q, availableStoreVersions);
          if (foundInOther) {
            if (foundInOther.location) {
              const floorLoc = String(foundInOther.location).trim().toUpperCase();
              if (useAppStore.getState().globalLocationFilter[0] !== floorLoc) {
                useAppStore.getState().setGlobalLocationFilter([floorLoc]);
              }
            }
            if (foundInOther.id !== selectedVersionId) {
              setSelectedVersionId(foundInOther.id);
            }
          }
        }
      };

      tryZoom();
      // Multi-stage retry so that when tab switches and container DOM dimensions mount / re-measure, centering happens cleanly
      const t1 = setTimeout(tryZoom, 60);
      const t2 = setTimeout(tryZoom, 220);
      const t3 = setTimeout(tryZoom, 500);

      return () => {
        clearTimeout(t1);
        clearTimeout(t2);
        clearTimeout(t3);
      };
    } else if (targetUnitSearch === null || targetUnitSearch === '') {
      if (lastHandledSearchRef.current !== null || focusedUnitId !== null) {
        lastHandledSearchRef.current = null;
        setFocusedUnitId(null);
        setHoverInfo(null);
        if (focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusedTimerRef.current);
        fitToScreenRef.current(true);
      }
    }
  }, [targetUnitSearch, zoomAndPanToUnit, availableStoreVersions, selectedVersionId, setSelectedVersionId]);

  // Keyboard listener: Escape key to exit zoom focus
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && (focusedUnitId || targetUnitSearch)) {
        lastHandledSearchRef.current = null;
        setFocusedUnitId(null);
        setHoverInfo(null);
        if (focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusedTimerRef.current);
        fitToScreen(true);
        onClearFocus?.();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [focusedUnitId, targetUnitSearch, fitToScreen, onClearFocus]);

  // If units reload after floor switch and targetUnitSearch is waiting to be zoomed, zoom cleanly
  useEffect(() => {
    if (targetUnitSearch && String(targetUnitSearch).trim() && units.length > 0) {
      const q = String(targetUnitSearch).trim();
      if (lastHandledSearchRef.current !== q || !focusedUnitId) {
        const success = zoomAndPanToUnit(q);
        if (success) {
          lastHandledSearchRef.current = q;
        }
      }
    }
  }, [units, targetUnitSearch, zoomAndPanToUnit, focusedUnitId]);

  const activeTab = useAppStore(state => state.activeTab);

  // Auto-close tooltip and clear pinned state when navigating to another tab
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab !== 'layout') {
      setHoverInfo(null);
      isPinnedRef.current = false;
      if (focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusedTimerRef.current);
    }
  }, [activeTab]);

  // Clean up tooltip state on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      setHoverInfo(null);
      isPinnedRef.current = false;
      if (focusedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusedTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Window listeners: resize observer, print preview, export, visibility wake-up
  useLayoutWindowListeners({
    isPrintPreview,
    fitToScreen,
    fitToScreenRef,
    handleExport,
    stageRef,
    containerRef,
    setDimensions,
  });

  // Handle position tooltip directly via DOM with RAF throttle and 2D collision clamping
  const rafTooltipIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (rafTooltipIdRef.current !== null) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafTooltipIdRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const updateTooltipPos = useCallback((clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
    if (rafTooltipIdRef.current !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafTooltipIdRef.current);
    }
    rafTooltipIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      rafTooltipIdRef.current = null;
      if (!tooltipRef.current) return;
      const el = tooltipRef.current;
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const tooltipWidth = rect.width > 0 ? rect.width : 340;
      const tooltipHeight = rect.height > 0 ? rect.height : 280;

      const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
      const visualVp = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.visualViewport : null;
      const viewportHeight = visualVp ? visualVp.height : window.innerHeight;

      const styleObj = computeTooltipPosition(
        clientX,
        clientY,
        tooltipWidth,
        tooltipHeight,
        viewportWidth,
        viewportHeight
      );

      Object.assign(el.style, styleObj);
    });
  }, []);

  // Re-anchor tooltip position when ProjectModal closes if it was kept open from comment button
  const prevIsProjectModalOpenRef = useRef(isProjectModalOpen);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevIsProjectModalOpenRef.current && !isProjectModalOpen) {
      if (hoverInfo?.visible && hoverInfo.clientX != null && hoverInfo.clientY != null) {
        updateTooltipPos(hoverInfo.clientX, hoverInfo.clientY);
      }
    }
    prevIsProjectModalOpenRef.current = isProjectModalOpen;
  }, [isProjectModalOpen, hoverInfo?.visible, hoverInfo?.clientX, hoverInfo?.clientY, updateTooltipPos]);

  // Keep hoverInfo.data in sync with latest aggregatedData if projects update
  useEffect(() => {
    if (hoverInfo?.visible && hoverInfo.unitName) {
      const uName = hoverInfo.unitName.toLowerCase();
      const latestData = aggregatedDataRef.current[uName];
      if (latestData && latestData !== hoverInfo.data) {
        if (hasAggregatedDataChanged(hoverInfo.data, latestData)) {
          setHoverInfo(current => current ? { ...current, data: latestData } : null);
        }
      }
    }
  }, [hoverInfo?.visible, hoverInfo?.unitName, hoverInfo?.data]);

  const handleMouseEnterUnit = useCallback((unit: any, e: any) => {
    if (gestures.isInteractingRef.current || (e?.evt && e.evt.buttons > 0) || isPinnedRef.current || Boolean(miniGanttProject) || Boolean(isProjectModalOpen)) return;
    try {
      const container = e.target.getStage()?.container();
      if (container) container.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      const uName = (unit.name || '').toLowerCase();
      const aggregatedData = aggregatedDataRef.current;
      setHoverInfo({
        visible: true,
        data: (uName && aggregatedData[uName]) ? aggregatedData[uName] : {},
        unitName: unit.name || 'Unknown',
        clientX: e.evt.clientX,
        clientY: e.evt.clientY
      });
      setTimeout(() => updateTooltipPos(e.evt.clientX, e.evt.clientY), 0);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Defensive Check: Error onMouseEnter unit in LiveLayoutViewer:", err, unit);
    }
  }, [gestures.isInteractingRef, miniGanttProject, isProjectModalOpen, updateTooltipPos]);

  const handleMouseMoveUnit = useCallback((_unit: any, e: any) => {
    if (gestures.isInteractingRef.current || (e?.evt && e.evt.buttons > 0) || isPinnedRef.current || Boolean(miniGanttProject) || Boolean(isProjectModalOpen)) return;
    try {
      updateTooltipPos(e.evt.clientX, e.evt.clientY);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Defensive Check: Error onMouseMove unit in LiveLayoutViewer:", err);
    }
  }, [gestures.isInteractingRef, miniGanttProject, isProjectModalOpen, updateTooltipPos]);

  const handleMouseLeaveUnit = useCallback((unit: any, e: any) => {
    try {
      const container = e.target.getStage()?.container();
      if (container && !gestures.isInteractingRef.current) container.style.cursor = 'grab';
      if (gestures.isInteractingRef.current || (e?.evt && e.evt.buttons > 0) || isPinnedRef.current || Boolean(miniGanttProject) || Boolean(isProjectModalOpen)) return;
      setHoverInfo(current => (current ? null : current));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Defensive Check: Error onMouseLeave unit in LiveLayoutViewer:", err, unit);
    }
  }, [gestures.isInteractingRef, miniGanttProject, isProjectModalOpen]);

  const pinAndShowTooltip = useCallback((unit: any, clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
    isPinnedRef.current = true;
    const uName = (unit?.name || '').toLowerCase();
    const agg = aggregatedDataRef.current;
    setHoverInfo({
      visible: true,
      data: (uName && agg[uName]) ? agg[uName] : {},
      unitName: unit?.name || 'Unknown',
      clientX,
      clientY
    });
    setTimeout(() => updateTooltipPos(clientX, clientY), 0);
  }, [updateTooltipPos]);

  const handleClickUnit = useCallback((unit: any, e: any) => {
    if (gestures.isInteractingRef.current || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
    try {
      pinAndShowTooltip(unit, e.evt.clientX, e.evt.clientY);
      onUnitSelected?.(unit);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Defensive Check: Error onClick unit in LiveLayoutViewer:", err, unit);
    }
  }, [gestures.isInteractingRef, miniGanttProject, pinAndShowTooltip, onUnitSelected]);

  const handleTapUnit = useCallback((unit: any, e: any) => {
    if (gestures.isInteractingRef.current || Boolean(miniGanttProject)) return;
    try {
      const clientX = e.evt.changedTouches ? e.evt.changedTouches[0].clientX : e.evt.clientX;
      const clientY = e.evt.changedTouches ? e.evt.changedTouches[0].clientY : e.evt.clientY;
      pinAndShowTooltip(unit, clientX, clientY);
      onUnitSelected?.(unit);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Defensive Check: Error onTap unit in LiveLayoutViewer:", err, unit);
    }
  }, [gestures.isInteractingRef, miniGanttProject, pinAndShowTooltip, onUnitSelected]);

  return {
    stageRef,
    containerRef,
    tooltipRef,
    dimensions,
    hoverInfo,
    setHoverInfo,
    isPinnedRef,
    stageScale,
    setStageScale,
    stagePos,
    setStagePos,
    focusedUnitId,
    setFocusedUnitId,
    focusedTimerRef,
    lastHandledSearchRef,
    touchStateRef: gestures.touchStateRef,
    pendingTouchRef: gestures.pendingTouchRef,
    rafTouchIdRef: gestures.rafTouchIdRef,
    isInteractingRef: gestures.isInteractingRef,
    wheelTimeoutRef: gestures.wheelTimeoutRef,
    pendingWheelDeltaRef: gestures.pendingWheelDeltaRef,
    rafWheelIdRef: gestures.rafWheelIdRef,
    lastWheelPointerRef: gestures.lastWheelPointerRef,
    dragVelocityTrackerRef: gestures.dragVelocityTrackerRef,
    rafInertiaIdRef: gestures.rafInertiaIdRef,
    stopInertia,
    fitToScreen,
    handleDragStart,
    handleDragMove,
    handleDragEnd,
    handleZoomIn,
    handleZoomOut,
    zoomAndPanToUnit,
    handleMouseEnterUnit,
    handleMouseMoveUnit,
    handleMouseLeaveUnit,
    handleClickUnit,
    handleTapUnit,
    handleExport,
    updateTooltipPos,
    updateAggregatedData,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/useLayoutTabData.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { useEnrichedData } from '../../hooks/useEnrichedData';
import { AppRole } from '../../types';
import { getUserAllowedStores, getEffectiveStoreFilter } from '../../lib/utils';
import { useDataStore } from '../PictureMapping/DataContext';
import { useLayoutTabSettings } from './useLayoutTabSettings';
import { 
  buildUnitSuggestions, 
  scoreAndFilterUnitSuggestions, 
  resolveTargetFloorForUnit, 
  resolveInitialTargetLocation,
  sortLocationsByFloorRank
} from './layoutTabSearchUtils';

export interface UseLayoutTabDataProps {
  propInitialStore?: string;
  propInitialLocation?: string;
  propInitialProjectCode?: string;
  onClearFocus?: () => void;
}

export function useLayoutTabData({
  propInitialStore,
  propInitialLocation,
  propInitialProjectCode,
  onClearFocus,
}: UseLayoutTabDataProps) {
  const layoutTabFilters = useAppStore(state => state.layoutTabFilters);
  const initialStore = propInitialStore !== undefined ? propInitialStore : (layoutTabFilters?.store || 'all');
  const initialLocation = propInitialLocation !== undefined ? propInitialLocation : (layoutTabFilters?.location || 'all');
  const initialProjectCode = propInitialProjectCode !== undefined ? propInitialProjectCode : (layoutTabFilters?.projectCode || '');

  const { enrichedProjects: projects, filteredTasks: tasks } = useEnrichedData();
  const currentUser = useAppStore(state => state.currentUser)!;
  const permissionMatrix = useAppStore(state => state.permissionMatrix);
  const locations = useAppStore(state => state.locations);
  const locationVisibility = useAppStore(state => state.locationVisibility);

  const globalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalStoreFilter);
  const setGlobalStoreFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalStoreFilter);
  const globalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalLocationFilter);
  const setGlobalLocationFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalLocationFilter);

  const [projectCodeFilter, setProjectCodeFilter] = useState(initialProjectCode);
  
  const isAdmin = currentUser.role === 'admin';
  const role = currentUser.role as AppRole;
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.globalYearFilter);
  const setGlobalYearFilter = useAppStore(state => state.setGlobalYearFilter);
  const isArchiveYear = globalYearFilter !== 'all' && Number(globalYearFilter) < new Date().getFullYear();
  const canWrite = (isAdmin || !!permissionMatrix[role]?.Write?.layout) && !isArchiveYear;

  const allowedStores = useMemo(() => {
    return getUserAllowedStores(currentUser);
  }, [currentUser]);
  const effectiveStore = getEffectiveStoreFilter(globalStoreFilter, currentUser);
  const activeStore = effectiveStore === 'all' ? (allowedStores[0] || '') : (allowedStores.includes(effectiveStore) ? effectiveStore : (allowedStores[0] || ''));

  const getAllStoreVersions = useDataStore((state) => state.getAllStoreVersions);
  const storeLocationData = useDataStore((state) => state.storeLocationData);
  const mapVersions = useDataStore((state) => state.mapVersions);

  // Stable memoized versions for activeStore to prevent reference churn across partition updates
  const prevStoreVersionsRef = useRef<any[]>([]);
  const prevStoreVersionsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const allStoreVersions = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const vers = getAllStoreVersions((activeStore === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM'));
      if (!Array.isArray(vers)) return [];
      const sig = `${activeStore}_${vers.map(v => `${v?.id || ''}_${v?.backgroundUrl || ''}`).join('|')}`;
      if (sig === prevStoreVersionsKeyRef.current) {
        return prevStoreVersionsRef.current;
      }
      prevStoreVersionsKeyRef.current = sig;
      prevStoreVersionsRef.current = vers;
      return vers;
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }, [getAllStoreVersions, activeStore, storeLocationData, mapVersions]);

  // Initial params sync effect - runs on mount or when props / layoutTabFilters change!
  const hasSyncedInitialRef = useRef(false);
  const lastInitialPropKeyRef = useRef('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const activeStoreParam = propInitialStore !== undefined ? propInitialStore : (layoutTabFilters?.store || '');
    const activeLocParam = propInitialLocation !== undefined ? propInitialLocation : (layoutTabFilters?.location || '');
    const activeCodeParam = propInitialProjectCode !== undefined ? propInitialProjectCode : (layoutTabFilters?.projectCode || '');
    const filterTs = (layoutTabFilters as any)?._ts || '';

    const propKey = `${activeStoreParam}_${activeLocParam}_${activeCodeParam}_${filterTs}`;
    if (hasSyncedInitialRef.current && propKey === lastInitialPropKeyRef.current) {
      return;
    }
    hasSyncedInitialRef.current = true;
    lastInitialPropKeyRef.current = propKey;

    if (activeStoreParam && activeStoreParam !== 'all') {
      setGlobalStoreFilter(activeStoreParam);
    }
    
    if (activeLocParam && activeLocParam !== 'all' && activeLocParam !== 'ALL') {
      setIsLiveMapMode(true);
      setGlobalLocationFilter([activeLocParam.toUpperCase().trim()]);
    }
    
    if (activeCodeParam) {
      setProjectCodeFilter(activeCodeParam);
      setUnitSearchInput(activeCodeParam);
      setTargetUnitSearch(activeCodeParam);
      setIsLiveMapMode(true);
    }

    const unitInfo = useDataStore.getState().unitInfo || [];
    const targetLoc = resolveInitialTargetLocation(
      activeLocParam, 
      activeCodeParam, 
      projects, 
      tasks, 
      allStoreVersions, 
      unitInfo
    );

    if (targetLoc && targetLoc.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
      setGlobalLocationFilter([targetLoc]);
    }
  }, [propInitialStore, propInitialLocation, propInitialProjectCode, layoutTabFilters, projects, tasks, allStoreVersions, setGlobalStoreFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  // Available years: based on user permissions, projects, tasks, and store versions
  const prevAvailableYearsRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const prevAvailableYearsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const availableYears = useMemo(() => {
    const storeProjects = projects.filter(p => {
      if (!activeStore || activeStore === 'all') return true;
      const pStore = String(p.store || 'HCM').toUpperCase().trim();
      return pStore === activeStore;
    });

    const projectYearsSet = new Set<string>();
    storeProjects.forEach(p => {
      const y = String(p.year || (p.start ? String(p.start).substring(0, 4) : '')).trim();
      if (y && y.toLowerCase() !== 'all' && /^\d{4}$/.test(y)) {
        projectYearsSet.add(y);
      }
    });

    const storeTasks = tasks.filter(t => {
      if (!activeStore || activeStore === 'all') return true;
      const tStore = String(t.projectStore || 'HCM').toUpperCase().trim();
      return tStore === activeStore;
    });
    const taskYearsSet = new Set<string>();
    storeTasks.forEach(t => {
      const y = String(t.projectYear || (t.start ? String(t.start).substring(0, 4) : '')).trim();
      if (y && y.toLowerCase() !== 'all' && /^\d{4}$/.test(y)) {
        taskYearsSet.add(y);
      }
    });

    const userPermittedYears = new Set([...projectYearsSet, ...taskYearsSet]);

    const versionYears = Array.from(
      new Set(
        allStoreVersions
          .filter(v => {
            if (!activeStore || activeStore === 'all') return true;
            const vStore = String(v.store || (activeStore === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM')).toUpperCase().trim();
            return vStore === activeStore;
          })
          .map(v => (v.year ? String(v.year).trim() : ''))
          .filter(y => y && y.toLowerCase() !== 'all' && /^\d{4}$/.test(y))
      )
    );

    const defaultStoreYears = activeStore === 'HN' ? ['2027'] : ['2026', '2027'];

    const finalYears = Array.from(new Set([...userPermittedYears, ...versionYears, ...defaultStoreYears]))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));

    const key = finalYears.join('|');
    if (key === prevAvailableYearsKeyRef.current) {
      return prevAvailableYearsRef.current;
    }
    prevAvailableYearsKeyRef.current = key;
    prevAvailableYearsRef.current = finalYears;
    return finalYears;
  }, [allStoreVersions, projects, tasks, activeStore]);

  const effectiveYear = useMemo(() => {
    if (globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== 'all' && availableYears.includes(globalYearFilter)) {
      return globalYearFilter;
    }
    return availableYears[0] || '';
  }, [globalYearFilter, availableYears]);

  // Layout tab requires specific year selection (no 'all' option allowed)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableYears.length > 0 && (!globalYearFilter || globalYearFilter === 'all' || !availableYears.includes(globalYearFilter))) {
      setGlobalYearFilter(effectiveYear);
    }
  }, [globalYearFilter, availableYears, effectiveYear, setGlobalYearFilter]);

  // Layout tab only supports store-specific floor plans (HCM, HN), hide all-stores
  useEffect(() => {
    if (allowedStores.length > 0 && (!globalStoreFilter || globalStoreFilter === 'all' || !allowedStores.includes(globalStoreFilter))) {
      setGlobalStoreFilter(allowedStores[0]);
    }
  }, [globalStoreFilter, allowedStores, setGlobalStoreFilter]);

  // Danh sách location của Tab Layout (Cached to prevent array reference churn)
  const prevAvailableLocationsRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const prevAvailableLocationsKeyRef = useRef<string>('');

  const availableLocations = useMemo(() => {
    const storeParam = (activeStore === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM');
    const isUserAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'admin';
    const locPerms = currentUser?.locationPermissions || {};
    const hasAll = isUserAdmin || locPerms['all'] === true;

    const isFloorName = (name: string) => {
      if (!name) return false;
      const n = name.toUpperCase().trim();
      const nonFloors = ['BUDGET', 'COST', 'ALL', 'SUMMARY', 'GENERAL', 'SETTING'];
      if (nonFloors.includes(n)) return false;
      return true;
    };

    const isPermitted = (loc: string) => {
      if (!loc || !isFloorName(loc)) return false;
      if (locationVisibility[loc] === false) return false;
      if (hasAll) return true;
      const lLower = loc.toLowerCase().trim();
      const cleanLoc = lLower.replace(/^md-/, '');
      return !!(locPerms[cleanLoc] || locPerms[`md-${cleanLoc}`] || locPerms[lLower]);
    };

    const pmLocationsSet = new Set<string>();

    allStoreVersions.forEach(v => {
      const loc = String(v.location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      if (loc && isPermitted(loc)) {
        pmLocationsSet.add(loc);
      }
    });

    if (storeLocationData) {
      Object.entries(storeLocationData).forEach(([key, partition]) => {
        if (key.startsWith(`${storeParam}_`)) {
          const loc = key.replace(`${storeParam}_`, '').toUpperCase().trim();
          if (loc && isPermitted(loc)) {
            if (
              (partition?.mapVersions && partition.mapVersions.length > 0) ||
              (partition?.mapUnits && partition.mapUnits.length > 0) ||
              partition?.activeMapVersionId
            ) {
              pmLocationsSet.add(loc);
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    let finalLocations: string[] = [];
    if (pmLocationsSet.size > 0) {
      finalLocations = Array.from(pmLocationsSet);
    } else {
      finalLocations = (locations || []).map(l => String(l).toUpperCase().trim()).filter(isPermitted);
    }

    const sorted = sortLocationsByFloorRank(finalLocations);
    const key = sorted.join('|');
    if (key === prevAvailableLocationsKeyRef.current) {
      return prevAvailableLocationsRef.current;
    }
    prevAvailableLocationsKeyRef.current = key;
    prevAvailableLocationsRef.current = sorted;
    return sorted;
  }, [allStoreVersions, storeLocationData, activeStore, currentUser, locationVisibility, locations]);

  // Ensure globalLocationFilter is never 'all' or empty in Layout tab
  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableLocations.length > 0) {
      const currentLoc = (globalLocationFilter[0] || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      if (!currentLoc || currentLoc === 'ALL') {
        const initialTargetLoc = resolveInitialTargetLocation(
          propInitialLocation || layoutTabFilters?.location || '', 
          propInitialProjectCode || layoutTabFilters?.projectCode || '', 
          projects, 
          tasks, 
          allStoreVersions, 
          useDataStore.getState().unitInfo || []
        );
        if (initialTargetLoc && availableLocations.includes(initialTargetLoc)) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter([initialTargetLoc]);
          return;
        }
      }
      const matched = availableLocations.find(l => l.toUpperCase().trim() === currentLoc);
      if (matched) {
        if (globalLocationFilter[0] !== matched) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter([matched]);
        }
      } else {
        const initialTargetLoc = resolveInitialTargetLocation(
          propInitialLocation || layoutTabFilters?.location || '', 
          propInitialProjectCode || layoutTabFilters?.projectCode || '', 
          projects, 
          tasks, 
          allStoreVersions, 
          useDataStore.getState().unitInfo || []
        );
        if (initialTargetLoc && availableLocations.includes(initialTargetLoc)) {
          setGlobalLocationFilter([initialTargetLoc]);
        } else {
          setGlobalLocationFilter([availableLocations[0]]);
        }
      }
    }
  }, [availableLocations, globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter, propInitialLocation, propInitialProjectCode, layoutTabFilters, projects, tasks, allStoreVersions]);

  const locFilterStr = useMemo(() => {
    const currentLoc = (globalLocationFilter[0] || '').toUpperCase().trim();
    if (currentLoc && currentLoc !== 'ALL') {
      const matched = availableLocations.find(l => l.toUpperCase().trim() === currentLoc);
      if (matched) return matched;
      return currentLoc;
    }
    return availableLocations[0] || '';
  }, [globalLocationFilter, availableLocations]);
  const [isLiveMapMode, setIsLiveMapMode] = useState(true);
  const [isFullscreenView, setIsFullscreenView] = useState(false);

  // Settings, URL persistence, and export triggers
  const {
    url,
    isEditing,
    setIsEditing,
    editUrl,
    setEditUrl,
    handleSave,
    isExporting,
    exportStatusMessage,
    handleTriggerReExport,
    getCleanUrl,
    fallbackSvg,
    cacheBuster,
    setCacheBuster,
  } = useLayoutTabSettings({ activeStore, locFilterStr });

  // Search Unit functionality next to Trigger Export
  const [unitSearchInput, setUnitSearchInput] = useState('');
  const [targetUnitSearch, setTargetUnitSearch] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions] = useState(false);
  const searchContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const getAllStoreUnits = useDataStore((state) => state.getAllStoreUnits);

  // Lazy autocomplete suggestions: ONLY compute when user opens or types into search box
  const unitSuggestions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!showSuggestions && !unitSearchInput.trim()) {
      return [];
    }
    const storeUnits: any[] = typeof getAllStoreUnits === 'function' ? (getAllStoreUnits as any)(activeStore) || [] : [];
    return buildUnitSuggestions(storeUnits, projects, activeStore, availableLocations, isAdmin);
  }, [getAllStoreUnits, activeStore, projects, availableLocations, isAdmin, showSuggestions, unitSearchInput]);

  const filteredUnitSuggestions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!unitSearchInput.trim()) return [];
    const currentLoc = globalLocationFilter[0] || '';
    return scoreAndFilterUnitSuggestions(unitSuggestions, unitSearchInput, currentLoc);
  }, [unitSuggestions, unitSearchInput, globalLocationFilter]);

  const handleSelectSearchUnit = useCallback((unitItem: { unit: string; location?: string; brand?: string; project?: string; code?: string }) => {
    setUnitSearchInput(unitItem.unit);
    setShowSuggestions(false);

    if (!isLiveMapMode) {
      setIsLiveMapMode(true);
    }

    const targetFloor = resolveTargetFloorForUnit(unitItem, projects);
    if (targetFloor && targetFloor.toLowerCase() !== 'all') {
      setGlobalLocationFilter([targetFloor]);
    }

    setTargetUnitSearch(unitItem.unit);
  }, [isLiveMapMode, projects, setGlobalLocationFilter]);

  const handleClearSearchAndFocus = useCallback(() => {
    setUnitSearchInput('');
    setTargetUnitSearch(null);
    setShowSuggestions(false);
    onClearFocus?.();
  }, [onClearFocus]);

  // Close suggestions on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOutsideClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (searchContainerRef.current && !searchContainerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setShowSuggestions(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick);
  }, []);

  // When activeStore, locFilterStr, or effectiveYear changes, reset search & focus states to default
  const prevFilterStateRef = useRef({ store: activeStore, loc: locFilterStr, yr: effectiveYear });
  useEffect(() => {
    const prev = prevFilterStateRef.current;
    if (prev.store !== activeStore || prev.loc !== locFilterStr || prev.yr !== effectiveYear) {
      prevFilterStateRef.current = { store: activeStore, loc: locFilterStr, yr: effectiveYear };
      setUnitSearchInput('');
      setTargetUnitSearch(null);
      setShowSuggestions(false);
      onClearFocus?.();
    }
  }, [activeStore, locFilterStr, effectiveYear, onClearFocus]);

  return {
    allowedStores, activeStore, setGlobalStoreFilter,
    globalLocationFilter, setGlobalLocationFilter,
    availableLocations, locFilterStr,
    availableYears, effectiveYear, setGlobalYearFilter, globalYearFilter,
    canWrite, isAdmin, isEditing, setIsEditing, editUrl, setEditUrl, handleSave,
    isLiveMapMode, setIsLiveMapMode, url, getCleanUrl, fallbackSvg,
    isExporting, exportStatusMessage, handleTriggerReExport,
    unitSearchInput, setUnitSearchInput, targetUnitSearch, setTargetUnitSearch,
    showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions, searchContainerRef,
    filteredUnitSuggestions, handleSelectSearchUnit, handleClearSearchAndFocus,
    isFullscreenView, setIsFullscreenView,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/useLayoutTabSettings.ts ==================== */
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { doc, onSnapshot, setDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../lib/firebase';
import { usePerformanceStore } from '../../store/usePerformanceStore';
import { executeTriggerExportProcess } from '../PictureMapping/lib/dynamicExportService';
import { isValidUrl } from './layoutTabSearchUtils';

interface UseLayoutTabSettingsProps {
  activeStore: string;
  locFilterStr: string;
}

export function useLayoutTabSettings({ activeStore, locFilterStr }: UseLayoutTabSettingsProps) {
  const [layoutSettings, setLayoutSettings] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [url, setUrl] = useState<string>('https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hxzPKKhQWhQ-tAThmgan8eNqqy5GN-Ds/preview');
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editUrl, setEditUrl] = useState('');
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);
  const [exportStatusMessage, setExportStatusMessage] = useState<string>('');
  const [cacheBuster, setCacheBuster] = useState<number>(Date.now());

  const docKey = `url_${activeStore}_${locFilterStr}`;

  // Listen to layout settings & triggers from Firestore
  useEffect(() => {
    usePerformanceStore.getState().registerListener('taka_settings/layout');
    usePerformanceStore.getState().registerListener('taka_settings/layout_trigger');

    const unsubLayout = onSnapshot(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_settings', 'layout'), (docSnap) => {
      usePerformanceStore.getState().trackSnapshot('taka_settings/layout', docSnap);
      if (docSnap.exists()) {
        setLayoutSettings(docSnap.data());
      }
    }, (error) => {
      console.error('Error listening to layout settings', error);
    });

    const unsubTrigger = onSnapshot(doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_settings', 'layout_trigger'), (docSnap) => {
      usePerformanceStore.getState().trackSnapshot('taka_settings/layout_trigger', docSnap);
      if (docSnap.exists()) {
        const data = docSnap.data();
        if (data.is_ready_to_export === false) {
          setIsExporting(false);
          if (data.export_completed_at) {
            setCacheBuster(data.export_completed_at);
          }
        } else if (data.is_ready_to_export === true) {
          if (data.requested_at && Date.now() - data.requested_at < 15000) {
            setIsExporting(true);
          } else {
            setIsExporting(false);
          }
        }
      }
    }, (error) => {
      console.error('Error listening to layout_trigger', error);
    });

    return () => {
      unsubLayout();
      unsubTrigger();
      usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener('taka_settings/layout');
      usePerformanceStore.getState().unregisterListener('taka_settings/layout_trigger');
    };
  }, []);

  // Synchronize URL when docKey, layoutSettings, or activeStore changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (layoutSettings[docKey] && isValidUrl(layoutSettings[docKey])) {
      setUrl(layoutSettings[docKey]);
    } else if (layoutSettings[`url_${activeStore}`] && isValidUrl(layoutSettings[`url_${activeStore}`])) {
      setUrl(layoutSettings[`url_${activeStore}`]);
    } else {
      setUrl('');
    }
  }, [docKey, layoutSettings, activeStore]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let timeoutId: NodeJS.Timeout;
    if (isExporting) {
      timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        setIsExporting(false);
        setExportStatusMessage('');
      }, 30000);
    }
    return () => {
      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    };
  }, [isExporting]);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    try {
      const docRef = doc(db, 'artifacts', APP_ID, 'public', 'data', 'taka_settings', 'layout');
      const updates: Record<string, any> = { [docKey]: editUrl };
      setDoc(docRef, updates, { merge: true });
      setUrl(editUrl);
      setIsEditing(false);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving layout URL', error);
    }
  };

  const handleTriggerReExport = async () => {
    if (isExporting) return;
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      setExportStatusMessage('Bước 1/4: Đang tải dữ liệu từ Cloudflare R2...');
      const targetStore = (activeStore === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM') as 'HCM' | 'HN';
      
      const res = await executeTriggerExportProcess(targetStore, (status) => {
        setExportStatusMessage(status);
      });

      setCacheBuster(Date.now());
      setIsExporting(false);
      setExportStatusMessage('');
      alert(`✅ ${res.message}`);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Error triggering layout export', error);
      setIsExporting(false);
      setExportStatusMessage('');
      alert(`⚠️ Lỗi khi Trigger Export:\n${error?.message || error}`);
    }
  };

  const getCleanUrl = useCallback((inputUrl: string | undefined | null) => {
    if (!inputUrl) return undefined;
    let cleanUrl = inputUrl;
    if (cleanUrl.includes('/view')) {
      cleanUrl = cleanUrl.replace('/view', '/preview');
    }
    if (cleanUrl) {
      const separator = cleanUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
      return `${cleanUrl}${separator}t=${cacheBuster}`;
    }
    return undefined;
  }, [cacheBuster]);

  const fallbackSvg = 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="100" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="%2394a3b8" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"></circle><polyline points="21 15 16 10 5 21"></polyline></svg>';

  return {
    url,
    isEditing,
    setIsEditing,
    editUrl,
    setEditUrl,
    handleSave,
    isExporting,
    exportStatusMessage,
    handleTriggerReExport,
    getCleanUrl,
    fallbackSvg,
    cacheBuster,
    setCacheBuster,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/useLayoutWindowListeners.ts ==================== */
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

interface UseLayoutWindowListenersParams {
  isPrintPreview: boolean;
  fitToScreen: (animated?: boolean) => void;
  fitToScreenRef: React.MutableRefObject<(animated?: boolean) => void>;
  handleExport: () => void;
  stageRef: React.RefObject<any>;
  containerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  setDimensions: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<{ width: number; height: number }>>;
}

export function useLayoutWindowListeners({
  isPrintPreview,
  fitToScreen,
  fitToScreenRef,
  handleExport,
  stageRef,
  containerRef,
  setDimensions,
}: UseLayoutWindowListenersParams) {
  // ResizeObserver for canvas container: safely only update state when width/height actually changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const updateSize = () => {
      if (!containerRef.current) return;
      const newW = containerRef.current.offsetWidth || 800;
      const newH = containerRef.current.offsetHeight || 600;
      setDimensions(prev => (prev.width === newW && prev.height === newH) ? prev : { width: newW, height: newH });
    };

    updateSize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateSize);
    let ro: ResizeObserver | null = null;
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined' && containerRef.current) {
      ro = new ResizeObserver(updateSize);
      ro.observe(containerRef.current);
    }
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', updateSize);
      if (ro) ro.disconnect();
    };
  }, [containerRef, setDimensions]);

  // When print preview activates or deactivates, automatically fit floor plan to screen
  const prevPrintPreviewRef = useRef(isPrintPreview);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevPrintPreviewRef.current !== isPrintPreview) {
      prevPrintPreviewRef.current = isPrintPreview;
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        fitToScreen(false);
      }, 150);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [isPrintPreview, fitToScreen]);

  // Handle browser native print & custom export events
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforePrint = () => fitToScreenRef.current(false);
    const handleExportPngEvent = () => handleExport();
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('export-png', handleExportPngEvent);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
      window.removeEventListener('export-png', handleExportPngEvent);
    };
  }, [handleExport, fitToScreenRef]);

  // Wake-up redraw handler after tab cold freeze or background sleep
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleWakeUp = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        stageRef.current?.batchDraw();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleWakeUp);
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleWakeUp);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleWakeUp);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleWakeUp);
    };
  }, [stageRef]);
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/LayoutTabParts/useMiniGanttData.ts ==================== */
import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Project, Task } from '../../types';
import { useAppStore } from '../../store/useAppStore';
import { parseDateTime, getTaskStatus } from '../../lib/utils';
import { sortGroupTasks, extractSubtaskIndex } from '../../lib/ganttUtils';
import { safeSetItemLocal, safeSetItemSession } from '../../lib/storage';

export const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'Jan',
  'Feb',
  'Mar',
  'Apr',
  'May',
  'Jun',
  'Jul',
  'Aug',
  'Sep',
  'Oct',
  'Nov',
  'Dec',
];

export const formatMonthDay = (d: Date | null): string => {
  if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  const month = MONTH_NAMES[d.getMonth()];
  const day = d.getDate();
  return `${month} ${day}`;
};

export const getBarColor = (status: string, duration?: string | number) => {
  if (
    duration !== undefined &&
    duration !== '' &&
    parseFloat(String(duration)) === 0
  )
    return 'bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 border border-amber-600';
  const s = String(status || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (s === 'completed' || s === 'done')
    return 'bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 border border-emerald-600';
  if (s === 'on process' || s === 'in progress')
    return 'bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 border border-blue-600';
  if (s === 'delayed' || s === 'delay' || s === 'overdue')
    return 'bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-600 border border-rose-600';
  if (s === 'upcoming' || s === 'planned')
    return 'bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-500 dark:hover:bg-slate-400 border border-slate-500/80';
  if (s === 'handover')
    return 'bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 border border-blue-600';
  if (s === 'canceled' || s === 'cancelled')
    return 'bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-400 text-slate-600 border border-slate-400';
  return 'bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-500 border border-slate-500/80';
};

export interface MiniGanttRow {
  task: Task;
  isChild: boolean;
  hasChildren: boolean;
  childCount: number;
}

export function useMiniGanttData(project: Project | null, onClose: () => void) {
  const tasks = useAppStore((state) => state.tasks);
  const setActiveTab = useAppStore((state) => state.setActiveTab);
  const isTasksRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.isTasksRequested);
  const setIsTasksRequested = useAppStore((state) => state.setIsTasksRequested);

  // Ensure tasks are fetched from Firestore when Mini Gantt is opened
  useEffect(() => {
    if (project && !isTasksRequested) {
      setIsTasksRequested(true);
    }
  }, [project, isTasksRequested, setIsTasksRequested]);

  // Raw tasks for this project (matching Main Gantt getGroupTasksForProject logic)
  const rawProjectTasks = useMemo(() => {
    if (!project) return [];

    const pId = project.id ? String(project.id) : '';
    const pCode = (project.code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    const pYear = project.year ? String(project.year).trim() : '';
    const pStore = project.store ? String(project.store).trim().toUpperCase() : '';

    const matchedZustandTasks = tasks.filter((t) => {
      if (t.isDeleted) return false;
      if (pId && t.projectId && String(t.projectId) === pId) return true;
      const tCode = String(t.projectCode || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (!tCode || tCode !== pCode) return false;
      const tYear = t.projectYear ? String(t.projectYear).trim() : '';
      const tStore = t.projectStore ? String(t.projectStore).trim().toUpperCase() : '';
      if (pYear && tYear && tYear !== pYear) return false;
      if (pStore && tStore && tStore !== pStore) return false;
      return true;
    });

    if (matchedZustandTasks.length > 0) {
      return matchedZustandTasks;
    }

    if (project.taskSummaries && project.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
      return project.taskSummaries.map((ts: any, idx: number) => {
        const subtaskNum = extractSubtaskIndex(ts.taskCodePhu);
        const derivedOrderIndex =
          subtaskNum !== null
            ? subtaskNum - 1
            : ts.orderIndex !== undefined && ts.orderIndex !== null
            ? ts.orderIndex
            : idx;
        const fallbackCode = subtaskNum !== null ? `#${subtaskNum}` : ts.taskCodePhu || '';

        let durStr = '1';
        if (ts.duration !== undefined && ts.duration !== null && String(ts.duration).trim() !== '') {
          durStr = String(ts.duration).trim();
        }

        return {
          id: ts.id || ts.taskId || `ts_${idx}`,
          name: ts.name || 'Task',
          start: ts.start || '',
          finish: ts.finish || '',
          duration: durStr,
          taskCodePhu: fallbackCode,
          runningStatus: ts.runningStatus || (ts.approval === 'Approved' ? 'Completed' : 'Upcoming'),
          approval: ts.approval,
          party: ts.party,
          parentTaskId: ts.parentTaskId,
          projectCode: project.code,
          projectId: project.id,
          orderIndex: derivedOrderIndex,
        } as Task;
      });
    }

    return [];
  }, [project, tasks]);

  // Exact Main Gantt (useGanttVirtualization.ts) task ordering & hierarchy
  const orderedGanttRows: MiniGanttRow[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (rawProjectTasks.length === 0) return [];

    const pTasks = sortGroupTasks(rawProjectTasks);

    // Group parent and child tasks (identical to Main Gantt)
    const parentTasks: Task[] = [];
    const childTasksMap = new Map<string, Task[]>();

    // Index tasks in project by ID and taskCodePhu for robust parent matching
    const projectTaskById = new Map<string, Task>();
    const projectTaskByCode = new Map<string, Task>();
    pTasks.forEach((t) => {
      if (t.id) projectTaskById.set(String(t.id), t);
      if (t.taskCodePhu) {
        projectTaskByCode.set(String(t.taskCodePhu).trim().toLowerCase(), t);
      }
    });

    pTasks.forEach((t) => {
      const rawParentId = t.parentTaskId || (t as any).parentId;
      if (rawParentId) {
        const parentKey = String(rawParentId).trim().toLowerCase();
        const matchedParent =
          projectTaskById.get(String(rawParentId)) || projectTaskByCode.get(parentKey);
        const effectiveParentId = matchedParent ? matchedParent.id : String(rawParentId);

        if (!childTasksMap.has(effectiveParentId)) {
          childTasksMap.set(effectiveParentId, []);
        }
        childTasksMap.get(effectiveParentId)!.push(t);
      } else {
        parentTasks.push(t);
      }
    });

    // Exactly like Main Gantt: sort parent tasks independently
    const sortedParentTasks = sortGroupTasks(parentTasks);

    const rows: MiniGanttRow[] = [];

    sortedParentTasks.forEach((t) => {
      const rawChildren = childTasksMap.get(t.id) || [];
      // Exactly like Main Gantt: sort child tasks of this parent independently
      const children = sortGroupTasks(rawChildren);
      const hasChildren = children.length > 0;

      rows.push({
        task: t,
        isChild: false,
        hasChildren,
        childCount: children.length,
      });

      if (hasChildren) {
        children.forEach((c) => {
          rows.push({
            task: c,
            isChild: true,
            hasChildren: false,
            childCount: 0,
          });
        });
      }
    });

    return rows;
  }, [rawProjectTasks]);

  // Calculate timeline bounding dates
  const timelineBounds = useMemo(() => {
    if (!project) {
      const now = new Date().getTime();
      return {
        startDate: new Date(now),
        finishDate: new Date(now + 30 * 86400000),
        totalDays: 30,
      };
    }
    const dates: number[] = [];

    const projStart = parseDateTime(project.computedTakStart || project.start);
    const projFinish = parseDateTime(
      project.computedTakCompl || project.handover || project.opening
    );
    if (projStart) dates.push(projStart.getTime());
    if (projFinish) dates.push(projFinish.getTime());

    rawProjectTasks.forEach((t) => {
      const s = parseDateTime(t.start);
      const f = parseDateTime(t.finish);
      if (s) dates.push(s.getTime());
      if (f) dates.push(f.getTime());
    });

    const now = new Date().getTime();
    if (dates.length === 0) {
      return {
        startDate: new Date(now),
        finishDate: new Date(now + 30 * 86400000),
        totalDays: 30,
      };
    }

    const minTime = Math.min(...dates);
    const maxTime = Math.max(...dates);
    const totalDays = Math.max(1, Math.round((maxTime - minTime) / 86400000) + 1);

    return {
