                onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('review')}
                className={cn(
                  "flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all duration-200",
                  activeSubTab === 'review' 
                    ? "bg-brand-600/30 text-brand-300 border border-brand-500/40 shadow-sm" 
                    : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
                )}
              >
                <Eye size={11} />
                Review
              </button>
            </div>
            
            <button 
              onClick={() => setIsTabFullscreen(true)}
              className="p-1.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-semibold"
              title="Toàn màn hình Workspace"
            >
              <Maximize2 size={12} />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Toàn Màn Hình</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Content Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 w-full h-full rounded-xl border border-slate-800 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col z-0 bg-[#141416]">
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
          <motion.div
            key={activeSubTab}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
          >
            {renderTabContent()}
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>

      {/* Fullscreen Overlay */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isTabFullscreen && (
          <motion.div 
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] bg-bg-dark p-6 lg:p-12 overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
              <div className="flex bg-slate-900/50 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('edit')}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex items-center gap-2 px-8 py-3 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold uppercase transition-all",
                    activeSubTab === 'edit' ? "bg-brand-600 text-white shadow-lg" : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-200"
                  )}
                >
                  <Edit3 size={16} /> Edit
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('dynamic-hierarchy')}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex items-center gap-2 px-8 py-3 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold uppercase transition-all",
                    activeSubTab === 'dynamic-hierarchy' ? "bg-brand-600 text-white shadow-lg" : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-200"
                  )}
                >
                  <GitMerge size={16} /> Dynamic Hierarchy
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('review')}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex items-center gap-2 px-8 py-3 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold uppercase transition-all",
                    activeSubTab === 'review' ? "bg-brand-600 text-white shadow-lg" : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-200"
                  )}
                >
                  <Eye size={16} /> Review
                </button>
              </div>

              <button 
                onClick={() => setIsTabFullscreen(false)}
                className="w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-800 hover:bg-red-600 text-white rounded-2xl transition-all shadow-xl"
              >
                <X size={24} />
              </button>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative glass border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-8">
              <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                <motion.div
                  key={`fs-${activeSubTab}`}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                  className="h-full"
                >
                  {renderTabContent()}
                </motion.div>
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
});



/* ==================== FILE: src/components/PictureMapping/components/R2UploadModal.tsx ==================== */
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { 
  X, CloudUpload, Settings, Key, GripHorizontal, 
  CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, HelpCircle, Copy, Check, 
  ChevronDown, ChevronUp, RefreshCw 
} from 'lucide-react';
import Draggable from 'react-draggable';
import { testR2Connection } from '../lib/r2Upload';
import { cn } from '../lib/utils';
import { useAppStore } from '../../../store/useAppStore';
import { doc, setDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../../lib/firebase';

interface R2UploadModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onStartExport: () => void;
  uploading: boolean;
  uploadProgress: number;
  statusMessage?: string;
}

const CORS_SAMPLE_JSON = `[
  {
    "AllowedOrigins": ["*"],
    "AllowedMethods": ["GET", "PUT", "POST", "DELETE", "HEAD"],
    "AllowedHeaders": ["*"],
    "ExposeHeaders": [],
    "MaxAgeSeconds": 3000
  }
]`;

export default function R2UploadModal({ isOpen, onClose, onStartExport, uploading, uploadProgress, statusMessage }: R2UploadModalProps) {
  const nodeRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [accountId, setAccountId] = useState('');
  const [accessKey, setAccessKey] = useState('');
  const [secretKey, setSecretKey] = useState('');
  const [bucketName, setBucketName] = useState('');
  const [cfZoneId, setCfZoneId] = useState('');
  const [cfApiToken, setCfApiToken] = useState('');
  const [showConfig, setShowConfig] = useState(true);
  const [showGuide, setShowGuide] = useState(false);
  const [copiedCors, setCopiedCors] = useState(false);
  const [testStatus, setTestStatus] = useState<{ state: 'idle' | 'testing' | 'success' | 'error'; message: string }>({
    state: 'idle',
    message: '',
  });

  const r2Config = useAppStore(state => state.r2Config);
  const setR2Config = useAppStore(state => state.setR2Config);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Ưu tiên lấy từ global store (đồng bộ từ Server), nếu không có mới lấy local storage
    const storedAccountId = r2Config?.accountId || (localStorage.getItem('r2_account_id') || '').trim();
    const storedAccessKey = r2Config?.accessKeyId || (localStorage.getItem('r2_access_key') || localStorage.getItem('r2_access_key_id') || '').trim();
    const storedSecretKey = r2Config?.secretAccessKey || (localStorage.getItem('r2_secret_key') || localStorage.getItem('r2_secret_access_key') || '').trim();
    const storedBucketName = r2Config?.bucketName || (localStorage.getItem('r2_bucket_name') || '').trim();
    const storedCfZoneId = (localStorage.getItem('cf_zone_id') || '').trim();
    const storedCfApiToken = (localStorage.getItem('cf_api_token') || '').trim();

    setAccountId(storedAccountId);
    setAccessKey(storedAccessKey);
    setSecretKey(storedSecretKey);
    setBucketName(storedBucketName);
    setCfZoneId(storedCfZoneId);
    setCfApiToken(storedCfApiToken);
    setTestStatus({ state: 'idle', message: '' });

    if (storedAccountId && storedAccessKey && storedSecretKey && storedBucketName) {
      setShowConfig(false);
    } else {
      setShowConfig(true);
    }
  }, [isOpen, r2Config]);

  const handleCopyCors = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(CORS_SAMPLE_JSON);
    setCopiedCors(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedCors(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleTestConnection = async () => {
    const cleanAccountId = accountId.trim();
    const cleanBucketName = bucketName.trim();
    const cleanAccessKey = accessKey.trim();
    const cleanSecretKey = secretKey.trim();

    if (!cleanAccountId || !cleanBucketName || !cleanAccessKey || !cleanSecretKey) {
      setTestStatus({
        state: 'error',
        message: 'Vui lòng điền đủ 4 trường: Account ID, Bucket Name, Access Key và Secret Key trước khi test.',
      });
      return;
    }

    setTestStatus({ state: 'testing', message: 'Đang gửi file kiểm tra kết nối & CORS lên Cloudflare R2...' });
    const res = await testR2Connection({
      accountId: cleanAccountId,
      bucketName: cleanBucketName,
      accessKeyId: cleanAccessKey,
      secretAccessKey: cleanSecretKey,
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      setTestStatus({ state: 'success', message: res.message });
    } else {
      setTestStatus({ state: 'error', message: res.message });
    }
  };

  const handleSaveAndUpload = async () => {
    const cleanAccountId = accountId.trim();
    const cleanAccessKey = accessKey.trim();
    const cleanSecretKey = secretKey.trim();
    const cleanBucketName = bucketName.trim();
    const cleanCfZoneId = cfZoneId.trim();
    const cleanCfApiToken = cfApiToken.trim();

    if (cleanAccessKey && cleanSecretKey && cleanAccessKey === cleanSecretKey) {
      alert('Lỗi cấu hình Cloudflare R2:\nSecret Access Key đang bị trùng khớp với Access Key ID!\n\nTrong Cloudflare R2:\n- Access Key ID: chuỗi 32 ký tự hex (vd: 53fdcb...)\n- Secret Access Key: chuỗi 64 ký tự hex (vd: a1b2c3d4...)\n\nVui lòng kiểm tra lại Cloudflare Dashboard > R2 > Manage R2 API Tokens để lấy đúng Secret Access Key.');
      return;
    }

    localStorage.setItem('r2_account_id', cleanAccountId);
    localStorage.setItem('r2_access_key', cleanAccessKey);
    localStorage.setItem('r2_access_key_id', cleanAccessKey);
    localStorage.setItem('r2_secret_key', cleanSecretKey);
    localStorage.setItem('r2_secret_access_key', cleanSecretKey);
    localStorage.setItem('r2_bucket_name', cleanBucketName);
    localStorage.setItem('cf_zone_id', cleanCfZoneId);
    localStorage.setItem('cf_api_token', cleanCfApiToken);

    // Đồng bộ cấu hình lên Firestore để dùng chung toàn hệ thống
    if (cleanAccountId && cleanBucketName && cleanAccessKey && cleanSecretKey) {
      const configData = {
        accountId: cleanAccountId,
        bucketName: cleanBucketName,
        accessKeyId: cleanAccessKey,
        secretAccessKey: cleanSecretKey
      };
      setR2Config(configData);
      try {
        await setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "r2_credentials"), configData);
        await setDoc(doc(db, "artifacts", APP_ID, "public", "data", "taka_config", "versions"), { 
          r2Version: Date.now(),
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        }, { merge: true });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Lỗi khi lưu cấu hình R2 lên server:", e);
      }
    }

    if (window.confirm("Đồng ý lưu bản mới lên Cloudflare R2?\nHệ thống sẽ tự động dọn dẹp các bản cũ trên R2 để chỉ lưu 1 version duy nhất, tránh rác lưu trữ.\nĐồng thời, khoá kết nối R2 sẽ được đồng bộ lên Server cho toàn hệ thống.")) {
      onStartExport();
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen || !mounted) return null;

  const isConfigured = accountId.trim() && bucketName.trim() && accessKey.trim() && secretKey.trim();

  const modalContent = (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[999999] bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-150 overflow-hidden">
      <Draggable
        disabled={typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 640}
        handle=".modal-handle"
        bounds="parent"
        nodeRef={nodeRef}
        cancel="button, input, select, textarea, .no-drag"
      >
        <div 
          ref={nodeRef} 
          className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-lg max-w-[calc(100vw-1rem)] sm:max-w-lg max-h-[88vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden my-auto pointer-events-auto"
        >
          <div className="modal-handle cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-slate-800 shrink-0 bg-slate-900/95 select-none">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <GripHorizontal className="text-slate-500 shrink-0" size={18} />
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2 font-sans">
                <CloudUpload className="text-amber-400" size={20} />
                Upload to Cloudflare R2
              </h2>
            </div>
            <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg transition-colors no-drag">
              <X size={20} />
            </button>
          </div>

        <div className="p-5 space-y-4 font-sans overflow-y-auto flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
          {!showConfig && isConfigured ? (
            <div className="bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-xl space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Key size={12} className="text-amber-500" /> Cấu hình hiện tại
                </span>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setShowConfig(true)} 
                  className="text-xs text-amber-500 hover:text-amber-400 font-bold transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
                  disabled={uploading}
                >
                  <Settings size={12} /> Cài đặt lại
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm text-slate-300 space-y-1.5 font-mono text-[13px]">
                <div><span className="text-slate-500 font-sans">Bucket:</span> <span className="text-amber-400">{bucketName}</span></div>
                <div><span className="text-slate-500 font-sans">Account ID:</span> {accountId.substring(0, 12)}...</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {isConfigured && (
                <div className="flex justify-end">
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => setShowConfig(false)} 
                    className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 transition-colors font-medium"
                    disabled={uploading}
                  >
                    ← Ẩn bảng điền API
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Collapsible Guide */}
              <div className="border border-slate-800 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/60 overflow-hidden">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowGuide(!showGuide)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 hover:bg-slate-900/60 transition-colors"
                >
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <HelpCircle size={14} /> Hướng dẫn điền & Khắc phục lỗi (CORS / Token)
                  </span>
                  {showGuide ? <ChevronUp size={14} /> : <ChevronDown size={14} />}
                </button>

                {showGuide && (
                  <div className="p-3.5 border-t border-slate-800/80 text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-3 bg-slate-900/30">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <p className="font-bold text-amber-300">1. Khi tạo R2 API Token trong Cloudflare:</p>
                      <p>• Quyền (Permissions): Chọn <strong className="text-white bg-slate-800 px-1 py-0.5 rounded">Object Read & Write</strong> (hoặc Admin Read & Write). <span className="text-rose-400">Không chọn Object Read Only</span>.</p>
                      <p>• Account ID: Xem ở cột phải trang chính R2 trong Cloudflare.</p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-1.5 border-t border-slate-800 pt-2">
                      <p className="font-bold text-amber-300">2. Cấu hình CORS (Nguyên nhân 99% lỗi khi Save):</p>
                      <p>• Vào Cloudflare Dashboard &gt; <strong>R2</strong> &gt; Chọn <strong>Bucket của bạn</strong> &gt; Tab <strong>Settings</strong> &gt; Cuộn xuống mục <strong>CORS Policy</strong> &gt; Bấm <strong>Add CORS policy</strong>.</p>
                      <div className="relative">
                        <pre className="p-2 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-400 overflow-x-auto max-h-28">
                          {CORS_SAMPLE_JSON}
                        </pre>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={handleCopyCors}
                          className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 px-2 py-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-[10px] rounded flex items-center gap-1 border border-slate-700 transition-colors"
                        >
                          {copiedCors ? <Check size={11} className="text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy size={11} />}
                          {copiedCors ? 'Đã copy!' : 'Copy JSON'}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">Account ID</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={accountId}
                  onChange={(e) => setAccountId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500 text-sm font-mono transition-colors"
                  placeholder="e.g. 1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j"
                  disabled={uploading}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">Bucket Name</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={bucketName}
                  onChange={(e) => setBucketName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500 text-sm font-mono transition-colors"
                  placeholder="e.g. my-taka-exports"
                  disabled={uploading}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">Access Key ID</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={accessKey}
                  onChange={(e) => setAccessKey(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500 text-sm font-mono transition-colors"
                  placeholder="e.g. YOUR_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
                  disabled={uploading}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">Secret Access Key</label>
                <input
                  type="password"
                  value={secretKey}
                  onChange={(e) => setSecretKey(e.target.value)}
                  className={cn(
                    "w-full bg-slate-950 border rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none text-sm font-mono transition-colors",
                    accessKey.trim() && secretKey.trim() && accessKey.trim() === secretKey.trim()
                      ? "border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-500 text-rose-200"
                      : "border-slate-700 focus:border-amber-500"
                  )}
                  placeholder="e.g. YOUR_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
                  disabled={uploading}
                />
                {accessKey.trim() && secretKey.trim() && accessKey.trim() === secretKey.trim() && (
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-rose-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                    ⚠️ Secret Access Key đang bị trùng với Access Key ID! Key bí mật của Cloudflare R2 là chuỗi 64 ký tự hex.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Test Connection Button & Status */}
              <div className="pt-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleTestConnection}
                  disabled={uploading || testStatus.state === 'testing' || !accountId || !bucketName || !accessKey || !secretKey}
                  className="w-full py-2 px-3 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                >
                  {testStatus.state === 'testing' ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw size={13} className="animate-spin text-amber-400" />
                      <span>Đang kiểm tra kết nối và CORS...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle2 size={13} className="text-emerald-400" />
                      <span>Kiểm tra kết nối & CORS trước khi Lưu</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>

                {testStatus.state === 'success' && (
                  <div className="mt-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-800/80 text-xs text-emerald-300 flex items-start gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle2 size={15} className="text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <span>{testStatus.message}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {testStatus.state === 'error' && (
                  <div className="mt-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-800/80 text-xs text-rose-300 flex items-start gap-2">
                    <AlertCircle size={15} className="text-rose-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <span>{testStatus.message}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              
              <div className="pt-2 mt-4 border-t border-slate-800">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 uppercase mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5"><Settings size={14} className="text-brand-400"/> Tùy chọn xóa Cache</h3>
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">Cloudflare Zone ID (Tùy chọn)</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={cfZoneId}
                      onChange={(e) => setCfZoneId(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 text-sm font-mono transition-colors"
                      placeholder="e.g. 023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
                      disabled={uploading}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">CF API Token (Quyền Purge Cache, Tùy chọn)</label>
                    <input
                      type="password"
                      value={cfApiToken}
                      onChange={(e) => setCfApiToken(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 text-sm font-mono transition-colors"
                      placeholder="e.g. xyZabc123"
                      disabled={uploading}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {uploading && (
            <div className="bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-800/60 p-4 rounded-xl space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-amber-300">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-amber-400 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                  {statusMessage || 'Đang tải file lên Cloudflare R2...'}
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono text-amber-400 font-bold">{uploadProgress}%</span>
              </div>
              <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden border border-slate-700/60">
                <div 
                  className="bg-amber-500 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ease-out"
                  style={{ width: `${uploadProgress}%` }}
                ></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="pt-2 text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-800/40 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-300 font-semibold">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400"></span>
              Chế độ Lưu 1 Version Duy Nhất (Chống Rác R2)
            </div>
            <p>Hệ thống tự động lưu phiên bản mới và <strong className="text-white">quét xóa toàn bộ các bản xuất cũ</strong> trên bucket R2 để tránh rác và không tốn chi phí lưu trữ.</p>
            <p className="text-amber-500/80"><strong className="text-amber-500">Lưu ý cấu hình:</strong> Đảm bảo cấu hình CORS trên Cloudflare R2 Bucket cho phép các method <code className="text-slate-300 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 px-1 rounded">GET, PUT, DELETE</code>.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-800 flex justify-end gap-3 bg-slate-900/50">
          <button 
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 rounded-lg transition-colors text-sm font-medium font-sans"
            disabled={uploading}
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handleSaveAndUpload}
            disabled={uploading || !accountId.trim() || !bucketName.trim() || !accessKey.trim() || !secretKey.trim()}
            className="px-4 py-2 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 disabled:bg-slate-700 disabled:text-slate-500 text-white rounded-lg transition-colors text-sm font-bold font-sans flex items-center justify-center min-w-[120px]"
          >
            {uploading ? (
              <>
                <div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mr-2"></div>
                Uploading...
              </>
            ) : (!showConfig && isConfigured ? "Upload Now" : "Save & Upload")}
          </button>
        </div>
        </div>
      </Draggable>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined' ? createPortal(modalContent, document.body) : null;
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/PictureMapping/hooks/useDynamicRules.ts ==================== */
import { useMemo, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { UnitShape, MapVersion, GroupRule } from '../components/DataMapping/types';
import { SummaryDataItem, calculateSummaryData } from '../lib/summaryData';
import { useAppStore } from '../../../store/useAppStore';
import { useDataStore } from '../DataContext';
import {
  enrichProjects,
  getStatus,
  computeProjectActStatus,
  extractAllProjectCodes,
  projectMatchesUnitCode,
  extractProjectMetadata,
  projectMatchesScope,
} from '../../../lib/utils';

// ============================================================================
// TIER 1: MEMORY EVALUATION (0ms - 100% RAM EXECUTION)
// Evaluates rules on units in RAM (<3ms) with zero Firestore reads/writes.
// ============================================================================

export function matchRuleAgainstData(rule: GroupRule, data: Record<string, any>): boolean {
  let val = data[rule.field];
  const f = String(rule.field || '').toLowerCase().trim();

  // 1. Explicit App Data / Real-time Project checks (Strictly from App Projects & Live Task Summaries - ZERO Excel)
  if (f === 'appprojectstatus' || f === 'appstatus' || f === 'app: status' || f === 'status' || f === 'projectstatus') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectStatus || '') : '';
  } else if (f === 'apptask' || f === 'app: task' || f === 'app: task summarize' || f === 'app: task summaries' || f === 'app: tasks' || f === 'task' || f === 'tasks' || f === 'tasksummaries' || f === 'task summarize' || f === 'task summary' || f === 'task name') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.task || '') : '';
  } else if (f === 'appprojectyear' || f === 'appyear' || f === 'app: year') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectYear || '') : '';
  } else if (f === 'appprojectcode' || f === 'appcode' || f === 'app: project code') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectCode || '') : '';
  } else if (f === 'appprojectfloor' || f === 'appfloor' || f === 'app: floor') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.location || data.floor || '') : '';
  } else if (f === 'appprojectmdstatus' || f === 'appmdstatus' || f === 'app: md status' || f === 'app:md status') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectMdStatus || '') : '';
  } else if (f === 'appprojectactstatus' || f === 'appactstatus' || f === 'app: act status' || f === 'app:act status' || f === 'actstatus') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectActStatus || '') : '';
  } else if (f === 'appprojectdetail' || f === 'appdetail' || f === 'app: detail (project)' || f === 'detail') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectDetail || '') : '';
  } else if (f === 'appprojectdescription' || f === 'appdescription' || f === 'app: description (project)' || f === 'description (project)') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectDescription || '') : '';
  } else if (f === 'appprojectparty' || f === 'appparty' || f === 'app: party' || f === 'party') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectParty || '') : '';
  } else if (f === 'appprojectbudget' || f === 'appbudget' || f === 'app: budget' || f === 'budget') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectBudget ?? 0) : 0;
  } else if (f === 'appprojectactual' || f === 'appactual' || f === 'app: actual' || f === 'actual') {
    val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectActual ?? 0) : 0;
  } else if (val === undefined || val === null || String(val).trim() === '') {
    // 2. General attribute fallbacks
    if (f === 'floor' || f === 'location') {
      val = data.floor || data.location || '';
    } else if (f === 'year') {
      val = data.year || '';
    } else if (f === 'mdstatus') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectMdStatus || data.mdStatus || '') : (data.mdStatus || '');
    } else if (f === 'unit' || f === 'code') {
      val = data.unit || data.appProjectCode || '';
    }
  }

  if (rule.field === 'margin' || rule.field === 'marginByCp' || rule.field === 'hcmMargin') {
    val = Number(val) * 100; // evaluate margin as percentage, e.g. 25 instead of 0.25
  }

  const numVal = Number(rule.value);
  const isNum = !isNaN(numVal) && String(rule.value || '').trim() !== '';

  let compareValStr = String(val ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
  let compareRuleStr = String(rule.value ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (compareRuleStr === 'in progress') compareRuleStr = 'on process';
  if (compareValStr === 'in progress') compareValStr = 'on process';

  switch (rule.operator) {
    case '>':
      return isNum ? Number(val) > numVal : false;
    case '<':
      return isNum ? Number(val) < numVal : false;
    case '>=':
      return isNum ? Number(val) >= numVal : false;
    case '<=':
      return isNum ? Number(val) <= numVal : false;
    case '=':
      return compareValStr === compareRuleStr;
    case 'contains': {
      const searchTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      return searchTerms.every((term) => compareValStr.includes(term));
    }
    case 'or':
    case 'OR': {
      const orTerms = compareRuleStr
        .split(/[\r\n\t,;+/&|]+|\s{2,}/)
        .map((t) => {
          let tr = t.trim();
          if (tr === 'in progress') tr = 'on process';
          return tr;
        })
        .filter(Boolean);
      if (orTerms.length === 0) {
        const spaceTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        return spaceTerms.some((term) => compareValStr === term || compareValStr.includes(term));
      }
      return orTerms.some((term) => {
        if (compareValStr === term) return true;
        if (compareValStr.includes(term)) return true;
        if (isNum && !isNaN(Number(term)) && Number(val) === Number(term)) return true;
        return false;
      });
    }
    case 'exclude': {
      const searchTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      return !searchTerms.some((term) => compareValStr.includes(term));
    }
    default:
      return false;
  }
}

export function evaluateRulesOnUnits(
  units: UnitShape[],
  rules: GroupRule[] | undefined,
  dataMap: Record<string, any>
): string[] {
  if (!rules || rules.length === 0) return [];
  const matchedIds: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < units.length; i++) {
    const u = units[i];
    const uName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase();
    const data = uName ? dataMap[uName] : null;
    if (data && rules.every((r) => matchRuleAgainstData(r, data))) {
      matchedIds.push(u.id);
    }
  }
  return matchedIds;
}

export interface UseDynamicRulesOptions {
  units: UnitShape[];
  versions?: MapVersion[];
  setVersions?: (v: MapVersion[]) => void;
  setUnits?: (u: UnitShape[]) => void;
  summaryData?: SummaryDataItem[];
  store?: 'HCM' | 'HN';
  location?: string;
  year?: string;
  autoEvaluate?: boolean;
  onDirtyChange?: () => void;
}

export function useDynamicRules(
  unitsOrOptions: UnitShape[] | UseDynamicRulesOptions,
  legacySummaryData?: SummaryDataItem[]
) {
  // Normalize input options
  const isOptionsObject = !Array.isArray(unitsOrOptions) && typeof unitsOrOptions === 'object';
  const options: UseDynamicRulesOptions = isOptionsObject
    ? (unitsOrOptions as UseDynamicRulesOptions)
    : {
        units: unitsOrOptions as UnitShape[],
        summaryData: legacySummaryData,
      };

  const units = options.units || [];
  const versions = options.versions;
  const setVersions = options.setVersions;
  const setUnits = options.setUnits;
  const store = options.store || 'HCM';
  const location = options.location || 'L1';
  const year = options.year;
  const autoEvaluate = options.autoEvaluate ?? false;
  const onDirtyChange = options.onDirtyChange;

  // Reactively track projects and tasks from Zustand Global Store
  const projects = useAppStore((state) => state.projects || []);
  const tasks = useAppStore((state) => state.tasks || []);
  const delegationGroups = useAppStore((state) => state.delegationGroups || []);
  const globalYearFilter = useAppStore((state) => state.globalYearFilter);
  const effectiveYear = year || (globalYearFilter && globalYearFilter !== 'all' ? globalYearFilter : '2026');

  // Reactively track data from DataContext if summaryData wasn't passed
  const unitInfo = useDataStore((state) => state.unitInfo);
  const classInfo = useDataStore((state) => state.classInfo);
  const actualClassInfo = useDataStore((state) => state.actualClassInfo);
  const sales = useDataStore((state) => state.sales);
  const profits = useDataStore((state) => state.profits);
  const subFees = useDataStore((state) => state.subFees);
  const mdStatus = useDataStore((state) => state.mdStatus);
  const projectStatus = useDataStore((state) => state.projectStatus);
  const projectLink = useDataStore((state) => state.projectLink);
  const basePlan = useDataStore((state) => state.basePlan);
  const storeUnits = useDataStore((state) => state.units);

  const enrichedProjects = useMemo(() => enrichProjects(projects, tasks, delegationGroups), [projects, tasks, delegationGroups]);

  const internalSummaryData = useMemo(() => {
    if (options.summaryData && options.summaryData.length > 0) {
      return options.summaryData;
    }
    return calculateSummaryData({
      unitInfo,
      classInfo,
      actualClassInfo,
      sales,
      profits,
      subFees,
      mdStatus,
      projectStatus,
      projectLink,
      basePlan,
      units: storeUnits,
    });
  }, [
    options.summaryData,
    unitInfo,
    classInfo,
    actualClassInfo,
    sales,
    profits,
    subFees,
    mdStatus,
    projectStatus,
    projectLink,
    basePlan,
    storeUnits,
  ]);

  const unitNamesStr = useMemo(
    () => JSON.stringify(units.map((u) => ({ id: u.id, name: u.name, location: u.location }))),
    [units]
  );

  // Aggregated Data Map (0ms RAM memoization)
  const aggregatedData = useMemo(() => {
    const dataMap: Record<string, any> = {};

    // Pre-index tasks by project code
    const tasksByCodeMap = new Map<string, any[]>();
    tasks.forEach((t) => {
      if (!t || !t.name || !t.projectCode) return;
      const tStore = String(t.projectStore || (t as any).store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
      const currentStore = String(store || '').trim();
      if (tStore && tStore !== 'ALL' && currentStore && currentStore !== 'all' && tStore !== currentStore.toUpperCase()) return;
      const tYear = String(t.projectYear || (t as any).year || '').trim();
      if (tYear && tYear !== 'ALL' && effectiveYear && effectiveYear !== 'all' && tYear !== String(effectiveYear).trim()) return;

      const rawCode = String(t.projectCode).trim().toLowerCase();
      const codeParts = rawCode.split(/[+;,/]/).map((c) => c.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      codeParts.forEach((c) => {
        let list = tasksByCodeMap.get(c);
        if (!list) {
          list = [];
          tasksByCodeMap.set(c, list);
        }
        list.push(t);
      });
    });

    const parsedUnits = JSON.parse(unitNamesStr);
    parsedUnits.forEach((u: any) => {
      const uName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase();
      if (!uName) return;
      dataMap[uName] = {
        name: u.name || '',
        id: u.id,
        unit: u.name || '',
        year: String(effectiveYear),
        store: u.store || store || 'HCM',
        location: u.location || location || 'L1',
        floor: u.location || location || '',
        hasAppProject: false,
        size: 0,
        sales: 0,
        salesByCp: 0,
        salesByHcmcate: 0,
        profit: 0,
        profitByCp: 0,
        profitByHcmcate: 0,
        margin: 0,
        marginByCp: 0,
        hcmSalesEffi: 0,
        hcmMargin: 0,
        mdStatus: '',
        task: '',
        projectStatus: '',
        actStatus: '',
        startDate: '',
        endDate: '',
        status: '',
        vendorCode: '',
        brandCode: '',
        brandName: '',
        classCode: '',
        appProjectStatus: '',
        appProjectBudget: 0,
        appProjectActual: 0,
        appProjectCode: '',
        appProjectYear: '',
      };
    });

    internalSummaryData.forEach((sumData) => {
      const key = sumData.unit?.toLowerCase();
      if (key && dataMap[key]) {
        dataMap[key].size = sumData.size || 0;
        dataMap[key].sales = sumData.salesAmount || 0;
        dataMap[key].salesByCp = sumData.salesByCp || 0;
        dataMap[key].salesByHcmcate = sumData.salesByHcmcate || 0;
        dataMap[key].profit = sumData.profitAmount || 0;
        dataMap[key].profitByCp = sumData.profitByCp || 0;
        dataMap[key].profitByHcmcate = sumData.profitByHcmcate || 0;
        dataMap[key].margin = sumData.margin || 0;
        dataMap[key].marginByCp = sumData.marginByCp || 0;
        dataMap[key].hcmSalesEffi = sumData.hcmSalesEffi || 0;
        dataMap[key].hcmMargin = sumData.hcmMargin || 0;
        dataMap[key].mdStatus = sumData.mdStatus || '';
        dataMap[key].vendorCode = sumData.vendorCode || '';
        dataMap[key].brandCode = sumData.brandCode || '';
        dataMap[key].brandName = sumData.brandName || '';
        dataMap[key].classCode = sumData.classCode || '';
        dataMap[key].floor = dataMap[key].floor || (sumData as any).floor || '';
      }
    });

    // Pre-index projectLink: maps unit name -> list of linked project codes
    const unitToProjectCodesMap = new Map<string, string[]>();
    (projectLink || []).forEach((pl: any) => {
      const u = String(pl?.unit || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const pCode = String(pl?.code || pl?.projectCode || pl?.project || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (u && pCode) {
        if (!unitToProjectCodesMap.has(u)) unitToProjectCodesMap.set(u, []);
        unitToProjectCodesMap.get(u)!.push(pCode);
      }
    });

    // Merge real-time Project data from Zustand
    enrichedProjects.forEach((p) => {
      if (!p.code && !p.linkCodes) return;

      const pMeta = extractProjectMetadata(p);
      if (!projectMatchesScope(pMeta, { store, location, year: effectiveYear })) {
        return;
      }

      const pCodes = extractAllProjectCodes(p);
      const status = getStatus(
        p.computedTakStart || p.start,
        p.computedTakCompl || p.handover,
        p.computedOpening || p.opening,
        p.code
      );

      const actStatus = (p as any).computedActStatus || (p as any).actStatus || computeProjectActStatus(p, delegationGroups);
      const detailStr = p.detail || '';
      const descStr = p.detail || (p as any).description || '';
      const partyStr = p.party || (p as any).contractor || '';
      const mdStatusStr = p.mdStatus || '';

      // Match tasks for this project
      const matchedTaskSet = new Set<any>();
      pCodes.forEach((c) => {
        const list = tasksByCodeMap.get(c);
        if (list) list.forEach((t) => matchedTaskSet.add(t));
      });
      if (p.code) {
        const list = tasksByCodeMap.get(String(p.code).trim().toLowerCase());
        if (list) list.forEach((t) => matchedTaskSet.add(t));
      }

      const now = new Date();
      let activeTaskNames: string[] = [];
      const allMatchedTasks = Array.from(matchedTaskSet);
      if (allMatchedTasks.length > 0) {
        const activeTasks = allMatchedTasks.filter((t: any) => {
          if (!t.start || !t.finish) return false;
          const start = new Date(t.start);
          const finish = new Date(t.finish);
          return now >= start && now <= finish;
        });
        activeTaskNames = activeTasks.map((t: any) => t.name);
      } else if (p.taskSummaries && p.taskSummaries.length > 0) {
        const activeTasks = p.taskSummaries.filter((t: any) => {
          if (!t.start || !t.finish) return false;
          const start = new Date(t.start);
          const finish = new Date(t.finish);
          return now >= start && now <= finish;
        });
        activeTaskNames = activeTasks.map((t: any) => t.name);
      }
      const taskSummaryStr = activeTaskNames.length > 0 
        ? activeTaskNames.join('; ')
        : (allMatchedTasks.map((t: any) => t.name).join('; ') || (p.taskSummaries?.map((t: any) => t.name).join('; ') || ''));

      const targetUnitKeys = new Set<string>();
      Object.keys(dataMap).forEach(uKey => {
        const uEntry = dataMap[uKey];
        if (!uEntry) return;
        const uStore = (uEntry.store || store || '').toUpperCase().trim();
        const uLoc = (uEntry.location || location || '').toUpperCase().trim();
        const uYr = String(uEntry.year || effectiveYear || '').trim();

        // Strict Store, Location, and Year Isolation
        if (pMeta.store && uStore && uStore !== 'ALL' && uStore !== 'all' && pMeta.store !== uStore) return;
        const isStorewide = pMeta.location === 'ALL' || pMeta.location === 'STORE' || pMeta.location === 'STOREWIDE' || pMeta.location === 'WHOLE STORE' || pMeta.location === 'ALL FLOORS';
        if (pMeta.location && uLoc && !isStorewide && pMeta.location !== uLoc) return;
        if (pMeta.year && uYr && uYr !== 'ALL' && uYr !== 'all' && pMeta.year !== uYr) return;

        const linkedCodes = [
          ...(unitToProjectCodesMap.get(uKey.toLowerCase()) || []),
          ...(uEntry.name ? (unitToProjectCodesMap.get(uEntry.name.toLowerCase()) || []) : []),
          ...(uEntry.id ? (unitToProjectCodesMap.get(uEntry.id.toLowerCase()) || []) : []),
        ];
        const isLinkedViaProjectLink = linkedCodes.some(lc => 
          pCodes.some(pc => pc.toLowerCase() === lc.toLowerCase() || projectMatchesUnitCode([pc], lc))
        );

        const isExactCode = pCodes.some(c => c.toLowerCase() === uKey.toLowerCase() || (uEntry.name && c.toLowerCase() === uEntry.name.toLowerCase()));
        if (isExactCode || isLinkedViaProjectLink || projectMatchesUnitCode(pCodes, uKey) || (uEntry.name && projectMatchesUnitCode(pCodes, uEntry.name))) {
          targetUnitKeys.add(uKey);
        }
      });

      targetUnitKeys.forEach((code) => {
        if (dataMap[code]) {
          dataMap[code].hasAppProject = true;
          dataMap[code].appProjectStatus = status;
          dataMap[code].task = taskSummaryStr;
          dataMap[code].appProjectBudget = p.budget || 0;
          dataMap[code].appProjectActual = p.actual || 0;
          dataMap[code].appProjectCode = String(p.code || code);
          dataMap[code].appProjectYear = pMeta.year || (p.year ? String(p.year) : String(effectiveYear));
          dataMap[code].year = pMeta.year || (p.year ? String(p.year) : String(effectiveYear));

          dataMap[code].appProjectMdStatus = mdStatusStr;
          dataMap[code].appMdStatus = mdStatusStr;

          dataMap[code].appProjectActStatus = actStatus;
          dataMap[code].appActStatus = actStatus;

          dataMap[code].appProjectDetail = detailStr;
          dataMap[code].appDetail = detailStr;

          dataMap[code].appProjectDescription = descStr;
          dataMap[code].appDescription = descStr;

          dataMap[code].appProjectParty = partyStr;
          dataMap[code].appParty = partyStr;
        }
      });
    });

    return dataMap;
  }, [unitNamesStr, internalSummaryData, enrichedProjects, tasks, store, location, effectiveYear, delegationGroups]);

  // Pure in-memory calculation function (< 3ms)
  const calculateNextVersions = useCallback(
    (inputVersions: MapVersion[]): { nextVersions: MapVersion[]; hasChanges: boolean } => {
      let hasChanges = false;
      const nextVersions = inputVersions.map((v) => {
        const isActive = true; // Always active
        if (!v.groups || v.groups.length === 0) return { ...v, isDynamicActive: true };

        let versionChanged = false;
        const newMappings: Record<string, string[]> = { ...(v.groupMappings || {}) };

        v.groups.forEach((group) => {
          if (!group.rules || group.rules.length === 0) {
            if (newMappings[group.id] && newMappings[group.id].length > 0) {
              newMappings[group.id] = [];
              versionChanged = true;
              hasChanges = true;
            }
            return;
          }

          const matchingUnits = evaluateRulesOnUnits(units, group.rules, aggregatedData);
          const currentMappings = newMappings[group.id] || [];

          if (
            matchingUnits.length !== currentMappings.length ||
            !matchingUnits.every((id) => currentMappings.includes(id))
          ) {
            newMappings[group.id] = matchingUnits;
            versionChanged = true;
            hasChanges = true;
          }
        });

        if (versionChanged) {
          return { ...v, groupMappings: newMappings };
        }
        return v;
      });

      return { nextVersions, hasChanges };
    },
    [units, aggregatedData]
  );

  // Reactive Memory Evaluation Effect:
  // When autoEvaluate is enabled and dependencies change, evaluate in RAM (0ms) without Firestore
  const prevEvaluatedRef = useRef<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoEvaluate || !versions || !setVersions || versions.length === 0) return;

    // Fast-path evaluation in memory
    const { nextVersions, hasChanges } = calculateNextVersions(versions);

    if (hasChanges) {
      const serialized = JSON.stringify(
        nextVersions.map((v) => ({ id: v.id, m: v.groupMappings }))
      );
      if (serialized !== prevEvaluatedRef.current) {
        prevEvaluatedRef.current = serialized;
        setVersions(nextVersions);

        // Note: Dynamic rules calculate groupMappings and display colors without corrupting base units
        onDirtyChange?.();
      }
    }
  }, [
    autoEvaluate,
    versions,
    setVersions,
    calculateNextVersions,
    units,
    setUnits,
    effectiveYear,
    onDirtyChange,
  ]);

  return {
    aggregatedData,
    calculateNextVersions,
  };
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/PictureMapping/lib/auth.ts ==================== */
import { initializeApp, getApps } from 'firebase/app';
import { getAuth, signInWithPopup, GoogleAuthProvider, onAuthStateChanged, User } from 'firebase/auth';
import firebaseConfig from '../../../../firebase-applet-config.json';

const app = getApps().length === 0 ? initializeApp(firebaseConfig) : getApps()[0];
const auth = getAuth(app);

const provider = new GoogleAuthProvider();
provider.addScope('https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file');
provider.setCustomParameters({
  prompt: 'select_account'
});

let isSigningIn = false;
let cachedAccessToken: string | null = null;

export const initAuth = (
  onAuthSuccess?: (user: User, token: string) => void,
  onAuthFailure?: () => void
) => {
  return onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user: User | null) => {
    if (user) {
      if (cachedAccessToken) {
        if (onAuthSuccess) onAuthSuccess(user, cachedAccessToken);
      } else if (!isSigningIn) {
        cachedAccessToken = null;
        if (onAuthFailure) onAuthFailure();
      }
    } else {
      cachedAccessToken = null;
      if (onAuthFailure) onAuthFailure();
    }
  });
};

export const googleSignIn = async (): Promise<{ user: User; accessToken: string } | null> => {
  try {
    isSigningIn = true;
    const result = await signInWithPopup(auth, provider);
    const credential = GoogleAuthProvider.credentialFromResult(result);
    if (!credential?.accessToken) {
      throw new Error('Failed to get access token from Firebase Auth');
    }

    cachedAccessToken = credential.accessToken;
    return { user: result.user, accessToken: cachedAccessToken };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Sign in error:', error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    isSigningIn = false;
  }
};

export const getAccessToken = async (): Promise<string | null> => {
  return cachedAccessToken;
};

export const logout = async () => {
  await auth.signOut();
  cachedAccessToken = null;
};


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/PictureMapping/lib/drive.ts ==================== */
export async function uploadFileToDrive({
  accessToken,
  fileBlob,
  fileName,
  mimeType,
  fileId,
}: {
  accessToken: string;
  fileBlob: Blob;
  fileName: string;
  mimeType: string;
  fileId?: string;
}) {
  const metadata = {
    name: fileName,
    mimeType,
  };

  const form = new FormData();
  form.append('metadata', new Blob([JSON.stringify(metadata)], { type: 'application/json' }));
  form.append('file', fileBlob);

  let uploadUrl = '';
  let method = 'POST';

  if (fileId) {
    uploadUrl = `https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files/${fileId}?uploadType=multipart`;
    method = 'PATCH';
  } else {
    // 1. Check if the file already exists (to overwrite it)
    const query = encodeURIComponent(`name='${fileName}' and trashed=false`);
    const listRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q=${query}&fields=files(id,name)`, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
      },
    });

    if (!listRes.ok) {
      throw new Error('Failed to list files from Google Drive');
    }

    const listData = await listRes.json();
    const existingFile = listData.files && listData.files.length > 0 ? listData.files[0] : null;

    if (existingFile) {
      // Overwrite existing file
      uploadUrl = `https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files/${existingFile.id}?uploadType=multipart`;
      method = 'PATCH';
    } else {
      // Create new file
      uploadUrl = 'https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=multipart';
      method = 'POST';
    }
  }

  const uploadRes = await fetch(uploadUrl, {
    method,
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
    },
    body: form,
  });

  if (!uploadRes.ok) {
    const errorData = await uploadRes.text();
    console.error('Failed to upload file:', errorData);
    throw new Error('Failed to upload file to Google Drive');
  }

  return await uploadRes.json();
}


/* ==================== FILE: src/components/PictureMapping/lib/dynamicExportService.ts ==================== */
import { doc, setDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db, APP_ID } from '../../../lib/firebase';
import { useAppStore } from '../../../store/useAppStore';
import { useDataStore } from '../DataContext';
import { UnitShape, MapVersion, GroupRule } from '../components/DataMapping/types';
import { calculateSummaryData } from './summaryData';
import { getStoredR2Credentials, getStoredR2CredentialsAsync, uploadSingleR2File, extractR2Key, getS3Sdk } from './r2Upload';
import { enrichProjects, getStatus, computeProjectActStatus, projectMatchesUnitCode } from '../../../lib/utils';

const getPartitionKey = (store: string, location: string) => `${store}_${location}`;

// Evaluates a set of rules on a unit shape using the data map
export function matchRulesAgainstUnit(unit: UnitShape, rules: GroupRule[] | undefined, dataMap: Record<string, any>): boolean {
  if (!rules || rules.length === 0) return false;
  const uName = (unit.name || '').toLowerCase();
  const data = uName ? dataMap[uName] : null;
  if (!data) return false;

  return rules.every((rule) => {
    let val = data[rule.field];
    const f = String(rule.field || '').toLowerCase().trim();

    // 1. Explicit App Data / Real-time Project checks (Strictly from App Projects & Live Task Summaries - ZERO Excel)
    if (f === 'appprojectstatus' || f === 'appstatus' || f === 'app: status' || f === 'status' || f === 'projectstatus') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectStatus || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'apptask' || f === 'app: task' || f === 'app: task summarize' || f === 'app: task summaries' || f === 'app: tasks' || f === 'task' || f === 'tasks' || f === 'tasksummaries' || f === 'task summarize' || f === 'task summary' || f === 'task name') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.task || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectyear' || f === 'appyear' || f === 'app: year') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectYear || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectcode' || f === 'appcode' || f === 'app: project code') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectCode || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectfloor' || f === 'appfloor' || f === 'app: floor') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.location || data.floor || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectmdstatus' || f === 'appmdstatus' || f === 'app: md status' || f === 'app:md status') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectMdStatus || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectactstatus' || f === 'appactstatus' || f === 'app: act status' || f === 'app:act status' || f === 'actstatus') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectActStatus || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectdetail' || f === 'appdetail' || f === 'app: detail (project)' || f === 'detail') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectDetail || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectdescription' || f === 'appdescription' || f === 'app: description (project)' || f === 'description (project)') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectDescription || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectparty' || f === 'appparty' || f === 'app: party' || f === 'party') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectParty || '') : '';
    } else if (f === 'appprojectbudget' || f === 'appbudget' || f === 'app: budget' || f === 'budget') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectBudget ?? 0) : 0;
    } else if (f === 'appprojectactual' || f === 'appactual' || f === 'app: actual' || f === 'actual') {
      val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectActual ?? 0) : 0;
    } else if (val === undefined || val === null || String(val).trim() === '') {
      // 2. General attribute fallbacks
      if (f === 'floor' || f === 'location') {
        val = data.floor || unit.location || '';
      } else if (f === 'year') {
        val = data.year || '';
      } else if (f === 'mdstatus') {
        val = data.hasAppProject ? (data.appProjectMdStatus || data.mdStatus || '') : (data.mdStatus || '');
      } else if (f === 'unit' || f === 'code') {
        val = data.unit || data.appProjectCode || unit.name || '';
      }
    }

    if (rule.field === 'margin' || rule.field === 'marginByCp') {
      val = val * 100;
    }

    const numVal = Number(rule.value);
    const isNum = !isNaN(numVal) && String(rule.value || '').trim() !== '';

    let res = false;
    let compareValStr = String(val || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    let compareRuleStr = String(rule.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (compareRuleStr === 'in progress') compareRuleStr = 'on process';
    if (compareValStr === 'in progress') compareValStr = 'on process';

    switch (rule.operator) {
      case '>':
        res = isNum ? Number(val) > numVal : false;
        break;
      case '<':
        res = isNum ? Number(val) < numVal : false;
        break;
      case '>=':
        res = isNum ? Number(val) >= numVal : false;
        break;
      case '<=':
        res = isNum ? Number(val) <= numVal : false;
        break;
      case '=':
        res = compareValStr === compareRuleStr;
        break;
      case 'contains': {
        const searchTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/);
        res = searchTerms.every((term) => compareValStr.includes(term));
        break;
      }
      case 'or':
      case 'OR': {
        const orTerms = compareRuleStr
          .split(/[\r\n\t,;+/&|]+|\s{2,}/)
          .map((t) => {
            let tr = t.trim();
            if (tr === 'in progress') tr = 'on process';
            return tr;
          })
          .filter(Boolean);
        if (orTerms.length === 0) {
          const spaceTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
          res = spaceTerms.some(term => compareValStr === term || compareValStr.includes(term));
        } else {
          res = orTerms.some((term) => {
            if (compareValStr === term) return true;
            if (compareValStr.includes(term)) return true;
            if (isNum && !isNaN(Number(term)) && Number(val) === Number(term)) return true;
            return false;
          });
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'exclude': {
        const searchTerms = compareRuleStr.split(/\s+/);
        res = !searchTerms.some((term) => compareValStr.includes(term));
        break;
      }
      default:
        res = false;
        break;
    }

    return res;
  });
}

/**
 * Helper: Tạo dataMap tương ứng với từng năm cụ thể để đánh giá rule không bị chéo năm
 */
export function buildDataMapForYear(targetYear: string, targetStore: 'HCM' | 'HN'): Record<string, any> {
  const appState = useAppStore.getState();
  const dataState = useDataStore.getState();

  const projects = appState.projects || [];
  const tasks = appState.tasks || [];
  const delegationGroups = appState.delegationGroups || [];
  const enrichedProjects = enrichProjects(projects, tasks, delegationGroups);

  const summaryData = calculateSummaryData({
    unitInfo: dataState.unitInfo,
    classInfo: dataState.classInfo,
    actualClassInfo: dataState.actualClassInfo,
    sales: dataState.sales,
    profits: dataState.profits,
    subFees: dataState.subFees,
    mdStatus: dataState.mdStatus,
    projectStatus: dataState.projectStatus,
    projectLink: dataState.projectLink,
    basePlan: dataState.basePlan,
    units: dataState.units,
  });

  const allUnits = dataState.getAllStoreUnits(targetStore);
  const dataMap: Record<string, any> = {};

  allUnits.forEach((u) => {
    const uName = (u.name || '').toLowerCase();
    if (!uName) return;
    const item = summaryData.find((s) => s.unit?.toLowerCase() === uName);
    dataMap[uName] = {
      name: u.name || '',
      id: u.id,
      unit: u.name || '',
      year: targetYear,
      size: item?.size || 0,
      sales: item?.salesAmount || 0,
      salesAmount: item?.salesAmount || 0,
      salesByCp: item?.salesByCp || 0,
      salesByHcmcate: item?.salesByHcmcate || 0,
      profit: item?.profitAmount || 0,
      profitAmount: item?.profitAmount || 0,
      profitByCp: item?.profitByCp || 0,
      profitByHcmcate: item?.profitByHcmcate || 0,
      margin: item?.margin || 0,
      marginByCp: item?.marginByCp || 0,
      hcmSalesEffi: item?.hcmSalesEffi || 0,
      hcmMargin: item?.hcmMargin || 0,
      mdStatus: item?.mdStatus || '',
      mdNotes: item?.mdNotes || '',
      task: item?.task || '',
      projectStatus: item?.projectStatus || '',
      actStatus: item?.actStatus || '',
      startDate: item?.startDate || '',
      endDate: item?.endDate || '',
      status: item?.status || '',
      vendorCode: item?.vendorCode || '',
      brandCode: item?.brandCode || '',
      brandName: item?.brandName || '',
      classCode: item?.classCode || '',
      floor: u.location || (item as any)?.floor || '',
      appProjectStatus: '',
      appProjectBudget: 0,
      appProjectActual: 0,
      appProjectCode: '',
      appProjectYear: '',
      ...(item || {}),
      unitName: u.name,
    };
  });

  summaryData.forEach((item) => {
    const key = (item.unit || '').toLowerCase();
    if (key && !dataMap[key]) {
      dataMap[key] = {
        name: item.unit || '',
        unit: item.unit || '',
        year: targetYear,
        size: item.size || 0,
        sales: item.salesAmount || 0,
        salesAmount: item.salesAmount || 0,
        salesByCp: item.salesByCp || 0,
        salesByHcmcate: item.salesByHcmcate || 0,
        profit: item.profitAmount || 0,
        profitAmount: item.profitAmount || 0,
        profitByCp: item.profitByCp || 0,
        profitByHcmcate: item.profitByHcmcate || 0,
        margin: item.margin || 0,
        marginByCp: item.marginByCp || 0,
        hcmSalesEffi: item.hcmSalesEffi || 0,
        hcmMargin: item.hcmMargin || 0,
        mdStatus: item.mdStatus || '',
        mdNotes: item.mdNotes || '',
        task: item.task || '',
        projectStatus: item.projectStatus || '',
        actStatus: item.actStatus || '',
        startDate: item.startDate || '',
        endDate: item.endDate || '',
        status: item.status || '',
        vendorCode: item.vendorCode || '',
        brandCode: item.brandCode || '',
        brandName: item.brandName || '',
        classCode: item.classCode || '',
        floor: (item as any)?.floor || '',
        appProjectStatus: '',
        appProjectBudget: 0,
        appProjectActual: 0,
        appProjectCode: '',
        appProjectYear: '',
        ...item,
        unitName: item.unit,
      };
    }
  });

  const normalizedTargetYear = String(targetYear || '').trim();

  // Pre-index projectLink: maps unit name -> list of linked project codes
  const unitToProjectCodesMap = new Map<string, string[]>();
  (dataState.projectLink || []).forEach((pl: any) => {
    const u = String(pl?.unit || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const pCode = String(pl?.code || pl?.projectCode || pl?.project || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (u && pCode) {
      if (!unitToProjectCodesMap.has(u)) unitToProjectCodesMap.set(u, []);
      unitToProjectCodesMap.get(u)!.push(pCode);
    }
  });

  enrichedProjects.forEach((p) => {
    const pYear = String(p.year || (p as any).projectYear || '').trim();
    if (normalizedTargetYear && normalizedTargetYear !== 'all' && pYear && pYear !== normalizedTargetYear) {
      return;
    }

    const rawCodes = (p.linkCodes && p.linkCodes.trim()) ? p.linkCodes : String(p.code || '');
    const pCodes = rawCodes.split(/[+;,/]/).map((c) => c.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
    const status = getStatus(
      p.computedTakStart || p.start,
      p.computedTakCompl || p.handover,
      p.computedOpening || p.opening,
      p.code
    );
    const actStatus = (p as any).computedActStatus || (p as any).actStatus || computeProjectActStatus(p, delegationGroups);
    const detailStr = p.detail || '';
    const descStr = p.detail || (p as any).description || '';
    const partyStr = p.party || (p as any).contractor || '';
    const mdStatusStr = p.mdStatus || '';

    const targetUnitKeys = new Set<string>();
    Object.keys(dataMap).forEach((uKey) => {
      const uEntry = dataMap[uKey];
      if (!uEntry) return;

      const linkedCodes = [
        ...(unitToProjectCodesMap.get(uKey.toLowerCase()) || []),
        ...(uEntry.name ? (unitToProjectCodesMap.get(uEntry.name.toLowerCase()) || []) : []),
        ...(uEntry.id ? (unitToProjectCodesMap.get(uEntry.id.toLowerCase()) || []) : []),
      ];
      const isLinkedViaProjectLink = linkedCodes.some(lc => 
        pCodes.some(pc => pc.toLowerCase() === lc.toLowerCase() || projectMatchesUnitCode([pc], lc))
      );

      const isExactCode = pCodes.some(c => c.toLowerCase() === uKey.toLowerCase() || (uEntry.name && c.toLowerCase() === uEntry.name.toLowerCase()));
      if (isExactCode || isLinkedViaProjectLink || projectMatchesUnitCode(pCodes, uKey) || (uEntry.name && projectMatchesUnitCode(pCodes, uEntry.name))) {
        targetUnitKeys.add(uKey);
      }
    });

    targetUnitKeys.forEach((code) => {
      if (dataMap[code]) {
        dataMap[code].hasAppProject = true;
        dataMap[code].appProjectStatus = status;
        dataMap[code].appProjectBudget = p.budget || 0;
        dataMap[code].appProjectActual = p.actual || 0;
        dataMap[code].appProjectCode = String(p.code);
        dataMap[code].appProjectYear = pYear || normalizedTargetYear;

        dataMap[code].appProjectMdStatus = mdStatusStr;
        dataMap[code].appMdStatus = mdStatusStr;

        dataMap[code].appProjectActStatus = actStatus;
        dataMap[code].appActStatus = actStatus;

        dataMap[code].appProjectDetail = detailStr;
        dataMap[code].appDetail = detailStr;

        dataMap[code].appProjectDescription = descStr;
        dataMap[code].appDescription = descStr;

        dataMap[code].appProjectParty = partyStr;
        dataMap[code].appParty = partyStr;

        if (!dataMap[code].year) dataMap[code].year = pYear || normalizedTargetYear;
        dataMap[code].projectStatus = status;
        if (!dataMap[code].task) dataMap[code].task = (p as any).title || (p as any).name || '';
        if (p.computedTakStart || p.start) dataMap[code].startDate = p.computedTakStart || p.start;
        if (p.computedOpening || p.opening || p.computedTakCompl || p.handover) dataMap[code].endDate = p.computedOpening || p.opening || p.computedTakCompl || p.handover;
      }
    });
  });

  return dataMap;
}

/**
 * Bước 1: Áp dụng toàn bộ rules của toàn bộ tab dynamic cho store đang xem
 */
export function applyAllDynamicRulesForStore(targetStore: 'HCM' | 'HN'): {
  updatedStoreLocationData: Record<string, { mapUnits: UnitShape[]; mapVersions: MapVersion[]; activeMapVersionId?: string | null }>;
  totalEvaluatedUnits: number;
} {
  const dataState = useDataStore.getState();
  const effectiveYear = String(useAppStore.getState().globalYearFilter || '2026').trim();

  const dataMapCache: Record<string, Record<string, any>> = {};
  const getDataMap = (year: string) => {
    const yrKey = String(year || effectiveYear || '2026').trim();
    if (!dataMapCache[yrKey]) {
      dataMapCache[yrKey] = buildDataMapForYear(yrKey, targetStore);
    }
    return dataMapCache[yrKey];
  };

  // 4. Update all partitions for this store
  const updatedStoreLocationData = { ...dataState.storeLocationData };
  let totalEvaluatedUnits = 0;

  for (const pKey in updatedStoreLocationData) {
    if (pKey.startsWith(`${targetStore}_`)) {
      const partition = updatedStoreLocationData[pKey];
      if (!partition) continue;

      const pUnits = partition.mapUnits ? [...partition.mapUnits] : [];
      const pVersions = partition.mapVersions ? [...partition.mapVersions] : [];
      const pLoc = pKey.split('_')[1] || dataState.location;

      // Evaluate rules for every version in partition using THAT VERSION'S YEAR
      const updatedVersions = pVersions.map((v) => {
        if (!v.groups || v.groups.length === 0) return v;

        const vYear = String(v.year || effectiveYear).trim();
        const yearDataMap = getDataMap(vYear);

        const newMappings: Record<string, string[]> = {};
        v.groups.forEach((group) => {
          if (group.rules && group.rules.length > 0) {
            const matchingIds = pUnits
              .filter((u) => (!v.location || !u.location || u.location === v.location || u.location === pLoc) && matchRulesAgainstUnit(u, group.rules, yearDataMap))
              .map((u) => u.id);
            newMappings[group.id] = matchingIds;
          } else {
            newMappings[group.id] = [];
          }
        });

        return {
          ...v,
          groupMappings: newMappings,
        };
      });

      // Ensure units maintain default visible styling and do not get overwritten with transparent colors
      const sanitizedUnits = pUnits.map((u) => ({
        ...u,
        fill: (u.fill && u.fill !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.001)' && u.fill !== 'transparent') ? u.fill : '#3b82f6',
      }));

      totalEvaluatedUnits += sanitizedUnits.length;
      updatedStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
        ...partition,
        mapUnits: sanitizedUnits,
        mapVersions: updatedVersions,
      };
    }
  }

  // Update Zustand store
  const currentKey = getPartitionKey(dataState.store, dataState.location);
  const activePartition = updatedStoreLocationData[currentKey];

  useDataStore.setState({
    storeLocationData: updatedStoreLocationData,
    mapUnits: activePartition?.mapUnits || dataState.mapUnits,
    mapVersions: activePartition?.mapVersions || dataState.mapVersions,
  });

  return { updatedStoreLocationData, totalEvaluatedUnits };
}

/**
 * Bước 1: Tải toàn bộ cấu hình và dữ liệu từ Cloudflare R2 về ứng dụng
 */
export async function loadStoreFromCloudR2(): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
  const creds = await getStoredR2CredentialsAsync();
  if (!creds) {
    throw new Error('Chưa cấu hình R2 Cloudflare trên hệ thống. Vui lòng cấu hình R2 trước.');
  }

  const { S3Client, GetObjectCommand, getSignedUrl } = await getS3Sdk();
  const s3 = new S3Client({
    region: 'auto',
    endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId.trim()}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
    credentials: {
      accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId.trim(),
      secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey.trim(),
    },
  });

  const command = new GetObjectCommand({
    Bucket: creds.bucketName,
    Key: 'mapping_config.json',
  });

  const signedUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, command, { expiresIn: 3600 });
  const res = await fetch(signedUrl);
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error('Không tìm thấy file mapping_config.json trên Cloudflare R2.');
  }

  const data = await res.json();
  const dataState = useDataStore.getState();

  // Convert data into normalized storeLocationData
  let normalizedStoreLocationData: Record<string, any> = {};

  if (data.storeLocationData && typeof data.storeLocationData === 'object') {
    normalizedStoreLocationData = data.storeLocationData;
  } else if (Array.isArray(data.versions) || Array.isArray(data.mapUnits) || Array.isArray(data.units)) {
    const legacyKey = `${data.store || dataState.store || 'HCM'}_${data.location || dataState.location || 'L1'}`;
    normalizedStoreLocationData = {
      [legacyKey]: {
        mapUnits: data.mapUnits || data.units || [],
        mapVersions: data.versions || [],
        activeMapVersionId: data.activeMapVersionId || data.versions?.[0]?.id || null,
      },
    };
  }

  // Merge current local partition and storeLocationData from in-memory state
  const currentKey = `${dataState.store}_${dataState.location}`;
  const allLocalPartitions: Record<string, any> = {
    ...dataState.storeLocationData,
  };
  if (dataState.mapVersions && dataState.mapVersions.length > 0) {
    allLocalPartitions[currentKey] = {
      mapUnits: dataState.mapUnits,
      mapVersions: dataState.mapVersions,
      activeMapVersionId: dataState.activeMapVersionId,
    };
  }

  for (const pKey in allLocalPartitions) {
    const localPart = allLocalPartitions[pKey];
    if (localPart && Array.isArray(localPart.mapVersions) && localPart.mapVersions.length > 0) {
      const existingR2Part = normalizedStoreLocationData[pKey];
      normalizedStoreLocationData[pKey] = {
        mapUnits: (localPart.mapUnits && localPart.mapUnits.length > 0) ? localPart.mapUnits : (existingR2Part?.mapUnits || []),
        mapVersions: localPart.mapVersions.map((lv: any) => {
          const cloudV = existingR2Part?.mapVersions?.find((cv: any) => cv.id === lv.id || cv.name === lv.name);
          return {
            ...lv,
            backgroundUrl: lv.backgroundUrl || cloudV?.backgroundUrl || '',
          };
        }),
        activeMapVersionId: localPart.activeMapVersionId || existingR2Part?.activeMapVersionId || localPart.mapVersions[0]?.id || null,
      };
    }
  }

  // Resolve all R2 background images across all partitions
  for (const pKey in normalizedStoreLocationData) {
    const partition = normalizedStoreLocationData[pKey];
    if (!partition) continue;

    const pStore = (pKey.split('_')[0] === 'HN' ? 'HN' : 'HCM') as 'HCM' | 'HN';
    const pLoc = pKey.split('_')[1] || 'L1';

    partition.mapUnits = (partition.mapUnits || []).map((u: any) => ({
      ...u,
      store: u.store || pStore,
      location: u.location || pLoc,
      visible: u.visible !== false,
      locked: !!u.locked,
    }));

    if (Array.isArray(partition.mapVersions)) {
      for (let j = 0; j < partition.mapVersions.length; j++) {
        const v = partition.mapVersions[j];
        const r2Key = extractR2Key(v.backgroundUrl) || (v as any).r2Key;

        if (r2Key) {
          try {
            const imgCommand = new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: creds.bucketName, Key: r2Key });
            const imgUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, imgCommand, { expiresIn: 3600 * 24 * 7 });
            v.backgroundUrl = imgUrl;
            (v as any).r2Key = r2Key;
          } catch (imgErr) {
            console.warn(`Lỗi tạo signed URL cho ảnh ${r2Key}:`, imgErr);
          }
        }

        const rawGroups = v.groups || [];
        const deepCopiedGroups = Array.isArray(rawGroups) ? rawGroups.map((g: any) => ({
          id: g.id,
          name: g.name,
          color: g.color,
          opacity: g.opacity,
          rules: Array.isArray(g.rules) ? g.rules.map((r: any) => ({
            field: r.field,
            operator: r.operator,
            value: r.value !== undefined ? String(r.value) : '',
          })) : [],
        })) : [];

        v.store = v.store || pStore;
        v.location = v.location || pLoc;
        v.groups = deepCopiedGroups;
        v.groupMappings = v.groupMappings || {};
        v.isDynamicActive = true;
      }
    }
  }

  if (data.globalYearFilter || data.year) {
    useAppStore.getState().setGlobalYearFilter(data.globalYearFilter || data.year);
  }

  useDataStore.getState().loadFullCloudData({
    storeLocationData: normalizedStoreLocationData,
    store: data.store || dataState.store,
    location: data.location || dataState.location,
    activeMapVersionId: data.activeMapVersionId,
    reviewSelectedLabels: data.reviewSelectedLabels || [],
    reviewLabelColors: data.reviewLabelColors || {},
    unitInfo: data.unitInfo || [],
    classInfo: data.classInfo || [],
    actualClassInfo: data.actualClassInfo || [],
    sales: data.sales || [],
    profits: data.profits || [],
    subFees: data.subFees || [],
    mdStatus: data.mdStatus || [],
    projectStatus: data.projectStatus || [],
    projectLink: data.projectLink || [],
    basePlan: data.basePlan || [],
    units: data.units || [],
  });

  return { success: true, message: 'Đã tải thành công cấu hình và dữ liệu từ Cloudflare R2.' };
}

/**
 * Bước 3: Lưu cloud của store đang xem lên R2 Cloudflare
 */
export async function saveStoreToCloudR2(
  targetStore: 'HCM' | 'HN',
  customStoreLocationData?: Record<string, { mapUnits: UnitShape[]; mapVersions: MapVersion[]; activeMapVersionId?: string | null }>
): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
  const creds = await getStoredR2CredentialsAsync();
  if (!creds) {
    throw new Error('Chưa cấu hình R2 Cloudflare trên hệ thống. Vui lòng bấm "Cấu hình R2" để kết nối.');
  }

  const { S3Client } = await getS3Sdk();
  const s3 = new S3Client({
    region: 'auto',
    endpoint: `https://${creds.accountId.trim()}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`,
    credentials: {
      accessKeyId: creds.accessKeyId.trim(),
      secretAccessKey: creds.secretAccessKey.trim(),
    },
  });
  const dataState = useDataStore.getState();
  const currentActiveKey = getPartitionKey(dataState.store || targetStore, dataState.location || 'L1');
  const baseStoreLocationData = customStoreLocationData || {
    ...dataState.storeLocationData,
    [currentActiveKey]: {
      mapUnits: dataState.mapUnits || [],
      mapVersions: dataState.mapVersions || [],
      activeMapVersionId: dataState.activeMapVersionId,
    },
  };

  // Format cloudStoreLocationData with r2:// references
  const cloudStoreLocationData: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const pKey in baseStoreLocationData) {
    const partition = baseStoreLocationData[pKey];
    if (!partition) continue;

    const pStore = pKey.split('_')[0] || targetStore;
    const pLoc = pKey.split('_')[1] || 'L1';
    const pUnits = partition.mapUnits || [];
    const pVersions = partition.mapVersions || [];

    const pVersionsCloud: any[] = [];
    for (const v of pVersions) {
      const displayUrl = (v.backgroundUrl || '').trim();
      let r2Key = extractR2Key(displayUrl) || (v as any).r2Key;

      if (displayUrl && (displayUrl.startsWith('blob:') || displayUrl.startsWith('data:'))) {
        try {
          const res = await fetch(displayUrl);
          const blob = await res.blob();
          const bgName = `bg_${v.id}_${Date.now()}.jpeg`;
          const uploadRes = await uploadSingleR2File({ name: bgName, blob }, creds, s3);
          if (uploadRes.success) {
            r2Key = uploadRes.name;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[SaveStoreToCloudR2] Error uploading bg blob:', e);
        }
      }

      const rawGroups = v.groups || [];
      const deepCopiedGroups = Array.isArray(rawGroups) ? rawGroups.map((g: any) => ({
        id: g.id,
        name: g.name,
        color: g.color,
        opacity: g.opacity,
        rules: Array.isArray(g.rules) ? g.rules.map((r: any) => ({
          field: r.field,
          operator: r.operator,
          value: r.value !== undefined ? String(r.value) : '',
        })) : [],
      })) : [];

      pVersionsCloud.push({
